pinyin: wa, zhè bù diànyǐng suīrán hěn cháng, dànshì qíngjiē tèbié xīyǐnrén.
en: Wow, although this movie is quite long, the plot is really compelling.

zh: 哇，她竟然一个人完成了这么复杂的项目，真是令人印象深刻。
pinyin: wa, tā jìngrán yīgè rén wánchéng le zhème fùzá de xiàngmù, zhēnshi lìngrén yìnxiàng shēnkè.
en: Wow, she actually completed such a complex project all by herself—that's really impressive.

zh: 我叫王名。
pinyin: Wǒ jiào Wáng Míng.
en: My name is Wang Ming.

zh: 他的名字很特别,我很喜欢。
pinyin: Tā de míngzi hěn tèbié, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
en: His name is really unique, and I like it a lot.

zh: 虽然她的名字很长,但是很容易记住。
pinyin: Suīrán tā de míngzi hěn cháng, dànshi hěn róngyì jìzhù.
en: Although her name is long, it's easy to remember.

zh: 这家公司的名声很好,所以很多人想在那里工作。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de míngsheng hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén xiǎng zài nàlǐ gōngzuò.
en: This company has a great reputation, so many people want to work there.

zh: 他因为一次成功的项目而名声大噪,现在是行业内的知名人士。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi yī cì chénggōng de xiàngmù érmiáng shēng dà zào, xiànzài shì hángyè nèi de zhīmíng rénshì.
en: He became well-known overnight because of one successful project, and now he's a prominent figure in the industry.

zh: 这些苹果很红，它们很好吃。
pinyin: Zhèxiē píngguǒ hěn hóng, tāmen hěn hǎochī.
en: These apples are very red, and they taste really good.

zh: 我有两只猫，它们每天都在睡觉。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī māo, tāmen měitiān dōu zài shuìjiào.
en: I have two cats, and they sleep all day long.

zh: 虽然这些书很旧，但是它们对我很重要。
pinyin: Suīrán zhèxiē shū hěn jiù, dànshì tāmen duì wǒ hěn zhòngyào.
en: Although these books are old, they're really important to me.

zh: 我买了几件新衣服，因为它们打折了，所以便宜很多。
pinyin: Wǒ mǎile jǐ jiàn xīn yīfu, yīnwèi tāmen dǎzhé le, suǒyǐ piányi hěn duō.
en: I bought several new clothes because they were on sale, so they were much cheaper.

zh: 这些公司虽然规模不同，但它们的发展目标基本一致。
pinyin: Zhèxiē gōngsī suīrán guīmó búntóng, dàn tāmen de fāzhǎn mùbiāo jīběn yīzhì.
en: Although these companies vary in size, their development goals are essentially aligned.

zh: 我总是吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ zǒngshì chī mǐfàn.
en: I always eat rice.

zh: 他每天总要喝一杯咖啡。
pinyin: Tā měitiān zǒngyào hē yībēi kāfēi.
en: He always has to drink a cup of coffee every day.

zh: 虽然很累，但他总是坚持去健身房。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn tā zǒngshì jiānchí qù jiànshēnfáng.
en: Even though he's tired, he always insists on going to the gym.

zh: 总的来说，这个计划比较可行，但还需要改进。
pinyin: Zǒngde lái shuō, zhège jìhuà bǐjiào kěxíng, dàn háishi xūyào gǎijìn.
en: Overall, this plan is fairly feasible, but it still needs improvement.

zh: 不管怎样，我们总要面对现实，不能一直逃避。
pinyin: Búguǎn zěnyàng, wǒmen zǒngyào miànduì xiànshí, búnéng yīzhí táobì.
en: No matter what, we always have to face reality—we can't keep running away from it.

zh: 我确定喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ quèdìng xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: I'm sure I like eating rice.

zh: 明天的会议时间确定了吗？
pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì shíjiān quèdìng le ma?
en: Has the time for tomorrow's meeting been confirmed?

zh: 因为天气不好，所以我们确定下周去旅游。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen quèdìng xiàzhōu qù lǚyóu.
en: Since the weather isn't good, we've decided to go on a trip next week instead.

zh: 在我们确定这个计划之前，需要先听听大家的意见。
pinyin: Zài wǒmen quèdìng zhège jìhuà zhīqián, xūyào xiān tīngtīng dàjiā de yìjiàn.
en: Before we finalize this plan, we need to hear what everyone thinks first.

zh: 虽然他表面上同意了，但我还是不能确定他是否真心支持这个方案。
pinyin: Suīrán tā biǎomiàn shang tóngyì le, dàn wǒ háishi búnéng quèdìng tā shìfǒu zhēnxīn zhīchí zhège fāng'àn.
en: Although he agreed on the surface, I still can't be sure whether he genuinely supports this proposal.

zh: 有人在吃饭。
pinyin: Yǒu rén zài chīfàn.
en: Someone is eating.

zh: 今天有人来我家玩。
pinyin: Jīntiān yǒu rén lái wǒ jiā wán.
en: Someone is coming to my house to play today.

zh: 虽然有人不同意，但是我们还是决定了。
pinyin: Suīrán yǒu rén búhuì tóngyì, dànshì wǒmen háishi juéding le.
en: Although some people disagree, we decided anyway.

zh: 如果有人问你这个问题，你应该怎么回答？
pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu rén wèn nǐ zhège wèntí, nǐ yīnggāi zěnme huídá?
en: If someone asks you this question, how should you respond?

zh: 有人说这个计划太冒险了，但我觉得没有尝试就没有机会。
pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō zhège jìhuà tài màoxiǎn le, dàn wǒ juéde méiyǒu chángshì jiù méiyǒu jīhuì.
en: Some people say this plan is too risky, but I think you can't get anywhere without trying.

zh: 我看得很清楚。
pinyin: Wǒ kàn de hěn qīngchu.
en: I can see it very clearly.

zh: 请你说得清楚一点，我没听懂。
pinyin: Qǐng nǐ shuō de qīngchu yīdiǎn, wǒ méi tīngdǒng.
en: Can you speak a bit more clearly? I didn't understand.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但我还是看得很清楚。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dàn wǒ háishi kàn de hěn qīngchu.
en: Even though the weather was bad, I could still see it clearly.

zh: 因为没有清楚地了解情况，我们做了一个错误的决定。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu qīngchu de liǎojiě qíngkuàng, wǒmen zuòle yī ge cuòwù de juédìng.
en: Because we didn't clearly understand the situation, we made a wrong decision.

zh: 与其猜测，不如主动问清楚，这样才能避免以后的麻烦。
pinyin: Yǔqī cāicè, búrú zhǔdòng wèn qīngchu, zhèyàng cáinéng bìmiǎn yǐhòu de máfan.
en: Rather than guessing, it's better to just ask outright to get clarity—that way you can avoid trouble later.

zh: 晚上我吃饭。
pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒ chī fàn.
en: I eat dinner in the evening.

zh: 晚上我和家人看电视。
pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒ hé jiārén kàn diànshì.
en: In the evening, I watch TV with my family.

zh: 因为晚上很冷,所以我穿上厚衣服。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǎnshang hěn lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ chuānshang厚 yīfu.
en: Because it's cold in the evening, I put on thick clothes.

zh: 虽然晚上很累,但是我还是坚持去健身房锻炼。
pinyin: Suīrán wǎnshang hěn léi, dànshi wǒ háishi jiānchí qù jiànshēnfáng duànliàn.
en: Even though I'm tired in the evening, I still make the effort to go to the gym.

zh: 晚上的时候我通常会花一小时处理工作邮件和计划第二天的任务。
pinyin: Wǎnshang de shíhou wǒ tōngcháng huì huā yī xiǎoshí chǔlǐ gōngzuò yóujiàn hé jìhuà dì'èr tiān de rènwu.
en: In the evenings, I usually spend an hour dealing with work emails and planning out my tasks for the next day.

zh: 孩子要安全。
pinyin: Háizi yào ānquán.
en: Children need to be safe.

zh: 坐车的时候要系安全带。
pinyin: Zuò chē de shíhou yào xì ānquán dài.
en: You should wear a seatbelt when riding in a car.

zh: 虽然这条路很近，但是不安全，所以我们走别的路。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè tiáo lù hěn jìn, dànshì bù ānquán, suǒyǐ wǒmen zǒu biéde lù.
en: Although this road is shorter, it's not safe, so we'll take a different route.

zh: 公司制定了新的安全规则，为了保护员工的身体健康。
pinyin: Gōngsī zhìdìngle xīn de ānquán guīzé, wèile bǎohù yuángōng de shēntǐ jiànkāng.
en: The company has established new safety rules to protect employees' health.

zh: 只有做好日常安全检查，才能防患于未然，避免后期出现大问题。
pinyin: Zhǐyǒu zuò hǎo rìcháng ānquán jiǎnchá, cáinéng fánghuàn yú wèirán, bìmiǎn hòuqī chūxiàn dà wèntí.
en: Only by conducting regular safety inspections can we prevent problems before they arise and avoid major issues later.

zh: 你怎样吃饭？
pinyin: Nǐ zěnyàng chīfàn?
en: How do you eat?

zh: 今天天气怎样？很冷吗？
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì zěnyàng? Hěn lěng ma?
en: What's the weather like today? Is it very cold?

zh: 虽然他很忙，但是怎样都要帮助朋友。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì zěnyàng dōu yào bāngzhù péngyou.
en: Even though he's busy, he always wants to help his friends no matter what.

zh: 如果你想学好中文，首先怎样安排学习计划很重要。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng xuéhǎo zhōngwén, shǒuxiān zěnyàng ānpái xuéxí jìhuà hěn zhòngyào.
en: If you want to learn Chinese well, how you plan your study schedule is really important from the start.

zh: 现在网络那么发达，年轻人怎样才能找到真正有意义的东西，这成了一个问题。
pinyin: Xiànzài wǎngluò nàme fāda, niánqīng rén zěnyàng cáinéng zhǎodào zhēnzhèng yǒu yìyì de dōngxi, zhè chéngle yī ge wèntí.
en: With the internet so advanced these days, how young people can find something truly meaningful has become a real question.

zh: 没什么，我很好。
pinyin: Méi shénme, wǒ hěn hǎo.
en: It's nothing, I'm fine.

zh: 你不用担心，真的没什么问题。
pinyin: Nǐ búyòng dānxin, zhēnde méi shénme wèntí.
en: Don't worry, there's really nothing wrong.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但是没什么能阻止他来帮我们。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, búshì méi shénme néng zǔzhǐ tā lái bāng wǒmen.
en: Even though he's busy, nothing can stop him from coming to help us.

zh: 这次失败没什么大不了的，我们从中可以学到东西。
pinyin: Zhè cì shībài méi shénme dà búliǎo de, wǒmen cóng zhōng kěyǐ xuédào dōngxi.
en: This failure is no big deal; we can learn something from it.

zh: 与其纠结过去，不如放下心结，因为那些都没什么好回忆的。
pinyin: Yǔqī jiūjié guòqù, búrú fàngxià xīnjié, yīnwèi nàxiē dōu méi shénme hǎo huíyì de.
en: Rather than dwelling on the past, it's better to let it go, since there's nothing good to remember anyway.

zh: 我有一块蛋糕。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī kuài dàngāo.
en: I have a piece of cake.

zh: 昨天我买了一块巧克力。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ mǎile yī kuài qiǎokèlì.
en: I bought a chocolate bar yesterday.

zh: 虽然这块布很便宜，但是质量很好。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè kuài bù hěn piányi, dànshì zhìliàng hěn hǎo.
en: Although this piece of cloth is cheap, the quality is really good.

zh: 他把那块地用来种菜，收成很不错。
pinyin: Tā bǎ nà kuài dì yònglái zhòngcài, shōuchéng hěn búcuò.
en: He uses that plot of land to grow vegetables, and the harvest is quite good.

zh: 这块屏幕的分辨率虽然不是最高的，但看视频足够用了。
pinyin: Zhè kuài píngmù de fēnbiànyùlǜ suīrán búshì zuìgāo de, dàn kàn shìpín zúgòu yòngle.
en: This screen's resolution isn't the best, but it's more than enough for watching videos.

zh: 我要回家。
pinyin: Wǒ yào huíjiā.
en: I want to go home.

zh: 下午五点我回家吃饭。
pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn wǒ huíjiā chīfàn.
en: I go home at 5 PM to eat dinner.

zh: 因为今天很累，所以我早点回家休息。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān hěn lèi, suǒyǐ wǒ zǎodiǎn huíjiā xiūxi.
en: Because I'm very tired today, I'm going home early to rest.

zh: 虽然工作还没完成，但他还是决定回家陪家人。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò háishi méi wánchéng, dàn tā háishi juéding huíjiā péi jiārén.
en: Although his work wasn't finished, he still decided to go home and spend time with his family.

zh: 经过一整天的忙碌，他终于回家，松了口气。
pinyin: Jīngguò yī zhěngtiān de mánglù, tā zhōngyú huíjiā, sōngle kǒuqi.
en: After a full day of rushing around, he finally got home and felt relieved.

zh: 我要留在家里。
pinyin: Wǒ yào liúzài jiāli.
en: I want to stay home.

zh: 他明天留在学校吃饭。
pinyin: Tā míngtiān liúzài xuéxiào chīfàn.
en: He's staying at school tomorrow to have lunch.

zh: 因为下雨，我们决定留在朋友家过夜。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒmen juéding liúzài péngyou jiā guòyè.
en: Because it was raining, we decided to spend the night at our friend's place.

zh: 虽然很累，但他还是留下来帮忙收拾房间。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì tā háishi liúxiàlái bāngmang shōushī fángjiān.
en: Even though he was exhausted, he still stayed to help tidy up the room.

zh: 这份工作机会不错，但他最后还是决定留在现在的公司。
pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò jīhuì búcuò, dànshì tā zuìhòu háishi juéding liúzài xiànzài de gōngsī.
en: The job opportunity was good, but in the end he decided to stay with his current company.

zh: 我每周去公园。
pinyin: Wǒ měi zhōu qù gōngyuán.
en: I go to the park every week.

zh: 上周我买了一个新书包。
pinyin: Shàng zhōu wǒ mǎile yī ge xīn shūbāo.
en: Last week I bought a new school bag.

zh: 虽然这周很忙，但是我还是想去见朋友。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè zhōu hěn máng, dànshì wǒ háishi xiǎng qù jiàn péngyou.
en: Even though I'm busy this week, I still want to see my friends.

zh: 周末的时候我们经常一起去爬山，这样可以锻炼身体。
pinyin: Zhōumò de shíhou wǒmen jīngcháng yìqǐ qù páshān, zhèyàng kěyǐ duànliàn shēntǐ.
en: On weekends we often go hiking together, which helps us stay fit.

zh: 这周的项目进展不太理想，但团队决定下周加班补上进度。
pinyin: Zhè zhōu de xiàngmù jìnzhǎn búhuì tài lǐxiǎng, dàn tuánduì juéding xià zhōu jiābān bǔ shàng jìndù.
en: This week's project hasn't progressed as well as hoped, but the team has decided to work overtime next week to catch up.

zh: 我愿意吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ yuànyì chī mǐfàn.
en: I'm willing to eat rice.

zh: 他们明天愿意去公园吗？
pinyin: Tāmen míngtiān yuànyì qù gōngyuán ma?
en: Are they willing to go to the park tomorrow?

zh: 虽然很累，但我还是愿意帮助你。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn wǒ háishi yuànyì bāngzhù nǐ.
en: Even though I'm very tired, I'm still willing to help you.

zh: 很多年轻人愿意为了梦想放弃稳定的工作。
pinyin: Hěnduō niánqīngrén yuànyì wèile mèngxiǎng fàngqì wěndìng de gōngzuò.
en: Many young people are willing to give up stable jobs for their dreams.

zh: 如果公司愿意提高薪水，员工就更容易留住。
pinyin: Rúguǒ gōngsī yuànyì tígāo xīnshuǐ, yuángōng jiù gèng róngyì liúzhù.
en: If the company is willing to raise salaries, it's much easier to retain employees.

zh: 我有一个计划。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī gè jìhuà.
en: I have a plan.

zh: 明天我们的计划是去公园。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒmen de jìhuà shì qù gōngyuán.
en: Our plan for tomorrow is to go to the park.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以我们改了计划去爬山。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen gǎile jìhuà qù páshān.
en: Because the weather is nice, we changed our plan and went hiking instead.

zh: 这个项目的计划需要调整，因为资金不够。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de jìhuà xūyào tiáozhěng, yīnwèi zījīn búgòu.
en: This project's plan needs to be adjusted because we don't have enough funding.

zh: 公司长期的发展计划包括开拓国际市场和培养更多专业人才。
pinyin: Gōngsī chángqī de fāzhǎn jìhuà bāokuò kāituò guójì shìchǎng hé péiyǎng gèngduō zhuānyè réncái.
en: The company's long-term development plan includes expanding into international markets and cultivating more specialized talent.

zh: 这是我爸。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ bà.
en: This is my dad.

zh: 我爸今天在家工作。
pinyin: Wǒ bà jīntiān zài jiā gōngzuò.
en: My dad is working from home today.

zh: 因为爸爸很忙，所以我们周末一起吃饭。
pinyin: Yīnwèi bàba hěn máng, suǒyǐ wǒmen zhōumò yìqǐ chīfàn.
en: Because Dad is busy during the week, we eat together on weekends.

zh: 我爸说他年轻的时候喜欢踢足球。
pinyin: Wǒ bà shuō tā niánqīng de shíhou xǐhuān tī zúqiú.
en: My dad told me he loved playing soccer when he was young.

zh: 虽然爸爸平时话不多，但他对我们的关心无微不至。
pinyin: Suīrán bàba píngshí huà búduō, dàn tā duì wǒmen de guānxin wúwēi búzhì.
en: Although Dad doesn't say much, his care and attention to us is incredibly thoughtful.

zh: 我俩喜欢吃苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ liǎ xǐhuān chī píngguǒ.
en: We two like eating apples.

zh: 昨天我俩一起去了公园。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ liǎ yìqǐ qùle gōngyuán.
en: Yesterday the two of us went to the park together.

zh: 虽然他俩是朋友,但是他们的想法不一样。
pinyin: Suīrán tā liǎ shì péngyou, dànshì tāmen de xiǎngfǎ búyīyàng.
en: Although the two of them are friends, their ideas are different.

zh: 因为这俩个选择都很困难,所以我需要更多时间来决定。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè liǎ ge xuǎnzé dōu hěn kùnnan, suǒyǐ wǒ xūyào gèngduō shíjiān lái juéding.
en: Because both of these options are difficult, I need more time to make a decision.

zh: 他俩在这个项目上的配合堪称完美,效率也比预期高出不少。
pinyin: Tā liǎ zài zhège xiàngmù shang de pèihé kānchèng wánměi, xiàolǜ yě bǐ yùqī gāochū búshǎo.
en: The two of them work together flawlessly on this project, and their efficiency is considerably higher than expected.

zh: 车停了。
pinyin: Chē tíng le.
en: The car stopped.

zh: 请在这里停一下。
pinyin: Qǐng zài zhèlǐ tíng yīxià.
en: Please stop here for a moment.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以公交车停在路边。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ gōngjiāochē tíng zài lùbiān.
en: Because it was raining, the bus stopped on the side of the road.

zh: 虽然红绿灯还在亮，但是出租车已经停下来了。
pinyin: Suīrán hónglǜdēng háishi zài liàng, dànshi chūzūchē yǐjīng tíng xiàlai le.
en: Even though the traffic light was still on, the taxi had already come to a stop.

zh: 他工作这么多年，一直没停止过学习新技能。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò zhème duō nián, yìzhí méi tíngzhǐ guò xuéxí xīn jìnéng.
en: After working for so many years, he's never stopped learning new skills.

zh: 我不能吃鱼。
pinyin: Wǒ búnéng chī yú.
en: I can't eat fish.

zh: 他今天不能来上课。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān búnéng lái shàngkè.
en: He can't come to class today.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以我们不能去公园。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ wǒmen búnéng qù gōngyuán.
en: Because it's raining, we can't go to the park.

zh: 虽然他很聪明，但是不能总是依赖别人帮助。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn cōngming, búshì búnéng zǒngshì yīlài biérén bāngzhù.
en: Although he's smart, he can't always rely on others to help him.

zh: 在这种情况下，我们不能只考虑经济利益，还要顾及社会影响。
pinyin: Zài zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng xià, wǒmen búnéng zhǐ kǎolǜ jīngjì lìyì, háiyào gùjí shèhuì yǐngxiǎng.
en: In this situation, we can't just think about profit—we also have to consider the social impact.

zh: 他妈的，我找不到钥匙。
pinyin: Tā mā de, wǒ zhǎo bu dào yào匙.
en: Damn it, I can't find my keys.

zh: 他妈的，昨天我又迟到了。
pinyin: Tā mā de, zuótiān wǒ yòu chídào le.
en: Damn it, I was late again yesterday.

zh: 他妈的，因为堵车，我上班的时候迟到了。
pinyin: Tā mā de, yīnwèi dǔchē, wǒ shàngbān de shíhou chídào le.
en: Shit, because of traffic, I was late getting to work.

zh: 他妈的，你说话也不想想，有时候真的很讨厌。
pinyin: Tā mā de, nǐ shuōhuà yě bu xiǎngxiang, yǒushíhou zhēnde hěn tǎoyàn.
en: For God's sake, you don't think before you speak—it's really annoying sometimes.

zh: 他妈的，我们准备了这么久，结果计划全被打乱了。
pinyin: Tā mā de, wǒmen zhǔnbèi le zhème jiǔ, jiéguǒ jìhuà quán bèi dǎluàn le.
en: Damn it all—we prepared for so long and the whole plan just fell apart.

zh: 我喜欢说话。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān shuōhuà.
en: I like to talk.

zh: 他每天都在说话，很吵。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu zài shuōhuà, hěn chǎo.
en: He talks every day and it's really noisy.

zh: 因为他很紧张，所以说话的时候很快。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ shuōhuà de shíhou hěn kuài.
en: Because he's nervous, he talks very quickly.

zh: 她在会议上说话虽然不多，但是每句都很有意思。
pinyin: Tā zài huìyì shang shuōhuà suīrán búduō, dànshì měi jù dōu hěn yǒu yìsi.
en: Although she doesn't say much in meetings, every word she says is meaningful.

zh: 他在公众面前说话总是有点紧张，但习惯了以后就好多了。
pinyin: Tā zài gōngzhòng miànqián shuōhuà zǒngshi yǒudiǎn jǐnzhāng, dàn xíguàn le yǐhòu jiù hǎo duō le.
en: He's always a bit nervous speaking in public, but it gets much easier once you get used to it.

zh: 我喜欢苹果，另一个喜欢香蕉。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān píngguǒ, lìng yī gè xǐhuān xiāngjiāo.
en: I like apples, and the other one likes bananas.

zh: 这件衣服太小了，我需要另一个号码。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu tài xiǎo le, wǒ xūyào lìng yī ge hàomǎ.
en: This shirt is too small; I need a different size.

zh: 因为今天下雨，所以我们另外选择了在家里的活动。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen lìngwài xuǎnzé le zàijiālǐ de huódòng.
en: Since it rained today, we chose different activities to do at home instead.

zh: 这个方案虽然便宜，但另外有个更好的选择可能更值得考虑。
pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn suīrán piányi, dàn lìngwài yǒu ge gèng hǎo de xuǎnzé kěnéng gèng zhídé kǎolǜ.
en: Although this plan is cheap, there's another option that might be worth considering more.

zh: 与其在这里纠缠，倒不如另辟蹊径，寻找新的发展机会。
pinyin: Yǔqī zài zhèlǐ jiūchán, dàobúrú lìngpì xījìng, xúnzhǎo xīn de fāzhǎn jīhuì.
en: Rather than getting tangled up here, it'd be better to find a new path and look for fresh opportunities.

zh: 我很开心。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn kāixīn.
en: I'm very happy.

zh: 他今天不开心，因为考试没考好。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān bù kāixīn, yīnwèi kǎoshì méi kǎo hǎo.
en: He's not in a good mood today because he didn't do well on the test.

zh: 虽然工作很累，但是看到孩子的笑脸，我的心里很高兴。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn lèi, dànshì kàndào háizi de xiàoliǎn, wǒ de xīnli hěn gāoxìng.
en: Although work is tiring, when I see my child's smile, my heart feels really happy.

zh: 她心里想着明天的演讲，所以整晚都没有好好睡觉。
pinyin: Tā xīnli xiǎngzhe míngtiān de yǎnjiǎng, suǒyǐ zhěng wǎn dōu méiyǒu hǎohao shuìjiào.
en: She kept thinking about tomorrow's presentation, so she didn't sleep well all night.

zh: 他做事很有责任心，即使遇到困难也会坚持到底。
pinyin: Tā zuòshì hěn yǒu zérènxīn, jíshǐ遇dào kùnnan yě huì jiānchí dào dǐ.
en: He's very conscientious about his work and will see things through to the end, no matter what difficulties come up.

zh: 我喜欢红花。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān hóng huā.
en: I like red flowers.

zh: 春天公园里有很多花开了。
pinyin: Chūntiān gōngyuán lǐ yǒu hěnduō huā kāi le.
en: In spring, lots of flowers bloom in the park.

zh: 虽然这些花很漂亮，但是很贵。
pinyin: Suīrán zhèxiē huā hěn piàoliang, dànshì hěn guì.
en: Although these flowers are beautiful, they're quite expensive.

zh: 她每周都去花店买花，因为喜欢在家里放新鲜的花。
pinyin: Tā měi zhōu dōu qù huādiàn mǎi huā, yīnwèi xǐhuān zài jiālǐ fàng xīnxiān de huā.
en: She goes to the flower shop every week because she enjoys having fresh flowers at home.

zh: 与其花大价钱买名贵花卉，不如选择容易养活的植物。
pinyin: Yǔqī huā dà jiàqian mǎi míngguì huāhuì, búrú xuǎnzé róngyì yǎnghuó de zhíwù.
en: Rather than spend a fortune on exotic flowers, it's better to choose plants that are easy to care for.

zh: 她们喜欢吃苹果。
pinyin: Tāmen xǐhuān chī píngguǒ.
en: They like to eat apples.

zh: 她们昨天去公园了。
pinyin: Tāmen zuótiān qù gōngyuán le.
en: They went to the park yesterday.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以她们决定去海边。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ tāmen juédìng qù hǎibiān.
en: Because the weather was nice, they decided to go to the beach.

zh: 她们虽然工作很忙，但是还是经常聚在一起吃饭。
pinyin: Tāmen suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, búguò háishi jīngcháng jùzài yìqǐ chīfàn.
en: Even though their jobs are busy, they still get together to eat often.

zh: 她们对这个项目的态度截然不同，但最后还是达成了共识。
pinyin: Tāmen duì zhège xiàngmù de tàidù jiēránbùtóng, búguò zuìhòu háishi dáchéngle gòngshí.
en: They had completely opposite views about this project, but eventually they reached an agreement.

zh: 有些苹果是红的。
pinyin: Yǒuxiē píngguǒ shì hóng de.
en: Some apples are red.

zh: 今天有些冷,我穿了厚衣服。
pinyin: Jīntiān yǒuxiē lěng, wǒ chuānle hòu yīfu.
en: It's a bit cold today, so I wore thick clothes.

zh: 虽然有些难,但是我还是想学中文。
pinyin: Suīrán yǒuxiē nán, dànshì wǒ háishi xiǎng xué Zhōngwén.
en: Although it's somewhat difficult, I still want to learn Chinese.

zh: 有些学生因为工作忙,所以没能参加昨天的活动。
pinyin: Yǒuxiē xuésheng yīnwèi gōngzuò máng, suǒyǐ méi néng cānjiā zuótiān de huódòng.
en: Some students couldn't attend yesterday's event because they were busy with work.

zh: 有些人觉得远程工作很方便,但有些人认为这样容易失去工作与生活的平衡。
pinyin: Yǒuxiē rén juéde yuǎnchéng gōngzuò hěn fāngbiàn, dàn yǒuxiē rén rènwéi zhèyàng róngyì shīqù gōngzuò yǔ shēnghuó de pínghuà.
en: Some people find remote work very convenient, but others believe it's easy to lose the balance between work and life that way.

zh: 门开了。
pinyin: Mén kāi le.
en: The door opened.

zh: 早上我打开了家里的门。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ dǎkāi le jiālǐ de mén.
en: This morning I opened the door at home.

zh: 因为下雨，我关上了门窗，所以房间里很安静。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒ guānshàng le ménhuāng, suǒyǐ fángjiān lǐ hěn ānjìng.
en: Because it was raining, I closed the doors and windows, so the room became very quiet.

zh: 虽然门锁坏了，但是我们还是能进去办公室工作。
pinyin: Suīrán ménsuǒ huài le, dànshì wǒmen háishi néng jìnqu bàngōngshì gōngzuò.
en: Although the door lock was broken, we were still able to go into the office and work.

zh: 这家公司大门口排队的人越来越多，说明他们的产品确实很受欢迎。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī dàménkǒu pái duì de rén yuèláiyuè duō, shuōmíng tāmen de chǎnpǐn quèshí hěn shòu huānyíng.
en: There are more and more people lining up at the entrance of this company, which shows their products are really popular.

zh: 我感谢你的帮助。
pinyin: Wǒ gǎnxiè nǐ de bāngzhù.
en: I thank you for your help.

zh: 昨天他给了我礼物，我很感谢他。
pinyin: Zuótiān tā gěi le wǒ lǐwù, wǒ hěn gǎnxiè tā.
en: Yesterday he gave me a gift, and I'm really grateful to him.

zh: 因为你帮助我找到工作，所以我很感谢你。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nǐ bāngzhù wǒ zhǎodào gōngzuò, suǒyǐ wǒ hěn gǎnxiè nǐ.
en: Because you helped me find a job, I'm very grateful to you.

zh: 虽然这个项目很困难，但我感谢团队的支持和鼓励。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège xiàngmù hěn kùnnan, dàn wǒ gǎnxiè tuánduì de zhīchí hé gǔlì.
en: Although this project was challenging, I'm grateful for the team's support and encouragement.

zh: 我特别感谢你在最困难的时候没有放弃我，这对我意义重大。
pinyin: Wǒ tèbié gǎnxiè nǐ zài zuì kùnnan de shíhou méiyǒu fàngqì wǒ, zhè duì wǒ yìyì zhòngdà.
en: I'm especially grateful that you didn't give up on me during my hardest time—it meant the world to me.

zh: 我们谈谈你的家人。
pinyin: Wǒmen tántán nǐ de jiārén.
en: Let's talk about your family.

zh: 今天下午我想和你谈谈工作的事情。
pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ tántán gōngzuò de shìqing.
en: This afternoon I'd like to discuss work matters with you.

zh: 虽然很难,但是我们还是应该谈谈这个问题。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dànshì wǒmen háishi yīnggāi tántán zhège wèntí.
en: Even though it's difficult, we should still talk about this issue.

zh: 在开会之前,经理想和我们谈谈公司未来的发展方向。
pinyin: Zài kāihuì zhīqián, jīnglǐ xiǎng hé wǒmen tántán gōngsī wèilái de fāzhǎn fāngxiàng.
en: Before the meeting, the manager wants to discuss the company's future direction with us.

zh: 与其互相猜测,不如坦诚地谈谈彼此的期望和顾虑。
pinyin: Yǔqí hùxiāng cāicè, búrú tǎnchéng de tántán bǐcǐ de qīwàng hé gùlǜ.
en: Rather than speculating about each other, it's better to honestly discuss our expectations and concerns.

zh: 我们明天定去公园。
pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān dìng qù gōngyuán.
en: We're definitely going to the park tomorrow.

zh: 你先定好座位，我们一会儿就来。
pinyin: Nǐ xiān dìng hǎo zuòwèi, wǒmen yīhuǐr jiù lái.
en: You go ahead and reserve the seats; we'll be there in a moment.

zh: 虽然价格有点贵，但这家餐厅的饭菜确实定很好吃。
pinyin: Suīrán jiàgé yǒudiǎn guì, dàn zhè jiā cāntīng de fàn菜 quèshí dìng hěn hǎochī.
en: Although it's a bit pricey, the food at this restaurant is definitely really delicious.

zh: 我们已经定好了计划，所以这个周末的安排就基本定下来了。
pinyin: Wǒmen yǐjīng dìng hǎo le jìhuà, suǒyǐ zhège zhōumò de ānpái jiù jīběn dìng xiàlai le.
en: We've already settled on a plan, so the weekend arrangements are basically confirmed now.

zh: 在这个问题上，大家的看法还没有定论，需要进一步的讨论才能做出决定。
pinyin: Zài zhège wèntí shang, dàjiā de kànfǎ háishi méiyǒu dìnglùn, xūyào jìnyībù de tǎolùn cái néng zuòchū juéding.
en: There's still no consensus on this issue yet; we need further discussion before we can reach a final decision.

zh: 我来自于中国。
pinyin: Wǒ lái zì yú Zhōngguó.
en: I come from China.

zh: 这个苹果好吃于那个。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ hǎochī yú nàge.
en: This apple tastes better than that one.

zh: 因为下雨，所以今天的活动推迟于明天。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ jīntiān de huódòng tuīchíyú míngtiān.
en: Because it rained, today's event was postponed to tomorrow.

zh: 这个问题的答案不同于我之前的理解。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí de dáàn búntóng yú wǒ zhīqián de lǐjiě.
en: The answer to this question differs from my previous understanding.

zh: 与其为了面子赔钱，不如坦诚地和客户沟通。
pinyin: Yǔqī wèile miànzi péi qián, búrú tǎnchéng de hé kèhù gōutōng.
en: Rather than lose money just to save face, it's better to communicate honestly with the client.

zh: 以后我喝茶。
pinyin: Yǐhòu wǒ hē chá.
en: From now on, I'll drink tea.

zh: 明天以后，我要去学校。
pinyin: Míngtiān yǐhòu, wǒ yào qù xuéxiào.
en: After tomorrow, I need to go to school.

zh: 虽然今天很累，但是以后我会坚持运动。
pinyin: Suīrán jīntiān hěn lèi, dànshì yǐhòu wǒ huì jiānchí yùndòng.
en: Even though I'm tired today, I'll keep exercising from now on.

zh: 工作以后，他才意识到学习有多重要。
pinyin: Gōngzuò yǐhòu, tā cái yìshí dào xuéxí yǒu duō zhòngyào.
en: Only after starting work did he realize how important studying is.

zh: 经历了这次失败以后，他对人生有了新的认识。
pinyin: Jīnglìle zhè cì shībài yǐhòu, tā duì rénshēng yǒule xīn de rènshi.
en: After experiencing this failure, he gained a new perspective on life.

zh: 我管理这个房间。
pinyin: Wǒ guǎnlǐ zhège fángjiān.
en: I take care of this room.

zh: 妈妈管我和弟弟的功课。
pinyin: Māma guǎn wǒ hé dìdi de gōngkè.
en: Mom oversees my and my brother's schoolwork.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但他仍然管家里的事务。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn tā réngránguǎn jiālǐ de shìwù.
en: Although he's very busy, he still handles household matters.

zh: 公司让他管理销售部，因为他的经验丰富。
pinyin: Gōngsī ràng tā guǎnlǐ xiāoshòu bù, yīnwèi tā de jīngyàn fēngfù.
en: The company put him in charge of the sales department because of his rich experience.

zh: 这位经理管过三个不同行业的公司，管理能力相当出众。
pinyin: Zhè wèi jīnglǐ guòguò sān ge búdòng hángyè de gōngsī, guǎnlǐ néngliwù xiāngdāng chūzhòng.
en: This manager has run companies across three different industries, and his management skills are exceptionally outstanding.

zh: 这是我的照片。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de zhàopiàn.
en: This is my photo.

zh: 昨天我拍了很多照片。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ pāile hěnduō zhàopiàn.
en: Yesterday I took a lot of photos.

zh: 虽然照片很小，但是很清楚。
pinyin: Suīrán zhàopiàn hěn xiǎo, dànshì hěn qīngchu.
en: Although the photo is small, it's very clear.

zh: 她把手机里的照片都删除了，因为没有空间。
pinyin: Tā bǎ shǒujī lǐ de zhàopiàn dōu shānchúle, yīnwèi méiyǒu kōngjiān.
en: She deleted all the photos on her phone because there wasn't enough space.

zh: 这些旅游照片记录了我们最美好的回忆。
pinyin: Zhèxiē lǚyóu zhàopiàn jìlùle wǒmen zuì měihǎo de huíyì.
en: These travel photos capture our most wonderful memories.

zh: 每个学生都有书。
pinyin: Měi ge xuésheng dōu yǒu shū.
en: Every student has a book.

zh: 我每个月去一次医生那里。
pinyin: Wǒ měi ge yuè qù yī cì yīshēng nàlǐ.
en: I go to the doctor once every month.

zh: 因为每个人都想成功，所以大家都很努力。
pinyin: Yīnwèi měi ge rén dōu xiǎng chénggōng, suǒyǐ dàjiā dōu hěn nǔlì.
en: Because everyone wants to succeed, they all work very hard.

zh: 这家公司给每个员工提供健康保险和退休计划。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī gěi měi ge yuángōng tígōng jiànkāng bǎoxiǎn hé tuì休jìhuà.
en: This company provides health insurance and a retirement plan to every employee.

zh: 每个决定都会影响我们的未来，所以我们需要更加谨慎。
pinyin: Měi ge juéding dōu huì yǐngxiǎng wǒmen de wèilái, suǒyǐ wǒmen xūyào gèngjiā jǐnshèn.
en: Every decision will affect our future, so we need to be more careful.

zh: 欢迎你来我家。
pinyin: Huānyíng nǐ lái wǒ jiā.
en: Welcome to my home.

zh: 我们很欢迎你明天来吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒmen hěn huānyíng nǐ míngtiān lái chīfàn.
en: We'd really love for you to come eat with us tomorrow.

zh: 因为你是我的朋友，所以我特别欢迎你。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nǐ shì wǒ de péngyou, suǒyǐ wǒ tèbié huānyíng nǐ.
en: Since you're my friend, I'm especially happy to welcome you.

zh: 虽然我们第一次见面，但我们都很欢迎新同事加入我们的团队。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen dì yī cì jiànmiàn, dàn wǒmen dōu hěn huānyíng xīn tóngshì jiānyù wǒmen de tuánduì.
en: Even though this is our first meeting, we're all genuinely glad to welcome the new colleague to our team.

zh: 我们公司一直欢迎有想法、有干劲的年轻人加入我们。
pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī yīzhí huānyíng yǒu xiǎngfǎ, yǒu gānjìn de niánqīng rén jiānyù wǒmen.
en: Our company has always welcomed ambitious and driven young people to join us.

zh: 我敢吃辣椒。
pinyin: Wǒ gǎn chī làjiāo.
en: I dare to eat spicy peppers.

zh: 他不敢在课堂上说话。
pinyin: Tā búgǎn zài kètáng shàng shuōhuà.
en: He doesn't dare to speak in class.

zh: 虽然她很害怕，但她还是敢去看医生。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn hàipà, dànshì tā háishi gǎn qù kàn yīshēng.
en: Although she was very scared, she still dared to go see the doctor.

zh: 因为他工作经验丰富，所以敢接受这个很难的项目。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā gōngzuò jīngyàn fēngfù, suǒyǐ gǎn jiēshòu zhège hěn nán de xiàngmù.
en: Because he has abundant work experience, he dares to take on this difficult project.

zh: 现在很多年轻人敢于尝试新的想法，不怕失败。
pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō niánqīngrén gǎnyú chángshì xīn de xiǎngfǎ, búpà shībài.
en: Nowadays, many young people are bold enough to try new ideas without fearing failure.

zh: 我有一个兄弟。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī gè xiōngdì.
en: I have a brother.

zh: 我的兄弟在北京工作。
pinyin: Wǒ de xiōngdì zài běijīng gōngzuò.
en: My brother works in Beijing.

zh: 虽然我们是兄弟，但是我们的爱好不一样。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen shì xiōngdì, dànshì wǒmen de àihào búyīyàng.
en: Although we're brothers, we have different hobbies.

zh: 他把兄弟当成最信任的朋友，什么事都跟他说。
pinyin: Tā bǎ xiōngdì dàngchéng zuì xìnrèn de péngyou, shénme shì dōu gēn tā shuō.
en: He treats his brother as his most trusted friend and tells him everything.

zh: 在这个时代，真正的兄弟情义变得越来越珍贵了。
pinyin: Zài zhège shídài, zhēnzhèng de xiōngdì qíngyì biàn de yuèláiyuè zhēnguì le.
en: In this day and age, genuine brotherly bonds have become increasingly precious.

zh: 我从来不吃辣。
pinyin: Wǒ cónglaí bù chī là.
en: I never eat spicy food.

zh: 她从来没有去过北京。
pinyin: Tā cónglaí méiyǒu qùguò Běijīng.
en: She has never been to Beijing.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但他从来不迟到。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn tā cónglaí bù chídào.
en: Although he's very busy, he never arrives late.

zh: 因为从来没有人教过他，所以他的方法很特别。
pinyin: Yīnwèi cónglaí méiyǒu rén jiāoguò tā, suǒyǐ tā de fāngfǎ hěn tèbié.
en: Since no one ever taught him, his method is quite unique.

zh: 我从来不相信那种说法，因为很多事实都证明它是错的。
pinyin: Wǒ cónglaí bù xiāngxìn nàzhǒng shuōfǎ, yīnwèi hěnduō shìshí dōu zhèngmíng tā shì cuò de.
en: I've never believed that kind of claim, because countless facts prove it wrong.

zh: 我总是吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ zǒngshì chī mǐfàn.
en: I always eat rice.

zh: 他总是早上七点起床。
pinyin: Tā zǒngshì zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng.
en: He always gets up at seven in the morning.

zh: 虽然天气很冷，但我总是去公园跑步。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, dàn wǒ zǒngshì qù gōngyuán pǎobù.
en: Even though it's cold, I still always go running in the park.

zh: 因为工作很忙，他总是没有时间陪家人。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò hěn máng, tā zǒngshì méiyǒu shíjiān péi jiārén.
en: Because he's so busy with work, he never has time to spend with his family.

zh: 不管遇到什么问题，她总是能想出聪明的办法解决。
pinyin: Búguǎn遇dào shénme wèntí, tā zǒngshì néng xiǎngchū cōngming de bànfǎ jiějué.
en: No matter what problems come up, she always manages to find a clever solution.

zh: 我的嘴很大。
pinyin: Wǒ de zuǐ hěn dà.
en: My mouth is very big.

zh: 吃饭的时候不要说话，嘴里有食物。
pinyin: Chīfàn de shíhou búyào shuōhuà, zuǐ lǐ yǒu shíwù.
en: Don't talk while eating—you have food in your mouth.

zh: 因为他嘴很甜，所以大家都喜欢他。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā zuǐ hěn tián, suǒyǐ dàjiā dōu xǐhuān tā.
en: Because he knows how to say the right things, everyone likes him.

zh: 虽然她嘴上说不去，但实际上她很想去那个聚会。
pinyin: Suīrán tā zuǐ shang shuō búqù, dàn shíjì shang tā hěn xiǎng qù nàge jùhuì.
en: Although she says she won't go, she actually really wants to go to that party.

zh: 他嘴上不承认，可心里明白得很，这事儿他早就想到了。
pinyin: Tā zuǐ shang búchèngrèn, kě xīn lǐ míngbai de hěn, zhè shìr tā zǎojiù xiǎngdào le.
en: He won't admit it out loud, but deep down he knows full well—he saw this coming from a mile away.

zh: 小孩跳得很高。
pinyin: xiǎohái tiào de hěn gāo.
en: The child jumps very high.

zh: 我每天早上都跳绳。
pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang dōu tiào shéng.
en: I jump rope every morning.

zh: 因为音乐很好听，所以她跳得很开心。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yīnyuè hěn hǎo tīng, suǒyǐ tā tiào de hěn kāixīn.
en: Because the music is so nice, she dances very happily.

zh: 虽然他第一次跳舞有点紧张，但是表现得不错。
pinyin: Suīrán tā dì yī cì tiàowǔ yǒudiǎn jǐnzhāng, dànshì biǎoxiàn de búcuò.
en: Although he was a bit nervous dancing for the first time, he performed quite well.

zh: 这个舞蹈演员的跳跃技巧令观众印象深刻。
pinyin: Zhège wǔdào yǎnyuanyuán de tiàoyuè jìqiǎo lìng guānzhòng yìnxiàng shēnkè.
en: This dancer's jumping technique left a strong impression on the audience.

zh: 拜托你帮我。
pinyin: Bàituō nǐ bāng wǒ.
en: Please help me.

zh: 明天拜托你买菜,好吗?
pinyin: Míngtiān bàituō nǐ mǎi cài, hǎo ma?
en: Could you buy groceries for me tomorrow?

zh: 我很忙,拜托你照顾一下我的孩子。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn máng, bàituō nǐ zhàogu yīxià wǒ de háizi.
en: I'm really busy—please look after my child for me.

zh: 这个项目很重要,拜托你一定要按时完成。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù hěn zhòngyào, bàituō nǐ yīdìng yào ànshí wánchéng.
en: This project is really important—I'm counting on you to finish it on time.

zh: 既然你要出国,那就拜托你多多学习当地文化,别丢人。
pinyin: 既然 nǐ yào chūguó, nàjiù bàituō nǐ duōduō xuéxí dāngdì wénhuà, bié diūrén.
en: Since you're going abroad, I'm asking you to really study the local culture and don't embarrass us.

zh: 我抓住了猫。
pinyin: Wǒ zhuāzhù le māo.
en: I caught the cat.

zh: 小孩子喜欢抓住妈妈的手。
pinyin: Xiǎoháizi xǐhuān zhuāzhù māma de shǒu.
en: Little children like to grab their mom's hand.

zh: 因为他跑得很快，所以我没抓住他。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā pǎo de hěn kuài, suǒyǐ wǒ méi zhuāzhù tā.
en: Because he was running so fast, I couldn't catch him.

zh: 警察抓住了那个偷东西的人，现在他在监狱里。
pinyin: Jǐngchá zhuāzhù le nàge tōu dōngxi de rén, xiànzài tā zài jiānyù lǐ.
en: The police arrested the person who was stealing, and now he's in jail.

zh: 我们要抓住这个机会，不能让它从手指间溜走。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhuāzhù zhège jīhuì, búnéng ràng tā cóng shǒuzhǐjiān liū zǒu.
en: We need to seize this opportunity—we can't let it slip through our fingers.

zh: 这位小姐是我妈妈。
pinyin: Zhè wèi xiǎojiě shì wǒ māma.
en: This lady is my mom.

zh: 那个小姐每天都在咖啡店工作。
pinyin: Nàge xiǎojiě měi tiān dōu zài kāfēi diàn gōngzuò.
en: That young woman works at the coffee shop every day.

zh: 虽然小姐很忙，但是她还是帮助了我们。
pinyin: Suīrán xiǎojiě hěn máng, dànshì tā háishi bāngzhù le wǒmen.
en: Although the lady was very busy, she still helped us anyway.

zh: 前台的小姐告诉我们会议被推迟了一个小时。
pinyin: Qiántái de xiǎojiě gàosu wǒmen huìyì bèi tuīchíle yī ge xiǎoshí.
en: The receptionist told us the meeting had been postponed by an hour.

zh: 这位小姐虽然经验不足，但做起事来却毫不含糊。
pinyin: Zhè wèi xiǎojiě suīrán jīngyàn búzú, dàn zuò qǐ shì lái què háobù hánhu.
en: Despite her lack of experience, this young woman doesn't mess around when it comes to getting things done.

zh: 小孩在动。
pinyin: Xiǎohái zài dòng.
en: The child is moving.

zh: 他每天都动一动身体。
pinyin: Tā měitiān dōu dòng yī dòng shēntǐ.
en: He moves his body a little every day.

zh: 虽然他很累，但是还是要动起来。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn lèi, dànshì háishi yào dòng qǐlái.
en: Even though he's tired, he still needs to get moving.

zh: 因为工作太忙，他好久没有动过运动了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng, tā hǎojiǔ méiyǒu dòngguò yùndòng le.
en: Because work has been so busy, he hasn't exercised in a long time.

zh: 这件事触动了他的心，让他决定采取行动。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì chùdòng le tā de xīn, ràng tā juéding cǎiqǔ xíngdòng.
en: This matter touched his heart, which made him decide to take action.

zh: 我们赢了比赛。
pinyin: Wǒmen yíng le bǐsài.
en: We won the match.

zh: 昨天足球队赢了三比一。
pinyin: Zuótiān zúqiú duì yíng le sān bǐ yī.
en: Yesterday the soccer team won 3 to 1.

zh: 虽然他们很强，但我们还是赢了这场重要的比赛。
pinyin: Suīrán tāmen hěn qiáng, dàn wǒmen háishi yíng le zhè chǎng zhònyào de bǐsài.
en: Even though they were strong, we still managed to win this important game.

zh: 因为大家一起努力训练，所以最后赢得了全国冠军。
pinyin: Yīnwèi dàjiā yìqǐ nǔlì xùnliàn, suǒyǐ zuìhòu yíng de le quánguó guànjūn.
en: Because everyone trained hard together, we ended up winning the national championship.

zh: 他在生意上赢得了不少机会，但始终觉得做生意不如帮助别人开心。
pinyin: Tā zài shēngyì shang yíng de le búshǎo jīhuì, dàn shǐzhōng juéde zuò shēngyì búrú bāngzhù biérén kāixīn.
en: He's won quite a few opportunities in business, but he's always felt that helping others be happy is more rewarding than making money.

zh: 我收到一个消息。
pinyin: Wǒ shōudào yīgè xiāoxi.
en: I received a message.

zh: 妈妈给我发来一条消息。
pinyin: Māma gěi wǒ fālái yītiáo xiāoxi.
en: Mom sent me a message.

zh: 因为没有网络，所以我没收到消息。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu wǎngluò, suǒyǐ wǒ méi shōudào xiāoxi.
en: Because there was no internet, I didn't receive the message.

zh: 他发来的消息很重要，我们需要马上回复他。
pinyin: Tā fālái de xiāoxi hěn zhòngyào, wǒmen xūyào mǎshang huífù tā.
en: The message he sent is very important, and we need to reply to him right away.

zh: 虽然已经很晚了，但他还是坚持等待客户的消息。
pinyin: Suīrán yǐjīng hěn wǎn le, dàn tā háishi jiānchí děngdài kèhù de xiāoxi.
en: Although it was very late, he still insisted on waiting for the client's message.

zh: 她是一个女孩。
pinyin: Tā shì yīgè nǚ háizi.
en: She is a girl.

zh: 我的女朋友很喜欢吃水果。
pinyin: Wǒ de nǚ péngyou hěn xǐhuān chī shuǐguǒ.
en: My girlfriend really likes eating fruit.

zh: 虽然她是个女生，但是她很擅长打篮球。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shì ge nǚ shēng, dànshì tā hěn shàncháng dǎ lánqiú.
en: Although she's a girl, she's actually really good at basketball.

zh: 那位女医生因为经验丰富，所以很多患者都信任她。
pinyin: Nà wèi nǚ yīshēng yīnwèi jīngyàn fēngfù, suǒyǐ hěnduō huànzhě dōu xìnrèn tā.
en: That female doctor has so much experience that many patients really trust her.

zh: 这位女企业家凭借自己的努力，把一个小公司发展成了行业领头羊。
pinyin: Zhè wèi nǚ qǐyèjiājiā píngjiè zìjǐ de nǔlì, bǎ yīgè xiǎo gōngsī fāzhǎn chéngle hángyè lǐngtóu yáng.
en: Through her own hard work, this female entrepreneur developed a small company into an industry leader.

zh: 妈妈很忙。
pinyin: Māma hěn máng.
en: Mom is very busy.

zh: 他今天很忙，没有时间吃饭。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān hěn máng, méiyǒu shíjiān chīfàn.
en: He's so busy today that he doesn't have time to eat.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但是他还是坚持每天运动。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshi tā háishi jiānchí měi tiān yùndòng.
en: Although his work keeps him busy, he still makes a point of exercising every day.

zh: 因为公司最近很忙，我的同事们都在加班工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngsī zuìjìn hěn máng, wǒ de tóngshìmen dōu zài jiābān gōngzuò.
en: Because the company is slammed lately, my colleagues are all working overtime.

zh: 他整天忙得不可开交，连朋友的电话都顾不上回。
pinyin: Tā zhěngtiān máng de búkě kāijiāo, lián péngyou de diànhuà dōu gù bu shàng huí.
en: He's so swamped every day that he can't even find time to call his friends back.

zh: 或许明天下雨。
pinyin: Huòxǔ míngtiān xiàyǔ.
en: Maybe it will rain tomorrow.

zh: 他或许喜欢吃米饭和菜。
pinyin: Tā huòxǔ xǐhuān chīfàn hé cài.
en: He might like eating rice and vegetables.

zh: 虽然很晚了，但她或许还在工作。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn wǎnle, dànshì tā huòxǔ háizài gōngzuò.
en: Even though it's late, she might still be working.

zh: 因为他没来电话，所以或许他忘记了约定。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā méi lái diànhuà, suǒyǐ huòxǔ tā wàngjìle yuēdìng.
en: Since he didn't call, perhaps he forgot about our plan.

zh: 这个决定或许不是最完美的，但在当前情况下已经足够了。
pinyin: Zhège juédìng huòxǔ búshì zuì wánměi de, dànshì zài dāngqián qíngkuàng xià yǐjīng zúgòu le.
en: This decision may not be perfect, but given the circumstances, it's sufficient for now.

zh: 天气如此热。
pinyin: Tiānqì rúcǐ rè.
en: The weather is so hot.

zh: 他每天都如此忙碌。
pinyin: Tā měitiān dōu rúcǐ mánglu。
en: He's this busy every single day.

zh: 虽然价格便宜，但质量如此好，我很满意。
pinyin: Suīrán jiàgé piányì, dàn zhìliàng rúcǐ hǎo, wǒ hěn mǎnyì.
en: Even though the price is cheap, the quality is so good that I'm really satisfied.

zh: 他解释得如此清楚，使得大家都理解了问题。
pinyin: Tā jiěshì de rúcǐ qīngchu, shǐde dàjiā dōu lǐjiě le wèntí.
en: His explanation was so clear that everyone understood the problem.

zh: 市场变化如此迅速，企业必须不断调整战略才能生存。
pinyin: Shìchǎng biànhuà rúcǐ xùnsù, qǐyè bìxū búduàn tiáozhěng zhànlüè cáinéng shēngcún.
en: The market changes so rapidly that businesses have to constantly adjust their strategy just to survive.

zh: 我们队赢了。
pinyin: Wǒmen duì yíng le.
en: Our team won.

zh: 昨天我们队踢了一场足球比赛。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒmen duì踢 le yī chǎng zúqiú bǐsài.
en: Yesterday our team played a soccer match.

zh: 虽然对方队很强，但是我们队坚持到了最后。
pinyin: Suīrán duìfāng duì hěn qiáng, dànshi wǒmen duì jiānchí dào le zuìhòu.
en: Although the other team was strong, our team persisted until the end.

zh: 因为新来的教练很有经验，所以队里的表现比上赛季好多了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xīn lái de jiàoliàn hěn yǒu jīngyàn, suǒyǐ duìli de biǎoxiàn bǐ shàng sàijì hǎo duō le.
en: Because the new coach is very experienced, the team's performance has improved a lot compared to last season.

zh: 这支队伍虽然人数不多，但凭着团队精神和坚持不懈的训练，最终赢得了冠军。
pinyin: Zhè zhī duìwu suīrán rénshù búduō, dàn píngzháo tuánduì jīngshén hé jiānchí búxié de xùnliàn, zuìzh終 yíngdé le guànjūn.
en: Although this team wasn't large in numbers, through teamwork and relentless training, they ultimately won the championship.

zh: 我无法吃辣。
pinyin: Wǒ wúfǎ chī là.
en: I can't eat spicy food.

zh: 他今天无法来上课。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān wúfǎ lái shàngkè.
en: He can't come to class today.

zh: 因为下雨，我们无法去公园玩。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒmen wúfǎ qù gōngyuán wán.
en: Because of the rain, we can't go play in the park.

zh: 虽然他很努力，但无法通过这次考试。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn nǔlì, dàn wúfǎ tōngguò zhè cì kǎoshì.
en: Even though he worked hard, he still couldn't pass this exam.

zh: 由于网络问题，我们无法及时获取最新信息。
pinyin: Yóuyú wǎngluò wèntí, wǒmen wúfǎ jíshí huòqǔ zuìxīn xìnxī.
en: Due to network issues, we're unable to get the latest information in a timely manner.

zh: 这是我的房子。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de fángzi.
en: This is my house.

zh: 我昨天买了一个新房子。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān mǎi le yī ge xīn fángzi.
en: I bought a new house yesterday.

zh: 因为房子太小，所以我们想搬到大房子里。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fángzi tài xiǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen xiǎng bān dào dà fángzi lǐ.
en: Because the house is too small, we want to move to a bigger one.

zh: 虽然那个房子价格很贵，但是位置特别好，靠近学校。
pinyin: Suīrán nàge fángzi jiàgé hěn guì, dànshì wèizhì tèbié hǎo, kàojìn xuéxiào.
en: Although that house is expensive, the location is really good—it's close to the school.

zh: 他们存了五年钱才买到这套房子，现在生活质量提高了不少。
pinyin: Tāmen cún le wǔ nián qián cái mǎi dào zhè tào fángzi, xiànzài shēnghuó zhìliàng tíhuà le búshǎo.
en: They saved money for five years before they could afford this house, and their quality of life has improved quite a bit now.

zh: 妈妈拉我的手。
pinyin: Māma lā wǒ de shǒu.
en: Mom is holding my hand.

zh: 昨天他拉了我去公园。
pinyin: Zuótiān tā lāle wǒ qù gōngyuán.
en: Yesterday he dragged me to the park.

zh: 因为天气冷，他拉上了窗帘。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì lěng, tā lāshàngle chuānglián.
en: Because it was cold, he pulled the curtains shut.

zh: 虽然他很累，但还是拉着行李走到了车站。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn lèi, dàn háishi lāzhe xíngli zǒudàole chēzhàn.
en: Although he was exhausted, he still managed to drag his luggage to the station.

zh: 这个项目被拉长了三个月，客户的耐心也跟着被拉到了极限。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù bèi lāchángle sān ge yuè, kèhù de nàixīn yě gēnzhe bèi lādàole jíxiàn.
en: The project got dragged out by three months, and the client's patience wore thin along with it.

zh: 我的衣服是蓝色的。
pinyin: Wǒ de yīfu shì lán sè de.
en: My clothes are blue.

zh: 昨天我买了两件新衣服。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ mǎi le liǎng jiàn xīn yīfu.
en: I bought two new outfits yesterday.

zh: 因为天气冷，所以我穿了厚衣服。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ chuān le hòu yīfu.
en: Because the weather is cold, I wore thick clothing.

zh: 虽然这件衣服很贵，但质量特别好。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiàn yīfu hěn guì, dàn zhìliàng tèbié hǎo.
en: Although this piece of clothing is expensive, the quality is really excellent.

zh: 现在很多人喜欢网购衣服，因为既方便又便宜。
pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō rén xǐhuān wǎng gòu yīfu, yīnwèi jì fāngbiàn yòu piányi.
en: Nowadays many people like buying clothes online because it's both convenient and affordable.

zh: 听说你吃了米饭。
pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ chīle mǐfàn.
en: I heard you ate rice.

zh: 听说明天会下雨，我们在家吧。
pinyin: Tīngshuō míngtiān huì xiàyǔ, wǒmen zàijiā ba.
en: I heard it'll rain tomorrow, so let's stay home.

zh: 听说这家餐厅很好吃，因为他们的菜很新鲜。
pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè jiā cāntīng hěn hǎochī, yīnwèi tāmen de cài hěn xīnxiān.
en: People say this restaurant is really good because their dishes are always fresh.

zh: 听说他辞职了，虽然工资不错，但是工作太累了。
pinyin: Tīngshuō tā císhíle, suīrán gōngzī búcuò, dànshì gōngzuò tài lèile.
en: I heard he quit his job—the pay was decent, but the work was exhausting.

zh: 听说他在这个项目上投入了很多时间，结果反而没有取得预期的成果。
pinyin: Tīngshuō tā zài zhège xiàngmù shang tóurùle hěnduō shíjiān, jiéguǒ fǎn'ér méiyǒu qǔdé yùqī de chéngguǒ.
en: I heard he put a lot of effort into this project, but ironically didn't achieve the expected results.

zh: 医生救了我。
pinyin: Yīshēng jiùle wǒ.
en: The doctor saved me.

zh: 昨天消防员救出了那只小猫。
pinyin: Zuótiān xiāofánghuǒyuán jiùchūle nà zhī xiǎo māo.
en: Yesterday the firefighters rescued that kitten.

zh: 因为天气不好，救援队的工作变得很困难。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, jiùyuánduì de gōngzuò biànde hěn kùnnan.
en: Because of the bad weather, the rescue team's work became very difficult.

zh: 虽然他不会游泳，但他还是跳进水里救了溺水的孩子。
pinyin: Suīrán tā búhuì yóuyǒng, dàn tā háishi tiàojìn shuǐlǐ jiùle nìshuǐ de háizi.
en: Although he couldn't swim, he still jumped into the water and rescued the drowning child.

zh: 政府为了救经济危机，采取了一系列刺激消费的政策。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ wèile jiù jīngjì wēijī, cǎiqǔle yī xìliè cìjī xiāofèi de zhèngcè.
en: To rescue the economy from crisis, the government implemented a series of consumer-stimulus policies.

zh: 我参加了派对。
pinyin: Wǒ参jiā le pài duì.
en: I went to the party.

zh: 昨天我参加了学校的运动会。
pinyin: Zuó tiān wǒ参jiā le xué xiào de yùn dòng huì.
en: I participated in my school's sports day yesterday.

zh: 虽然很累，但我还是参加了朋友的婚礼。
pinyin: Suī rán hěn lèi, dàn wǒ háishi参jiā le péng you de hūn lǐ.
en: Although I was exhausted, I still attended my friend's wedding.

zh: 因为想增加工作经验，他决定参加这个实习项目。
pinyin: Yīn wèi xiǎng zēng jiā gōng zuò jīng yàn, tā jué dìng参jiā zhè ge shí xí xiàng mù.
en: He decided to join the internship program because he wanted to gain work experience.

zh: 越来越多的年轻人选择参加各种志愿活动来回报社会。
pinyin: Yuè lái yuè duō de nián qīng rén xuǎn zé参jiā gè zhǒng zhì yuàn huó dòng lái huí bào shè huì.
en: More and more young people are choosing to take part in volunteer activities as a way to give back to society.

zh: 我有办法了。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu bànfǎ le.
en: I've got an idea.

zh: 没有办法，我们只能等他。
pinyin: Méiyǒu bànfǎ, wǒmen zhǐnéng děng tā.
en: There's no way around it—we just have to wait for him.

zh: 虽然很难，但我们一定能想到办法。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dàn wǒmen yídìng néng xiǎngdào bànfǎ.
en: Even though it's difficult, we'll definitely come up with a solution.

zh: 如果按照他的办法去做，问题会更复杂。
pinyin: Rúguǒ ànzhào tā de bànfǎ qù zuò, wèntí huì gèng fùzá.
en: If we follow his approach, the problem will only get more complicated.

zh: 与其抱怨，不如主动想办法改善现状。
pinyin: Yǔqī bàoyuàn, búrú zhǔdòng xiǎng bànfǎ gǎishàn xiànzhuàng.
en: Rather than complain, it's better to take the initiative and figure out ways to improve the situation.

zh: 我每天睡八小时。
pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān shuì bā xiǎo shí.
en: I sleep eight hours every day.

zh: 昨天我睡得很晚，今天很累。
pinyin: Zuó tiān wǒ shuì de hěn wǎn, jīn tiān hěn lèi.
en: I went to bed very late yesterday, so I'm tired today.

zh: 因为他工作太忙，所以睡眠不足。
pinyin: Yīn wèi tā gōng zuò tài máng, suǒ yǐ shuì mián bù zú.
en: Because he's too busy with work, he doesn't get enough sleep.

zh: 在飞机上睡觉很不舒服，但我还是睡着了。
pinyin: Zài fēi jī shàng shuì jiào hěn bu shū fu, dàn wǒ háishi shuì zháo le.
en: Sleeping on a plane is uncomfortable, but I managed to fall asleep anyway.

zh: 长期睡眠不足会影响免疫系统和工作效率。
pinyin: Cháng qī shuì mián bu zú huì yǐng xiǎng miǎn yì xì tǒng hé gōng zuò xiào lǜ.
en: Chronic sleep deprivation can affect your immune system and work performance.

zh: 这是唯一的苹果。
pinyin: Zhè shì wéiyī de píngguǒ.
en: This is the only apple.

zh: 他唯一喜欢吃的是米饭。
pinyin: Tā wéiyī xǐhuān chī de shì mǐfàn.
en: The only thing he likes to eat is rice.

zh: 虽然很难，但这是唯一的办法。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dàn zhè shì wéiyī de bànfǎ.
en: Even though it's difficult, this is the only way.

zh: 工作是她唯一能专注的事情。
pinyin: Gōngzuò shì tā wéiyī néng zhuānzhù de shìqing.
en: Work is the only thing she can really focus on.

zh: 在这个竞争激烈的市场中，创新是企业唯一的出路。
pinyin: Zài zhège jìngjìng jīliè de shìchǎng zhōng, chuàngxīn shì qǐyè wéiyī de chūlù.
en: In this fiercely competitive market, innovation is the company's only way forward.

zh: 我要回去吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ yào huíqù chīfàn.
en: I need to go back and eat.

zh: 下课以后，我们都回去了。
pinyin: Xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒmen dōu huíqù le.
en: After class ended, we all went back home.

zh: 虽然今天很累，但是我还是回去做了功课。
pinyin: Suīrán jīntiān hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ háishi huíqù zuò le gōngkè.
en: Although I was tired today, I still went back and did my homework.

zh: 因为忘记了钥匙，他不得不回去问邻居借。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wàngjì le yàoshi, tā búdébu huíqù wèn línjū jiè.
en: Because he forgot his keys, he had no choice but to go back and ask his neighbor to borrow a set.

zh: 虽然工作机会很不错，但考虑到父母的身体，他最后还是决定回去了。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò jīhuì hěn búcuò, dàn kǎolǜ dào fùmǔ de shēntǐ, tā zuìhòu háishi juédìng huíqù le.
en: Although the job opportunity was quite good, considering his parents' health, he ultimately decided to go back anyway.

zh: 人们喜欢吃饭。
pinyin: Rénmen xǐhuān chīfàn.
en: People like to eat.

zh: 早上人们都去上班了。
pinyin: Zǎoshang rénmen dōu qù shàngbān le.
en: In the morning, everyone goes to work.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以人们都想出去玩。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ rénmen dōu xiǎng chūqù wán.
en: Because the weather is nice, people want to go out and have fun.

zh: 现在越来越多的人们开始关注环境保护的问题。
pinyin: Xiànzài yuèláiyuè duō de rénmen kāishǐ guānzhù huánjìng bǎohù de wèntí.
en: Nowadays, more and more people are starting to pay attention to environmental protection issues.

zh: 尽管生活压力很大，但人们仍然对未来充满了希望。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn shēnghuó yālì hěn dà, dàn rénmen réngrán duì wèilái chōngmǎn le xīwàng.
en: Despite the enormous pressure of daily life, people still remain hopeful about the future.

zh: 我晚上吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ wǎnshang chīfàn.
en: I eat dinner in the evening.

zh: 他今天晚上不来了。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān wǎnshang búlái le.
en: He's not coming tonight.

zh: 因为下雨，所以我晚到了公司。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ wǎn dào le gōngsī.
en: Because it was raining, I arrived at the office late.

zh: 虽然出发晚了，但我们还是按时赶到了会议。
pinyin: Suīrán chūfā wǎn le, dàn wǒmen háishi ànshí gǎndào le huìyì.
en: Although we left late, we still made it to the meeting on time.

zh: 每次都晚交作业，这样下去肯定会吃亏的。
pinyin: Měi cì dōu wǎn jiāo zuòyè, zhèyàng xiàqu kěndìng huì chīkuī de.
en: You keep submitting assignments late—if this keeps up, you'll definitely pay the price.

zh: 该死的蚊子！
pinyin: gāisǐ de wénzi!
en: Damn mosquitoes!

zh: 该死，我忘记带钥匙了。
pinyin: Gāisǐ, wǒ wàngjì dài yàoshi le.
en: Damn it, I forgot to bring my keys.

zh: 因为天气太热，那只该死的猫躲在房间里睡觉。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì tài rè, nà zhī gāisǐ de māo duǒ zài fángjiān lǐ shuìjiào.
en: Because it's too hot, that damn cat is hiding in the room sleeping.

zh: 这该死的电脑又坏了，害得我今天没办法完成工作。
pinyin: Zhè gāisǐ de diànnǎo yòu huài le, hài de wǒ jīntiān méi bànfǎ wánchéng gōngzuò.
en: This damned computer broke again, and now I can't finish my work today.

zh: 这该死的堵车让我差点迟到，真是倒霉透了。
pinyin: Zhè gāisǐ de dǔ chē ràng wǒ chàdiǎn chídào, zhēnshi dàomèi tòu le.
en: This damn traffic jam almost made me late—talk about bad luck.

zh: 门闭了。
pinyin: Mén bì le.
en: The door is closed.

zh: 晚上我们闭上眼睛睡觉。
pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒmen bì shang yǎnjing shuìjiào.
en: In the evening we close our eyes and go to sleep.

zh: 因为太吵，我闭上耳朵的时候还是听得见。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tài chǎo, wǒ bì shang ěrduǒ de shíhou háishi tīng de jiàn.
en: Because it was so noisy, even when I covered my ears I could still hear it.

zh: 他闭着嘴巴没有说话，但眼睛里充满了不满。
pinyin: Tā bìzhe zuǐba méiyǒu shuōhuà, dàn yǎnjing lǐ chōngmǎn le búmǎn.
en: He kept his mouth shut and said nothing, but his eyes were full of displeasure.

zh: 与其闭门造车，不如多听听客户的真实想法。
pinyin: Yǔqī bìmén zàochē, búrú duō tīngting kèhù de zhēnshí xiǎngfǎ.
en: Rather than work in isolation, it's better to listen to what customers actually think.

zh: 我选择吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ xuǎnzé chī mǐfàn.
en: I choose to eat rice.

zh: 今天我选择穿红色的衣服。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ xuǎnzé chuān hóngsè de yīfu.
en: Today I'm choosing to wear a red shirt.

zh: 因为天气很热，所以我选择喝冷水。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn rè, suǒyǐ wǒ xuǎnzé hē lěngshuǐ.
en: Because the weather is hot, I choose to drink cold water.

zh: 大学生在选择专业的时候需要认真考虑。
pinyin: Dàxuésheng zài xuǎnzé zhuānyè de shíhou xūyào rènzhēn kǎolǜ.
en: University students need to think seriously when choosing their major.

zh: 面对不同的工作机会，求职者的选择往往决定了他的职业前景。
pinyin: Miànduì búhuà de gōngzuò jīhuì, qiúzhízhě de xuǎnzé wǎngwǎng juédingled e zhíyè qiánjǐng.
en: When faced with different job opportunities, a job seeker's choice often determines their career prospects.

zh: 这个苹果坏了。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ huài le.
en: This apple has gone bad.

zh: 昨天下雨,我的手机坏了。
pinyin: Zuótiān xiàyǔ, wǒ de shǒujī huài le.
en: It rained yesterday and my phone broke.

zh: 因为天气坏,所以我们没有去公园。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì huài, suǒyǐ wǒmen méiyǒu qù gōngyuán.
en: Because the weather was bad, we didn't go to the park.

zh: 他虽然很聪明,但性格有点坏,很难相处。
pinyin: Tā suīrán hěn cōngming, dàn xìnggé yǒudiǎn huài, hěn nán xiāngchǔ.
en: Although he's very smart, his personality is a bit unpleasant and hard to get along with.

zh: 这件事处理得不好,可能会坏了公司的名声。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì chǔlǐ de búhǎo, kěnéng huì huài le gōngsī de míngsheng.
en: If this matter isn't handled well, it could damage the company's reputation.

zh: 他迟到的原因是堵车。
pinyin: Tā chídào de yuányīn shì dǔchē.
en: The reason he was late is traffic.

zh: 她今天不来上班的原因是生病了。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān búlái shàngbān de yuányīn shì shēngbìng le.
en: The reason she didn't come to work today is that she's sick.

zh: 虽然原因很复杂，但是我们还是要继续工作。
pinyin: Suīrán yuányīn hěn fùzá, dànshì wǒmen háishi yào jìxù gōngzuò.
en: Although the reasons are complicated, we still need to keep working.

zh: 公司决定关闭这家店铺的主要原因是销售额下降。
pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng guānbì zhè jiā diànpù de zhǔyào yuányīn shì xiāoshòu'é xiàjiàng.
en: The main reason the company decided to close this store is because sales have dropped.

zh: 造成这场事故的根本原因还没有完全查清楚。
pinyin: Zàochéng zhè chǎng shìgù de gēnběn yuányīn háimeiyǒu wánquán cháqīngchu.
en: The underlying cause of this accident hasn't been fully clarified yet.

zh: 继续吃下去。
pinyin: Jìxù chī xiàqù.
en: Keep eating.

zh: 天黑了，我们走下去吧。
pinyin: Tiān hēi le, wǒmen zǒu xiàqù ba.
en: It's getting dark, let's keep walking.

zh: 虽然很累，但他还是坚持工作下去。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn tā háishi jiānchí gōngzuò xiàqù.
en: Even though he was exhausted, he still kept on working.

zh: 如果这样发展下去，公司可能会面临很大的困难。
pinyin: Rúguǒ zhèyàng fāzhǎn xiàqù, gōngsī kěnéng huì miànlín hěn dà de kùnnan.
en: If things continue to develop this way, the company might face serious difficulties.

zh: 按照目前的趋势下去，我们很难在竞争中占据优势。
pinyin: Ànzhào mùqián de qūshì xiàqù, wǒmen hěn nán zài jìngjìng zhōng zhànnjù yōushì.
en: Given the current trend, it'll be hard for us to maintain a competitive edge.

zh: 我受伤了。
pinyin: Wǒ shòushāng le.
en: I got injured.

zh: 昨天我受到了老师的表扬。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ shòudào le lǎoshī de biǎoyáng.
en: Yesterday I received praise from my teacher.

zh: 虽然比赛很难，但他还是受到了大家的欢迎。
pinyin: Suīrán bǐsài hěn nán, dànshì tā háishi shòudào le dàjiā de huānyíng.
en: Although the competition was difficult, he was still welcomed by everyone.

zh: 因为他的努力，所以受到了公司的重视和提升。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā de nǔlì, suǒyǐ shòudào le gōngsī de zhòngshì hé tíshēng.
en: Because of his hard work, he gained the company's attention and got promoted.

zh: 这部电影虽然受到不少批评，但票房依然很好。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng suīrán shòudào búshǎo pīpíng, dàn piàofáng yīrán hěn hǎo.
en: Despite receiving considerable criticism, the film's box office performance remained strong.

zh: 我连水都没喝。
pinyin: Wǒ lián shuǐ dōu méi hē.
en: I didn't even drink any water.

zh: 昨天我连饭都没吃就睡觉了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ lián fàn dōu méi chī jiù shuìjiào le.
en: Yesterday I went to sleep without even eating dinner.

zh: 因为很忙，他连朋友的电话都没接过。
pinyin: Yīnwèi hěn máng, tā lián péngyou de diànhuà dōu méi jiē guò.
en: Because he was so busy, he didn't even answer his friends' calls.

zh: 这家餐厅的服务很差，连基本的礼貌都没有。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de fúwù hěn chà, lián jīběn de lǐmào dōu méiyǒu.
en: This restaurant's service is terrible—they don't even have basic courtesy.

zh: 他对工作的执着程度让人印象深刻，连周末都在思考项目的方案。
pinyin: Tā duì gōngzuò de zhízháo chéngdù ràng rén yìnxiàng shēnkè, lián zhōumò dōu zài sīkǎo xiàngmù de fāng'àn.
en: His dedication to work is impressive—he even spends weekends thinking about project solutions.

zh: 你要好好吃饭。
pinyin: Nǐ yào hǎohāo chīfàn.
en: You need to eat well.

zh: 明天你要好好睡觉,不要太晚。
pinyin: Míngtiān nǐ yào hǎohāo shuìjiào, búyào tài wǎn.
en: Tomorrow you should get proper sleep and not stay up too late.

zh: 因为考试很重要,所以你这周要好好复习功课。
pinyin: Yīnwèi kǎoshì hěn zhòngyào, suǒyǐ nǐ zhè zhōu yào hǎohāo fùxí gōngkè.
en: Since the exam is important, you should study your lessons carefully this week.

zh: 虽然工作很忙,但我还是决定好好陪陪家人。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn wǒ háishi juéding hǎohāo péipeì jiārén.
en: Although work is busy, I've decided to spend quality time with my family anyway.

zh: 他意识到健康的重要性后,就开始好好锻炼身体,改善生活习惯。
pinyin: Tā yìshi dào jiànkāng de zhòngyàoxìng hòu, jiù kāishǐ hǎohāo duànliàn shēntǐ, gǎishàn shēnghuó xíguàn.
en: After realizing the importance of health, he started exercising properly and improving his lifestyle habits.

zh: 我吃全部米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ chī quánbù mǐfàn.
en: I ate all the rice.

zh: 今天全班学生都来学校了。
pinyin: Jīntiān quánbān xuésheng dōu lái xuéxiào le.
en: All the students in the class came to school today.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但是全家人还是决定去公园。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, búshì quánjiā rén háishi juéding qù gōngyuán.
en: Although the weather was bad, the whole family still decided to go to the park.

zh: 因为这个项目很重要，所以我们需要全力以赴地完成它。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhège xiàngmù hěn zhòngyào, suǒyǐ wǒmen xūyào quánlì yǐ fù de wánchéng tā.
en: Because this project is so important, we need to give it our all to complete it.

zh: 员工们对公司的改革意见不全相同，但都支持这个大方向。
pinyin: Yuángōngmen duì gōngsī de gǎigé yìjian búquán xiāngtóng, búguò dōu zhīchí zhège dà fāngxiàng.
en: The employees don't entirely agree on the company's reforms, but they all support the general direction.

zh: 这个苹果确实很甜。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ quèshí hěn tián.
en: This apple is really sweet.

zh: 昨天的天气确实很冷。
pinyin: Zuótiān de tiānqì quèshí hěn lěng.
en: Yesterday's weather was definitely very cold.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但他确实想帮助我们。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn tā quèshí xiǎng bāngzhù wǒmen.
en: Although he's very busy, he really does want to help us.

zh: 这份工作的薪水确实比上一份高得多。
pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò de xīnshuǐ quèshí bǐ shàng yī fèn gāo de duō.
en: The salary for this job is definitely much higher than the previous one.

zh: 他说的确实有道理，不过执行起来并不简单。
pinyin: Tā shuō de quèshí yǒu dàolǐ, búguò zhíxíng qǐlai bìng bu jiǎndān.
en: What he said does make sense, but putting it into practice isn't straightforward.

zh: 这个苹果挺好吃。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ tǐng hǎochī.
en: This apple is pretty tasty.

zh: 昨天的天气挺冷的。
pinyin: Zuótiān de tiānqì tǐng lěng de.
en: The weather yesterday was quite cold.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但是他挺支持我的想法。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì tā tǐng zhīchí wǒ de xiǎngfǎ.
en: Even though he's busy, he's pretty supportive of my ideas.

zh: 这个项目的难度挺大，但团队还是坚持完成了。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de nándù tǐng dà, dàn tuánduì háishi jiānchí wánchéng le.
en: This project is quite challenging, but the team managed to finish it anyway.

zh: 她在公司里表现得挺出色，升职的机会也相当不错。
pinyin: Tā zài gōngsī li biǎoxiàn de tǐng chūsè, shēngzhí de jīhuì yě xiāngdāng búcuò.
en: She's performed quite well at the company, and her chances for promotion are pretty good too.

zh: 此书很好。
pinyin: Cǐ shū hěn hǎo.
en: This book is really good.

zh: 我喜欢此地的天气。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān cǐ dì de tiānqì.
en: I like the weather in this place.

zh: 虽然此事很困难，但是我们一定要做。
pinyin: Suīrán cǐ shì hěn kùnnan, dànshì wǒmen yīdìng yào zuò.
en: Although this matter is difficult, we definitely have to do it.

zh: 因为此次会议很重要，所以我们需要认真准备。
pinyin: Yīnwèi cǐ cì huìyì hěn zhòngyào, suǒyǐ wǒmen xūyào rènzhēn zhǔnbèi.
en: Since this meeting is so important, we need to prepare carefully.

zh: 此外，研究表明这个方法的效率比之前提高了三倍。
pinyin: Cǐwài, yánjiū biǎomíng zhège fāngfǎ de xiàolǜ bǐ zhīqián tíigāo le sān bèi.
en: Moreover, research shows that this method's efficiency has increased threefold compared to before.

zh: 我喝水。
pinyin: Wǒ hē shuǐ.
en: I drink water.

zh: 早上我喝了一杯水。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ hēle yī bēi shuǐ.
en: I had a glass of water this morning.

zh: 因为天很热，所以我喝了很多水。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiān hěn rè, suǒyǐ wǒ hēle hěn duō shuǐ.
en: Because it was so hot, I drank a lot of water.

zh: 虽然外面下雨了，但是花园里的水还不够。
pinyin: Suīrán wàimiàn xiàyǔ le, dànshì huāyuán lǐ de shuǐ háishi búgòu.
en: Even though it rained outside, there still wasn't enough water in the garden.

zh: 他对这份工作的热情如火如荼，比投入水中的热度还高。
pinyin: Tā duì zhè fèn gōngzuò de règíng rúhuǒrútú, bǐ tóurù shuǐ zhōng de règù háishi gāo.
en: His passion for this job is so fervent—it's like throwing heat into water, burning even hotter.

zh: 他是混蛋。
pinyin: Tā shì huùndàn.
en: He's a jerk.

zh: 那个混蛋昨天又迟到了。
pinyin: Nàge huùndàn zuótiān yòu chídào le.
en: That jerk was late again yesterday.

zh: 因为他说谎，所以我觉得他是个混蛋。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā shuōhuǎng, suǒyǐ wǒ juéde tā shì ge huùndàn.
en: Because he lied, I think he's a real jerk.

zh: 虽然他道歉了，但我还是觉得他那样对我很混蛋。
pinyin: Suīrán tā dàoqiàn le, dàn wǒ háishi juéde tā nàyàng duì wǒ hěn huùndàn.
en: Even though he apologized, I still think what he did to me was really jerky.

zh: 你别在我面前装好人，我早就看透你那套混蛋的把戏了。
pinyin: Nǐ biè zài wǒ miànqián zhuāng hǎorén, wǒ zǎojiù kàntòu nǐ nàtào huùndàn de bǎxì le.
en: Don't pretend to be a good guy in front of me—I saw through your jerky tricks a long time ago.

zh: 我喝一杯水。
pinyin: Wǒ hē yī bēi shuǐ.
en: I drink a cup of water.

zh: 早上我喝一杯咖啡。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ hē yī bēi kāfēi.
en: In the morning I have a cup of coffee.

zh: 因为天气很热，所以我想喝一杯冷饮。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn rè, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng hē yī bēi lěngyǐn.
en: Because the weather is very hot, I want to drink a cold beverage.

zh: 虽然这个杯子很便宜，但是质量还不错。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège bēizi hěn piányí, dànshì zhìliàng háishi búcuò.
en: Although this cup is cheap, the quality is actually pretty good.

zh: 他一口气喝完了三杯啤酒，同事们都为他的酒量印象深刻。
pinyin: Tā yīkǒuqì hēwán le sān bēi píjiǔ, tóngshìmen dōu wèi tāde jiǔliàng yìnxiàng shēnkè.
en: He drank three beers in one go, and his colleagues were really impressed by his alcohol tolerance.

zh: 我保证明天来。
pinyin: Wǒ bǎozhèng míngtiān lái.
en: I promise I'll come tomorrow.

zh: 他保证这个菜很好吃。
pinyin: Tā bǎozhèng zhège cài hěn hǎochī.
en: He guarantees this dish tastes really good.

zh: 因为质量有问题，公司保证给你换新的。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhìliàng yǒu wèntí, gōngsī bǎozhèng gěi nǐ huàn xīn de.
en: Because there's a quality issue, the company promises to replace it with a new one for you.

zh: 虽然计划改了很多次，但是我保证这次一定能完成。
pinyin: Suīrán jìhuà gǎi le hěnduō cì, dànshì wǒ bǎozhèng zhè cì yídìng néng wánchéng.
en: Even though the plan has changed many times, I absolutely guarantee we'll finish it this time.

zh: 只要你按照说明书操作，我就保证产品不会出现问题。
pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ ānzhào shuōmíngshū cāozuò, wǒ jiù bǎozhèng chǎnpǐn búhuì chūxiàn wèntí.
en: As long as you follow the instructions, I guarantee the product won't have any problems.

zh: 我的学校很大。
pinyin: Wǒ de xuéxiào hěn dà.
en: My school is very big.

zh: 每天早上我去学校上课。
pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang wǒ qù xuéxiào shàngkè.
en: Every morning I go to school for class.

zh: 因为下雨，所以学校今天放假了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ xuéxiào jīntiān fàngjià le.
en: Because it rained, school is closed today.

zh: 虽然学校离我家很远，但我还是喜欢那里。
pinyin: Suīrán xuéxiào lí wǒ jiā hěn yuǎn, dàn wǒ háishi xǐhuān nàlǐ.
en: Even though my school is far from home, I still really like it there.

zh: 从小学到高中，我在这所学校度过了最重要的成长时期。
pinyin: Cóng xiǎoxué dào gāozhōng, wǒ zài zhè suǒ xuéxiào dùguò le zuì zhòngyào de chéngzhǎng shíqī.
en: From elementary through high school, I spent my most formative years at this school.

zh: 妈妈卖菜。
pinyin: Māma mài cài.
en: Mom sells vegetables.

zh: 这家店卖很便宜的衣服。
pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn mài hěn piányi de yīfu.
en: This shop sells clothes that are really cheap.

zh: 因为房子太贵，他决定卖掉旧车来还债。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fángzi tài guì, tā juéding mài diào jiù chē lái hái zhài.
en: Because the house was so expensive, he decided to sell his old car to pay off the debt.

zh: 虽然这个品牌卖得很火，但质量问题不少。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège pǐnpái mài de hěn huǒ, dàn zhìliàng wèntí búshǎo.
en: Although this brand sells like hotcakes, it has quite a few quality issues.

zh: 他靠卖二手电子产品发家致富，现在已经成为这个市场的龙头企业。
pinyin: Tā kào mài èrshǒu diànzǐ chǎnpǐn fājiā zhìfù, xiànzài yǐjīng chéngwéi zhège shìchǎng de lóngtóu qǐyè.
en: He built his fortune by dealing in used electronics, and has now become the market leader in that sector.

zh: 我信你。
pinyin: Wǒ xìn nǐ.
en: I trust you.

zh: 他每天都收信和邮件。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu shōu xìn hé yóujiàn.
en: He receives letters and emails every day.

zh: 因为我信任他，所以我告诉他我的秘密。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ xìnrèn tā, suǒyǐ wǒ gàosu tā wǒ de mìmì.
en: Because I trust him, I told him my secret.

zh: 虽然信息很多，但我只相信来自官方的信息。
pinyin: Suīrán xìnxī hěn duō, dàn wǒ zhǐ xiāngxìn láizì guānfāng de xìnxī.
en: Although there's a lot of information out there, I only trust what comes from official sources.

zh: 与其盲目相信网络谣言，不如核实信息的真假。
pinyin: Yǔqī mángmù xiāngxìn wǎngluò yáoyán, búrú héshí xìnxī de zhēnjiǎ.
en: Rather than blindly believing internet rumors, it's better to verify whether the information is true or false.

zh: 我接受你的礼物。
pinyin: Wǒ jiēshòu nǐ de lǐwù.
en: I accept your gift.

zh: 他今天接受了我的邀请。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān jiēshòu le wǒ de yāoqǐng.
en: He accepted my invitation today.

zh: 虽然很累，但她仍然接受了这份工作。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn tā réngrán jiēshòu le zhè fèn gōngzuò.
en: Even though she was tired, she still accepted the job.

zh: 许多患者接受了新的治疗方法，效果很不错。
pinyin: Xǔduō huànzhě jiēshòu le xīn de zhìliáo fāngfǎ, xiàoguǒ hěn búcuò.
en: Many patients accepted the new treatment method, and the results were quite good.

zh: 公司接受了员工的反馈意见，并在下个月推出改进版本。
pinyin: Gōngsī jiēshòu le yuángōng de fǎnkuì yìjiàn, bìng zài xiàge yuè tuīchū gǎijìn bǎnběn.
en: The company accepted the employees' feedback and will roll out an improved version next month.

zh: 我改变了主意。
pinyin: Wǒ gǎibiàn le zhǔyì.
en: I changed my mind.

zh: 他今年改变了很多。
pinyin: Tā jīnnián gǎibiàn le hěnduō.
en: He's changed a lot this year.

zh: 因为天气改变了，所以我们改变了计划。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì gǎibiàn le, suǒyǐ wǒmen gǎibiàn le jìhuà.
en: Because the weather changed, we changed our plans.

zh: 学习新技能能改变一个人的职业前景。
pinyin: Xuéxí xīn jìnéng néng gǎibiàn yīgè rén de zhíyè qiánjǐng.
en: Learning new skills can transform someone's career prospects.

zh: 这次经历彻底改变了她对生活的态度和价值观。
pinyin: Zhè cì jīnglì chèdǐ gǎibiàn le tā duì shēnghuó de tàidù hé jiàzhíguān.
en: This experience fundamentally changed her attitudes and values about life.

zh: 她喜欢舞蹈。
pinyin: Tā xǐhuān wǔdǎo.
en: She likes dancing.

zh: 每天晚上她都去学舞。
pinyin: Měitiān wǎnshang tā dōu qù xué wǔ.
en: She goes to dance class every evening.

zh: 虽然他很累，但是他还是去舞蹈班了。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn lèi, dànshì tā háishi qù wǔdǎobān le.
en: Even though he was tired, he still went to dance class.

zh: 因为练舞需要很多时间，所以他的功课受到了影响。
pinyin: Yīnwèi liàn wǔ xūyào hěnduō shíjiān, suǒyǐ tā de gōngkè shòudàole yǐngxiǎng.
en: Because dance practice takes a lot of time, his schoolwork has been affected.

zh: 她在舞台上的表现令人印象深刻，观众都被她的舞蹈深深吸引了。
pinyin: Tā zài wǔtái shang de biǎoxiàn lìng rén yìnxiàng shēnkè, guānzhòng dōu bèi tā de wǔdǎo shēnshēn xīyǐnle.
en: Her performance on stage left a deep impression, and the audience was completely captivated by her dancing.

zh: 看来今天会下雨。
pinyin: Kàn lái jīntiān huì xiàyǔ.
en: It looks like it's going to rain today.

zh: 看来你很喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Kàn lái nǐ hěn xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: It seems you really like eating rice.

zh: 虽然很晚了，但看来他还在工作。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn wǎn le, dàn kàn lái tā háizài gōngzuò.
en: Even though it's late, it looks like he's still working.

zh: 看来你对这个问题的理解有些不一样。
pinyin: Kàn lái nǐ duì zhège wèntí de lǐjiě yǒuxiē búyīyàng.
en: It seems your understanding of this problem is a bit different from others.

zh: 看来这个项目能否成功，关键还是在于团队的执行力。
pinyin: Kàn lái zhège xiàngmù néngfǒu chénggōng, guānjiàn háishi zàiyú tuánduì de zhíxíng lì.
en: It appears that whether this project succeeds ultimately depends on the team's ability to execute.

zh: 这个山很高。
pinyin: Zhège shān hěn gāo.
en: This mountain is very tall.

zh: 我哥哥个子很高，比我高多了。
pinyin: Wǒ gēge gèzi hěn gāo, bǐ wǒ gāo duō le.
en: My older brother is really tall; he's much taller than me.

zh: 因为房子在高楼层，所以租金很贵。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fángzi zài gāo lóu céng, suǒyǐ zūjīn hěn guì.
en: Because the apartment is on a high floor, the rent is very expensive.

zh: 虽然这份工作薪水高，但是压力也特别大。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè fèn gōngzuò xīnshuǐ gāo, dànshì yālì yě tèbié dà.
en: Although this job pays well, the pressure is also extremely intense.

zh: 他的学历很高，却找不到理想的工作，真是高不成低不就。
pinyin: Tā de xuéli hěn gāo,却 zhǎo bu dào lǐxiǎng de gōngzuò, zhēnshi gāo bu chéng dī bu jiù.
en: He has an advanced degree but can't find a job he really wants—caught between aiming too high and settling too low.

zh: 请帮我，这很麻烦。
pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ, zhè hěn máfan.
en: Please help me—this is really annoying.

zh: 早上起床很麻烦，我不想起。
pinyin: Zǎoshang qǐchuáng hěn máfan, wǒ búxiǎng qǐ.
en: Getting up in the morning is a hassle; I don't want to do it.

zh: 虽然这个办法有点麻烦，但是很有用。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège bànfǎ yǒudiǎn máfan, dànshi hěn yǒuyòng.
en: Although this method is somewhat troublesome, it's actually quite effective.

zh: 能不能麻烦你帮我查一下这个单词的意思？
pinyin: Néng bu néng máfan nǐ bāng wǒ chá yīxià zhège dāncí de yìsi?
en: Would you mind helping me look up the meaning of this word?

zh: 这件事说起来简单，做起来却很麻烦，需要很多时间和精力。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì shuōqǐlái jiǎndān, zuòqǐlái què hěn máfan, xūyào hěnduō shíjiān hé jīnglì.
en: This matter sounds simple in theory, but it's actually quite complicated and requires a lot of time and effort.

zh: 猫出现了。
pinyin: Māo chūxiàn le.
en: The cat appeared.

zh: 早上太阳出现在天空。
pinyin: Zǎoshang tàiyáng chūxiàn zài tiānkōng.
en: The sun appears in the sky in the morning.

zh: 因为下雨,所以问题出现了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wèntí chūxiàn le.
en: Because it rained, problems came up.

zh: 自从他搬到新城市,就经常出现在咖啡馆里。
pinyin: Zìcóng tā bānhuà xīn chéngshì, jiù jīngcháng chūxiàn zài kāfēiguǎn lǐ.
en: Since he moved to the new city, he's been showing up at the café all the time.

zh: 虽然计划得很周密,但执行中还是出现了一些意想不到的困难。
pinyin: Suīrán jìhuà de hěn zhōumìi, dàn zhíxíng zhōng háishi chūxiàn le yīxiē yìxiǎng budào de kùnnan.
en: Even though the plan was thorough, unexpected difficulties still cropped up during implementation.

zh: 我打算吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn chī mǐfàn.
en: I'm planning to eat rice.

zh: 她打算明天去买书。
pinyin: Tā dǎsuàn míngtiān qù mǎi shū.
en: She's planning to go buy books tomorrow.

zh: 因为天气好，我们打算去公园玩。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hǎo, wǒmen dǎsuàn qù gōngyuán wán.
en: Since the weather is nice, we're planning to go play in the park.

zh: 他虽然很忙，但还是打算周末来参加聚会。
pinyin: Tā suīrán hěn máng, dàn háishi dǎsuàn zhōumò lái cānjiā jùhuì.
en: Even though he's really busy, he's still planning to come to the party this weekend.

zh: 我们打算利用这次机会重新调整工作计划和生活节奏。
pinyin: Wǒmen dǎsuàn lìyòng zhè cì jīhuì chóngxīn tiáozhěng gōngzuò jìhuà hé shēnghuó jiēzòu.
en: We're planning to use this opportunity to reset our work schedule and living pace.

zh: 我喜欢看电影。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān kàn diànyǐng.
en: I like to watch movies.

zh: 昨天我和朋友看了一部电影。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hé péngyou kànle yī bù diànyǐng.
en: Yesterday my friend and I watched a movie.

zh: 因为这部电影很有意思，所以我看了两遍。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒu yìsi, suǒyǐ wǒ kànle liǎng biàn.
en: Because this movie was so interesting, I watched it twice.

zh: 虽然电影的票价很贵，但是我还是想去电影院看最新的电影。
pinyin: Suīrán diànyǐng de piàojià hěn guì, dànshi wǒ háishi xiǎng qù diànyǐngyuàn kàn zuìxīn de diànyǐng.
en: Although movie tickets are expensive, I still want to go to the cinema to see the latest film.

zh: 这部电影虽然获得了不少奖项，但观众的评价却褒贬不一。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng suīrán huòdéle búshǎo jiǎngxiàng, dàn guānzhòng de píngjiā却 bāobiǎn búyī.
en: Despite winning several awards, this film has received mixed reviews from audiences.

zh: 我想试试这个。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng shìshi zhège.
en: I want to try this.

zh: 明天我要试一试新的工作。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào shì yī shì xīn de gōngzuò.
en: Tomorrow I'm going to try out my new job.

zh: 虽然很难，但是我还是想试试看能不能做好。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dànshì wǒ háishi xiǎng shìshi kàn néng bu néng zuò hǎo.
en: Even though it's difficult, I still want to give it a try and see if I can do it well.

zh: 在买之前，顾客通常会要求试一下产品的质量。
pinyin: Zài mǎi zhīqián, gùkè tōngcháng huì yāoqiú shì yīxià chǎnpǐn de zhìliàng.
en: Before purchasing, customers usually ask to test the quality of the product.

zh: 与其盲目跟风，不如先试试这个方法，看看是否真的适合自己。
pinyin: Yǔqī mángmù gēnfēng, búrú xiānshi shìshi zhège fāngfǎ, kànkan shìfǒu zhēnde shìhé zìjǐ.
en: Rather than blindly following the crowd, it's better to try this approach first and see if it really suits you.

zh: 我身上有钱。
pinyin: Wǒ shēnshang yǒu qián.
en: I have money on me.

zh: 他今天身上穿着新衣服。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān shēnshang chuānzhe xīn yīfu.
en: He's wearing new clothes today.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以我身上都湿了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ wǒ shēnshang dōu shī le.
en: Because it rained, I got completely soaked.

zh: 虽然他身上有伤，但是仍然坚持去上班。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shēnshang yǒu shāng, dànshì réngrán jiānchí qù shàngbān.
en: Although he had injuries on his body, he still insisted on going to work.

zh: 经历了那么多困难以后，他身上那种乐观的精神从未改变。
pinyin: Jīng历 le nàme duō kùnnan yǐhòu, tā shēnshang nà zhǒng lèguān de jīngshén cóngwèi gǎibiàn.
en: After going through so many hardships, that optimistic spirit he carried has never changed.

zh: 这是我的房间。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de fángjiān.
en: This is my room.

zh: 我每天早上在房间里读书。
pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang zài fángjiān lǐ dúshū.
en: I read in my room every morning.

zh: 因为房间太小，所以我们买了一张小床。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fángjiān tài xiǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen mǎi le yī zhāng xiǎo chuáng.
en: Because the room is small, we bought a single bed.

zh: 虽然这个房间不大，但是光线很好，住得还挺舒服。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège fángjiān búdà, búguò guāngxiàn hěn hǎo, zhù de háitǐng shūfu.
en: Although the room isn't spacious, the lighting is great and it's quite comfortable to live in.

zh: 搬到新公司附近以后，我租了一间房间，虽然有点贵，但省去了两小时通勤时间。
pinyin: Bān dào xīn gōngsī fùjìn yǐhòu, wǒ zū le yī jiān fángjiān, suīrán yǒudiǎn guì, búguò shěng qù le liǎng xiǎoshí tōngqín shíjiān.
en: After moving closer to the new office, I rented a room—it's a bit pricey, but it saves me two hours of commute every day.

zh: 这个苹果很美。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ hěn měi.
en: This apple looks beautiful.

zh: 她穿着美丽的红色衣服去公园。
pinyin: Tā chuānzhe měilì de hóngsè yīfu qù gōngyuán.
en: She wore a beautiful red dress to the park.

zh: 虽然这个城市很大，但是风景特别美。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège chéngshì hěn dà, dànshì fēngjǐng tèbié měi.
en: Although the city is big, the scenery is especially beautiful.

zh: 他对美食很感兴趣，经常去尝试新的餐厅。
pinyin: Tā duì měishí hěn gǎn xìngqù, jīngcháng qù chángshì xīn de cāntīng.
en: He's really interested in good food and often tries new restaurants.

zh: 现在很多年轻人都意识到内在美比外在美更重要。
pinyin: Xiànzài hěnduō niánqīng rén dōu yìshi dào nèixài měi bǐ wàizài měi gèng zhòngyào.
en: Nowadays, many young people realize that inner beauty is more important than outer beauty.

zh: 不管下雨，我都去公园。
pinyin: Búguǎn xiàyǔ, wǒ dōu qù gōngyuán.
en: No matter if it rains, I'm still going to the park.

zh: 不管你喜不喜欢，我们今天要吃这个。
pinyin: Búguǎn nǐ xǐ bu xǐhuān, wǒmen jīntiān yào chī zhège.
en: Regardless of whether you like it or not, we're eating this today.

zh: 不管天气怎么样，他每天都坚持跑步。
pinyin: Búguǎn tiānqì zěnyàng, tā měitiān dōu jiānchí pǎobù.
en: No matter what the weather is like, he sticks to running every single day.

zh: 不管别人怎么说，她还是决定辞职去创业。
pinyin: Búguǎn biéren zěnyàoshuo, tā háishi juéding cízhí qù chuàngyè.
en: Regardless of what others say, she's still determined to quit and start her own business.

zh: 不管遇到什么困难，只要有明确的目标，就能坚持不懈地走下去。
pinyin: Búguǎn yùdào shénme kùnnan, zhǐyào yǒu míngquè de mùbiāo, jiù néng jiānchí búxié de zǒu xiàqù.
en: Whatever difficulties you encounter, as long as you have a clear goal, you can persevere and push forward.

zh: 我有一本书。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī běn shū.
en: I have a book.

zh: 昨天我在图书馆买了一本新书。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài túshūguǎn mǎile yī běn xīn shū.
en: Yesterday I bought a new book at the library.

zh: 虽然这本书很厚，但是故事很有意思。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè běn shū hěn hòu, dànshì gùshì hěn yǒu yìsi.
en: Even though this book is thick, the story is really interesting.

zh: 因为工作太忙，我最近没有时间读书。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng, wǒ zuìjìn méiyǒu shíjiān dúshū.
en: Because work has been so busy, I haven't had time to read lately.

zh: 这部书虽然出版已久，但其中的观点对现代社会仍然有借鉴意义。
pinyin: Zhè bù shū suīrán chūbǎn yǐ jiǔ, dàn qīzhōng de guāndiǎn duì xiàndài shèhuì réngránhěn yǒu jièjiàn yìyì.
en: Although this book was published long ago, its ideas still offer valuable insights for modern society.

zh: 这个苹果特别甜。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ tèbié tián.
en: This apple is especially sweet.

zh: 今天天气特别冷，我穿了很多衣服。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì tèbié lěng, wǒ chuānle hěnduō yīfu.
en: The weather is particularly cold today, so I wore a lot of clothes.

zh: 因为明天要考试，所以他今天特别认真地学习。
pinyin: Yīnwèi míngtiān yào kǎoshì, suǒyǐ tā jīntiān tèbié rènzhēn de xuéxí.
en: Because there's an exam tomorrow, he studied extra carefully today.

zh: 这部电影在年轻人中特别受欢迎，票都卖光了。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng zài niánqīngrén zhōng tèbié shòu huānyíng, piào dōu màiguàng le.
en: This movie is particularly popular with young people—all the tickets sold out.

zh: 他对细节的要求特别高，同事们都觉得有点吃不消。
pinyin: Tā duì xì節de yāoqiú tèbié gāo, tóngshìmen dōu juéde yǒudiǎn chībuliǎo xiāo.
en: He has exceptionally high standards for detail, and his colleagues find it a bit overwhelming.

zh: 注意车！
pinyin: Zhùyì chē!
en: Watch out for the car!

zh: 吃饭的时候要注意卫生。
pinyin: Chīfàn de shíhou yào zhùyì wèishēng.
en: You should pay attention to hygiene when you eat.

zh: 虽然很累，但我还是注意听讲了。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn léi, dàn wǒ háishi zhùyì tīngjiǎng le.
en: Even though I was tired, I still paid attention to the lecture.

zh: 开车时注意后面的车，避免发生事故。
pinyin: Kāichē shí zhùyì hòumiàn de chē, bìmiǎn fāshēng shìgù.
en: When driving, pay attention to the cars behind you to avoid accidents.

zh: 他的演讲引人入胜，值得注意的是他对细节的把握。
pinyin: Tā de yǎnjiǎng yǐnrénrùshèng, zhídé zhùyì de shì tā duì细jiē de bǎwoù.
en: His speech was captivating; what's worth noting is his grasp of the details.

zh: 我喜欢踢球。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān tī qiú.
en: I like to play football.

zh: 昨天我和朋友打篮球。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hé péngyou dǎ lánqiú.
en: Yesterday I played basketball with my friends.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以我们去公园踢球。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen qù gōngyuán tī qiú.
en: Because the weather was nice, we went to the park to play football.

zh: 虽然他的球技不错，但是他最近没有多少时间练习。
pinyin: Suīrán tā de qiújì búcuò, dànshì tā zuìjìn méiyǒu duōshao shíjiān liànxí.
en: Although his ball skills are pretty good, he hasn't had much time to practice lately.

zh: 他对球的热情从未减退，即使工作再忙也坚持每周踢一次。
pinyin: Tā duì qiú de règíng cóngwèi jiǎntuì, jíshǐ gōngzuò zài máng yě jiānchí měi zhōu tī yī cì.
en: His passion for the game has never waned—no matter how busy work gets, he still makes time to play once a week.

zh: 我查一下。
pinyin: Wǒ chá yīxià.
en: Let me check.

zh: 你能查一下我的电话号码吗？
pinyin: Nǐ néng chá yīxià wǒ de diànhuà hàomǎ ma?
en: Can you look up my phone number for me?

zh: 因为不确定时间，所以我查了一下火车票。
pinyin: Yīnwèi búquèdìng shíjiān, suǒyǐ wǒ chá le yīxià huǒchē piào.
en: Because I wasn't sure about the time, I checked the train ticket information.

zh: 医生给我检查身体的时候，查出了血压有点高。
pinyin: Yīshēng gěi wǒ jiǎnchá shēntǐ de shíhou, chá chū le xiěyā yǒudiǎn gāo.
en: When the doctor examined me, they discovered my blood pressure was a bit high.

zh: 警察查阅了监控录像后，发现嫌疑人的行踪有明显矛盾。
pinyin: Jǐngchá cháyuè le jiānkòng lùyìng hòu, fāxiàn xiányí rén de xíngzōng yǒu míngxiǎn máodùn.
en: After the police reviewed the surveillance footage, they found clear inconsistencies in the suspect's movements.

zh: 我忘了你的名字。
pinyin: Wǒ wàngle nǐ de míngzì.
en: I forgot your name.

zh: 昨天我忘记带钥匙了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ wàngjì dài yàoshi le.
en: Yesterday I forgot to bring my keys.

zh: 因为太忙，我忘记了朋友的生日。
