pinyin: Yīnwèi tài máng, wǒ wàngjìle péngyou de shēngrì.
en: Because I was so busy, I forgot my friend's birthday.

zh: 他虽然忘记了很多事，但是从不忘记家人的重要日期。
pinyin: Tā suīrán wàngjìle hěnduō shì, dànshì cóngbuǒ wàngjì jiārén de zhòngyào rìqī.
en: Although he forgets a lot of things, he never forgets important dates for his family.

zh: 有些往事再也忘不掉，尤其是那些深刻影响过我们的经历。
pinyin: Yǒuxiē wǎngshì zàiyě wàng búdiào, yóuqī shì nàxiē shēnkè yǐngxiǎng guòle wǒmen de jīnglì.
en: Some memories from the past we can never forget, especially the experiences that have deeply affected us.

zh: 他甚至不吃饭。
pinyin: Tā shènzhì búchiī fàn.
en: He doesn't even eat rice.

zh: 今天很冷，甚至下雪了。
pinyin: Jīntiān hěn lěng, shènzhì xiàxuě le.
en: It's very cold today—it even snowed.

zh: 因为太忙，他甚至没有时间睡觉。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tài máng, tā shènzhì méiyǒu shíjiān shuìjiào.
en: Because he was so busy, he didn't even have time to sleep.

zh: 这个地方很偏远，甚至没有网络信号。
pinyin: Zhège dìfang hěn piānyuǎn, shènzhì méiyǒu wǎngluò xìnhào.
en: That place is really remote—there's not even a cell signal.

zh: 这份工作压力很大，甚至影响了他的身体健康。
pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò yālì hěn dà, shènzhì yǐngxiǎng le tāde shēntǐ jiànkāng.
en: The job stress is so intense it's even affecting his physical health.

zh: 我们要保护树。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎohù shù.
en: We need to protect the trees.

zh: 妈妈保护小孩不受伤害。
pinyin: Māma bǎohù xiǎo háizi búshòu shānghài.
en: Mom protects the child from getting hurt.

zh: 因为环境很重要，所以我们要保护地球。
pinyin: Yīnwèi huánjìng hěn zhòngyào, suǒyǐ wǒmen yào bǎohù dìqiú.
en: Because the environment is important, we need to protect the planet.

zh: 政府制定了新的法律来保护野生动物。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhìdìngle xīn de fǎlǜ lái bǎohù yěshēng dòngwù.
en: The government has created new laws to protect wildlife.

zh: 互联网公司必须采取措施保护用户的个人信息和隐私。
pinyin: Húlián wǎng gōngsī bìxū cǎiqǔ cuòshī bǎohù yònghu de gèrén xìnxī hé yǐn私.
en: Internet companies must take steps to protect users' personal information and privacy.

zh: 这是真正的牛奶。
pinyin: Zhè shì zhēnzhèng de niúnǎi.
en: This is real milk.

zh: 他真正喜欢吃米饭和蔬菜。
pinyin: Tā zhēnzhèng xǐhuān chī mǐfàn hé shūcài.
en: He really likes eating rice and vegetables.

zh: 虽然她很忙，但是她真正关心家人。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì tā zhēnzhèng guānxīn jiārén.
en: Although she's very busy, she genuinely cares about her family.

zh: 只有真正努力学习，你才能取得好成绩。
pinyin: Zhǐyǒu zhēnzhèng nǔlì xuéxí, nǐ cáinéng qǔdé hǎo chéngjì.
en: Only by truly working hard at your studies can you achieve good grades.

zh: 要想在这个行业成功，你需要真正热爱这份工作。
pinyin: Yào xiǎng zài zhège hángyè chénggōng, nǐ xūyào zhēnzhèng règài zhè fèn gōngzuò.
en: If you want to succeed in this industry, you need to truly love the job.

zh: 结果很好吃。
pinyin: Jiēguǒ hěn hǎochī.
en: The fruit tastes really good.

zh: 我昨天买的书，结果今天就看完了。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān mǎi de shū, jiēguǒ jīntiān jiù kànwán le.
en: The book I bought yesterday—I actually finished it today already.

zh: 虽然他很累，但是结果还是完成了工作。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn lèi, dànshì jiēguǒ háishi wánchéngle gōngzuò.
en: Even though he was exhausted, he ended up finishing the work anyway.

zh: 我们讨论了很久，结果决定下周再开会。
pinyin: Wǒmen tǎolùnle hěnjiǔ, jiēguǒ juédìng xiàzhōu zài kāihuì.
en: After we discussed it for a long time, we decided to have another meeting next week.

zh: 他投入了大量精力做这个项目，结果却因为一个小错误前功尽弃。
pinyin: Tā tóurùle dàliàng jīnglì zuò zhège xiàngmù, jiēguǒ què yīnwèi yīgè xiǎo cuòwù qiánggōng jìnqì.
en: He poured enormous effort into this project, but ended up losing everything because of one small mistake.

zh: 他的表现很好。
pinyin: Tā de biǎoxiàn hěn hǎo.
en: His performance is very good.

zh: 今天小王在课堂上的表现不错。
pinyin: Jīntiān Xiǎo Wáng zài kètáng shang de biǎoxiàn búcuò.
en: Xiaowang did pretty well in class today.

zh: 虽然她很紧张，但她的表现还是很自信。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn jǐnzhāng, dànshì tā de biǎoxiàn háishi hěn zìxìn.
en: Although she was nervous, her performance was still very confident.

zh: 因为他这次表现出色，所以公司决定给他升职。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā zhè cì biǎoxiàn chūsè, suǒyǐ gōngsī juéding gěi tā shēngzhí.
en: Because he performed exceptionally this time, the company decided to promote him.

zh: 孩子在压力下的真实表现往往比预期更能反映他的真正能力。
pinyin: Háizi zài yālì xia de zhēnshí biǎoxiàn wǎngwang bǐ yùqī gèng néng fǎnyìng tā de zhēnzhèng nénglik.
en: How a child actually performs under pressure often reflects their true abilities better than what we expect.

zh: 我拍了一张照片。
pinyin: Wǒ pāile yì zhāng zhàopiàn.
en: I took a photo.

zh: 昨天我在公园拍了很多照片。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài gōngyuán pāile hěnduō zhàopiàn.
en: Yesterday I took lots of photos in the park.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以我们去海边拍照。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen qù hǎibiān pāizhào.
en: Because the weather was nice, we went to the beach to take pictures.

zh: 虽然他不是专业摄影师，但是拍出来的照片质量很不错。
pinyin: Suīrán tā búshì zhuānyè shèyǐngshī, dànshì pāichūlái de zhàopiàn zhìliàng hěn búcuò.
en: Although he's not a professional photographer, the photos he takes are quite good quality.

zh: 这部电影的导演非常擅长拍摄动作场景，每一个镜头都令人印象深刻。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de dǎoyǎn fēicháng shàncháng pāishè dòngzuò chǎngjǐng, měi yì ge jìngtou dōu lìng rén yìnxiàng shēnkè.
en: This film's director is exceptionally skilled at shooting action scenes, and every shot is deeply impressive.

zh: 其实我喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Qíshí wǒ xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: Actually, I like eating rice.

zh: 其实这个苹果很好吃，你试试。
pinyin: Qíshí zhège píngguǒ hěn hǎochī, nǐ shìshi.
en: Actually, this apple is really tasty—try some.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但其实去公园很舒服。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dàn qíshí qù gōngyuán hěn shūfu.
en: Even though the weather isn't great, it's actually really nice to go to the park.

zh: 其实他不是不想来，只是那天有别的事情要做。
pinyin: Qíshí tā búshì búxiǎng lái, zhǐshì nàtiān yǒu biéde shìqing yào zuò.
en: Actually, it's not that he didn't want to come—he just had other things to do that day.

zh: 其实语言学习没有捷径，坚持练习才是最重要的。
pinyin: Qíshí yǔyán xuéxí méiyǒu jiéjìng, jiānchí liànxí cáishi zuì zhòngyào de.
en: In reality, there's no shortcut to learning a language—consistent practice is what really matters.

zh: 小心火！
pinyin: Xiǎoxīn huǒ!
en: Watch out for fire!

zh: 过马路的时候要小心。
pinyin: Guò mǎlù de shíhou yào xiǎoxīn.
en: You need to be careful when crossing the street.

zh: 因为地很滑，所以你要小心走路。
pinyin: Yīnwèi dì hěn huá, suǒyǐ nǐ yào xiǎoxīn zǒulù.
en: Because the floor is slippery, you need to be careful when walking.

zh: 虽然天气很好，但我们还是要小心那些坏人。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn hǎo, dàn wǒmen háishi yào xiǎoxīn nàxiē huàirén.
en: Even though the weather is nice, we still need to watch out for bad people.

zh: 在网上交朋友要小心，别被骗了金钱和信息。
pinyin: Zài wǎngshang jiāo péngyou yào xiǎoxīn, bié bèi piàn le jīnqián hé xìnxī.
en: You should be cautious when making friends online—don't get scammed out of money or personal information.

zh: 请进来。
pinyin: Qǐng jìnlái.
en: Please come in.

zh: 妈妈叫我进来吃饭。
pinyin: Māma jiào wǒ jìnlái chīfàn.
en: Mom called me to come in for dinner.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以我们都进来了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ wǒmen dōu jìnlái le.
en: Because it was raining, we all came inside.

zh: 他推开门进来的时候，办公室里很安静。
pinyin: Tā tuīkāi mén jìnlái de shíhou, bàngōngshì lǐ hěn ānjìng.
en: When he pushed the door open and came in, the office was very quiet.

zh: 只要客人一进来，前台就会主动递上欢迎饮料。
pinyin: Zhǐyào kèrén yī jìnlái, qiántái jiù huì zhǔdòng dì shang huānyíng yǐnliào.
en: Whenever a guest comes in, the reception desk proactively offers them a welcome drink.

zh: 这条路很长。
pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù hěn cháng.
en: This road is very long.

zh: 我每天走这条路去上班。
pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǒu zhè tiáo lù qù shàngbān.
en: I take this road to work every day.

zh: 因为下雨，所以这条路很滑，我走得很慢。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ zhè tiáo lù hěn huá, wǒ zǒu de hěn màn.
en: Because it's raining, the road is slippery, so I'm walking slowly.

zh: 虽然这条路有点远，但是风景很美，我很喜欢。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè tiáo lù yǒudiǎn yuǎn, dànshì fēngjǐng hěn měi, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
en: Although this road is a bit far, the scenery is beautiful, and I really like it.

zh: 他在这条路上坚持跑步已经三年了，现在身体好多了。
pinyin: Tā zài zhè tiáo lù shang jiānchíliǎo pǎobù yǐjīng sān nián le, xiànzài shēntǐ hǎo duō le.
en: He's been sticking with running on this road for three years now, and his health has improved a lot.

zh: 他呆在家里。
pinyin: Tā dāi zài jiā lǐ.
en: He's staying at home.

zh: 昨天我呆在图书馆三个小时。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ dāi zài túshūguǎn sān ge xiǎoshí.
en: Yesterday I spent three hours at the library.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但他还是呆在公园里看书。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dànshì tā háishi dāi zài gōngyuán lǐ kànshū.
en: Even though the weather was bad, he still stayed in the park to read.

zh: 会议延迟了，我们只好呆在会议室里等待通知。
pinyin: Huìyì yánchíle, wǒmen zhǐhǎo dāi zài huìyìshì lǐ děngdài tōngzhī.
en: The meeting was postponed, so we had to stay in the conference room waiting for updates.

zh: 疫情期间，很多人被迫呆在家里，这对心理健康造成了不少影响。
pinyin: Yìqíng qījiān, hěnduō rén bèipò dāi zài jiā lǐ, zhè duì xīnlǐ jiànkāng zàochéngle búshǎo yǐngxiǎng.
en: During the pandemic, many people were forced to stay home, which had a significant impact on their mental health.

zh: 我有四个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu sì ge píngguǒ.
en: I have four apples.

zh: 今天是星期四，我很高兴。
pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqī sì, wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
en: Today is Thursday, and I'm really happy.

zh: 虽然只有四个人，但是我们的计划很好。
pinyin: Suīrán zhǐyǒu sì ge rén, dànshì wǒmen de jìhuà hěn hǎo.
en: Although there are only four of us, our plan is still pretty solid.

zh: 因为疫情的原因，会议从四月推迟到了六月。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yìqíng de yuányīn, huìyì cóng sì yuè tuīchí dàole liù yuè.
en: Because of the pandemic, the conference was postponed from April to June.

zh: 四舍五入这个数学概念对学生来说既简单又实用。
pinyin: Sì shě wǔ rù zhège shùxué gàiniàn duì xuésheng lái shuō jì jiǎndān yòu shíyòng.
en: The mathematical concept of rounding is both straightforward and practical for students.

zh: 我久没吃饭了。
pinyin: Wǒ jiǔ méi chīfàn le.
en: I haven't eaten in a long time.

zh: 他在北京住了很久。
pinyin: Tā zài Běijīng zhù le hěn jiǔ.
en: He lived in Beijing for quite a while.

zh: 因为下雨，我们等了很久，但还是去了公园。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒmen děng le hěn jiǔ, dàn háishi qù le gōngyuán.
en: Because of the rain, we waited for ages, but we still went to the park.

zh: 这部电影虽然很久以前拍的，但现在看还是很有意思。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng suīrán hěn jiǔ yǐqián pāi de, dàn xiànzài kàn háishi hěn yǒu yìsi.
en: Even though this film was made a long time ago, it's still really interesting to watch now.

zh: 我们分别后久久不见面，最后还是决定重新联系彼此。
pinyin: Wǒmen fēnbié hòu jiǔjiǔ bújiànmiàn, zuìhòu háishi juéding chóngxīn liánxì bǐcǐ.
en: After we parted ways, we didn't see each other for the longest time, but eventually we decided to get back in touch.

zh: 当时我在家吃饭。
pinyin: Dāngshí wǒ zài jiā chīfàn.
en: I was eating at home at that time.

zh: 当时天气很冷，我穿了厚衣服。
pinyin: Dāngshí tiānqì hěn lěng, wǒ chuānle厚 yīfu.
en: The weather was cold back then, so I wore thick clothes.

zh: 当时我虽然很累，但是还是坚持完成了工作。
pinyin: Dāngshí wǒ suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì háishi jiānchíle wánchéngle gōngzuò.
en: At that time, even though I was exhausted, I still persisted and finished the work.

zh: 当时他正在找工作，突然得到了一个很好的机会。
pinyin: Dāngshí tā zhèngzài zhǎo gōngzuò, túrán dé到le yīge hěn hǎo de jīhuì.
en: Back then he was job hunting when suddenly a great opportunity came up.

zh: 当时互联网刚刚兴起，没人想到它会改变整个世界。
pinyin: Dāngshí hùliánwǎng gānggāng xīngqǐ, méi rén xiǎngdào tā huì gǎibiàn zhěngge shìjiè.
en: Back when the internet was just emerging, nobody imagined it would transform the entire world.

zh: 你要茶或咖啡？
pinyin: Nǐ yào chá huòshì kāfēi?
en: Do you want tea or coffee?

zh: 今天或明天我们去公园吧。
pinyin: Jīntiān huòshì míngtiān wǒmen qù gōngyuán ba.
en: Let's go to the park today or tomorrow.

zh: 因为天气不好，我们或者在家或者去看电影。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, wǒmen huòzhě zàijiā huòzhě qù kàn diànyǐng.
en: Because the weather is bad, we'll either stay home or go watch a movie.

zh: 他说下周或下下周会完成这个项目，但还不确定具体时间。
pinyin: Tā shuō xiàzhōu huò xiàxià zhōu huì wánchéng zhège xiàngmù, dàn háishi búquèdìng jùtǐ shíjiān.
en: He said he'd finish the project next week or the week after, but he's still not sure of the exact timing.

zh: 无论你选择哪条路，或早或晚都会遇到困难，关键是怎么去面对。
pinyin: Búlùn nǐ xuǎnzé nǎ tiáo lù, huò zǎo huò wǎn dōu huì yùdào kùnnan, guānjiàn shì zěnme qù miànduì.
en: No matter which path you choose, you'll face difficulties sooner or later—what matters is how you deal with them.

zh: 我懂中文。
pinyin: Wǒ dǒng zhōngwén.
en: I understand Chinese.

zh: 你懂电脑吗？我不太懂。
pinyin: Nǐ dǒng diànnǎo ma? Wǒ bútiài dǒng.
en: Do you know about computers? I don't know much about them.

zh: 因为他学了三年，所以他很懂音乐。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā xuéle sānnián, suǒyǐ tā hěn dǒng yīnyuè.
en: Because he studied for three years, he understands music really well.

zh: 虽然她刚开始学，但她已经懂了基本的语法规则。
pinyin: Suīrán tā gāng kāishǐ xué, dàn tā yǐjīng dǒngle jīběn de yǔfǎ guīzé.
en: Even though she just started learning, she already understands the basic grammar rules.

zh: 做生意需要懂市场，不懂的话很容易亏本。
pinyin: Zuò shēngyì xūyào dǒng shìchǎng, búdǒng dehuà hěn róngyì kuīběn.
en: Running a business requires understanding the market; if you don't, you'll easily lose money.

zh: 只有妈妈在家。
pinyin: Zhǐyǒu māma zài jiā.
en: Only Mom is at home.

zh: 今天只有我和你一起吃饭。
pinyin: Jīntiān zhǐyǒu wǒ hé nǐ yìqǐ chīfàn.
en: Today it's just you and me eating together.

zh: 虽然很累，但只有坚持才能成功。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn zhǐyǒu jiānchí cái néng chénggōng.
en: Although it's tiring, you can only succeed by persisting.

zh: 只有真正了解他的人，才能理解他的决定。
pinyin: Zhǐyǒu zhēnzhèng liǎojiě tā de rén, cái néng lǐjiě tā de juédìng.
en: Only people who really understand him can make sense of his decision.

zh: 在这个竞争激烈的时代，只有不断学习才能立于不败之地。
pinyin: Zài zhège jìngjìng jīliè de shídài, zhǐyǒu búduàn xuéxí cái néng lìyú búbài zhī dì.
en: In this fiercely competitive era, continuous learning is the only way to stay unbeaten.

zh: 我没有钱，怎么办？
pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu qián, zěnme bàn?
en: I don't have any money. What should I do?

zh: 明天要下雨，我们的春游怎么办？
pinyin: Míngtiān yào xiàyǔ, wǒmen de chūnyóu zěnme bàn?
en: It's going to rain tomorrow. What are we going to do about our spring outing?

zh: 因为生病了，所以不能去参加比赛，怎么办？
pinyin: Yīnwèi shēngbìng le, suǒyǐ búnéng qù cānjiā bǐsài, zěnme bàn?
en: Since I'm sick and can't compete, what should I do about it?

zh: 虽然很紧张，但是我必须冷静下来，先想想怎么办。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn jǐnzhāng, búshì wǒ bìxū lěngjìng xiàlái, xiān xiǎngxiang zěnme bàn.
en: Even though I'm very nervous, I need to calm down and figure out what to do first.

zh: 他们现在意见不合，如果继续争执，项目怎么办？
pinyin: Tāmen xiànzài yìjiàn búhé, rúguǒ jìxù zhēngzhí, xiàngmù zěnme bàn?
en: They disagree right now, and if they keep arguing like this, what's going to happen to the project?

zh: 这是第一个苹果。
pinyin: Zhè shì dì yī gè píngguǒ.
en: This is the first apple.

zh: 我每天第一件事是喝水。
pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān dì yī jiàn shì shì hē shuǐ.
en: The first thing I do every day is drink water.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但是他第一次就成功了。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì tā dì yī cì jiù chénggōng le.
en: Although he was busy, he succeeded on his first try.

zh: 根据调查，第二季度的销售额比去年增长了百分之十。
pinyin: Gēnjù diàochá, dì èr jìdù de xiāoshòuē bǐ qùnián zēngzhǎng le bǎifēnzhī shí.
en: According to the survey, second-quarter sales increased by ten percent compared to last year.

zh: 在第三次谈判中，双方终于就关键问题达成了共识。
pinyin: Zài dì sān cì tánpàn zhōng, shuāngfāng zhōngyú jiù guānjiàn wèntí dáchéng le gòngshí.
en: In the third round of negotiations, both sides finally reached a consensus on the key issues.

zh: 我喜欢马。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān mǎ.
en: I like horses.

zh: 昨天我看到了一匹白马。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ kàndàole yī pǐ báimǎ.
en: Yesterday I saw a white horse.

zh: 虽然马很大，但是它很温和。
pinyin: Suīrán mǎ hěn dà, búshì tā hěn wēnhé.
en: Although horses are big, they are actually very gentle.

zh: 因为他从小喜欢骑马，所以他现在是专业的骑手。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā cóngxiǎo xǐhuān qímǎ, suǒyǐ tā xiànzài shì zhuānyè de qísǒu.
en: Because he loved horseback riding since childhood, he's now a professional rider.

zh: 在农村长大的孩子对马并不陌生，他们经常帮忙照顾家里的马。
pinyin: Zài nóngcūn zhǎngdà de háizi duì mǎ bìngbù mòshēng, tāmen jīngcháng bāngmang zhàogu jiālǐ de mǎ.
en: Kids who grew up in the countryside aren't unfamiliar with horses; they often help take care of the family's horse.

zh: 我讲中文。
pinyin: Wǒ jiǎng zhōngwén.
en: I speak Chinese.

zh: 老师在课堂上讲语法。
pinyin: Lǎoshī zài kètáng shang jiǎng yǔfǎ.
en: The teacher explains grammar in class.

zh: 因为他讲得很清楚，所以我都听懂了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā jiǎng de hěn qīngchǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ dōu tīngdǒng le.
en: Because he explained it so clearly, I understood everything.

zh: 他讲的故事虽然有点长，但是很有意思。
pinyin: Tā jiǎng de gùshì suīrán yǒudiǎn cháng, dànshì hěn yǒu yìsi.
en: Although the story he told was a bit long, it was really interesting.

zh: 在会议上，经理讲了关于新产品计划的详细信息。
pinyin: Zài huìyì shang, jīnglǐ jiǎng le guānyú xīn chǎnpǐn jìhuà de xiáng细 xìnxī.
en: At the meeting, the manager went over the detailed information about the new product plan.

zh: 这是绝对不行。
pinyin: Zhè shì juéduì búxíng.
en: This absolutely won't work.

zh: 你绝对不能迟到，一定要准时。
pinyin: Nǐ juéduì búnéng chídào, yīdìng yào zhǔnshí.
en: You absolutely cannot be late—you must be on time.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以他绝对会来参加聚会。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ tā juéduì huì lái cānjiā jùhuì.
en: Because the weather is nice, he will definitely come to the party.

zh: 虽然规则很复杂，但这一点绝对是错误的。
pinyin: Suīrán guīzé hěn fùzá, dàn zhè yī diǎn juéduì shì cuòwù de.
en: Although the rules are complicated, this point is absolutely wrong.

zh: 在这种情况下，我们绝对不能退缩，必须坚持到底。
pinyin: Zài zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng xià, wǒmen juéduì búnéng tuìsuō, bìxū jiānchí dàodǐ.
en: In this situation, we absolutely cannot back down—we must stick with it to the end.

zh: 长官来了。
pinyin: Zhǎngguān lái le.
en: The officer has arrived.

zh: 那个长官很严肃，我们都有点害怕。
pinyin: Nàge zhǎngguān hěn yánzsù, wǒmen dōu yǒudiǎn hàipà.
en: That officer is very stern, and we're all a bit scared of him.

zh: 因为长官的命令，所以我们必须早上六点起床。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhǎngguān de mìnglings, suǒyǐ wǒmen bìxū zǎoshang liù diǎn qǐchuáng.
en: Because of the officer's orders, we have to wake up at six in the morning.

zh: 虽然长官看起来很凶，但他对手下的士兵其实很公平。
pinyin: Suīrán zhǎngguān kàn qǐlai hěn xiōng, dàn tā duì shǒuxià de shìbīng qīshí hěn gōngpíng.
en: Although the officer seems fierce, he's actually quite fair to his subordinate soldiers.

zh: 这位长官为人正直，在部队中赢得了下属的尊重和信任。
pinyin: Zhè wèi zhǎngguān wéirén zhèngzhí, zài búduì zhōng yíngde le xiàzhǔ de zūnjìng hé xìnrèn.
en: This officer is an upright person, and has earned the respect and trust of his subordinates in the unit.

zh: 他是公司员工。
pinyin: Tā shì gōngsī yuángōng.
en: He's a company employee.

zh: 今天店里有五个员工上班。
pinyin: Jīntiān diàn里yǒu wǔ ge yuángōng shàngbān.
en: There are five staff members working at the shop today.

zh: 因为新员工还不太了解工作，所以经理在帮助他。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xīn yuángōng háishi búhuì liǎojiě gōngzuò, suǒyǐ jīnglǐ zài bāngzhù tā.
en: Because the new employee doesn't quite understand the job yet, the manager is helping him out.

zh: 虽然这位员工工作经验少，但他学习速度快，同事们都很喜欢他。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè wèi yuángōng gōngzuò jīngyàn shǎo, dàn tā xuéxí sùdù kuài, tóngshìmen dōu hěn xǐhuān tā.
en: Although this employee has little work experience, he learns quickly and all his colleagues really like him.

zh: 公司最近招聘了一批销售员，他们的业绩直接影响部门的整体表现。
pinyin: Gōngsī zuìjìn zhāopìnle yī pī xiāoshòu yuán, tāmen de yèjī zhíjiē yǐngxiǎng bùmén de zhěngtǐ biǎoxiàn.
en: The company recently hired a group of sales staff, and their performance directly affects the whole department's results.

zh: 我进去了。
pinyin: Wǒ jìnqù le.
en: I went in.

zh: 他每天都进去上班。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu jìnqù shàngbān.
en: He goes in to work every day.

zh: 因为下雨了，我们赶快进去房间。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, wǒmen gǎnkuài jìnqù fángjiān.
en: Because it was raining, we quickly went into the room.

zh: 虽然门很小，但是我们还是能进去。
pinyin: Suīrán mén hěn xiǎo, dànshì wǒmen háishi néng jìnqù.
en: Although the door was small, we were still able to get inside.

zh: 他们决定进去看看这家新开的餐厅怎么样。
pinyin: Tāmen juéding jìnqù kànkan zhè jiā xīn kāi de cāntīng zěnyàng.
en: They decided to go in and check out what this newly opened restaurant was like.

zh: 我至少吃了两个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ zhìshǎo chīle liǎng ge píngguǒ.
en: I ate at least two apples.

zh: 今天至少有十个学生来上课。
pinyin: Jīntiān zhìshǎo yǒu shí ge xuésheng lái shànngkè.
en: At least ten students came to class today.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但至少每周给父母打一次电话。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn zhìshǎo měi zhōu gěi fùmǔ dǎ yī cì diànhuà.
en: Although he's busy, he calls his parents at least once a week.

zh: 这个项目需要至少三个月的时间才能完成。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào zhìshǎo sān ge yuè de shíjiān cáinéng wánchéng.
en: This project will take at least three months to complete.

zh: 你应该至少提前一周通知我们关于会议日期的变更。
pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi zhìshǎo tíqián yī zhōu tōngzhī wǒmen guānyú huìyì rìqī de biànggēng.
en: You should notify us at least a week in advance about any changes to the meeting date.

zh: 他是律师。
pinyin: Tā shì lǜshī.
en: He is a lawyer.

zh: 我的爸爸是律师，他很忙。
pinyin: Wǒ de bàba shì lǜshī, tā hěn máng.
en: My father is a lawyer, and he's very busy.

zh: 因为她想帮助别人，所以她成了律师。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā xiǎng bāngzhù biérén, suǒyǐ tā chéngle lǜshī.
en: Because she wanted to help people, she became a lawyer.

zh: 如果你有法律问题，应该咨询一位有经验的律师。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu fǎlǜ wèntí, yīnggāi zīxún yī wèi yǒu jīngyàn de lǜshī.
en: If you have a legal issue, you should consult an experienced lawyer.

zh: 那位律师虽然年纪不大，但凭借过硬的专业知识赢得了很多客户的信任。
pinyin: Nà wèi lǜshī suīrán niánjì búdà, dàn píngjiè guòyìng de zhuānyè zhīshi yíngdele hěnduō kèhù de xìnrèn.
en: Although that lawyer is quite young, she has earned many clients' trust thanks to her solid professional expertise.

zh: 喔，我喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Ó, wǒ xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: Oh, I like eating rice.

zh: 喔，原来你今天要去公园啊。
pinyin: Ó, yuánlái nǐ jīntiān yào qù gōngyuán a.
en: Oh, so you're going to the park today.

zh: 喔，虽然下雨了，但是我们还是想去外面玩。
pinyin: Ó, suīrán xiàyǔ le, dànshì wǒmen háishi xiǎng qù wàimiàn wán.
en: Oh, even though it's raining, we still want to go outside and play.

zh: 喔，你的意思是说这个计划需要改一下才能实现。
pinyin: Ó, nǐ de yìsi shì shuō zhège jìhuà xūyào gǎi yīxià cáinéng shíxiàn.
en: Oh, so what you're saying is this plan needs some adjustments to work out.

zh: 喔，我明白了，看来你们的合作确实存在一些问题需要及时沟通。
pinyin: Ó, wǒ míngbai le, kànlái nǐmen de hézuò quèshí cúnzài yīxiē wèntí xūyào jíshí gōutōng.
en: I see—it looks like your partnership does have some issues that need timely communication to address.

zh: 整个上午我在家。
pinyin: Zhěngge shàngwǔ wǒ zài jiā.
en: I was at home the whole morning.

zh: 昨天整个下午都下雨了。
pinyin: Zuótiān zhěngge xiàwǔ dōu xiàyǔ le.
en: It rained all afternoon yesterday.

zh: 虽然整个会议很长，但是很有意思。
pinyin: Suīrán zhěngge huìyì hěn cháng, dànshì hěn yǒu yìsi.
en: Although the whole meeting was long, it was really interesting.

zh: 整个项目需要三个月才能完成。
pinyin: Zhěngge xiàngmù xūyào sān ge yuè cáinéng wánchéng.
en: The entire project will take three months to complete.

zh: 整个行业都在经历转变，我们必须跟上趋势。
pinyin: Zhěngge hángyè dōu zài jīnglì zhuǎnbiàn, wǒmen bìxū gēnshang qūshì.
en: The whole industry is going through changes, and we have to keep up with the trends.

zh: 我听到妈妈的声音。
pinyin: Wǒ tīngdào māma de shēngyīn.
en: I heard my mom's voice.

zh: 昨天我听到了一首好听的歌。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ tīngdàole yī shǒu hǎotīng de gē.
en: Yesterday I heard a really nice song.

zh: 虽然很远，但我还是听到了那个声音。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn yuǎn, dàn wǒ háishi tīngdàole nàge shēngyīn.
en: Even though it was far away, I still managed to hear that sound.

zh: 我在睡觉的时候听到了楼下的汽车声音。
pinyin: Wǒ zài shuìjiào de shíhou tīngdàole lóuxià de qìchē shēngyīn.
en: I heard the sound of a car downstairs while I was sleeping.

zh: 自从听到这个消息以后，他就一直心烦意乱。
pinyin: Zìcóng tīngdào zhège xiāoxi yǐhòu, tā jiù yìzhí xīnfányìluàn.
en: Ever since he heard this news, he's been in a bad mood.

zh: 小孩表演唱歌。
pinyin: Xiǎohái biǎoyǎn chànggē.
en: The child performed a song.

zh: 昨天他在学校表演了舞蹈。
pinyin: Zuótiān tā zài xuéxiào biǎoyǎnle wǔdǎo.
en: Yesterday he performed a dance at school.

zh: 因为很紧张，所以他的表演不太好。
pinyin: Yīnwèi hěn jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ tāde biǎoyǎn búhuài tài hǎo.
en: Because he was very nervous, his performance wasn't very good.

zh: 这个演员的表演能力很强，观众都很喜欢。
pinyin: Zhège yǎnyuán de biǎoyǎn néngglì hěn qiáng, guānzhòng dōu hěn xǐhuān.
en: This actor's performing ability is excellent, and the audience really enjoyed it.

zh: 虽然表演的难度很大，但她凭着多年的经验完成得相当出色。
pinyin: Suīrán biǎoyǎn de nándù hěn dà, dàn tā píngzhe duōnián de jīngyàn wánchéng de xiāngdāng chūsè.
en: Although the performance was technically challenging, she pulled it off impressively thanks to her years of experience.

zh: 妈妈正在做饭。
pinyin: Māma zhèngzài zuòfàn.
en: Mom is cooking right now.

zh: 现在他正在学习中文。
pinyin: Xiànzài tā zhèngzài xuéxí zhōngwén.
en: He's currently studying Chinese.

zh: 因为下雨，我们正在家里看电影。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒmen zhèngzài jiālǐ kàn diànyǐng.
en: Because it's raining, we're watching a movie at home.

zh: 虽然很累，但他还是正在努力完成这个项目。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn léi, dànshì tā háishi zhèngzài nǔlì wánchéng zhège xiàngmù.
en: Although he's tired, he's still working hard to complete this project.

zh: 随着技术发展，越来越多的公司正在转向远程工作模式。
pinyin: Suízhe jìshù fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuè duō de gōngsī zhèngzài zhuǎnxiàng yuǎnchéng gōngzuò móshì.
en: As technology advances, more and more companies are shifting toward remote work arrangements.

zh: 我家里无猫。
pinyin: Wǒ jiāli wú māo.
en: I don't have a cat at home.

zh: 今天我无时间去公园。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ wú shíjiān qù gōngyuán.
en: I have no time to go to the park today.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但无法放弃这个机会。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn wúfǎ fàngqì zhège jīhuì.
en: Although he's very busy, he can't pass up this opportunity.

zh: 因为公司资金无法到位，所以项目延期了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngsī zījīn wúfǎ dàowèi, suǒyǐ xiàngmù yánqī le.
en: Because the company couldn't secure the funding, the project was postponed.

zh: 这次谈判无疾而终，双方无法达成共识。
pinyin: Zhè cì tánpàn wújí ér zhōng, shuāngfāng wúfǎ dáchéng gòngshí.
en: The negotiations ended without result—both sides couldn't reach an agreement.

zh: 我已经吃饭了。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng chīfàn le.
en: I've already eaten.

zh: 他已经去学校了,现在不在家。
pinyin: Tā yǐjīng qù xuéxiào le, xiànzài búzài jiā.
en: He's already gone to school and isn't home right now.

zh: 因为下雨了,所以我已经决定不去公园。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ wǒ yǐjīng juéding búqù gōngyuán.
en: Since it's raining, I've already decided not to go to the park.

zh: 虽然项目已经开始了,但我们还能加入这个团队。
pinyin: Suīrán xiàngmù yǐjīng kāishǐ le, dàn wǒmen háinéng jiārù zhège tuánduì.
en: Although the project has already started, we can still join this team.

zh: 根据最新数据,这家公司的销售额已经超过预期的百分之二十。
pinyin: Gēnjù zuìxīn shùjù, zhè jiā gōngsī de xiāoshòuē yǐjīng chāoguò yùqī de bǎifēnzhī èrshí.
en: According to the latest data, this company's sales have already exceeded the target by twenty percent.

zh: 妈妈笑了。
pinyin: Māma xiào le.
en: Mom smiled.

zh: 他看到小狗就笑了。
pinyin: Tā kàndào xiǎo gǒu jiù xiào le.
en: He smiled as soon as he saw the puppy.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但是大家还是笑得很开心。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, búguò dàjiā háishi xiào de hěn kāixīn.
en: Even though the weather was bad, everyone still laughed happily.

zh: 他讲的笑话那么冷，结果没人笑。
pinyin: Tā jiǎng de xiàohuà nàme lěng, jiéguǒ méi rén xiào.
en: His joke was so bad that nobody laughed.

zh: 她用自嘲的语气讲自己的失败，惹得大家都笑了起来。
pinyin: Tā yòng zìcháo de yǔqì jiǎng zìjǐ de shībài, ruě de dàjiā dōu xiào le qǐlái.
en: She talked about her own failures with self-deprecating humor, which got everyone laughing.

zh: 我选了苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ xuǎnle píngguǒ.
en: I chose an apple.

zh: 明天我要选一个新书包。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào xuǎn yīgè xīn shūbāo.
en: Tomorrow I need to pick out a new school bag.

zh: 因为时间不多，所以我快速选了最喜欢的颜色。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shíjiān búduō, suǒyǐ wǒ kuàisù xuǎnle zuì xǐhuān de yánsè.
en: Because time was short, I quickly selected my favorite color.

zh: 在买房子之前，他仔细选了几个不同的社区来比较。
pinyin: Zài mǎi fángzi zhīqián, tā zǐxì xuǎnle jǐge búntóng de shèhuì lái bǐjiào.
en: Before buying a house, he carefully selected several different neighborhoods to compare.

zh: 公司为了找到合适的员工，从数百名应聘者中精心选出了十位进行面试。
pinyin: Gōngsī wèile zhǎodào héshìde yuángōng, cóng shù bǎi míng yìngpìnzhě zhōng jīngxīn xuǎnchūle shí wèi jìnxíng miànshì.
en: To find the right employees, the company carefully selected ten candidates from hundreds of applicants to interview.

zh: 我感到很饿。
pinyin: Wǒ gǎndào hěn è.
en: I feel very hungry.

zh: 昨天我感到有点冷。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ gǎndào yǒudiǎn lěng.
en: Yesterday I felt a bit cold.

zh: 因为天气很好，我感到特别开心。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒ gǎndào tèbié kāixīn.
en: Because the weather was nice, I felt especially happy.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但我感到很有成就感。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn wǒ gǎndào hěn yǒu chéngjiùgǎn.
en: Although the work was demanding, I felt a real sense of accomplishment.

zh: 经过这次失败，我感到需要改变自己的方法。
pinyin: Jīngguò zhè cì shībài, wǒ gǎndào xūyào gǎibiàn zìjǐ de fāngfǎ.
en: After this setback, I felt I needed to change my approach.

zh: 那边是学校。
pinyin: Nàbiān shì xuéxiào.
en: That place over there is the school.

zh: 明天我要去那边买东西。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào qù nàbiān mǎi dōngxi.
en: Tomorrow I need to go over there to buy some things.

zh: 虽然那边很远，但是公交车可以到。
pinyin: Suīrán nàbiān hěn yuǎn, dànshì gōngjiāochē kěyǐ dào.
en: Although it's far over there, the bus can still get you there.

zh: 因为工作的原因，我最近经常去那边出差。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò de yuányīn, wǒ zuìjìn jīngcháng qù nàbiān chūchāi.
en: Because of work, I've been traveling to that area for business trips a lot recently.

zh: 听说那边的发展前景不错，很多年轻人都想过去创业。
pinyin: Tīngshuō nàbiān de fāzhǎn qiánjǐng búcuò, hěnduō niánqīngrén dōu xiǎng guòqu chuàngyè.
en: I hear that area has pretty good development prospects, and a lot of young people want to move there to start businesses.

zh: 我家离学校很远。
pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn yuǎn.
en: My home is very far from school.

zh: 他每天坐公交去远的地方工作。
pinyin: Tā měitiān zuò gōngjiāo qù yuǎn de dìfang gōngzuò.
en: He takes the bus to work at a distant place every day.

zh: 虽然那家餐厅离这儿很远，但是饭很好吃。
pinyin: Suīrán nà jiā cāntīng lí zhèr hěn yuǎn, dànshi fàn hěn hǎochī.
en: Even though that restaurant is far from here, the food is really good.

zh: 他想去远方发展事业，因为在这个城市没有更好的机会。
pinyin: Tā xiǎng qù yuǎnfāng fāzhǎn shìyè, yīnwèi zài zhège chéngshì méiyǒu gèng hǎo de jīhuì.
en: He wants to develop his career in a distant place because there aren't better opportunities in this city.

zh: 从远处看，这栋楼的设计很现代，但走近了才发现质量有问题。
pinyin: Cóng yuǎnchù kàn, zhè dòng lóu de shèjì hěn xiàndài, dàn zǒujìnle cái fāxiàn zhìliàng yǒu wèntí.
en: From a distance, the building's design looks quite modern, but once you get closer you realize it has quality issues.

zh: 我有一个儿子。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī gè érzi.
en: I have a son.

zh: 他的儿子今年八岁了。
pinyin: Tā de érzi jīnnián bā suì le.
en: His son is eight years old this year.

zh: 因为她没有儿女，所以她很想要孩子。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā méiyǒu érǚ, suǒyǐ tā hěn xiǎngyào háizi.
en: Because she has no children, she really wants to have kids.

zh: 虽然儿子还小，但他已经能帮父母做一些简单的家务了。
pinyin: Suīrán érzi háishi xiǎo, dàn tā yǐjīng néng bāng fùmǔ zuò yīxiē jiǎndān de jiāwù le.
en: Although his son is still young, he's already able to help his parents with some simple household chores.

zh: 现在很多年轻人工作压力大，对生儿育女这件事变得越来越谨慎。
pinyin: Xiànzài hěnduō niánqīng rén gōngzuò yālì dà, duì shēng ér yù nǚ zhè jiàn shì biànde yuèláiyuè jǐnshèn.
en: These days, many young people face heavy work pressure and have become increasingly cautious about having children.

zh: 我喜欢听故事。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān tīng gùshì.
en: I like listening to stories.

zh: 妈妈每天给我讲故事。
pinyin: Māma měitiān gěi wǒ jiǎng gùshì.
en: Mom tells me a story every day.

zh: 虽然这个故事很长,但是我很喜欢听。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège gùshì hěn cháng, dànshì wǒ hěn xǐhuān tīng.
en: Even though this story is long, I really enjoy listening to it.

zh: 他讲的故事让所有人都笑了起来。
pinyin: Tā jiǎng de gùshì ràng suǒyǒu rén dōu xiào le qǐlái.
en: The story he told made everyone burst out laughing.

zh: 这部电影改编自一个民间故事,虽然情节有所改动,但核心内容还是保留下来了。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng gǎibiān zì yīgè mínjīan gùshì, suīrán qíng节 yǒusuǒ gǎidòng, dàn héxīn nèiróng háishi bǎoliú xiàlái le.
en: This film is adapted from a folk story; while the plot has been modified, the core content is still preserved.

zh: 他疯了。
pinyin: Tā fēng le.
en: He's gone crazy.

zh: 昨天他疯狂地笑了很久。
pinyin: Zuótiān tā fēngkuáng de xiào le hěnjiǔ.
en: Yesterday he laughed like a madman for a long time.

zh: 因为他没有睡觉，所以变得有点疯。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā méiyǒu shuìjiào, suǒyǐ biàn de yǒudiǎn fēng.
en: Because he didn't sleep, he got a bit crazy.

zh: 那些年轻人为了买票疯狂排队，场面很混乱。
pinyin: Nàxiē niánqīngnián wèile mǎi piào fēngkuáng páiduì, chǎngmiàn hěn hùnluàn.
en: Those young people lined up frantically to buy tickets, and the scene was pretty chaotic.

zh: 他最近迷上了炒股，整天疯魔似的盯着屏幕看行情。
pinyin: Tā zuìjìn míshang le chǎogǔ, zhěngtiān fēngmó shìde dīngzhe píngmù kàn hángqíng.
en: He's gotten obsessed with stock trading lately—he stares at the screen like a man possessed, checking prices all day.

zh: 我要换衣服。
pinyin: Wǒ yào huàn yīfu.
en: I need to change my clothes.

zh: 你的鞋坏了，要不要换一双？
pinyin: Nǐ de xié huài le, yào bu yào huàn yī shuāng?
en: Your shoe is broken—do you want to get a new pair?

zh: 虽然这个手机很旧，但我还是想换新的。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège shǒujī hěn jiù, dàn wǒ háishi xiǎng huàn xīn de.
en: Although this phone is old, I still want to switch to a new one.

zh: 因为工作压力太大，他决定换一个环境。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò yālì tài dà, tā juéding huàn yīgè huánjìng.
en: Because work stress was too heavy, he decided to change his environment.

zh: 与其在这家公司苦熬，不如主动换个思路，寻找更适合的机会。
pinyin: Yǔqī zài zhè jiā gōngsī kǔáo, búrú zhǔdòng huàn ge sīlù, xúnzhǎo gèng shìhé de jīhuì.
en: Rather than struggle at this company, you might as well take the initiative to change your approach and look for a better opportunity.

zh: 她要结婚了。
pinyin: Tā yào jiéhūn le.
en: She's going to get married.

zh: 他们明年想结婚。
pinyin: Tāmen míngniān xiǎng jiéhūn.
en: They want to get married next year.

zh: 因为他们相爱，所以决定结婚。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tāmen xiānglài, suǒyǐ juéhuà jiéhūn.
en: Because they love each other, they've decided to get married.

zh: 虽然他们才认识一年，但还是决定结婚了。
pinyin: Suīrán tāmen cái rènshi yī nián, dàn háishi juéhuà jiéhūn le.
en: Even though they've only known each other for a year, they still decided to get married.

zh: 他们打算在父母的支持下结婚，并邀请朋友们参加婚礼。
pinyin: Tāmen dǎsuàn zài fùmǔ de zhīchí xià jiéhūn, bìng yāoqǐng péngyoumen cānjiā hūnlǐ.
en: They're planning to get married with their parents' support and are inviting friends to the wedding.

zh: 我猜你喜欢吃苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ cāi nǐ xǐhuān chī píngguǒ.
en: I guess you like eating apples.

zh: 昨天他买了一个礼物，我一直在猜是什么。
pinyin: Zuótiān tā mǎi le yī ge lǐwù, wǒ yīzhí zài cāi shì shénme.
en: Yesterday he bought a gift, and I've been trying to guess what it is.

zh: 虽然我没有看过电影，但是我能猜出故事的结局。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ méiyǒu kànguò diànyǐng, dànshì wǒ néng cāi chū gùshì de jiéjú.
en: Even though I haven't watched the movie, I can still guess the ending of the story.

zh: 根据他的表情和语气，我猜测他可能对这个决定有些不满意。
pinyin: Gēnjù tā de biǎoqíng hé yǔqì, wǒ cāicè tā kěnéng duì zhège juéding yǒuxiē búmǎnyì.
en: Based on his expression and tone, I suspect he may be somewhat dissatisfied with this decision.

zh: 我们在办公室里猜测了半天，最后才知道老板其实是想给大家加薪。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài bàngōngshì lǐ cāicè le bàntiān, zuìhòu cái zhīdào lǎobǎn qīshí shì xiǎng gěi dàjiā jiāxīn.
en: We spent ages speculating in the office, and it turned out the boss actually wanted to give everyone a raise.

zh: 咱们去吃饭。
pinyin: Zánmen qù chīfàn.
en: Let's go eat.

zh: 咱们明天一起去公园玩。
pinyin: Zánmen míngtiān yìqǐ qù gōngyuán wán.
en: Let's go play in the park together tomorrow.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以咱们决定去爬山。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ zánmen juéding qù páshān.
en: Because the weather is nice, we've decided to go hiking.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但咱们还是应该抽时间陪家人。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn zánmen háishi yīnggāi chōu shíjiān péi jiārén.
en: Even though work is busy, we should still make time to spend with family.

zh: 咱们不能只顾眼前利益，要为长远发展考虑。
pinyin: Zánmen búnéng zhǐ gùyǎn qiányuán lìyì, yào wèi chángyuǎn fāzhǎn kǎolǜ.
en: We can't just focus on immediate gains—we need to think about long-term development.

zh: 我的床很大。
pinyin: Wǒ de chuáng hěn dà.
en: My bed is very big.

zh: 早上我在床上吃早饭。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ zài chuáng shang chī zǎofàn.
en: In the morning I eat breakfast in bed.

zh: 因为昨天很累，所以我在床上睡了很久。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zuótiān hěn lèi, suǒyǐ wǒ zài chuáng shang shuìle hěnjiǔ.
en: Because I was exhausted yesterday, I slept in bed for a long time.

zh: 虽然房间不大，但是那张床很舒服，我很喜欢。
pinyin: Suīrán fángjiān búdà, búshì nà zhāng chuáng hěn shūfu, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
en: Although the room isn't spacious, that bed is really comfortable, and I love it.

zh: 每次出差回来，躺在自己的床上就感到特别踏实。
pinyin: Měi cì chūchāi huílai, tǎng zài zìjǐ de chuáng shang jiù gǎndào tèbié tāshí.
en: Every time I come back from a business trip, lying on my own bed makes me feel genuinely at ease.

zh: 我处理垃圾。
pinyin: Wǒ chǔlǐ lājī.
en: I'm taking out the trash.

zh: 妈妈每天处理很多事情。
pinyin: Māma měitiān chǔlǐ hěnduō shìqing.
en: Mom deals with a lot of things every day.

zh: 因为电脑坏了，所以我需要处理这个问题。
pinyin: Yīnwèi diànnǎo huàile, suǒyǐ wǒ xūyào chǔlǐ zhège wèntí.
en: Because the computer broke, I need to fix this problem.

zh: 公司处理了顾客的投诉，虽然过程比较复杂。
pinyin: Gōngsī chǔlǐle gùkè de tóusu, suīrán guòchéng bǐjiào fùzá.
en: The company handled the customer's complaint, though the process was quite complicated.

zh: 要处理好人际关系，需要既有耐心又懂得沟通。
pinyin: Yào chǔlǐ hǎo rénjì guānxi, xūyào既有 nàixīn yòu dǒngde gōutōng.
en: Managing relationships well requires both patience and good communication skills.

zh: 他的妻子很好。
pinyin: Tā de qīzi hěn hǎo.
en: His wife is very nice.

zh: 我的妻子每天都去公司工作。
pinyin: Wǒ de qīzi měitiān dōu qù gōngsī gōngzuò.
en: My wife goes to the office to work every day.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但是他的妻子还是照顾孩子。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì tā de qīzi háishi zhàogu hái zi.
en: Although work is hectic, his wife still takes care of the children.

zh: 他经常跟妻子讨论公司的问题和生活的计划。
pinyin: Tā jīngcháng gēn qīzi tǎolùn gōngsī de wèntí hé shēnghuó de jìhuà.
en: He frequently discusses work issues and life plans with his wife.

zh: 多年来，他和妻子一直保持着相互理解和支持的关系。
pinyin: Duō nián lái, tā hé qīzi yīzhí bǎochízhe xiānghu lǐjiě hé zhīchí de guānxi.
en: Over many years, he and his wife have maintained a relationship built on mutual understanding and support.

zh: 我们进行游戏。
pinyin: Wǒmen jìnxíng yóuxì.
en: We're playing a game.

zh: 明天下午进行足球比赛。
pinyin: Míngtiān xiàwǔ jìnxíng zúqiú bǐsài.
en: The soccer match will take place tomorrow afternoon.

zh: 因为下雨，所以我们在家进行讨论。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen zàijiā jìnxíng tǎolùn.
en: Because it was raining, we had a discussion at home.

zh: 医生在进行检查的时候，患者感到有点紧张。
pinyin: Yīshēng zài jìnxíng jiǎnchá de shíhou, huànzhě gǎndào yǒudiǎn jǐnzhāng.
en: The patient felt a bit nervous while the doctor was conducting the examination.

zh: 公司正在进行产品升级，预计下月完成所有工作。
pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài jìnxíng chǎnpǐn shēngjí, yùjì xiàyuè wánchéng suǒyǒu gōngzuò.
en: The company is currently upgrading its products and expects to complete all work by next month.

zh: 房子内有一张床。
pinyin: Fángzi nèi yǒu yī zhāng chuáng.
en: There is a bed inside the house.

zh: 这个盒子内装着很多糖果。
pinyin: Zhège héziǐ nèi zhuāngzhe hěnduō tángguǒ.
en: This box contains lots of candies inside.

zh: 因为公司内有很多工作，所以他很忙。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngsī nèi yǒu hěnduō gōngzuò, suǒyǐ tā hěn máng.
en: Because there is a lot of work at the company, he is very busy.

zh: 会议内容虽然很复杂，但是大家都理解了。
pinyin: Huìyì nèiróng suīrán hěn fùzá, dànshì dàjiā dōu lǐjiěle.
en: Although the meeting content was quite complex, everyone understood it.

zh: 我们需要在三天内完成这个项目，这对团队来说是个挑战。
pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào zài sān tiān nèi wánchéng zhège xiàngmù, zhè duì tuánduì lái shuō shì ge tiǎozhàn.
en: We need to complete this project within three days, which is a real challenge for the team.

zh: 你是否喜欢吃米饭？
pinyin: Nǐ shìfǒu xǐhuān chī mǐfàn?
en: Do you like eating rice?

zh: 明天是否会下雨？我想知道。
pinyin: Míngtiān shìfǒu huì xiàyǔ? Wǒ xiǎng zhīdào.
en: Will it rain tomorrow? I want to know.

zh: 因为天气不好，我不确定是否能去公园。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, wǒ búquèdìng shìfǒu néng qù gōngyuán.
en: Because the weather is bad, I'm not sure if I can go to the park.

zh: 医生需要检查一下，才能判断是否需要做手术。
pinyin: Yīshēng xūyào jiǎnchá yīxià, cáinéng pànduàn shìfǒu xūyào zuò shǒushù.
en: The doctor needs to do an examination first to determine whether surgery is necessary.

zh: 这个项目能否成功，关键在于团队是否能齐心协力。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù néngfǒu chénggōng, guānjiàn zàiyú tuánduì shìfǒu néng qíxīn xiélì.
en: Whether this project succeeds depends on whether the team can work together in unity.

zh: 这段路很长。
pinyin: Zhè duàn lù hěn cháng.
en: This stretch of road is very long.

zh: 昨天我看了一段很有趣的视频。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ kànle yī duàn hěn yǒuqù de shìpín.
en: Yesterday I watched a really interesting video clip.

zh: 虽然这段时间很忙，但是我还是坚持学习中文。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè duàn shíjiān hěn máng, dànshì wǒ háishi jiānchí xuéxí Zhōngwén.
en: Although this period has been busy, I still keep practicing Chinese.

zh: 最近这段工作经历让我学到了很多管理的技能。
pinyin: Zuìjìn zhè duàn gōngzuò jīnglì ràng wǒ xuédàole hěn duō guǎnlǐ de jìnéng.
en: This recent work experience has taught me a lot of management skills.

zh: 那段创业的日子虽然充满挑战，但也成就了我的梦想。
pinyin: Nà duàn chuàngyè de rìzi suīrán chōngmǎn tiǎozhàn, dàn yě chéngjiùle wǒ de梦想.
en: Those days starting my business were full of challenges, but they also made my dreams come true.

zh: 这个令人开心。
pinyin: Zhège lìng rén kāixīn.
en: This makes people happy.

zh: 他的表现令我们感到很骄傲。
pinyin: Tā de biǎoxiàn lìng wǒmen gǎndào hěn jiāo'ào.
en: His performance makes us feel very proud.

zh: 虽然天气很冷，但是他的笑容令大家都感到温暖。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, dànshì tā de xiàoróng lìng dàjiā dōu gǎndào nuǎnhuо.
en: Although the weather is cold, his smile makes everyone feel warm.

zh: 这部电影的结局令我们意外，因为我们之前没有想到这样的发展。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de jiéjú lìng wǒmen yìwài, yīnwèi wǒmen zhīqián méiyǒu xiǎngdào zhèyàng de fāzhǎn.
en: The movie's ending surprised us, because we hadn't anticipated such a development.

zh: 他那些令人费解的言论在网上引起了很多争议和讨论。
pinyin: Tā nàxiē lìng rén fèijiě de yánlùn zài wǎngshang yǐnqǐle hěnduō zhēngyì hé tǎolùn.
en: His rather baffling remarks sparked considerable controversy and discussion online.

zh: 我刚刚吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng chīfàn.
en: I just ate.

zh: 她刚刚从学校回来。
pinyin: Tā gānggāng cóng xuéxiào huílái.
en: She just got back from school.

zh: 因为刚刚下雨，所以地很湿。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gānggāng xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ dì hěn shī.
en: Because it just rained, the ground is wet.

zh: 刚刚那个电话是老板打来的，他要我明天开会。
pinyin: Gānggāng nàge diànhuà shì lǎobǎn dǎlái de, tā yào wǒ míngtiān kāihuì.
en: That call just now was from my boss—he wants me in a meeting tomorrow.

zh: 刚刚在会议上提出的方案虽然可行，但我们还需要进一步论证。
pinyin: Gānggāng zài huìyì shang tíchū de fāng'àn suīrán kěxíng, dàn wǒmen háixū yìnjiàyībù lùnzhèng.
en: The proposal put forward just now in the meeting is feasible, but we still need to verify it further.

zh: 警察在看案子。
pinyin: Jǐngchá zài kàn ànzi.
en: The police officer is looking at the case.

zh: 昨天我们讨论了一个有趣的案子。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒmen tǎolùnle yīgè yǒuqù de ànzi.
en: Yesterday we discussed an interesting case.

zh: 因为案子很复杂，所以律师花了很多时间。
pinyin: Yīnwèi ànzi hěn fùzá, suǒyǐ lǜshī huāle hěnduō shíjiān.
en: Because the case was complicated, the lawyer spent a lot of time on it.

zh: 虽然这个案子看起来简单，但实际上隐藏了很多问题。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège ànzi kàn qǐlai jiǎndān, dàn shíjìshang yǐncángle hěnduō wèntí.
en: Although this case seemed straightforward at first, it actually concealed many complications.

zh: 检察官认为这个案子证据充分，足以起诉嫌疑人。
pinyin: Jiǎnchájūguān rènwéi zhège ànzi zhèngjù chōngfèn, zúyǐ qǐsù xiányírén.
en: The prosecutor believes the evidence in this case is sufficient to indict the suspect.

zh: 我们现在行动。
pinyin: Wǒmen xiànzài xíngdòng.
en: We're taking action now.

zh: 明天我们一起去行动吧。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒmen yìqǐ qù xíngdòng ba.
en: Let's go do something together tomorrow.

zh: 因为时间紧急，所以我们必须立即行动。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shíjiān jǐnjí, suǒyǐ wǒmen bìxū lìjí xíngdòng.
en: Because time is tight, we need to take action right away.

zh: 虽然计划还不完美，但是我们不能再等待，必须开始行动。
pinyin: Suīrán jìhuà háishi bù wánměi, dànshi wǒmen búnéng zài děngdài, bìxū kāishǐ xíngdòng.
en: Although the plan isn't perfect yet, we can't wait any longer—we have to start acting now.

zh: 与其坐以待毙，不如趁现在还有机会赶紧行动。
pinyin: Yǔqī zuò yǐ dāibì, búrú chèn xiànzài háiyǒu jīhuì gǎnjǐn xíngdòng.
en: Rather than just waiting for disaster to strike, we should seize the opportunity and take action while we still can.

zh: 我的第二个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ de dì èr ge píngguǒ.
en: This is my second apple.

zh: 今天第二次下雨了。
pinyin: Jīntiān dì èr cì xiàyǔ le.
en: It's rained a second time today.

zh: 因为第一次不好，所以我第二次更努力了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi dì yī cì búhǎo, suǒyǐ wǒ dì èr cì gèng nǔlì le.
en: Because the first time didn't go well, I worked much harder the second time.

zh: 他第二次参加这个考试，希望能通过。
pinyin: Tā dì èr cì cānjiā zhège kǎoshì, xīwàng néng tōngguò.
en: He's taking this exam for the second time, hoping to pass this time.

zh: 第二次创业虽然风险更大，但他已经有经验了。
pinyin: Dì èr cì chuàngyè suīrán fēngxiǎn gèng dà, dàn tā yǐjīng yǒu jīngyàn le.
en: Though his second venture carries greater risk, he's gained valuable experience by now.

zh: 我努力学习。
pinyin: Wǒ nǔlì xuéxí.
en: I work hard at studying.

zh: 他每天都很努力地做功课。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu hěn nǔlì de zuò gōngkè.
en: He does his homework very carefully every single day.

zh: 虽然这个工作很难，但是我会努力完成它。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège gōngzuò hěn nán, dànshì wǒ huì nǔlì wánchéng tā.
en: Even though this job is difficult, I will work hard to finish it.

zh: 因为他努力了很长时间，所以最后成功了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā nǔlì le hěn cháng shíjiān, suǒyǐ zuìhòu chénggōng le.
en: Because he persisted for such a long time, he finally succeeded in the end.

zh: 只要你继续努力，就不会为将来的选择后悔。
pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ jìxù nǔlì, jiù búhuì wèi jiāngláide xuǎnzé hòuhuǐ.
en: As long as you keep working hard, you won't regret the choices you make for your future.

zh: 我害怕狗。
pinyin: Wǒ hàipà gǒu.
en: I'm afraid of dogs.

zh: 小孩子晚上害怕黑暗。
pinyin: Xiǎo háizi wǎnshang hàipà hēi'àn.
en: Little children are scared of the dark at night.

zh: 虽然他很强壮，但是他害怕蜘蛛。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn qiángzhuàng, dànshì tā hàipà zhīzhū.
en: Although he's very strong, he's afraid of spiders.

zh: 她因为害怕迟到，所以提前一小时出门。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi hàipà chídào, suǒyǐ tíqián yī xiǎoshí chūmén.
en: Because she was worried about being late, she left an hour early.

zh: 很多人害怕失败，但这恰恰阻止了他们去尝试新东西。
pinyin: Hěn duō rén hàipà shībài, dàn zhè qià qià zǔzhǐle tāmen qù chángshì xīn dōngxi.
en: Many people are afraid of failure, but that's precisely what stops them from trying new things.

zh: 我爸爸喜欢喝酒。
pinyin: Wǒ bàba xǐhuān hēy酒。
en: My dad likes to drink alcohol.

zh: 晚上我们一起去酒吧喝酒。
pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒmen yìqǐ qù jiǔbā hēy酒。
en: In the evening we're going to a bar together to have a drink.

zh: 因为明天要工作，所以我今天不想喝酒。
pinyin: Yīnwèi míngtiān yào gōngzuò, suǒyǐ wǒ jīntiān búxiǎng hēy酒。
en: Because I have work tomorrow, I don't want to drink today.

zh: 虽然他不太喜欢酒的味道，但是他还是会在聚会上喝一点。
pinyin: Suīrán tā búhuì xǐhuān jiǔ de wèidào, dànshì tā háishi huì zài jùhuì shang hēy yìdiǎn。
en: Although he doesn't really like the taste of alcohol, he'll still have a little at parties.

zh: 他对酒的热情一直很高，朋友们都说他是个酒鬼。
pinyin: Tā duì jiǔ de règíng yìzhí hěn gāo, péngyoumen dōu shuō tā shì ge jiǔguǐ。
en: He's always been really enthusiastic about alcohol, and his friends all say he's a boozer.

zh: 我发现一只猫。
pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn yī zhī māo.
en: I found a cat.

zh: 昨天我发了一条短信给朋友。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ fāle yī tiáo duǎnxìn gěi péngyou.
en: Yesterday I sent a text message to my friend.

zh: 因为天气很冷，所以他发烧了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn lěng, suǒyǐ tā fāshāole.
en: Because the weather was very cold, he came down with a fever.

zh: 虽然他很努力，但最后还是没有发挥出最好的水平。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn nǔlì, dàn zuìhòu háishi méiyǒu fāhuī chū zuì hǎo de shuǐpíng.
en: Although he tried hard, he ultimately couldn't perform at his best level.

zh: 这个项目能否成功取决于团队是否能发挥各自的优势。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù néngfǒu chénggōng qǔjuéyú tuánduì shìfǒu néng fāhuī gèzì de yōushì.
en: Whether this project succeeds depends on whether the team can leverage each member's strengths.

zh: 警察调查了这个案子。
pinyin: Jǐngchá tiáochá le zhège ànzi.
en: The police investigated this case.

zh: 昨天老师调查了学生的家庭情况。
pinyin: Zuótiān lǎoshī tiáochá le xuésheng de jiātíng qíngkuàng.
en: Yesterday the teacher looked into the students' family backgrounds.

zh: 因为出了问题，所以公司决定调查一下原因。
pinyin: Yīnwèi chū le wèntí, suǒyǐ gōngsī juéding tiáochá yīxià yuányīn.
en: Because something went wrong, the company decided to investigate the cause.

zh: 政府正在调查这家工厂是否违反了环保规定。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhèngzài tiáochá zhè jiā gōngchǎng shìfǒu wēifǎn le huánbǎo guīdìng.
en: The government is currently investigating whether the factory violated environmental regulations.

zh: 根据消费者调查结果，大多数人对这款产品的质量并不满意。
pinyin: Gēnjù xiāofèizhě tiáochá jiéguǒ, dàduōshù rén duì zhè ku�ǎn chǎnpǐn de zhìliàng bìngbù mǎnyì.
en: According to consumer survey results, most people aren't satisfied with the quality of this product.

zh: 我失去了钥匙。
pinyin: Wǒ shīqù le yàoshi.
en: I lost my keys.

zh: 昨天我在公园失去了手机。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài gōngyuán shīqù le shǒujī.
en: I lost my phone in the park yesterday.

zh: 因为没有好好学习，他失去了上大学的机会。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu hǎohāo xuéxí, tā shīqù le shàng dàxué de jīhuì.
en: Because he didn't study hard, he lost the chance to go to university.

zh: 自从搬到新城市以后，他逐渐失去了和老朋友的联系。
pinyin: Zìcóng bān dào xīn chéngshì yǐhòu, tā zhújiàn shīqù le hé lǎo péngyou de liánxì.
en: After moving to a new city, he gradually lost touch with his old friends.

zh: 公司由于管理不善，慢慢失去了市场竞争力，最后不得不关闭了。
pinyin: Gōngsī yóuyú guǎnlǐ búshàn, mànman shīqù le shìchǎng jìngzhēng lì, zuìhòu búděbù guānbì le.
en: The company gradually lost its market competitiveness due to poor management, and ultimately had to shut down.

zh: 我喜欢唱歌。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān chànggē.
en: I like to sing.

zh: 昨天我和朋友一起唱歌。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hé péngyou yìqǐ chànggē.
en: Yesterday I sang with my friends.

zh: 虽然他唱歌不太好，但是他很开心。
pinyin: Suīrán tā chànggē búhuì hǎo, dànshì tā hěn kāixīn.
en: Although his singing isn't very good, he's really happy.

zh: 因为她的歌声很甜美，所以很多人都喜欢听她唱歌。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā de gēshēng hěn tiánměi, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén dōu xǐhuān tīng tā chànggē.
en: Because her voice is so sweet, a lot of people enjoy listening to her sing.

zh: 他虽然没有接受过专业训练，但唱歌的天赋让他在比赛中脱颖而出。
pinyin: Tā suīrán méiyǒu jiēshòu guò zhuānyè xùnliàn, dàn chànggē de tiānfù ràng tā zài bǐsài zhōng tuōyǐng érchū.
en: Although he never had formal training, his natural talent for singing made him stand out in the competition.

zh: 他成功了。
pinyin: Tā chénggōng le.
en: He succeeded.

zh: 她今天考试成功了。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān kǎoshì chénggōng le.
en: She passed her exam today.

zh: 因为他努力学习，所以成功了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā nǔlì xuéxí, suǒyǐ chénggōng le.
en: Because he studied hard, he succeeded.

zh: 虽然开始很困难，但他最后还是成功了。
pinyin: Suīrán kāishǐ hěn kùnnan, dàn tā zuìhòu háishi chénggōng le.
en: Although it was difficult at first, he eventually succeeded in the end.

zh: 经过多年的坚持和努力，她终于在事业上取得了成功。
pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de jiānchí hé nǔlì, tā zh终于 zài shìyè shang huòdé le chénggōng.
en: After years of persistence and hard work, she finally achieved success in her career.

zh: 我喜欢唱歌。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān chàng gē.
en: I like to sing.

zh: 她每天在家唱歌。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān zài jiā chàng gē.
en: She sings at home every day.

zh: 虽然他唱得不好，但是很努力。
pinyin: Suīrán tā chàng de búhǎo, dànshì hěn nǔlì.
en: Although he doesn't sing well, he tries really hard.

zh: 在聚会的时候，大家一起唱了很多歌曲。
pinyin: Zài jùhuì de shíhou, dàjiā yīqǐ chàngle hěnduō gēqū.
en: At the party, everyone sang a lot of songs together.

zh: 他对唱歌很有热情，经常参加各种歌唱比赛。
pinyin: Tā duì chàng gē hěn yǒu règíng, jīngcháng cānjiā gèzhǒng gēchàng bǐsài.
en: He's really passionate about singing and frequently takes part in various singing competitions.

zh: 我考虑吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ kǎolǜ chī mǐfàn.
en: I'm thinking about eating rice.

zh: 明天我要考虑去哪个公园。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào kǎolǜ qù nǎge gōngyuán.
en: Tomorrow I need to decide which park to go to.

zh: 因为天气不好，所以我在考虑不去旅游。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, suǒyǐ wǒ zài kǎolǜ búqù lǚyóu.
en: Because the weather is bad, I'm thinking about not going on the trip.

zh: 他在考虑是否应该换一份工作，因为现在很累。
pinyin: Tā zài kǎolǜ shìfǒu yīnggāi huàn yī fèn gōngzuò, yīnwèi xiànzài hěn léi.
en: He's considering whether he should change jobs since he's exhausted right now.

zh: 我们在考虑投资这个项目，但需要仔细评估风险和收益。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài kǎolǜ tóuzī zhège xiàngmù, dàn xūyào zǐxì píngēstimate fēngxiǎn hé shōuyì.
en: We're considering investing in this project, but we need to carefully assess the risks and returns.

zh: 我刚才吃饭了。
pinyin: Wǒ gānɡcái chīfàn le.
en: I just ate.

zh: 刚才妈妈给我买了一个苹果。
pinyin: Gānɡcái māma ɡěi wǒ mǎi le yī ɡè pínnɡuǒ.
en: My mom just bought me an apple.

zh: 刚才下雨的时候，我在家里看书。
pinyin: Gānɡcái xiàyǔ de shíhou, wǒ zài jiālǐ kànshū.
en: I was reading at home when it rained just now.

zh: 刚才那个电话虽然很短，但是传达了重要的信息。
pinyin: Gānɡcái nàɡe diànhuà suīrán hěn duǎn, dànshi chuándá le zhònyào de xìnxī.
en: Although that call just now was brief, it conveyed important information.

zh: 刚才的会议讨论得很激烈，大家对这个方案意见不一。
pinyin: Gānɡcái de huìyì tǎolùn de hěn jīliè, dàjiā duì zhèɡe fāng'àn yìjian búyī.
en: The meeting we just had was quite heated, with everyone disagreeing about the proposal.

zh: 我们今天约会。
pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān yuēhuì.
en: We're going on a date today.

zh: 他想周末和女朋友约会。
pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhōumò hé nǚpéngyou yuēhuì.
en: He wants to go on a date with his girlfriend this weekend.

zh: 虽然很忙，但是我还是想约会。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn máng, dànshì wǒ háishi xiǎng yuēhuì.
en: Even though I'm really busy, I still want to go on a date.

zh: 因为下雨了，我们决定改天约会。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, wǒmen juéding gǎitiān yuēhuì.
en: Because it was raining, we decided to reschedule our date for another day.

zh: 她最近工作压力很大，但还是坚持要和朋友约会放松一下。
pinyin: Tā zuìjìn gōngzuò yālì hěn dà, dàn háishi jiānchí yào hé péngyou yuēhuì fàngsōng yīxià.
en: She's been under a lot of work stress lately, but she's determined to go out and hang out with friends to relax.

zh: 我喜欢看节目。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān kàn jiémù.
en: I like watching TV shows.

zh: 晚上八点有一个有趣的节目。
pinyin: Wǎnshang bā diǎn yǒu yī gè yǒuqù de jiémù.
en: There's an interesting program on at 8 PM tonight.

zh: 因为这个节目很好看，所以很多人喜欢看。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhège jiémù hěn hǎokàn, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén xǐhuān kàn.
en: Because this show is so good, lots of people like watching it.

zh: 虽然这个节目播出很晚，但很多年轻人还是会看。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège jiémù bōchū hěn wǎn, dàn hěnduō niánqīngrén háishi huì kàn.
en: Although the show airs pretty late, young people still make time to watch it.

zh: 这档节目因为制作用心、演员阵容强大而获得了不少观众的好评。
pinyin: Zhè dàng jiémù yīnwèi zhìzuò yòngxīn, yǎnyuán zhènróng qiángdà érhuòdéle búshǎo guānzhòng de hǎopíng.
en: The show has earned lots of praise from viewers thanks to its careful production and strong cast.

zh: 我通过考试了。
pinyin: Wǒ tōngguò kǎoshì le.
en: I passed the exam.

zh: 他昨天通过了驾照考试。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān tōngguò le jiàzhào kǎoshì.
en: He passed his driving test yesterday.

zh: 因为她很努力，所以通过了这次面试。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn nǔlì, suǒyǐ tōngguò le zhè cì miànshì.
en: Because she worked hard, she passed this interview.

zh: 学生们通过小组讨论的方式来解决问题。
pinyin: Xuéshēngmen tōngguò xiǎozǔ tǎolùn de fāngshì lái jiějué wèntí.
en: Students solve problems by working through group discussions.

zh: 公司通过改进工作流程来提高生产效率。
pinyin: Gōngsī tōngguò gǎijìn gōngzuò liúchéng lái tígāo shēngchǎn xiàolǜ.
en: The company increased productivity by improving its work processes.

zh: 我和你之间有一个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ hé nǐ zhī jiān yǒu yī ge píngguǒ.
en: There's an apple between you and me.

zh: 他们之间没有什么问题。
pinyin: Tāmen zhī jiān méiyǒu shénme wèntí.
en: There's nothing wrong between them.

zh: 虽然他们之间有分歧，但是他们还是好朋友。
pinyin: Suīrán tāmen zhī jiān yǒu fēnqī, dànshì tāmen háishi hǎo péngyou.
en: Although they have differences between them, they're still good friends.

zh: 在这两个城市之间的距离大约是五百公里。
pinyin: Zài zhè liǎng ge chéngshì zhī jiān de jùlí dàyuē shì wǔbǎi gōnglǐ.
en: The distance between these two cities is approximately five hundred kilometers.

zh: 他们之间存在着信任危机，需要通过沟通来化解矛盾。
pinyin: Tāmen zhī jiān cúnzàizhe xìnrèn wēijī, xūyào tōngguò gōutōng lái huàjiě máodùn.
en: There's a trust crisis between them; they need to communicate to resolve the conflict.

zh: 我喜欢苹果,别的不吃。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān píngguǒ, biéde búchī.
en: I like apples, but I don't eat anything else.

zh: 今天没有别的课,只有英语课。
pinyin: Jīntiān méiyǒu biéde kè, zhǐyǒu yīngyǔ kè.
en: We don't have any other classes today, just English class.

zh: 虽然房间很小,但别的都很好,所以我很满意。
pinyin: Suīrán fángjiān hěn xiǎo, dàn biéde dōu hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒ hěn mǎnyì.
en: Although the room is small, everything else is great, so I'm quite satisfied.

zh: 除了这个问题,别的都解决了,我们明天继续讨论这个。
pinyin: Chúle zhège wèntí, biéde dōu jiějuéle, wǒmen míngtiān jìxù tǎolùn zhège.
en: Apart from this issue, we've resolved everything else; we'll keep discussing this one tomorrow.

zh: 他对别的工作不感兴趣,只想专注于自己热爱的研究领域。
pinyin: Tā duì biéde gōngzuò búgǎn xìngqù, zhǐ xiǎng zhuānzhù yú zìjǐ règài de yánjiū lǐngyù.
en: He's not interested in other jobs—he just wants to focus on his beloved research field.

zh: 我学中文。
pinyin: Wǒ xué zhōngwén.
en: I'm learning Chinese.

zh: 我每天学两个小时。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān xué liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
en: I study for two hours every day.

zh: 因为我想找好工作，所以我认真学英语。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ xiǎng zhǎo hǎo gōngzuò, suǒyǐ wǒ rènzhēn xué yīngyǔ.
en: Because I want to find a good job, I study English seriously.

zh: 他虽然学了很多年的钢琴，但是还是没有参加过比赛。
pinyin: Tā suīrán xuéle hěnduō nián de gāngqin, búguò háishi méiyǒu cānjiāguò bǐsài.
en: Even though he's been studying piano for many years, he's never competed in a competition.

zh: 在国外工作的这几年里，他不仅学到了专业知识，还学会了如何适应不同的文化。
pinyin: Zài guówài gōngzuò de zhè jǐ nián lǐ, tā bújǐn xuédàole zhuānyè zhīshi, háishi xuéhuìle rúhé shìyìng bútonǎg de wénhuà.
en: During these years working abroad, he not only gained professional knowledge but also learned how to adapt to different cultures.

zh: 我吃了糖，很开心。
pinyin: Wǒ chīle táng, hěn kāixīn.
en: I ate candy and felt really happy.

zh: 昨天和朋友一起玩，我很开心。
pinyin: Zuótiān hé péngyou yìqǐ wán, wǒ hěn kāixīn.
en: I played with my friend yesterday and had a great time.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以我们都很开心。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen dōu hěn kāixīn.
en: Because the weather was nice, we all felt happy.

zh: 虽然工作很累，但是和同事们聊天时我还是很开心。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn lèi, dànshì hé tóngshìmen liáotiān shí wǒ háishi hěn kāixīn.
en: Although work is exhausting, I'm still happy when I chat with my colleagues.

zh: 这次项目圆满完成，全队都开心得不得了。
pinyin: Zhè cì xiàngmù yuánmǎn wánchéng, quán duì dōu kāixīn de búdeliǎo.
en: The project wrapped up successfully, and the whole team was absolutely thrilled.

zh: 我的母亲很好。
pinyin: Wǒ de mǔqīn hěn hǎo.
en: My mother is very nice.

zh: 每天早上母亲给我做早饭。
pinyin: Měi tiān zǎoshang mǔqīn gěi wǒ zuò zǎofàn.
en: Every morning my mother makes breakfast for me.

zh: 因为母亲很忙，所以我帮她做家务。
pinyin: Yīnwèi mǔqīn hěn máng, suǒyǐ wǒ bāng tā zuò jiāwù.
en: Because my mother is busy, I help her with the housework.

zh: 虽然母亲工作很累，但是她从不对我们发脾气。
pinyin: Suīrán mǔqīn gōngzuò hěn lèi, dànshì tā cóng bu duì wǒmen fā píqi.
en: Although my mother works hard and gets tired, she never loses her temper with us.

zh: 我母亲经常说，养儿方知父母恩，等我长大才真正理解了她的意思。
pinyin: Wǒ mǔqīn jīngcháng shuō, yǎng ér fāng zhī fùmǔ ēn, děng wǒ zhǎngdà cái zhēnzhèng lǐjiě le tā de yìsi.
en: My mother often says that you only understand your parents' kindness when you have children of your own—I truly grasped what she meant as I grew up.

zh: 我有一辆车。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī liàng chē.
en: I have one car.

zh: 他昨天买了一辆新自行车。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān mǎile yī liàng xīn zìxíngchē.
en: He bought a new bicycle yesterday.

zh: 虽然这辆公交车很旧，但是它每天都很准时。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè liàng gōngjiāochē hěn jiù, dànshì tā měitiān dōu hěn zhǔnshí.
en: Although this bus is old, it's always on time every day.

zh: 因为公司给了我一辆电动车，所以我上班再也不用挤地铁了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngsī gěile wǒ yī liàng diàndòngchē, suǒyǐ wǒ shàngbān zàiyě búyòng jǐ dìtiě le.
en: Because the company gave me an electric vehicle, I don't have to squeeze onto the subway to go to work anymore.

zh: 停车场里停了好几辆豪车，其中一辆法拉利引起了大家的注意。
pinyin: Tīngchēchǎng lǐ tínggle hǎo jǐ liàng háochē, qīzhōng yī liàng Fǎlālì yǐnqǐle dàjiā de zhùyì.
en: The parking lot had several luxury cars, and one Ferrari in particular caught everyone's attention.

zh: 我有一个好主意。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī gè hǎo zhǔyì.
en: I have a good idea.

zh: 昨天他想了一个主意，很有趣。
pinyin: Zuótiān tā xiǎngle yī gè zhǔyì, hěn yǒuqù.
en: Yesterday he came up with an idea that was really fun.

zh: 虽然这个主意很简单，但是很有用。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège zhǔyì hěn jiǎndān, dànshì hěn yǒuyòng.
en: Although this idea is simple, it's actually very useful.

zh: 她总是能想到别人想不到的主意。
pinyin: Tā zǒngshì néng xiǎngdào biérén xiǎng búdào de zhǔyì.
en: She always manages to come up with ideas that others can't think of.

zh: 这个主意听起来不错，但我们得先考虑成本和时间。
pinyin: Zhège zhǔyì tīng qǐlai búcuò, dàn wǒmen děi xiānkǎolǜ chéngběn hé shíjiān.
en: The idea sounds good, but we need to first consider the cost and timeline.

zh: 我想探望奶奶。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng tànwàng nǎinai.
en: I want to visit my grandmother.

zh: 昨天我去医院探望了病人。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ qù yīyuàn tànwàng le bìngrén.
en: Yesterday I went to the hospital to visit a patient.

zh: 虽然很忙，但我还是想去探望朋友。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn máng, dàn wǒ háishi xiǎng qù tànwàng péngyou.
en: Even though I'm busy, I still want to visit my friend.

zh: 警察正在探查这个案件的真相。
pinyin: Jǐngchá zhèngzài tànchá zhège ànjiàn de zhēnxiàng.
en: The police are investigating the truth behind this case.

zh: 科学家们探索宇宙的奥秘已经有几十年了。
pinyin: Kēxuéjiā men tànsuǒ yǔzhòu de àomì yǐjīng yǒu jǐ shí nián le.
en: Scientists have been exploring the mysteries of the universe for several decades now.

zh: 我的丈夫叫李明。
pinyin: Wǒ de zhàngfu jiào Lǐ Míng.
en: My husband's name is Li Ming.

zh: 昨天我丈夫买了一个新手机。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zhàngfu mǎile yīge xīn shǒujī.
en: Yesterday my husband bought a new phone.

zh: 因为丈夫工作很忙，所以我们周末一起去公园。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhàngfu gōngzuò hěn máng, suǒyǐ wǒmen zhōumò yīqǐ qù gōngyuán.
en: Because my husband is busy with work, we go to the park together on weekends.

zh: 虽然丈夫出差了一个月，但是他经常给我发信息。
pinyin: Suīrán zhàngfu chūchāile yīge yuè, dànshi tā jīngcháng gěi wǒ fā xìnxī.
en: Although my husband was away on a business trip for a month, he messages me often.

zh: 我丈夫对工作很认真，但在家里他总是放下手机陪我们。
pinyin: Wǒ zhàngfu duì gōngzuò hěn rènzhēn, dàn zàijiāli tā zǒngshi fàngxia shǒujī péi wǒmen.
en: My husband is very serious about his work, but at home he always puts his phone down to spend time with us.

zh: 请你待在家里。
pinyin: Qǐng nǐ dāizài jiāli.
en: Please stay at home.

zh: 我们明天待在公园玩。
pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān dāizài gōngyuán wán.
en: We'll stay in the park to play tomorrow.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但是我还要待在外面。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dànshi wǒ háiyào dāizài wàimiàn.
en: Even though the weather is bad, I still want to stay outside.

zh: 这份工作待遇不错，所以很多人都想申请。
pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò dàiyù búcuò, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén dōu xiǎng shēnqǐng.
en: This job offers good benefits, so many people want to apply for it.

zh: 他在那家公司待了十年以上，对行业的发展很了解。
pinyin: Tā zài nà jiā gōngsī dāile shí nián yǐshàng, duì hángyè de fāzhǎn hěn liǎojiě.
en: He's been at that company for over ten years, so he understands the industry's development really well.

zh: 水变成了冰。
pinyin: Shuǐ biànchéngle bīng.
en: Water turned into ice.

zh: 今天天气冷，水变成了冰。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì lěng, shuǐ biànchéngle bīng.
en: The weather is cold today, so the water has turned to ice.

zh: 因为下雪了，白色的雪花变成了冰，路很滑。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàxuěle, báisè de xuěhuā biànchéngle bīng, lù hěn huá.
en: Because it snowed, the white snowflakes turned to ice, and the road became slippery.

zh: 他从一个害羞的男孩变成了自信的领导者。
pinyin: Tā cóng yīgè hàixiū de nánháizi biànchéngle zìxìn de lǐngdǎozhě.
en: He went from being a shy boy to becoming a confident leader.

zh: 随着科技发展，我们的生活方式也在逐渐变成了数字化的样子。
pinyin: Suízhe kējì fāzhǎn, wǒmen de shēnghuó fāngshì yě zài zhújiàn biànchéngle shùzìhuà de yàngzi.
en: As technology advances, our lifestyle has gradually been transforming into something increasingly digital.

zh: 我倒了一杯水。
pinyin: Wǒ dàole yī bēi shuǐ.
en: I poured a glass of water.

zh: 昨天下雨的时候，树倒了。
pinyin: Zuótiān xiàyǔ de shíhou, shù dàole.
en: When it rained yesterday, a tree fell over.

zh: 虽然这个主意不错，但我倒觉得有点奇怪。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège zhǔyì búcuò, dàn wǒ dào juéde yǒudiǎn qíguài.
en: Although the idea is decent, I actually think it's a bit odd.

zh: 他经常说要辞职，但到现在还倒没真的离开公司。
pinyin: Tā jīngcháng shuō yào cízhí, dàn dào xiànzài háishi dào méi zhēnde líkāi gōngsī.
en: He often talks about quitting, but he hasn't actually left the company yet.

zh: 这些年轻人倒挺有想法的，只是执行起来往往差强人意。
pinyin: Zhèxiē niánqīng rén dào tǐng yǒu xiǎngfǎ de, zhǐshì zhíxíng qǐlai wǎngwǎng chàqiáng rén yì.
en: These young people actually have quite good ideas; it's just that the execution tends to fall short.

zh: 我家离学校近。
pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào jìn.
en: My house is close to school.

zh: 他离开公司的时候很开心。
pinyin: Tā líkāi gōngsī de shíhou hěn kāixīn.
en: He was very happy when he left the company.

zh: 虽然离家很远，但是他每周都给家人打电话。
pinyin: Suīrán líjiā hěn yuǎn, dànshi tā měi zhōu dōu gěi jiārén dǎ diànhuà.
en: Although he lives far from home, he calls his family every week.

zh: 因为工作离不开电脑，所以他经常感到眼睛疲劳。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò líbukāi diànnǎo, suǒyǐ tā jīngcháng gǎndào yǎnjing píláo.
en: Because his work is inseparable from computers, he often experiences eye strain.

zh: 自从离开那个城市以后，她就再也没有回过头，专注于新的生活。
pinyin: Zìcóng líkāi nàge chéngshì yǐhòu, tā jiù zàiyě méiyǒu huíguò tóu, zhuānzhù yú xīn de shēnghuó.
en: Since leaving that city, she never looked back and focused entirely on her new life.

zh: 老师解释了这个字。
pinyin: Lǎoshī jiěshì le zhège zì.
en: The teacher explained this character.

zh: 妈妈用简单的话解释了这个问题。
pinyin: Māma yòng jiǎndān de huà jiěshì le zhège wèntí.
en: Mom explained the problem in simple words.

zh: 因为他不懂，所以我需要再解释一遍。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā búdǒng, suǒyǐ wǒ xūyào zài jiěshì yī biàn.
en: Since he didn't understand, I had to explain it again.

zh: 经理耐心地解释了新规则，员工才明白了。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ nàixīn de jiěshì le xīn guīzé, yuángōng cái míngbai le.
en: The manager patiently explained the new rules, and then the employees understood.

zh: 他试图解释自己的行为，但说法前后不一，显得有些可疑。
pinyin: Tā shìtú jiěshì zìjǐ de xíngwéi, dàn shuōfǎ qiánhòu búyī, xiǎnde yǒuxiē kěyí.
en: He tried to explain his behavior, but his story kept changing, which made him seem rather suspicious.

zh: 我往学校走。
pinyin: Wǒ wǎng xuéxiào zǒu.
en: I'm walking toward school.

zh: 每天早上我往办公室去。
pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang wǒ wǎng bàngōngshì qù.
en: Every morning I head to the office.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但他还是往山上走去。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dànshì tā háishi wǎng shānshang zǒuqù.
en: Although the weather was bad, he still went toward the mountain.

zh: 从去年开始，越来越多人往城市搬家找工作。
pinyin: Cóng qùnián kāishǐ, yuèláiyuè duō rén wǎng chéngshì bānjiā zhǎo gōngzuò.
en: Starting last year, more and more people have been moving to cities to find jobs.

zh: 往年这个季节生意还不错，但今年往往一开门就是亏损。
pinyin: Wǎngnián zhège jìjié shēngyì háishi búcuò, dàn jīnnián wǎngwǎng yī kāimén jiùshi kuīsǔn.
en: In previous years this season had decent business, but nowadays we often end up taking losses the moment we open.

zh: 这个手机一万块。
pinyin: Zhège shǒujī yī wàn kuài.
en: This phone costs ten thousand yuan.

zh: 去年有一万多个学生来了这所学校。
pinyin: Qùnián yǒu yī wàn duō ge xuésheng lái le zhè suǒ xuéxiào.
en: Last year, over ten thousand students came to this school.

zh: 虽然只花了一万块，但是这个电脑质量很好。
pinyin: Suīrán zhǐ huā le yī wàn kuài, dànshì zhège diànnǎo zhìliàng hěn hǎo.
en: Although it only cost ten thousand yuan, this computer has really good quality.

zh: 因为他每年收入不到十万，所以买房对他来说很困难。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā měi nián shōurù búdào shí wàn, suǒyǐ mǎi fáng duì tā lái shuō hěn kùnnan.
en: Since his annual income is less than one million yuan, buying a house is very difficult for him.

zh: 这个项目需要投资五百万以上，虽然风险很大，但我们万一成功了就能赚很多钱。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào tóuzī wǔ bǎi wàn yǐshàng, suīrán fēngxiǎn hěn dà, dàn wǒmen wànyī chénggōng le jiù néng zuàn hěn duō qián.
en: This project requires an investment of at least five million yuan; while the risk is substantial, if we happen to succeed, we could make a lot of money.

zh: 我联系你妈妈。
pinyin: Wǒ liánxì nǐ māma.
en: I'll contact your mom.

zh: 明天我要联系医生。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào liánxì yīshēng.
en: Tomorrow I need to get in touch with the doctor.

zh: 因为手机坏了，我没法联系他。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shǒujī huài le, wǒ méi fǎ liánxì tā.
en: Because my phone broke, I couldn't reach him.

zh: 这个问题很复杂，需要联系不同部门才能解决。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí hěn fùzá, xūyào liánxì búntóng bùmén cáinéng jiějué.
en: This issue is complex and requires coordinating with different departments to solve it.

zh: 项目延期了，我们得马上联系所有合作伙伴告知情况。
pinyin: Xiàngmù yánqī le, wǒmen děi mǎshang liánxì suǒyǒu hézuò huǒbàn gàozhī qíngkuàng.
en: The project's been postponed, so we need to contact all our partners right away to inform them of the situation.

zh: 他派人送饭。
pinyin: Tā pài rén sòng fàn.
en: He sent someone to deliver the meal.

zh: 老师派我们去打扫教室。
pinyin: Lǎoshī pài wǒmen qù dǎsǎo jiàoshì.
en: The teacher assigned us to clean the classroom.

zh: 因为明天有活动，所以经理派了很多员工。
pinyin: Yīnwèi míngtiān yǒu huódòng, suǒyǐ jīnglǐ pàile hěnduō yuángōng.
en: Because there's an event tomorrow, the manager sent a lot of staff.

zh: 公司派我去上海出差，虽然只有一周，但工作很紧张。
pinyin: Gōngsī pài wǒ qù Shànghǎi chūchāi, suīrán zhǐyǒu yī zhōu, dàn gōngzuò hěn jǐnzhāng.
en: The company sent me to Shanghai on a business trip; although it's only a week, the work is quite intense.

zh: 这个派系在公司内部势力很大，所以新项目都派给他们负责。
pinyin: Zhège pàixì zài gōngsī nèibù shìlì hěn dà, suǒyǐ xīn xiàngmù dōu pàigěi tāmen fùzé.
en: This faction has considerable influence within the company, so all new projects are assigned to them to oversee.

zh: 门关了。
pinyin: Mén guān le.
en: The door is closed.

zh: 我每天都关心我的家人。
pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān dōu guānxīn wǒ de jiārén.
en: I care about my family every day.

zh: 因为天气不好，所以我关了窗户。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, suǒyǐ wǒ guān le chuānghu.
en: Because the weather was bad, I closed the window.

zh: 这个问题关系到公司的未来发展。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí guānxì dào gōngsī de wèilái fāzhǎn.
en: This issue is connected to the company's future development.

zh: 他对经济政策的看法深刻，这关乎整个国家的前景。
pinyin: Tā duì jīngjì zhèngcè de kànfǎ shēnkè, zhè guānhū zhěngge guójiā de qiánjǐng.
en: His views on economic policy are insightful, and they bear on the entire nation's prospects.

zh: 这是我的证明。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de zhèngmíng.
en: This is my proof.

zh: 你需要带证明来上班。
pinyin: Nǐ xūyào dài zhèngmíng lái shàngbān.
en: You need to bring proof when you come to work.

zh: 因为他有证明，所以医生说他可以工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā yǒu zhèngmíng, suǒyǐ yīshēng shuō tā kěyǐ gōngzuò.
en: Because he has proof, the doctor says he can work.

zh: 学生需要用成绩单来证明自己的学习水平。
pinyin: Xuésheng xūyào yòng chéngjīdān lái zhèngmíng zìjǐ de xuéxí shuǐpíng.
en: Students need to use their transcript to demonstrate their academic level.

zh: 这项研究充分证明了长期锻炼对身体健康的重要作用。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū chōngfèn zhèngmíngle chángqī duànliàn duì shēntǐ jiànkāng de zhònyào zuòyòng.
en: This research fully demonstrates the significant impact of long-term exercise on physical health.

zh: 这句话很简单。
pinyin: Zhè jù huà hěn jiǎndān.
en: This sentence is very simple.

zh: 老师每天教我们一句新单词。
pinyin: Lǎoshī měi tiān jiāo wǒmen yī jù xīn dāncí.
en: The teacher teaches us one new phrase every day.

zh: 因为我听不懂，所以问了老师那句话的意思。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ tīng bu dǒng, suǒyǐ wènle lǎoshī nà jù huà de yìsi.
en: Because I didn't understand, I asked the teacher what that sentence meant.

zh: 他说的那句话让我印象很深，我一直都记得。
pinyin: Tā shuō de nà jù huà ràng wǒ yìnxiàng hěn shēn, wǒ yīzhí dōu jìde.
en: That sentence he said left a deep impression on me; I still remember it clearly.

zh: 与其反复解释那句话，不如直接用例子让他们明白。
pinyin: Yǔqī fǎnfù jiěshì nà jù huà, búrú zhíjiē yòng lìzi ràng tāmen míngbai.
en: Rather than explain that sentence over and over, it's better to just use examples to make it clear.

zh: 我有五个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu wǔ ge píngguǒ.
en: I have five apples.

zh: 今天我五点钟起床。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ wǔ diǎn zhōng qǐchuáng.
en: I woke up at five o'clock today.

zh: 虽然他只有五岁,但是他能读书。
pinyin: Suīrán tā zhǐyǒu wǔ suì, dànshì tā néng dúshū.
en: Although he's only five years old, he can read.

zh: 因为公司离我家五公里远,所以我每天坐地铁。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngsī lí wǒ jiā wǔ gōnglǐ yuǎn, suǒyǐ wǒ měi tiān zuò dìtiě.
en: Since the company is five kilometers from my home, I take the subway every day.

zh: 这个项目需要五个月的时间才能完成,而且预算也超过了最初的计划。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào wǔ ge yuè de shíjiān cái néng wánchéng, érqiě yùsuàn yě chāoguòle zuìchū de jìhuà.
en: This project will take five months to complete, and the budget has also exceeded the original plan.

zh: 生命很重要。
pinyin: Shēngmìng hěn zhòngyào.
en: Life is very important.

zh: 每个人的生命都不一样。
pinyin: Měi ge rén de shēngmìng dōu búyīyàng.
en: Every person's life is different.

zh: 虽然生活很难，但是我们要珍惜生命。
pinyin: Suīrán shēnghuó hěn nán, búshì wǒmen yào zhēnxī shēngmìng.
en: Although life is hard, we should cherish our lives.

zh: 医生说运动能帮助我们延长生命。
pinyin: Yīshēng shuō yùndòng néng bāngzhù wǒmen yánzhǎng shēngmìng.
en: The doctor said that exercise can help extend our lifespan.

zh: 他经历了许多挫折，但这些经历让他对生命有了更深的理解。
pinyin: Tā jīnglìle xǔduō cuòzhé, búshì zhèxiē jīnglì ràng ta duì shēngmìng yǒule gèngshēn de lǐjiě.
en: He went through many setbacks, but these experiences gave him a deeper understanding of life.

zh: 这个苹果有点酸。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ yǒudiǎn suān.
en: This apple is a bit sour.

zh: 今天天气有点冷，我穿了外套。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì yǒudiǎn lěng, wǒ chuānle wàitào.
en: The weather today is a little cold, so I put on a jacket.

zh: 虽然这部电影有点长，但是故事很有趣。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè bù diànyǐng yǒudiǎn cháng, dànshì gùshì hěn yǒuqù.
en: Although this movie is somewhat long, the story is quite interesting.

zh: 他最近工作压力有点大，所以看起来比较疲劳。
pinyin: Tā zuìjìn gōngzuò yālì yǒudiǎn dà, suǒyǐ kàn qǐlai bǐjiào píláo.
en: He's been under quite a bit of work stress lately, so he looks pretty tired.

zh: 这个提议有点理想化，不太考虑到实际情况的复杂性。
pinyin: Zhège tíyì yǒudiǎn lǐxiǎnghuàhuà, búduō kǎolǜ dào shíjì qíngkuàng de fùzáxìng.
en: This proposal is somewhat idealistic and doesn't really account for the complexity of the actual situation.

zh: 我靠爸爸。
pinyin: Wǒ kào bàba.
en: I rely on my dad.

zh: 他每天靠工作赚钱。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān kào gōngzuò zuàn qián.
en: He makes money by working every day.

zh: 因为他靠近窗户，所以能看到外面。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā kào jìn chuānghu, suǒyǐ néng kàndào wàimiàn.
en: Because he's sitting near the window, he can see outside.

zh: 这家公司主要靠销售产品来维持运营。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhǔyào kào xiāoshòu chǎnpǐn lái wéichí yùnyíng.
en: This company mainly sustains its operations through product sales.

zh: 不少年轻人靠自媒体平台积累粉丝，逐渐成为网红。
pinyin: Búshǎo niánqīng rén kào zì méitǐ píng tái jīlěi fěnsī, zhújiàn chéngwéi wǎng hóng.
en: Many young people build a following through social media platforms and gradually become online influencers.

zh: 我们解决了问题。
pinyin: Wǒmen jiějuéle wèntí.
en: We solved the problem.

zh: 昨天我解决了电脑的问题。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ jiějuéle diànnǎo de wèntí.
en: Yesterday I fixed the computer problem.

zh: 虽然很难，但是他最后解决了这个困难。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dànshì tā zuìhòu jiějuéle zhège kùnnan.
en: Although it was difficult, he eventually resolved this challenge.

zh: 因为沟通不足，所以他们花了很长时间才解决了分歧。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōutōng búzú, suǒyǐ tāmen huāle hěn cháng shíjiān cái jiějuéle fēnqī.
en: Because of poor communication, it took them a long time to resolve their disagreement.

zh: 公司通过引进新技术和培训员工，有效地解决了生产效率低下的问题。
pinyin: Gōngsī tōngguò yǐnjìn xīn jìshù hé péixùn yuángōng, yǒuxiàode jiějuéle shēngchǎn xiàolǜ dī xià de wèntí.
en: By introducing new technology and training employees, the company effectively solved the problem of low production efficiency.

zh: 这是办公室。
pinyin: Zhè shì bàngōngshì.
en: This is an office.

zh: 我每天在办公室工作。
pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zài bàngōngshì gōngzuò.
en: I work in the office every day.

zh: 因为今天很冷，所以我在办公室里喝了热茶。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān hěn lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ zài bàngōngshì lǐ hēle rè chá.
en: Because it was cold today, I drank hot tea in the office.

zh: 虽然办公室很小，但是我们的工作效率很高。
pinyin: Suīrán bàngōngshì hěn xiǎo, dànshì wǒmen de gōngzuò xiàolǜ hěn gāo.
en: Although the office is small, our work efficiency is quite high.

zh: 同事们经常在办公室讨论项目，这样可以提高沟通效果。
pinyin: Tóngshìmen jīngcháng zài bàngōngshì tǎolùn xiàngmù, zhèyàng kěyǐ tígāo gōutōng xiàoguǒ.
en: Colleagues often discuss projects in the office, which helps improve communication.

zh: 难道你不喜欢吃饭？
pinyin: Nándào nǐ búxǐhuān chīfàn?
en: You mean you don't like eating?

zh: 难道他今天不来上班吗？
pinyin: Nándào tā jīntiān búlái shàngbān ma?
en: Is he really not coming to work today?

zh: 虽然下雨了，难道你还要去公园吗？
pinyin: Suīránhěn xiàyǔ le, nándào nǐ háiyào qù gōngyuán ma?
en: Even though it's raining, you're still going to the park?

zh: 难道你不觉得这个办法有点奇怪吗？
pinyin: Nándào nǐ bújiàede zhège bànfǎ yǒudiǎn qíguài ma?
en: Don't you think there's something odd about this approach?

zh: 难道你没听说过那个有名的公司倒闭的事？
pinyin: Nándào nǐ méi tīng shuōguo nàge yǒumíng de gōngsī dàobì de shì?
en: You haven't heard about that famous company going under?

zh: 作为学生要好好学习。
pinyin: Zuòwéi xuésheng yào hǎohāo xuéxí.
en: As a student, you should study hard.

zh: 作为老师，他每天都很忙。
pinyin: Zuòwéi lǎoshī, tā měi tiān dōu hěn máng.
en: As a teacher, he's busy every single day.

zh: 虽然作为家长很累，但是我很开心。
pinyin: Suīrán zuòwéi jiāzhǎng hěn lèi, búguò wǒ hěn kāixīn.
en: Even though being a parent is exhausting, I'm really happy about it.

zh: 作为公司的新员工，他需要快速适应工作环境。
pinyin: Zuòwéi gōngsī de xīn yuángōng, tā xūyào kuàisù shìyìng gōngzuò huánjìng.
en: As a new employee at the company, he needs to quickly adapt to the work environment.

zh: 作为一个负责任的公民，我们应该关心社会问题。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī ge fùzéren de gōngmín, wǒmen yīnggāi guānxin shèhuì wèntí.
en: As responsible citizens, we should care about social issues.

zh: 这个味道很奇怪。
pinyin: Zhège wèidào hěn qíguài.
en: This flavor is really strange.

zh: 今天天气很奇怪，又冷又热。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn qíguài, yòu lěng yòu rè.
en: The weather today is weird—it's both cold and hot.

zh: 虽然他的想法很奇怪，但是我们还是决定听他的。
pinyin: Suīrán tā de xiǎngfǎ hěn qíguài, dànshì wǒmen háishi juéding tīng tā de.
en: Even though his idea seems odd, we decided to go along with it anyway.

zh: 他最近的行为变得越来越奇怪，我们都有点担心。
pinyin: Tā zuìjìn de xíngwéi biàn de yuèláiyuè qíguài, wǒmen dōu yǒudiǎn dānxin.
en: His behavior has been getting increasingly odd lately, and we're all a bit concerned.

zh: 这件事看起来有点奇怪，我觉得背后肯定有什么隐情。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì kàn qǐlái yǒudiǎn qíguài, wǒ juéde bèihou kěndìng yǒu shénme yǐnqíng.
en: This whole situation seems suspicious—I'm pretty sure there's something fishy going on behind the scenes.

zh: 我是学生。
pinyin: Wǒ shì xuésheng.
en: I'm a student.

zh: 他每天生活很忙碌。
pinyin: Tā měitiān shēnghuó hěn mánglu。
en: His daily life is very busy.

zh: 因为天气不好，所以今天生意不太好。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, suǒyǐ jīntiān shēngyì bújiǔ háo.
en: Because the weather is bad, business isn't great today.

zh: 虽然他已经生了病，但他还是坚持上班。
pinyin: Suīrán tā yǐjīng shēngle bìng, dànshì tā háishi jiānchí shàngbān.
en: Although he's already fallen ill, he still insists on going to work.

zh: 在这个竞争激烈的时代，生存压力越来越大。
pinyin: Zài zhège jìngjìng jīliè de shídài, shēngcún yālì yuèláiyuè dà.
en: In this highly competitive era, the pressure to survive keeps growing.

zh: 这个礼物由我买的。
pinyin: Zhège lǐwù yóu wǒ mǎi de.
en: I bought this gift.

zh: 明天的会议由李老师主持。
pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì yóu Lǐ lǎoshī zhǔchí.
en: Tomorrow's meeting will be led by Teacher Li.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以运动会由下周举行。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ yùndònghuì yóu xiàzhōu jǔxíng.
en: Because it rained, the sports day has been moved to next week.

zh: 这个项目由三个部门合作完成，进展很顺利。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù yóu sān ge bùmén hézuò wánchéng, jìnzhǎn hěn shùnlì.
en: This project is being completed through collaboration between three departments, and it's progressing smoothly.

zh: 由于市场竞争加剧，公司决定由员工投票选择新的发展策略。
pinyin: Yóuyú shìchǎng jìngjìng jiājù, gōngsī juéding yóu yuángōng tóupiào xuǎnzé xīn de fāzhǎn cèlüè.
en: Due to intensified market competition, the company decided to let employees vote on the new development strategy.

zh: 这是一个男孩。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè nánnǚ háizi.
en: This is a boy.

zh: 我的男朋友叫王明。
pinyin: Wǒ de nánn pénggyou jiào Wáng Míng.
en: My boyfriend is called Wang Ming.

zh: 因为他是男生，所以他喜欢踢足球。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā shì nánnshēng, suǒyǐ tā xǐhuān tī zúqiú.
en: Because he's a boy, he enjoys playing soccer.

zh: 那个男医生虽然很年轻，但是他的医术特别好。
pinyin: Nàge nányīshēng suīrán hěn niánqīng, dànshì tā de yīshù tèbié hǎo.
en: Although that male doctor is quite young, his medical skills are exceptional.

zh: 我们公司的男员工比女员工多，这反映了这个行业的特点。
pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī de nányuángōng bǐ nǚyuángōng duō, zhè fǎnyìngle zhège hángyè de tèdiǎn.
en: Our company has more male employees than female ones, which reflects the characteristics of this industry.

zh: 这个苹果甜极了！
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ tián jí le!
en: This apple is so sweet!

zh: 昨天的天气冷极了，我穿了很多衣服。
pinyin: Zuótiān de tiānqì lěng jí le, wǒ chuān le hěnduō yīfu.
en: Yesterday's weather was incredibly cold, so I wore a lot of clothes.
