zh: 虽然这部电影很长，但是故事有意思极了。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè bù diànyǐng hěn cháng, dànshì gùshì yǒu yìsi jí le.
en: Although this movie is quite long, the story is absolutely fascinating.

zh: 他对这个工作的热情高极了，经常加班到晚上十点。
pinyin: Tā duì zhège gōngzuò de règíng gāo jí le, jīngcháng jiābān dào wǎnshang shí diǎn.
en: He's incredibly enthusiastic about this job and often works overtime until 10 PM.

zh: 那位老师讲课的方式生动极了，学生们听得入迷，下课时还舍不得离开。
pinyin: Nà wèi lǎoshī jiǎngkè de fāngshi shēngdòng jí le, xuéshēngmen tīng de rùmì, xiàkè shí háishi shěbudelíkāi.
en: That teacher's teaching style is absolutely engaging—the students were so absorbed that they didn't even want to leave after class.

zh: 我同意。
pinyin: Wǒ tóngyì.
en: I agree.

zh: 爸爸同意我去公园。
pinyin: Bàba tóngyì wǒ qù gōngyuán.
en: Dad agrees to let me go to the park.

zh: 虽然很贵，但是我同意买这个。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn guì, dànshì wǒ tóngyì mǎi zhège.
en: Even though it's expensive, I'm willing to buy it.

zh: 老板同意了我的假期申请，所以下周我能休息。
pinyin: Lǎobǎn tóngyìle wǒ de jiàqī shēnqǐng, suǒyǐ xiàzhōu wǒ néng xiūxi.
en: My boss approved my time-off request, so I can take next week off.

zh: 尽管有些困难，公司还是同意了我们的新项目计划。
pinyin: Jìnguǎn yǒuxiē kùnnan, gōngsī háishi tóngyìle wǒmen de xīn xiàngmù jìhuà.
en: Despite some challenges, the company still approved our new project plan.

zh: 苹果如红球。
pinyin: píngguǒ rú hóng qiú.
en: An apple is like a red ball.

zh: 她的声音如鸟唱歌一样好听。
pinyin: Tā de shēngyīn rú niǎo chànggē yīyàng hǎotīng.
en: Her voice is as pleasant as a bird singing.

zh: 虽然他很累，但工作如常进行。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn lèi, dàn gōngzuò rúcháng jìnxíng.
en: Although he was tired, work went on as usual.

zh: 如果你想成功，就需要像他一样坚持努力。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng chénggōng, jiù xūyào xiàng tā yīyàng jiānchí nǔlì.
en: If you want to succeed, you need to persevere just like he does.

zh: 他对待员工如对待家人，因此团队的忠诚度特别高。
pinyin: Tā duìdài yuángōng rú duìdài jiārén, yīncǐ tuánduì de zhōngchéng dù tèbié gāo.
en: He treats his employees like family, so the team's loyalty is exceptionally strong.

zh: 我喜欢玩游戏。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān wán yóuxì.
en: I like to play games.

zh: 他每天都玩电脑游戏。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu wán diànnǎo yóuxì.
en: He plays computer games every day.

zh: 因为游戏很有趣，所以我经常玩。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yóuxì hěn yǒuqù, suǒyǐ wǒ jīngcháng wán.
en: Because games are fun, I play them often.

zh: 虽然这个游戏很难，但我还是想试试。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège yóuxì hěn nán, dàn wǒ háishi xiǎng shìshi.
en: Even though this game is hard, I still want to try it.

zh: 不少年轻人沉迷于手机游戏，忽略了现实生活。
pinyin: Búshǎo niánqīngrén chénmí yú shǒujī yóuxì, hūlüèle xiànshí shēnghuó.
en: Many young people get addicted to mobile games and neglect their real lives.

zh: 妈妈帮忙做饭。
pinyin: Māma bāngmang zuò fàn.
en: Mom helps cook dinner.

zh: 明天你能帮忙搬东西吗？
pinyin: Míngtiān nǐ néng bāngmang bān dōngxi ma?
en: Can you help me move things tomorrow?

zh: 因为我很忙，所以请你帮忙照顾小孩。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ hěn máng, suǒyǐ qǐng nǐ bāngmang zhàogù xiǎohái.
en: Because I'm really busy, I'm asking you to help look after the kids.

zh: 虽然他没有经验，但是他很愿意帮忙处理这个问题。
pinyin: Suīrán tā méiyǒu jīngyàn, dànshì tā hěn yuànyì bāngmang chǔlǐ zhège wèntí.
en: Even though he has no experience, he's very willing to help tackle this issue.

zh: 在这个项目遇到困难时，同事们主动帮忙，这让我们能够按时完成任务。
pinyin: Zài zhège xiàngmù yùdào kùnnan shí, tóngshìmen zhǔdòng bāngmang, zhè ràng wǒmen nénggoù ànshí wánchéng rènwù.
en: When we ran into trouble on this project, my colleagues stepped in to help, which allowed us to finish on schedule.

zh: 他用手指指向门。
pinyin: Tā yòng shǒuzhǐ zhǐ xiàng mén.
en: He pointed his finger at the door.

zh: 老师用笔指着黑板上的字。
pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng bǐ zhǐzhe hēibǎn shang de zì.
en: The teacher pointed at the characters on the blackboard with a pen.

zh: 虽然她没有说话，但是用眼睛指了指那个方向。
pinyin: Suīrán tā méiyǒu shuōhuà, dànshì yòng yǎnjing zhǐle zhǐ nàge fāngxiàng.
en: Although she didn't speak, she pointed in that direction with her eyes.

zh: 他指着合同上的条款，解释了其中的重要内容。
pinyin: Tā zhǐzhe hétonɡ shang de tiáokuǎn, jiěshìle qīzhōng de zhòngyào nèiróng.
en: He pointed to the clauses in the contract and explained the important details.

zh: 医生指出这种治疗方法虽然见效快，但长期使用可能会带来副作用。
pinyin: Yīshēng zhǐchū zhè zhǒng zhìliáo fāngfǎ suīrán jiàn xiào kuài, dàn chángqī shǐyòng kěnéng huì dàilái fùzuòyòng.
en: The doctor pointed out that although this treatment method works quickly, prolonged use may cause side effects.

zh: 火很危险。
pinyin: Huǒ hěn wēixiǎn.
en: Fire is very dangerous.

zh: 晚上一个人走路很危险。
pinyin: Wǎnshang yī gè rén zǒulù hěn wēixiǎn.
en: It's dangerous to walk alone at night.

zh: 虽然这个工作工资高，但是很危险。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège gōngzuò gōngzī gāo, dànshì hěn wēixiǎn.
en: Although this job pays well, it's quite dangerous.

zh: 开车的时候玩手机很危险，容易出事故。
pinyin: Kāichē de shíhou wán shǒujī hěn wēixiǎn, róngyì chūshì gù.
en: Playing on your phone while driving is dangerous and can easily cause accidents.

zh: 那家工厂的安全措施不完善，工作环境相当危险。
pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng de ānquán cuòshī bù wánsh善, gōngzuò huánjìng xiāngdāng wēixiǎn.
en: That factory's safety measures are inadequate, making the work environment quite hazardous.

zh: 我讨厌吃胡萝卜。
pinyin: Wǒ tǎoyàn chī húluóbo.
en: I hate eating carrots.

zh: 他很讨厌下雨天去上班。
pinyin: Tā hěn tǎoyàn xiàyǔ tiān qù shàngbān.
en: He really dislikes going to work on rainy days.

zh: 虽然这部电影很有名,但我还是讨厌它。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒumíng, dànshì wǒ háishi tǎoyàn tā.
en: Even though this movie is famous, I still can't stand it.

zh: 因为他总是迟到,所以同事们都讨厌和他一起工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā zǒngshi chídào, suǒyǐ tóngshìmen dōu tǎoyàn hé tā yìqǐ gōngzuò.
en: Because he's always late, his colleagues hate working with him.

zh: 很多人讨厌那些假惺惺的人,因为他们显得特别虚伪。
pinyin: Hěnduō rén tǎoyàn nàxiē jiǎ xīngxīng de rén, yīnwèi tāmen xiǎnde tèbié xūwěi.
en: A lot of people can't stand phony people because they come across as particularly fake.

zh: 我曾经喜欢吃糖。
pinyin: Wǒ céngjīng xǐhuān chī táng.
en: I used to like eating candy.

zh: 她曾经在北京工作过两年。
pinyin: Tā céngjīng zài Běijīng gōngzuò guò liǎng nián.
en: She once worked in Beijing for two years.

zh: 虽然他曾经很害怕,但是现在他很勇敢。
pinyin: Suīrán tā céngjīng hěn hàipà, dànshì xiànzài tā hěn yǒngqì.
en: Although he used to be very scared, he's brave now.

zh: 我们曾经是好朋友,后来因为一些事情疏远了。
pinyin: Wǒmen céngjīng shì hǎo péngyou, hòuláibecause yīnwèi yīxiē shìqing shūyuǎn le.
en: We used to be close friends, but we drifted apart over some issues later.

zh: 他曾经梦想成为医生,可惜后来放弃了那个理想。
pinyin: Tā céngjīng mèngxiǎng chéngwéi yīshēng, kěxī hòuláibecause fàngqì le nàge lǐxiǎng.
en: He once dreamed of becoming a doctor, but sadly he gave up on that dream eventually.

zh: 我的眼睛很大。
pinyin: Wǒ de yǎnjing hěn dà.
en: My eyes are big.

zh: 早上我睁开眼睛，看到妈妈。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ zhēngkāi yǎnjing, kàndào māma.
en: In the morning I opened my eyes and saw Mom.

zh: 因为太累了，所以他的眼睛有点红。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tài lèi le, suǒyǐ tā de yǎnjing yǒudiǎn hóng.
en: Because he was so tired, his eyes were a bit red.

zh: 她盯着电脑屏幕很久，眼睛开始感到疲劳。
pinyin: Tā dīngzhe diànnǎo píngmù hěnjiǔ, yǎnjing kāishǐ gǎndào píláo.
en: After staring at the computer screen for so long, she started to feel eye strain.

zh: 这部电影的结局让很多观众眼睛都湿润了。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de jiéjú ràng hěnduō guānzhòng yǎnjing dōu shīrùn le.
en: The ending of this film made many viewers' eyes well up with tears.

zh: 外面很冷。
pinyin: Wàimiàn hěn lěng.
en: It's very cold outside.

zh: 今天外面下雨，我不想出去。
pinyin: Jīntiān wàimiàn xiàyǔ, wǒ búxiǎng chūqù.
en: It's raining outside today, so I don't want to go out.

zh: 虽然外面天气不好，但是我们还是决定去公园。
pinyin: Suīrán wàimiàn tiānqì búhǎo, búshì wǒmen háishi juéding qù gōngyuán.
en: Although the weather outside isn't nice, we still decided to go to the park.

zh: 外面停着很多车，说明这家饭店很受欢迎。
pinyin: Wàimiàn tíngzhe hěnduō chē, shuōmíng zhè jiā fàndiàn hěn shòu huānyíng.
en: There are lots of cars parked outside, which shows this restaurant is really popular.

zh: 别看外面风风火火的样子，其实他心里对这个项目没什么信心。
pinyin: Bié kàn wàimiàn fēngfēng huǒhuǒ de yàngzi, qīshí tā xīnli duì zhège xiàngmù méi shénme xìnxin.
en: Don't be fooled by how fired up he seems on the surface—actually, he's not confident about this project at all.

zh: 我在这处工作。
pinyin: Wǒ zài zhè chù gōngzuò.
en: I work at this place.

zh: 每天我都在办公处见到他。
pinyin: Měi tiān wǒ dōu zài bàngōng chù jiàndào tā.
en: I see him at the office every day.

zh: 虽然这处很远，但是我因为工作必须去。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè chù hěn yuǎn, dànshì wǒ yīnwèi gōngzuò bìxū qù.
en: Although this place is far away, I have to go because of work.

zh: 在处理这个问题的时候，我们需要考虑各个方面。
pinyin: Zài chǔlǐ zhège wèntí de shíhou, wǒmen xūyào kǎolǜ gège fāngmiàn.
en: When dealing with this issue, we need to consider all aspects.

zh: 无论在什么处境下，她都能冷静地处理突发情况。
pinyin: Wúlùn zài shénme chǔjìng xià, tā dōu néng lěngjìng de chǔlǐ túfā qíngkuàng.
en: No matter what situation she's in, she can always handle emergencies calmly.

zh: 我爱我的国家。
pinyin: Wǒ ài wǒ de guójiā.
en: I love my country.

zh: 每个国家都有自己的文化。
pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu zìjǐ de wénhuà.
en: Every country has its own culture.

zh: 虽然国家很大，但是人民很团结。
pinyin: Suīrán guójiā hěn dà, dànshì rénmín hěn tuánjié.
en: Although the country is large, the people are very united.

zh: 因为经济发展快，所以这个国家吸引了很多外国投资。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīngjì fāzhǎn kuài, suǒyǐ zhège guójiā xīyǐnle hěn duō wàiguó tóuzī.
en: Because the economy is developing rapidly, this country has attracted a lot of foreign investment.

zh: 随着教育水平的提高，越来越多的年轻人愿意为国家的未来贡献力量。
pinyin: Suízhe jiàoyù shuǐpíng de tígāo, yuèláiyuè duō de niánqīng rén yuànyì wèi guójiā de wèilái gòngxiàn lìliàng.
en: As education standards improve, more and more young people are willing to contribute to their country's future.

zh: 这个苹果看上去很红。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ kàn shàngyqu hěn hóng.
en: This apple looks very red.

zh: 她今天看上去很开心。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān kàn shàngyqu hěn kāixīn.
en: She looks very happy today.

zh: 虽然他很累，但是看上去还是很精神。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn lèi, dànshì kàn shàngyqu háishi hěn jīngshén.
en: Although he's tired, he still looks energetic.

zh: 这件衣服看上去不太适合你，换一件试试。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu kàn shàngyqu bújiǔ shìhé nǐ, huàn yī jiàn shìshi.
en: This outfit doesn't seem to suit you very well—try a different one.

zh: 他虽然学历不高，但看上去做事很有条理，能力也不错。
pinyin: Tā suīrán xuéhuà búgāo, dàn kàn shàngyqu zuòshì hěn yǒu tiáolǐ, nénghuà yě búcuò.
en: Despite not having much formal education, he seems very organized in his work and his abilities are quite solid.

zh: 总统是国家的领导人。
pinyin: Zǒngtǒng shì guójiā de lǐngdǎo rén.
en: The president is the leader of the country.

zh: 昨天总统在电视上讲话了。
pinyin: Zuótiān zǒngtǒng zài diànshì shang jiǎnghuà le.
en: The president gave a speech on TV yesterday.

zh: 因为总统的决定很重要，所以很多人关注这件事。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zǒngtǒng de juédinè hěn zhòngyào, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén guānzhù zhè jiàn shì.
en: Because the president's decision is so important, many people are paying attention to this matter.

zh: 新当选的总统承诺要改善教育和医疗系统。
pinyin: Xīn dāngxuǎn de zǒngtǒng chéngnuò yào gǎishàn jiàoyù hé yīliáo xìtǒng.
en: The newly elected president promised to improve the education and healthcare systems.

zh: 尽管总统面临经济困难，但他仍然坚持推行改革政策。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zǒngtǒng miànlín jīngjì kùnnan, dàn tā réngránjiǔ jiānchí tuīxíng gǎigé zhèngcè.
en: Despite facing economic hardship, the president remains committed to implementing reform policies.

zh: 我们之间是朋友。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhījiān shì péngyou.
en: We are friends with each other.

zh: 他们两个人之间有问题。
pinyin: Tāmen liǎng ge rén zhījiān yǒu wèntí.
en: There's a problem between the two of them.

zh: 虽然房间很小，但是我很喜欢。
pinyin: Suīrán fángjiān hěn xiǎo, búguò wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
en: Although the room is small, I really like it.

zh: 在这个时间段里，公司之间的竞争变得越来越激烈。
pinyin: Zài zhège shíjiān duàn lǐ, gōngsī zhījiān de jìngjìng biàn de yuèláiyuè jīliè.
en: During this period, competition between companies has become increasingly fierce.

zh: 两国之间的贸易协议经过多次协商才最终达成。
pinyin: Liǎng guó zhījiān de màoyì xiéyì jīngguò duō cì xiéshāng cái zuìzhōng dáchéng.
en: The trade agreement between the two countries was only finalized after several rounds of negotiation.

zh: 不要伤害小狗。
pinyin: Búyào shānghài xiǎo gǒu.
en: Don't hurt the puppy.

zh: 打人会伤害别人的身体。
pinyin: Dǎ rén huì shānghài biérén de shēntǐ.
en: Hitting someone can injure their body.

zh: 虽然他很生气，但他没有伤害任何人。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn shēngqì, dàn tā méiyǒu shānghài rènhé rén.
en: Even though he was very angry, he didn't hurt anyone.

zh: 长期压力会伤害你的心理健康和工作效率。
pinyin: Chángqī yālì huì shānghài nǐ de xīnlǐ jiànkāng hé gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
en: Long-term stress can damage both your mental health and work performance.

zh: 有些父母不知道严厉批评会伤害孩子的自信心和亲子关系。
pinyin: Yǒuxiē fùmǔ búzhīdào yánlì píphēng huì shānghài háizi de zìxìnxīn hé qīnzǐ guānxi.
en: Some parents don't realize that harsh criticism can undermine a child's confidence and damage the parent-child relationship.

zh: 我控制了狗。
pinyin: Wǒ kòngzhì le gǒu.
en: I controlled the dog.

zh: 他用手控制了这个车。
pinyin: Tā yòng shǒu kòngzhì le zhège chē.
en: He controlled the car with his hands.

zh: 虽然天气很热，但他控制了自己的情绪。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn rè, dàn tā kòngzhì le zìjǐ de qíngxù.
en: Although it was very hot, he managed to control his emotions.

zh: 公司为了降低成本，严格控制了员工的开支。
pinyin: Gōngsī wèile jiàngdī chéngběn, yángé kòngzhì le yuángōng de kāishī.
en: To cut costs, the company strictly controlled employee expenses.

zh: 政府采取措施控制房价上涨，但效果并不理想。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔ cuòshī kòngzhì fángjià shànngzhǎng, dàn xiàoguǒ bìngbù lǐxiǎng.
en: The government took measures to control rising house prices, but the results weren't satisfactory.

zh: 最近我吃了很多苹果。
pinyin: Zuìjìn wǒ chīle hěnduō píngguǒ.
en: I've been eating a lot of apples lately.

zh: 最近天气很冷，我每天穿厚衣服。
pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì hěn lěng, wǒ měitiān chuān hòu yīfu.
en: The weather has been really cold recently, so I wear thick clothes every day.

zh: 最近工作很忙，因为有很多项目，所以我很累。
pinyin: Zuìjìn gōngzuò hěn máng, yīnwèi yǒu hěnduō xiàngmù, suǒyǐ wǒ hěn lèi.
en: Work has been hectic lately because there are many projects, so I'm exhausted.

zh: 最近看到的电影虽然评价不错，但我觉得故事有点无聊。
pinyin: Zuìjìn kàndào de diànyǐng suīrán píngjiǎ búcuò, dàn wǒ juéde gùshì yǒudiǎn wúliáo.
en: The movie I watched recently got good reviews, but I found the plot a bit boring.

zh: 最近听说他们公司的经营状况不太理想，员工们也开始担心自己的前景。
pinyin: Zuìjìn tīngshuō tāmen gōngsī de jīngyíng zhuàngkuàng búduō lǐxiǎng, yuángōngmen yě kāishǐ dānxin zìjǐ de qiánjǐng.
en: I've heard recently that their company's business situation isn't looking great, and employees have started worrying about their own prospects.

zh: 妈妈的声音很好听。
pinyin: Māma de shēngyīn hěn hǎotīng.
en: Mom's voice is really nice.

zh: 早上我听到鸟的声音。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ tīngdào niǎo de shēngyīn.
en: This morning I heard the sound of birds.

zh: 虽然电视的声音很大，但我还是听不清。
pinyin: Suīrán diànshì de shēngyīn hěn dà, dàn wǒ háishi tīngbù qīng.
en: Although the TV volume was loud, I still couldn't hear it clearly.

zh: 他说话的声音太小了，我们坐在后面根本听不见。
pinyin: Tā shuōhuà de shēngyīn tài xiǎo le, wǒmen zuòzài hòumiàn gēnběn tīngbù jiàn.
en: His voice when speaking is too quiet—we sitting in the back literally can't hear him.

zh: 她的声音不大，但很有感染力，能让所有人都专注听她讲话。
pinyin: Tā de shēngyīn búdà, dàn hěn yǒu gǎnrǎnlì, néng ràng suǒyǒurén dōu zhuānzhù tīng tā jiǎnghuà.
en: Her voice isn't loud, but it's really engaging—it can make everyone focus on listening to her speak.

zh: 这个苹果糟了。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ zāo le.
en: This apple has gone bad.

zh: 昨天的天气很糟,我没有出门。
pinyin: Zuótiān de tiānqì hěn zāo, wǒ méiyǒu chūmén.
en: The weather was awful yesterday, so I didn't go out.

zh: 因为计划出了问题,所以今天的会议很糟糕。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jìhuà chū le wèntí, suǒyǐ jīntiān de huìyì hěn zāogāo.
en: Because the plan went wrong, today's meeting was really bad.

zh: 虽然他的表现不错,但整个项目的结果还是很糟。
pinyin: Suīrán tā de biǎoxiàn búcuò, dàn zhěnggè xiàngmù de jiéguǒ háishi hěn zāo.
en: Although his performance was decent, the overall project result was still pretty bad.

zh: 那次会议的气氛糟透了,与其说是讨论不如说是吵架。
pinyin: Nà cì huìyì de qìfēn zāo tòu le, yǔqīshuō shì tǎolùn búrúshuō shì chǎojià.
en: The atmosphere at that meeting was absolutely terrible—it was more of an argument than a discussion.

zh: 我很快乐。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn kuàilè.
en: I'm very happy.

zh: 今天我和家人一起玩，很快乐。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ hé jiārén yìqǐ wán, hěn kuàilè.
en: Today I played with my family and had a great time.

zh: 虽然考试很难，但是我通过了，所以感到快乐。
pinyin: Suīrán kǎoshì hěn nán, dànshì wǒ tōngguòle, suǒyǐ gǎndào kuàilè.
en: Although the exam was difficult, I passed it, so I felt happy.

zh: 和朋友聊天的时候，我们都感到特别快乐和放松。
pinyin: Hé péngyou liáotiān de shíhou, wǒmen dōu gǎndào tèbié kuàilè hé fàngsōng.
en: When chatting with friends, we both felt especially happy and relaxed.

zh: 工作再忙，只要家人健康快乐，我就觉得一切都值得。
pinyin: Gōngzuò zài máng, zhǐyào jiārén jiànkāng kuàilè, wǒ jiù juéde yìqiè dōu zhídé.
en: No matter how busy work gets, as long as my family is healthy and happy, I feel it's all worth it.

zh: 他偷吃了我的糖。
pinyin: Tā tōu chīle wǒ de táng.
en: He ate my candy without asking.

zh: 昨天我妹妹偷偷拿走了我的手机。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ mèimei tōutōu názǒule wǒ de shǒujī.
en: Yesterday my sister sneakily took my phone.

zh: 虽然他很穷，但他从不偷东西，因为他有自尊心。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn qióng, dàn tā cóngbù tōu dōngxi, yīnwèi tā yǒu zìzūnxin.
en: Although he's poor, he never steals because he has self-respect.

zh: 那个小偷偷了很多手机，后来被警察逮捕了。
pinyin: Nàge xiǎo tōu tōule hěn duō shǒujī, hòulái bèi jǐngchá dàibǔle.
en: That thief stole many phones and was arrested by the police later.

zh: 她承认自己年轻时曾经偷过超市的东西，但现在已经改邪归正了。
pinyin: Tā chéngrèn zìjǐ niánqīng shí céngjīng tōuguò chāoshì de dōngxi, dàn xiànzài yǐjīng gǎixié guīzhèng le.
en: She admits she used to shoplift when she was younger, but she's turned her life around now.

zh: 这是我首次来这里。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ shǒu cì lái zhèlǐ.
en: This is my first time coming here.

zh: 昨天我首先去了超市买菜。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ shǒuxiān qùle chāoshì mǎi cài.
en: Yesterday I went to the supermarket first to buy groceries.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但他首先想到的还是家人。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn tā shǒuxiān xiǎngdào de háishi jiārén.
en: Even though he's very busy, family is still the first thing he thinks about.

zh: 公司在首都开设了新办公室，这是扩展业务的第一步。
pinyin: Gōngsī zài shǒudū kāishèle xīn bàngōngshì, zhè shì kuòzhǎn yèwù de dì yī bù.
en: The company opened a new office in the capital, which is the first step in expanding the business.

zh: 这份报告首次系统地分析了消费者行为的变化趋势。
pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào shǒu cì xìtǒng地fēnxī le xiāofèizhě xíngwéi de biànhuà qūshì.
en: This report is the first to systematically analyze the changing trends in consumer behavior.

zh: 这只猫很可爱。
pinyin: Zhè zhī māo hěn kěài.
en: This cat is very cute.

zh: 小女孩穿着可爱的红色衣服。
pinyin: Xiǎo nǚhái chuānzhe kěài de hóngsè yīfu.
en: The little girl is wearing an adorable red dress.

zh: 虽然他很调皮，但是他也很可爱。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn tiáopí, dànshì tā yě hěn kěài.
en: Although he's mischievous, he's also very lovable.

zh: 我朋友的新宠物狗因为聪明又可爱，所以很受欢迎。
pinyin: Wǒ péngyou de xīn chǒngwù gǒu yīnwèi聪明 yòu kěài, suǒyǐ hěn shòu huānyíng.
en: My friend's new pet dog is quite popular because it's smart and adorable.

zh: 这个品牌的包包设计得很可爱，难怪女生都喜欢买。
pinyin: Zhège pǐnpái de bāobao shèjì de hěn kěài, nánguài nǚshēng dōu xǐhuān mǎi.
en: This brand's bags are designed so cutely that it's no wonder all the girls want to buy them.

zh: 我进入房间。
pinyin: Wǒ jìnrù fángjiān.
en: I enter the room.

zh: 孩子们进入学校的时候很高兴。
pinyin: Háizi men jìnrù xuéxiào de shíhou hěn gāoxìng.
en: The children are very happy when they enter school.

zh: 虽然天气很冷，但是我们还是进入了森林。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, dànshì wǒmen háishi jìnrù le sēnlín.
en: Although the weather was cold, we still went into the forest.

zh: 她因为工作的机会进入了一个大公司。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi gōngzuò de jīhuì jìnrù le yī ge dà gōngsī.
en: She joined a large company because of a job opportunity.

zh: 随着互联网技术的发展，越来越多的年轻人进入了科技行业。
pinyin: Suízhe hùliánwǎng jìshù de fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuè duō de niánqīngrén jìnrù le kējì hángyè.
en: As internet technology has developed, more and more young people have entered the tech industry.

zh: 我能够吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ néng gòu chī mǐfàn.
en: I can eat rice.

zh: 他今天能够来上课吗？
pinyin: Tā jīntiān néng gòu lái shàngkè ma?
en: Can he come to class today?

zh: 因为她很努力，所以能够考上好大学。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn nǔlì, suǒyǐ néng gòu kǎoshang hǎo dàxué.
en: Because she worked hard, she was able to get into a good university.

zh: 虽然条件不太好，但我们仍然能够完成这个项目。
pinyin: Suīrán tiáojiàn búzhào hǎo, dàn wǒmen réngránéng gòu wánchéng zhège xiàngmù.
en: Although conditions aren't ideal, we're still able to complete this project.

zh: 只要有决心，任何人都能够克服困难实现自己的梦想。
pinyin: Zhǐyào yǒu juéxīn, rènhé rén dōu néng gòu kèfú kùnnan shíxiàn zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
en: As long as you have determination, anyone can overcome difficulties and achieve their dreams.

zh: 事实上，我喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Shìshí shang, wǒ xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: Actually, I like eating rice.

zh: 事实上，他昨天没有来上课。
pinyin: Shìshí shang, tā zuótiān méiyǒu lái shàngkè.
en: In fact, he didn't come to class yesterday.

zh: 虽然看起来很难，但事实上这个问题很简单。
pinyin: Suīrán kàn qǐlai hěn nán, dàn shìshí shang zhège wèntí hěn jiǎndān.
en: Although it looks difficult, this problem is actually quite simple.

zh: 事实上，很多人认为学习中文很困难，其实不然。
pinyin: Shìshí shang, hěn duō rén rènwéi xuéxí zhōngwén hěn kùnnan, qīshí búrán.
en: In reality, many people think learning Chinese is very difficult, but that's not actually the case.

zh: 事实上，这项政策虽然初衷不错，但实施过程中存在很多问题。
pinyin: Shìshí shang, zhè xiàng zhèngcè suīrán chūzhōng búcuò, dàn shíshī guòchéng zhōng cúnzài hěn duō wèntí.
en: In fact, while this policy had good intentions, there have been quite a few issues in how it's been implemented.

zh: 哈哈，我很开心。
pinyin: Hāhā, wǒ hěn kāixīn.
en: Haha, I'm really happy.

zh: 昨天看电影时，我们都哈哈大笑。
pinyin: Zuótiān kàn diànyǐng shí, wǒmen dōu hāhā dàxiào.
en: When we watched a movie yesterday, we all laughed really hard.

zh: 虽然这个笑话很旧，但是他讲得很好笑，大家都哈哈笑了。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège xiàohuà hěn jiù, dànshì tā jiǎng de hěn hǎoxiào, dàjiā dōu hāhā xiàole.
en: Although the joke was old, he told it so well that everyone burst out laughing.

zh: 他听到这个消息后，哈哈一笑，就同意了我们的计划。
pinyin: Tā tīngdào zhège xiāoxī hòu, hāhā yī xiào, jiù tóngyìle wǒmen de jìhuà.
en: After hearing the news, he laughed it off and immediately agreed to our plan.

zh: 经理在会议上哈哈一笑，用这种轻松的态度化解了部门之间的紧张气氛。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ zài huìyì shàng hāhā yī xiào, yòng zhè zhǒng qīngsōng de tàidù huàjiě le bùmén zhījiān de jǐnzhāng qìfēn.
en: The manager laughed it off in the meeting, and his relaxed attitude eased the tension between departments.

zh: 我醒了。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐng le.
en: I woke up.

zh: 早上七点我醒了。
pinyin: Zǎoshang qī diǎn wǒ xǐng le.
en: I woke up at seven in the morning.

zh: 虽然很累，但是我还是醒了。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ háishi xǐng le.
en: Even though I was exhausted, I still managed to wake up.

zh: 他喝了咖啡以后很快就醒了。
pinyin: Tā hēle kāfēi yǐhòu hěn kuài jiù xǐng le.
en: After drinking coffee, he woke up pretty quickly.

zh: 那个噩梦把我吓醒了，之后就再也睡不着。
pinyin: Nàge èmèng bǎ wǒ xiàxǐng le, zhīhòu jiù zàiyě shuì bu zhào.
en: That nightmare scared me awake, and after that I couldn't fall back asleep.

zh: 这是我的一分钱。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de yī fēn qián.
en: This is my one cent.

zh: 妈妈把蛋糕分成两份。
pinyin: Māma bǎ dàngāo fēnchéng liǎng fèn.
en: Mom divided the cake into two pieces.

zh: 因为时间不多，我们把工作分给了三个人。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shíjiān búduō, wǒmen bǎ gōngzuò fēngěi le sān ge rén.
en: Because time was limited, we assigned the work to three people.

zh: 虽然她只分配了我一小部分任务，但我还是用心完成了。
pinyin: Suīrán tā zhǐ fēnpèi le wǒ yī xiǎo búfen rènwu, dàn wǒ háishi yòngxīn wánchéng le.
en: Even though she only assigned me a small portion of the task, I still completed it carefully.

zh: 在团队中，每个人都要明确自己的职责分工，这样才能事半功倍。
pinyin: Zài tuánduì zhōng, měi ge rén dōu yào míngquè zìjǐ de zhízé fēngōng, zhèyàng cái néng shìbàn gōngbèi.
en: In a team, everyone needs to clearly understand their role and responsibilities; that way you achieve better results with less effort.

zh: 我完成了作业。
pinyin: Wǒ wánchéng le zuòyè.
en: I finished my homework.

zh: 他昨天完成了这个项目。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān wánchéng le zhège xiàngmù.
en: He completed this project yesterday.

zh: 虽然很难，但是我还是完成了这个任务。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dànshì wǒ háishi wánchéng le zhège rènwu.
en: Even though it was difficult, I still managed to finish the task.

zh: 为了在截止日期前完成报告，她加班了两个晚上。
pinyin: Wèile zài jiēzhǐ rìqī qián wánchéng bàogào, tā jiābān le liǎng ge wǎnshang.
en: To complete the report before the deadline, she worked late two nights in a row.

zh: 这个建筑项目由于资金充足，比预计时间提前完成了。
pinyin: Zhège jiànzhù xiàngmù yóuyú zījīn chōngzú, bǐ yùjì shíjiān tíqiān wánchéng le.
en: Thanks to sufficient funding, the construction project was completed ahead of schedule.

zh: 这是一部电影。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī bù diànyǐng.
en: This is a movie.

zh: 我昨天看了一部很有趣的电视剧。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān kànle yī bù hěn yǒuqù de diànshìjù.
en: I watched a really interesting TV series yesterday.

zh: 虽然这部小说很长，但是故事特别吸引人。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè bù xiǎoshuō hěn cháng, dànshì gùshì tèbié xīyǐnrén.
en: Although this novel is quite long, the story is really captivating.

zh: 公司最近成立了一个新部门来处理客户投诉。
pinyin: Gōngsī zuìjìn chénglìle yīgè xīn bùmén lái chǔlǐ kèhù tóusu.
en: The company recently set up a new department to handle customer complaints.

zh: 这部作品虽然获得了国际奖项，但在国内的认可度仍然有限。
pinyin: Zhè bù zuòpǐn suīrán huòdéle guójì jiǎngxiàng, dàn zài guónèi de rènkě dù réngrán yǒuxiàn.
en: While this work won international awards, its recognition at home remains somewhat limited.

zh: 昨晚我吃了米饭。
pinyin: Zuó晚 wǒ chīle mǐfàn.
en: Last night I ate rice.

zh: 昨晚我和朋友看了电影。
pinyin: Zuó晚 wǒ hé péngyou kànle diànyǐng.
en: Last night my friend and I watched a movie.

zh: 昨晚下雨的时候，我在家里看书。
pinyin: Zuó晚 xiàyǔ de shíhou, wǒ zài jiālǐ kànshū.
en: While it was raining last night, I was reading at home.

zh: 昨晚虽然很累，但是我还是完成了工作。
pinyin: Zuó晚 suīrán hěn lèi, dànshi wǒ háishi wánchéngle gōngzuò.
en: Even though I was exhausted last night, I still managed to finish my work.

zh: 昨晚的会议讨论了公司明年的发展计划。
pinyin: Zuó晚 de huìyì tǎolùnle gōngsī míngnián de fāzhǎn jìhuà.
en: Last night's meeting discussed the company's development plan for next year.

zh: 我和他同学。
pinyin: Wǒ hé tā tóng xué.
en: He and I are classmates.

zh: 我们在同一个学校读书。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài tóng yī ge xuéxiào dúshū.
en: We study at the same school.

zh: 虽然我们来自不同的城市，但是想法同样很相似。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen láizì búdòng de chéngshì, dànshì xiǎngfǎ tóngyàng hěn xiāngisì.
en: Although we're from different cities, our ideas are surprisingly similar.

zh: 这个新项目需要与其他部门同时进行，以便节省时间。
pinyin: Zhège xīn xiàngmù xūyào yǔ qítā bùmén tóngshí jìnxíng, yǐbiàn jiéshěng shíjiān.
en: This new project needs to run simultaneously with other departments to save time.

zh: 领导希望员工们同心协力，共同推进公司的战略目标。
pinyin: Lǐngdǎo xīwàng yuángōngmen tóng xīn xié lì, gòngtóng tuījìn gōngsī de zhànlüè mùbiāo.
en: The leadership wants employees to work with one mind and one effort to advance the company's strategic goals together.

zh: 我去医院了。
pinyin: Wǒ qù yīyuàn le.
en: I went to the hospital.

zh: 昨天我在医院看医生。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài yīyuàn kàn yīshēng.
en: Yesterday I saw a doctor at the hospital.

zh: 因为他生病了，所以他去医院检查。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā shēngbìng le, suǒyǐ tā qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá.
en: Because he got sick, he went to the hospital for a check-up.

zh: 虽然医院离我家很远，但是医生很专业。
pinyin: Suīrán yīyuàn lí wǒ jiā hěn yuǎn, dànshì yīshēng hěn zhuānyè.
en: Although the hospital is far from my home, the doctors are very professional.

zh: 上次住院的时候，医院的护士照顾得无微不至。
pinyin: Shàng cì zhùyuàn de shíhou, yīyuàn de húshi zhàogu de wúwēibùzhì.
en: When I was hospitalized last time, the hospital nurses took care of me attentively.

zh: 我不行，你来。
pinyin: Wǒ búxíng, nǐ lái.
en: I can't do it. You try.

zh: 这个办法不行，我们换一个。
pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ búxíng, wǒmen huàn yī ge.
en: This approach won't work. Let's try a different one.

zh: 虽然他很努力，但是这样做还是不行。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn nǔlì, dànshì zhèyàng zuò háishi búxíng.
en: Even though he tried hard, this way of doing it still won't work.

zh: 如果没有足够的时间，这个计划肯定不行。
pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu zúgòu de shíjiān, zhège jìhuà kěndìng búxíng.
en: Without enough time, this plan definitely won't happen.

zh: 光靠理论知识是不行的，还需要实际操作经验。
pinyin: Guāng kào lǐlùn zhīshi shì búxíng de, háishi xūyào shíjì cāozuò jīngyàn.
en: Theory alone just isn't enough—you also need hands-on experience.

zh: 我吃了半个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ chīle bàn ge píngguǒ.
en: I ate half an apple.

zh: 昨天下午半点我去了公园。
pinyin: Zuótiān xiàwǔ bàn diǎn wǒ qùle gōngyuán.
en: Yesterday at half past two in the afternoon, I went to the park.

zh: 虽然只学了半年，但是他的中文已经很不错了。
pinyin: Suīrán zhǐ xuéle bàn nián, dànshì tā de Zhōngwén yǐjīng hěn búcuò le.
en: Although he's only studied for half a year, his Chinese is already pretty good.

zh: 这个项目花了我们半年多的时间才完成。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù huāle wǒmen bàn nián duō de shíjiān cái wánchéng.
en: It took us more than half a year to finish this project.

zh: 他工作了半辈子，现在终于可以安心退休了。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuòle bàn béizi, xiànzài zhōngyú kěyǐ ānxīn tuì休 le.
en: After working for half a lifetime, he can finally retire with peace of mind.

zh: 我只是喝水而已。
pinyin: Wǒ zhǐshì hēshuǐ éryǐ.
en: I'm just drinking water, that's all.

zh: 他今天没来，因为生病了而已。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān méi lái, yīnwèi shēngbìng le éryǐ.
en: He didn't come today—it's just because he's sick.

zh: 虽然她很聪明，但她不过是个学生而已。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn聪míng, dànshì tā búguò shì ge xuésheng éryǐ.
en: Although she's smart, she's only a student after all.

zh: 这份工作看起来不错，其实就是重复的工作而已。
pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò kàn qǐlai búcuò, qīshí jiùshi chóngfù de gōngzuò éryǐ.
en: This job looks decent on the surface, but it's really just repetitive work.

zh: 他的成功并非天赋异禀，不过是坚持不懈而已。
pinyin: Tā de chéngōng bìngfēi tiānfù yìbǐng, búguò shì jiānchí búxié éryǐ.
en: His success isn't due to exceptional talent—it's simply a matter of persistence.

zh: 书在桌子上面。
pinyin: Shū zài zhuōzi shàngmiàn.
en: The book is on the table.

zh: 墙上面有一张漂亮的画。
pinyin: Qiáng shàngmiàn yǒu yī zhāng piàoliang de huà.
en: There's a beautiful picture on the wall.

zh: 虽然上面很高，但是我们还是爬上去了。
pinyin: Suīrán shàngmiàn hěn gāo, danshi wǒmen háishi páshang qùle.
en: Even though it was high up, we still managed to climb up there.

zh: 这份报告的上面写着公司的重要通知。
pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào de shàngmiàn xiězhe gōngsī de zhòngyào tōngzhī.
en: At the top of this report, there's an important company announcement.

zh: 从表面上面看，这个项目很成功，但实际上存在很多隐患。
pinyin: Cóng biǎomiàn shàngmiàn kàn, zhège xiàngmù hěn chénggōng, dan shíjìshang cúnzài hěnduō yǐnhuàn.
en: On the surface, the project looks successful, but there are actually quite a few hidden risks.

zh: 这个苹果的样子很好。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ de yàngzi hěn hǎo.
en: This apple looks really nice.

zh: 昨天她穿的样子很漂亮。
pinyin: Zuótiān tā chuān de yàngzi hěn piàoliang.
en: What she wore yesterday looked really pretty.

zh: 虽然他很累，但样子看起来还很开心。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn lèi, dàn yàngzi kàn qǐlai háishi hěn kāixīn.
en: Even though he was exhausted, he still looked quite happy.

zh: 他说话的样子让人觉得他对这件事很有把握。
pinyin: Tā shuōhuà de yàngzi ràng rén juéde tā duì zhè jiàn shì hěn yǒu bǎwò.
en: The way he spoke made people feel confident that he had a solid grasp of the situation.

zh: 从她写邮件的样子就能看出，她对这个项目投入了不少心思。
pinyin: Cóng tā xiě yóujiàn de yàngzi jiù néng kànchū, tā duì zhège xiàngmù tóuruìle búshǎo xīnsi.
en: From the way she wrote her emails, you could tell she'd put a lot of thought into this project.

zh: 我吃得很少。
pinyin: Wǒ chī de hěn shǎo.
en: I eat very little.

zh: 今天来的人比较少。
pinyin: Jīntiān lái de rén bǐjiào shǎo.
en: There are relatively few people here today.

zh: 虽然他的钱不多，但是花得很少。
pinyin: Suīrán tā de qián búduō, búshì huā de hěn shǎo.
en: Although he doesn't have much money, he spends very little.

zh: 因为加班太多，他最近睡眠少得可怜。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jiābān tàiduō, tā zuìjìn shuìmián shǎo de kěliàn.
en: Because he's been working overtime so much, he's been getting pitifully little sleep lately.

zh: 现在买房的年轻人少之又少，主要是因为房价太高了。
pinyin: Xiànzài mǎifáng de niánqīng rén shǎo zhī yòu shǎo, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi fángjià tài gāo le.
en: Very few young people are buying homes these days, mainly because housing prices have become so expensive.

zh: 这个游戏很有趣。
pinyin: Zhège yóuxì hěn yǒuqù.
en: This game is really fun.

zh: 昨天我看了一个有趣的电影。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ kànle yī ge yǒuqù de diànyǐng.
en: Yesterday I watched an interesting movie.

zh: 虽然这本书很长，但是内容很有趣。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè běn shū hěn cháng, dànshì nèiróng hěn yǒuqù.
en: Although this book is long, the content is really engaging.

zh: 因为他讲故事的方式很有趣，所以大家都喜欢听他说话。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā jiǎng gùshì de fāngshì hěn yǒuqù, suǒyǐ dàjiā dōu xǐhuān tīng tā shuōhuà.
en: Because the way he tells stories is so entertaining, everyone loves listening to him talk.

zh: 那个讲座涉及很多有趣的话题，让我对这个领域产生了浓厚的兴趣。
pinyin: Nàge jiǎngzuò shèjí hěnduō yǒuqù de huàtí, ràng wǒ duì zhège lǐngyù chǎnshēngle nóng厚 de xìngqù.
en: That lecture covered so many fascinating topics that it sparked a real interest in me for this field.

zh: 我提着包。
pinyin: Wǒ tízhe bāo.
en: I'm carrying a bag.

zh: 昨天我提了一个问题。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ tíle yīgè wèntí.
en: Yesterday I raised a question.

zh: 因为他总是迟到，所以我提醒他要早起。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā zǒngshì chídào, suǒyǐ wǒ tíxǐng tā yào zǎoqǐ.
en: Because he's always late, I remind him to wake up early.

zh: 在做这个项目之前，我想提一个重要的建议。
pinyin: Zài zuò zhège xiàngmù zhīqián, wǒ xiǎng tí yīgè zhòngyào de jiànyì.
en: Before we start this project, I'd like to bring up an important suggestion.

zh: 关于成本问题，财务部门已经提出了详细的分析报告。
pinyin: Guānyú chéngběn wèntí, cáiwù bùmén yǐjīng tíchūle xiáng细 de fēnxī bàogào.
en: Regarding the cost issue, the finance department has already submitted a detailed analytical report.

zh: 我弄坏了。没关系。
pinyin: Wǒ nònghuài le. Méi guānxi.
en: I broke it. That's okay.

zh: 你迟到了？没关系，我们还有时间。
pinyin: Nǐ chídào le? Méi guānxi, wǒmen háiyǒu shíjiān.
en: You're late? Don't worry, we still have time.

zh: 虽然他说错话了，但没关系，我们都能理解他。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shuōcuò huà le, dàn méi guānxi, wǒmen dōu néng lǐjiě tā.
en: Even though he misspoke, it's fine—we all understand what he means.

zh: 上次聚会你没来，但没关系，下次一定要过来啊。
pinyin: Shàng cì jùhuì nǐ méi lái, dàn méi guānxi, xià cì yídìng yào guòlái a.
en: You missed the last gathering, but that's alright—you've got to come next time.

zh: 虽然计划有些改变，但没关系，灵活应对才是最重要的。
pinyin: Suīrán jìhuà yǒuxiē gǎibiàn, dàn méi guānxi, línghuó yìngduì cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.
en: The plans shifted a bit, but it doesn't matter—being adaptable is what really counts.

zh: 这是斯坦的书。
pinyin: Zhè shì Sītǎn de shū.
en: This is Stan's book.

zh: 昨天我在斯密斯超市买了很多东西。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài Sīmìsī chāoshì mǎile hěnduō dōngxi.
en: Yesterday I bought a lot of things at Smith's supermarket.

zh: 虽然这个斯坦福的课程很难，但是他坚持学下去了。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège Sītǎnfúde kèchéng hěn nán, dànshì tā jiānchí xué xiàqù le.
en: Although the Stanford course was difficult, he stuck with it and kept learning.

zh: 因为他毕业于斯坦福大学，所以在科技公司很受欢迎。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā bìyè yú Sītǎnfúde dàxué, suǒyǐ zài kējì gōngsī hěn shòu huānyíng.
en: Because he graduated from Stanford University, he's very sought-after at tech companies.

zh: 那位斯坦福毕业的工程师虽然年纪轻，但技术能力已经达到了业界一流水平。
pinyin: Nàwèi Sītǎnfúde bìyè de gōngchéngshī suīrán niánjì qīng, dàn jìshù néng力 yǐjīng dádàole yèjiè yīliú shuǐpíng.
en: That Stanford-educated engineer, though young, has already reached first-class technical standards in the industry.

zh: 杰克是我的朋友。
pinyin: Jiékè shì wǒ de péngyou.
en: Jack is my friend.

zh: 杰克今天穿了一件蓝色的衬衫。
pinyin: Jiékè jīntiān chuānle yī jiàn lánsè de chènshān.
en: Jack wore a blue shirt today.

zh: 虽然杰克来自英国，但是他很喜欢吃中国菜。
pinyin: Suīrán Jiékè láizì Yīngguó, dànshì tā hěn xǐhuān chī Zhōngguó cài.
en: Although Jack is from England, he really likes eating Chinese food.

zh: 杰克因为工作很忙，所以最近没有时间去健身房。
pinyin: Jiékè yīnwèi gōngzuò hěn máng, suǒyǐ zuìjìn méiyǒu shíjiān qù jiànshēnfáng.
en: Because Jack's been swamped with work, he hasn't had time to go to the gym lately.

zh: 杰克提议我们应该趁着周末天气好的时候一起去郊外走走。
pinyin: Jiékè tíyì wǒmen yīnggāi chènzháo zhōumò tiānqì hǎo de shíhou yīqǐ qù jiāowài zǒuzou.
en: Jack suggested we should take advantage of the nice weather this weekend and go for a walk in the countryside together.

zh: 这个苹果真的很好吃。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ zhēnde hěn hǎochī.
en: This apple is really delicious.

zh: 昨天下雨了，真的下了很久。
pinyin: Zuótiān xiàyǔ le, zhēnde xiàle hěn jiǔ.
en: It rained yesterday, and it actually rained for a long time.

zh: 虽然这个工作很忙，但是真的很有意思。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì zhēnde hěn yǒu yìsi.
en: Even though this job is busy, it's actually really interesting.

zh: 他说他会来，但我现在真的有点怀疑他是不是忘了。
pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì lái, dàn wǒ xiànzài zhēnde yǒudiǎn huáiyí tā shì bu shi wàngle.
en: He said he'd come, but honestly I'm starting to doubt whether he forgot.

zh: 这部电影的确不错，但真的没必要花那么多钱去电影院看。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng díquè búcuò, dàn zhēnde méi bìyào huā nàme duō qián qù diànyǐngyuàn kàn.
en: The movie is admittedly good, but there's really no need to spend that much money going to the cinema to watch it.

zh: 部分学生喜欢吃苹果。
pinyin: Bùfen xuésheng xǐhuān chī píngguǒ.
en: Some students like to eat apples.

zh: 今天部分人没有来上课。
pinyin: Jīntiān bùfen rén méiyǒu lái shàngkè.
en: Some people didn't come to class today.

zh: 虽然部分工作很难，但是我们可以完成。
pinyin: Suīrán bùfen gōngzuò hěn nán, dànshì wǒmen kěyǐ wánchéng.
en: Although part of the work is difficult, we can still finish it.

zh: 这部分员工因为经验丰富，所以工作效率很高。
pinyin: Zhè bùfen yuángōng yīnwèi jīngyàn fēngfù, suǒyǐ gōngzuò xiàolǜ hěn gāo.
en: These employees have high work efficiency because this group has abundant experience.

zh: 虽然部分消费者对新产品持怀疑态度，但销售数据表明它已逐渐获得市场认可。
pinyin: Suīrán bùfen xiāofèizhě duì xīn chǎnpǐn chí huáiyí tàidù, dàn xiāoshòu shùjù biǎomíng tā yǐ zhújiàn huòdé shìchǎng rènkě.
en: Although some consumers are skeptical about the new product, sales data shows it's gradually gaining market acceptance.

zh: 老师要求我们做功课。
pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen zuò gōngkè.
en: The teacher requires us to do our homework.

zh: 公司要求员工每天早上八点来上班。
pinyin: Gōngsī yāoqiú yuángōng měitiān zǎoshang bā diǎn lái shàngbān.
en: The company requires employees to come to work at 8 a.m. every morning.

zh: 因为安全很重要，所以他们要求所有人戴安全帽。
pinyin: Yīnwèi ānquán hěn zhòngyào, suǒyǐ tāmen yāoqiú suǒyǒu rén dài ānquán mào.
en: Because safety is important, they require everyone to wear a hard hat.

zh: 这个工作虽然薪水不高，但是要求的专业技能很强。
pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò suīrán xīnshui búgāo, dànshì yāoqiú de zhuānyè jìnéng hěn qiáng.
en: Although this job doesn't pay well, it requires very specialized professional skills.

zh: 现在的消费者对产品质量的要求越来越高，企业必须不断改进。
pinyin: Xiànzài de xiāofèizhě duì chǎnpǐn zhìliàng de yāoqiú yuèláiyuè gāo, qǐyè bìxū búduàn gǎijìn.
en: Nowadays consumers' demands for product quality keep getting higher, so companies must constantly improve.

zh: 天气糟糕。
pinyin: Tiānqì zāogāo.
en: The weather is terrible.

zh: 今天我的心情很糟糕。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ de xīnqíng hěn zāogāo.
en: I'm in a really bad mood today.

zh: 因为下雨，所以比赛的情况很糟糕。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ bǐsài de qíngkuàng hěn zāogāo.
en: Because it rained, the match situation turned out really bad.

zh: 他的成绩一直很糟糕，虽然他很努力学习。
pinyin: Tā de chéngjì yìzhí hěn zāogāo, suīrán tā hěn nǔlì xuéxí.
en: His grades have always been poor, even though he studies hard.

zh: 会议进行得很糟糕，大家都意见不合，最后不欢而散。
pinyin: Huìyì jìnxíng de hěn zāogāo, dàjiā dōu yìjiàn búhé, zuìhòu búhuānyōuésàn.
en: The meeting went terribly—everyone disagreed, and we ended up breaking up on bad terms.

zh: 除了苹果,我还要香蕉。
pinyin: Chúle píngguǒ, wǒ háiyào xiāngjiāo.
en: Besides apples, I also want bananas.

zh: 除了星期天,我每天都要上班。
pinyin: Chúle xīngqītiān, wǒ měi tiān dōu yào shàngbān.
en: Except for Sundays, I work every single day.

zh: 除了英语以外,他还会说法语和日语。
pinyin: Chúle yīngyǔ yǐwài, tā háishi huì shuōfǎ fǎyǔ hé rìyǔ.
en: In addition to English, he can also speak French and Japanese.

zh: 除了工作压力大以外,他的生活还算不错。
pinyin: Chúle gōngzuò yālì dà yǐwài, tā de shēnghuó háisuàn búcuò.
en: Apart from high work stress, his life is actually going pretty well.

zh: 除了必要的开支,我们应该尽量减少不必要的消费。
pinyin: Chúle bìyào de kāizhī, wǒmen yīnggāi jìnliàng jiǎnshǎo búbìyào de xiāofèi.
en: Beyond essential expenses, we should try our best to cut down on unnecessary spending.

zh: 这很容易。
pinyin: Zhè hěn róngyì.
en: This is easy.

zh: 小孩子容易生病。
pinyin: Xiǎo háizi róngyì shēngbìng.
en: Young children get sick easily.

zh: 虽然这个游戏看起来容易，但是玩的时候不简单。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège yóuxì kàn qǐlai róngyì, dànshi wán de shíhou bújiǎndān.
en: Although this game looks easy, it's actually hard to play.

zh: 如果你不认真听讲，就容易犯错误。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ búrènzhēn tīngjiǎng, jiù róngyì fàn cuòwù.
en: If you don't pay careful attention in class, you'll easily make mistakes.

zh: 在网络时代，人容易被虚假信息迷惑。
pinyin: Zài wǎngluò shídài, rén róngyì bèi xūjiǎ xìnxī míhuò.
en: In the internet age, people are easily misled by false information.

zh: 我保持健康。
pinyin: Wǒ bǎochíh jiànkāng.
en: I stay healthy.

zh: 每天保持运动很重要。
pinyin: Měitiān bǎochí yùndòng hěn zhòngyào.
en: Exercising every day is really important.

zh: 虽然很累，但他保持了好心态。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn tā bǎochíle hǎo xīntài.
en: Even though he was exhausted, he maintained a positive attitude.

zh: 为了保持竞争力，公司需要不断创新。
pinyin: Wèile bǎochí jìngjìnglì, gōngsī xūyào búduàn chuàngxīn.
en: To stay competitive, the company needs to keep innovating.

zh: 长期保持良好沟通能帮助维系夫妻感情。
pinyin: Chángqī bǎochí liáng好 gōutōng néng bāngzhù wéixì fūqī gǎnqíng.
en: Maintaining good communication over time can help preserve a marriage.

zh: 虽然下雨，我还是去了。
pinyin: Suīránjiàn xiàyǔ, wǒ háishi qù le.
en: Even though it was raining, I still went.

zh: 虽然很累，但是我今天还要工作。
pinyin: Suīránjiàn hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ jīntiān háiyào gōngzuò.
en: Although I'm very tired, I still have to work today.

zh: 虽然这个电影很长，但我看的时候很开心。
pinyin: Suīránjiàn zhège diànyǐng hěn cháng, dàn wǒ kàn de shíhou hěn kāixīn.
en: Even though the movie was long, I was really happy while watching it.

zh: 虽然他没有太多的工作经验，但他学习的速度很快。
pinyin: Suīránjiàn tā méiyǒu tàiduō de gōngzuò jīngyàn, dàn tā xuéxí de sùdù hěn kuài.
en: Although he doesn't have much work experience, he learns very quickly.

zh: 虽然这份工作薪水不算特别高，但发展空间很大，值得去尝试。
pinyin: Suīránjiàn zhè fèn gōngzuò xīnshuǐ búsuàn tèbié gāo, dàn fāzhǎn kōngjiān hěn dà, zhíde qù chángshì.
en: Although this job doesn't pay particularly well, there's a lot of room for growth, so it's worth trying.

zh: 我们办一个聚会。
pinyin: Wǒmen bàn yī ge jùhuì.
en: We're throwing a party.

zh: 明天我要去办银行卡。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào qù bàn yínháng kǎ.
en: Tomorrow I need to go open a bank account.

zh: 因为工作忙，所以我没时间办护照。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò máng, suǒyǐ wǒ méi shíjiān bàn hùzhào.
en: Because work is busy, I don't have time to get a passport.

zh: 虽然办理手续很麻烦，但是为了安全还是要办保险。
pinyin: Suīrán bànlǐ shǒuxù hěn máfan, dànshì wèile ānquán háishi yào bàn bǎoxiǎn.
en: Even though the paperwork is tedious, it's still necessary to get insurance for safety.

zh: 他想自己办个小公司，但缺少资金和经验，所以一直没有付诸行动。
pinyin: Tā xiǎng zìjǐ bàn ge xiǎo gōngsī, dàn quēshǎo zījīn hé jīngyàn, suǒyǐ yīzhí méiyǒu fùzhū xíngdòng.
en: He wants to start his own small business, but lacks the capital and experience, so he's never actually done it.

zh: 妈妈教我做饭。
pinyin: Māma jiāo wǒ zuò fàn.
en: Mom teaches me how to cook.

zh: 老师每天教我们英语。
pinyin: Lǎoshī měi tiān jiāo wǒmen yīngyǔ.
en: The teacher teaches us English every day.

zh: 因为我想学钢琴，所以爸爸教我弹琴。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ xiǎng xué gāngqín, suǒyǐ bàba jiāo wǒ tánqín.
en: Because I want to learn piano, my dad is teaching me how to play.

zh: 虽然他没有正式学过，但他教朋友的方式很有耐心。
pinyin: Suīrán tā méiyǒu zhèngshì xuéguò, dàn tā jiāo péngyou de fāngshì hěn yǒu nàixīn.
en: Although he never formally studied it, he teaches his friends very patiently.

zh: 好的教育不仅教知识，更重要的是教学生如何独立思考。
pinyin: Hǎo de jiàoyù búnjǐn jiāo zhīshi, gèng zhòngyào de shì jiāo xuésheng rúhé dúlì sīkǎo.
en: Good education doesn't just teach knowledge; more importantly, it teaches students how to think independently.

zh: 我想到了妈妈。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngdào le māma.
en: I thought of my mom.

zh: 昨天我想到了一个好主意。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ xiǎngdào le yī ge hǎo zhǔyì.
en: Yesterday I came up with a good idea.

zh: 虽然很困难,但他还是想到了解决办法。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn kùnnan, dànshì tā háishi xiǎngdào le jiějué bànfǎ.
en: Although it was difficult, he still managed to think of a solution.

zh: 直到看到这个问题,我才想到以前犯过同样的错误。
pinyin: Zhídào kàndào zhège wèntí, wǒ cái xiǎngdào yǐqián犯guò tóngyàng de cuòwù.
en: Not until I saw this problem did I remember making the same mistake before.

zh: 他想到了一个办法,既能节省成本,又不影响质量。
pinyin: Tā xiǎngdào le yī ge bànfǎ, jì néng jiéshěng chéngběn, yòu búyǐngxiǎng zhìliàng.
en: He came up with an approach that both cuts costs and maintains quality.

zh: 我理解你的意思。
pinyin: Wǒ lǐjiě nǐ de yìsi.
en: I understand what you mean.

zh: 他很快就理解了这个简单的规则。
pinyin: Tā hěn kuài jiù lǐjiě le zhège jiǎndān de guīzé.
en: He understood that simple rule very quickly.

zh: 虽然很难，但是如果你多练习，就能理解这个语法。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dànshi rúguǒ nǐ duō liànxí, jiù néng lǐjiě zhège yǔfǎ.
en: Even though it's difficult, if you practice more, you'll be able to understand this grammar.

zh: 因为文化不同，我们有时候很难理解彼此的想法。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wénhuà búyàng, wǒmen yǒushíhou hěn nán lǐjiě bǐcǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
en: Because of cultural differences, we sometimes find it hard to understand each other's thoughts.

zh: 要理解别人的立场，你需要站在他们的角度去思考问题。
pinyin: Yào lǐjiě biérén de lìchǎng, nǐ xūyào zhàn zài tāmen de jiǎodù qù sīkǎo wèntí.
en: To understand someone else's position, you need to think about the problem from their perspective.

zh: 我们有证据。
pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu zhèngjù.
en: We have evidence.

zh: 警察找到了新的证据。
pinyin: Jǐngchá zhǎodào le xīn de zhèngjù.
en: The police found new evidence.

zh: 虽然他说了很多，但是没有证据证明他的话。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shuōle hěnduō, dànshì méiyǒu zhèngjù zhèngmíng tā de huà.
en: Although he said a lot, there's no evidence to prove what he said.

zh: 医生根据这些证据判断患者得了什么病。
pinyin: Yīshēng gēnjù zhèxiē zhèngjù pànduàn huànzhě déle shénme bìng.
en: Based on this evidence, the doctor determined what disease the patient had.

zh: 要想赢得这场官司，必须拿出更有说服力的证据。
pinyin: Yàoxiǎng yíngde zhè chǎng guānsi, bìxū náchūlái gèng yǒu shuōfúlì de zhèngjù.
en: To win this lawsuit, you need to produce more convincing evidence.

zh: 我加糖。
pinyin: Wǒ jiā táng.
en: I'm adding sugar.

zh: 早上我喝咖啡加牛奶。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ hē kāfēi jiā niúnǎi.
en: In the morning I drink coffee with milk.

zh: 因为天气冷，我穿衣服的时候加了一件外套。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì lěng, wǒ chuānyīfu de shíhou jiāle yī jiàn wàitào.
en: Because it's cold, I put on an extra jacket when I got dressed.

zh: 公司决定加工资，虽然幅度不大，但大家都很高兴。
pinyin: Gōngsī juéding jiā gōngzī, suīrán fúdù búdà, dàn dàjiā dōu hěn gāoxìng.
en: The company decided to give everyone a raise; although it wasn't huge, everybody was really happy.

zh: 随着网络技术的发展，越来越多企业开始加大对数字营销的投入。
pinyin: Suízhe wǎngluò jìshù de fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuè duō qǐyè kāishǐ jiādà duì shùzì yíngxiāo de tóurù.
en: As internet technology has evolved, more and more companies have been stepping up their investment in digital marketing.

zh: 她的脸很红。
pinyin: Tā de liǎn hěn hóng.
en: Her face is very red.

zh: 他今天脸色不太好。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān liǎnsè búzhào hǎo.
en: He doesn't look well today.

zh: 因为他很害羞，所以脸变得特别红。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn hàixiū, suǒyǐ liǎn biàn de tèbié hóng.
en: Because he's very shy, his face turned especially red.

zh: 虽然她化了妆，但是还是能看出脸上有疲劳的痕迹。
pinyin: Suīrán tā huà le zhuàng, búguò háishi néng kànchū liǎnshang yǒu píláo de hénjī.
en: Although she wore makeup, you could still see traces of exhaustion on her face.

zh: 他在会议上被经理当众批评，脸上顿时没有了血色。
pinyin: Tā zài huìyì shang bèi jīnglǐ dāngzhòng píngpíng, liǎnshang dùnshí méiyǒu le xiěsè.
en: When the manager criticized him in front of everyone at the meeting, his face went completely pale.

zh: 这个游戏很简单。
pinyin: Zhège yóuxì hěn jiǎndān.
en: This game is very easy.

zh: 早上的早餐很简单，只有面包和牛奶。
pinyin: Zǎoshang de zǎocān hěn jiǎndān, zhǐyǒu miànbāo hé niúnǎi.
en: Breakfast in the morning is simple—just bread and milk.

zh: 虽然这个问题看起来简单，但是回答的时候需要认真想。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège wèntí kàn qǐlái jiǎndān, dànshì huídá de shíhou xūyào rènzhēn xiǎng.
en: Although this question looks simple, you need to think carefully when answering it.

zh: 与其追求复杂的解决方案，不如选择一个简单有效的办法。
pinyin: Yǔqī zhuīqiú fùzá de jiějué fāng'àn, búrú xuǎnzé yīgè jiǎndān yǒuxiào de bànfǎ.
en: Rather than pursuing a complicated solution, it's better to choose a simple and effective method.

zh: 很多人觉得编程很难，但实际上初级阶段的逻辑其实挺简单的，关键是要有耐心。
pinyin: Hěnduō rén juéde biānchéng hěn nán, dàn shíjì shang chūjí jiēduàn de luójì qīshí tǐng jiǎndān de, guānjiàn shì yào yǒu nàixīn.
en: Many people think programming is hard, but actually the logic at the beginner level is pretty straightforward—the key is having patience.

zh: 我和你不同。
pinyin: Wǒ hé nǐ bútonɡ.
en: You and I are different.

zh: 今天的天气和昨天不同。
pinyin: Jīntiān de tiānqì hé zuótiān bútonɡ.
en: Today's weather is different from yesterday's.

zh: 虽然我们来自不同的城市，但是我们是好朋友。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen lái zì bútonɡ de chéngshì, dànshì wǒmen shì hǎo pénɡyou.
en: Although we're from different cities, we're still good friends.

zh: 每个人对这个问题的看法都不同，我们需要尊重彼此的意见。
pinyin: Měɡ ge rén duì zhèɡe wèntí de kànfǎ dōu bútonɡ, wǒmen xūyào zūnzhònɡ bǐcǐ de yìjian.
en: Everyone has a different perspective on this issue, so we need to respect each other's opinions.

zh: 在不同的文化背景下，人们对成功的定义往往存在很大的差异。
pinyin: Zài bútonɡ de wénhuà bèiɡǐnɡ xià, rénmen duì chénɡɡōnɡ de dìnɡyì wǎnɡwǎnɡ cúnzài hěn dà de chāyì.
en: Against different cultural backgrounds, people's definitions of success often differ significantly.

zh: 这是王夫人。
pinyin: Zhè shì Wáng fūren.
en: This is Mrs. Wang.

zh: 夫人每天早上喝咖啡。
pinyin: Fūren měitiān zǎoshang hē kāfēi.
en: The lady drinks coffee every morning.

zh: 因为天气很冷，所以夫人穿了厚外套。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn lěng, suǒyǐ fūren chuānle hòu wàitào.
en: Because the weather was cold, the lady put on a thick coat.

zh: 虽然夫人工作很忙，但她每周都抽时间去健身房。
pinyin: Suīrán fūren gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn tā měi zhōu dōu chōu shíjiān qù jiànshēnfáng.
en: Although the lady's work is very busy, she still makes time to go to the gym every week.

zh: 这位夫人在商业领域取得了不少成就，她的经验对年轻企业家很有启发。
pinyin: Zhè wèi fūren zài shāngyè lǐngyù qǔdéle búshǎo chéngjiù, tā de jīngyàn duì niánqīng qǐyèjiājiā hěn yǒu qǐfā.
en: This lady has achieved considerable success in the business field, and her experience is quite enlightening for young entrepreneurs.

zh: 我的父母很好。
pinyin: Wǒ de fùmǔ hěn hǎo.
en: My parents are very kind.

zh: 每天父母都在家里工作。
pinyin: Měi tiān fùmǔ dōu zài jiāli gōngzuò.
en: Every day my parents work at home.

zh: 虽然父母很忙，但是他们经常陪我。
pinyin: Suīrán fùmǔ hěn máng, dànshì tāmen jīngcháng péi wǒ.
en: Even though my parents are busy, they often spend time with me.

zh: 父母希望我好好学习，因为他们认为教育很重要。
pinyin: Fùmǔ xīwàng wǒ hǎohāo xuéxí, yīnwèi tāmen rènwéi jiàoyù hěn zhòngyào.
en: My parents want me to study hard because they believe education is important.

zh: 我父母的建议对我影响很大，现在我更理解他们的用心良苦。
pinyin: Wǒ fùmǔ de jiànyì duì wǒ yǐngxiǎng hěn dà, xiànzài wǒ gèng lǐjiě tāmen de yòngxīn liáng苦.
en: My parents' advice has had a big impact on me, and now I understand their good intentions even better.

zh: 这个盒子很重。
pinyin: Zhège héziǐ hěn zhòng.
en: This box is heavy.

zh: 昨天我买了一个很重的书包。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ mǎile yīge hěn zhòng de shūbāo.
en: Yesterday I bought a really heavy backpack.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以今天的空气很重。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔle, suǒyǐ jīntiān de kōngqì hěn zhòng.
en: Because it rained, the air feels heavy today.

zh: 他工作太重，经常加班到很晚才回家。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò tài zhòng, jīngcháng jiābān dào hěn wǎn cái huíjiā.
en: His workload is too heavy, so he often works late before going home.

zh: 这个项目的责任很重，但他没有退缩，反而更加努力了。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de zérèn hěn zhòng, dàn tā méiyǒu tuìsuō, fǎn'ér gèngjiā nǔlì le.
en: The responsibility for this project is significant, but instead of backing down, he worked even harder.

zh: 谢谢你的恩情。
pinyin: Xièxiè nǐ de ēnqíng.
en: Thank you for your kindness.

zh: 我永远不会忘记父母的恩。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒngyuǎn búhuì wàngjì fùmǔ de ēn.
en: I will never forget my parents' kindness.

zh: 虽然很困难，但他因为感恩的心坚持了下去。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn kùnnan, dàn tā yīnwèi gǎn'ēn de xīn jiānchíle xiàqu.
en: Although it was very difficult, he persevered because of his grateful heart.

zh: 老师给了我很大的帮助，我应该报答他的恩。
pinyin: Lǎoshī gěile wǒ hěn dà de bāngzhù, wǒ yīnggāi bàodá tā de ēn.
en: My teacher has helped me tremendously, so I should repay their kindness.

zh: 我们要懂得感恩，这是一个人最基本的品质。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào dǒngde gǎn'ēn, zhè shì yī ge rén zuì jīběn de pǐnzhì.
en: We need to understand gratitude—it's one of the most fundamental qualities a person can have.

zh: 我曾吃过北京鸭。
pinyin: Wǒ céng chīguò běi jīng yā.
en: I've had Peking duck before.

zh: 她曾在这家医院工作过三年。
pinyin: Tā céng zài zhè jiā yīyuàn gōngzuò guò sān nián.
en: She used to work at this hospital for three years.

zh: 虽然他曾经失败过,但是他没有放弃自己的梦想。
pinyin: Suīrán tā céng jīng shībài guò, dànshì tā méiyǒu fàngqì zìjǐ de梦想.
en: Although he had failed before, he never gave up on his dream.

zh: 那位老师曾经教过我们公司很多员工的英语课程。
pinyin: Nà wèi lǎoshī céng jīng jiāoguò wǒmen gōngsī hěnduō yuángōng de yīngyǔ kèchéng.
en: That teacher once taught English classes to many employees in our company.

zh: 我曾想过放弃这份工作,但后来意识到坚持才是成功的关键。
pinyin: Wǒ céng xiǎngguò fàngqì zhè fèn gōngzuò, dàn hòuláidì yìshi dào jiānchí cái shì chéngōng de guānjiàn.
en: I once considered quitting this job, but eventually I realized that persistence is the key to success.

zh: 事实是我喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Shìshí shì wǒ xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: The fact is, I like eating rice.

zh: 事实上，他昨天没有来上课。
pinyin: Shìshí shang, tā zuótiān méiyǒu lái shàngkè.
en: In fact, he didn't come to class yesterday.

zh: 虽然他说很忙，但事实是他有时间玩游戏。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shuō hěn máng, dàn shìshí shì tā yǒu shíjiān wán yóuxì.
en: Although he says he's busy, the truth is he has time to play games.

zh: 根据调查的事实，大多数人认为这个计划很有用。
pinyin: Gēnjù diàochá de shìshí, dàduōshù rén rènwéi zhège jìhuà hěn yǒuyòng.
en: Based on the facts from the survey, most people think this plan is quite useful.

zh: 无论他怎样辩解，事实胜于雄辩，他的行为已经说明了一切。
pinyin: Wúlùn tā zěnyàng biànjiě, shìshí shèngyú xióngbiàn, tā de xíngwéi yǐjīng shuōmíng le yīqiè.
en: No matter how he explains himself, facts speak louder than words—his actions have already made everything clear.

zh: 飞机很大。
pinyin: Fēijī hěn dà.
en: Airplanes are very big.

zh: 我昨天坐飞机去了北京。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān zuò fēijī qù le běijīng.
en: I took a plane to Beijing yesterday.

zh: 因为天气不好，所以飞机晚点了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, suǒyǐ fēijī wǎndiǎn le.
en: Because the weather was bad, the plane was delayed.

zh: 登机前要检查飞机票和护照，这很重要。
pinyin: Dēngjī qián yào jiǎnchá fēijī piào hé húzhào, zhè hěn zhòngyào.
en: Before boarding, you need to check your airline ticket and passport—it's very important.

zh: 现在的飞机票价格不稳定，经常看到便宜的机票就要赶紧下手。
pinyin: Xiànzài de fēijī piào jiàgé búwěndìng, jīngcháng kàndào piányì de jīpiào jiù yào gǎnjǐn xiàshǒu.
en: Flight ticket prices are unpredictable these days—whenever you spot a cheap flight, you need to book it right away.

zh: 我的家庭很好。
pinyin: Wǒ de jiātíng hěn hǎo.
en: My family is great.

zh: 每天我和家庭一起吃饭。
pinyin: Měi tiān wǒ hé jiātíng yìqǐ chīfàn.
en: Every day I eat meals together with my family.

zh: 因为家庭很重要，所以我经常回家。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jiātíng hěn zhòngyào, suǒyǐ wǒ jīngcháng huíjiā.
en: Because family is so important, I often go back home.

zh: 现在很多人为了工作忽视家庭的需要。
pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō rén wèile gōngzuò húshì jiātíng de xūyào.
en: Nowadays many people neglect their family's needs because of work.

zh: 建立一个稳定和谐的家庭环境对孩子的成长至关重要。
pinyin: Jiànlì yī ge wěndìng héxié de jiātíng huánjìng duì háizi de chéngzhǎng zhìguān zhòngyào.
en: Creating a stable and harmonious family environment is crucial for a child's development.

zh: 大象很大。
pinyin: Dàxiàng hěn dà.
en: Elephants are very big.

zh: 我昨天在动物园看到了象。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān zài dòngwùyuán kàndàole xiàng.
en: I saw an elephant at the zoo yesterday.

zh: 虽然象很重，但是它跑得很快。
pinyin: Suīrán xiàng hěn zhòng, dànshì tā páo de hěn kuài.
en: Even though elephants are heavy, they can still run quite fast.

zh: 这个雕像看起来象一个古代的战士。
pinyin: Zhège diāoxiàng kàn qǐlai xiàng yīge gǔdài de zhànshì.
en: This statue looks like an ancient warrior.

zh: 他的举止和说话方式都象极了他的父亲。
pinyin: Tā de jǔzhǐ hé shuōhuà fāngshì dōu xiàng jí le tā de fùqīn.
en: His mannerisms and way of speaking are remarkably similar to his father's.

zh: 我装书在书包里。
pinyin: Wǒ zhuāng shū zài shūbāo lǐ.
en: I'm putting books in my backpack.

zh: 妈妈装了很多菜在盒子里。
pinyin: Māma zhuāngle hěnduō cài zài hézi lǐ.
en: Mom packed a lot of dishes into containers.

zh: 虽然他装得很开心，但是我看得出他很难过。
pinyin: Suīrán tā zhuāngde hěn kāixīn, dànshi wǒ kàn dechu tā hěn nánguò.
en: Although he's pretending to be happy, I can tell he's actually sad.

zh: 这个软件装在手机里以后，使用起来特别方便。
pinyin: Zhège ruǎnjiàn zhuāng zài shǒujī lǐ yǐhòu, shǐyòng qǐlai tèbié fāngbiàn.
en: Once you install this app on your phone, it becomes really convenient to use.

zh: 他装作不知道那件事，其实早就听说过了，真是装模作样。
pinyin: Tā zhuāngzuò bù zhīdào nà jiàn shì, qīshí zǎojiù tīng shuōguole, zhēnshi zhuāng mózuò yàng.
en: He's pretending he doesn't know about that matter, but he'd heard about it ages ago—total fake act.

zh: 这是我的秘密。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de mìmì.
en: This is my secret.

zh: 你不能告诉别人我的秘密。
pinyin: Nǐ búnéng gàosu biérén wǒ de mìmì.
en: You can't tell anyone else my secret.

zh: 虽然这是秘密，但我想告诉你。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè shì mìmì, dàn wǒ xiǎng gàosu nǐ.
en: Even though it's a secret, I want to tell you.

zh: 他因为不想被人发现，所以一直隐瞒这个秘密。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi búxiǎng bèi rén fāxiàn, suǒyǐ yìzhí yǐnmán zhège mìmì.
en: He kept hiding this secret because he didn't want anyone to find out.

zh: 公司的新产品还没上市，这是目前最大的商业秘密。
pinyin: Gōngsī de xīn chǎnpǐn háishi méi shàngyè, zhè shì mùqián zuìdà de shāngyè mìmì.
en: The company's new product hasn't launched yet—that's the biggest trade secret right now.

zh: 这是学法语的书。
pinyin: Zhè shì xué fǎyǔ de shū.
en: This is a book for learning French.

zh: 我每天用这个方法学习汉语。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān yòng zhège fāngfǎ xuéxí hànyǔ.
en: I use this method to study Chinese every day.

zh: 虽然这个办法很简单，但是效果很好。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège bànfǎ hěn jiǎndān, dànshì xiàoguǒ hěn hǎo.
en: Although this approach is simple, it works really well.

zh: 根据法律规定，公司必须遵守这些规则。
pinyin: Gēnjù fǎlǜ guīdìng, gōngsī bìxū zunshǒu zhèxiē guīzé.
en: According to the law, companies must comply with these regulations.

zh: 他想到了一个绝妙的办法来解决这个难题。
pinyin: Tā xiǎngdàole yīge juémiào de bànfǎ lái jiějué zhège nántí.
en: He came up with a brilliant solution to solve this difficult problem.

zh: 警察找到了尸体。
pinyin: Jǐngchá zhǎodào le shītǐ.
en: The police found the body.

zh: 昨天医生检查了那具尸体。
pinyin: Zuótiān yīshēng jiǎnchá le nàjù shītǐ.
en: Yesterday the doctor examined that body.

zh: 因为尸体在水里，所以警察花了很长时间找。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shītǐ zài shuǐ lǐ, suǒyǐ jǐngchá huā le hěn cháng shíjiān zhǎo.
en: Because the body was in the water, it took the police a very long time to find it.

zh: 虽然尸体已经腐烂了，但法医还是能够确定死亡时间。
pinyin: Suīrán shītǐ yǐjīng fǔlàn le, dàn fǎyī háishi néng gòu quèdìng sǐwáng shíjiān.
en: Although the body had already decomposed, the forensic examiner was still able to determine the time of death.

zh: 警察根据现场证据和尸体的检验结果推断出犯罪嫌疑人的身份。
pinyin: Jǐngchá gēnjù xiànchǎng zhèngjù hé shītǐ de jiǎnyàn jiéguǒ tuīduàn chū fànzuì xiányí rén de shēnfèn.
en: Based on the crime scene evidence and the body's autopsy results, the police deduced the suspect's identity.

zh: 请打开门。
pinyin: Qǐng dǎkāi mén.
en: Please open the door.

zh: 早上我打开窗户看外面。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ dǎkāi chuānghu kàn wàimiàn.
en: In the morning I open the window to look outside.

zh: 因为天气很热，所以我打开了空调。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn rè, suǒyǐ wǒ dǎkāile kōngtiáo.
en: Because the weather is very hot, I turned on the air conditioning.

zh: 他每天早上都打开电脑工作，直到晚上才休息。
pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshang dōu dǎkāi diànnǎo gōngzuò, zhídào wǎnshang cái xiūxi.
en: Every morning he opens his computer to work, and doesn't rest until evening.

zh: 与其整天抱怨，不如打开心扉接受新的机会和挑战。
pinyin: Yǔqī zhěngtiān bàoyuàn, búrú dǎkāi xīnfēi jiēshòu xīnde jīhuì hé tiǎozhàn.
en: Rather than complaining all day, it's better to open your heart and accept new opportunities and challenges.

zh: 夏季很热。
pinyin: Xiàjì hěn rè.
en: Summer is very hot.

zh: 春季的时候花开了。
pinyin: Chūnjì de shíhou huā kāi le.
en: When spring came, the flowers bloomed.

zh: 虽然冬季很冷，但是我喜欢滑雪。
pinyin: Suīrán dōngjì hěn lěng, dànshi wǒ xǐhuān huáxuě.
en: Although winter is cold, I like to ski.

zh: 这个季度公司的销售额增长了百分之十五。
pinyin: Zhège jìdù gōngsī de xiāoshòuè zēngzhǎng le bǎifēnzhī shíwǔ.
en: This quarter the company's sales increased by fifteen percent.

zh: 虽然秋季是丰收的季节，但农民们也要为冬季做充足的准备。
pinyin: Suīrán qiūjì shì fēngshōu de jìjié, dàn nóngmín men yě yào wèi dōngjì zuò chōngzú de zhǔnbèi.
en: Although autumn is a season of harvest, farmers still need to make thorough preparations for winter.

zh: 医生检查我的牙齿。
pinyin: Yīshēng jiǎnchá wǒ de yáchǐ.
en: The doctor checks my teeth.

zh: 上班前，我检查了自己的手机。
pinyin: Shàngbān qián, wǒ jiǎnchá le zìjǐ de shǒujī.
en: Before work, I checked my phone.

zh: 因为孩子生病了，所以父母带他去医院检查。
pinyin: Yīnwèi háizi shēngbìng le, suǒyǐ fùmǔ dài tā qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá.
en: Because the child was sick, the parents took him to the hospital for a checkup.

zh: 飞机起飞前，机务人员需要仔细检查每个零件。
pinyin: Fēijī qǐfēi qián, jīwù rényuán xūyào zǐxì jiǎnchá měi ge língjiàn.
en: Before takeoff, the maintenance crew needs to carefully inspect every component.

zh: 公司定期检查员工的工作表现，以便及时发现和改进问题。
pinyin: Gōngsī dìngqī jiǎnchá yuángōng de gōngzuò biǎoxiàn, yǐbiàn jíshí fāxiàn hé gǎijìn wèntí.
en: The company regularly reviews employees' performance so they can promptly identify and address any issues.

zh: 我早上吃面包。
pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang chī miànbāo.
en: I eat bread in the morning.

zh: 她早上七点起床去上班。
pinyin: Tā zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng qù shàngbān.
en: She gets up at seven in the morning to go to work.

zh: 虽然早上很冷，但是我还是去跑步了。
pinyin: Suīrán zǎoshang hěn lěng, dànshì wǒ háishi qù pǎobù le.
en: Even though it was cold in the morning, I still went jogging.

zh: 早上开会的时候，他提出了一个不错的想法。
pinyin: Zǎoshang kāihuì de shíhou, tā tíchūle yī ge búcuò de xiǎngfǎ.
en: When we had the meeting this morning, he came up with a pretty good idea.

zh: 早上匆匆忙忙出门，结果忘记带钥匙了。
pinyin: Zǎoshang cōngcōngmángmáng chūmén, jiéguǒ wàngjì dàile yàoshì le.
en: I rushed out this morning and ended up forgetting my keys.

zh: 这是玩笑。
pinyin: Zhè shì wán笑.
en: That's a joke.

zh: 他昨天和我开了个玩笑。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān hé wǒ kāile ge wánxiào.
en: He played a joke on me yesterday.

zh: 虽然他很爱开玩笑，但是没人生气。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn ài kāi wánxiào, dànshì méi rén shēngqì.
en: Even though he loves to joke around, nobody gets upset.

zh: 别太认真了，我只是跟你开个玩笑而已。
pinyin: Bié tài rènzhēn le, wǒ zhǐshì gēn nǐ kāi ge wánxiào érǐ.
en: Don't take it so seriously—I was just kidding with you.

zh: 他们经常互相开玩笑，这已经成了他们友谊的一部分。
pinyin: Tāmen jīngcháng hùxiāng kāi wánxiào, zhè yǐjīng chéngle tāmen yǒuyì de yī bùfen.
en: They're always joking around with each other—it's become part of their friendship.

zh: 这是我的任务。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de rènwù.
en: This is my task.

zh: 今天我有一个新任务。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ yǒu yī ge xīn rènwù.
en: Today I have a new task.

zh: 虽然任务很难，但是我会完成。
pinyin: Suīrán rènwù hěn nán, dànshì wǒ huì wánchéng.
en: Although the task is difficult, I'll still complete it.

zh: 经理给了我们一个重要的任务要在周五前做完。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ gěi le wǒmen yī ge zhòngyào de rènwù yào zài zhōuwǔ qián zuò wán.
en: The manager gave us an important task that needs to be finished by Friday.

zh: 完成这个任务需要团队合作，单靠一个人是做不了的。
pinyin: Wánchéng zhège rènwù xūyào tuánduì hézuò, dānkào yī ge rén shì zuò bu liǎo de.
en: Completing this task requires teamwork—no single person can pull it off alone.

zh: 警察在现场。
pinyin: Jǐngchá zài xiànchǎng.
en: The police are at the scene.

zh: 昨天的事故现场很危险。
pinyin: Zuótiān de shìgù xiànchǎng hěn wēixiǎn.
en: Yesterday's accident scene was very dangerous.

zh: 虽然我没有去现场，但是我看了视频。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ méiyǒu qù xiànchǎng, dànshì wǒ kànle shìpín.
en: Although I didn't go to the scene, I watched the video.

zh: 医生赶到现场时，伤者已经被送进救护车了。
pinyin: Yīshēng gǎndào xiànchǎng shí, shāngzhě yǐjīng bèi sòngjìn jiùhùchē le.
en: By the time the doctor arrived at the scene, the injured person had already been put in the ambulance.

zh: 作为记者，她经常需要赶赴现场采访突发事件。
pinyin: Zuòwéi jìzhě, tā jīngcháng xūyào gǎnfù xiànchǎng cǎifǎng túfā shìjiàn.
en: As a journalist, she often has to rush to the scene to cover breaking news.

zh: 这个工具使工作更快。
pinyin: Zhège gōngjù shǐ gōngzuò gèng kuài.
en: This tool makes work faster.

zh: 早点睡觉使你明天有精神。
pinyin: Zǎodiǎn shuìjiào shǐ nǐ míngtiān yǒu jīngshén.
en: Going to bed early gives you energy tomorrow.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但这个计划使我们都很开心。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dàn zhège jìhuà shǐ wǒmen dōu hěn kāixīn.
en: Even though the weather was bad, this plan made us all really happy.

zh: 政府的新政策使很多人失业，这使得社会问题变得更复杂。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ de xīn zhèngcè shǐ hěnduō rén shīyè, zhè shǐde shèhuì wèntí biàn de gèng fùzá.
en: The government's new policy caused many people to lose their jobs, which made social problems even more complicated.

zh: 那次失败本来使他信心受损，但他最后使出浑身解数，终于扭转了局面。
pinyin: Nà cì shībài běnlái shǐ tā xìnxīn shòusǔn, dàn tā zuìhòu shǐchū húnshēn jiěshù, zhōngyú niǔzhuǎn le júmiàn.
en: That failure initially damaged his confidence, but he ultimately pulled out all the stops and managed to turn things around.

zh: 请转身。
pinyin: Qǐng zhuǎnshēn.
en: Please turn around.

zh: 我每天转公交车去上班。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zhuǎn gōngjiāochē qù shàngbān.
en: I transfer to a bus every day to get to work.

zh: 因为天气冷，所以我转身进屋了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ zhuǎnshēn jìnwū le.
en: Because it was cold, I turned around and went inside.

zh: 这个消息在网上转得很快，大家都看到了。
pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi zài wǎngshang zhuǎn de hěn kuài, dàjiā dōu kàndào le.
en: This news spread really fast online, and everyone saw it.

zh: 随着经济发展，人们的观念也在逐渐转变。
pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì fāzhǎn, rénmen de guānniàn yě zài zhújiàn zhuǎnbiàn.
en: As the economy develops, people's attitudes are gradually shifting too.

zh: 他是博士。
pinyin: Tā shì博士。
en: He is a doctor.

zh: 我爸爸是大学博士。
pinyin: Wǒ bàba shì dàxué博士。
en: My dad has a doctorate from university.

zh: 因为她学习很好，所以她成为了博士。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā xuéxí hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ tā chéngwéile博士。
en: Because she studied hard, she became a doctor.

zh: 那位博士虽然年纪不大，但是他的研究非常有名。
pinyin: Nàwèi博士 suīrán niánjì búdà, dànshì tā de yánjiū fēicháng yǒumíng。
en: Although that doctor is quite young, his research is very well-known.

zh: 获得博士学位需要多年的努力和坚持。
pinyin: Huòdé博士 xuéwèi xūyào duō nián de nǔlì hé jiānchí。
en: Earning a doctorate requires years of effort and persistence.

zh: 直到晚上我才吃饭。
pinyin: Zhídào wǎnshang wǒ cái chīfàn.
en: I didn't eat until evening.

zh: 直到妈妈回家，孩子才睡觉。
pinyin: Zhídào māma huíjiā, háizi cái shuìjiào.
en: The child didn't go to sleep until mom came home.

zh: 虽然很累，但他直到完成工作才休息。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn tā zhídào wánchéng gōngzuò cái xiūxi.
en: Although he was exhausted, he didn't rest until he finished the work.

zh: 直到看了这部电影，我才明白他想表达什么。
pinyin: Zhídào kànle zhè bù diànyǐng, wǒ cái míngbai tā xiǎng biǎodá shénme.
en: It wasn't until I watched this film that I understood what he was trying to say.

zh: 直到经历了那次失败，他才意识到坚持的重要性。
pinyin: Zhídào jīnglìle nà cì shībài, tā cái yìshi dào jiānchí de zhòngyàoxìng.
en: Only after experiencing that failure did he realize how important persistence really is.

zh: 我很紧张。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng.
en: I'm very nervous.

zh: 考试的时候我有点紧张。
pinyin: Kǎoshì de shíhou wǒ yǒudiǎn jǐnzhāng.
en: I'm a bit nervous during exams.

zh: 虽然准备得很充分，但我上台前还是很紧张。
pinyin: Suīrán zhǔnbèi de hěn chōngfèn, dàn wǒ shàngtái qián háishi hěn jǐnzhāng.
en: Even though I prepared thoroughly, I was still very nervous before going on stage.

zh: 他因为害怕失败而感到紧张，这影响了他的表现。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi hàipà shībài érshì gǎndào jǐnzhāng, zhè yǐngxiǎngle tā de biǎoxiàn.
en: He felt nervous because of his fear of failure, which affected his performance.

zh: 工作压力太大的时候，很多人会变得紧张，甚至影响睡眠质量。
pinyin: Gōngzuò yālì tài dà de shíhou, hěnduō rén huì biàn de jǐnzhāng, shènzhì yǐngxiǎng shuìmián zhìliàng.
en: When work stress gets too high, many people become tense and even experience problems with sleep quality.

zh: 我有两个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liǎng ge píngguǒ.
en: I have two apples.

zh: 今天是星期二，我要去上课。
pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqī'èr, wǒ yào qù shàngkè.
en: Today is Tuesday, and I need to go to class.

zh: 虽然他第二次考试失败了，但是他没有放弃。
pinyin: Suīrán tā dì'èr cì kǎoshì shībài le, dànshì tā méiyǒu fàngqì.
en: Although he failed the second exam, he didn't give up.

zh: 这家餐厅有两种特色菜，我推荐你尝尝第二种。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng yǒu liǎng zhǒng tèsè cài, wǒ tuījiàn nǐ chángchang dì'èr zhǒng.
en: This restaurant has two signature dishes; I recommend you try the second one.

zh: 他第二次创业终于成功了，这次他吸取了之前的教训。
pinyin: Tā dì'èr cì chuàngyè zhōngyú chénggōng le, zhè cì tā xīqǔ le zhīqián de jiàoxun.
en: His second startup finally succeeded; this time he learned from his previous mistakes.

zh: 这个苹果简直太甜了。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ jiǎnzhí tài tián le.
en: This apple is just so sweet.

zh: 昨天的天气简直太冷了，我都不想出门。
pinyin: Zuótiān de tiānqì jiǎnzhí tài lěng le, wǒ dōu búxiǎng chūmén.
en: Yesterday's weather was absolutely freezing; I didn't even want to go out.

zh: 虽然他只学了一个月，但是他的中文简直进步得很快。
pinyin: Suīrán tā zhǐ xuéle yī ge yuè, dànshi tā de zhōngwén jiǎnzhí jìnbù de hěn kuài.
en: Even though he's only been studying for a month, his Chinese has made absolutely amazing progress.

zh: 他对工作的态度简直不负责任，经常迟到还经常出错。
pinyin: Tā duì gōngzuò de tàidù jiǎnzhí búfù zérènxin, jīngcháng chídào háishi jīngcháng chūcuò.
en: His attitude toward work is frankly irresponsible—he's always late and constantly makes mistakes.

zh: 这部电影的剧情简直一团糟，我真后悔花钱买票看它。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de jùqing jiǎnzhí yī tuán zāo, wǒ zhēn hòuhuǐ huāqián mǎi piào kàn tā.
en: This movie's plot is absolutely a mess; I genuinely regret paying to see it.

zh: 我放弃了。
pinyin: Wǒ fàngqì le.
en: I give up.

zh: 他不想放弃这个机会。
pinyin: Tā búxiǎng fàngqì zhège jīhuì.
en: He doesn't want to give up this opportunity.

zh: 虽然很困难，但我不会放弃学习中文。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn kùnnan, dàn wǒ búhuì fàngqì xuéxí zhōngwén.
en: Although it's very difficult, I won't give up learning Chinese.

zh: 因为工作压力太大，他考虑放弃这份工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò yālì tài dà, tā kǎolǜ fàngqì zhè fèn gōngzuò.
en: Because the work pressure was so intense, he's considering quitting this job.

zh: 许多创业者在失败面前选择放弃，但成功者从不放弃希望。
pinyin: Xǔduō chuàngyèzhě zài shībài miànqián xuǎnzé fàngqì, dàn chénggōngzhě cóngbù fàngqì xīwàng.
en: Many entrepreneurs give up when facing failure, but successful people never abandon hope.

zh: 那个小子很淘气。
pinyin: Nàge xiǎozi hěn táoqì.
en: That kid is really mischievous.

zh: 这个小子昨天吃了很多糖。
pinyin: Zhège xiǎozi zuótiān chīle hěnduō táng.
en: This little guy ate a lot of candy yesterday.

zh: 虽然小子很小，但是他很聪明。
pinyin: Suīrán xiǎozi hěn xiǎo, dànshi tā hěn cōngming.
en: Although the kid is young, he's actually quite smart.

zh: 这小子最近在学校表现得不错，老师都夸他。
pinyin: Zhè xiǎozi zuìjìn zài xuéxiào biǎoxiàn de búcuò, lǎoshī dōu kuā tā.
en: This boy has been doing pretty well at school lately, and the teachers praise him.

zh: 别看这小子年纪小，他的想法已经比很多大人都成熟了。
pinyin: Biékàn zhè xiǎozi niánjì xiǎo, tā de xiǎngfǎ yǐjīng bǐ hěnduō dàrén dōu chéngshú le.
en: Don't let his age fool you—this kid's thinking is already more mature than many adults.

zh: 我喜欢看电视。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān kàn diànshì.
en: I like watching TV.

zh: 每天晚上我都看电视。
pinyin: Měitiān wǎnshang wǒ dōu kàn diànshì.
en: I watch TV every evening.

zh: 虽然电视很有趣，但是我没有太多时间看。
pinyin: Suīrán diànshì hěn yǒuqù, dànshì wǒ méiyǒu tàiduō shíjiān kàn.
en: Although TV is interesting, I don't have much time to watch it.

zh: 现在很多年轻人不再经常看电视，他们更喜欢用手机。
pinyin: Xiànzài hěnduō niánqīng rén búzài jīngcháng kàn diànshì, tāmen gèng xǐhuān yòng shǒujī.
en: Nowadays, many young people don't watch TV as often anymore; they prefer using their phones.

zh: 虽然流媒体平台兴起，但传统电视仍然在家庭娱乐中占据重要地位。
pinyin: Suīrán liúméitǐ píngtái xīngqǐ, dàn chuántǒng diànshì réngránzài jiātíng yúlè zhōng zhànjù zhòngyào dìwèi.
en: Despite the rise of streaming platforms, traditional television still holds an important place in home entertainment.

zh: 他很强。
pinyin: Tā hěn qiáng.
en: He is very strong.

zh: 这个运动员比那个强。
pinyin: Zhège yùndòngyuán bǐ nàge qiáng.
en: This athlete is stronger than that one.

zh: 虽然他个子不高，但他很强壮。
pinyin: Suīrán tā gezǐ búgāo, dànshì tā hěn qiángzhuàng.
en: Although he's not tall, he's very muscular and strong.

zh: 因为长期训练，他的身体变得很强。
pinyin: Yīnwèi chángqī xùnliàn, tāde shēntǐ biàn de hěn qiáng.
en: Because of long-term training, his body has become very strong.

zh: 我们公司在行业里实力很强，但不能骄傲自满。
pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī zài hángyè lǐ shílì hěn qiáng, dàn búnéng jiāo'ào zìmǎn.
en: Our company has strong capabilities in the industry, but we can't become arrogant and complacent.

zh: 我不好意思问你。
pinyin: Wǒ búhǎo yìsi wèn nǐ.
en: I'm embarrassed to ask you.

zh: 他昨天迟到了，有点不好意思。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān chídào le, yǒudiǎn búhǎo yìsi.
en: He arrived late yesterday and felt a bit awkward about it.

zh: 因为我英语不好，所以不好意思在课堂上说话。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ yīngyǔ búhǎo, suǒyǐ búhǎo yìsi zài kètáng shang shuōhuà.
en: Because my English isn't good, I feel self-conscious about speaking in class.

zh: 她虽然很想帮你，但是不好意思开口借钱给你。
pinyin: Tā suīrán hěn xiǎng bāng nǐ, búshì búhǎo yìsi kāikǒu jiè qián gěi nǐ.
en: Although she really wants to help you, she feels awkward about actually offering to lend you money.

zh: 我们第一次见面就谈工资，他看起来有点不好意思，气氛有些尴尬。
pinyin: Wǒmen dì yī cì jiànmiàn jiù tán gōngzī, tā kànqǐlai yǒudiǎn búhǎo yìsi, qìfēn yǒuxiē gānggà.
en: We talked about salary on our first meeting, and he seemed a bit uncomfortable—the atmosphere got pretty awkward.

zh: 我的女儿很可爱。
pinyin: Wǒ de nǚ'ér hěn kě'ài.
en: My daughter is very cute.

zh: 昨天我女儿在学校吃了午饭。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ nǚ'ér zài xuéxiào chīle wǔfàn.
en: Yesterday my daughter had lunch at school.

zh: 因为女儿喜欢唱歌，所以我给她买了一个麦克风。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nǚ'ér xǐhuān chànggē, suǒyǐ wǒ gěi tā mǎile yī ge màikèfēng.
en: Because my daughter likes singing, I bought her a microphone.

zh: 我女儿虽然才八岁，但是她已经能读比较复杂的书了。
pinyin: Wǒ nǚ'ér suīrán cái bā suì, dànshì tā yǐjīng néng dú bǐjiào fùzá de shū le.
en: Although my daughter is only eight years old, she can already read fairly complex books.

zh: 女儿从小就对科学感兴趣，现在高中了，还是坚持参加各种科技竞赛。
pinyin: Nǚ'ér cóngxiǎo jiù duì kēxué gǎn xìngqù, xiànzài gāozhōng le, háishi jiānchí cānjiā gèzhǒng kējì jìngsài.
en: My daughter has been interested in science since childhood, and now that she's in high school, she still keeps participating in various science competitions.

zh: 我大概十岁。
pinyin: Wǒ dàgài shí suì.
en: I'm roughly ten years old.

zh: 明天大概会下雨吧。
pinyin: Míngtiān dàgài huì xiàyǔ ba.
en: It'll probably rain tomorrow.

zh: 因为今天很忙，所以我大概晚上七点才能到。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān hěn máng, suǒyǐ wǒ dàgài wǎnshang qī diǎn cái néng dào.
en: Since I'm busy today, I'll probably only arrive around 7 PM.

zh: 这家饭店的菜虽然便宜，但大概口味不太特别。
pinyin: Zhè jiā fàndiàn de cài suīrán piányi, dàn dàgài kǒuwèi bújiǔ tèbié.
en: Although this restaurant's dishes are affordable, the flavors are probably pretty ordinary.

zh: 根据天气预报，明天大概率会堵车，建议你提前出门。
pinyin: Gēnjù tiānqì yùbào, míngtiān dàgài lǜ huì dǔchē, jiànyì nǐ tíqián chūmén.
en: According to the weather forecast, there's a high probability of traffic tomorrow, so I'd suggest leaving early.

zh: 这个苹果的确很好吃。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ de quèshí hěn hǎochī.
en: This apple is really delicious.

zh: 昨天的天气的确很冷。
pinyin: Zuótiān de tiānqì de quèshí hěn lěng.
en: Yesterday's weather was indeed very cold.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但他的确很想来帮我们。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn tā de quèshí hěn xiǎng lái bāngzhù wǒmen.
en: Although he's busy, he really does want to come help us.

zh: 这部电影的确比上一部更有意思，很多人都说好。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de quèshí bǐ shàngyī bù gèng yǒu yìsi, hěnduō rén dōu shuō hǎo.
en: This movie is definitely more interesting than the last one; lots of people think it's great.

zh: 他的英文能力的确不错，但在实际工作中还是需要继续提高。
pinyin: Tā de yīngwén néngbì de quèshí búcuò, dàn zài shíjì gōngzuò zhōng háishi xūyào jìxù tígāo.
en: His English skills are genuinely solid, but in actual work he still needs to keep improving.

zh: 这个菜特别好吃。
pinyin: Zhège cài tèbié hǎochī.
en: This dish is especially delicious.

zh: 今天天气特别冷，我穿了很厚的衣服。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì tèbié lěng, wǒ chuānle hěn hòu de yīfu.
en: The weather today is particularly cold, so I wore very thick clothes.

zh: 因为明天有特殊的会议，所以大家都提前准备了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi míngtiān yǒu tèshū de huìyì, suǒyǐ dàjiā dōu tíqián zhǔnbèile.
en: Because there's a special meeting tomorrow, everyone prepared in advance.

zh: 他有一个特点就是做事很认真，虽然有时候比较慢。
pinyin: Tā yǒu yīge tèdiǎn jiùshì zuòshì hěn rènzhēn, suīrán yǒushíhou bǐjiào màn.
en: His particular strength is that he's very conscientious about his work, even though he can be a bit slow sometimes.

zh: 这家咖啡馆特别受欢迎，不仅因为环境舒适，更因为老板特有的经营理念。
pinyin: Zhè jiā kāfēiguǎn tèbié shòu huānyíng, búnjǐn yīnwèi huánjìng shūshì, gèng yīnwèi lǎobǎn tèyǒu de jīngyíng lǐniàn.
en: This café is particularly popular, not only because of its comfortable environment, but especially because of the owner's unique business philosophy.

zh: 我吃药了。
pinyin: Wǒ chī yào le.
en: I took medicine.

zh: 他生病了，妈妈给他买药。
pinyin: Tā shēngbìng le, māma gěi tā mǎi yào.
en: He got sick, so Mom bought him medicine.

zh: 因为头疼，我吃了药以后感觉好多了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tóu téng, wǒ chīle yào yǐhòu gǎnjuéde hǎo duō le.
en: Because I had a headache, I felt much better after taking medicine.

zh: 虽然这种药很苦，但是对治疗咳嗽特别有效果。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè zhǒng yào hěn kǔ, dànshì duì zhìliáo késou tèbié yǒu xiàoguǒ.
en: Although this medicine tastes bitter, it's especially effective for treating coughs.

zh: 医生建议我坚持吃这种药三个月，才能从根本上解决问题。
pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì wǒ jiānchí chī zhè zhǒng yào sān ge yuè, cái néng cóng gēnběn shang jiějué wèntí.
en: The doctor advised me to take this medicine consistently for three months to fundamentally solve the problem.

zh: 我回到家。
pinyin: Wǒ huídào jiā.
en: I went back home.

zh: 他昨天回到了北京。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān huídào le běi jīng.
en: He returned to Beijing yesterday.

zh: 虽然很累，但是我还是回到了办公室。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ háishi huídào le bàngōngshì.
en: Although I was tired, I still went back to the office.

zh: 工作完成后，她立刻回到了自己的座位上。
pinyin: Gōngzuò wánchéng hòu, tā lìkè huídào le zìjǐ de zuòwèi shang.
en: After finishing the work, she immediately returned to her seat.

zh: 经过了这么多年的漂泊，他终于回到了童年的那条街道。
pinyin: Jīngguò le zhème duō nián de piāobō, tā zhōngyú huídào le tóngnián de nà tiáo jiēdào.
en: After all those years of wandering, he finally returned to the street where he spent his childhood.

zh: 这个男孩很高。
pinyin: Zhège nánháizi hěn gāo.
en: This boy is very tall.

zh: 那个男孩每天都去公园。
pinyin: Nàge nánháizi měi tiān dōu qù gōngyuán.
en: That boy goes to the park every day.

zh: 因为男孩喜欢足球，所以他常常在外面踢球。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nánháizi xǐhuān zúqiú, suǒyǐ tā chángcháng zài wàimiàn tī qiú.
en: Because the boy likes soccer, he often plays outside.

zh: 那个男孩虽然很调皮，但是他的数学成绩特别好。
pinyin: Nàge nánháizi suīrán hěn tiáo皮, dànshì tāde shùxué chéngjī tèbié hǎo.
en: Although that boy is quite mischievous, his math grades are particularly excellent.

zh: 这个男孩从小就展现出对音乐的天赋，现在已经能演奏好几种乐器了。
pinyin: Zhège nánháizi cóng xiǎo jiù zhǎnxiàn chūlái duì yīnyuè de tiānfù, xiànzài yǐjīng néng yǎnzòu hǎo jǐ zhǒng yuèqì le.
en: This boy has shown a talent for music since childhood, and by now he's able to play several different instruments.

zh: 我喜欢音乐。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān yīnyuè.
en: I like music.

zh: 每天晚上我听音乐。
pinyin: Měitiān wǎnshang wǒ tīng yīnyuè.
en: I listen to music every evening.

zh: 因为喜欢音乐，所以我买了很多CD。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xǐhuān yīnyuè, suǒyǐ wǒ mǎile hěnduō CD.
en: Because I like music, I've bought a lot of CDs.

zh: 虽然音乐课很有意思，但是我更喜欢运动。
pinyin: Suīrán yīnyuè kè hěn yǒu yìsi, dànshì wǒ gèng xǐhuān yùndòng.
en: Although music class is interesting, I actually prefer sports.

zh: 他对音乐的热情从未改变，不管生活多么困难。
pinyin: Tā duì yīnyuè de règing cóngwèi gǎibiàn, búguǎn shēnghuó duōme kùnnan.
en: His passion for music has never wavered, no matter how difficult life has been.

zh: 我的身体很好。
pinyin: Wǒ de shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
en: My body is in good shape.

zh: 每天运动对身体很有好处。
pinyin: Měitiān yùndòng duì shēntǐ hěn yǒu hǎochu.
en: Exercising every day is really good for your body.

zh: 虽然他很累，但是他的身体还是很强壮。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn lèi, dànshì tā de shēntǐ háishi hěn qiángzhuàng.
en: Although he's exhausted, his body is still quite strong.

zh: 长期压力会影响我们的身体健康和心理状态。
pinyin: Chángqī yālì huì yǐngxiǎng wǒmen de shēntǐ jiànkāng hé xīnlǐ zhuàngtài.
en: Prolonged stress can affect both our physical health and mental state.

zh: 现代人工作繁忙，往往忽视了身体的信号，等到问题严重才去就医。
pinyin: Xiàndài rén gōngzuò fánmáng, wǎngwǎng hūshìle shēntǐ de xìnhào, děngdào wèntí yánzhòng cái qù jiùyī.
en: Modern people are busy with work and often ignore what their body is telling them, waiting until problems become serious before seeing a doctor.

zh: 他的血型是O型。
pinyin: Tā de xuèxíng shì O xíng.
en: His blood type is O.

zh: 医生说我需要检查血糖。
pinyin: Yīshēng shuō wǒ xūyào jiǎnchá xuètáng.
