en: The doctor said I need to have my blood sugar checked.

zh: 因为他失血太多，所以医生给他输血。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā shīxiě tài duō, suǒyǐ yīshēng gěi tā shūxiě.
en: Because he lost too much blood, the doctor gave him a blood transfusion.

zh: 献血虽然只需要十分钟，但对病人很重要。
pinyin: Xiànxiě suīrán zhǐ xūyào shí fēnzhōng, dàn duì bìngrén hěn zhòngyào.
en: Although donating blood only takes ten minutes, it's very important for patients.

zh: 最近的体检报告显示我的血压和血脂都有点偏高。
pinyin: Zuìjìn de tǐjiǎn bàogào xiǎnshì wǒ de xuèyā hé xuèzhī dōu yǒudiǎn piānhāo.
en: My recent physical exam shows that both my blood pressure and cholesterol are a bit on the high side.

zh: 我留下了一个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ liúxià le yī ge píngguǒ.
en: I left an apple behind.

zh: 妈妈给我留下了一些钱。
pinyin: Māma gěi wǒ liúxià le yīxiē qián.
en: Mom left some money for me.

zh: 虽然他走了，但是留下了很多好回忆。
pinyin: Suīrán tā zǒu le, dànshì liúxià le hěnduō hǎo huíyì.
en: Although he left, he left behind many good memories.

zh: 这次经历在我心里留下了深刻的印象。
pinyin: Zhè cì jīnglì zài wǒ xīnlǐ liúxià le shēnkè de yìnxiàng.
en: This experience left a deep impression on my mind.

zh: 那段艰苦的日子虽然过去了，但留下的教训至今还影响着我的选择。
pinyin: Nà duàn jiānkǔ de rìzi suīrán guòqu le, dàn liúxià de jiàoxun zhìjīn háiyǐ háiyǐng xiǎngzhe wǒ de xuǎnzé.
en: Those difficult days are long gone, but the lessons they left behind still influence my choices today.

zh: 我们用这种方式吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒmen yòng zhè zhǒng fāngshì chīfàn.
en: We eat in this way.

zh: 学生们每天用不同的方式学习。
pinyin: Xuéshēngmen měi tiān yòng búntóng de fāngshì xuéxí.
en: Students study using different methods every day.

zh: 虽然他的方式很特别，但是很有效果。
pinyin: Suīrán tā de fāngshì hěn tèbié, búshì hěn yǒu xiàoguǒ.
en: Although his approach is unusual, it's actually very effective.

zh: 公司改变了沟通方式以更好地服务客户。
pinyin: Gōngsī gǎibiànle gōutōng fāngshì yǐ gèng hǎo de fúwù kèhù.
en: The company changed its communication method to better serve customers.

zh: 现代人倾向于用数字化方式管理生活和工作。
pinyin: Xiàndài rén qīngxiàng yú yòng shùzìhuà fāngshì guǎnlǐ shēnghuó hé gōngzuò.
en: Modern people tend to manage their lives and work through digital methods.

zh: 他摔伤了腿。
pinyin: Tā shuāi shāngle tuǐ.
en: He hurt his leg when he fell.

zh: 昨天我在运动的时候伤了手。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài yùndòng de shíhou shāngle shǒu.
en: I injured my hand while exercising yesterday.

zh: 虽然他伤得很重，但是他还是坚持上班。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shāng de hěn zhòng, dànshi tā háishi jiānchí shàngbān.
en: Although his injury was serious, he still insisted on going to work.

zh: 长期的压力会伤害身体健康，所以要学会放松。
pinyin: Chángqī de yālì huì shānghài shēntǐ jiànkāng, suǒyǐ yào xuéhuì fàngsōng.
en: Prolonged stress can damage your physical health, so you need to learn to relax.

zh: 他那些伤人的言论引起了很多人的反感和不满。
pinyin: Tā nàxiē shāngrén de yánlùn yǐnqǐle hěnduō rén de fǎngǎn hé búmǎn.
en: His hurtful remarks provoked a lot of resentment and dissatisfaction among people.

zh: 这个味道很怪。
pinyin: Zhège wèidào hěn guài.
en: This taste is strange.

zh: 他今天穿得很怪,我不认识他。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān chuān de hěn guài, wǒ búrènshi tā.
en: He dressed so oddly today that I didn't recognize him.

zh: 虽然这个故事很怪,但是小孩子都喜欢听。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège gùshì hěn guài, dànshi xiǎo háizi dōu xǐhuān tīng.
en: Although the story is quite bizarre, children love listening to it.

zh: 他最近的行为有点怪,我担心他可能遇到了什么问题。
pinyin: Tā zuìjìn de xíngwéi yǒudiǎn guài, wǒ dānxin tā kěnéng yùdàole shénme wèntí.
en: His behavior has been a bit off lately, and I'm worried he might be dealing with something.

zh: 这个地方确实有点怪,当地人都说这里经常发生奇怪的事情。
pinyin: Zhège dìfang quèshí yǒudiǎn guài, dāngdì rén dōu shuō zhèlǐ jīngcháng fāshēng qíguài de shìqing.
en: This place really is peculiar—locals say strange things happen here all the time.

zh: 一美元很便宜。
pinyin: Yī měiyuán hěn piányí.
en: One dollar is very cheap.

zh: 这个苹果要五美元。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ yào wǔ měiyuán.
en: This apple costs five dollars.

zh: 因为没有美元，所以我用人民币付钱。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu měiyuán, suǒyǐ wǒ yòng rénmínbì fùqián.
en: Because I didn't have dollars, I paid with yuan instead.

zh: 虽然美元升值了，但是这家店的商品价格没有变。
pinyin: Suīrán měiyuán shēngzhíle, dànshì zhè jiā diàn de shāngpǐn jiàgé méiyǒu biàn.
en: Although the dollar has appreciated, this store's prices haven't changed.

zh: 最近美元汇率波动比较大，很多人都在关注汇率的变化。
pinyin: Zuìjìn měiyuán huìlǜ bōdòng bǐjiào dà, hěnduō rén dōu zài guānzhù huìlǜ de biànhuà.
en: The dollar exchange rate has been fluctuating quite a bit lately, and lots of people are paying attention to how it changes.

zh: 他在监狱里。
pinyin: Tā zài jiānyù lǐ.
en: He is in prison.

zh: 那个人因为犯罪去了监狱。
pinyin: Nàge rén yīnwèi fànzuì qù le jiānyù.
en: That person went to prison because he committed a crime.

zh: 虽然他在监狱里，但是他家人还是经常去看他。
pinyin: Suīrán tā zài jiānyù lǐ, búguò tā jiārén háishi jīngcháng qù kàn tā.
en: Even though he's in prison, his family still visits him regularly.

zh: 因为没有足够的证据，警察不能把他送进监狱。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu zúgòu de zhèngjù, jǐngchá búnéng bǎ tā sòngjìn jiānyù.
en: Because there wasn't enough evidence, the police couldn't send him to prison.

zh: 他服刑五年后终于从监狱释放，重新开始了新的生活。
pinyin: Tā fúxíng wǔ nián hòu zhōngyú cóng jiānyù shìfàng, chóngxīn kāishǐ le xīn de shēnghuó.
en: After serving a five-year sentence, he was finally released from prison and started a new life.

zh: 我读书。
pinyin: Wǒ dú shū.
en: I read books.

zh: 她每天读一个小时。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dú yī gè xiǎo shí.
en: She reads for one hour every day.

zh: 因为喜欢这个故事，所以他读了两遍。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xǐhuān zhège gùshi, suǒyǐ tā duéle liǎng biàn.
en: Because he liked the story, he read it twice.

zh: 虽然这本书很难，但她还是坚持读完了。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè běn shū hěn nán, dànshì tā háishi jiānchí duéwánle.
en: Although the book was difficult, she persisted and finished reading it.

zh: 他从小就喜欢读书，现在已经读过上百本文学作品了。
pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo jiù xǐhuān dúshū, xiànzài yǐjīng guòle shàng bǎi běn wénxué zuòpǐn le.
en: He's loved reading since childhood and has now read over a hundred literary works.

zh: 这边有饭。
pinyin: Zhèbiān yǒu fàn.
en: There's food over here.

zh: 早上我在这边吃早饭。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ zài zhèbiān chī zǎofàn.
en: I eat breakfast over here in the morning.

zh: 虽然这边离学校近，但是这边很贵。
pinyin: Suīrán zhèbiān lí xuéxiào jìn, dànshì zhèbiān hěn guì.
en: Even though it's close to school over here, it's quite expensive.

zh: 你可以先去这边办理登记，然后在那边等待。
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ xiānqù zhèbiān bànlǐ děngjì, ránhòu zài nàbiān děngdài.
en: You can register over here first, and then wait over there afterward.

zh: 关于这个问题，我们这边的看法和你们那边有些不同。
pinyin: Guānyú zhège wèntí, wǒmen zhèbiān de kànfǎ hé nǐmen nàbiān yǒuxiē búdòng.
en: Regarding this issue, our perspective on this side differs somewhat from yours over there.

zh: 我重新吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ chóngxīn chīfàn.
en: I'm eating again.

zh: 他弄坏了，需要重新买一个。
pinyin: Tā nònghuài le, xūyào chóngxīn mǎi yī gè.
en: He broke it, so he needs to buy a new one.

zh: 虽然第一次失败了，但是我决定重新尝试。
pinyin: Suīrán dì yī cì shībài le, dànshì wǒ juédìng chóngxīn chángshì.
en: Although I failed the first time, I've decided to try again.

zh: 因为数据不准确，我们必须重新检查所有的信息。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shùjù búzhǔnquè, wǒmen bìxū chóngxīn jiǎnchá suǒyǒu de xìnxī.
en: Because the data was inaccurate, we had to verify all the information again.

zh: 这个项目虽然投入了很多资源，但效果不理想，所以公司决定重新评估整个策略。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù suīrán tóuruò le hěnduō zīyuán, dàn xiàoguǒ búlǐxiǎng, suǒyǐ gōngsī juédìng chóngxīn píngūgu zhěnggè cèlüè.
en: Although the project had consumed a lot of resources, the results were disappointing, so the company decided to reassess the whole strategy.

zh: 你瞧，这是我的狗。
pinyin: Nǐ qiào, zhè shì wǒ de gǒu.
en: Look, this is my dog.

zh: 早上我瞧见了一只很大的鸟。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ qiàojiàn le yī zhī hěn dà de niǎo.
en: This morning I spotted a really big bird.

zh: 虽然天黑了，但我还能瞧见前面的路。
pinyin: Suīrán tiān hēi le, dàn wǒ háinéng qiàojiàn qiánmiàn de lù.
en: Even though it's dark, I can still see the road ahead.

zh: 他瞧不起别人的想法，总是坚持自己的意见。
pinyin: Tā qiàobuqǐ biérén de xiǎngfǎ, zǒngshì jiānchí zìjǐ de yìjiàn.
en: He looks down on other people's ideas and always insists on his own opinion.

zh: 从他的表情瞧得出来，这个消息让他既高兴又有点担心。
pinyin: Cóng tā de biǎoqíng qiàodechu chūlái, zhège xiāoxi ràng tā jì gāoxìng yòu yǒudiǎn dānxin.
en: You can tell from his expression that this news made him both happy and a bit worried.

zh: 他疯狂地笑了。
pinyin: Tā fēngkuáng de xiào le.
en: He laughed wildly.

zh: 昨天的派对很疯狂，每个人都很开心。
pinyin: Zuótiān de pàiduì hěn fēngkuáng, měi ge rén dōu hěn kāixīn.
en: Yesterday's party was crazy—everyone had a great time.

zh: 因为天气很热，人们疯狂地买冰淇淋。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn rè, rénmen fēngkuáng de mǎi bīngqīlín.
en: Because it was so hot, people went crazy buying ice cream.

zh: 他对足球的热爱疯狂到每天都要练习好几个小时。
pinyin: Tā duì zúqiú de règài fēngkuáng dào měi tiān dōu yào liànxí hǎo jǐ ge xiǎoshí.
en: His passion for soccer is so crazy that he practices for several hours every single day.

zh: 那部电影上映后，粉丝们疯狂地追捧，票房一下子就破了纪录。
pinyin: Nà bù diànyǐng shàngyìng hòu, fěnsīmen fēngkuáng de zhuīpěng, piàofáng yīxià zi jiù pòle jìlù.
en: After that movie came out, fans went absolutely wild for it, and the box office broke records right away.

zh: 我收到了一个包。
pinyin: Wǒ shōudào le yī ge bāo.
en: I received a package.

zh: 昨天我收到了妈妈的信。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ shōudào le māma de xìn.
en: Yesterday I got a letter from my mom.

zh: 因为天气不好，所以我没有收到快递。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, suǒyǐ wǒ méiyǒu shōudào kuàidì.
en: Because the weather was bad, I didn't receive my delivery.

zh: 我已经收到了你的邮件，明天会回复你。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng shōudào le nǐ de yóujiàn, míngtiān huì huīfù nǐ.
en: I've already received your email and will reply to you tomorrow.

zh: 虽然收到了通知，但是具体什么时候开始还没有确定。
pinyin: Suīrán shōudào le tōngzhī, búguò jùtǐ shénme shíhou kāishǐ háishi méiyǒu quèdìng.
en: Although I received the notice, it's still unclear exactly when things will start.

zh: 我有三个苹果，其中两个是红的。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu sān ge píngguǒ, qīzhōng liǎng ge shì hóng de.
en: I have three apples, and two of them are red.

zh: 这个班有二十个学生，其中一半是女生。
pinyin: Zhège bān yǒu èrshí ge xuésheng, qīzhōng yībàn shì nǚsheng.
en: This class has twenty students, half of whom are girls.

zh: 我去过很多城市，其中北京和上海最喜欢。
pinyin: Wǒ qùguò hěnduō chéngshì, qīzhōng Běijīng hé Shànghǎi zuì xǐhuān.
en: I've been to many cities, and I like Beijing and Shanghai the most.

zh: 公司招聘了五十名员工，其中大部分来自不同的地区。
pinyin: Gōngsī zhāopìnle wǔshí míng yuángōng, qīzhōng dàbùfen lái zì búntóng de dìqū.
en: The company hired fifty employees, most of whom are from different regions.

zh: 研究团队分析了市场数据，其中消费者的反馈意见对产品改进起到了关键作用。
pinyin: Yánjiū tuánduì fēnxīle shìchǎng shùjù, qīzhōng xiāofèizhě de fǎnkuì yìjiàn duì chǎnpǐn gǎijìn qǐdào le guānjiàn zuòyòng.
en: The research team analyzed market data, and consumer feedback among it played a crucial role in product improvement.

zh: 我吃一片面包。
pinyin: Wǒ chī yī piàn miànbāo.
en: I'm eating a slice of bread.

zh: 昨天我看了一片电影。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ kànle yī piàn diànyǐng.
en: Yesterday I watched a movie.

zh: 虽然这片地方很小，但是很安静。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè piàn dìfang hěn xiǎo, dànshì hěn ānjìng.
en: Although this area is small, it's very quiet.

zh: 因为这片云彩遮住了太阳，所以今天特别冷。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè piàn yúncǎi zhēzhùle tàiyáng, suǒyǐ jīntiān tèbié lěng.
en: Because those clouds are blocking the sun, it's especially cold today.

zh: 他对这片行业的前景很乐观，打算投资更多资金。
pinyin: Tā duì zhè piàn hángyè de qiánjǐng hěn lèguān, dǎsuàn tóuzī gèngduō zījīn.
en: He's optimistic about the prospects in this industry and plans to invest more capital.

zh: 我的想法很简单。
pinyin: Wǒ de xiǎngfǎ hěn jiǎndān.
en: My idea is very simple.

zh: 昨天我有一个新想法。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ yǒu yīgè xīn xiǎngfǎ.
en: I had a new idea yesterday.

zh: 虽然他的想法很好，但是我不同意。
pinyin: Suīrán tā de xiǎngfǎ hěn hǎo, dànshì wǒ búdòngyì.
en: Although his idea is good, I don't agree with it.

zh: 我们决定采纳她的想法，因为它很实用。
pinyin: Wǒmen juédìng cǎinà tā de xiǎngfǎ, yīnwèi tā hěn shíyòng.
en: We decided to adopt her idea because it's very practical.

zh: 虽然他的想法有些不切实际，但我们还是听取了他的建议。
pinyin: Suīrán tā de xiǎngfǎ yǒuxiē búqiè shíjì, dàn wǒmen háishi tīngqǔ le tā de jiànyì.
en: Even though his ideas were somewhat unrealistic, we still took his suggestions into consideration.

zh: 我在纽约。
pinyin: Wǒ zài Niǔyuē.
en: I'm in New York.

zh: 去年我去了纽约旅游。
pinyin: Qùnián wǒ qùle Niǔyuē lǚyóu.
en: I went to New York for a trip last year.

zh: 因为工作的原因，他搬到了纽约生活。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò de yuányīn, tā bāndàole Niǔyuē shēnghuó.
en: Because of work, he moved to New York to live.

zh: 纽约虽然很贵，但那里有很多有意思的工作机会。
pinyin: Niǔyuē suīrán hěn guì, dàn nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō yǒu yìsi de gōngzuò jīhuì.
en: Although New York is expensive, there are lots of interesting job opportunities there.

zh: 许多创意产业的从业者都梦想能在纽约发展自己的事业。
pinyin: Xǔduō chuàngyì chǎnyè de cóngyèzhě dōu mèngxiǎng néng zài Niǔyuē fāzhǎn zìjǐ de shìyè.
en: Many creative professionals dream of developing their careers in New York.

zh: 我家里有一只猫。
pinyin: Wǒ jiālǐ yǒu yī zhī māo.
en: I have a cat at home.

zh: 今天我在家里吃午饭。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ zài jiālǐ chī wǔfàn.
en: Today I'm eating lunch at home.

zh: 因为天气很冷，所以我家里开了暖气。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ jiālǐ kāile nuǎnqì.
en: Because the weather is cold, we've turned on the heating at home.

zh: 虽然我家里离学校很远，但是我每天都坚持去上课。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ jiālǐ lí xuéxiào hěn yuǎn, dànshì wǒ měitiān dōu jiānchí qù shàngkè.
en: Although my home is far from school, I still make the effort to go to class every day.

zh: 自从父亲退休以后，家里的气氛就变得轻松多了，他经常在家里教我做饭。
pinyin: Zìcóng fùqin tuì休 yǐhòu, jiālǐ de qìfēn jiù biànde qīngsōng duō le, tā jīngcháng zài jiālǐ jiāo wǒ zuòfàn.
en: Since my father retired, the atmosphere at home has become much more relaxed, and he often teaches me how to cook.

zh: 我的猫是黑色。
pinyin: Wǒ de māo shì hēi sè.
en: My cat is black.

zh: 昨天晚上天很黑，我看不见路。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang tiān hěn hēi, wǒ kànbújiàn lù.
en: Last night it was so dark I couldn't see the road.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以天变得很黑，我们决定早点回家。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ tiān biàn de hěn hēi, wǒmen juéding zǎodiǎn huí jiā.
en: Because it was raining, the sky got very dark, so we decided to go home early.

zh: 他在黑暗中工作了几个小时，眼睛很累，看东西都有点模糊。
pinyin: Tā zài hēi'àn zhōng gōngzuò le jǐ ge xiǎoshí, yǎnjing hěn lèi, kàn dōngxi dōu yǒudiǎn móhu.
en: After working in the dark for several hours, his eyes were tired and everything looked blurry.

zh: 这家公司的财务管理一团黑，没人能说清楚钱到底去了哪里。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de cáiwù guǎnlǐ yī tuán hēi, méi rén néng shuōqīngchu qián dàodǐ qù le nǎli.
en: This company's financial management is a complete mess—nobody can explain where the money actually went.

zh: 我身体很好。
pinyin: Wǒ shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
en: My body is very healthy.

zh: 昨天我身上很疼。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ shēnshang hěn téng.
en: Yesterday my whole body was aching.

zh: 虽然他身体不太好，但是他还是坚持运动。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shēntǐ búdài hǎo, búshì tā háishi jiānchí yùndòng.
en: Although his health isn't that great, he still insists on exercising.

zh: 因为长期出差，他身心都感到非常疲劳。
pinyin: Yīnwèi chángqī chūchāi, tā shēnxīn dōu gǎndào fēicháng píláo.
en: Because he travels for work so often, both his body and mind feel extremely exhausted.

zh: 在这个高压的环境里，很多人身不由己地陷入焦虑。
pinyin: Zài zhège gāoyālì de huanjìng lǐ, hěnduō rén shēn búyóujǐ de xiànrù jiāolǜ.
en: In this high-pressure environment, many people find themselves trapped in anxiety against their will.

zh: 我还要喝水。
pinyin: Wǒ háiyào hē shuǐ.
en: I want to drink more water.

zh: 吃完饭以后，我还要做功课。
pinyin: Chīwán fàn yǐhòu, wǒ háiyào zuò gōngkè.
en: After finishing dinner, I still need to do my homework.

zh: 虽然今天很累，但是我还要去公司开会。
pinyin: Suīrán jīntiān hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ háiyào qù gōngsī kāihuì.
en: Even though I'm exhausted today, I still have to go to the company for a meeting.

zh: 因为项目还没完成，所以我周末还要继续工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàngmù háishi méi wánchéng, suǒyǐ wǒ zhōumò háiyào jìxù gōngzuò.
en: Since the project isn't finished yet, I'll have to keep working over the weekend.

zh: 除了学习语言，我们还要理解文化背景才能真正交流。
pinyin: Chúle xuéxí yǔyán, wǒmen háiyào lǐjiě wénhuà bèijǐng cáinéng zhēnzhèng jiāoliú.
en: Beyond just learning the language, we also need to understand the cultural context to truly communicate.

zh: 我作饭。
pinyin: Wǒ zuò fàn.
en: I'm cooking.

zh: 她每天作功课两小时。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān zuò gōngkè liǎng xiǎoshí.
en: She does her homework for two hours every day.

zh: 虽然作业很多，但是学生还是认真完成了。
pinyin: Suīrán zuòyè hěn duō, dànshì xuésheng háishi rènzhēn wánchéng le.
en: Although there was a lot of homework, the students still completed it carefully.

zh: 因为他作为班长，需要帮助同学们解决问题。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā zuòwéi bānzhǎng, xūyào bāngzhù tóngxuémen jiějué wèntí.
en: As class monitor, he needs to help his classmates solve problems.

zh: 这部电影作为一部经典作品，影响了几代人的审美观。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng zuòwéi yī bù jīngdiǎn zuòpǐn, yǐngxiǎng le jǐ dài rén de shěnměi guān.
en: This film, as a classic work, has influenced the aesthetic sensibilities of several generations.

zh: 猫在狗后面。
pinyin: Māo zài gǒu hòumiàn.
en: The cat is behind the dog.

zh: 我们坐在教室后面的位子。
pinyin: Wǒmen zuò zài jiàoshì hòumiàn de wèizi.
en: We sit in the seats at the back of the classroom.

zh: 因为他走得慢，我就走在他后面。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā zǒu de màn, wǒ jiù zǒu zài tā hòumiàn.
en: Because he walked slowly, I ended up walking behind him.

zh: 虽然他说得不错，但后面的解释有问题。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shuō de búcuò, dàn hòumiàn de jiěshì yǒu wèntí.
en: Although his initial explanation was good, the part that came after had some issues.

zh: 这个计划表面上可行，但后面的细节问题足以让整个项目失败。
pinyin: Zhège jìhuà biǎomiàn shang kěxíng, dàn hòumiàn de xì節jiè wèntí zúyǐ ràng zhěngge xiàngmù shībài.
en: On the surface this plan looks workable, but the detailed issues that come later are enough to derail the whole project.

zh: 猫的性格很好。
pinyin: māo de xìnggé hěn hǎo.
en: The cat has a good temperament.

zh: 他的性格有点内向，不太爱说话。
pinyin: Tā de xìnggé yǒudiǎn nèixiàng, búhuì ài shuōhuà.
en: His personality is somewhat introverted; he doesn't talk much.

zh: 虽然他们性格不同，但是他们是很好的朋友。
pinyin: Suīrán tāmen xìnggé búyī, búguò tāmen shì hěn hǎo de péngyou.
en: Although their personalities are different, they are very good friends.

zh: 这个工作需要有耐心的性格，因为经常要和客户沟通。
pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò xūyào yǒu nàixīn de xìnggé, yīnwèi jīngcháng yào hé kèhù gōutōng.
en: This job requires a patient personality because you constantly need to communicate with clients.

zh: 在压力大的环境里，一个人的性格和处事风格往往能反映出他真实的品质。
pinyin: Zài yālì dà de huánjìng lǐ, yī ge rén de xìnggé hé chǔshì fēnggé wǎngwǎng néng fǎnyìng chū tā zhēnshí de pǐnzhì.
en: In high-pressure environments, a person's character and way of handling things often reveal their true qualities.

zh: 妈妈带来了水果。
pinyin: Māma dàilái le shuǐguǒ.
en: Mom brought some fruit.

zh: 昨天的雨带来了很多泥土。
pinyin: Zuótiān de yǔ dàilái le hěnduō nítu.
en: Yesterday's rain brought a lot of mud.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但是它带来了很多机会。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì tā dàilái le hěnduō jīhuì.
en: Although the work is busy, it brings lots of opportunities.

zh: 新技术为公司带来了显著的增长和竞争力。
pinyin: Xīn jìshù wéi gōngsī dàilái le xiǎnzhù de zēngzhǎng hé jìngjìnglì.
en: New technology has brought significant growth and competitiveness to the company.

zh: 互联网带来的便利确实改变了我们的生活方式，但也产生了新的问题。
pinyin: Hùliánwǎng dàilái de biànlì quèshí gǎibiàn le wǒmen de shēnghuó fāngshì, dàn yě chǎnshēng le xīn de wèntí.
en: The convenience brought by the internet has genuinely changed our lifestyle, but it's also created new problems.

zh: 昨天我吃了米饭。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ chīle mǐfàn.
en: I had rice yesterday.

zh: 昨天我和妈妈去了公园。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hé māma qùle gōngyuán.
en: Yesterday I went to the park with my mom.

zh: 昨天虽然下雨，但是我们还是去了学校。
pinyin: Zuótiān suīrán xiàyǔ, dànshì wǒmen háishi qùle xuéxiào.
en: Even though it rained yesterday, we still went to school.

zh: 昨天开会的时候，老板宣布了一个重要的决定。
pinyin: Zuótiān kāihuì de shíhou, lǎobǎn xuānbùle yīge zhòngyào de juéding.
en: When we had the meeting yesterday, the boss announced an important decision.

zh: 昨天那次谈判虽然很困难，但双方最后还是达成了共识。
pinyin: Zuótiān nàcì tánpàn suīrán hěn kùnnan, dàn shuāngfāng zuìhòu háishi dáchéngle gòngshí.
en: Yesterday's negotiation was challenging, but both sides ultimately reached a consensus.

zh: 这个苹果不好吃。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ búhǎo chī.
en: This apple doesn't taste good.

zh: 今天天气不好，我不想出去。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì búhǎo, wǒ búxiǎng chūqu.
en: The weather is bad today, so I don't want to go out.

zh: 虽然这个饭店很便宜，但是菜的质量不好。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège fàndiàn hěn piányi, dànshi cài de zhìliàng búhǎo.
en: Although this restaurant is cheap, the quality of the dishes isn't good.

zh: 他最近工作压力很大，心情不好，所以跟朋友吵架了。
pinyin: Tā zuìjìn gōngzuò yālì hěn dà, xīnqing búhǎo, suǒyǐ跟 péngyou chǎojià le.
en: He's been under a lot of work stress lately, and he's been in a bad mood, so he had a fight with his friend.

zh: 这个项目的计划设计得不好，导致后期改动很多，浪费了不少时间和资源。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de jìhuà shèjì de búhǎo, dǎozhì hòuqī gǎidòng hěn duō, làngfèi le búshǎo shíjiān hé zīyuán.
en: The project plan wasn't well designed, which led to many changes in the later stages and wasted considerable time and resources.

zh: 我抓住了小猫。
pinyin: Wǒ zhuāzhù le xiǎo māo.
en: I caught the kitten.

zh: 他昨天抓住了一条大鱼。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān zhuāzhù le yī tiáo dà yú.
en: He caught a big fish yesterday.

zh: 因为他跑得快，所以抓住了那个男孩。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā pǎo de kuài, suǒyǐ zhuāzhù le nàge nánháir.
en: Because he ran fast, he managed to catch that boy.

zh: 虽然她没有做好准备，但还是抓住了这个机会。
pinyin: Suīrán tā méiyǒu zuò hǎo zhǔnbèi, dàn háishi zhuāzhù le zhège jīhuì.
en: Although she wasn't well prepared, she still seized this opportunity.

zh: 在这个竞争激烈的市场里，谁能抓住消费者的需求，谁就能成功。
pinyin: Zài zhège jìngjìng jīliè de shìchǎng lǐ, shéi néng zhuāzhù xiāofèizhě de xūqiú, shéi jiù néng chénggōng.
en: In this fiercely competitive market, whoever can grasp what consumers actually need will succeed.

zh: 我记录了食物。
pinyin: Wǒ jìlù le shíwù.
en: I recorded the food.

zh: 老师记录了学生的名字。
pinyin: Lǎoshī jìlù le xuésheng de míngzi.
en: The teacher wrote down the students' names.

zh: 因为比赛很重要，所以我记录了每个比分。
pinyin: Yīnwèi bǐsài hěn zhòngyào, suǒyǐ wǒ jìlù le měi ge bǐfēn.
en: Because the match was important, I recorded every single score.

zh: 医生详细地记录了患者的病情和治疗方案。
pinyin: Yīshēng xiáng细 de jìlù le huànzhě de bìngqíng hé zhìliáo fāng'àn.
en: The doctor carefully documented the patient's condition and treatment plan.

zh: 这个项目的进展需要定期记录，以便管理层了解实际情况。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de jìnzhǎn xūyào dìngqī jìlù, yǐbiàn guǎnlǐcéng liǎojiě shíjì qíngkuàng.
en: This project's progress needs to be recorded regularly so that management can stay informed about the actual situation.

zh: 我想吃点儿面包。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chī diǎnr miànbāo.
en: I'd like to eat some bread.

zh: 晚上我们可以喝点儿茶。
pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒmen kěyǐ hē diǎnr chá.
en: We can have some tea this evening.

zh: 因为今天很热，所以我想喝点儿冰水。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān hěn rè, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng hē diǎnr bīng shuǐ.
en: Since it's really hot today, I want to drink some ice water.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但是周末还是愿意花点儿时间陪家人。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì zhōumò háishi yuànyì huā diǎnr shíjiān péi jiārén.
en: Although he's very busy, he's still willing to spend some time with his family on weekends.

zh: 与其在网上浪费时间，不如花点儿精力学习一项新技能。
pinyin: Yǔqī zài wǎngshang làngfèi shíjiān, búrú huā diǎnr jīnglì xuéxí yī xiàng xīn jìnéng.
en: Rather than wasting time online, you might as well put some effort into learning a new skill.

zh: 老兄，你好！
pinyin: Lǎoxiōng, nǐ hǎo!
en: Hey buddy, how are you?

zh: 老兄，今天天气很好，我们去公园吧。
pinyin: Lǎoxiōng, jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen qù gōngyuán ba.
en: Listen, the weather's nice today—want to go to the park?

zh: 老兄，虽然很累，但是我们还是要完成这个工作。
pinyin: Lǎoxiōng, suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì wǒmen háishi yào wánchéng zhège gōngzuò.
en: Look, even though we're exhausted, we've still got to finish this job.

zh: 老兄，你上次说的那个计划怎么样了？有进展吗？
pinyin: Lǎoxiōng, nǐ shàngcì shuō de nàge jìhuà zěnyàng le? Yǒu jìnzhǎn ma?
en: Man, whatever happened with that plan you mentioned last time? Any progress on it?

zh: 老兄，我看你最近有点心烦意乱，要不要找个地方好好聊聊？
pinyin: Lǎoxiōng, wǒ kàn nǐ zuìjìn yǒudiǎn xīnfán yìluàn, yàobunyào zhǎo ge dìfang hǎohāo liáoliao?
en: Buddy, I can tell you've had something on your mind lately—want to sit down and talk it through?

zh: 这个苹果来自中国。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ láizì Zhōngguó.
en: This apple comes from China.

zh: 我的朋友来自美国，他很友好。
pinyin: Wǒ de péngyou láizì Měiguó, tā hěn yǒuhǎo.
en: My friend is from America, and he's very friendly.

zh: 因为她来自南方，所以她很喜欢吃辣的东西。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā láizì nánfāng, suǒyǐ tā hěn xǐhuān chī làde dōngxi.
en: Because she's from the south, she really enjoys eating spicy food.

zh: 这个想法来自我们昨天和同事的讨论。
pinyin: Zhège xiǎngfǎ láizì wǒmen zuótiān hé tóngshì de tǎolùn.
en: This idea came from our discussion with colleagues yesterday.

zh: 他成功的秘诀来自于长期的努力和对工作的热情。
pinyin: Tā chénggōng de mìjué láizìyú chángqī de nǔlì hé duì gōngzuò de règing.
en: The secret to his success stems from years of hard work and genuine passion for his job.

zh: 我越来越喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: I like eating rice more and more.

zh: 天气越来越冷，我们都穿上了厚衣服。
pinyin: Tiānqì yuè lái yuè lěng, wǒmen dōu chuānshang le hòu yīfu.
en: The weather is getting colder and colder, so we all put on thick clothes.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但是他的汉语越来越好，因为他坚持练习。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì tā de Hànyǔ yuè lái yuè hǎo, yīnwèi tā jiānchí liànxí.
en: Although he's very busy, his Chinese keeps improving because he practices consistently.

zh: 随着工作经验增加，他对这个行业的理解越来越深入了。
pinyin: Suízhe gōngzuò jīngyàn zēngjiā, tā duì zhège hángyè de lǐjiě yuè lái yuè shēnrù le.
en: As his work experience has accumulated, his understanding of the industry has become increasingly deeper.

zh: 这家公司的产品质量越来越好，市场占有率也随之提高了不少。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de chǎnpǐn zhìliàng yuè lái yuè hǎo, shìchǎng zhànyǒu lǜ yě suízī tíggāo le búshǎo.
en: This company's product quality has improved steadily, and their market share has risen considerably as a result.

zh: 我在大学学习。
pinyin: Wǒ zài dàxué xuéxí.
en: I study at university.

zh: 他今年进了一个很好的大学。
pinyin: Tā jīnnián jìnle yīge hěn hǎo de dàxué.
en: He got into a really good university this year.

zh: 因为想学英语，所以她选择了那个大学。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiǎng xué Yīngyǔ, suǒyǐ tā xuǎnzéle nàge dàxué.
en: Because she wanted to study English, she chose that university.

zh: 虽然大学的学费很贵，但很多学生还是决定去读。
pinyin: Suīrán dàxué de xuéfèi hěn guì, dàn hěnduō xuésheng háishi juédìng qù dú.
en: Although university tuition is expensive, many students still decide to go.

zh: 上了大学以后，他逐渐意识到自己需要更加努力才能跟上同学们。
pinyin: Shàngle dàxué yǐhòu, tā zhújiàn yìshi dào zìjǐ xūyào gèngjiā nǔlì cáinéng gēnshàng tóngxuémen.
en: After starting university, he gradually realized he needed to work much harder to keep up with his classmates.

zh: 妈妈照顾我。
pinyin: Māma zhàogù wǒ.
en: Mom takes care of me.

zh: 爸爸每天照顾小狗。
pinyin: Bàba měi tiān zhàogù xiǎo gǒu.
en: Dad looks after the puppy every day.

zh: 因为奶奶生病了，所以我要照顾她。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nǎinai shēng bìng le, suǒyǐ wǒ yào zhàogù tā.
en: Because Grandma is sick, I need to take care of her.

zh: 在照顾孩子的时候，父母要特别注意安全。
pinyin: Zài zhàogù háizi de shíhou, fùmǔ yào tèbié zhùyì ānquán.
en: When looking after children, parents need to pay special attention to safety.

zh: 她辞职了，为了更好地照顾患病的丈夫和两个孩子。
pinyin: Tā cízhí le, wèile gèng hǎo de zhàogù huànbìng de zhànfu hé liǎng ge háizi.
en: She quit her job in order to better care for her sick husband and two children.

zh: 这是王太太。
pinyin: Zhè shì Wáng tàitai.
en: This is Mrs. Wang.

zh: 王太太每天早上去公园。
pinyin: Wáng tàitai měi tiān zǎoshang qù gōngyuán.
en: Mrs. Wang goes to the park every morning.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以李太太决定出去散步。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ Lǐ tàitai juéding chūqù sǎnbù.
en: Because the weather was nice, Mrs. Li decided to go out for a walk.

zh: 虽然张太太很忙，但她还是坚持每周去健身房锻炼。
pinyin: Suīrán Zhāng tàitai hěn máng, dàn tā háishi jiānchí měi zhōu qù jiànshēnfáng duànliàn.
en: Even though Mrs. Zhang is very busy, she still makes time to work out at the gym every week.

zh: 陈太太在公司担任经理，她的管理能力得到了同事们的一致认可。
pinyin: Chén tàitai zài gōngsī dānrèn jīnglǐ, tā de guǎnlǐ néngли dédào le tóngshìmen de yīzhì rènkě.
en: Mrs. Chen works as a manager at the company, and her leadership skills have earned consistent recognition from her colleagues.

zh: 我的妹妹很聪明。
pinyin: Wǒ de mèimei hěn聪明。
en: My little sister is very smart.

zh: 他聪明，所以学习很快。
pinyin: Tā聪明，suǒyǐ xuéxí hěn kuài。
en: Because he's clever, he learns very quickly.

zh: 虽然他很聪明，但是他不喜欢读书。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn聪明，dànshì tā búxǐhuān dúshū。
en: Although he's intelligent, he doesn't like reading.

zh: 她用聪明的办法解决了这个难题。
pinyin: Tā yòng聪明de bànfǎ jiějué le zhège nántí。
en: She solved that difficult problem by using a clever approach.

zh: 他聪明反被聪明误，因为太自信就没听老师的建议。
pinyin: Tā聪明fǎn bèi聪明wù，yīnwèi tài zìxìn jiù méi tīng lǎoshī de jiànyì。
en: His cleverness became his downfall—he was too confident and ignored his teacher's advice.

zh: 本来我要吃饭。
pinyin: Běnlái wǒ yào chīfàn.
en: I was originally going to eat.

zh: 本来今天要下雨，但是没下。
pinyin: Běnlái jīntiān yào xiàyǔ, búguò méiyǒu xià.
en: It was supposed to rain today, but it didn't.

zh: 因为生病，我本来的计划都改了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shēngbìng, wǒ běnlái de jìhuà dōu gǎi le.
en: Because I got sick, all my original plans changed.

zh: 本来想自己做饭，后来觉得太麻烦就点外卖了。
pinyin: Běnlái xiǎng zìjǐ zuò fàn, hòulái juéde tài máfan jiù diǎn wàimài le.
en: I'd initially planned to cook myself, but then it seemed too much hassle so I ordered takeout.

zh: 本来这个项目能按时完成，可惜后来资金出了问题。
pinyin: Běnlái zhège xiàngmù néng ànshí wánchéng, kěxī hòulái zījīn chū le wèntí.
en: This project could have been completed on schedule originally, but unfortunately funding issues came up later.

zh: 妈妈说加油！
pinyin: Māmā shuō jiāyóu!
en: Mom says come on!

zh: 明天考试，我要加油。
pinyin: Míngtiān kǎoshì, wǒ yào jiāyóu.
en: I have a test tomorrow, so I need to do my best.

zh: 虽然很累，但是我还要加油继续跑。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ háiyào jiāyóu jìxù pǎo.
en: Even though I'm tired, I still need to push on and keep running.

zh: 既然选择了这份工作，就要加油做好它。
pinyin: 既然xuǎnzé le zhè fèn gōngzuò, jiù yào jiāyóu zuò hǎo tā.
en: Since you chose this job, you've got to work hard and do it well.

zh: 面对困难时，我们要互相鼓励加油，才能成功。
pinyin: Miànduì kùnnan shí, wǒmen yào hùxiāng gǔlì jiāyóu, cáinéng chénggōng.
en: When facing difficulties, we need to encourage each other and push forward in order to succeed.

zh: 实际上我喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Shíjìshang wǒ xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: Actually, I like eating rice.

zh: 实际上今天天气很好，我们可以出去。
pinyin: Shíjìshang jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen kěyǐ chūqu.
en: Actually, the weather is really nice today, so we can go out.

zh: 虽然看起来很难，但实际上这个问题很简单。
pinyin: Suīrán kàn qǐlái hěn nán, dàn shíjìshang zhège wèntí hěn jiǎndān.
en: Although it looks difficult, this problem is actually quite simple.

zh: 实际上很多学生觉得数学困难，其实是因为没有用心学。
pinyin: Shíjìshang hěnduō xuésheng juéde shùxué kùnnan, qíshí shì yīnwèi méiyǒu yòngxīn xué.
en: In reality, many students find math difficult mainly because they don't study hard enough.

zh: 实际上他表面上很开心，但工作的压力让他夜不能寐。
pinyin: Shíjìshang tā biǎomiàn shang hěn kāixīn, dàn gōngzuò de yālì ràng tā yè bù néng mián.
en: In fact, although he seems cheerful on the surface, work stress keeps him awake at night.

zh: 这个糖很甜。
pinyin: Zhège táng hěn tián.
en: This candy is very sweet.

zh: 妈妈买的苹果很甜,我很喜欢吃。
pinyin: Māma mǎi de píngguǒ hěn tián, wǒ hěn xǐhuān chī.
en: The apples mom bought are really sweet, and I love eating them.

zh: 虽然这个蛋糕有点贵,但是味道很甜,所以很多人喜欢买。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège dàngāo yǒudiǎn guì, dànshì wèidào hěn tián, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén xǐhuān mǎi.
en: Although this cake is a bit expensive, it tastes really sweet, so lots of people like to buy it.

zh: 他喜欢喝甜咖啡,因为觉得这样可以让心情变好。
pinyin: Tā xǐhuān hē tián kāfēi, yīnwèi juéde zhèyàng kěyǐ ràng xīnqíng biàn hǎo.
en: He likes drinking sweet coffee because he feels it can improve his mood.

zh: 这家餐厅的甜点设计得很精致,虽然分量不大,但给人留下了深刻的印象。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de tiándiǎn shèjì de hěn jīngzhì, suīrán fènliàng búdà, dàn gěi rén liúxia le shēnkè de yìnxiàng.
en: The desserts at this restaurant are exquisitely designed; though the portions are small, they really make a strong impression.

zh: 我怕狗。
pinyin: Wǒ pà gǒu.
en: I'm afraid of dogs.

zh: 他很怕冷，冬天不想出门。
pinyin: Tā hěn pà lěng, dōngtiān búxiǎng chūmén.
en: He really hates the cold and doesn't want to go out in winter.

zh: 虽然她怕黑，但是她必须自己走回家。
pinyin: Suīrán tā pà hēi, dànshì tā bìxū zìjǐ zǒu huíjiā.
en: Although she's afraid of the dark, she has to walk home by herself.

zh: 他怕失去这份工作，所以每天都很认真地工作。
pinyin: Tā pà shīqù zhè fèn gōngzuò, suǒyǐ měitiān dōu hěn rènzhēn de gōngzuò.
en: He's afraid of losing this job, so he works very carefully every single day.

zh: 我不太怕失败，反而担心自己会安于现状。
pinyin: Wǒ búdài pà shībài, fǎn'ér dānxīn zìjǐ huì ānyú xiànzhuàng.
en: I'm not so much afraid of failure as I am worried I'll become complacent.

zh: 你要等多久？
pinyin: Nǐ yào děng duōjiǔ?
en: How long do you have to wait?

zh: 从家到学校要多久？
pinyin: Cóng jiā dào xuéxiào yào duōjiǔ?
en: How long does it take to get from home to school?

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他还是问我多久能完成。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì tā háishi wèn wǒ duōjiǔ néng wánchéng.
en: Even though work is busy, he still asked me how long it would take to finish.

zh: 医生问病人已经咳嗽多久了，以便做出正确诊断。
pinyin: Yīshēng wèn bìngrén yǐjīng késòu duōjiǔ le, yǐbiàn zuòchū zhèngquè zhěnduàn.
en: The doctor asked the patient how long they'd been coughing so he could make an accurate diagnosis.

zh: 他对这个项目的进展不满意，问项目经理多久才能见到成果。
pinyin: Tā duì zhège xiàngmù de jìnzhǎn búmǎnyì, wèn xiàngmù jīnglǐ duōjiǔ cáinéng jiàndào chéngguǒ.
en: He was unhappy with the project's progress and asked the project manager how much longer before seeing results.

zh: 我喜欢苹果并且喜欢香蕉。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān píngguǒ bìngqiě xǐhuān xiāngjiāo.
en: I like apples and I like bananas.

zh: 她今天去公园并且见了朋友。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān qù gōngyuán bìngqiě jiàn le péngyou.
en: Today she went to the park and saw a friend.

zh: 因为下雨，我不能去，并且他也不去了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒ búnéng qù, bìngqiě tā yě búqù le.
en: Because it's raining, I can't go, and he's not going either.

zh: 这家公司很有名，并且员工的工资也很高。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī hěn yǒumíng, bìngqiě yuángōng de gōngzī yě hěn gāo.
en: This company is very famous, and its employees earn high salaries too.

zh: 他不仅学习成绩好，并且在体育方面也很出色。
pinyin: Tā bújǐn xuéxí chéngjī hǎo, bìngqiě zài tǐyù fāngmiàn yě hěn chūsè.
en: Not only are his grades excellent, but he also excels in sports.

zh: 我直接吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ zhíjiē chīfàn.
en: I'll eat right away.

zh: 他下班后直接回家了。
pinyin: Tā xiàbān hòu zhíjiē huíjiā le.
en: After work, he went straight home.

zh: 因为时间紧张，我们直接坐出租车去机场。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shíjiān jǐnzhāng, wǒmen zhíjiē zuò chūzūchē qù jīchǎng.
en: Because we were short on time, we took a taxi directly to the airport.

zh: 与其等待回复，不如直接打电话给客户。
pinyin: Yǔqī děngdài huífù, búrú zhíjiē dǎ diànhuà gěi kèhù.
en: Rather than waiting for a reply, it's better to call the client directly.

zh: 这个问题我们无法直接解决，需要向上级反映情况。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí wǒmen wúfǎ zhíjiē jiějué, xūyào xiàng shàngjí fǎnyìng qíngkuàng.
en: We can't resolve this issue directly—we need to report the situation to management.

zh: 对于苹果，我很喜欢。
pinyin: Duìyú píngguǒ, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
en: As for apples, I really like them.

zh: 对于这个问题，他昨天给了我答案。
pinyin: Duìyú zhège wèntí, tā zuótiān gěile wǒ dáàn.
en: Regarding this question, he gave me the answer yesterday.

zh: 虽然对于英语很难，但是我每天都在学习。
pinyin: Suīrán duìyú yīngyǔ hěn nán, dànshì wǒ měi tiān dōu zài xuéxí.
en: Even though English is difficult for me, I study it every day.

zh: 对于年轻人来说，找到好工作变得越来越不容易了。
pinyin: Duìyú niánqīng rén lái shuō, zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò biàn de yuèláiyuè búróngyì le.
en: For young people, finding a good job has become increasingly difficult.

zh: 对于这种现象，专家们提出了不同的看法，有人赞成，有人反对。
pinyin: Duìyú zhè zhǒng xiànxiàng, zhuānjiā men tíchūle búyī de kànfǎ, yǒurén zànchéng, yǒurén fǎnduì.
en: Regarding this phenomenon, experts have put forward different views—some support it, others oppose it.

zh: 我记得你的名字。
pinyin: Wǒ jìde nǐ de míngzi.
en: I remember your name.

zh: 昨天我记下了老师的电话号码。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ jìxiàle lǎoshī de diànhuà hàomǎ.
en: Yesterday I wrote down the teacher's phone number.

zh: 虽然我记性不太好，但是我不会忘记朋友的生日。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ jìxìng búhuì tài hǎo, búshì wǒ búhuì wàngjì péngyou de shēngrì.
en: Even though my memory isn't great, I'll never forget a friend's birthday.

zh: 他在日记里记录了这次旅行的每一个有趣的细节。
pinyin: Tā zài rìjì lǐ jìlù le zhè cì lǚxíng de měi yī ge yǒuqù de xì節.
en: He recorded every interesting detail of the trip in his diary.

zh: 这家餐厅的口味让我印象深刻，我一定要把它记在心里，以后常来。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cānting de kǒuweì ràng wǒ yìnxiàng shēnkè, wǒ yīdìng yào bǎ tā jì zài xīn lǐ, yǐhòu cháng lái.
en: The flavors at this restaurant really impressed me—I'll definitely keep it in mind and come back often.

zh: 我突然看到一只猫。
pinyin: Wǒ túrán kàndào yī zhī māo.
en: I suddenly saw a cat.

zh: 昨天上课时，他突然站起来了。
pinyin: Zuótiān shàngkè shí, tā túrán zhàn qǐlái le.
en: Yesterday during class, he suddenly stood up.

zh: 虽然天气很好，但是突然下起了大雨。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn hǎo, dànshi túrán xiàxǐ le dà yǔ.
en: Although the weather was nice, it suddenly started raining heavily.

zh: 工作进行得很顺利，突然出现了一个严重的问题。
pinyin: Gōngzuò jìnxíng de hěn shùnlì, túrán chūxiàn le yī ge yánzhòng de wèntí.
en: The work was going smoothly until a serious problem suddenly appeared.

zh: 他多年来默默努力，突然有一天机会来临，终于实现了梦想。
pinyin: Tā duō nián lái mòmò nǔlì, túrán yǒu yī tiān jīhuì lái lín, zhōngyú shíxiàn le mèngxiǎng.
en: After years of quiet effort, opportunity suddenly came one day, and he finally achieved his dream.

zh: 你吃啥？
pinyin: Nǐ chī shá?
en: What are you eating?

zh: 你今天穿的啥颜色？
pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān chuān de shá yánsè?
en: What color are you wearing today?

zh: 因为下雨了，所以他不知道啥时候能到。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ tā búzhīdào shá shíhou néng dào.
en: Because it's raining, he doesn't know when he'll be able to arrive.

zh: 虽然我问了他好几次，但他还是不想告诉我啥事。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ wènle tā hǎo jǐ cì, dànshì tā háishi búxiǎng gàosu wǒ shá shì.
en: Even though I've asked him several times, he still doesn't want to tell me what's going on.

zh: 他那种态度让我觉得他根本不在乎啥规则，只想做自己想做的。
pinyin: Tā nàzhǒng tàidù ràng wǒ juéde tā gēnběn búzàihu shá guīzé, zhǐ xiǎng zuò zìjǐ xiǎng zuò de.
en: His attitude makes me feel like he doesn't care about any rules at all—he just wants to do whatever he pleases.

zh: 警察开枪了。
pinyin: Jǐngchá kāiguāng le.
en: The police officer fired a gun.

zh: 士兵在早上开枪训练。
pinyin: Shìbīng zài zǎoshang kāiguāng xùnliàn.
en: The soldiers practiced shooting in the morning.

zh: 因为有危险，所以警察决定开枪。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu wēixiǎn, suǒyǐ jǐngchá juédìng kāiguāng.
en: Because there was danger, the police decided to fire their weapon.

zh: 当那个人拿出刀的时候，警察才开枪保护自己。
pinyin: Dāng nàge rén náchūlái dāo de shíhou, jǐngchá cái kāiguāng bǎohù zìjǐ.
en: Only when the man pulled out a knife did the officer fire a shot to protect himself.

zh: 虽然他们进行了多次谈判，但最后还是被迫开枪才解决了这个冲突。
pinyin: Suīrán tāmen jìnxíng le duō cì tánpàn, dàn zuìhòu háishi bèipò kāiguāng cái jiějué le zhège chōngtū.
en: Although they conducted multiple negotiations, they were ultimately forced to use gunfire to resolve the conflict.

zh: 我听到了一个声音。
pinyin: Wǒ tīngdào le yī gè shēngyīn.
en: I heard a sound.

zh: 早上我听到鸟的声音。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ tīngdào niǎo de shēngyīn.
en: In the morning I heard the sound of birds.

zh: 虽然电视的声音很大，但我还是睡着了。
pinyin: Suīrán diànshì de shēngyīn hěn dà, dàn wǒ háishi shuìzháo le.
en: Even though the TV volume was loud, I still fell asleep.

zh: 因为教室里很安静，所以每个声音都听得很清楚。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jiàoshì lǐ hěn ānjìng, suǒyǐ měi ge shēngyīn dōu tīng de hěn qīngchu.
en: Because the classroom was so quiet, you could hear every single sound clearly.

zh: 他用平静的声音解释了这个复杂的问题，让大家都能理解。
pinyin: Tā yòng píingjìng de shēngyīn jiěshì le zhège fùzá de wèntí, ràng dàjiā dōu néng lǐjiě.
en: He explained the complicated problem in a calm voice, so everyone could understand it.

zh: 除非你吃饭，不然饿。
pinyin: Chúfēi nǐ chīfàn, búránHè è.
en: Unless you eat, you'll be hungry.

zh: 除非明天下雨，我们去公园。
pinyin: Chúfēi míngtiān xiàyǔ, wǒmen qù gōngyuán.
en: Unless it rains tomorrow, we're going to the park.

zh: 虽然很贵，但除非你有钱，否则买不了。
pinyin: Suīránhěn guì, dàn chúfēi nǐ yǒu qián, fǒuzé mǎi búliǎo.
en: Although it's expensive, unless you have money, you can't afford it.

zh: 除非你的工作特别忙，不然应该有时间陪家人。
pinyin: Chúfēi nǐ de gōngzuò tèbié máng, búránShìnóy yīnggāi yǒu shíjiān péi jiārén.
en: Unless your work is exceptionally busy, you should have time to spend with family.

zh: 除非他主动认错，不然我不太想原谅他这样的态度。
pinyin: Chúfēi tā zhǔdòng rènzuò, búránwǒ búTài xiǎng yuányuàng tā zhèyàng de tàidù.
en: Unless he takes the initiative to apologize, I'm not really inclined to forgive him for this kind of attitude.

zh: 我们在公园集合。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài gōngyuán jíhé.
en: We're meeting up at the park.

zh: 明天下午三点我们集中在学校。
pinyin: Míngtiān xiàwǔ sān diǎn wǒmen jízhōng zài xuéxiào.
en: Tomorrow at 3 p.m. we'll all gather at school.

zh: 因为要开会，所以大家集中在会议室里面。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yào kāihuì, suǒyǐ dàjiā jízhōng zài huìyì shì lǐmiàn.
en: Since we have a meeting, everyone's gathering in the conference room.

zh: 这个周末我们计划集合讨论新项目的想法。
pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒmen jìhuà jíhé tǎolùn xīn xiàngmù de xiǎngfǎ.
en: This weekend we're planning to meet up and discuss ideas for the new project.

zh: 团队成员从不同城市集结，为了参加这场重要的比赛。
pinyin: Tuánduì chéngyuán cóng búntóng chéngshì jíjié, wèile cānjiā zhè chǎng zhòngyào de bǐsài.
en: Team members converged from different cities in order to participate in this important competition.

zh: 这是一家书店。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī jiā shūdiàn.
en: This is a bookstore.

zh: 我昨天去了咖啡店喝咖啡。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān qùle kāfēidiàn hē kāfēi.
en: I went to the coffee shop yesterday and had some coffee.

zh: 因为那家店的衣服很便宜，所以很多人在那儿买。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nà jiā diàn de yīfu hěn piányi, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén zài nàr mǎi.
en: Because that store's clothes are so cheap, lots of people shop there.

zh: 虽然这家店离我家很远，但服务态度特别好，我还是常去。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiā diàn lí wǒ jiā hěn yuǎn, dàn fúwù tàidù tèbié hǎo, wǒ háishi cháng qù.
en: Although this shop is quite far from my place, the service is so good that I still go there often.

zh: 他开的餐店虽然没有豪华装修，却因为食材新鲜、价格公道而生意兴隆。
pinyin: Tā kāi de cāndiàn suīrán méiyǒu háohuá zhuāngxiū, què yīnwèi shícái xīnxiān, jiàgé gōngdào ér shēngyì xīngglóng.
en: His restaurant doesn't have fancy décor, but it's always busy because the ingredients are fresh and the prices are fair.

zh: 这个男孩很酷。
pinyin: Zhège nánh áiyuán hěn kù.
en: That boy is cool.

zh: 他穿着酷的黑色衣服去上班。
pinyin: Tā chuānzháo kù de hēisè yīfu qù shàngbān.
en: He wears cool black clothes to work.

zh: 虽然天气很热，但他穿得很酷。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn rè, dànshì tā chuānde hěn kù.
en: Although the weather is hot, he still dresses really cool.

zh: 那个摄影师的风格很酷，因为他总是用新颖的角度拍照。
pinyin: Nàge shèyǐngshī de fēnggé hěn kù, yīnwèi tā zǒngshì yòng xīnyǐng de jiǎodù pāizhào.
en: That photographer has a really cool style because he always shoots from fresh perspectives.

zh: 这位设计师的作品既酷又实用，深受年轻人喜爱。
pinyin: Zhèwèi shèjìshī de zuòpǐn jì kù yòu shíyòng, shēnshòu niánqīngrén xǐ'ài.
en: This designer's work is both cool and practical, really popular with young people.

zh: 我每天正常吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zhèngcháng chīfàn.
en: I eat normally every day.

zh: 他今天感冒了，不正常。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān gǎnmào le, bù zhèngcháng.
en: He caught a cold today and isn't acting normal.

zh: 虽然下雨了，但是火车还是正常运行。
pinyin: Suīrán xiàyǔ le, dànshì huǒchē háishi zhèngcháng yùnxíng.
en: Even though it's raining, the train is still running normally.

zh: 因为网络故障，公司的工作流程没有正常进行。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǎngluò gùzhàng, gōngsī de gōngzuò liúchéng méiyǒu zhèngcháng jìnxíng.
en: Due to a network outage, the company's workflow wasn't able to proceed normally.

zh: 经过几个月的治疗后，他的身体逐渐恢复到正常水平。
pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ ge yuè de zhìliáo hòu, tā de shēntǐ zhújiàn huīfù dào zhèngcháng shuǐpíng.
en: After several months of treatment, his physical condition gradually returned to normal levels.

zh: 他的狗死亡了。
pinyin: Tā de gǒu sǐwáng le.
en: His dog died.

zh: 去年那只老鼠因为生病死亡了。
pinyin: Qùnián nà zhī lǎoshǔ yīnwèi shēngbìng sǐwáng le.
en: Last year that old mouse died because it got sick.

zh: 虽然医生很努力，但是他还是死亡了。
pinyin: Suīrán yīshēng hěn nǔlì, dànshì tā háishi sǐwáng le.
en: Although the doctor tried hard, he still passed away.

zh: 这场车祸导致五个人死亡，很多人受伤。
pinyin: Zhè chǎng chēhuò dǎozhì wǔ ge rén sǐwáng, hěnduō rén shòushāng.
en: That car accident resulted in five deaths and many injuries.

zh: 根据报告，长期吸烟会大大增加死亡风险。
pinyin: Gēnjù bàogào, chángqī xīyān huì dàdà zēngjiā sǐwáng fēngxiǎn.
en: According to the report, long-term smoking significantly increases the risk of death.

zh: 我终于吃到了。
pinyin: Wǒ zhōngyú chīdào le.
en: I finally got to eat it.

zh: 等了很久，他终于来了。
pinyin: Děng le hěnjiǔ, tā zhōngyú lái le.
en: After waiting a long time, he finally arrived.

zh: 虽然很难，但是我终于学会了。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dànshì wǒ zhōngyú xuéhuì le.
en: Although it was difficult, I finally managed to learn it.

zh: 经过三个月的准备，我们终于可以开始这个项目了。
pinyin: Jīngguò sān ge yuè de zhǔnbèi, wǒmen zhōngyú kěyǐ kāishǐ zhège xiàngmù le.
en: After three months of preparation, we can finally start this project.

zh: 她工作了五年才攒够钱，终于买上了自己的房子。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò le wǔ nián cái zǎnggòu qián, zhōngyú mǎishàng le zìjǐ de fángzi.
en: After working for five years and saving up, she finally bought her own apartment.

zh: 我拥有一只猫。
pinyin: Wǒ yōngyǒu yī zhī māo.
en: I have a cat.

zh: 他拥有很多好朋友。
pinyin: Tā yōngyǒu hěnduō hǎo péngyou.
en: He has lots of good friends.

zh: 因为她拥有丰富经验,所以找到了好工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā yōngyǒu fēngfù jīngyàn, suǒyǐ zhǎodàole hǎo gōngzuò.
en: Because she has rich experience, she found a good job.

zh: 那家公司拥有先进的技术,虽然规模不大。
pinyin: Nà jiā gōngsī yōngyǒu xiānnjìn de jìshù, suīrán guīmó búdà.
en: That company possesses advanced technology, even though it's not very large.

zh: 能拥有健康的身体和稳定的工作,已经是很幸运的事了。
pinyin: Néng yōngyǒu jiànkāng de shēntǐ hé wěndìng de gōngzuò, yǐjīng shì hěn xìngyùn de shì le.
en: Being able to have a healthy body and a stable job is already quite fortunate.

zh: 警察来了。
pinyin: Jǐngchá lái le.
en: The police officer came.

zh: 昨天警察在我们学校。
pinyin: Zuótiān jǐngchá zài wǒmen xuéxiào.
en: The police were at our school yesterday.

zh: 因为有小偷，所以警察来保护我们的家。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu xiǎotōu, suǒyǐ jǐngchá lái bǎohù wǒmen de jiā.
en: Because there was a thief, the police came to protect our house.

zh: 那个年轻警察虽然很严肃，但是对我们很有礼貌。
pinyin: Nàge niánqīng jǐngchá suīrán hěn yánsuò, dànshì duì wǒmen hěn yǒu lǐmào.
en: Although that young police officer seemed very stern, he was quite polite to us.

zh: 警察提醒司机们要小心驾驶，不然会造成交通事故。
pinyin: Jǐngchá tíxǐng sījīmen yào xiǎoxin jiàshǐ, búrán huì zàochéng jiāotōng shìgù.
en: The police reminded drivers to be careful while driving, or they would cause traffic accidents.

zh: 这是一条船。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī tiáo chuán.
en: This is a boat.

zh: 我昨天坐船去了那个岛。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān zuò chuán qù le nàge dǎo.
en: I took a boat to that island yesterday.

zh: 虽然船很小，但是很安全。
pinyin: Suīrán chuán hěn xiǎo, dànshì hěn ānquán.
en: Although the boat is small, it's quite safe.

zh: 因为天气不好，所以那条船没有出海。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, suǒyǐ nà tiáo chuán méiyǒu chūhǎi.
en: Because of the bad weather, the boat didn't set out to sea.

zh: 他每天都要检查船的引擎，以确保安全航行。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu yào jiǎnchá chuán de yǐn擎, yǐ quèbǎo ānquán hánghíng.
en: He checks the boat's engine every day to ensure safe navigation.

zh: 我付钱买书。
pinyin: Wǒ fù qián mǎi shū.
en: I paid money to buy a book.

zh: 昨天我在饭店付了账单。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài fàndiàn fùle zhàngdān.
en: Yesterday I settled the bill at the restaurant.

zh: 因为他忘记付房租，所以房东很生气。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā wàngjì fù fángzū, suǒyǐ fángdōng hěn shēngqì.
en: Because he forgot to pay the rent, the landlord got very angry.

zh: 这个月我需要付医疗费用，虽然很贵，但必须付。
pinyin: Zhège yuè wǒ xūyào fù yīliáo fèiyòng, suīrán hěn guì, dàn bìxū fù.
en: This month I need to pay medical expenses, and even though they're expensive, I have to pay them.

zh: 她为了孩子的教育付出了很多努力，这种投入一定会有回报。
pinyin: Tā wèile háizi de jiàoyù fùchūle hěnduō nǔlì, zhè zhǒng tóurù yīdìng huì yǒu huíbào.
en: She made great efforts and sacrificed a lot for her child's education, and such investment will definitely pay off.

zh: 我们明天开派对。
pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān kāi pàiduì.
en: We're having a party tomorrow.

zh: 周末我想去参加派对吃蛋糕。
pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ xiǎng qù cānjiā pàiduì chī dàngāo.
en: I want to go to a party this weekend and eat cake.

zh: 因为今天是生日，所以朋友们都来了派对。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān shì shēngrì, suǒyǐ péngyoumen dōu lái le pàiduì.
en: Because it's my birthday today, all my friends came to the party.

zh: 虽然派对很晚才开始，但是大家都玩得很开心。
pinyin: Suīrán pàiduì hěn wǎn cái kāishǐ, búguò dàjiā dōu wán de hěn kāixīn.
en: Although the party started quite late, everyone had a lot of fun.

zh: 上周的派对人太多了，我们决定下次派对就在家里举办。
pinyin: Shàng zhōu de pàiduì rén tài duō le, wǒmen juéding xiàcì pàiduì jiù zài jiālǐ jǔbàn.
en: Last week's party had way too many people, so we decided to host the next one at home.

zh: 我遍地找钥匙。
pinyin: Wǒ biàn dì zhǎo yào匙.
en: I looked everywhere for my keys.

zh: 昨天我遍访了所有的朋友。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ biàn fǎng le suǒyǒu de péngyou.
en: Yesterday I visited all my friends one by one.

zh: 虽然时间很紧，但他还是遍阅了所有的资料。
pinyin: Suīrán shíjiān hěn jǐn, dàn tā háishi biànyuè le suǒyǒu de zīliào.
en: Although time was tight, he still went through all the materials thoroughly.

zh: 新产品上市后，广告遍布了整个城市的大街小巷。
pinyin: Xīn chǎnpǐn shàngshì hòu, guǎnggào biànbù le zhěnggè chéngshì de dàjiē xiǎoxiàng.
en: After the new product launched, advertisements spread throughout every street and corner of the city.

zh: 他遍读群书，学富五车，却始终保持谦虚的态度。
pinyin: Tā biàndú qúnshū, xuéfù wǔ chē,却 shǐzhōng bǎochí qiānxū de tàidù.
en: He's read widely and extensively learned, yet he's always maintained a humble attitude.

zh: 我每天走步。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǒu bù.
en: I take a walk every day.

zh: 早上我喜欢在公园里散步。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ xǐhuān zài gōngyuán lǐ sǎnbù.
en: In the morning, I like to take a walk in the park.

zh: 虽然今天很冷，但是我还是决定去散步。
pinyin: Suīrán jīntiān hěn lěng, dànshì wǒ háishi juéding qù sǎnbù.
en: Although it's cold today, I've still decided to go for a walk.

zh: 工作一整天以后，散步能帮我放松身体和精神。
pinyin: Gōngzuò yī zhěngtiān yǐhòu, sǎnbù néng bāng wǒ fàng松 shēntǐ hé jīngshén.
en: After working all day, taking a walk helps me relax both my body and mind.

zh: 他虽然年纪大了，但每天还坚持散步半小时来保持健康。
pinyin: Tā suīrán niánjì dà le, dàn měitiān háishi jiānchí sǎnbù bàn xiǎoshí lái bǎochí jiànkāng.
en: Even though he's getting on in years, he still walks for half an hour every day to stay healthy.

zh: 我不再吃糖了。
pinyin: Wǒ búzài chī táng le.
en: I don't eat candy anymore.

zh: 他生病以后不再去学校了。
pinyin: Tā shēngbìng yǐhòu búzài qù xuéxiào le.
en: After he got sick, he stopped going to school.

zh: 因为下雨，我们不再去公园，但是在家玩游戏。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒmen búzài qù gōngyuán, búguò zài jiā wán yóuxì.
en: Because it's raining, we're not going to the park anymore, but we're playing games at home instead.

zh: 自从用了新手机，他不再抱怨电池不够用了。
pinyin: Zìcóng yòngle xīn shǒujī, tā búzài bàoyuàn diànchí búgòu yòng le.
en: Since he got a new phone, he's stopped complaining about the battery running out.

zh: 随着经济改善，越来越多的年轻人不再选择离开城市去农村工作。
pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì gǎishàn, yuèláiyuè duō de niánqīng rén búzài xuǎnzé líkāi chéngshì qù nóngcūn gōngzuò.
en: As the economy improves, more and more young people are no longer choosing to leave the city to work in rural areas.

zh: 小孩怕鬼。
pinyin: Xiǎo háizi pà guǐ.
en: Little children are afraid of ghosts.

zh: 万圣节的时候，人们穿鬼的衣服。
pinyin: Wàn shèngjié de shíhou, rénmen chuān guǐ de yīfu.
en: During Halloween, people wear ghost costumes.

zh: 虽然他说有鬼，但是我不相信，因为世界上没有鬼。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shuō yǒu guǐ, dànshi wǒ búxiāngxìn, yīnwèi shìjiè shang méiyǒu guǐ.
en: Although he said there were ghosts, I didn't believe him because ghosts don't exist in the real world.

zh: 这部恐怖电影讲的是一个被鬼缠身的女人的故事。
pinyin: Zhè bù kǒngbù diànyǐng jiǎng de shì yī ge bèi guǐ chánshēn de nǚren de gùshi.
en: This horror film tells the story of a woman who is haunted by a ghost.

zh: 他工作太累了，经常看到幻觉，同事们都说他是鬼迷心窍了。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò tài lèi le, jīngcháng kàndào huànjuéé, tóngshì men dōu shuō tā shì guǐmí xīnqiào le.
en: He was so exhausted from work that he kept seeing things; his coworkers said he was completely out of it.

zh: 我喝咖啡。
pinyin: Wǒ hē kāfēi.
en: I drink coffee.

zh: 早上我喜欢喝一杯咖啡。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ xǐhuān hē yībēi kāfēi.
en: In the morning, I like to have a cup of coffee.

zh: 因为咖啡很苦，所以她在里面加了糖。
pinyin: Yīnwèi kāfēi hěn kǔ, suǒyǐ tā zàilimiàn jiāle táng.
en: Because the coffee was bitter, she added sugar to it.

zh: 这家咖啡店的环境不错，很适合工作的时候来。
pinyin: Zhè jiā kāfēi diàn de huánjìng búcuò, hěn shìhé gōngzuò de shíhou lái.
en: This coffee shop has a nice atmosphere and is perfect for coming to work.

zh: 与其每天买外面的咖啡，不如自己在家里泡，既省钱又新鲜。
pinyin: Yǔqī měitiān mǎi wàimiàn de kāfēi, búrú zìjǐ zàijiāli pào, jì shěng qián yòu xīnxiān.
en: Rather than buying coffee outside every day, you might as well brew it at home—it's cheaper and fresher.

zh: 他很傻。
pinyin: Tā hěn shǎ.
en: He's really silly.

zh: 我弟弟有时候很傻，总是忘记东西。
pinyin: Wǒ dìdi yǒushíhou hěn shǎ, zǒngshì wàngjì dōngxi.
en: My little brother is kind of silly sometimes—he's always forgetting things.

zh: 虽然他看起来傻，但是他其实很聪明。
pinyin: Suīrán tā kàn qǐlai shǎ, dànshì tā qíshí hěn cōngming.
en: Even though he seems silly on the surface, he's actually pretty smart.

zh: 你别傻了，这么明显的骗局你都看不出来？
pinyin: Nǐ biéshǎ le, zhème míngxiǎn de piànjú nǐ dōu kàn bu chūlái?
en: Come on, don't be dense—you can't even see through such an obvious scam?

zh: 他傻傻地相信了那些承诺，结果被骗得一塌糊涂。
pinyin: Tā shǎshǎ de xiāngxìn le nàxiē chéngnuò, jiéguǒ bèi piàn de yītāhútu.
en: He naively believed all those promises and ended up getting totally duped.

zh: 我们要阻止他吃糖。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào zǔzhǐ tā chī táng.
en: We need to stop him from eating candy.

zh: 警察阻止了那个坏人进入房间。
pinyin: Jǐngchá zǔzhǐle nàge huài rén jìnrù fángjiān.
en: The police officer prevented that bad person from entering the room.

zh: 虽然很困难,但我们必须阻止这个问题变得更糟。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn kùnnan, dàn wǒmen bìxū zǔzhǐ zhège wèntí biàn de gèng zāo.
en: Although it's difficult, we must prevent this problem from getting worse.

zh: 政府采取了措施来阻止污染继续扩大。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔle cuòshī lái zǔzhǐ wūrǎn jìxù kuòdà.
en: The government took measures to stop pollution from continuing to spread.

zh: 尽管公司想阻止竞争对手进入市场,但这种做法最终还是失败了。
pinyin: Jìnguǎn gōngsī xiǎng zǔzhǐ jìngjìng duìshǒu jìnrù shìchǎng, dàn zhè zhǒng zuòfǎ zuìzhōng háishi shībài le.
en: Although the company wanted to block its competitors from entering the market, this approach ultimately failed.

zh: 我想象一个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngxiàng yī ge píngguǒ.
en: I'm imagining an apple.

zh: 小孩喜欢想象有趣的故事。
pinyin: Xiǎoháir xǐhuān xiǎngxiàng yǒuqù de gùshì.
en: Children like to imagine fun stories.

zh: 虽然我没去过那个地方，但我能想象它很美。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ méi qù guò nàge dìfang, dàn wǒ néng xiǎngxiàng tā hěn měi.
en: Although I've never been there, I can imagine it's very beautiful.

zh: 很难想象一个人在没有朋友的情况下生活会是什么样子。
pinyin: Hěn nán xiǎngxiàng yī ge rén zài méiyǒu péngyou de qíngkuàng xià shēnghuó huì shì shénmeyàng zǐzi.
en: It's hard to imagine what life would be like for someone without friends.

zh: 你可以想象，如果互联网突然消失了，现代社会会陷入什么样的混乱。
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ xiǎngxiàng, rúguǒ hùliánwǎng túrán xiāoshī le, xiàndài shèhuì huì xiànrù shénmeyàng de hùnluàn.
en: You can imagine the kind of chaos that would grip modern society if the internet suddenly vanished.

zh: 他很冷静。
pinyin: Tā hěn lěngjìng.
en: He is very calm.

zh: 妈妈遇到问题时很冷静。
pinyin: Māma yùdào wèntí shí hěn lěngjìng.
en: Mom stays calm when she encounters problems.

zh: 虽然他很害怕，但他努力保持冷静。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn hàipà, dàn tā nǔlì bǎochí lěngjìng.
en: Although he was scared, he tried hard to stay calm.

zh: 在紧急情况下，医生必须保持头脑冷静。
pinyin: Zài jǐnjí qíngkuàng xià, yīshēng bìxū bǎochí tóunǎo lěngjìng.
en: In emergencies, doctors must keep a clear head.

zh: 他越是遇到挫折就越冷静，这种心态值得我们学习。
pinyin: Tā yuèshì yùdào cuòzhé jiù yuè lěngjìng, zhè zhǒng xīntài zhídé wǒmen xuéxí.
en: The more setbacks he faces, the calmer he becomes—that kind of mindset is worth learning from.

zh: 这是学习的好方法。
pinyin: Zhè shì xuéxí de hǎo fāngfǎ.
en: This is a good way to study.

zh: 早上跑步是保持健康的方法。
pinyin: Zǎoshang pǎobù shì bǎochí jiànkāng de fāngfǎ.
en: Running in the morning is a way to stay healthy.

zh: 虽然有很多方法，但是最简单的办法最有效。
pinyin: Suīrán yǒu hěnduō fāngfǎ, dànshì zuì jiǎndān de bànfǎ zuì yǒuxiào.
en: Although there are many methods, the simplest approach is usually the most effective.

zh: 如果你想提高英语水平，最好的方法就是每天练习。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng tígāo yīngyǔ shuǐpíng, zuì hǎo de fāngfǎ jiùshì měitiān liànxí.
en: If you want to improve your English, the best method is to practice every day.

zh: 解决这个问题没有什么灵丹妙药，关键是找到适合自己的方法。
pinyin: Jiějué zhège wèntí méiyǒu shénme língdān miàoyao, guānjiàn shì zhǎodào shìhéhé zìjǐ de fāngfǎ.
en: There's no magic solution to this problem; the key is finding a method that works for you.

zh: 他犯了一个错误。
pinyin: Tā fànle yīgè cuòwù.
en: He made a mistake.

zh: 昨天我犯了一个很大的错误。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ fànle yīgè hěn dà de cuòwù.
en: Yesterday I made a really big mistake.

zh: 虽然他很聪明，但是还是容易犯错误。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn cōngming, dànshì háishi róngyì fàncuòwù.
en: Although he's smart, he still tends to make careless mistakes.

zh: 开车的时候犯困会非常危险。
pinyin: Kāichē de shíhou fàn kùn huì fēicháng wēixiǎn.
en: Getting drowsy while driving is extremely dangerous.

zh: 他因为不专心工作而经常犯一些低级的错误。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi bù zhuānxīn gōngzuò érjīngcháng fàn yīxiē dījí de cuòwù.
en: Because he doesn't focus on his work, he often makes careless mistakes.

zh: 我扔了垃圾。
pinyin: Wǒ扔le lājī.
en: I threw out the trash.

zh: 他每天都扔掉很多旧东西。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu扔diào hěn duō jiù dōngxi.
en: Every day he throws away lots of old things.

zh: 虽然这个包很旧，但我不想扔掉它。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège bāo hěn jiù, dànshì wǒ búxiǎng扔diào tā.
en: Although this bag is old, I don't want to throw it away.

zh: 他经常扔一些重要的文件，结果后来后悔了。
pinyin: Tā jīngcháng扔 yīxiē zhònyào de wénjiàn, jiéguǒ hòulái hòuhuǐ le.
en: He often threw away important documents, and later he regretted it.

zh: 与其把钱扔在没有回报的投资上，不如存起来。
pinyin: Yǔqī bǎ qián扔 zài méiyǒu huíbào de tóuzī shang, búrú cún qǐlai.
en: Rather than throw money at investments with no return, it's better to save it.

zh: 我祝你生日快乐。
pinyin: Wǒ zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè.
en: I wish you a happy birthday.

zh: 妈妈祝我考试成功。
pinyin: Māma zhù wǒ kǎoshì chénggōng.
en: Mom wishes me success on my exam.

zh: 因为明天是你的大日子，我真诚地祝你好运。
pinyin: Yīnwèi míngtiān shì nǐ de dà rìzi, wǒ zhēnchéng de zhù nǐ hǎoyùn.
en: Because tomorrow is your big day, I sincerely wish you good luck.

zh: 虽然我们相距很远，但我还是要祝你新年快乐。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen xiāngjù hěn yuǎn, dàn wǒ háishi yào zhù nǐ xīnnián kuàilè.
en: Even though we're far apart, I still want to wish you a happy new year.

zh: 在你开始这个新工作之前，我祝你一帆风顺，希望你能充分发挥自己的潜力。
pinyin: Zài nǐ kāishǐ zhège xīn gōngzuò zhīqián, wǒ zhù nǐ yī fān fēng shùn, xīwàng nǐ néng chōngfèn fāhuī zìjǐ de qiánlì.
en: Before you start this new job, I wish you smooth sailing and hope you can fully realize your potential.

zh: 我有能力吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu néngglì chīfàn.
en: I'm able to eat.

zh: 他的英语能力很好。
pinyin: Tā de yīngyǔ néngglì hěn hǎo.
en: His English ability is very good.

zh: 虽然他很年轻，但是工作能力很强。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn niánqīng, dànshì gōngzuò néngglì hěn qiáng.
en: Although he's young, his work ability is very strong.

zh: 经过两年的训练，她的编程能力已经提高了很多。
pinyin: Jīngguò liǎng nián de xùnliàn, tā de biānchéng néngglì yǐjīng tíhāo le hěnduō.
en: After two years of training, her programming ability has improved a lot.

zh: 要想在这个行业成功，不仅需要专业知识，更重要的是解决问题的能力。
pinyin: Yào xiǎng zài zhège hángyè chénggōng, bújǐn xūyào zhuānyè zhīshi, gèng zhòngyào de shì jiějué wèntí de néngglì.
en: To succeed in this industry, you need not just professional knowledge, but more importantly, the ability to solve problems.

zh: 这个苹果很完美。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ hěn wánměi.
en: This apple is perfect.

zh: 昨天的生日派对很完美。
pinyin: Zuótiān de shēngrì pàiduì hěn wánměi.
en: Yesterday's birthday party was really perfect.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但这次旅游还是很完美。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dànshì zhè cì lǚyóu háishi hěn wánměi.
en: Even though the weather wasn't great, the trip was still perfect.

zh: 因为做了充分准备，所以这次演讲进行得完美。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zuòle chōngfèn zhǔnbèi, suǒyǐ zhè cì yǎnjiǎng jìnxíng de wánměi.
en: Because we prepared thoroughly, the presentation went perfectly.

zh: 虽然不是十全十美，但这个方案已经相当完美了。
pinyin: Suīrán búshì shíquán-shíměi, dàn zhège fāng'àn yǐjīng xiāngdāng wánměi le.
en: While it's not absolutely flawless, this solution is already quite excellent.

zh: 我克制了吃糖。
pinyin: Wǒ kèzhì le chī táng.
en: I resisted eating candy.

zh: 他每天都克服困难去上学。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu kèfúk ùnnan qù shàngxué.
en: He overcomes difficulties to go to school every day.

zh: 虽然这个任务很难,但我们能克服它。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège rènwu hěn nán, dàn wǒmen néng kèfúk tā.
en: Although this task is hard, we can overcome it.

zh: 为了克服语言障碍,她每天坚持练习。
pinyin: Wèile kèfúk yǔyán zhàngài, tā měi tiān jiānchí liànxí.
en: To overcome the language barrier, she practices persistently every day.

zh: 他克服了自己的恐惧,最终成功完成了这个项目。
pinyin: Tā kèfúk le zìjǐ de kǒngjù, zuìzhōng chénggōng wánchéng le zhège xiàngmù.
en: He conquered his own fear and ultimately succeeded in completing the project.

zh: 我的口很渴。
pinyin: Wǒ de kǒu hěn kě.
en: My mouth is very dry.

zh: 早上我在家里吃口饭。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ zài jiāli chī kǒu fàn.
en: In the morning I eat a meal at home.

zh: 因为天气热，所以我想喝口冷水。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì rè, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng hē kǒu lěng shuǐ.
en: Because the weather is hot, I want to drink some cold water.

zh: 虽然他说话很多，但是每句话都很有意思。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shuōhuà hěn duō, dànshì měi jù huà dōu hěn yǒu yìsi.
en: Although he talks a lot, every word he says is interesting.

zh: 这家餐厅的口碑很好，食客们都夸它的菜味道一流。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cānting de kǒub碑 hěn hǎo, shíkè men dōu kuā tā de cài wèidào yī liú.
en: This restaurant has an excellent reputation, and diners all praise its cooking as first-rate.

zh: 我的目标是学中文。
pinyin: Wǒ de mùbiāo shì xué Zhōngwén.
en: My goal is to study Chinese.

zh: 今年我的目标是每天运动。
pinyin: Jīnnián wǒ de mùbiāo shì měitiān yùndòng.
en: This year, my goal is to exercise every day.

zh: 因为想找好工作，所以我的目标是学更多技能。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiǎng zhǎo hǎo gōngzuò, suǒyǐ wǒ de mùbiāo shì xué gèngduō jìnéng.
en: Because I want to find a good job, my goal is to learn more skills.

zh: 虽然很困难，但公司的目标是在三年内增加销售。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn kùnnan, dàn gōngsī de mùbiāo shì zài sānnián nèi zēngjiā xiāoshòu.
en: Although it's challenging, the company's goal is to increase sales within three years.

zh: 运动员制定了明确的目标，为的是在比赛中发挥最好的水平。
pinyin: Yùndòngyuán zhìdìngle míngquè de mùbiāo, wèi de shì zài bǐsài zhōng fāhuī zuìhǎo de shuǐpíng.
en: The athlete set a clear goal in order to perform at their best during the competition.

zh: 耶！我赢了！
pinyin: Yē! Wǒ yíng le!
en: Yes! I won!

zh: 昨天我去公园，耶，天气很好。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ qù gōngyuán, yē, tiānqì hěn hǎo.
en: I went to the park yesterday, and wow, the weather was really nice.

zh: 虽然很累，但是我们终于完成了，耶！
pinyin: Suīrán hěn léi, dànshì wǒmen zhōngyú wánchéngle, yē!
en: Even though we were exhausted, we finally finished it—yes!

zh: 他听到录取通知的时候大喊一声耶，全家都很开心。
pinyin: Tā tīngdào lùqǔ tōngzhī de shíhou dàhǎn yī shēng yē, quánjiā dōu hěn kāixīn.
en: When he heard he got accepted, he let out a big 'yes!', and the whole family was thrilled.

zh: 看到最后一秒进球，我们都激动得耶地跳了起来。
pinyin: Kàndào zuìhòu yī miǎo jìnqiú, wǒmen dōu jīdòng de yē de tiàole qǐlái.
en: Seeing the goal scored in the final second, we all jumped up excitedly, shouting 'yes!'

zh: 今天是星期一。
pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqī yī.
en: Today is Monday.

zh: 我每天早上六点起床。
pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang liù diǎn qǐchuáng.
en: I get up at six o'clock every morning.

zh: 虽然昨天下雨，但是我们还是去公园了。
pinyin: Suīrán zuótiān xiàyǔ, dànshì wǒmen háishi qù gōngyuán le.
en: Even though it rained yesterday, we still went to the park.

zh: 因为这个项目需要时间，所以我们决定把截止日期延后一周。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhège xiàngmù xūyào shíjiān, suǒyǐ wǒmen juéding bǎ jiēzhǐ rìqī yánhòu yī zhōu.
en: Since this project needs more time, we've decided to push back the deadline by one week.

zh: 他三天两头加班到深夜，这样下去迟早会影响身体。
pinyin: Tā sān tiān liǎng tóu jiābān dào shēnyè, zhèyàng xiàqù chízhǎo huì yǐngxiǎng shēntǐ.
en: He's constantly working late into the night; if this keeps up, it'll eventually take a toll on his health.

zh: 这有关我的家。
pinyin: Zhè yǒuguān wǒ de jiā.
en: This is about my family.

zh: 老师说了有关明天考试的事情。
pinyin: Lǎoshī shuōle yǒuguān míngtiān kǎoshì de shìqing.
en: The teacher told us about tomorrow's exam.

zh: 因为天气不好，所以比赛有关的安排改了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, suǒyǐ bǐsài yǒuguān de ānpái gǎile.
en: Because the weather is bad, all the arrangements related to the match have been changed.

zh: 公司收到了有关新产品上市的重要通知。
pinyin: Gōngsī shōudàole yǒuguān xīn chǎnpǐn shàngshì de zhòngyào tōngzhī.
en: The company received an important notice regarding the new product launch.

zh: 这份报告提供了有关市场趋势的详细数据分析。
pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào tígōngle yǒuguān shìchǎng qūshì de xiáng细 shùjù fēnxī.
en: This report provides a detailed data analysis concerning market trends.

zh: 他的精神很好。
pinyin: Tā de jīngshén hěn hǎo.
en: He's in a good mood.

zh: 早上喝咖啡以后,精神就好了。
pinyin: Zǎoshang hē kāfēi yǐhòu, jīngshén jiù hǎo le.
en: After drinking coffee in the morning, I feel more energized.

zh: 虽然很累,但是他的精神还是不错的。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshi tā de jīngshén háishi búcuò de.
en: Even though he's tired, his spirits are still pretty good.

zh: 长期睡眠不足会影响工作的精神状态。
pinyin: Chángqī shuìmián búzú huì yǐngxiǎng gōngzuò de jīngshén zhuàngtài.
en: Chronic sleep deprivation affects your mental state at work.

zh: 这个项目虽然困难,但团队的精神面貌令人印象深刻。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù suīrán kùnnan, dàn tuánduì de jīngshén miànmào lìngrén yìnxiàng shēnkè.
en: The project is challenging, but the team's morale and spirit have been really impressive.

zh: 我喜欢苹果，另外也喜欢香蕉。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān píngguǒ, lìngwài yě xǐhuān xiāngjiāo.
en: I like apples, and I also like bananas.

zh: 今天我买了书，另外还买了一支笔。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ mǎile shū, lìngwài háishi mǎile yī zhī bǐ.
en: Today I bought a book, and I also bought a pen.

zh: 虽然这家餐厅很贵，但是食物很好吃，另外服务也不错。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiā cānting hěn guì, dànshi shíwù hěn hǎochī, lìngwài fúwù yě búcuò.
en: Although this restaurant is expensive, the food is delicious, and besides, the service is also good.

zh: 这个工作薪水不低，另外公司还提供健康保险和假期。
pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò xīnshuǐ búdī, lìngwài gōngsī háishi tígōng jiànkāng bǎoxiǎn hé jiàqī.
en: This job offers decent pay, and in addition the company also provides health insurance and holidays.

zh: 我们的计划不仅需要资金支持，另外还需要有经验的团队来执行。
pinyin: Wǒmen de jìhuà bújǐn xūyào zījīn zhīchí, lìngwài háishi xūyào yǒu jīngyàn de tuánduì lái zhíxíng.
en: Our plan needs not only financial backing but also an experienced team to carry it out.

zh: 我要放松。
pinyin: Wǒ yào fàng松。
en: I need to relax.

zh: 周末我喜欢放松,看电视。
pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ xǐhuān fàng松, kàn diànshì。
en: On weekends I like to relax and watch TV.

zh: 因为工作很累,所以我需要放松一下。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò hěn lèi, suǒyǐ wǒ xūyào fàng松 yīxià。
en: Because work is tiring, I need to take some time to unwind.

zh: 虽然今天很忙,但我还是要放松自己的心情。
pinyin: Suīrán jīntiān hěn máng, dàn wǒ háishi yào fàng松 zìjǐ de xīnqíng。
en: Even though today was hectic, I still need to ease my mind.

zh: 长期的压力让我无法放松,所以我决定去旅游调整一下。
pinyin: Chángqī de yālì ràng wǒ wúfǎ fàng松, suǒyǐ wǒ juéding qù lǚyóu tiáozhěng yīxià。
en: The prolonged stress made it impossible for me to relax, so I decided to take a trip to reset.

zh: 我丢了钥匙。
pinyin: Wǒ diūle yàoshi.
en: I lost my keys.

zh: 昨天我丢了一个很重要的包。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ diūle yī ge hěn zhòngyào de bāo.
en: I lost an important bag yesterday.

zh: 因为我不小心，所以丢了手机和钱包。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ búxiǎoxin, suǒyǐ diūle shǒujī he qiánbāo.
en: Because I wasn't careful, I lost my phone and wallet.

zh: 他在地铁上丢了护照，现在很着急地找警察帮忙。
pinyin: Tā zài dìtiě shang diūle hùzhào, xiànzài hěn zháojí de zhǎo jǐngchá bāngmang.
en: He lost his passport on the subway and is now anxiously looking for police to help.

zh: 别丢三落四，重要的文件一定要妥善保管好。
pinyin: Bié diū sān là sì, zhòngyào de wénjiàn yīdìng yào tuǒshàn bǎoguǎn hǎo.
en: Don't be forgetful and scatterbrained—you absolutely must keep important documents safe and secure.

zh: 我要休息。
pinyin: Wǒ yào xiūxi.
en: I need to rest.

zh: 下午我在家休息两个小时。
pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǒ zàijiā xiūxi liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
en: In the afternoon I rest at home for two hours.

zh: 因为很累，所以我今天需要好好休息。
pinyin: Yīnwèi hěn lèi, suǒyǐ wǒ jīntiān xūyào hǎohāo xiūxi.
en: Because I'm exhausted, I really need to get proper rest today.

zh: 工作了一整天以后，他坐在沙发上休息了一会儿。
pinyin: Gōngzuò le yī zhěng tiān yǐhòu, tā zuòzài shāfā shàng xiūxi le yīhuǐr.
en: After working the whole day, he sat on the sofa and rested for a while.

zh: 医生建议患者要劳逸结合，不能一直工作而不休息。
pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì huànzhě yào láoyì jiéhé, búnéng yìzhí gōngzuò érbuò xiūxi.
en: The doctor advised the patient to balance work and leisure—you can't just keep working without taking breaks.

zh: 我每天吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān chī mǐfàn.
en: I eat rice every day.

zh: 她每天早上跑步。
pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshang pǎobù.
en: She goes running every morning.

zh: 虽然很忙，但他每天都学中文。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn máng, dàn tā měitiān dōu xué zhōngwén.
en: Even though he's busy, he studies Chinese every day.

zh: 因为工作很累，所以我每天只睡六小时。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò hěn lèi, suǒyǐ wǒ měitiān zhǐ shuì liù xiǎoshí.
en: Because my job is exhausting, I only get six hours of sleep every day.

zh: 他每天坚持健身，这个习惯已经保持了三年。
pinyin: Tā měitiān jiānchí jiànshēn, zhège xíguàn yǐjīng bǎochíle le sān nián.
en: He works out every single day—he's maintained this habit for three years now.

zh: 他回答了我的问题。
pinyin: Tā huídá le wǒ de wènti.
en: He answered my question.

zh: 老师问我，我马上回答了。
pinyin: Lǎoshī wèn wǒ, wǒ mǎshang huídá le.
en: The teacher asked me, and I answered right away.

zh: 虽然问题很难，但是他还是认真回答了。
pinyin: Suīrán wènti hěn nán, dànshi tā háishi rènzhēn huídá le.
en: Although the question was difficult, he answered it carefully anyway.

zh: 在面试的时候，她用英文回答了所有的问题。
pinyin: Zài miànshì de shíhou, tā yòng yīngwén huídá le suǒyǒu de wènti.
en: During the interview, she answered all the questions in English.

zh: 面对记者的追问，发言人没有直接回答，反而转移了话题。
pinyin: Miànduì jìzhě de zhuīwèn, fāyánrén méiyǒu zhíjiē huídá, fǎn'ér zhuǎnyí le huàtí.
en: When pressed by reporters' follow-up questions, the spokesperson didn't answer directly but changed the subject instead.

zh: 警察找到了凶手。
pinyin: Jǐngchá zhǎodàole le xiōngshǒu.
en: The police found the killer.

zh: 昨天警察抓住了那个凶手。
pinyin: Zuótiān jǐngchá zhuāzhùle nàge xiōngshǒu.
en: Yesterday the police caught that murderer.

zh: 虽然凶手逃跑了，但是警察很快就找到他了。
pinyin: Suīrán xiōngshǒu táopǎole, dànshì jǐngchá hěnkuài jiù zhǎodàole tā le.
en: Although the killer fled, the police found him very quickly.

zh: 这起案件的凶手因为留下了指纹，最后被警察逮捕了。
pinyin: Zhè qǐ ànjiàn de xiōngshǒu yīnwèi liúxiàle zhǐwén, zuìhòu bèi jǐngchá dàibǔle.
en: The perpetrator of this case was eventually arrested by police because he left fingerprints.

zh: 经过三个月的调查，警方终于锁定了凶手，并且掌握了足够的证据。
pinyin: Jīngguò sān ge yuè de diàochá, jǐngfāng zhōngyú suǒdìngle xiōngshǒu, bìngqiě zhǎngwòle zúgòu de zhèngjù.
en: After three months of investigation, the police finally identified the perpetrator and gathered sufficient evidence.

zh: 我负责做饭。
pinyin: Wǒ fùzé zuò fàn.
en: I'm in charge of cooking.

zh: 他每天负责打扫教室。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān fùzé dǎsǎo jiàoshì.
en: He's responsible for cleaning the classroom every day.

zh: 因为你负责这个项目，所以要认真做好。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nǐ fùzé zhège xiàngmù, suǒyǐ yào rènzhēn zuò hǎo.
en: Since you're responsible for this project, you need to do it seriously.

zh: 这个部门的经理对公司的销售业绩负责。
pinyin: Zhège bùmén de jīnglǐ duì gōngsī de xiāoshòu yèjī fùzé.
en: The manager of this department is accountable for the company's sales performance.

zh: 作为团队领导，她不仅要负责日常工作，还要为团队的失误承担责任。
pinyin: Zuòwéi tuánduì lǐngdǎo, tā búyǐn yào fùzé rìcháng gōngzuò, háiyào wèi tuánduì de shīwù chéngdān zérèn.
en: As a team leader, she has to manage day-to-day operations and also take responsibility for the team's mistakes.

zh: 他的命很好。
pinyin: Tā de mìng hěn hǎo.
en: He has good luck.

zh: 医生救了他的命。
pinyin: Yīshēng jiùle tā de mìng.
en: The doctor saved his life.

zh: 虽然工作很累，但是为了家人的命运，他还是坚持了。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn lèi, dànshì wèile jiārén de mìngyùn, tā háishi jiānchíle.
en: Although the work was tiring, he kept going for his family's sake.

zh: 那次车祸改变了他整个人生的命运。
pinyin: Nà cì chēhuò gǎibiànle tā zhěngge rénshēng de mìngyùn.
en: That car accident completely changed the course of his life.

zh: 他认为自己的命运掌握在自己手里，所以从不抱怨生活。
pinyin: Tā rènwéi zìjǐ de mìngyùn zhǎngwò zài zìjǐ shǒulǐ, suǒyǐ cóng bu bàoyuàn shēnghuó.
en: He believes his fate is in his own hands, so he never complains about life.

zh: 我在外面吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ zài wàimiàn chīfàn.
en: I'm eating outside.

zh: 今天天气很好，我们一起去外面玩。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen yīqǐ qù wàimiàn wán.
en: The weather is nice today, so let's go outside and play together.

zh: 虽然外面下雨，但是我们还是要去上班。
pinyin: Suīrán wàimiàn xiàyǔ, dànshì wǒmen háishi yào qù shàngbān.
en: Even though it's raining outside, we still have to go to work.

zh: 除了家人以外，朋友对我的生活也很重要。
pinyin: Chúle jiārén yǐwài, péngyou duì wǒ de shēnghuó yě hěn zhòngyào.
en: Besides family, friends are also really important to my life.

zh: 这份工作的薪水不错，但工作环境和前景以外的其他方面还需要考虑。
pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò de xīnshuǐ búcuò, dàn gōngzuò huánjìng hé qiánjǐng yǐwài de qítā fāngmiàn háishi xūyào kǎolǜ.
en: The salary for this job is decent, but I still need to consider other aspects beyond the work environment and prospects.

zh: 我碰到了一个朋友。
pinyin: Wǒ pèngdào le yī ge péngyou.
en: I ran into a friend.

zh: 昨天我在公园碰见了老师。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài gōngyuán pèngjiàn le lǎoshī.
en: Yesterday I bumped into my teacher at the park.

zh: 虽然我们很久没见，但是今天碰面的时候很高兴。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen hěnjiǔ méi jiàn, dànshì jīntiān pèngmiàn de shíhou hěn gāoxìng.
en: Even though we hadn't seen each other in ages, we were really happy when we met up today.

zh: 他不小心碰坏了办公室里的电脑，现在特别担心被老板批评。
pinyin: Tā búxiǎoxin pènghuài le bàngōngshì li de diànnǎo, xiànzài tèbié dānxin bèi lǎobǎn píngpíng.
en: He accidentally damaged the office computer, and now he's really worried about getting scolded by his boss.

zh: 在这个行业里想成功，难免会碰到各种困难和挑战。
pinyin: Zài zhège hángyè li xiǎng chénggōng, nánmiǎn huì pèngdào gèzhǒng kùnnan hé tiǎozhàn.
en: If you want to succeed in this industry, you'll inevitably run into all kinds of difficulties and challenges.

zh: 你介意吗？
pinyin: Nǐ jièyì ma?
en: Do you mind?

zh: 我不介意喝冷水。
pinyin: Wǒ bújièyì hē lěng shuǐ.
en: I don't mind drinking cold water.

zh: 虽然房间很小，但我不介意。
pinyin: Suīrán fángjiān hěn xiǎo, dàn wǒ bújièyì.
en: Even though the room is small, I don't mind.

zh: 同事迟到了，但他好像不介意被批评。
pinyin: Tóngshì chídào le, dàn tā hǎoxiàng bújièyì bèi píngpíng.
en: My coworker was late, but he doesn't seem to mind being criticized.

zh: 与其纠结别人的看法，不如专注自己的目标，反正大多数人也不会介意。
pinyin: Yǔqī jiūjié biérén de kànfǎ, búrú zhuānzhù zìjǐ de mùbiāo, fǎnzhèng dàduōshù rén yě búhuì jièyì.
en: Rather than obsess over what others think, focus on your own goals—most people won't care anyway.

zh: 我做了一个梦。
pinyin: Wǒ zuòle yīgè梦。
en: I had a dream.

zh: 昨天晚上我做梦了，梦里很有趣。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ zuò梦le, mèng lǐ hěn yǒuqù.
en: Last night I had a dream—it was really fun in the dream.

zh: 虽然那只是一个梦，但是我醒来以后还记得很清楚。
pinyin: Suīrán nà zhǐ shì yīgè梦, dànshì wǒ xǐnglaí yǐhòu háishi jìde hěn qīngchǔ.
en: Even though it was just a dream, I still remember it very clearly after I woke up.

zh: 他从小就有一个梦想，想要成为一名医生来帮助别人。
pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù yǒu yīgè梦xiǎng, xiǎngyào chéngwéi yīmíng yīshēng lái bāngzhù biérén.
en: He's had a dream since childhood—he wants to become a doctor to help people.

zh: 很多人都说做梦是大脑在处理信息，所以有时候梦会很荒唐。
pinyin: Hěnduō rén dōu shuō zuò梦 shì dànǎo zài chǔlǐ xìnxī, suǒyǐ yǒushíhou梦 huì hěn huāngtáng.
en: Many people say that dreaming is the brain processing information, which is why dreams can sometimes be completely absurd.

zh: 我试试这个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ shìshi zhège píngguǒ.
en: Let me try this apple.

zh: 你明天试试能不能来。
pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān shìshi néng bu néng lái.
en: Try to see if you can come tomorrow.

zh: 因为我没穿过，所以我想试试这件衣服。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ méi chuānguò, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng shìshi zhè jiàn yīfu.
en: Since I've never worn one like this, I want to try on this outfit.

zh: 虽然这个方法有点奇怪，但我们还是先试试看能不能解决。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège fāngfǎ yǒudiǎn qíguài, dàn wǒmen háishi xiānshi shìshi kàn néng bu néng jiějué.
en: Although this method seems a bit odd, let's try it anyway and see if it can solve the problem.

zh: 与其一直抱怨效果不好，不如主动试试新的营销策略。
pinyin: Yǔqī yìzhí bàoyuàn xiàoguǒ búhǎo, búrú zhǔdòng shìshi xīn de yíngxiāo cèlüè.
en: Instead of constantly complaining about poor results, why not proactively try a new marketing strategy?

zh: 那天我吃了面。
pinyin: Nà tiān wǒ chīle miàn.
en: That day I ate noodles.

zh: 那天下雨，我没有去公园。
pinyin: Nà tiān xiàyǔ, wǒ méiyǒu qù gōngyuán.
en: It rained that day, so I didn't go to the park.

zh: 那天的时候虽然很冷，但是我们还是去爬山了。
pinyin: Nà tiān de shíhou suīrán hěn lěng, dànshi wǒmen háishi qù páshān le.
en: Even though it was really cold that day, we still went hiking.

zh: 那天在咖啡馆里，我碰巧遇见了很久没见的朋友。
pinyin: Nà tiān zài kāfēiguǎn lǐ, wǒ碰巧 yùjiàn le hěnjiǔ méi jiàn de péngyou.
en: That day at the café, I happened to run into a friend I hadn't seen in ages.

zh: 那天的谈话让我受益匪浅，我们讨论了工作中的一些挑战。
pinyin: Nà tiān de tánhuà ràng wǒ shòuyìk fěiqiǎn, wǒmen tǎolùn le gōngzuò zhōng de yīxiē tiǎozhàn.
en: That conversation was really eye-opening for me—we discussed some of the challenges we face at work.

zh: 这个系统很好。
pinyin: Zhège xìtǒng hěn hǎo.
en: This system is really good.

zh: 学校的系统每天都在用。
pinyin: Xuéxiào de xìtǒng měi tiān dōu zài yòng.
en: We use the school's system every day.

zh: 因为系统坏了，所以我们不能工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xìtǒng huài le, suǒyǐ wǒmen búnéng gōngzuò.
en: Because the system broke down, we couldn't work.

zh: 虽然系统很复杂，但是新员工学得很快。
pinyin: Suīrán xìtǒng hěn fùzá, danshì xīn yuángōng xuéde hěn kuài.
en: Although the system is complicated, new employees pick it up quickly.

zh: 公司投入了大量资金升级系统，希望能提高工作效率。
pinyin: Gōngsī tóurù le dàliàng zījīn shēngjí xìtǒng, xīwàng néng tígāo gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
en: The company invested a lot of money to upgrade the system in hopes of improving work efficiency.

zh: 我要睡觉。
pinyin: Wǒ yào shuìjiào.
en: I'm going to sleep.

zh: 晚上十点我就睡觉了。
pinyin: Wǎnshang shí diǎn wǒ jiù shuìjiào le.
en: I go to bed at ten o'clock at night.

zh: 因为很累，所以我早早睡觉了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi hěn lèi, suǒyǐ wǒ zǎozao shuìjiào le.
en: Because I was tired, I went to bed early.

zh: 虽然他很想看电影，但还是决定睡觉了。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn xiǎng kàn diànyǐng, dàn háishi juéding shuìjiào le.
en: Although he really wanted to watch a movie, he decided to go to bed instead.

zh: 最近工作太忙，我经常只能睡觉不到六小时。
pinyin: Zuìjìn gōngzuò tài máng, wǒ jīngcháng zhǐnéng shuìjiào búdào liù xiǎoshí.
en: Work has been so hectic lately that I often get fewer than six hours of sleep.

zh: 球滚走了。
pinyin: Qiú gǔn zǒu le.
en: The ball rolled away.

zh: 小狗在草地上滚来滚去。
pinyin: Xiǎo gǒu zài cǎodì shang gǔn lái gǔn qù.
en: The puppy was rolling around on the grass.

zh: 因为地板很滑，所以木头球很快就滚下去了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi dìbǎn hěn huá, suǒyǐ mùtou qiú hěn kuài jiù gǔn xiàqu le.
en: Because the floor was slippery, the wooden ball rolled down really quickly.

zh: 他生气的时候总是让别人滚蛋，但没人真的会离开。
pinyin: Tā shēngqì de shíhou zǒngshì ràng biérén gǔn dàn, dàn méi rén zhēnde huì líkāi.
en: Whenever he gets angry, he tells people to scram, but nobody actually leaves.

zh: 这个项目一开始进展顺利，后来却滚成了一个烂摊子，最后只能放弃。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù yī kāishǐ jìnzhǎn shùnlì, hòulái què gǔn chéngle yī ge làn tānzi, zuìhòu zhǐnéng fàngqì.
en: The project started off smoothly, but then it turned into a complete mess, and we had to give it up in the end.

zh: 这是谋杀电影。
pinyin: Zhè shì móushā diànyǐng.
en: This is a murder movie.

zh: 昨天警察抓到了谋杀犯。
pinyin: Zuótiān jǐngchá zhuādàole móushā fàn.
en: Yesterday the police caught the murderer.

zh: 虽然他被指控谋杀，但是他说自己是无辜的。
pinyin: Suīrán tā bèi zhǐkòng móushā, dànshì tā shuō zìjǐ shì wúguìde.
en: Although he was accused of murder, he says he's innocent.

zh: 法官判定他犯了谋杀罪，因此他会在监狱里待很多年。
pinyin: Fǎguān pàndìng tā fànle móushā zuì, yīncǐ tā huì zài jiānyù lǐ dāi hěnduō nián.
en: The judge ruled that he committed murder, so he'll spend many years in prison.

zh: 这个案件涉及多起谋杀，侦探花了好几个月才理清真相。
pinyin: Zhège ànjiàn shèjí duōqǐ móushā, zhēntàn huāle hǎojǐ ge yuè cái lǐqīng zhēnxiàng.
en: This case involved multiple murders, and it took the detective several months to uncover the truth.

zh: 这是我的礼物。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de lǐwù.
en: This is my gift.

zh: 妈妈给我买了一个礼物。
pinyin: Māma gěi wǒ mǎile yī ge lǐwù.
en: Mom bought me a gift.

zh: 因为今天是我的生日,爸爸给我买了礼物。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān shì wǒ de shēngrì, bàba gěi wǒ mǎile lǐwù.
en: Because it's my birthday today, Dad bought me a gift.

zh: 虽然礼物不贵,但是它对我很有意义。
pinyin: Suīrán lǐwù búguì, danshì tā duì wǒ hěn yǒu yìyì.
en: Although the gift isn't expensive, it means a lot to me.

zh: 与其花大钱买礼物,不如选一份贴心的礼物送给朋友。
pinyin: Yǔqī huā dàqián mǎi lǐwù, búrú xuǎn yī fèn tiēxīn de lǐwù sònggěi péngyou.
