en: Rather than spend a lot of money on a gift, it's better to choose something thoughtful to give to a friend.

zh: 我不喜欢那种苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ búxǐhuān nàzhǒng píngguǒ.
en: I don't like that kind of apple.

zh: 他每天都喝那种咖啡。
pinyin: Tā měitiān dōu hē nàzhǒng kāfēi.
en: He drinks that type of coffee every day.

zh: 虽然那种天气很热,但是我们还是去了公园。
pinyin: Suīrán nàzhǒng tiānqì hěn rè, búguò wǒmen háishi qùle gōngyuán.
en: Even though that kind of weather was hot, we still went to the park.

zh: 很多年轻人都喜欢那种新的音乐风格。
pinyin: Hěnduō niánqīngrén dōu xǐhuān nàzhǒng xīnde yīnyuè fēnggé.
en: A lot of young people really like that new style of music.

zh: 那种老一代的工作态度其实值得我们学习。
pinyin: Nàzhǒng lǎo yīdài de gōngzuò tàidù qíshí zhídé wǒmen xuéxí.
en: That work ethic from the older generation is actually worth learning from.

zh: 我戴帽子。
pinyin: Wǒ dài màozi.
en: I'm wearing a hat.

zh: 冬天的时候我戴围巾。
pinyin: Dōngtiān de shíhou wǒ dài wéijīn.
en: I wear a scarf in winter.

zh: 因为太阳很大，所以我戴了太阳镜。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tàiyáng hěn dà, suǒyǐ wǒ dàile tàiyáng jìng.
en: Because the sun is so bright, I put on sunglasses.

zh: 医生戴着口罩给病人检查身体。
pinyin: Yīshēng dàizhe kǒuzhào gěi bìngrén jiǎnchá shēntǐ.
en: The doctor wears a mask while examining the patient's body.

zh: 运动员戴着奖牌走上领奖台，观众们为他们欢呼。
pinyin: Yùndòngyuán dàizhe jiǎngpái zǒushàng lǐngjiǎng tái, guānzhòngmen wèi tāmen huānhū.
en: The athletes wore their medals as they walked onto the podium, and the audience cheered for them.

zh: 各位，请坐。
pinyin: Gèwèi, qǐng zuò.
en: Everyone, please have a seat.

zh: 各位朋友，今天很高兴见到你们。
pinyin: Gèwèi péngyou, jīntiān hěn gāoxìng jiàndào nǐmen.
en: Friends, I'm really happy to see you all today.

zh: 虽然各位都很忙，但是希望大家能来参加这个会议。
pinyin: Suīrán gèwèi dōu hěn máng, dànshì xīwàng dàjiā néng lái cānjiā zhège huìyì.
en: Although you're all very busy, we hope everyone can attend this meeting.

zh: 各位如果对这个提议有不同意见，现在可以提出来。
pinyin: Gèwèi rúguǒ duì zhège tíyì yǒu búdòng yìjiàn, xiànzài kěyǐ tíchūlái.
en: If any of you have different opinions about this proposal, feel free to speak up now.

zh: 各位领导和同事们，感谢大家在项目中的配合和支持。
pinyin: Gèwèi lǐngdǎo hé tóngshìmen, gǎnxiè dàjiā zài xiàngmù zhōng de pèihé hé zhīchí.
en: Leadership and colleagues, thank you all for your cooperation and support throughout this project.

zh: 这是错误的。
pinyin: Zhè shì cuòwù de.
en: This is wrong.

zh: 我今天做了一个错误的决定。
pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān zuòle yī ge cuòwù de juéding.
en: I made a wrong decision today.

zh: 因为我没注意,所以犯了一个很大的错误。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ méi zhùyì, suǒyǐ fānle yī ge hěn dà de cuòwù.
en: Because I wasn't paying attention, I made a really big mistake.

zh: 虽然这个错误很严重,但我们还是可以修正它。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège cuòwù hěn yánzhòng, dàn wǒmen háishi kěyǐ xiūzhèng tā.
en: Even though this error is serious, we can still fix it.

zh: 他承认自己的错误,这种态度值得我们尊重和学习。
pinyin: Tā chéngrèn zìjǐ de cuòwù, zhè zhǒng tàidu zhíde wǒmen zūnjìng hé xuéxí.
en: He admitted his mistake; that kind of attitude deserves our respect and is worth learning from.

zh: 我的儿子很小。
pinyin: Wǒ de érzi hěn xiǎo.
en: My son is very young.

zh: 昨天我和女儿一起吃了饺子。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hé nǚ'ér yīqǐ chīle jiǎozi.
en: Yesterday I ate dumplings together with my daughter.

zh: 因为儿子喜欢看书，所以我给他买了很多故事书。
pinyin: Yīnwèi érzi xǐhuān kànshū, suǒyǐ wǒ gěi tā mǎile hěnduō gùshìshū.
en: Because my son loves reading, I bought him lots of storybooks.

zh: 虽然女儿才六岁，但她已经能自己系鞋带子了。
pinyin: Suīrán nǚ'ér cái liù suì, dàn tā yǐjīng néng zìjǐ xì xiéedàizi le.
en: Although my daughter is only six, she can already tie her shoelaces by herself.

zh: 我儿子为人处世很有分寸，所以在学校里朋友特别多。
pinyin: Wǒ érzi wéirén chǔshì hěn yǒu fēn寸, suǒyǐ zài xuéxiào lǐ péngyou tèbié duō.
en: My son has great judgment and tact in how he deals with people, so he has lots of friends at school.

zh: 你随便吃。
pinyin: Nǐ suíbiàn chī.
en: Help yourself to food.

zh: 今天天气好，我们随便去哪里都可以。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hǎo, wǒmen suíbiàn qù nǎlǐ dōu kěyǐ.
en: The weather is nice today, so we can go anywhere we like.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但是他随便抽出时间来帮我。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì tā suíbiàn chōuchū shíjiān lái bāng wǒ.
en: Although he's busy, he still found time to help me without making a fuss.

zh: 不要随便相信网上的信息，因为有些不是真的。
pinyin: Búyào suíbiàn xiāngxìn wǎngshang de xìnxī, yīnwèi yǒuxiē búshì zhēn de.
en: Don't just believe any information online, because some of it isn't accurate.

zh: 在工作中随便做决定往往会带来麻烦，所以我们需要谨慎考虑。
pinyin: Zài gōngzuò zhōng suíbiàn zuò juédìng wǎngwǎng huì dàilái máfan, suǒyǐ wǒmen xūyào jǐnshèn kǎolǜ.
en: Making snap decisions at work often causes problems, so we need to think carefully.

zh: 她的头发很长。
pinyin: Tā de tóufa hěn cháng.
en: Her hair is very long.

zh: 我今天洗了头发。
pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān xǐle tóufa.
en: I washed my hair today.

zh: 因为下雨，所以她的头发有点湿。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ tā de tóufa yǒudiǎn shī.
en: Because it was raining, her hair got a little wet.

zh: 虽然他剪了头发，但还是看起来很疲劳。
pinyin: Suīrán tā jiǎnle tóufa, dàn háishi kàn qǐlái hěn píláo.
en: Even though he got a haircut, he still looks exhausted.

zh: 长期染头发对发质伤害很大，所以我决定留自然色。
pinyin: Chángqī rǎn tóufa duì fāzhì shānghài hěn dà, suǒyǐ wǒ juédìng liú zìránséi.
en: Dyeing your hair constantly damages it a lot, so I've decided to keep my natural color.

zh: 猫藏在床下。
pinyin: māo cáng zài chuáng xià.
en: The cat is hiding under the bed.

zh: 他喜欢藏起来和朋友玩。
pinyin: Tā xǐhuān cáng qǐlai hé péngyou wán.
en: He likes to hide and play games with his friends.

zh: 虽然她藏了很多书，但是房间还是很整洁。
pinyin: Suīrán tā cángle hěnduō shū, dànshì fángjiān háishi hěn zhěngjié.
en: Although she stores a lot of books away, her room is still very tidy.

zh: 这个小镇藏着许多历史悠久的建筑，游客经常来这里参观。
pinyin: Zhège xiǎozhèn cángzhe xǔduō lìshǐ yōujiǔ de jiànzhù, yóukè jīngcháng lái zhèlǐ cānguān.
en: This small town holds many historically significant buildings that tourists regularly visit.

zh: 他为了逃避债务，藏匿在朋友家整整三个月，最后还是被发现了。
pinyin: Tā wèile táotuō zhàiwù, cángnì zài péngyou jiā zhěngzhěng sān ge yuè, zuìhòu háishi bèi fāxiàn le.
en: To avoid his debts, he went into hiding at a friend's place for three whole months, but was eventually discovered anyway.

zh: 妈妈关心我。
pinyin: Māma guānxīn wǒ.
en: My mom cares about me.

zh: 老师很关心学生的学习。
pinyin: Lǎoshī hěn guānxīn xuésheng de xuéxí.
en: The teacher really cares about her students' studies.

zh: 因为他关心你，所以他常常问你好。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā guānxīn nǐ, suǒyǐ tā chángcháng wèn nǐ hǎo.
en: Because he cares about you, he's always asking how you are.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但她仍然关心每个员工的生活。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn tā réngránguānxīn měi ge yuángōng de shēnghuó.
en: Even though work is hectic, she still takes care to look out for each employee's wellbeing.

zh: 他不仅关心公司的发展，也很关心员工的职业前景。
pinyin: Tā bújǐn guānxīn gōngsī de fāzhǎn, yě hěn guānxīn yuángōng de zhíyè qiánqǐng.
en: He cares not only about the company's growth but also about his employees' career prospects.

zh: 杯子底有水。
pinyin: Bēizi dǐ yǒu shuǐ.
en: There's water at the bottom of the cup.

zh: 昨天我看到了盒子底部的东西。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ kàndàole hézi dǐbù de dōngxi.
en: Yesterday I saw what was on the bottom of the box.

zh: 虽然很黑，但我还是看清了河底。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn hēi, dàn wǒ háishi kàn qīngle hédi.
en: Even though it was dark, I could still see the river bed clearly.

zh: 他从包底拿出了一张旧照片，那是他年轻时候的。
pinyin: Tā cóng bāo dǐ náchūle yī zhāng jiù zhàopiàn, nà shi tā niánqīng shíhou de.
en: He pulled out an old photo from the bottom of his bag—it was from when he was young.

zh: 这家公司底子薄，但团队的执行力很强，短短几年就发展得很快。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī dǐzi báo, dàn tuánduì de zhíxíng lì hěn qiáng, duǎnduǎn jǐ nián jiù fāzhǎn de hěn kuài.
en: This company started from scratch with limited resources, but the team's execution was strong, so it grew rapidly in just a few years.

zh: 你干吗吃饭？
pinyin: Nǐ gānma chīfàn?
en: Why are you eating?

zh: 他早上干吗去了？我不知道。
pinyin: Tā zǎoshang gānma qù le? Wǒ búzhīdào.
en: Where did he go this morning? I have no idea.

zh: 因为下雨，他干吗也不想出门。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, tā gānma yě búxiǎng chūmén.
en: Because it's raining, he doesn't feel like going out at all.

zh: 他突然问我干吗要辞职，我一时不知道怎么回答。
pinyin: Tā túrán wèn wǒ gānma yào辞职, wǒ yìshí búzhīdào zěnme huídá.
en: He suddenly asked me why I wanted to quit, and I didn't know how to answer on the spot.

zh: 与其整天问别人干吗不成功，不如先问问自己努力够不够。
pinyin: Yǔqī zhěngtiān wèn biérén gānma búchénggōng, búrú xiānwèn wèn zìjǐ nǔlì gòu búgòu.
en: Rather than constantly asking others why they're not successful, you'd be better off asking yourself if you're working hard enough.

zh: 我有兴趣学中文。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu xìngqù xué Zhōngwén.
en: I'm interested in learning Chinese.

zh: 他最近对足球很有兴趣。
pinyin: Tā zuìjìn duì zúqiú hěn yǒu xìngqù.
en: He's been really into soccer lately.

zh: 虽然这个游戏很难，但我还是很有兴趣玩。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège yóuxì hěn nán, dànshì wǒ háishi hěn yǒu xìngqù wán.
en: Even though this game is difficult, I'm still very interested in playing it.

zh: 他发现自己对艺术和设计的兴趣越来越大。
pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zìjǐ duì yìshù hé shèjì de xìngqù yuèláiyuè dà.
en: He's realized that his interest in art and design keeps growing.

zh: 与其被动地接受工作，不如主动培养对工作的兴趣。
pinyin: Yǔqī bèidòng de jiēshòu gōngzuò, búrú zhǔdòng péiyǎng duì gōngzuò de xìngqù.
en: Rather than passively accepting your job, it's better to actively cultivate an interest in it.

zh: 我喜欢她的性情。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān tā de xìngqíng.
en: I like her personality.

zh: 他今天的心情很不好。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān de xīnqíng hěn búhǎo.
en: He's in a really bad mood today.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但是大家的情绪还是很高。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, búshì dàjiā de qíngxù háishi hěn gāo.
en: Even though the weather is bad, everyone's spirits are still really high.

zh: 他向我讲述了他失业后的真实情况。
pinyin: Tā xiàng wǒ jiǎngshù le tā shīyè hòu de zhēnshí qíngkuàng.
en: He told me about the real situation he faced after losing his job.

zh: 根据目前的市场情形，公司决定暂时冻结招聘计划。
pinyin: Gēnjù múqián de shìchǎng qíngxíng, gōngsī juéding zànshí dòngjiē zhāopìn jìhuà.
en: Based on current market conditions, the company has decided to temporarily freeze hiring plans.

zh: 老师要我的报告。
pinyin: Lǎoshī yào wǒ de bàogào.
en: The teacher wants my report.

zh: 明天我要交一个报告给老师。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào jiāo yīgè bàogào gěi lǎoshī.
en: Tomorrow I need to hand in a report to my teacher.

zh: 虽然报告很长，但是我已经写完了。
pinyin: Suīrán bàogào hěn cháng, dànshì wǒ yǐjīng xiěwán le.
en: Even though the report is long, I've already finished writing it.

zh: 经理在会议上报告了这个季度的销售成绩。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ zài huìyì shang bàogàole zhège jìdù de xiāoshòu chéngjī.
en: The manager reported the quarter's sales results at the meeting.

zh: 根据最新的市场调查报告，消费者对这个产品的满意度有所提高。
pinyin: Gēnjù zuìxīn de shìchǎng tiáochá bàogào, xiāofèizhě duì zhège chǎnpǐn de mǎnyìdù yǒusuǒ tígāo.
en: According to the latest market research report, consumer satisfaction with this product has increased somewhat.

zh: 我从没吃过鱼。
pinyin: Wǒ cóngméi chīguò yú.
en: I've never eaten fish.

zh: 她从没去过北京，很想去。
pinyin: Tā cóngméi qùguò Běijīng, hěn xiǎng qù.
en: She's never been to Beijing, but she really wants to go.

zh: 虽然他学了很久，但从没见过这样的字。
pinyin: Suīrán tā xuéle hěnjiǔ, dàn cóngméi jiànguò zhèyàng de zì.
en: Although he's studied for a long time, he's never seen a character like that before.

zh: 我从没想过自己能做这么难的项目。
pinyin: Wǒ cóngméi xiǎngguò zìjǐ néng zuò zhème nán de xiàngmù.
en: I never imagined I'd be able to handle such a challenging project.

zh: 他从没后悔过那个决定，尽管很多人说他疯了。
pinyin: Tā cóngméi hòuhuǐguò nàge juéding, jìnguǎn hěnduō rén shuō tā fēngle.
en: He's never regretted that decision, even though plenty of people said he was crazy.

zh: 我替你拿书。
pinyin: Wǒ tì nǐ náshū.
en: I'll get the book for you.

zh: 明天她替我去上课。
pinyin: Míngtiān tā tì wǒ qù shànngkè.
en: Tomorrow she'll attend class in my place.

zh: 因为我生病了，朋友替我完成了工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ shēngbìng le, péngyou tì wǒ wánchéng le gōngzuò.
en: Because I got sick, my friend finished the work for me.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但还是替同事解决了这个问题。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn háishi tì tóngshì jiějué le zhège wèntí.
en: Although he was very busy, he still solved this problem for his colleague.

zh: 他经常替别人着想，这种品质在职场上很受欢迎。
pinyin: Tā jīngcháng tì biérén zháoxiǎng, zhè zhǒng pǐnzhì zài zhíchǎng shang hěn shòu huānyíng.
en: He often thinks of others, and this kind of character is really appreciated in the workplace.

zh: 我喜欢吃面。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān chī miàn.
en: I like to eat noodles.

zh: 今天早上我吃了一碗面。
pinyin: Jīntiān zǎoshang wǒ chīle yī wǎn miàn.
en: This morning I had a bowl of noodles.

zh: 因为很饿，所以我买了面条来吃。
pinyin: Yīnwèi hěn饿，suǒyǐ wǒ mǎile miàntiáo lái chī.
en: Because I was very hungry, I bought noodles to eat.

zh: 虽然这家店的面很有名，但价钱比较贵。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiā diàn de miàn hěn yǒumíng, dàn jiàqián bǐjiào guì.
en: Although this restaurant's noodles are famous, the prices are quite expensive.

zh: 在外面工作了一整天后，回家吃碗热汤面真是舒服。
pinyin: Zài wàimiàn gōngzuòle yī zhěngtiān hòu, huíjiā chī wǎn règ tāngtáng miàn zhēnshi shūfu.
en: After working outside all day, there's nothing quite like coming home to a bowl of hot noodle soup.

zh: 我经历了很多事。
pinyin: Wǒ jīnglì le hěnduō shì.
en: I've been through a lot of things.

zh: 去年我经历了一次难忘的旅行。
pinyin: Qùnián wǒ jīnglì le yī cì nánwàng de lǚxíng.
en: Last year I had an unforgettable trip.

zh: 因为经历过失败，所以他现在更加谨慎了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīnglì guò shībài, suǒyǐ tā xiànzài gèngjiā jǐnshèn le.
en: Because he's experienced failure, he's much more careful now.

zh: 她经历的那段困难时期让她学到了很多关于生活的道理。
pinyin: Tā jīnglì de nà duàn kùnnan shíqī ràng tā xuéd dào le hěnduō guānyú shēnghuó de dàolǐ.
en: That difficult period she went through taught her a lot about life.

zh: 每个人都会经历不同的人生阶段，关键是如何从经历中吸取教训。
pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu huì jīnglì búntóng de rénshēng jiēduàn, guānjiàn shì rúhé cóng jīnglì zhōng xīqǔ jiàoxun.
en: Everyone goes through different life stages, and the key is learning from those experiences.

zh: 我有六个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liù ge píngguǒ.
en: I have six apples.

zh: 今天是六月，天气很热。
pinyin: Jīntiān shì liù yuè, tiānqì hěn règ.
en: It's June today, and the weather is very hot.

zh: 虽然他只有六岁，但是他很聪明。
pinyin: Suīrán tā zhǐyǒu liù suì, dànshì tā hěn cōngming.
en: Although he's only six years old, he's very smart.

zh: 上周六我去了朋友的生日派对，大概有六十个人。
pinyin: Shàng zhōuliù wǒ qù le péngyou de shēngrì pàiduì, dàgài yǒu liùshí ge rén.
en: Last Saturday I went to my friend's birthday party, where there were about sixty people.

zh: 这家餐厅每个月都会推出六道新菜，因为他们想保持客人的新鲜感。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cānting měi ge yuè dōu huì tuīchū liù dào xīn cài, yīnwèi tāmen xiǎng bǎochí kèrén de xīnxiǎn gǎn.
en: This restaurant introduces six new dishes every month because they want to keep things interesting for their customers.

zh: 鸟在飞。
pinyin: Niǎo zài fēi.
en: The bird is flying.

zh: 昨天我看到飞机飞过天空。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ kàndào fēijī fēiguò tiānkōng.
en: Yesterday I saw an airplane fly across the sky.

zh: 因为风很大，所以树叶飞得到处都是。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fēng hěn dà, suǒyǐ shùyè fēi de dàochù dōu shì.
en: Because the wind was strong, leaves flew everywhere.

zh: 虽然飞行需要很多时间，但坐飞机还是最快的旅行方式。
pinyin: Suīrán fēixíng xūyào hěnduō shíjiān, dàn zuò fēijī háishi zuì kuài de lǚxíng fāngshì.
en: Although flying takes a lot of time, taking a plane is still the fastest way to travel.

zh: 他的事业如日中天，前景一片光明，看起来前程似锦，不过这些成功都是靠他勤奋工作飞速发展得来的。
pinyin: Tā de shìyè rúrì zhōngtiān, qiánjǐng yīpiàn guāngmíng, kàn qǐlai qiánchéng sìjǐn, búguò zhèxiē chénggōng dōu shì kào tā qínfèn gōngzuò fēisù fāzhǎn déláide.
en: His career is thriving and his prospects are bright, but all this success came from his diligent work and rapid development.

zh: 我的老师很好。
pinyin: Wǒ de lǎoshī hěn hǎo.
en: My teacher is very nice.

zh: 今天老师教我们英语。
pinyin: Jīntiān lǎoshī jiāo wǒmen yīngyǔ.
en: Today the teacher taught us English.

zh: 因为老师生病了，所以今天没有课。
pinyin: Yīnwèi lǎoshī shēngbìng le, suǒyǐ jīntiān méiyǒu kè.
en: Because the teacher got sick, there's no class today.

zh: 我们的老师虽然很严格，但学生都很尊重他。
pinyin: Wǒmen de lǎoshī suīrán hěn yángé, dàn xuésheng dōu hěn zūnzhòng tā.
en: Although our teacher is quite strict, all the students respect him.

zh: 这位老师不仅教学水平高，而且特别能激励学生的学习热情。
pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī bújǐn jiàoxué shuǐpíng gāo, érqiě tèbié néng jīlì xuésheng de xuéxí règìng.
en: This teacher not only has excellent teaching ability, but also has a special gift for inspiring students' enthusiasm to learn.

zh: 我很生气。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn shēngqì.
en: I'm really angry.

zh: 他今天心情不好，一直在生气。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān xīnqíng búhǎo, yìzhí zài shēngqì.
en: He's been in a bad mood all day and keeps getting upset.

zh: 因为他迟到了，所以妈妈很生气，但是她还是给他做饭。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā chídào le, suǒyǐ māma hěn shēngqì, búguò tā háishi gěi tā zuòfàn.
en: Because he was late, mom got really angry, but she still cooked for him anyway.

zh: 同学们在打篮球的时候，他因为一个小错误就生气了，队友都觉得有点莫名其妙。
pinyin: Tóngxuémen zài dǎ lánqiú de shíhou, tā yīnwèi yí ge xiǎo cuòwù jiù shēngqì le, duìyou dōu juéde yǒudiǎn mómíngqīmiào.
en: While the classmates were playing basketball, he got angry over a minor mistake, and his teammates thought it was pretty strange.

zh: 与其为了小事生气，不如想想有没有更好的解决办法。
pinyin: Yǔqī wèile xiǎoshì shēngqì, búrú xiǎngxiang yǒumeiyǒu gèng hǎo de jiějué bànfǎ.
en: Rather than getting upset over trivial matters, it's better to think about whether there's a better way to solve things.

zh: 你不用吃饭。
pinyin: Nǐ búyòng chīfàn.
en: You don't need to eat.

zh: 明天不用上班，我很高兴。
pinyin: Míngtiān búyòng shàngbān, wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
en: I don't have to work tomorrow, so I'm really happy.

zh: 因为今天下雨，所以不用去公园。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ búyòng qù gōngyuán.
en: Because it's raining today, we don't need to go to the park.

zh: 这个问题虽然很复杂，但是不用担心太多。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí suīrán hěn fùzá, búguò búyòng dānxin tàiduō.
en: Although this problem is quite complicated, you don't need to worry too much about it.

zh: 有了新的软件以后，我们不用花那么多时间处理数据了。
pinyin: Yǒule xīnde ruǎnjiàn yǐhòu, wǒmen búyòng huā nàme duō shíjiān chǔlǐ shùjù le.
en: Now that we have the new software, we don't have to spend so much time processing data anymore.

zh: 小孩喜欢吃糖。
pinyin: Xiǎohái xǐhuān chī táng.
en: Children like to eat candy.

zh: 那个小孩每天都去公园玩。
pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái měitiān dōu qù gōngyuán wán.
en: That child goes to the park to play every day.

zh: 因为小孩很累，所以他睡着了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiǎohái hěn lèi, suǒyǐ tā shuìzháo le.
en: Because the child was very tired, he fell asleep.

zh: 虽然小孩很调皮，但他学习还是很认真的。
pinyin: Suīrán xiǎohái hěn tiáopi, dàn tā xuéxí háishi hěn rènzhēn de.
en: Although the child is quite mischievous, he's actually very serious about his studies.

zh: 这个小孩特别聪慧，参加了好几个兴趣班以后进步神速。
pinyin: Zhège xiǎohái tèbié cōnghuì, cānjiā le hǎo jǐ ge xìngqùbān yǐhòu jìnbù shéngsù.
en: This child is exceptionally bright, and after joining several interest classes, his progress has been remarkable.

zh: 人类需要吃饭。
pinyin: Rénlèi xūyào chīfàn.
en: Humans need to eat.

zh: 人类每天都要喝水。
pinyin: Rénlèi měi tiān dōu yào hēshuǐ.
en: People have to drink water every day.

zh: 虽然人类很聪明，但是有时候也会犯错误。
pinyin: Suīrán rénlèi hěn cōngming, dànshì yǒushíhou yě huì fàn cuòwù.
en: Although humans are intelligent, they still make mistakes sometimes.

zh: 因为人类依赖科技，所以我们需要继续创新。
pinyin: Yīnwèi rénlèi yīlài kējì, suǒyǐ wǒmen xūyào jìxù chuàngxīn.
en: Since humanity relies on technology, we need to keep innovating.

zh: 人类历史表明，面对困难时我们往往能够团结一致。
pinyin: Rénlèi lìshǐ biǎomíng, miànduì kùnnan shí wǒmen wǎngwǎng nénggoù tuánjiē yīzhì.
en: Human history shows that when facing adversity, we tend to unite.

zh: 我冲咖啡。
pinyin: Wǒ chōng kāfēi.
en: I'm making coffee.

zh: 早上我冲一杯茶就去上班。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ chōng yī bēi chá jiù qù shàngbān.
en: In the morning I brew a cup of tea and then go to work.

zh: 因为下雨了，我冲进房间的时候衣服都湿了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, wǒ chōng jìn fángjiān de shíhou yīfu dōu shī le.
en: Because it was raining, my clothes got soaked when I rushed into the room.

zh: 他冲着我挥手，虽然人很多，但我还是看到了他。
pinyin: Tā chōngzhe wǒ huīshǒu, suīrán rén hěnduō, dàn wǒ háishi kàndào le tā.
en: He waved at me, and even though there were lots of people, I still managed to spot him.

zh: 不要冲我发火，我已经尽力了，这不是我的错。
pinyin: Búyào chōng wǒ fāhuǒ, wǒ yǐjīng jìnlì le, zhè búshì wǒ de cuò.
en: Don't take your anger out on me—I've done everything I can; this isn't my fault.

zh: 我喜欢自由。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zìyóu.
en: I like freedom.

zh: 周末我可以自由地玩。
pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ kěyǐ zìyóu de wán.
en: On weekends I can play freely.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但是我周日有自由时间。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì wǒ zhōurì yǒu zìyóu shíjiān.
en: Even though work is busy, I have free time on Sundays.

zh: 因为父母很开放，所以我有很多自由选择的机会。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fùmǔ hěn kāifàng, suǒyǐ wǒ yǒu hěnduō zìyóu xuǎnzé de jīhuì.
en: Because my parents are open-minded, I have lots of opportunities to make free choices.

zh: 现代人越来越追求自由，希望不受传统观念的束缚。
pinyin: Xiàndài rén yuèláiyuè zhuīqiú zìyóu, xībwàng búshòu chuántǒng guānniàn de shùfù.
en: Modern people increasingly pursue freedom, hoping to break free from the constraints of traditional ideas.

zh: 我支持你。
pinyin: Wǒ zhīchí nǐ.
en: I support you.

zh: 妈妈支持我去上大学。
pinyin: Māma zhīchí wǒ qù shàng dàxué.
en: My mom supports me going to university.

zh: 虽然很难，但我的朋友都支持我的决定。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dàn wǒ de péngyou dōu zhīchí wǒ de juédìng.
en: Although it's difficult, all my friends support my decision.

zh: 公司支持员工学习新技能来提高工作效率。
pinyin: Gōngsī zhīchí yuángōng xuéxí xīn jìnéng lái tígāo gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
en: The company supports employees learning new skills to improve work efficiency.

zh: 尽管他的想法有些激进，但我们还是决定支持他参加竞选。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā de xiǎngfǎ yǒuxiē jījìn, dàn wǒmen háishi juédìng zhīchí tā cānjiā jìngxuǎn.
en: Even though his ideas are somewhat radical, we decided to support him running for office.

zh: 星期一我上学。
pinyin: Xīngqī yī wǒ shàngxué.
en: I go to school on Monday.

zh: 每个星期天我和家人吃饭。
pinyin: Měi ge xīngqī tiān wǒ hé jiārén chīfàn.
en: Every Sunday I eat with my family.

zh: 因为星期五要工作，所以我很累。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xīngqī wǔ yào gōngzuò, suǒyǐ wǒ hěn lèi.
en: Because I have to work on Friday, I'm really tired.

zh: 虽然这个星期很忙，但我还是抽出时间运动。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège xīngqī hěn máng, dàn wǒ háishi chōuchū shíjiān yùndòng.
en: Even though this week is hectic, I still manage to find time to exercise.

zh: 上星期的会议拖得很长，导致这星期的日程安排得很紧张。
pinyin: Shàng xīngqī de huìyì tuō de hěn cháng, dǎozhì zhè xīngqī de rìchéng ānpái de hěn jǐnzhāng.
en: Last week's meeting ran long, which made this week's schedule incredibly tight.

zh: 我的脚很痛。
pinyin: Wǒ de jiǎo hěn ténɡ.
en: My foot really hurts.

zh: 昨天我脚受伤了，现在还很疼。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ jiǎo shòushānɡ le, xiànzài háishi hěn ténɡ.
en: I injured my foot yesterday, and it's still really sore now.

zh: 因为脚疼，所以我不能去踢足球，虽然我很想去。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jiǎo ténɡ, suǒyǐ wǒ búnénɡ qù tī zúqiú, suīrán wǒ hěn xiǎnɡ qù.
en: Because my foot hurts, I can't play soccer, even though I really want to.

zh: 运动员的脚容易受伤，需要经常做拉伸运动来保护。
pinyin: Yùndònɡyuán de jiǎo rónɡyì shòushānɡ, xūyào jīnɡchánaɡ zuò lāshēn yùndònɡ lái bǎohù.
en: Athletes' feet are prone to injury, so they need to do regular stretching exercises to protect them.

zh: 长时间站着工作会导致脚部疲劳，医生建议穿着舒适的鞋子并定期休息。
pinyin: Chánaɡ shíjiān zhànzhe ɡōnɡzuò huì dǎozhì jiǎobù píláo, yīshēnɡ jiànyì chuānzhe shūshi de xiézi bìnɡ dìnɡqī xiūxi.
en: Standing for long periods at work can lead to foot fatigue, so doctors recommend wearing comfortable shoes and taking regular breaks.

zh: 他很快吃完了。
pinyin: Tā hěnkuài chīwán le.
en: He finished eating very quickly.

zh: 明天很快就会来了。
pinyin: Míngtiān hěnkuài jiù huì lái le.
en: Tomorrow will come really soon.

zh: 虽然题目很难，但是他很快就做完了。
pinyin: Suīrán tímù hěn nán, dànshì tā hěnkuài jiù zuòwán le.
en: Although the questions were difficult, he finished them very quickly.

zh: 因为网络很快，所以我很快下载了这个文件。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǎngluò hěnkuài, suǒyǐ wǒ hěnkuài xiàzài le zhège wénjiàn.
en: Because the internet is fast, I was able to download the file quickly.

zh: 他适应新工作的速度很快，不到一个月就独立完成了项目。
pinyin: Tā shìyìng xīn gōngzuò de sùdù hěnkuài, búdào yī ge yuè jiù dúlì wánchéng le xiàngmù.
en: He adapted to his new job really fast—within less than a month he completed the project independently.

zh: 雨毁坏了房子。
pinyin: Yǔ huǐhuàile fángzi.
en: The rain damaged the house.

zh: 小孩子玩的时候毁坏了玩具。
pinyin: Xiǎo háizi wán de shíhou huǐhuàile wánjù.
en: The little child broke the toy while playing.

zh: 虽然他不是故意的，但是他还是毁坏了我的车。
pinyin: Suīrán tā búshì gùyì de, búguò tā háishi huǐhuàile wǒ de chē.
en: Although he didn't do it on purpose, he still wrecked my car.

zh: 长期不维护会毁坏机器，所以定期保养很重要。
pinyin: Chángqī búwéihu护huì huǐhuài jīqi, suǒyǐ dìngqī bǎoyǎng hěn zhòngyào.
en: Lack of maintenance will destroy the machine, which is why regular servicing is important.

zh: 他一句话就毁坏了我们多年建立的信任关系。
pinyin: Tā yī jù huà jiù huǐhuàile wǒmen duōnián jiànlì de xìnrèn guānxi.
en: One careless comment completely destroyed the trust we'd built up over many years.

zh: 妈妈生气了。
pinyin: Māma shēngqì le.
en: Mom is angry.

zh: 他今天迟到了，老师生气了。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān chídào le, lǎoshī shēngqì le.
en: He was late today, and the teacher got angry.

zh: 因为你没有做功课，爸爸生气了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nǐ méiyǒu zuò gōngkè, bàba shēngqì le.
en: Because you didn't do your homework, Dad got upset.

zh: 虽然他只是开玩笑，但是她还是生气了。
pinyin: Suīrán tā zhǐshì kāi wány笑, dànshì tā háishi shēngqì le.
en: Even though he was just joking, she still got mad.

zh: 他总是这样，难怪她会生气，我如果是她也受不了。
pinyin: Tā zǒngshì zhèyàng, nánguài tā huì shēngqì, wǒ rúguǒ shì tā yě shòu bu liǎo.
en: He's always like that—no wonder she's upset; honestly, I wouldn't put up with it either.

zh: 我建议你吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ jiànyì nǐ chī mǐfàn.
en: I suggest you eat rice.

zh: 医生建议我每天喝水。
pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì wǒ měitiān hēshuǐ.
en: The doctor recommends that I drink water every day.

zh: 因为天气很冷，我建议你穿厚衣服。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn lěng, wǒ jiànyì nǐ chuān hòu yīfu.
en: Because the weather is cold, I suggest you wear thick clothes.

zh: 我的建议是先完成作业，然后再玩游戏。
pinyin: Wǒ de jiànyì shì xiān wánchéng zuòyè, ránhòu zài wán yóuxì.
en: My suggestion is to finish your homework first, then play games.

zh: 专家建议消费者在购买电子产品前仔细比较价格和质量。
pinyin: Zhuānjiā jiànyì xiāofèizhě zài gòumǎi diànzǐ chǎnpǐn qián zǐxì bǐjiào jiàgé hé zhìliàng.
en: Experts recommend that consumers carefully compare prices and quality before buying electronic products.

zh: 我做到了。
pinyin: Wǒ zuòdào le.
en: I did it.

zh: 每天早上我都做到按时起床。
pinyin: Měi tiān zǎo shang wǒ dōu zuòdào ànshí qǐchuáng.
en: Every morning I manage to wake up on time.

zh: 虽然很难，但是我还是做到了减肥的目标。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dànshì wǒ háishi zuòdào le jiǎnféi de mùbiāo.
en: Although it was hard, I still managed to reach my weight loss goal.

zh: 要想做到工作和生活的平衡，需要合理安排时间。
pinyin: Yào xiǎng zuòdào gōngzuò hé shēnghuó de pínghuàn, xūyào héulǐ ānpái shíjiān.
en: To achieve a balance between work and life, you need to manage your time well.

zh: 他通过坚持不懈的努力，最终做到了从普通员工升到经理的目标。
pinyin: Tā tōngguò jiānchí búxié de nǔlì, zuìzhōng zuòdào le cóng pǔtōng yuángōng shēng dào jīnglǐ de mùbiāo.
en: Through persistent effort, he ultimately achieved his goal of advancing from an ordinary employee to manager.

zh: 我有一套新衣服。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī tào xīn yīfu.
en: I have a new outfit.

zh: 他买了一套书在图书馆。
pinyin: Tā mǎile yī tào shū zài túshūguǎn.
en: He bought a set of books at the library.

zh: 因为房子很贵，所以他租了一套公寓。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fángzi hěn guì, suǒyǐ tā zūle yī tào gōngyù.
en: Because houses are expensive, he rented an apartment.

zh: 虽然这套方案看起来简单，但实施起来很复杂。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè tào fāng'àn kàn qǐlai jiǎndān, dàn shíshī qǐlai hěn fùzá.
en: Although this plan looks simple on the surface, it's quite complex to implement.

zh: 他那一套理论虽然有趣，但经不起实际考验。
pinyin: Tā nà yī tào lǐlùn suīrán yǒuqù, dàn jīng bu qǐ shíjì kǎoyàn.
en: His whole set of theories is interesting, but they don't hold up under practical scrutiny.

zh: 孩子哭了。
pinyin: háizi kū le.
en: The child cried.

zh: 她看电影的时候哭了。
pinyin: Tā kàn diànyǐng de shíhou kū le.
en: She cried while watching the movie.

zh: 因为很难过，所以他在房间里哭了很久。
pinyin: Yīnwèi hěn nánguò, suǒyǐ tā zài fángjiān lǐ kū le hěnjiǔ.
en: Because he was so sad, he cried in his room for a long time.

zh: 虽然她努力忍住，但最后还是哭了出来。
pinyin: Suīrán tā nǔlì rěnzhù, dàn zuìhòu háishi kū le chūlái.
en: Although she tried hard to hold back, she eventually broke down and cried.

zh: 听到那个消息后，他再也忍不住，当众哭了起来。
pinyin: Tīngdào nàge xiāoxī hòu, tā zàiyě rěnbuzhù, dāngzhòng kū le qǐlái.
en: After hearing the news, he couldn't hold back anymore and started crying right there in front of everyone.

zh: 宝宝摔倒了，屁股疼。
pinyin: Báobao shuāidào le, pígu téng.
en: The baby fell down and his bottom hurts.

zh: 他坐了很久，屁股有点酸。
pinyin: Tā zuòle hěn jiǔ, pígu yǒudiǎn suān.
en: He sat for a long time and his butt got a bit sore.

zh: 因为长时间开车，司机的屁股很不舒服。
pinyin: Yīnwèi cháng shíjiān kāichē, sījī de pígu hěn búshūfu.
en: Because of driving for so long, the driver's bottom felt really uncomfortable.

zh: 虽然椅子很软，但坐了三小时以后屁股还是疼。
pinyin: Suīrán yǐzi hěn ruǎn, dàn zuòle sān xiǎoshí yǐhòu pígu háishi téng.
en: Even though the chair was soft, sitting for three hours still made his butt sore.

zh: 长途飞行中，很多乘客都抱怨屁股坐得疼，想站起来活动一下。
pinyin: Chángtu fēixíng zhōng, hěnduō chéngkè dōu bàoyuàn pígu zuò de téng, xiǎng zhàn qǐlai huódòng yīxià.
en: During a long flight, many passengers complained about their aching backsides and wanted to get up and stretch.

zh: 今天是我的生日。
pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ de shēngrì.
en: Today is my birthday.

zh: 妈妈在我生日的时候买了一个蛋糕。
pinyin: Māma zài wǒ shēngrì de shíhou mǎile yī ge dàngāo.
en: Mom bought a cake for my birthday.

zh: 虽然我的生日在冬天，但是我喜欢在外面庆祝。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ de shēngrì zài dōngtiān, dànshì wǒ xǐhuān zài wàimiàn qìngzhù.
en: Even though my birthday is in winter, I like to celebrate outside.

zh: 我收到了很多礼物，因为今年是我的特殊生日。
pinyin: Wǒ shōudàole hěnduō lǐwù, yīnwèi jīnnián shì wǒ de tèshū shēngrì.
en: I received lots of gifts because this year was a special birthday for me.

zh: 她每次提起自己的生日都显得兴高采烈，仿佛回到了童年。
pinyin: Tā měi cì tíqǐ zìjǐ de shēngrì dōu xiǎnde xīng gāo cǎi liè, fǎngfú huídàole tóngniánshí.
en: Whenever she mentions her birthday, she seems delighted, as if she's been transported back to childhood.

zh: 妈妈，晚安。
pinyin: Māma, wǎn'ān.
en: Mom, good night.

zh: 睡觉前我总是说晚安。
pinyin: Shuìjiào qián wǒ zǒngshì shuō wǎn'ān.
en: I always say good night before going to bed.

zh: 因为很累了，我早早地跟朋友说了晚安。
pinyin: Yīnwèi hěn leìle, wǒ zǎozǎo de gēn péngyou shuōle wǎn'ān.
en: Because I was really tired, I said good night to my friend early.

zh: 虽然有很多工作没做完，但我还是按时对家人说了晚安。
pinyin: Suīrán yǒu hěnduō gōngzuò méi zuòwán, dàn wǒ háishi ānshí duì jiārén shuōle wǎn'ān.
en: Even though I had a lot of unfinished work, I still said good night to my family on time.

zh: 每天无论再忙，我都会和孩子们说晚安，这已经成了我们的习惯。
pinyin: Měitiān wúlùn zài máng, wǒ dōu huì hé háizimen shuō wǎn'ān, zhè yǐjīng chéngle wǒmen de xíguàn.
en: No matter how busy I am each day, I always say good night to the kids—it's become our habit.

zh: 你要吃饭，否则会饿。
pinyin: Nǐ yào chīfàn, fǒuzé huì è.
en: You need to eat, or you'll get hungry.

zh: 明天你要早点睡觉，否则上课会很累。
pinyin: Míngtiān nǐ yào zǎodiǎn shuìjiào, fǒuzé shàngkè huì hěn lèi.
en: You should go to bed early tomorrow, otherwise you'll be exhausted in class.

zh: 虽然今天很冷，但你要穿外套，否则会生病。
pinyin: Suīrán jīntiān hěn lěng, dàn nǐ yào chuān wàitào, fǒuzé huì shēngbìng.
en: Even though it's cold today, you should wear a coat, or you might get sick.

zh: 你必须在今天下午五点之前完成作业，否则老师会很不开心。
pinyin: Nǐ bìxū zài jīntiān xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn zhīqián wánchéng zuòyè, fǒuzé lǎoshī huì hěn búkāixīn.
en: You have to finish your homework by five o'clock this afternoon, otherwise your teacher will be very unhappy.

zh: 如果你想在这个公司里升职，就必须提高工作效率，否则很难和同事竞争。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng zài zhège gōngsī lǐ shēngzhí, jiù bìxū tígāo gōngzuò xiàolǜ, fǒuzé hěn nán hé tóngshì jìngjìng.
en: If you want to advance in this company, you have to improve your work efficiency, otherwise it'll be hard to compete with your colleagues.

zh: 我喜欢画画。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān huà huà.
en: I like to draw.

zh: 昨天我画了一个漂亮的房子。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ huà le yī ge piàoliang de fángzi.
en: Yesterday I drew a beautiful house.

zh: 虽然我不会画画，但是我想学。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ búhuì huà huà, dànshi wǒ xiǎng xué.
en: Even though I can't draw, I want to learn.

zh: 他用铅笔画了一幅山水画，技术真的很高明。
pinyin: Tā yòng qiānbǐ huà le yī fú shānnshuǐ huà, jìshù zhēnde hěn gāomíng.
en: He drew a landscape painting with a pencil, and his technique is really impressive.

zh: 这位艺术家用独特的风格画出了人物的内心世界，每一幅作品都令人深思。
pinyin: Zhè wèi yìshùjiā yòng dúchuò de fēnggé huà chū le rénwù de nèixīn shìjiè, měi yī fú zuòpǐn dōu lìng rén shēnsī.
en: This artist painted the inner world of people through a unique style, and each work makes you think deeply.

zh: 我病了。
pinyin: Wǒ bìng le.
en: I'm sick.

zh: 昨天他病了，今天还在家里。
pinyin: Zuótiān tā bìng le, jīntiān háishi zài jiālǐ.
en: He got sick yesterday and is still at home today.

zh: 因为天气冷，所以很多人病了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì lěng, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén bìng le.
en: Because the weather is cold, a lot of people have gotten sick.

zh: 他虽然病了一个星期，但是恢复得很快。
pinyin: Tā suīrán bìng le yī ge xīngqī, dànshì huīfù de hěn kuài.
en: Although he was sick for a week, he recovered very quickly.

zh: 长期熬夜工作的人容易得病，这是个普遍现象。
pinyin: Chángqī áoyè gōngzuò de rén róngyì débing, zhè shì ge pǔbiàn xiànxiàng.
en: People who work late nights for extended periods tend to get sick—it's a common phenomenon.

zh: 这条线是红色的。
pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiàn shì hóng sè de.
en: This line is red.

zh: 我用一条线绑住了这个盒子。
pinyin: Wǒ yòng yī tiáo xiàn bǎngzhù le zhège hézi.
en: I tied this box up with a string.

zh: 因为天气不好，所以火车线路受到了影响。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, suǒyǐ huǒchē xiànlù shòudào le yǐngxiǎng.
en: Because the weather was bad, the train line was affected.

zh: 虽然这条线看起来很细，但是它的质量相当不错。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè tiáo xiàn kàn qǐlái hěn xì, dànshì tā de zhìliàng xiāngdāng búcuò.
en: Although this thread looks thin, its quality is actually quite good.

zh: 在制造这种产品时，对线的选择必须十分谨慎，否则容易出现质量问题。
pinyin: Zài zhìzào zhè zhǒng chǎnpǐn shí, duì xiàn de xuǎnzé bìxū shífēn jǐnshèn, fǒuzé róngyì chūxiàn zhìliàng wèntí.
en: When manufacturing this type of product, the choice of material for the thread must be extremely careful, otherwise quality issues easily arise.

zh: 太阳的光很亮。
pinyin: Tàiyáng de guāng hěn liàng.
en: The sun's light is very bright.

zh: 早上的光线让房间很舒服。
pinyin: Zǎoshang de guāngxiàn ràng fángjiān hěn shūfu.
en: The morning light makes the room feel really comfortable.

zh: 因为没有光，所以我看不清楚这个字。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu guāng, suǒyǐ wǒ kànbuqīngchu zhège zì.
en: Because there's no light, I can't see this character clearly.

zh: 手机的屏幕虽然很亮，但长时间看会伤害眼睛的光感。
pinyin: Shǒujī de píngmù suīrán hěn liàng, dàn cháng shíjiān kàn huì shānghài yǎnjing de guānggǎn.
en: Although a phone screen is very bright, looking at it for long periods can damage your eyes' light sensitivity.

zh: 在这个信息爆炸的时代，我们需要在众多观点中找到属于自己的光。
pinyin: Zài zhège xìnxī bàozhà de shídài, wǒmen xūyào zài zhòngduō guāndiǎn zhōng zhǎodào shǔyú zìjǐ de guāng.
en: In this age of information overload, we need to find our own light among many different viewpoints.

zh: 妈妈安排我吃饭。
pinyin: Māma ānpái wǒ chīfàn.
en: Mom arranged for me to eat.

zh: 老师明天安排考试时间。
pinyin: Lǎoshī míngtiān ānpái kǎoshì shíjiān.
en: The teacher is arranging the test time for tomorrow.

zh: 因为下雨，我们安排了另一个地方见面。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒmen ānpáile lìng yī ge dìfang jiànmiàn.
en: Because it was raining, we arranged to meet somewhere else instead.

zh: 公司给新员工安排了一周的培训课程。
pinyin: Gōngsī gěi xīn yuángōng ānpáile yī zhōu de péixùn kèchéng.
en: The company arranged a week of training courses for the new employees.

zh: 虽然日程很紧张，但项目经理还是妥善安排了每个人的工作。
pinyin: Suīrán rìchéng hěn jǐnzhāng, dàn xiàngmù jīnglǐ háishi tuǒshàn ānpáile měi ge rén de gōngzuò.
en: Although the schedule was tight, the project manager still managed to arrange everyone's work appropriately.

zh: 他的神情很开心。
pinyin: Tā de shénqíng hěn kāixīn.
en: His expression is very happy.

zh: 昨天我很累,今天神气多了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hěn lèi, jīntiān shénqi duō le.
en: I was exhausted yesterday, but I feel much better today.

zh: 虽然工作很忙,但是他的神态还是很放松。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì tā de shéntài háishi hěn fàngsōng.
en: Although work is busy, his demeanor is still quite relaxed.

zh: 她说话的时候神情特别认真,让我们都相信了她。
pinyin: Tā shuōhuà de shíhou shénqíng tèbié rènzhēn, ràng wǒmen dōu xiāngxìnle tā.
en: When she spoke, her expression was so serious that we all believed her.

zh: 医生从患者的神态和症状判断出这不是普通的感冒。
pinyin: Yīshēng cóng huànzhě de shéntài hé zhèngzhuàng pànduàn chū zhè búshì pǔtōng de gǎnmào.
en: The doctor judged from the patient's appearance and symptoms that this wasn't an ordinary cold.

zh: 我妈妈很年轻。
pinyin: Wǒ māma hěn niánqīng.
en: My mom is very young.

zh: 他年轻的时候喜欢运动。
pinyin: Tā niánqīng de shíhou xǐhuān yùndòng.
en: When he was young, he liked sports.

zh: 虽然她年轻，但是她很聪明。
pinyin: Suīrán tā niánqīng, dànshi tā hěn聪明.
en: Although she's young, she's very smart.

zh: 年轻人应该多学习新的技能。
pinyin: Niánqīng rén yīnggāi duō xuéxí xīn de jìnéng.
en: Young people should learn more new skills.

zh: 他年轻有为，已经在公司担任重要职位。
pinyin: Tā niánqīng yǒuwéi, yǐjīng zài gōngsī dānrèn zhòngyào zhíwèi.
en: He's a promising young man and already holds an important position at the company.

zh: 我操作电脑。
pinyin: Wǒ cāozuò diànnǎo.
en: I operate the computer.

zh: 每天我都操作这个机器。
pinyin: Měitiān wǒ dōu cāozuò zhège jīqì.
en: Every day I operate this machine.

zh: 因为他不会操作,所以我帮他做。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā búhuì cāozuò, suǒyǐ wǒ bāng tā zuò.
en: Because he doesn't know how to operate it, I'm helping him do it.

zh: 虽然这个软件很复杂,但是操作起来不难。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège ruǎnjiàn hěn fùzá, dànshì cāozuò qǐlai búnán.
en: Although this software is complicated, it's actually not hard to operate.

zh: 熟能生巧,只要多操作几次就能掌握要领。
pinyin: Shúnéng shēngqiǎo, zhǐyào duō cāozuò jǐ cì jiù néng zhǎngwò yàolǐng.
en: Practice makes perfect—just operate it a few more times and you'll get the hang of it.

zh: 下面是一只猫。
pinyin: Xiàmiàn shì yī zhī māo.
en: There's a cat down below.

zh: 桌子下面放着我的书。
pinyin: Zhuōzi xiàmiàn fàngzhe wǒ de shū.
en: My books are stored under the table.

zh: 因为下面下雨了，所以我们在楼上玩。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàmiàn xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ wǒmen zài lóushang wán.
en: Since it's raining outside, we're playing upstairs instead.

zh: 下面这个例子虽然简单，但是很有用处。
pinyin: Xiàmiàn zhège lìzi suīrán jiǎndān, dànshì hěn yǒu yòngchù.
en: Although the example below is simple, it's actually quite useful.

zh: 下面提到的几个方法都是实践证明过的，你可以放心使用。
pinyin: Xiàmiàn tíqǐ de jǐ ge fāngfǎ dōu shì shíjiàn zhèngmíng guòle, nǐ kěyǐ fàngxin shǐyòng.
en: The methods mentioned below have all been proven in practice, so you can use them with confidence.

zh: 这个姑娘很漂亮。
pinyin: Zhège gūniang hěn piàoliang.
en: This girl is very pretty.

zh: 那个姑娘今天穿了一件红色裙子。
pinyin: Nàge gūniang jīntiān chuānle yī jiàn hóngsè qúnzi.
en: That girl wore a red dress today.

zh: 因为姑娘很聪明，所以她考试得了高分。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gūniang hěn cōngming, suǒyǐ tā kǎoshì déle gāofēn.
en: Because the girl is smart, she got a high score on the exam.

zh: 那位姑娘虽然年纪小，但做事特别认真负责。
pinyin: Nà wèi gūniang suīrán niánjì xiǎo, dàn zuòshì tèbié rènzhēn fùzé.
en: Although that girl is young, she's remarkably serious and responsible about her work.

zh: 这个姑娘从小就热爱音乐，如今已经成了一名专业的钢琴师。
pinyin: Zhège gūniang cóngxiǎo jiù rèài yīnyuè, rújīn yǐjīng chéngle yī míng zhuānyè de gāngqín shī.
en: This girl loved music from childhood, and she's now become a professional pianist.

zh: 这是一条道。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī tiáo dào.
en: This is a road.

zh: 他每天走同一条道去上班。
pinyin: Tā měitiān zǒu tóngyī tiáo dào qù shàngbān.
en: He takes the same road to work every day.

zh: 虽然这条道很远，但是风景很漂亮。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè tiáo dào hěn yuǎn, dànshì fēngjǐng hěn piàoliang.
en: Although this road is long, the scenery is really beautiful.

zh: 他向朋友道歉了，因为他之前说的话伤害了对方。
pinyin: Tā xiàng péngyou dàoqiànle, yīnwèi tā zhīqián shuō de huà shānghài le duìfang.
en: He apologized to his friend because what he said earlier hurt them.

zh: 关于这个问题，我想和你好好谈一道，听听你的看法。
pinyin: Guānyú zhège wèntí, wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ hǎohāo tán yī dào, tīngtīng nǐ de kànfǎ.
en: About this issue, I'd like to have a proper discussion with you and hear your thoughts.

zh: 按门铃。
pinyin: Àn ménlínghuà.
en: Press the doorbell.

zh: 请按这个按钮开始。
pinyin: Qǐng àn zhège ànniǔ kāishǐ.
en: Please press this button to start.

zh: 虽然说明书很长，但我按照步骤做了。
pinyin: Suīrán shuōmíngshū hěn cháng, dàn wǒ ànzhào bùzhòu zuòle.
en: Even though the instructions were long, I followed the steps.

zh: 医生按照你的病情制定了治疗计划。
pinyin: Yīshēng ànzhào nǐ de bìngqíng zhìdìngle zhìliáo jìhuà.
en: The doctor designed a treatment plan based on your condition.

zh: 这个公司按时完成了合同，赢得了客户的信任。
pinyin: Zhège gōngsī ànshí wánchéngle hétonɡ, yíngdéle kèhù de xìnrèn.
en: The company completed the contract on schedule and earned the client's trust.

zh: 这是我的钥匙。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de yàoshi.
en: This is my key.

zh: 我找不到家里的钥匙了。
pinyin: Wǒ zhǎo bu dào jiā lǐ de yàoshi le.
en: I can't find my house key anymore.

zh: 因为丢了钥匙，所以我不能进屋。
pinyin: Yīnwèi diū le yàoshi, suǒyǐ wǒ bu néng jìn wū.
en: Because I lost my key, I can't get into the house.

zh: 虽然钥匙很小，但它对打开门非常重要。
pinyin: Suīrán yàoshi hěn xiǎo, dàn tā duì dǎkāi mén fēicháng zhòngyào.
en: Although the key is tiny, it's really important for opening the door.

zh: 他意识到自己忘记带钥匙了，只好打电话给朋友来帮忙。
pinyin: Tā yìshi dào zìjǐ wàngjì dài yàoshi le, zhǐhǎo dǎ diànhuà gěi péngyou lái bāngmang.
en: He realized he'd forgotten to bring his key, so he had to call a friend to help him out.

zh: 法官在法院。
pinyin: Fǎguān zài fǎyuàn.
en: The judge is at the court.

zh: 那个法官很聪明，每天工作。
pinyin: Nàge fǎguān hěn cōngming, měitiān gōngzuò.
en: That judge is very smart and works every day.

zh: 因为他是法官，所以他要做很多决定。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā shì fǎguān, suǒyǐ tā yào zuò hěnduō juéding.
en: Because he's a judge, he has to make a lot of decisions.

zh: 法官虽然工作很难，但是他觉得这个工作很重要。
pinyin: Fǎguān suīrán gōngzuò hěn nán, dànshì tā juéde zhège gōngzuò hěn zhòngyào.
en: Although the judge's work is difficult, she thinks it's very important.

zh: 这位法官因为判决公正而获得了很多人的尊重和信任。
pinyin: Zhè wèi fǎguān yīnwèi pànjué gōngzhèng ér huòdéle hěnduō rén de zūnzhòng hé xìnrèn.
en: This judge has earned the respect and trust of many people because of fair rulings.

zh: 这是我的包。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de bāo.
en: This is my bag.

zh: 我早上买了一个新包。
pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang mǎi le yī ge xīn bāo.
en: I bought a new bag this morning.

zh: 因为下雨，我用包保护了书。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒ yòng bāo bǎohù le shū.
en: Because it was raining, I used my bag to protect my books.

zh: 虽然这个包有点贵，但是质量很好。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège bāo yǒudiǎn guì, dànshì zhìliàng hěn hǎo.
en: Although this bag is a bit expensive, the quality is really good.

zh: 他包里装满了工作文件和个人用品。
pinyin: Tā bāo lǐ zhuāng mǎn le gōngzuò wénjiàn hé gèrén yònɡpǐn.
en: His bag was packed full of work documents and personal items.

zh: 我的腿很长。
pinyin: Wǒ de tuǐ hěn cháng.
en: My legs are very long.

zh: 昨天跑步以后，我的腿很疼。
pinyin: Zuótiān pǎobù yǐhòu, wǒ de tuǐ hěn téng.
en: After running yesterday, my legs hurt a lot.

zh: 因为坐了很久，所以站起来的时候腿有点麻。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zuòle hěnjiǔ, suǒyǐ zhàn qǐlái de shíhou tuǐ yǒudiǎn má.
en: Because I'd been sitting so long, my legs felt a bit numb when I stood up.

zh: 那个运动员虽然腿受伤了，但是还坚持完成了比赛。
pinyin: Nàge yùndòngyuán suīrán tuǐ shòushāngle, dànshi háishi jiānchíle wánchéng le bǐsài.
en: Although the athlete's leg was injured, he still insisted on finishing the competition.

zh: 长时间不运动的人，腿部肌肉容易退化，所以需要定期锻炼。
pinyin: Cháng shíjiān búyùndòng de rén, tuǐbù jīròu róngyì tuìhuà, suǒyǐ xūyào dìngqī duànliàn.
en: People who don't exercise for long periods tend to lose leg muscle, so they need regular training.

zh: 我自己吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ zìjǐ chīfàn.
en: I eat by myself.

zh: 他从自己的房间出来了。
pinyin: Tā cóng zìjǐ de fángjiān chūlái le.
en: He came out of his own room.

zh: 因为这是自己的事情，所以我要自己解决。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè shì zìjǐ de shìqing, suǒyǐ wǒ yào zìjǐ jiějué.
en: Because it's my own matter, I need to solve it myself.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但是他还是自己做了这个项目。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì tā háishi zìjǐ zuòle zhège xiàngmù.
en: Although he's very busy, he still completed the project on his own.

zh: 他从不依赖别人，凡事都坚持自己动手解决问题。
pinyin: Tā cóngbù yīlài biérén, fánshì dōu jiānchí zìjǐ dòngshǒu jiějué wèntí.
en: He never relies on others and insists on handling all problems himself.

zh: 这个选手很好。
pinyin: Zhège xuǎnshǒu hěn hǎo.
en: This athlete is really good.

zh: 今天的选手跑得很快。
pinyin: Jīntiān de xuǎnshǒu pǎo de hěn kuài.
en: Today's runner is running very fast.

zh: 虽然那个选手很累，但是他还在比赛。
pinyin: Suīrán nàge xuǎnshǒu hěn lèi, dànshì tā háizài bǐsài.
en: Even though that athlete was tired, he was still competing.

zh: 因为选手训练得认真，所以他在比赛中表现得很出色。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xuǎnshǒu xùnliàn de rènzhēn, suǒyǐ tā zài bǐsài zhōng biǎoxiàn de hěn chūcsè.
en: Because the competitor trained seriously, he performed excellently in the competition.

zh: 那位选手经过多年的刻苦训练，终于在国际赛事中获得了认可。
pinyin: Nàwèi xuǎnshǒu jīngguò duōnián de kèkǔ xùnliàn, zhōngyú zài guójiì sàishì zhōng huòdé le rènkě.
en: After years of rigorous training, that athlete finally earned recognition at international competitions.

zh: 我收到了信息。
pinyin: Wǒ shōudào le xìnxī.
en: I received a message.

zh: 他每天都给我发信息。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu gěi wǒ fā xìnxī.
en: He sends me messages every day.

zh: 因为网络不好，所以我没有收到信息。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǎngluò búhǎo, suǒyǐ wǒ méiyǒu shōudào xìnxī.
en: Because the internet was bad, I didn't receive the message.

zh: 公司需要更新客户的个人信息来改进服务。
pinyin: Gōngsī xūyào gēngxīn kèhù de gèrén xìnxī lái gǎijìn fúwù.
en: The company needs to update customers' personal information to improve its service.

zh: 虽然信息泛滥，但找到真正有用的信息反而变得越来越难。
pinyin: Suīrán xìnxī fányàn, dàn zhǎodào zhēnzhèng yǒuyòng de xìnxī fǎn'ér biàn de yuèláiyuè nán.
en: Although information is abundant, finding genuinely useful information has actually become increasingly difficult.

zh: 我整理房间。
pinyin: Wǒ zhěnglǐ fángjiān.
en: I'm tidying up my room.

zh: 妈妈整天在家做饭。
pinyin: Māma zhěngtiān zài jiā zuòfàn.
en: Mom spends all day cooking at home.

zh: 虽然房间很脏，但他花了一整天整理。
pinyin: Suīrán fángjiān hěn zāng, dàn tā huāle yī zhěngtiān zhěnglǐ.
en: Although the room was messy, he spent the whole day organizing it.

zh: 因为明天有客人来，所以我们需要整顿整个房子。
pinyin: Yīnwèi míngtiān yǒu kèren lái, suǒyǐ wǒmen xūyào zhěngdùn zhěngge fángzi.
en: Since guests are coming tomorrow, we need to put the whole house in order.

zh: 他把一整套的理论系统整合到了新的研究框架中。
pinyin: Tā bǎ yī zhěngtào de lǐlùn xìtǒng zhěnghé dàole xīn de yánjiū kuàngjià zhōng.
en: He integrated an entire theoretical system into the new research framework.

zh: 我们投票选班长。
pinyin: Wǒmen tóupiào xuǎn bānzhǎng.
en: We vote to choose the class monitor.

zh: 明天下午我们要投票决定去哪里。
pinyin: Míngtiān xiàwǔ wǒmen yào tóupiào juéding qù nǎlǐ.
en: Tomorrow afternoon we're going to vote on where to go.

zh: 虽然有很多人参加,但是投票的结果很快就出来了。
pinyin: Suīrán yǒu hěnduō rén cānjiā, dànshì tóupiào de jiéguǒ hěn kuài jiù chūlai le.
en: Although many people participated, the voting results came out very quickly.

zh: 公司为了选出最好的方案,决定让员工投票表达意见。
pinyin: Gōngsī wèile xuǎnchū zuì hǎo de fāng'àn, juéding ràng yuángōng tóupiào biǎodá yìjiàn.
en: The company decided to have employees vote to express their opinions in order to choose the best plan.

zh: 这次选举吸引了大量选民参与投票,投票率创下了历史新高。
pinyin: Zhè cì xuǎnjǔ xīyǐnle dàliàng xuǎnmín cānyù tóupiào, tóupiàolǜ chuàngxià le lìshǐ xīngāo.
en: This election attracted a large number of voters to participate, and the voting rate hit a historic high.

zh: 我哥哥很高。
pinyin: Wǒ gēge hěn gāo.
en: My older brother is very tall.

zh: 我哥哥每天早上吃面包。
pinyin: Wǒ gēge měi tiān zǎo shang chī miàn bāo.
en: My older brother eats bread every morning.

zh: 因为哥哥很忙，所以他常常不在家。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gēge hěn máng, suǒyǐ tā chángcháng búzài jiā.
en: Because my older brother is always busy, he's often not home.

zh: 我哥哥虽然工作很累，但是周末还会陪我们。
pinyin: Wǒ gēge suīrán gōngzuò hěn lèi, dànshi zhōumò háishi huì péi wǒmen.
en: Even though my older brother has tiring work, he still spends time with us on weekends.

zh: 我哥哥最近升职了，所有人都为他高兴。
pinyin: Wǒ gēge zuìjìn shēngzhí le, suǒyǒu rén dōu wèi tā gāoxìng.
en: My older brother got promoted recently, and everyone is happy for him.

zh: 爸爸做手术了。
pinyin: Bàba zuò shǒushù le.
en: Dad had surgery.

zh: 明天我要去医院做手术。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào qù yīyuàn zuò shǒushù.
en: Tomorrow I need to go to the hospital for surgery.

zh: 因为他的腿受伤了，所以需要做手术。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā de tuǐ shòushāng le, suǒyǐ xūyào zuò shǒushù.
en: Because his leg was injured, he needs to have surgery.

zh: 医生说这个手术虽然有风险，但是成功率很高。
pinyin: Yīshēng shuō zhège shǒushù suīrán yǒu fēngxiǎn, dànshi chénggōnglǜ hěn gāo.
en: The doctor said although this surgery carries some risk, the success rate is very high.

zh: 患者在做完手术以后需要住院观察几天才能出院。
pinyin: Huànzhě zài zuòwán shǒushù yǐhòu xūyào zhùyuàn guānchá jǐ tiān cái néng chūyuàn.
en: After the patient completes surgery, they need to stay hospitalized for observation for a few days before being discharged.

zh: 学习很必要。
pinyin: Xuéxí hěn bìyào.
en: Studying is really necessary.

zh: 每天喝水很必要，对身体好。
pinyin: Měitiān hēshuǐ hěn bìyào, duì shēntǐ hǎo.
en: Drinking water every day is essential—it's good for your health.

zh: 因为天气冷了，所以穿厚衣服是必要的。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì lěngle, suǒyǐ chuān hòu yīfu shì bìyào de.
en: Because the weather got cold, wearing thick clothes is necessary.

zh: 虽然花钱很多，但这次出国旅游对他来说是必要的经历。
pinyin: Suīrán huāqián hěnduō, dàn zhè cì chūguó lǚyóu duì tā lái shuō shì bìyào de jīnglì.
en: Although it costs a lot of money, this overseas trip is a necessary experience for him.

zh: 为了提高工作效率，定期培训员工已成为必要之举。
pinyin: Wèile tígāo gōngzuò xiàolǜ, dìngqī péixùn yuángōng yǐ chéngwéi bìyào zhī jǔ.
en: To boost work efficiency, regular employee training has become a necessary measure.

zh: 妈妈在我身边。
pinyin: Māma zài wǒ shēnbiān.
en: Mom is next to me.

zh: 我朋友总是在我身边帮助我。
pinyin: Wǒ péngyou zǒngshì zài wǒ shēnbiān bāngzhù wǒ.
en: My friend is always there by my side to help me.

zh: 虽然我一个人在外地，但家人的爱一直在我身边。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ yīgèrén zài wàidì, dànshì jiārén de ài yìzhí zài wǒ shēnbiān.
en: Although I'm alone in another city, my family's love is always with me.

zh: 工作压力很大的时候，有朋友在身边真的很重要。
pinyin: Gōngzuò yālì hěn dà de shíhou, yǒu péngyou zài shēnbiān zhēnde hěn zhòngyào.
en: When work pressure is really high, it's truly important to have friends around you.

zh: 许多成功人士都感谢身边那些默默支持他们的人。
pinyin: Xǔduō chénggōng rénshì dōu gǎnxiè shēnbiān nàxiē mòmò zhīchí tāmen de rén.
en: Many successful people are grateful for those around them who quietly support them.

zh: 我知道你的名字。
pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào nǐ de míngzì.
en: I know your name.

zh: 昨天我才知道他要去北京。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ cái zhīdào tā yào qù Běijīng.
en: I only found out yesterday that he's going to Beijing.

zh: 虽然他没有告诉我，但我还是知道了这个秘密。
pinyin: Suīrán tā méiyǒu gàosu wǒ, dàn wǒ háishi zhīdàole zhège mìmì.
en: Even though he didn't tell me, I still found out the secret.

zh: 直到看到那份报告，我才真正知道事情的严重性。
pinyin: Zhídào kàndào nà fèn bàogào, wǒ cái zhēnzhèng zhīdào shìqing de yánzhòngxìng.
en: It wasn't until I saw that report that I truly understood how serious the situation was.

zh: 她知道自己不够完美，但仍然坚持做最好的自己。
pinyin: Tā zhīdào zìjǐ búgòu wánměi, dàn réngrán jiānchí zuò zuìhǎo de zìjǐ.
en: She knows she's not perfect, but she's still committed to being the best version of herself.

zh: 任何人都喜欢吃好吃的。
pinyin: Rènhé rén dōu xǐhuān chī hǎochīde.
en: Everyone likes to eat delicious food.

zh: 任何人都不能随便进入这个房间。
pinyin: Rènhé rén dōu búnéng suíbiàn jìnrù zhège fángjiān.
en: No one is allowed to enter this room without permission.

zh: 虽然任何人都可以学中文，但是需要花很多时间。
pinyin: Suīrán rènhé rén dōu kěyǐ xué zhōngwén, búguò xūyào huā hěnduō shíjiān.
en: Although anyone can learn Chinese, it requires spending a lot of time.

zh: 这项工作不需要任何人有特殊的教育背景。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngzuò búxūyào rènhé rén yǒu tèshū de jiàoyù bèijǐng.
en: This job doesn't require anyone to have any special educational background.

zh: 任何人都有可能在错误的时间做出正确的决定。
pinyin: Rènhé rén dōu yǒu kěnéng zài cuòwù de shíjiān zuòchū zhèngquè de juéding.
en: Anyone can make the right decision at the wrong time.

zh: 我买了一张票。
pinyin: Wǒ mǎile yī zhāng piào.
en: I bought a ticket.

zh: 昨天我买了两张电影票。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ mǎile liǎng zhāng diànyǐng piào.
en: Yesterday I bought two movie tickets.

zh: 因为今天有演唱会，所以票已经卖完了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān yǒu yǎnchànghuì, suǒyǐ piào yǐjīng màiwán le.
en: Because there's a concert today, the tickets have already sold out.

zh: 虽然票价有点贵，但是我还是决定买一张演出票。
pinyin: Suīrán piàojià yǒudiǎn guì, dànshì wǒ háishi juédìng mǎi yī zhāng yǎnchū piào.
en: Although the ticket price is a bit expensive, I still decided to buy a show ticket.

zh: 他用学生证买了优惠票，省了不少钱。
pinyin: Tā yòng xuéshengzhèng mǎile yōuhuì piào, shěng le búshǎo qián.
en: He used his student ID to get a discounted ticket and saved quite a bit of money.

zh: 他撒谎了。
pinyin: Tā sāhuǎng le.
en: He lied.

zh: 孩子不应该撒谎。
pinyin: Háizi búyīnggāi sāhuǎng.
en: Children shouldn't lie.

zh: 虽然他撒谎了，但我还是原谅他。
pinyin: Suīrán tā sāhuǎng le, dànshì wǒ háishi yuányuànliàng tā.
en: Even though he lied, I still forgive him.

zh: 她因为害怕被责骂而撒谎，结果反而更糟糕。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi hàipà bèi zémaà érshang sāhuǎng, jiéguǒ fǎn'ér gèng zāogāo.
en: She lied out of fear of being scolded, but it only made things worse.

zh: 一旦被发现撒谎，他在同事中的信誉就彻底完蛋了。
pinyin: Yīdàn bèi fāxiàn sāhuǎng, tā zài tóngshì zhōng de xìnyù jiù chèdǐ wándàn le.
en: Once he was caught lying, his reputation among colleagues went completely down the drain.

zh: 这是武器。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǔqì.
en: This is a weapon.

zh: 士兵有很多武器。
pinyin: Shìbīng yǒu hěnduō wǔqì.
en: Soldiers have many weapons.

zh: 因为有了新武器，所以他们更强大了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒuले xīn wǔqì, suǒyǐ tāmen gèng qiángdà le.
en: Because they had new weapons, they became much stronger.

zh: 虽然敌人的武器很先进，但我们仍然能赢。
pinyin: Suīrán díren de wǔqì hěn xiāngjìn, dàn wǒmen réngránéng yíng.
en: Even though the enemy's weapons are advanced, we can still win.

zh: 现代战争中，信息技术已成为比传统武器更重要的武器。
pinyin: Xiàndài zhànzhēng zhōng, xìnxī jìshù yǐ chéngwéi bǐ chuántǒng wǔqì gèng zhòngyào de wǔqì.
en: In modern warfare, information technology has become a more important weapon than traditional weapons.

zh: 牙疼很痛苦。
pinyin: Yá téng hěn tnàngkǔ.
en: A toothache is really painful.

zh: 她昨天生病了，感到很痛苦。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān shēngbìng le, gǎndào hěn tnàngkǔ.
en: She got sick yesterday and felt really awful.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他没有说痛苦的话。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn tā méiyǒu shuō tnàngkǔ de huà.
en: Although work is very busy, he didn't complain about how hard it is.

zh: 长期失业让他感到心理上的痛苦和无助。
pinyin: Chángqī shīyè ràng tā gǎndào xīnlǐ shang de tnàngkǔ hé wúzhù.
en: Long-term unemployment made him feel psychological pain and helplessness.

zh: 患者虽然接受了治疗，但仍然经历着身体和精神上的双重痛苦。
pinyin: Huànzhě suīrán jiēshòu le zhìliáo, dàn réngránjiù jīngglì zhe shēntǐ hé jīngshén shang de shuāngzhòng tnàngkǔ.
en: Although the patient received treatment, they're still experiencing both physical and emotional suffering.

zh: 我吃全部的米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ chī quánbù de mǐfàn.
en: I ate all the rice.

zh: 今天全部的学生都来学校了。
pinyin: Jīntiān quánbù de xuésheng dōu lái xuéxiào le.
en: All the students came to school today.

zh: 因为下雨，全部的课都取消了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, quánbù de kè dōu qǔxiāo le.
en: Because of the rain, all the classes were cancelled.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但全部的工作还是完成了。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn quánbù de gōngzuò háishi wánchéng le.
en: Even though he was very busy, he still managed to finish all the work.

zh: 这个项目的全部费用已经得到了公司的批准。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de quánbù fèiyòng yǐjīng déidào le gōngsī de pīzhǔn.
en: The complete budget for this project has already been approved by the company.

zh: 这是我的手机。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de shǒujī.
en: This is my phone.

zh: 我每天早上看手机。
pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang kàn shǒujī.
en: I look at my phone every morning.

zh: 因为我丢了手机，所以我很着急。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ diūle shǒujī, suǒyǐ wǒ hěn zhāojí.
en: Because I lost my phone, I'm really worried.

zh: 虽然手机很方便，但是用太多对眼睛不好。
pinyin: Suīrán shǒujī hěn fāngbiàn, dànshì yòng tài duō duì yǎnjing búhǎo.
en: Although phones are convenient, using them too much is bad for your eyes.

zh: 现在很多人离不开手机，已经成为日常生活的一部分。
pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō rén líbukāi shǒujī, yǐjīng chéngwéi rìcháng shēnghuó de yī búfen.
en: Nowadays most people can't live without their phones—they've become a part of daily life.

zh: 我忘记吃饭了。
pinyin: Wǒ wàngjì chīfàn le.
en: I forgot to eat.

zh: 昨天我忘记带钥匙了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ wàngjì dài yàoshi le.
en: Yesterday I forgot to bring my keys.

zh: 虽然很忙，但是我不能忘记朋友的生日。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn máng, búguò wǒ búnéng wàngjì péngyou de shēngrì.
en: Even though I'm busy, I can't forget my friend's birthday.

zh: 因为工作太忙了，我经常忘记回复客户的邮件。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng le, wǒ jīngcháng wàngjì huīfù kèhù de yóujiàn.
en: Because work has been so hectic, I often forget to reply to clients' emails.

zh: 无论多久，我都忘记不了那次在国外旅行的经历。
pinyin: Búlùn duōjiǔ, wǒ dōu wàngjì búliǎo nà cì zài guówài lǚxíng de jīnglì.
en: No matter how much time passes, I can never forget that experience traveling abroad.

zh: 问题存在。
pinyin: Wèntí cúnzài.
en: The problem exists.

zh: 这个城市里存在很多餐厅。
pinyin: Zhège chéngshì lǐ cúnzài hěnduō cāntīng.
en: There are many restaurants in this city.

zh: 虽然很难，但是解决办法确实存在。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dànshì jiějué bànfǎ quèshí cúnzài.
en: Although it's difficult, a solution really does exist.

zh: 在公司工作的时候，我发现了一些存在已久的问题。
pinyin: Zài gōngsī gōngzuò de shíhou, wǒ fāxiànle yīxiē cúnzài yǐjiǔ de wèntí.
en: While working at the company, I discovered some long-standing issues.

zh: 尽管科技发展迅速，但人与人之间的沟通障碍依然存在。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn kējì fāzhǎn xùnsù, dàn rén yǔ rén zhījiān de gōutōng zhàngài yīránrán cúnzài.
en: Despite rapid technological progress, communication barriers between people still persist.

zh: 首先，我要吃饭。
pinyin: Shǒuxiān, wǒ yào chīfàn.
en: First, I need to eat.

zh: 首先我们要买菜，然后回家做饭。
pinyin: Shǒuxiān wǒmen yào mǎi cài, ránhòu huíjiā zuòfàn.
en: First we need to buy groceries, then we'll go home and cook.

zh: 首先你要学好中文，因为这样工作会更容易。
pinyin: Shǒuxiān nǐ yào xuéhǎo zhōngwén, yīnwèi zhèyàng gōngzuò huì gèng róngyì.
en: First you need to learn Chinese well, because that way work will be easier.

zh: 首先，我们必须确认这个计划是否可行，然后才能开始执行。
pinyin: Shǒuxiān, wǒmen bìxū quèrèn zhège jìhuà shìfǒu kěxíng, ránhòu cái néng kāishǐ zhíxíng.
en: First, we need to confirm whether this plan is feasible before we can start implementing it.

zh: 首先得承认这个问题的复杂性，否则讨论下去也是徒劳无功。
pinyin: Shǒuxiān děi chéngrenè zhège wèntí de fùzáxìng, fǒuzé tǎolùn xiàqu yě shì túláo wúgōng.
en: We first have to acknowledge how complex this issue is, otherwise any further discussion will be pointless.

zh: 我们一组五个人。
pinyin: Wǒmen yī zǔ wǔ ge rén.
en: There are five of us in our group.

zh: 今天我和朋友组织了一个小游戏。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ hé péngyou zǔzhī le yī ge xiǎo yóuxì.
en: Today my friend and I organized a small game.

zh: 因为他经验丰富，所以被选为这个项目组的负责人。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā jīngyàn fēngfù, suǒyǐ bèi xuǎn wéi zhège xiàngmù zǔ de fùzérén.
en: Because he has plenty of experience, he was chosen to lead this project group.

zh: 虽然每组只有三个人，但是他们的合作效率很高。
pinyin: Suīrán měi zǔ zhǐyǒu sān ge rén, dànshì tāmen de hézuò xiàoxiào hěn gāo.
en: Although each team only has three members, their collaborative efficiency is quite high.

zh: 这个研究组成功地完成了那项复杂的数据分析任务。
pinyin: Zhège yánjiū zǔ chénggōng de wánchéngle nà xiàng fùzá de shùjù fēnxī rènwu.
en: This research team successfully completed that complex data analysis task.

zh: 我照镜子。
pinyin: Wǒ zhào jìngzi.
en: I'm looking in the mirror.

zh: 每天早上我都照镜子梳头。
pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang wǒ dōu zhào jìngzi shūtou.
en: Every morning I look in the mirror and comb my hair.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但是照片还是拍得很漂亮。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, búshì zhàopiàn háishi pāi de hěn piàoliang.
en: Even though the weather wasn't great, the photos still turned out really nice.

zh: 医生照了X光以后，发现我的骨头没有问题。
pinyin: Yīshēng zhào le X guāng yǐhòu, fāxiàn wǒ de gǔtou méiyǒu wèntí.
en: After the doctor took an X-ray, they found there was nothing wrong with my bone.

zh: 按照公司的规定，所有员工都要按时完成报告，否则会被扣工资。
pinyin: Ānzhào gōngsī de guīdìng, suǒyǒu yuángōng dōu yào ānshí wánchéng bàogào, búzé huì bei kòu gōngzī.
en: According to company policy, all employees must complete their reports on time, or their pay will be deducted.

zh: 我和朋友交朋友。
pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyou jiāo péngyou.
en: I make friends with my friend.

zh: 昨天我在学校交了新朋友。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài xuéxiào jiāole xīn péngyou.
en: Yesterday I made a new friend at school.

zh: 因为他很友善,所以我想和他交朋友。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn yǒushàn, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng hé tā jiāo péngyou.
en: Because he's really friendly, I want to be friends with him.

zh: 在公司工作的时候,我交了很多有用的朋友。
pinyin: Zài gōngsī gōngzuò de shíhou, wǒ jiāole hěnduō yǒuyòng de péngyou.
en: While working at the company, I made a lot of useful connections.

zh: 虽然社交媒体让交友更容易,但面对面的友谊还是最珍贵的。
pinyin: Suīrán shèjiāo méitǐ ràng jiāoyou gèng róngyì, dàn miànduìmiàn de yǒuyi háishi zuì zhēnguì de.
en: Although social media makes it easier to connect with people, face-to-face friendships are still the most valuable.

zh: 我喜欢苹果以及香蕉。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān píngguǒ yǐjí xiāngjiāo.
en: I like apples and bananas.

zh: 他每天吃早饭以及喝咖啡。
pinyin: Tā měitiān chī zǎofàn yǐjí hē kāfēi.
en: He eats breakfast and drinks coffee every day.

zh: 因为下雨，我不能去公园以及图书馆。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒ búnéng qù gōngyuán yǐjí túshūguǎn.
en: Because it's raining, I can't go to the park or the library.

zh: 公司需要招聘程序员以及产品经理来完成这个项目。
pinyin: Gōngsī xūyào zhāopìn chéngxù yuán yǐjí chǎnpǐn jīnglǐ lái wánchéng zhège xiàngmù.
en: The company needs to hire programmers and product managers to complete this project.

zh: 学生应该掌握英语、数学以及批判性思维能力才能适应现代社会。
pinyin: Xuésheng yīnggāi zhǎngwò yīngyǔ, shùxué yǐjí píhuàn xìng sīwéi néngglì cáinéng shìyìng xiàndài shèhuì.
en: Students should master English, math, and critical thinking skills in order to adapt to modern society.

zh: 我十岁了。
pinyin: Wǒ shí suì le.
en: I'm ten years old.

zh: 今天下午三点十分开会。
pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ sān diǎn shí fēn kāihuì.
en: The meeting starts at 3:10 this afternoon.

zh: 虽然只有十个人，但是他们工作的时候很认真。
pinyin: Suīrán zhǐyǒu shí ge rén, dànshì tāmen gōngzuò de shíhou hěn rènzhēn.
en: Although there are only ten people, they work very seriously.

zh: 因为十月天气变凉了，所以很多人开始穿秋衣。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shíyuè tiānqì biàn liáng le, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén kāishǐ chuān qiūyī.
en: Since the weather gets cool in October, many people start wearing autumn clothes.

zh: 这家餐厅每十天会推出新菜单，顾客都很期待。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cānting měi shí tiān huì tuīchū xīn càidān, gùkè dōu hěn qīdài.
en: This restaurant releases a new menu every ten days, and customers always look forward to it.

zh: 这是一台电视。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī tái diànshì.
en: This is a television.

zh: 我家里有一台新电脑。
pinyin: Wǒ jiāli yǒu yī tái xīn diànnǎo.
en: I have a new computer at home.

zh: 因为这台机器坏了，所以我们不能工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè tái jīqì huài le, suǒyǐ wǒmen búnéng gōngzuò.
en: Because this machine broke down, we can't work.

zh: 虽然那台旧冰箱还能用，但是电费太高了。
pinyin: Suīrán nà tái jiù bīngxiāng háinéng yòng, búguò diànfèi tài gāo le.
en: Although that old fridge still works, the electricity bill is too high.

zh: 这台设备的性能不错，价格也合理，很值得购买。
pinyin: Zhè tái shèbèi de xìngnéng búcuò, jiàgé yě héli, hěn zhíde gòumǎi.
en: This device has decent performance and a reasonable price—it's really worth buying.

zh: 我搬了一个箱子。
pinyin: Wǒ bānyǎle yīge xiāngzi.
en: I moved a box.

zh: 他今天搬到新房子里去了。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān bānzào xīn fángzi lǐ qù le.
en: He moved into a new house today.

zh: 因为要搬家，所以他整理了很多东西。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yào bānjiā, suǒyǐ tā zhěnglǐle hěnduō dōngxi.
en: Because he was moving, he organized a lot of things.

zh: 公司决定搬到市中心，这样员工上班会更方便。
pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng bānzào shì zhōngxīn, zhèyàng yuángōng shàngbān huì gèng fāngbiàn.
en: The company decided to relocate to the city center so that employees would have an easier commute.

zh: 自从搬了新办公室以后，团队的工作效率明显提高了。
pinyin: Zìcóng bānle xīn bàngōngshì yǐhòu, tuánduì de gōngzuò xiàolǜ míngxiǎn tígāo le.
en: Since moving to the new office, the team's work efficiency has noticeably improved.

zh: 我是一个人。
pinyin: Wǒ shì yī gè rén.
en: I am alone.

zh: 每个人都喜欢吃好吃的东西。
pinyin: Měi gè rén dōu xǐhuān chī hǎochī de dōngxi.
en: Everyone likes to eat delicious food.

zh: 因为他是个人，所以他需要休息和睡眠。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā shì gè rén, suǒyǐ tā xūyào xiūxi hé shuìmián.
en: Because he's a person, he needs rest and sleep.

zh: 每个人都有自己的梦想，虽然实现梦想很困难。
pinyin: Měi gè rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng, suīrán shíxiàn mèngxiǎng hěn kùnnan.
en: Everyone has their own dreams, even though achieving them can be very difficult.

zh: 作为一个人，我们应该学会尊重他人的想法和选择。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī gè rén, wǒmen yīnggāi xuéhuì zūnjìng tārén de xiǎngfǎ hé xuǎnzé.
en: As individuals, we should learn to respect other people's thoughts and choices.

zh: 他代表我们班。
pinyin: Tā dàibiǎo wǒmen bān.
en: He represents our class.

zh: 老师让我代表班级参加比赛。
pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒ dàibiǎo bánjí cānjiā bǐsài.
en: The teacher had me represent the class in the competition.

zh: 虽然他很年轻，但他代表公司去谈生意。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn niánqīng, dàn tā dàibiǎo gōngsī qù tán shēngyì.
en: Although he's young, he represents the company in business negotiations.

zh: 这个产品代表了我们公司最新的技术发展。
pinyin: Zhège chǎnpǐn dàibiǎole wǒmen gōngsī zuì xīn de jìshù fāzhǎn.
en: This product represents the latest technological advancement of our company.

zh: 作为消费者代表，她在会议上提出了很多实际问题。
pinyin: Zuòwéi xiāofèizhě dàibiǎo, tā zài huìyì shang tíchūle hěnduō shíjì wèntí.
en: As a consumer representative, she raised a lot of practical concerns at the meeting.

zh: 我坚持每天跑步。
pinyin: Wǒ jiānchí měitiān pǎobù.
en: I run every day without fail.

zh: 他坚持不吃糖,因为要保护牙齿。
pinyin: Tā jiānchí búchī táng, yīnwèi yào bǎohù yáchǐ.
en: He sticks to not eating candy because he wants to protect his teeth.

zh: 虽然很累,但她坚持完成了所有的功课。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn tā jiānchí wánchéng le suǒyǒu de gōngkè.
en: Although she was tired, she persisted and finished all her homework.

zh: 学生们虽然遇到困难,还是坚持学习中文。
pinyin: Xuéshēngmen suīrán yùdào kùnnan, háishi jiānchí xuéxí zhōngwén.
en: The students faced difficulties but kept studying Chinese anyway.

zh: 长期坚持运动和健康饮食,才能达到真正的身体健康。
pinyin: Chángqī jiānchí yùndòng hé jiànkāng yǐnshí, cáinéng dádào zhēnzhèng de shēntǐ jiànkāng.
en: Only by consistently exercising and eating well over time can you achieve true physical health.

zh: 这个游戏很有意义。
pinyin: zhège yóuxì hěn yǒu yìyì.
en: This game is really meaningful.

zh: 帮助别人很有意义，我喜欢做。
pinyin: bāngzhù biérén hěn yǒu yìyì, wǒ xǐhuān zuò.
en: Helping others is really meaningful, and I enjoy doing it.

zh: 虽然工作很累，但是这份工作对我很有意义。
pinyin: suīrán gōngzuò hěn lèi, dànshì zhèfèn gōngzuò duì wǒ hěn yǒu yìyì.
en: Although the work is tiring, this job is really meaningful to me.

zh: 这个项目的意义在于能帮助更多困难的家庭。
pinyin: zhège xiàngmù de yìyì zàiyú néng bāngzhù gèngduō kùnnan de jiātíng.
en: The significance of this project lies in being able to help more families in difficulty.

zh: 虽然报酬不高，但我们坚持这份工作，因为它有深远的社会意义。
pinyin: suīrán bàochóu búgāo, dàn wǒmen jiānchí zhèfèn gōngzuò, yīnwèi tā yǒu shēnyuǎn de shèhuì yìyì.
en: Although the pay isn't great, we stick with this work because it has deep social significance.

zh: 我家在五楼。
pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài wǔ lóu.
en: My home is on the fifth floor.

zh: 昨天我在楼下看到了一只猫。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài lóu xià kàndàole yī zhī māo.
en: Yesterday I saw a cat downstairs.

zh: 因为电梯坏了，所以我走楼梯上楼。
pinyin: Yīnwèi diàntī huàile, suǒyǐ wǒ zǒu lóutī shàng lóu.
en: Because the elevator was broken, I took the stairs up.

zh: 这栋楼虽然很旧，但是租金便宜，很多年轻人都住在这里。
pinyin: Zhè dòng lóu suīrán hěn jiù, dànshì zūjīn piányi, hěnduō niánqīngrén dōu zhù zài zhèlǐ.
en: Although this building is old, the rent is cheap, so lots of young people live here.

zh: 公司搬到新楼以后，员工的工作环境改善了不少，生产效率也随之提高了。
pinyin: Gōngsī bāndào xīn lóu yǐhòu, yuángōng de gōngzuò huánjìng gǎishàn le búshǎo, shēngchǎn xiàolǜ yě suízī tíhuà le.
en: After the company moved to the new building, employees' working conditions improved considerably, and productivity rose accordingly.

zh: 我承认吃了。
pinyin: Wǒ chéngrèn chīle.
en: I admit I ate it.

zh: 他昨天承认了自己的错误。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān chéngrènle zìjǐ de cuòwù.
en: He admitted his mistake yesterday.

zh: 虽然他一开始不承认，但最后还是承认了。
pinyin: Suīrán tā yī kāishǐ bù chéngrèn, dàn zuìhòu háishi chéngrènle.
en: Although he didn't admit it at first, he finally came clean.

zh: 公司领导承认这个项目存在一些问题需要解决。
pinyin: Gōngsī lǐngdǎo chéngrèn zhège xiàngmù cúnzài yīxiē wèntí xūyào jiějué.
en: The company leadership acknowledged that this project has some problems that need to be addressed.

zh: 即使你不想承认，但这个事实摆在眼前谁都看得见。
pinyin: Jíshǐ nǐ búxiǎng chéngrèn, dàn zhège shìshí bǎizài yǎnqián shéi dōu kàndéjiàn.
en: Whether you want to admit it or not, the fact is right in front of us for everyone to see.

zh: 我发誓不吃糖。
pinyin: Wǒ fāshì búchī táng.
en: I promise not to eat candy.

zh: 他发誓明天一定来我家。
pinyin: Tā fāshì míngtiān yīdìng lái wǒ jiā.
en: He swore he would definitely come to my house tomorrow.

zh: 虽然很难，但他发誓要学好中文。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dàn tā fāshì yào xuéhǎo Zhōngwén.
en: Although it's difficult, he swore he would learn Chinese well.

zh: 她在朋友面前发誓，以后再也不会迟到。
pinyin: Tā zài péngyou miànqián fāshì, yǐhòu zàiyě búhuì chídào.
en: She swore in front of her friends that she would never be late again.

zh: 为了赢得她的信任，他发誓要改掉所有坏习惯。
pinyin: Wèile yíngdé tā de xìnrèn, tā fāshì yào gǎidiào suǒyǒu huài xíguàn.
en: To earn her trust, he swore he would break all his bad habits.

zh: 我没有理由不去。
pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu lǐyóu búqù.
en: I have no reason not to go.

zh: 他迟到的理由是睡过头了。
pinyin: Tā chídào de lǐyóu shì shuìguòtóu le.
en: His reason for being late was that he overslept.

zh: 虽然理由很充分，但我还是不同意。
pinyin: Suīrán lǐyóu hěn chōngfèn, dàn wǒ háishi búdòngyì.
en: Although the reason is very solid, I still disagree.

zh: 公司没有给员工解释裁员的具体理由。
pinyin: Gōngsī méiyǒu gěi yuángōng jiěshì cáiyuán de jùtǐ lǐyóu.
en: The company didn't give employees a specific reason for the layoffs.

zh: 除非你能提出充分的理由，否则这个决定是无法改变的。
pinyin: Chúfēi nǐ néng tíchū chōngfèn de lǐyóu, fǒuzé zhège juédìng shì wúfǎ gǎibiàn de.
en: Unless you can give a compelling reason, this decision cannot be changed.

zh: 他显然很高兴。
pinyin: Tā xiǎnrán hěn gāoxìng.
en: He's clearly very happy.

zh: 今天天气显然比昨天好。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì xiǎnrán bǐ zuótiān hǎo.
en: Today's weather is obviously better than yesterday's.

zh: 虽然他没说话，但显然他不同意这个主意。
pinyin: Suīrán tā méi shuōhuà, dàn xiǎnrán tā búdòngyì zhège zhǔyì.
en: Even though he didn't say anything, it's clear he disagrees with this idea.

zh: 从他的表情可以看出，他显然对这份工作不太满意。
pinyin: Cóng tā de biǎoqíng kěyǐ kànchū, tā xiǎnrán duì zhèfèn gōngzuò búhuài mǎnyì.
en: From his expression, it's evident that he's not very satisfied with this job.

zh: 这次失败显然打击了他的信心，但他决定重新站起来。
pinyin: Zhè cì shībài xiǎnrán dǎjī le tā de xìnxin, dàn tā juéding chóngxīn zhàn qǐlai.
en: This failure clearly knocked his confidence, but he decided to get back on his feet.

zh: 这是一个局。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè jú.
en: This is a game.

zh: 我们今天在公司的局里开会。
pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān zài gōngsī de jú lǐ kāihuì.
en: We're having a meeting in the office department today.

zh: 虽然这个局的工作很忙，但是大家都很开心。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège jú de gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì dàjiā dōu hěn kāixīn.
en: Although the department is busy with work, everyone is still happy.

zh: 他在市政府的新闻局工作，每天要处理很多媒体的问题。
pinyin: Tā zài shìzhèngfǔ de xīnwén jú gōngzuò, měi tiān yào chǔlǐ hěnduō méitǐ de wèntí.
en: He works at the city government's press bureau and has to handle lots of media inquiries every day.

zh: 这次谈判的局面很复杂，双方都想占上风，所以进展缓慢。
pinyin: Zhè cì tánpàn de júmiàn hěn fùzá, shuāngfāng dōu xiǎng zhàn shàngyǔ, suǒyǐ jìnzhǎn huǎnman.
en: The situation in this negotiation is complicated—both sides want the upper hand, so progress is slow.

zh: 政府在城市里。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zài chéngshì lǐ.
en: The government is in the city.

zh: 政府今天给我们放假。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jīntiān gěi wǒmen fàngjià.
en: The government gave us a day off today.

zh: 因为政府的帮助，所以很多人有了工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhèngfǔ de bāngzhù, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén yǒule gōngzuò.
en: Because of government support, many people found jobs.

zh: 政府最近出台了新政策来改善环境问题。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zuìjìn chūtāile xīn zhèngcè lái gǎishàn huánjìng wèntí.
en: The government recently rolled out new policies to improve environmental issues.

zh: 政府与企业合作，既促进了经济发展，也解决了就业难题。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ yǔ qǐyè hézuò, jì促jìnle jīngjì fāzhǎn, yě jiějuéle jiùyè nántí.
en: Through partnerships with businesses, the government has both boosted economic growth and tackled employment challenges.

zh: 这次我吃米饭。
pinyin: Zhè cì wǒ chī mǐfàn.
en: This time I'm eating rice.

zh: 这次我们去公园玩了。
pinyin: Zhè cì wǒmen qù gōngyuán wánle.
en: This time we went to the park to play.

zh: 虽然这次考试很难，但是我考得不错。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè cì kǎoshì hěn nán, dànshì wǒ kǎo de búcuò.
en: Although this exam was difficult, I actually did pretty well on it.

zh: 这次会议的决定会影响公司未来的发展方向。
pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de juédìng huì yǐngxiǎng gōngsī wèilái de fāzhǎn fāngxiàng.
en: The decision made at this meeting will impact the company's future development strategy.

zh: 这次项目失败的原因是团队沟通不足，我们吸取教训准备重新开始。
pinyin: Zhè cì xiàngmù shībài de yuányīn shì tuánduì gōutōng búzú, wǒmen xīqǔ jiàoxun zhǔnbèi chóngxīn kāishǐ.
en: The reason this project failed was poor team communication, so we've learned our lesson and are ready to start over.

zh: 我爸爸做生意。
pinyin: Wǒ bàba zuò shēngyì.
en: My dad runs a business.

zh: 他每天都很忙，因为生意很好。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu hěn máng, yīnwèi shēngyì hěn hǎo.
en: He's busy every day because his business is doing well.

zh: 虽然生意不错，但是她还是很累。
pinyin: Suīrán shēngyì búcuò, dànshì tā háishi hěn lèi.
en: Although her business is fine, she's still very tired.

zh: 自从搬到新地方以后，他的生意变得更好了。
pinyin: Zìcóng bān dào xīn dìfang yǐhòu, tāde shēngyì biàn de gèng hǎo le.
en: Ever since moving to a new location, his business has gotten even better.

zh: 疫情期间，不少人的生意都受到了很大的影响。
pinyin: Yìqíng qījiān, búshǎo rén de shēngyì dōu shòudào le hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
en: During the pandemic, many people's businesses were significantly affected.

zh: 我的眼睛很大。
pinyin: Wǒ de yǎnjing hěn dà.
en: My eyes are very big.

zh: 昨天我的眼睛很疼。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ de yǎnjing hěn téng.
en: My eyes hurt a lot yesterday.

zh: 虽然天很黑，但是我能看见她的眼睛。
pinyin: Suīrán tiān hěn hēi, dànshì wǒ néng kànjiàn tā de yǎnjing.
en: Even though it was dark, I could still see her eyes.

zh: 在这个问题上，我们的眼光完全不同。
pinyin: Zài zhège wèntí shang, wǒmen de yǎnguāng wánquán búduàng.
en: On this issue, our perspectives are completely different.

zh: 他一眼就看出了这件事背后的真相。
pinyin: Tā yī yǎn jiù kànchūle zhè jiàn shì bèihòu de zhēnxiàng.
en: He saw through the real situation behind this matter at a glance.

zh: 火很热。
pinyin: Huǒ hěn rè.
en: Fire is very hot.

zh: 妈妈用火做饭。
pinyin: Māma yòng huǒ zuòfàn.
en: Mom uses fire to cook.

zh: 因为停电了，所以我们用火来照亮房间。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tíngdiàn le, suǒyǐ wǒmen yòng huǒ lái zhàoliàng fángjiān.
en: Because the power went out, we used fire to light up the room.

zh: 这家餐厅的火锅虽然很贵，但是味道特别好。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de huǒguō suīrán hěn guì, dànshi wèidào tèbié hǎo.
en: Although this restaurant's hot pot is expensive, the taste is really excellent.

zh: 他工作特别忙，经常加班到深夜，真是火力全开。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò tèbié máng, jīngcháng jiābān dào shēnyè, zhēnshi huǒlì quánkāi.
en: He's extremely busy with work and often stays late into the night—he's really firing on all cylinders.

zh: 我在公园遇到了朋友。
pinyin: Wǒ zài gōngyuán yùdào le péngyou.
en: I ran into a friend at the park.

zh: 昨天我在超市遇到了我的老师。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài chāoshì yùdào le wǒ de lǎoshī.
en: Yesterday I bumped into my teacher at the supermarket.

zh: 虽然我们很久没见，但是今天在街上遇到了彼此。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen hěn jiǔ méi jiàn, dànshì jīntiān zài jiēshang yùdào le bǐcǐ.
en: Even though we hadn't seen each other for ages, we ran into each other on the street today.

zh: 工作中遇到困难时，我们需要冷静地分析问题。
pinyin: Gōngzuò zhōng yùdào kùnnan shí, wǒmen xūyào lěngjìng de fēnxī wèntí.
en: When we encounter difficulties at work, we need to calmly analyze the problem.

zh: 创业者经常会遇到资金短缺的挑战，这考验的是他们的解决能力。
pinyin: Chuàngyèzhě jīngcháng huì yùdào zījīn duǎnquē de tiǎozhàn, zhè kǎoyàn de shì tāmen de jiějué néinglì.
en: Entrepreneurs often face the challenge of insufficient capital, which tests their problem-solving abilities.

zh: 我有一只猫。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī zhī māo.
en: I have a cat.

zh: 我的猫很喜欢吃鱼。
pinyin: Wǒ de māo hěn xǐhuān chī yú.
en: My cat really likes to eat fish.

zh: 因为天气很热，猫就躺在地上睡觉。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn rè, māo jiù tǎng zài dìshang shuìjiào.
en: Because it was so hot, the cat lay down on the floor and took a nap.

zh: 虽然这只猫很调皮，但是我们全家都很喜欢它。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè zhī māo hěn tiáopí, dànshì wǒmen quánjiā dōu hěn xǐhuān tā.
en: Even though this cat is quite mischievous, our whole family loves it.

zh: 养猫的人都知道，猫虽然独立，但对主人的感情其实很深。
pinyin: Yǎng māo de rén dōu zhīdào, māo suīrán dúlì, dàn duì zhǔrén de gǎnqíng qíshí hěn shēn.
en: Anyone who owns a cat knows that despite being independent, cats actually have deep feelings for their owners.

zh: 即使下雨，我也要去。
pinyin: Jíshǐ xiàyǔ, wǒ yě yào qù.
en: Even if it rains, I'm still going.

zh: 即使很累，他也坚持工作。
pinyin: Jíshǐ hěn léi, tā yě jiānchí gōngzuò.
en: Even though he's really tired, he keeps working.

zh: 即使你不同意，我也要做这件事。
pinyin: Jíshǐ nǐ bù tóngyì, wǒ yě yào zuò zhè jiàn shì.
en: Even if you don't agree, I'm going to do it anyway.

zh: 即使公司给他更高的工资，他还是决定换工作。
pinyin: Jíshǐ gōngsī gěi tā gèng gāo de gōngzī, tā háishi juéding huàn gōngzuò.
en: Even though the company offered him a higher salary, he still decided to change jobs.

zh: 即使面临各种困难，这个团队也从未放弃过目标。
pinyin: Jíshǐ miànlín gèzhǒng kùnnan, zhège tuánduì yě cóngwèi fàngqì guò mùbiāo.
en: Even in the face of all kinds of challenges, this team has never given up on their goal.

zh: 我记住了你的名字。
pinyin: Wǒ jìzhù le nǐ de míngzì.
en: I remembered your name.

zh: 你要记住明天下午三点开会。
pinyin: Nǐ yào jìzhù míngtiān xiàwǔ sān diǎn kāihuì.
en: You need to remember that the meeting is tomorrow at 3 p.m.

zh: 虽然很难，但是你一定要记住这个规则。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dànshì nǐ yīdìng yào jìzhù zhège guīzé.
en: Even though it's hard, you absolutely have to remember this rule.

zh: 因为这件事很重要，所以我特意记住了每个细节。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè jiàn shì hěn zhòngyào, suǒyǐ wǒ tèyì jìzhù le měi ge xì節.
en: Because this matter is so important, I deliberately memorized every detail.

zh: 他把老板的建议完全记住了，决定改变自己的工作方式。
pinyin: Tā bǎ lǎobǎn de jiànyì wánquán jìzhù le, juéding gǎibiàn zìjǐ de gōngzuò fāngshì.
en: He took the boss's advice to heart and fully committed to changing his work approach.

zh: 公园里到处都是人。
pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ dàochù dōu shì rén.
en: There are people everywhere in the park.

zh: 昨天下雨，到处都很湿。
pinyin: Zuótiān xiàyǔ, dàochù dōu hěn shī.
en: It rained yesterday, so everything everywhere was wet.

zh: 虽然很晚了，但商店到处还开着。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn wǎn le, dàn shāngdiàn dàochù háishi kāizhe.
en: Even though it's late, shops are still open all over the place.

zh: 因为假期开始了，游客到处都在拍照。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jiàqī kāishǐ le, yóukè dàochù dōu zài pāizhào.
en: Since the holiday has started, tourists are taking photos everywhere.

zh: 装修以后，到处都有灰尘，需要彻底打扫。
pinyin: Zhuāngxiū yǐhòu, dàochù dōu yǒu huīchén, xūyào chèdǐ dǎsǎo.
en: After the renovation, there's dust all over the place, so we need to do a thorough cleaning.

zh: 我很幸运。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn xìngyùn.
en: I'm very lucky.

zh: 今天我很幸运，买到了便宜的票。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ hěn xìngyùn, mǎidào le piányi de piào.
en: I was lucky today and got cheap tickets.

zh: 虽然考试很难，但是我很幸运地及格了。
pinyin: Suīrán kǎoshì hěn nán, dànshì wǒ hěn xìngyùn de jígé le.
en: Although the exam was hard, I was fortunate to pass it.

zh: 他找工作的时候很幸运，第一次面试就成功了。
pinyin: Tā zhǎo gōngzuò de shíhou hěn xìngyùn, dì yī cì miànshì jiù chénggōng le.
en: He was lucky when job hunting—he succeeded on his first interview.

zh: 与其依赖幸运，不如脚踏实地工作更能改变人生。
pinyin: Yǔqī yīlài xìngyùn, búrú jiǎo tà shídì gōngzuò gèng néng gǎibiàn rénshēng.
en: Rather than relying on luck, working diligently and practically is a better way to change your life.

zh: 我的卡在这里。
pinyin: Wǒ de kǎ zài zhèlǐ.
en: My card is here.

zh: 昨天我买了一张卡。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ mǎi le yī zhāng kǎ.
en: I bought a card yesterday.

zh: 因为我弄丢了卡，所以不能买东西。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ nòngdiào le kǎ, suǒyǐ búnéng mǎi dōngxi.
en: Because I lost my card, I can't buy anything.

zh: 虽然这张卡很旧，但是我还是想继续用它。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè zhāng kǎ hěn jiù, búguò wǒ háishi xiǎng jìxù yòng tā.
en: Even though this card is old, I still want to keep using it.

zh: 银行的系统出问题了，导致我的卡被冻结，现在没法取钱。
pinyin: Yínháng de xìtǒng chū wèntí le, dǎozhì wǒ de kǎ bèi dòngjiē, xiànzài méifǎ qǔ qián.
en: The bank's system had a glitch that froze my card, so I can't withdraw money right now.

zh: 我洗手了。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐ shǒu le.
en: I washed my hands.

zh: 每天早上我洗脸刷牙。
pinyin: Měi tiān zǎo shang wǒ xǐ liǎn shuā yá.
en: Every morning I wash my face and brush my teeth.

zh: 虽然衣服很脏，但是洗了以后就很干净了。
pinyin: Suīrán yī fu hěn zāng, dànshì xǐ le yǐ hòu jiù hěn gānnjìng le.
en: Although the clothes were very dirty, once I washed them they became clean.

zh: 因为下雨天踩了很多泥，回家后我立刻洗掉了鞋子。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xià yǔ tiān cǎi le hěn duō ní, huí jiā hòu wǒ lìkè xǐ diào le xié zi.
