en: Because I stepped in a lot of mud on the rainy day, I immediately washed my shoes when I got home.

zh: 长期接触化学物质的工人需要定期洗澡，这样才能保护皮肤健康。
pinyin: Cháng qī jiē chù huà xué wù zhì de gōng rén xū yào dìng qī xǐ zǎo, zhè yàng cái néng bǎo hù pífu jiàn kāng.
en: Workers who have prolonged contact with chemicals need to bathe regularly in order to protect their skin health.

zh: 那时我在家。
pinyin: Nà shí wǒ zài jiā.
en: At that time, I was at home.

zh: 那时我还很小，不会说话。
pinyin: Nà shí wǒ háishi hěn xiǎo, búhuì shuōhuà.
en: Back then I was very young and couldn't speak yet.

zh: 那时虽然很冷，但是我们还是去了公园。
pinyin: Nà shí suīrán hěn lěng, danshi wǒmen háishi qùle gōngyuán.
en: Even though it was cold at that time, we still went to the park.

zh: 那时我刚开始工作，每天都很累，不过很开心。
pinyin: Nà shí wǒ gāng kāishǐ gōngzuò, měi tiān dōu hěn lèi, búguò hěn kāixīn.
en: When I first started working back then, I was tired every day, but I was really happy.

zh: 那时互联网还不普及，人们主要通过电话和信件联系。
pinyin: Nà shí húliánwǎng háishi búpǔjí, rénmen zhǔyào tōngguò diànhuà hé xìnjiàn liánxì.
en: Back then the internet wasn't widely available yet, so people mainly stayed in touch by phone and mail.

zh: 你干什么呢？
pinyin: Nǐ gàn shénme ne?
en: What are you doing?

zh: 他现在在厨房干什么？
pinyin: Tā xiànzài zài chúfáng gàn shénme?
en: What is he doing in the kitchen right now?

zh: 妈妈工作很忙，但是下班后干什么都很开心。
pinyin: Māma gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì xiàbān hòu gàn shénme dōu hěn kāixīn.
en: Mom's work is tiring, but she's happy doing anything after work.

zh: 如果没有手机，你觉得自己会干什么来打发时间？
pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu shǒujī, nǐ juéde zìjǐ huì gàn shénme lái dǎfā shíjiān?
en: If you didn't have a phone, what do you think you'd do to pass the time?

zh: 与其整天玩游戏，不如问问自己真正想干什么，这样才能有意义。
pinyin: Yǔqī zhěngtiān wán yóuxì, búrú wènwen zìjǐ zhēnzhèng xiǎng gàn shénme, zhèyàng cái néng yǒu yìyì.
en: Instead of playing games all day, you should ask yourself what you really want to do—that's the only way life becomes meaningful.

zh: 这是什么事儿？
pinyin: Zhè shì shénme shì'ér?
en: What's this about?

zh: 昨天发生了一件很奇怪的事儿。
pinyin: Zuótiān fāshēngle yī jiàn hěn qíguài de shì'ér.
en: Something really strange happened yesterday.

zh: 因为这件事儿，他和朋友之间产生了误会。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè jiàn shì'ér, tā hé péngyou zhījiān chǎnshēngle wùhuì.
en: Because of this situation, a misunderstanding came up between him and his friend.

zh: 虽然这事儿看起来很简单，但实际处理起来却挺复杂的。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè shì'ér kàn qǐlai hěn jiǎndān, dàn shíjì chǔlǐ qǐlai què tǐng fùzá de.
en: Although this matter seems straightforward on the surface, dealing with it in practice is actually quite complicated.

zh: 这事儿说起来容易，可一旦涉及到利益冲突就变得麻烦了。
pinyin: Zhè shì'ér shuōqǐlai róngyì, kě yīdàn shèjīdào lìyì chōngt突 jiù biàn de máfan le.
en: This kind of thing is easy to talk about in theory, but once conflicting interests come into play, it becomes a real hassle.

zh: 颜料混在一起。
pinyin: Yánliào huàn zài yīqǐ.
en: The paints are mixed together.

zh: 他每天都在咖啡里混糖。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu zài kāfēi lǐ huàn táng.
en: He mixes sugar into his coffee every day.

zh: 虽然工作很累，但他还是混在人群中开心地笑。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn lèi, dànshì tā háishi huàn zài rénjún zhōng kāixīn de xiào.
en: Even though work is tiring, he still mingles with the crowd and laughs happily.

zh: 这个学生因为经常混日子，所以成绩一直很差。
pinyin: Zhège xuésheng yīnwèi jīngcháng huàn rìzi, suǒyǐ chéngjì yīzhí hěn chà.
en: Because this student constantly coasts through school, his grades have always been poor.

zh: 他在那个圈子里混了十多年，积累了不少人脉和经验。
pinyin: Tā zài nàge quānzi lǐ huàn le shí duō nián, jīlěi le búshǎo rénmài hé jīngyàn.
en: He's been working in that industry for over a decade and has built up considerable connections and experience.

zh: 他犯罪了。
pinyin: Tā fànzuì le.
en: He committed a crime.

zh: 那个人去年犯罪,现在在监狱里。
pinyin: Nàge rén qùnián fànzuì, xiànzài zài jiānyù lǐ.
en: That man committed a crime last year and is now in prison.

zh: 因为他犯罪了,所以警察把他抓住。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā fànzuì le, suǒyǐ jǐngchá bǎ tā zhuāzhù.
en: Because he committed a crime, the police arrested him.

zh: 虽然他说自己没有犯罪,但证人的证词证明了他的罪行。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shuō zìjǐ méiyǒu fànzuì, dàn zhèngrén de zhèngcí zhèngmíng le tā de zuìxíng.
en: Although he claimed he didn't commit the crime, the witness's testimony proved his guilt.

zh: 这起案件涉及多个嫌疑人,他们可能共同犯罪或分别作案。
pinyin: Zhè qǐ ànjiàn shèjí duō ge xiányí rén, tāmen kěnéng gòngtóng fànzuì huò fēnbié zuòàn.
en: This case involves multiple suspects who may have committed the crime together or separately.

zh: 我在墙上挂了一张画。
pinyin: Wǒ zài qiáng shang guà le yī zhāng huà.
en: I hung a picture on the wall.

zh: 她每天早上都挂上红色的窗帘。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎo shang dōu guà shang hóng sè de chuāng lián.
en: She hangs up red curtains on the window every morning.

zh: 虽然天气很热，但是他还是挂着厚厚的外套。
pinyin: Suīrán tiān qì hěn rè, dànshi tā háishi guà zhe hòu hou de wài tào.
en: Even though it's hot outside, he still has a thick coat hanging on him.

zh: 因为他不想让别人看到那些文件，所以把它们都挂在了办公室的后面。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā búxiǎng ràng bié rén kàn dào nà xiē wén jiàn, suǒyǐ bǎ tā men dōu guà zai le bàn gōng shì de hòu miàn.
en: Because he didn't want others to see those documents, he hung them all up at the back of the office.

zh: 医生把病人的验血报告挂在系统里，这样患者可以随时查看自己的健康状况。
pinyin: Yī shēng bǎ bìng rén de yàn xiě bào gào guà zai xì tǒng lǐ, zhè yàng huàn zhě kě yǐ suí shí chá kàn zì jǐ de jiàn kāng zhuàng kuàng.
en: The doctor uploaded the patient's blood test results to the system, so the patient could check his health status anytime.

zh: 我喜欢跳舞。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān tiàowǔ.
en: I like to dance.

zh: 周末我和朋友一起跳舞。
pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ hé péngyou yìqǐ tiàowǔ.
en: On weekends, my friends and I dance together.

zh: 虽然她很累，但是她还想跳舞。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn lèi, dànshì tā háixiǎng tiàowǔ.
en: Even though she's tired, she still wants to dance.

zh: 自从学了拉丁舞以后，她每天都想跳舞。
pinyin: Zìcóng xuéle lādīng wǔ yǐhòu, tā měitiān dōu xiǎng tiàowǔ.
en: Ever since she learned Latin dance, she wants to dance every single day.

zh: 与其整天看手机，不如出去跳舞活动活动筋骨。
pinyin: Yǔqī zhěngtiān kàn shǒujī, búrú chūqù tiàowǔ huódòng huódòng jīngǔ.
en: Rather than staring at your phone all day, why not go out dancing and get some exercise?

zh: 他是白痴。
pinyin: Tā shì báichī.
en: He's an idiot.

zh: 你别像白痴一样说话。
pinyin: Nǐ bié xiàng báichī yīyàng shuōhuà.
en: Don't talk like you're stupid.

zh: 虽然他很聪明，但有时候做事很白痴。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn cōngming, dàn yǒushíhou zuòshì hěn báichī.
en: Although he's smart, sometimes he does really dumb things.

zh: 那个决定简直是白痴，因为没人考虑过后果。
pinyin: Nàge juédìng jiǎnzhí shì báichī, yīnwèi méi rén kǎolǜguo hòuguǒ.
en: That decision was absolutely idiotic because nobody thought about the consequences.

zh: 与其说他白痴，不如说他太自信了，结果反而害了自己。
pinyin: Yǔqì shuō tā báichī, búrú shuō tā tài zìxìnle, jiéguǒ fǎn'ér hàile zìjǐ.
en: Rather than call him an idiot, I'd say he's overconfident—and it ended up backfiring on him.

zh: 我信任妈妈。
pinyin: Wǒ xìnrèn māma.
en: I trust my mom.

zh: 他很诚实，我们都信任他。
pinyin: Tā hěn chéngshí, wǒmen dōu xìnrèn tā.
en: He's very honest, and we all trust him.

zh: 因为他总是帮助我，所以我信任他。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā zǒngshì bāngzhù wǒ, suǒyǐ wǒ xìnrèn tā.
en: Because he always helps me, I trust him.

zh: 建立信任需要时间和真诚的沟通。
pinyin: Jiànlì xìnrèn xūyào shíjiān hé zhēnchéng de gōutōng.
en: Building trust takes time and genuine communication.

zh: 在工作中失去信任很难再恢复，所以要格外谨慎。
pinyin: Zài gōngzuò zhōng shīqù xìnrèn hěn nán zài huīfù, suǒyǐ yào géwài jǐnshèn.
en: Once you lose someone's trust at work, it's hard to rebuild it, so you have to be extra careful.

zh: 我看新闻。
pinyin: Wǒ kàn xīnwén.
en: I'm watching the news.

zh: 早上我喜欢看新闻。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ xǐhuān kàn xīnwén.
en: I like to read the news in the morning.

zh: 因为新闻很重要，所以我每天都看。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xīnwén hěn zhòngyào, suǒyǐ wǒ měi tiān dōu kàn.
en: Because the news is important, I watch it every day.

zh: 虽然新闻有好有坏，但大多数人还是需要了解。
pinyin: Suīrán xīnwén yǒu hǎo yǒu huài, dàn dàduōshù rén háishi xūyào liǎojiě.
en: Although the news has good and bad stories, most people still need to stay informed.

zh: 在信息爆炸的年代，我们应该学会分辨新闻的真假。
pinyin: Zài xìnxī bàozhà de niándài, wǒmen yīnggāi xuéhuì fēnbiàn xīnwén de zhēnjiǎ.
en: In this age of information overload, we should learn to distinguish between real and fake news.

zh: 未来我想吃米饭。
pinyin: Wèilái wǒ xiǎng chī mǐfàn.
en: In the future, I want to eat rice.

zh: 未来的天气会很好吗？
pinyin: Wèilái de tiānqì huì hěn hǎo ma?
en: Will the weather be nice in the future?

zh: 虽然现在很忙，但是未来会更好。
pinyin: Suīrán xiànzài hěn máng, dànshì wèilái huì gèng hǎo.
en: Even though things are busy now, the future will be better.

zh: 为了未来的工作，他现在正在学习新的技能。
pinyin: Wèile wèilái de gōngzuò, tā xiànzài zhèngzài xuéxí xīn de jìnéng.
en: He's learning new skills now to prepare for his future career.

zh: 虽然无法预测未来，但我们可以通过努力来影响它。
pinyin: Suīrán wúfǎ yùcè wèilái, dàn wǒmen kěyǐ tōngguò nǔlì lái yǐngxiǎng tā.
en: While we can't predict the future, we can influence it through our efforts.

zh: 我说错了,要道歉。
pinyin: Wǒ shuōcuò le, yào dàoqiàn.
en: I said something wrong, and I need to apologize.

zh: 昨天我迟到了,今天向他道歉。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ chídào le, jīntiān xiàng tā dàoqiàn.
en: I was late yesterday, so today I apologized to him.

zh: 虽然不是故意的,但我还是要道歉。
pinyin: Suīrán búshì gùyì de, dàn wǒ háishi yào dàoqiàn.
en: Even though it wasn't on purpose, I still need to say sorry.

zh: 他因为弄坏了我的东西而真诚地道歉。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi nònghuài le wǒ de dōngxi érzhēnchéng de dàoqiàn.
en: He sincerely apologized because he had broken my things.

zh: 经理在会议上主动向全体员工道歉,承认了公司的失误。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ zài huìyì shang zhǔdòng xiàng quántǐ yuángōng dàoqiàn, chéngrènle gōngsī de shīwù.
en: The manager took the initiative to apologize to all employees at the meeting and acknowledged the company's mistake.

zh: 这只小狗很可怜。
pinyin: Zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu hěn kělián.
en: This little puppy is so pitiful.

zh: 那个孩子没有父母，很可怜。
pinyin: Nàge háizi méiyǒu fùmǔ, hěn kělián.
en: That child has no parents—it's really sad.

zh: 因为下雨，他没有伞，看起来很可怜。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, tā méiyǒu sǎn, kàn qǐlai hěn kělián.
en: Because it was raining and he had no umbrella, he looked pretty pathetic.

zh: 虽然她很努力工作，但薪水还是很低，真的挺可怜的。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn nǔlì gōngzuò, dàn xīnshui háishi hěn dī, zhēnde tǐng kělián de.
en: Even though she works hard, her salary is still really low—it's honestly quite unfortunate.

zh: 他一个人在大城市里奋斗，没有朋友，工作压力也大，确实挺可怜的。
pinyin: Tā yīge rén zài dà chéngshì lǐ fèndòu, méiyǒu péngyou, gōngzuò yālì yě dà, quèshí tǐng kělián de.
en: He's struggling alone in this big city with no friends and work stress piling up—it's genuinely rough.

zh: 这个苹果实在很甜。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ shízài hěn tián.
en: This apple is really sweet.

zh: 今天天气实在太热了，我很累。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, wǒ hěn lèi.
en: The weather today is honestly way too hot, and I'm exhausted.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但是他实在很想帮助朋友。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì tā shízài hěn xiǎng bāngzhù péngyou.
en: Even though he's really busy, he genuinely wants to help his friends.

zh: 这份工作的工资实在太低了，我决定辞职找新工作。
pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò de gōngzī shízài tài dī le, wǒ juéding cízhí zhǎo xīn gōngzuò.
en: The salary for this job is honestly way too low, so I've decided to quit and find something new.

zh: 他的表现实在令人失望，我们原本对他的期望要高得多。
pinyin: Tā de biǎoxiàn shízài lìngrén shīwàng, wǒmen yuánběn duì tā de qīwàng yào gāo de duō.
en: His performance has genuinely been disappointing—we had much higher expectations for him in the first place.

zh: 他骗我了。
pinyin: Tā piàn wǒ le.
en: He lied to me.

zh: 你不要骗小孩子。
pinyin: Nǐ búyào piàn xiǎo háizi.
en: Don't lie to little children.

zh: 虽然他骗过我，但是我还是选择原谅他。
pinyin: Suīránguǒ tā piàn guò wǒ, dànshì wǒ háishi xuǎnzé yuányòng tā.
en: Although he deceived me before, I still chose to forgive him.

zh: 那个销售员用虚假信息骗我买了不好的产品。
pinyin: Nàge xiāoshòu yuán yòng xūjiǎ xìnxī piàn wǒ mǎile búhǎo de chǎnpǐn.
en: That salesman tricked me into buying an inferior product using false information.

zh: 他们用各种借口骗取了老人的养老金，实在是太过分了。
pinyin: Tāmen yòng gèzhǒng jièkǒu piànqǔ le lǎorén de yǎnglǎo jīn, shízài shì tàiguòfen le.
en: They swindled the elderly out of their pension money using all sorts of pretexts—it's really inexcusable.

zh: 我加入了足球队。
pinyin: Wǒ jiāruìle zúqiú duì.
en: I joined the soccer team.

zh: 昨天我加入了一个新的英语班。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ jiāruìle yīgè xīn de yīngyǔ bān.
en: Yesterday I joined a new English class.

zh: 虽然我很害怕，但是我还是决定加入了这个项目。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ hěn hàipà, dànshì wǒ háishi juéding jiāruìle zhège xiàngmù.
en: Even though I was nervous, I still decided to join this project.

zh: 为了更好地学习中文，很多外国人加入了在线语言交换平台。
pinyin: Wèile gèng hǎo de xuéxí zhōngwén, hěnduō wàiguó rén jiāruìle zàixiàn yǔyán jiāohuàn píng tái.
en: To improve their Chinese, many foreigners have joined online language exchange platforms.

zh: 公司最近加入了一个国际合作项目，这对我们的发展意义重大。
pinyin: Gōngsī zuìjìn jiāruìle yīgè guójì hézuò xiàngmù, zhè duì wǒmen de fāzhǎn yìyì zhòngdà.
en: The company recently joined an international collaboration project, which has major implications for our growth.

zh: 医生看病人。
pinyin: Yīshēng kàn bìngrén.
en: The doctor examines the patient.

zh: 医院里有很多病人。
pinyin: Yīyuàn lǐ yǒu hěnduō bìngrén.
en: There are many patients in the hospital.

zh: 因为天气冷，所以病人很多。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì lěng, suǒyǐ bìngrén hěnduō.
en: Because the weather is cold, there are lots of patients.

zh: 护士每天都要照顾许多病人的日常需求。
pinyin: Húshi měi tiān dōu yào zhàogu hěnduō bìngrén de rìcháng xūqiú.
en: Nurses have to care for many patients' daily needs every day.

zh: 虽然病人很着急出院，但医生认为还需要再观察。
pinyin: Suīrán bìngrén hěn zháojí chūyuàn, dàn yīshēng rènwéi háishi xūyào zài guānchá.
en: Although the patient is anxious to leave the hospital, the doctor thinks they need more observation.

zh: 这是一个案子。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè ànzi.
en: This is a case.

zh: 警察昨天处理了一个新案件。
pinyin: Jǐngchá zuótiān chǔlǐle yī gè xīn ànjiàn.
en: The police handled a new case yesterday.

zh: 虽然这个案件很复杂，但是警察还是找到了证据。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège ànjiàn hěn fùzá, dànshi jǐngchá háishi zhǎodàole zhèngjù.
en: Although the case was complicated, the police still found evidence.

zh: 律师为了赢得这个案件，花了很多时间研究相关法律。
pinyin: Lǜshī wèile yíngde zhège ànjiàn, huāle hěn duō shíjiān yánjiū xiāngguān fǎlǜ.
en: The lawyer spent a lot of time studying relevant laws in order to win the case.

zh: 这起诈骗案件涉及多个部门，需要进一步的深入调查和证人证言。
pinyin: Zhè qǐ zhàpiàn ànjiàn shèjí duō gè bùmén, xūyào jìnyībù de shēnrù diàochá hé zhèngrén zhènyán.
en: This fraud case involves multiple departments and requires further investigation and witness testimony.

zh: 这根香蕉很好吃。
pinyin: Zhè gēn xiāngjiāo hěn hǎochī.
en: This banana is really delicious.

zh: 我每天都用一根筷子吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān dōu yòng yī gēn kuàizi chīfàn.
en: I use a pair of chopsticks to eat every day.

zh: 因为这根绳子太短，所以我们没法用它。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè gēn shéngzi tài duǎn, suǒyǐ wǒmen méifǎ yòng tā.
en: Because this rope is too short, we can't use it.

zh: 虽然这根树很老，但它的根还是很强壮。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè gēn shù hěn lǎo, dàn tā de gēn háishi hěn qiángzhuàng.
en: Although this tree is old, its roots are still very strong.

zh: 问题的根源在于我们没有充分理解客户的真实需求。
pinyin: Wèntí de gēnyuán zàiyú wǒmen méiyǒu chōngfèn lǐjiě kèhù de zhēnshí xūqiú.
en: The root cause of the problem is that we didn't fully understand the customer's real needs.

zh: 狗吓我了。
pinyin: Gǒu xià wǒ le.
en: The dog scared me.

zh: 昨天晚上的声音吓了我一跳。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang de shēngyīn xiàle wǒ yī tiào.
en: The noise last night gave me quite a fright.

zh: 虽然他只是开玩笑，但还是吓到了很多人。
pinyin: Suīrán tā zhǐshì kāi wány笑, dàn háishi xiàdàole hěnduō rén.
en: Although he was just joking, he still scared a lot of people.

zh: 在超市里突然停电吓坏了购物的顾客，大家都很害怕。
pinyin: Zài chāoshì lǐ túrán tíngdiàn xiàhuàile gòuwù de gùkè, dàjiā dōu hěn hàipà.
en: When the power suddenly went out in the supermarket, it really frightened the shoppers, and everyone was quite scared.

zh: 他经常用恐怖故事吓唬孩子们，结果反而把自己吓出了一身冷汗。
pinyin: Tā jīngcháng yòng kǒngbù gùshì xiàhu háizǐmen, jiéguǒ fǎn'ér bǎ zìjǐ xiàchūle yī shēn lěnghàn.
en: He often tried to frighten the kids with horror stories, but ended up scaring himself so badly he broke out in a cold sweat.

zh: 医生治疗病人。
pinyin: Yīshēng zhìliáo bìngrén.
en: The doctor treats the patient.

zh: 我昨天去医院治疗牙齿。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān qù yīyuàn zhìliáo yáchǐ.
en: I went to the hospital yesterday to have my teeth treated.

zh: 因为感冒很严重，所以需要去医生那里治疗。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gǎnmào hěn yánzhòng, suǒyǐ xūyào qù yīshēng nàlǐ zhìliáo.
en: Because the cold was serious, I had to go to the doctor for treatment.

zh: 这种病用新的方法治疗效果比较好。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bìng yòng xīn de fāngfǎ zhìliáo xiàoguǒ bǐjiào hǎo.
en: This illness responds better to treatment with the new method.

zh: 及时的治疗对患者的康复起着非常重要的作用。
pinyin: Jíshí de zhìliáo duì huànzhě de kāngfù qǐzhe fēicháng zhòngyào de zuòyòng.
en: Timely treatment plays a crucial role in the patient's recovery.

zh: 请原谅我。
pinyin: Qǐng yuányuàn my.
en: Please forgive me.

zh: 我迟到了，请原谅我。
pinyin: Wǒ chídào le, qǐng yuányuàn wǒ.
en: I was late—please forgive me.

zh: 因为我昨天很忙，所以没有给你打电话，希望你原谅我。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ zuótiān hěn máng, suǒyǐ méiyǒu gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà, xīwàng nǐ yuányuàn wǒ.
en: I was really busy yesterday and couldn't call you—I hope you'll forgive me.

zh: 虽然他说了难听的话，但我还是决定原谅他，因为他真心道歉了。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shuō le nánt‌ingde huà, dàn wǒ háishi juéding yuányuàn tā, yīnwèi tā zhēnxīn dàoqiàn le.
en: Even though he said hurtful things, I decided to forgive him because he genuinely apologized.

zh: 同事无意中伤害了我，后来意识到自己的错误，我觉得没什么理由不原谅他。
pinyin: Tóngshì wúyìzhōng shānghài le wǒ, hòulái yìshí dào zìjǐ de cuòwù, wǒ juéde méi shénme lǐyóu bu yuányuàn tā.
en: My coworker unintentionally hurt me, and later realized their mistake—I didn't really see any reason not to forgive them.

zh: 他的行为很好。
pinyin: Tā de xíngwéi hěn hǎo.
en: His behavior is very good.

zh: 小孩子的行为有时候很奇怪。
pinyin: Xiǎo háizi de xíngwéi yǒushíhou hěn qíguài.
en: Young children's behavior is sometimes quite strange.

zh: 虽然他说得好，但是他的行为不太好。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shuō de hǎo, dànshì tā de xíngwéi búcì hǎo.
en: Although he speaks well, his actions aren't very good.

zh: 我们需要改正那些不礼貌的行为，因为它影响别人。
pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào gǎizhèng nàxiē búlǐmào de xíngwéi, yīnwèi tā yǐngxiǎng biérén.
en: We need to correct impolite behaviors because they affect others.

zh: 学生的行为问题通常反映了家庭教育和学校管理的差距。
pinyin: Xuésheng de xíngwéi wèntí tōngcháng fǎnyìng le jiātíng jiàoyù hé xuéxiào guǎnlǐ de chājù.
en: Student behavior problems typically reflect gaps between home education and school management.

zh: 苹果比较甜。
pinyin: Píngguǒ bǐjiào tián.
en: Apples are quite sweet.

zh: 今天比较冷，我穿了厚衣服。
pinyin: Jīntiān bǐjiào lěng, wǒ chuānle厚 yīfu.
en: It's rather cold today, so I put on thick clothes.

zh: 虽然这个餐厅比较贵，但是食物很好吃。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège cāntīng bǐjiào guì, dànshi shíwù hěn hǎochī.
en: Although this restaurant is fairly expensive, the food is really delicious.

zh: 他的中文水平比较高，可以看懂复杂的文章。
pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng bǐjiào gāo, kěyǐ kàndǒng fùzá de wénzhāng.
en: His Chinese level is quite advanced; he can understand complex articles.

zh: 与其他城市相比，这个地方的生活成本比较低，吸引了很多年轻人。
pinyin: Yǔ qítā chéngshì xiāngbǐ, zhège dìfang de shēnghuó chéngběn bǐjiào dī, xīyǐnle hěnduō niánqīngrén.
en: Compared to other cities, the cost of living here is relatively low, which has attracted many young people.

zh: 我在河边玩。
pinyin: Wǒ zài hébiān wán.
en: I'm playing by the river.

zh: 妈妈在厨房边做饭边唱歌。
pinyin: Māma zài chúfáng biān zuòfàn biān chànggē.
en: Mom is cooking and singing at the same time in the kitchen.

zh: 因为天气很热，所以孩子们都在树边乘凉。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn rè, suǒyǐ háizimen dōu zài shù biān chéngliáng.
en: Because it was so hot, the children all went to cool off by the trees.

zh: 虽然这个地方边上有点吵，但是房租便宜，所以我们决定租了。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège dìfang biānshang yǒudiǎn chāo, dànshì fángzū piányi, suǒyǐ wǒmen juédìng zūle.
en: Although it's a bit noisy around the edges of this area, the rent is cheap, so we decided to take it.

zh: 他一边听着音乐一边工作，效率反而比平时高得多。
pinyin: Tā yībīan tīngzhe yīnyuè yībīan gōngzuò, xiàolǜ fǎn'ér bǐ píngshí gāo de duō.
en: He listens to music while working, and his productivity is actually much higher than usual.

zh: 我有双鞋。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu shuāng xié.
en: I have a pair of shoes.

zh: 他买了双新的黑色袜子。
pinyin: Tā mǎi le shuāng xīn de hēisè wàzi.
en: He bought a new pair of black socks.

zh: 虽然这双手套很贵，但是质量很好。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè shuāng shǒutào hěn guì, dànshì zhìliàng hěn hǎo.
en: Although this pair of gloves is expensive, the quality is really good.

zh: 因为他的双腿受伤了，所以现在走路很困难。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā de shuāng tuǐ shòushāng le, suǒyǐ xiànzài zǒulù hěn kùnnan.
en: Because both of his legs are injured, he finds it very difficult to walk now.

zh: 她用双手紧紧抱住孩子，眼睛里闪着泪光。
pinyin: Tā yòng shuāng shǒu jǐnjǐn bàozhu háizi, yǎnjing lǐ shǎnzhe lèiguāng.
en: She held the child tightly in both arms, her eyes glistening with tears.

zh: 他们的婚礼很好。
pinyin: Tāmen de hunyǐ hěn hǎo.
en: Their wedding was really nice.

zh: 我们下个月去参加婚礼。
pinyin: Wǒmen xiàge yuè qù cānjiā hunyǐ.
en: We're going to a wedding next month.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以婚礼在外面举行。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ hunyǐ zài wàimiàn jǔxíng.
en: Because the weather was nice, the wedding was held outside.

zh: 虽然婚礼的准备很复杂，但他们还是很开心。
pinyin: Suīrán hunyǐ de zhǔnbèi hěn fùzá, dàn tāmen háishi hěn kāixīn.
en: Although planning the wedding was complicated, they were still really happy about it.

zh: 他们花了不少钱筹办婚礼，希望一切顺利。
pinyin: Tāmen huāle búshǎo qián chóubàn hunyǐ, xīwàng yīqiè shùnlì.
en: They spent quite a bit preparing for the wedding and hope everything goes smoothly.

zh: 我弟弟很小。
pinyin: Wǒ dìdi hěn xiǎo.
en: My little brother is very young.

zh: 我弟弟每天都吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ dìdi měitiān dōu chī mǐfàn.
en: My little brother eats rice every day.

zh: 虽然我弟弟很调皮，但是我很喜欢他。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ dìdi hěn tiáopí, dànshì wǒ hěn xǐhuān tā.
en: Although my little brother is quite mischievous, I really like him.

zh: 因为我弟弟在学校表现不好，所以父母给他报名了辅导班。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ dìdi zài xuéxiào biǎoxiàn búhǎo, suǒyǐ fùmǔ gěi tā bàomíng le fǔdǎobān.
en: Because my little brother wasn't doing well at school, my parents enrolled him in a tutoring class.

zh: 我弟弟虽然年纪小，但他的想法有时候比我们都周到。
pinyin: Wǒ dìdi suīrán niánjì xiǎo, dàn tā de xiǎngfǎ yǒushíhou bǐ wǒmen dōu zhōudào.
en: My little brother, though young, sometimes thinks things through more carefully than we do.

zh: 学校组织了一个活动。
pinyin: Xuéxiào zǔzhī le yīgè huódòng.
en: The school organized an activity.

zh: 昨天公司组织员工去旅游。
pinyin: Zuótiān gōngsī zǔzhī yuángōng qù lǚyóu.
en: Yesterday the company organized employees to go on a trip.

zh: 因为疫情的原因，组织者决定推迟这个会议。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yìqíng de yuányīn, zǔzhīzhě juéding tuīchíle zhège huìyì.
en: Because of the pandemic, the organizers decided to postpone the meeting.

zh: 虽然组织这次活动花费了很多时间，但效果很不错。
pinyin: Suīrán zǔzhī zhè cì huódòng huāfèi le hěnduō shíjiān, dàn xiàoguǒ hěn búcuò.
en: Although organizing this event took a lot of time, the results turned out really well.

zh: 他凭借在公益组织的丰富经验，成功申请到了新的项目资金。
pinyin: Tā píngjiè zài gōngyì zǔzhī de fēngfù jīngyàn, chéngōng shēnqǐng dào le xīn de xiàngmù zījīn.
en: Drawing on his extensive experience with nonprofit organizations, he successfully secured funding for a new project.

zh: 我想想吃什么。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngxiang chī shénme.
en: Let me think about what to eat.

zh: 明天去公园吗？我想想再告诉你。
pinyin: Míngtiān qù gōngyuán ma? Wǒ xiǎngxiang zài gàosu nǐ.
en: Will you go to the park tomorrow? Let me think about it and I'll tell you.

zh: 虽然很累，但我想想还是应该完成这个工作。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn léi, dàn wǒ xiǎngxiang háishi yīnggāi wánchéng zhège gōngzuò.
en: Even though I'm tired, when I think about it, I should probably finish this work.

zh: 他最近的决定让我很困惑，我需要好好想想为什么他会这样做。
pinyin: Tā zuìjìn de juédìng ràng wǒ hěn kùnhuò, wǒ xūyào hǎohāo xiǎngxiang wèishéme tā huì zhèyàng zuò.
en: His recent decision has confused me—I really need to think hard about why he would do this.

zh: 关于这个项目的风险，我们应该仔细想想，不能盲目投资。
pinyin: Guānyú zhège xiàngmù de fēngxiǎn, wǒmen yīnggāi zīxì xiǎngxiang, búnéng mánglù tóuzī.
en: We should think carefully about the risks of this project and not invest blindly.

zh: 我们明天见面。
pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān jiànmiàn.
en: We're meeting tomorrow.

zh: 你下午有时间见面吗？
pinyin: Nǐ xiàwǔ yǒu shíjiān jiànmiàn ma?
en: Do you have time to meet this afternoon?

zh: 因为天气不好，我们决定在家里见面。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, wǒmen juéding zài jiāli jiànmiàn.
en: Because the weather was bad, we decided to meet at home instead.

zh: 虽然我们很久没见面，但是一见面就有说不完的话。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen hěnjiǔ méi jiànmiàn, búshì yī jiànmiàn jiù yǒu shuōbuwan de huà.
en: Even though we hadn't seen each other in ages, we had endless things to talk about the moment we met.

zh: 这次见面让我们意识到保持联系的重要性。
pinyin: Zhè cì jiànmiàn ràng wǒmen yìshi dào bǎochíng liánxì de zhòngyào xìng.
en: This meeting made us realize how important it is to stay in touch.

zh: 我经常吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ jīngcháng chī mǐfàn.
en: I eat rice often.

zh: 她经常在公园里散步。
pinyin: Tā jīngcháng zài gōngyuán lǐ sǎnbù.
en: She often takes walks in the park.

zh: 因为工作很忙，他经常加班到很晚。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò hěn máng, tā jīngcháng jiābān dào hěn wǎn.
en: Because his work is busy, he often works late into the evening.

zh: 虽然经常下雨，但城市的空气质量还是很好。
pinyin: Suīrán jīngcháng xiàyǔ, dàn chéngshì de kōngqì zhìliàng háishi hěn hǎo.
en: Although it rains frequently, the city's air quality is still quite good.

zh: 年轻人经常为了追求梦想而忽略了身体健康。
pinyin: Niánqīngrén jīngcháng wèile zhuīqiú梦想 ér hūlüèle shēntǐ jiànkāng.
en: Young people often neglect their health in pursuit of their dreams.

zh: 这是一个城市。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè chéngshì.
en: This is a city.

zh: 我喜欢住在城市里。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zhù zài chéngshì lǐ.
en: I like living in the city.

zh: 因为城市有很多商店，所以我经常去那里。
pinyin: Yīnwèi chéngshì yǒu hěnduō shāngdiàn, suǒyǐ wǒ jīngcháng qù nàlǐ.
en: Because the city has many shops, I often go there.

zh: 虽然城市很繁忙，但是人们喜欢在这里工作和生活。
pinyin: Suīrán chéngshì hěn fánmáng, dànshì rénmen xǐhuān zài zhèlǐ gōngzuò hé shēnghuó.
en: Although the city is very busy, people like to work and live here.

zh: 随着科技发展，越来越多的城市开始使用智能交通系统。
pinyin: Suízhe kējì fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuè duō de chéngshì kāishǐ shǐyòng zhìnéng jiāotōng xìtǒng.
en: As technology advances, more and more cities are beginning to adopt smart transportation systems.

zh: 老板卖咖啡。
pinyin: Lǎobǎn mài kāfēi.
en: The boss sells coffee.

zh: 我每天都去老板的店里吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān dōu qù lǎobǎn de diàn lǐ chīfàn.
en: I eat at the boss's restaurant every day.

zh: 因为生意很好，所以老板决定招聘新员工。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shēngyì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn juédìng zhāopìn xīn yuángōng.
en: Because business is good, the boss decided to hire new staff.

zh: 虽然老板很忙，但他仍然很关心每个员工的工作。
pinyin: Suīrán lǎobǎn hěn máng, dàn tā réngránhěn guānxin měi ge yuángōng de gōngzuò.
en: Although the boss is very busy, he still cares about every employee's work.

zh: 这位老板为人爽快，从不为难员工，所以大家都愿意给他卖力。
pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎobǎn wéi rén shuǎngkuai, cóng bu wéi nàn yuángōng, suǒyǐ dàjiā dōu yuànyì gěi tā màilì.
en: This boss is straightforward and never makes things difficult for his staff, so everyone is willing to work hard for him.

zh: 我们合作做饭。
pinyin: Wǒmen hézuò zuòfàn.
en: We're cooking together.

zh: 明天我和你合作做这个项目。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ hé nǐ hézuò zuò zhège xiàngmù.
en: Tomorrow you and I will work together on this project.

zh: 因为我们合作，所以工作完成得很快。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒmen hézuò, suǒyǐ gōngzuò wánchéng de hěn kuài.
en: Because we're cooperating, the work gets done really quickly.

zh: 两家公司决定合作，共同开发新的产品。
pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī juéding hézuò, gòngtóng kāifā xīn de chǎnpǐn.
en: The two companies decided to partner together to develop a new product.

zh: 只有各部门密切合作，才能有效提高工作效率。
pinyin: Zhǐyǒu gè bùmén mìqiè hézuò, cáinéng yǒuxiào tígāo gōngzuò xiàoxiàolǜ.
en: Only through close cooperation between departments can we really improve work efficiency.

zh: 我来到学校。
pinyin: Wǒ lái dào xuéxiào.
en: I arrived at school.

zh: 昨天我来到了一家新餐厅。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ lái dào le yī jiā xīn cāntīng.
en: Yesterday I went to a new restaurant.

zh: 因为下雨，我迟到了来到办公室。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒ chídào le lái dào bàngōngshì.
en: Because it was raining, I arrived late at the office.

zh: 虽然飞行很累，但我们终于来到了目的地。
pinyin: Suīrán fēixíng hěn lèi, dàn wǒmen zhōngyú lái dào le mùdì dì.
en: Although the flight was tiring, we finally reached our destination.

zh: 自从我来到这个城市工作以后，生活质量明显提高了。
pinyin: Zìcóng wǒ lái dào zhège chéngshì gōngzuò yǐhòu, shēnghuó zhìliàng míngxiǎn tígāo le.
en: Ever since I came to work in this city, my quality of life has noticeably improved.

zh: 一会儿吃饭。
pinyin: Yīhuǐr chīfàn.
en: We'll eat in a moment.

zh: 妈妈说一会儿就回家。
pinyin: Māma shuō yīhuǐr jiù huíjiā.
en: Mom said she'll be home in a little while.

zh: 虽然现在很忙，但是一会儿就有时间了。
pinyin: Suīrán xiànzài hěn máng, dànshì yīhuǐr jiù yǒu shíjiān le.
en: Even though we're busy right now, we'll have free time soon.

zh: 他先去开会，一会儿回来的时候我们再讨论这个问题。
pinyin: Tā xiān qù kāihuì, yīhuǐr huílái de shíhou wǒmen zài tǎolùn zhège wèntí.
en: He's going to a meeting first, and we'll discuss this issue when he gets back shortly.

zh: 别着急，他们的反馈一会儿就会发过来，到时候咱们再做决定。
pinyin: Bié zhháojí, tāmen de fǎnkuì yīhuǐr jiù huì fāguòlái, dàoshíhou zánmen zài zuò juéhuà.
en: Don't rush—their feedback will come through any minute now, and then we can make a call.

zh: 房间很乱。
pinyin: Fángjiān hěn luàn.
en: The room is messy.

zh: 早上我很忙，房间就乱了。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ hěn máng, fángjiān jiù luàn le.
en: This morning I was busy, so the room got messy.

zh: 因为小孩在玩，所以客厅变得很乱。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiǎohái zài wán, suǒyǐ kètīng biàn de hěn luàn.
en: Because the kids were playing, the living room became really chaotic.

zh: 他总是把东西乱放，家里就显得特别乱。
pinyin: Tā zǒngshì bǎ dōngxi luàn fàng, jiālǐ jiù xiǎn de tèbié luàn.
en: He always puts things down randomly, which makes the whole house look especially cluttered.

zh: 工作太忙乱了，我需要好好整理一下思路。
pinyin: Gōngzuò tài mángluàn le, wǒ xūyào hǎohāo zhěnglǐ yīxià sīlù.
en: Work has been chaotic and messy lately—I need to take some time to get my thoughts in order.

zh: 这个词很简单。
pinyin: Zhège cí hěn jiǎndān.
en: This word is very easy.

zh: 我昨天学了十个新词。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān xuéle shí ge xīn cí.
en: I learned ten new words yesterday.

zh: 虽然这个词不常用，但是它的意思很重要。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège cí bù chángyòng, dànshì tā de yìsi hěn zhòngyào.
en: Although this word isn't commonly used, its meaning is quite important.

zh: 在学习汉语的时候，掌握常用词很关键。
pinyin: Zài xuéxí Hànyǔ de shíhou, zhǎngwò chángyòng cí hěn guānjiàn.
en: When learning Chinese, grasping common words is really crucial.

zh: 他用词不当导致了误会，后来才意识到这个问题。
pinyin: Tā yòngyòng cí búdàng dǎozhì le wùhuì, hòulái cái yìshídào zhège wèntí.
en: His poor word choice caused a misunderstanding, and only later did he realize the problem.

zh: 你尔后要听话。
pinyin: Nǐ ěrhòu yào tīnghuà.
en: From now on, you need to listen and behave.

zh: 他说你尔虞我诈，我不相信。
pinyin: Tā shuō nǐ ěryú wǒzhà, wǒ búxiāngxìn.
en: He said you were being deceptive, but I don't believe it.

zh: 虽然他很聪明，但有时候尔尔不够专心。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn cōngmíng, dàn yǒushíhou ěrěr búgòu zhuānxīn.
en: Although he's smart, sometimes he's just not focused enough.

zh: 在那个会议上，他们相互尔虞我诈，最后谁都没得到想要的。
pinyin: Zài nàge huìyì shang, tāmen xiānghù ěryú wǒzhà, zuìhòu shéi dōu méi dé到 xiǎngyào de.
en: At that meeting, they were constantly scheming against each other, so in the end nobody got what they wanted.

zh: 商业谈判中双方尔虞我诈是常见的，关键是要保持底线。
pinyin: Shāngyè tánpàn zhōng shuāngfāng ěryú wǒzhà shì chángjiàn de, guānjiàn shì yào bǎochíng dǐxiàn.
en: In business negotiations, mutual deception between parties is common, but the key is to maintain your principles.

zh: 这个苹果超大。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ chāo dà.
en: This apple is super big.

zh: 昨天我超累,睡了很久。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ chāo lèi, shuìle hěn jiǔ.
en: I was exhausted yesterday, so I slept for a long time.

zh: 虽然票很贵,但是超值得买。
pinyin: Suīrán piào hěn guì, dànshì chāo zhíde mǎi.
en: Even though the ticket is expensive, it's totally worth buying.

zh: 他的工作经验超过十年,所以能力特别强。
pinyin: Tā de gōngzuò jīngyàn chāoguò shí nián, suǒyǐ nénglidx tèbié qiáng.
en: His work experience exceeds ten years, so his abilities are exceptional.

zh: 这款手机的性能和价格都超出我们的预期,难怪销售额这么高。
pinyin: Zhè kuǎn shǒujī de xìngnéng hé jiàgé dōu chāochū wǒmen de yùqī, nánguài xiāoshòu'é zhème gāo.
en: This phone's performance and price both exceeded our expectations—no wonder its sales are so high.

zh: 这两个苹果差不多。
pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge píngguǒ chàbuduō.
en: These two apples are about the same.

zh: 他和我的年纪差不多大。
pinyin: Tā hé wǒ de niánjì chàbuduō dà.
en: He's roughly the same age as me.

zh: 虽然这两家餐厅菜不一样，但味道差不多。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè liǎng jiā cāntīng cài búyīyàng, dàn wèidào chàbuduō.
en: Even though these two restaurants have different dishes, they taste pretty much the same.

zh: 因为物价上升了，所以现在和去年的生活费差不多贵。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wùjià shàngshēng le, suǒyǐ xiànzài hé qùnián de shēnghuófèi chàbuduō guì.
en: Since prices have gone up, living expenses are now about as expensive as they were last year.

zh: 这份工作的薪水虽然不错，但压力和前一份差不多大，我需要好好考虑。
pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò de xīnshuǐ suīrán búcuò, dàn yālì hé qián yī fèn chàbuduō dà, wǒ xūyào hǎohāo kǎolǜ.
en: The salary for this job is decent, but the pressure is about as intense as my last position, so I need to think it over carefully.

zh: 我有一支笔。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī zhī bǐ.
en: I have a pen.

zh: 妈妈买了三支红色的花。
pinyin: Māma mǎile sān zhī hóngsè de huā.
en: Mom bought three red flowers.

zh: 因为他喜欢唱歌，所以买了一支麦克风。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā xǐhuān chànggē, suǒyǐ mǎile yī zhī màikèfēng.
en: Because he loves singing, he bought a microphone.

zh: 公司今年支持了十几支创业团队的发展。
pinyin: Gōngsī jīnnián zhīchīle shí jǐ zhī chuàngyè tuánduì de fāzhǎn.
en: This year the company supported the development of over a dozen startup teams.

zh: 虽然这支队伍人数不多，但他们的执行力确实令人印象深刻。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè zhī duìwu rénshù búduō, dàn tāmen de zhíxíngglì quèshí lìngrén yìnxiàng shēnkè.
en: Although this team is small in numbers, their execution ability is genuinely impressive.

zh: 我老婆叫小红。
pinyin: Wǒ lǎopo jiào Xiǎohóng.
en: My wife's name is Xiaohong.

zh: 昨天我老婆买了新衣服。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ lǎopo mǎile xīn yīfu.
en: Yesterday my wife bought some new clothes.

zh: 因为老婆喜欢吃鱼，所以我经常买鱼。
pinyin: Yīnwèi lǎopo xǐhuān chī yú, suǒyǐ wǒ jīngcháng mǎi yú.
en: Because my wife likes eating fish, I often buy it for her.

zh: 我老婆虽然工作很忙，但是还是坚持运动。
pinyin: Wǒ lǎopo suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, búguò háishi jiānchíyùn dòng.
en: Although my wife's work is very busy, she still insists on exercising.

zh: 上次出差回来，老婆已经把家里收拾得干干净净。
pinyin: Shàng cì chūchāi huílái, lǎopo yǐjīng bǎ jiāli shōushi de gānganjìngjìng.
en: When I got back from my last business trip, my wife had already tidied up the whole house perfectly.

zh: 这是城市中心。
pinyin: Zhè shì chéngshì zhōngxīn.
en: This is the city center.

zh: 我们今天去商业中心买东西。
pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān qù shāngyè zhōngxīn mǎi dōngxi.
en: We're going to the shopping center today to buy things.

zh: 虽然中心很远，但是那里的服务很好。
pinyin: Suīrán zhōngxīn hěn yuǎn, dànshì nàlǐ de fúwù hěn hǎo.
en: Although the center is far away, the service there is really good.

zh: 公司把工作重心放在开发新产品上。
pinyin: Gōngsī bǎ gōngzuò zhòngxīn fàngzài kāifā xīn chǎnpǐn shang.
en: The company is focusing its work on developing new products.

zh: 随着城市发展，人口中心逐渐向郊区转移。
pinyin: Suízhe chéngshì fāzhǎn, rénkǒu zhōngxīn zhújiàn xiàng jiāoqū zhuǎnyí.
en: As the city develops, the population center is gradually shifting toward the suburbs.

zh: 狗很可怕。
pinyin: Gǒu hěn kěpà.
en: Dogs are scary.

zh: 晚上一个人走路很可怕。
pinyin: Wǎnshang yīgè rén zǒulù hěn kěpà.
en: Walking alone at night is really frightening.

zh: 因为天气不好，所以坐飞机的时候感觉很可怕。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, suǒyǐ zuò fēijī de shíhou gǎnjuéde hěn kěpà.
en: Because the weather was bad, I found flying really scary.

zh: 他说自己害怕失业，觉得失去工作是最可怕的事情。
pinyin: Tā shuō zìjǐ hàipà shīyè, juéde shīqù gōngzuò shì zuì kěpà de shìqing.
en: He said he's afraid of unemployment—he thinks losing his job would be the worst thing.

zh: 与其说那次事故可怕，不如说我们没有做好充分的准备工作。
pinyin: Yǔqī shuō nà cì shìgù kěpà, búrúshuō wǒmen méiyǒu zuòhǎo chōngfèn de zhǔnbèi gōngzuò.
en: Rather than saying that accident was frightening, it's more that we weren't adequately prepared.

zh: 我有一支笔。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī zhī bǐ.
en: I have a pen.

zh: 今天我用黑笔写了作业。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ yòng hēi bǐ xiěle zuòyè.
en: Today I did my homework with a black pen.

zh: 因为我的笔丢了，所以我用铅笔写字。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ de bǐ diūle, suǒyǐ wǒ yòng qiānbǐ xiězì.
en: Because I lost my pen, I'm writing with a pencil instead.

zh: 这支笔写得很流畅，虽然有点贵，但是质量特别好。
pinyin: Zhè zhī bǐ xiěde hěn liúchàng, suīrán yǒudiǎn guì, dànshi zhìliàng tèbié hǎo.
en: This pen writes really smoothly; it's a bit pricey, but the quality is exceptional.

zh: 要想写出好文章，一支好笔能帮上不少忙，但更关键的还是要多读多思考。
pinyin: Yào xiǎng xiěchū hǎo wénzhāng, yī zhī hǎo bǐ néng bāngshang bu shǎo máng, dàn gèng guānjiàn de háishi yào duō dú duō sīkǎo.
en: A good pen can definitely help you write better articles, but what really matters is reading widely and thinking critically.

zh: 杯子满了。
pinyin: Bēizi mǎn le.
en: The cup is full.

zh: 妈妈买了满满的一袋水果。
pinyin: Māma mǎi le mǎnman de yī dài shuǐguǒ.
en: Mom bought a whole bag completely full of fruit.

zh: 因为今天生意很好，老板的脸上满是笑容。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān shēngyì hěn hǎo, lǎobǎn de liǎnshang mǎnshi xiào容.
en: Because business was good today, the boss's face was full of smiles.

zh: 虽然才工作两年，但他已经满足于现在的生活。
pinyin: Suīrán cái gōngzuò liǎng nián, dàn tā yǐjīng mǎnzú yú xiànzài de shēnghuó.
en: Although he's only been working for two years, he's already satisfied with his current life.

zh: 他对这个项目的进展满怀信心，相信能在期限内完成。
pinyin: Tā duì zhège xiàngmù de jìnzhǎn mǎnhuái xìnxin, xiāngxìn néng zài qīxiàn nèi wánchéng.
en: He's full of confidence about the project's progress and believes it can be finished on time.

zh: 这是假的。
pinyin: Zhè shì jiǎ de.
en: This is fake.

zh: 他说假话，我不相信他。
pinyin: Tā shuō jiǎhuà, wǒ bù xiāngxìn tā.
en: He's lying, so I don't believe him.

zh: 虽然这个包很便宜，但是质量很假。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège bāo hěn piányi, dànshì zhìliàng hěn jiǎ.
en: Although this bag is cheap, the quality is really poor/fake.

zh: 他们卖假货已经被警察抓住了。
pinyin: Tāmen mài jiǎhuò yǐjīng bèi jǐngchá zhuāzhù le.
en: They've already been caught by police for selling counterfeit goods.

zh: 网上有很多假信息，我们需要学会辨别真假。
pinyin: Wǎngshang yǒu hěnduō jiǎ xìnxī, wǒmen xūyào xuéhuì biànbié zhēnjiǎ.
en: There's a lot of misinformation online, so we need to learn how to tell fact from fiction.

zh: 他明显很高兴。
pinyin: Tā míngxiǎn hěn gāoxìng.
en: He's clearly very happy.

zh: 今天天气明显比昨天冷。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì míngxiǎn bǐ zuótiān lěng.
en: The weather today is noticeably colder than yesterday.

zh: 虽然她没说话，但她的表情明显很不高兴。
pinyin: Suīrán tā méi shuōhuà, dàn tā de biǎoqíng míngxiǎn hěn búgāoxìng.
en: Although she didn't say anything, her expression clearly showed she wasn't happy.

zh: 经过这次训练以后，他的英语水平明显提高了很多。
pinyin: Jīngguò zhè cì xùnliàn yǐhòu, tā de yīngyǔ shuǐpíng míngxiǎn tígāo le hěnduō.
en: After this round of training, his English level has clearly improved significantly.

zh: 随着城市发展，交通问题变得越来越明显，成为市民关注的焦点。
pinyin: Suízhe chéngshì fāzhǎn, jiāotōng wèntí biàn de yuèláiyuè míngxiǎn, chéngwéi shìmín guānzhù de jiāodiǎn.
en: As the city develops, traffic problems have become increasingly apparent and are now a focal point of public concern.

zh: 我们研究中文。
pinyin: Wǒmen yánjiū zhōngwén.
en: We study Chinese.

zh: 昨天我研究了一个有趣的问题。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ yánjiūle yīgè yǒuqù de wèntí.
en: Yesterday I looked into an interesting question.

zh: 因为时间不够，所以我还在研究这个话题。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shíjiān búgòu, suǒyǐ wǒ háizài yánjiū zhège huàtí.
en: Because I don't have enough time, I'm still researching this topic.

zh: 研究这些数据需要花费很多精力，但结果很值得。
pinyin: Yánjiū zhèxiē shùjù xūyào huāfèi hěnduō jīnglì, dàn jiéguǒ hěn zhíde.
en: Analyzing this data takes a lot of effort, but the results are worthwhile.

zh: 专家们深入研究了这个现象，为今后的工作提供了宝贵参考。
pinyin: Zhuānjiāmen shēnyù yánjiūle zhège xiànxiàng, wèi jīnhòu de gōngzuò tígōngle báoguì cānkǎo.
en: Experts conducted an in-depth investigation into the phenomenon, providing valuable reference material for future work.

zh: 我意识到了。
pinyin: Wǒ yìshí dàole.
en: I realized it.

zh: 昨天我才意识到这个问题。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ cái yìshí dào zhège wèntí.
en: Only yesterday did I become aware of this problem.

zh: 虽然他很年轻，但意识很成熟。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn niánqīng, dàn yìshí hěn chéngshú.
en: Although he's young, his awareness is quite mature.

zh: 直到出了事故，他才意识到安全的重要性。
pinyin: Zhídào chūle shìgù, tā cái yìshí dào ānquán de zhòngyàoxìng.
en: Not until the accident happened did he realize how important safety is.

zh: 现代人需要提高环保意识，才能应对日益严峻的气候问题。
pinyin: Xiàndài rén xūyào tígāo huánbǎo yìshí, cáinéng yìngduì rìyì yánnjùn de qìhòu wèntí.
en: Modern people need to raise their environmental awareness in order to address the increasingly serious climate challenges.

zh: 附近有一家餐厅。
pinyin: Fùjìn yǒu yī jiā cāntīng.
en: There's a restaurant nearby.

zh: 我家附近有一个公园和一所学校。
pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu yī ge gōngyuán hé yī suǒ xuéxiào.
en: Near my home there's a park and a school.

zh: 虽然附近很吵，但是我们还是喜欢住在这里。
pinyin: Suīrán fùjìn hěn chāo, dànshì wǒmen háishi xǐhuān zhù zài zhèlǐ.
en: Although it's noisy around here, we still like living in this area.

zh: 因为在附近工作，我每天骑自行车上班只需要十分钟。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zài fùjìn gōngzuò, wǒ měi tiān qī zìxíngchē shàngbān zhǐ xūyào shí fēnzhōng.
en: Since I work nearby, it only takes me ten minutes to bike to the office every day.

zh: 我们找了很久才在附近找到一家性价比不错的小旅馆。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhǎole hěn jiǔ cái zài fùjìn zhǎodào yī jiā xìngjià bǐ búcuò de xiǎo lǚguǎn.
en: We searched for a while before finding a small inn nearby with decent value for money.

zh: 他是同性恋。
pinyin: Tā shì tóngxìngliàn.
en: He is gay.

zh: 我的朋友是同性恋，他很开心。
pinyin: Wǒ de péngyou shì tóngxìngliàn, tā hěn kāixīn.
en: My friend is gay, and he's very happy.

zh: 虽然有些人不理解，但同性恋应该被尊重。
pinyin: Suīrán yǒuxiē rén bù lǐjiě, dàn tóngxìngliàn yīnggāi bèi zunzhòng.
en: Although some people don't understand it, gay people deserve respect.

zh: 很多国家已经承认同性恋者的婚姻权利。
pinyin: Hěnduō guójiā yǐjīng chèngrèn tóngxìngliànzhě de hunyīn quánlì.
en: Many countries have already recognized marriage rights for gay people.

zh: 关于同性恋的看法因人而异，但法律应保护所有人的基本权益。
pinyin: Guānyú tóngxìngliàn de kànfǎ yīn rén éryì, dàn fǎlǜ yīng bǎohù suǒyǒu rén de jīběn quányì.
en: Views on homosexuality vary from person to person, but the law should protect everyone's basic rights.

zh: 对不起，打扰你了。
pinyin: Duìbùqǐ, dǎrǎo nǐ le.
en: Sorry for bothering you.

zh: 我很抱歉打扰你的工作。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn bàoqiàn dǎrǎo nǐ de gōngzuò.
en: I'm really sorry to interrupt your work.

zh: 虽然很晚了，但我还是想打扰你一下。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn wǎn le, dàn wǒ háishi xiǎng dǎrǎo nǐ yīxià.
en: Even though it's late, I still need to bother you for a moment.

zh: 如果我的问题打扰了你的计划，请告诉我。
pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒ de wèntí dǎrǎo le nǐ de jìhuà, qǐng gàosu wǒ.
en: If my questions have disrupted your plans, please let me know.

zh: 我不想总是打扰你，但这件事确实需要你的建议。
pinyin: Wǒ búxiǎng zǒngshi dǎrǎo nǐ, dàn zhè jiàn shì quèshí xūyào nǐ de jiànyì.
en: I don't want to keep pestering you, but I really do need your advice on this matter.

zh: 祝你好运！
pinyin: Zhù nǐ hǎoyùn!
en: Good luck!

zh: 明天考试，我希望你好运。
pinyin: Míngtiān kǎoshì, wǒ xīwàng nǐ hǎoyùn.
en: You have an exam tomorrow, and I hope you have good luck.

zh: 虽然你很紧张，但我相信你会好运。
pinyin: Suīrán nǐ hěn jǐnzhāng, dàn wǒ xiāngxìn nǐ huì hǎoyùn.
en: Even though you're nervous, I believe you'll have good luck.

zh: 面试的时候紧张是正常的，希望你好运。
pinyin: Miànshì de shíhou jǐnzhāng shì zhèngcháng de, xīwàng nǐ hǎoyùn.
en: It's normal to be nervous during an interview; I hope things go well for you.

zh: 虽然竞争很激烈，但只要你认真准备，就一定会好运。
pinyin: Suīrán jìngjìng hěn jīliè, dàn zhǐyào nǐ rènzhēn zhǔnbèi, jiù yídìng huì hǎoyùn.
en: The competition is fierce, but as long as you prepare seriously, luck will definitely be on your side.

zh: 警察找到了线索。
pinyin: Jǐngchá zhǎodàole xiànsuǒ.
en: The police found a clue.

zh: 昨天我发现了一条重要的线索。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ fāxiànle yī tiáo zhònyào de xiànsuǒ.
en: Yesterday I discovered an important clue.

zh: 因为没有线索，所以警察找不到那个人。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu xiànsuǒ, suǒyǐ jǐngchá zhǎobudào nàge rén.
en: Because there are no clues, the police can't find that person.

zh: 这个案件很复杂，我们需要更多线索才能解决。
pinyin: Zhège ànjiàn hěn fùzá, wǒmen xūyào gèngduō xiànsuǒ cáinéng jiějué.
en: This case is complicated; we need more clues to solve it.

zh: 虽然线索有限，但侦探还是根据这些信息逐步接近真相。
pinyin: Suīrán xiànsuǒ yǒuxiàn, dàn zhēntànzhě háishi gēnjù zhèxiē xìnxī zhúbù jiējìn zhēnxiàng.
en: Although the clues are limited, the detective is gradually getting closer to the truth based on this information.

zh: 妈妈在我面前。
pinyin: Māma zài wǒ miànqián.
en: Mom is in front of me.

zh: 早上我在老师面前读书。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ zài lǎoshī miànqián dúshū.
en: In the morning, I read a book in front of my teacher.

zh: 虽然他很紧张，但在朋友面前还是笑了。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn jǐnzhāng, dàn zài péngyou miànqián háishi xiàole.
en: Although he was nervous, he still smiled in front of his friends.

zh: 在领导面前展示你的想法需要很大的勇气。
pinyin: Zài lǐngdǎo miànqián zhǎnshì nǐ de xiǎngfǎ xūyào hěn dà de yǒngqì.
en: It takes a lot of courage to present your ideas in front of your leader.

zh: 在众人面前承认错误不容易，但这样做能赢得尊重。
pinyin: Zài zhòngrén miànqián chéngrèn cuòwù búróngyì, dàn zhèyàng zuò néng yíngdé zūnjìng.
en: It's not easy to admit a mistake in front of everyone, but doing so earns respect.

zh: 太阳消失了。
pinyin: Tàiyáng xiāoshī le.
en: The sun disappeared.

zh: 他早上出门后就消失了。
pinyin: Tā zǎoshang chūmén hòu jiù xiāoshī le.
en: He disappeared after leaving home this morning.

zh: 虽然他很有名，但他最近从公众视野中消失了。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn yǒumíng, dàn tā zuìjìn cóng gōngzhòng shìyě zhōng xiāoshī le.
en: Although he was very famous, he has recently disappeared from the public eye.

zh: 因为工作太忙，他和朋友的联系逐渐消失了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng, tā hé péngyou de liánxì zhújiàn xiāoshī le.
en: Because of work pressure, his contact with friends gradually faded away.

zh: 随着互联网的普及，许多传统行业正在逐步消失。
pinyin: Suízhe hùliányè de pǔjí, xǔduō chuántǒng hángyè zhèngzài zhúbù xiāoshī.
en: With the spread of the internet, many traditional industries are gradually disappearing.

zh: 我妹妹喜欢吃苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ mèimei xǐhuān chī píngguǒ.
en: My younger sister likes to eat apples.

zh: 昨天我妹妹在家里写了作业。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ mèimei zài jiālǐ xiěle zuòyè.
en: Yesterday my younger sister did her homework at home.

zh: 因为妹妹喜欢唱歌，所以我们常常一起唱。
pinyin: Yīnwèi mèimei xǐhuān chànggē, suǒyǐ wǒmen chángcháng yìqǐ chàng.
en: Because my sister loves singing, we often sing together.

zh: 虽然妹妹比较调皮，但是老师说她进步很快。
pinyin: Suīrán mèimei bǐjiào tiáopi, dànshi lǎoshī shuō tā jìnbù hěn kuài.
en: Although my sister is quite mischievous, her teacher says she's making good progress.

zh: 妹妹最近参加了学校的英语竞赛，虽然紧张，但还是表现得相当不错。
pinyin: Mèimei zuìjìn cānjiāle xuéxiào de yīngyǔ jìngsài, suīrán jǐnzhāng, dàn háishi biǎoxiàn de xiāngdāng búcuò.
en: Recently my sister entered her school's English competition, and despite being nervous, she performed quite well.

zh: 这个答案正确。
pinyin: Zhège dá'àn zhèngquè.
en: This answer is correct.

zh: 你写的字很正确，很好。
pinyin: Nǐ xiě de zì hěn zhèngquè, hěn hǎo.
en: The characters you wrote are very correct and nice.

zh: 虽然很难，但他还是找到了正确的方法。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dànshì tā háishi zhǎodàole le zhèngquè de fāngfǎ.
en: Although it was difficult, he still found the correct way.

zh: 医生给出了正确的诊断，病人才能及时得到治疗。
pinyin: Yīshēng gěichūle le zhèngquè de zhěnduàn, bìngrén cáinéng jíshí huòdào zhìliáo.
en: Only because the doctor made the correct diagnosis could the patient receive timely treatment.

zh: 要想做出正确的决定，必须充分了解情况和自己的想法。
pinyin: Yào xiǎng zuòchū zhèngquè de juédìng, bìxū chōngfèn liǎojiě qíngkuàng hé zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
en: To make the right decision, you need to thoroughly understand the situation and your own thoughts.

zh: 我的位置在这里。
pinyin: Wǒ de wèizhì zài zhèlǐ.
en: My position is here.

zh: 你找到了吗？我的位置在门的旁边。
pinyin: Nǐ zhǎodào le ma? Wǒ de wèizhì zài mén de pángbiān.
en: Did you find me? I'm positioned next to the door.

zh: 因为停车位置不好找，所以我们走了很久。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tíngchē wèizhì búhǎo zhǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen zǒu le hěnjiǔ.
en: Because parking spots were hard to find, we walked for a long time.

zh: 这个办公室的位置离地铁站很近，员工上班很方便。
pinyin: Zhège bàngōngshì de wèizhì lí dìtiě zhàn hěn jìn, yuángōng shàngbān hěn fāngbiàn.
en: This office's location is very close to the subway station, making it convenient for employees to commute.

zh: 虽然薪水不是最高的，但这个职位的位置和发展前景让很多人都很感兴趣。
pinyin: Suīrán xīnshuǐ búshì zuì gāo de, dàn zhège zhíwèi de wèizhì hé fāzhǎn qiánjǐng ràng hěnduō rén dōu hěn gǎn xìngqùzhě.
en: Although the salary isn't the highest, the position's standing and career prospects attract a lot of interest from people.

zh: 我答应你了。
pinyin: Wǒ dāyìng nǐ le.
en: I promised you.

zh: 妈妈答应明天带我去公园。
pinyin: Māma dāyìng míngtiān dài wǒ qù gōngyuán.
en: Mom promised to take me to the park tomorrow.

zh: 虽然很忙，但他还是答应了帮我的忙。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn máng, dàn tā háishi dāyìng le bāng wǒ de máng.
en: Even though he was busy, he still agreed to help me out.

zh: 经理答应了我们的要求，因为我们的计划很合理。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ dāyìng le wǒmen de yāoqiú, yīnwèi wǒmen de jìhuà hěn héhéli.
en: The manager agreed to our request because our plan was reasonable.

zh: 他答应了这个项目，却没有充分考虑到实际困难。
pinyin: Tā dāyìng le zhège xiàngmù, què méiyǒu chōngfèn kǎolǜ dào shíjì kùnnan.
en: He committed to the project without fully taking the practical difficulties into account.

zh: 我收到一个礼物。
pinyin: Wǒ shōudào yī ge lǐwù.
en: I received a gift.

zh: 昨天我收了很多快递包裹。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ shōule hěnduō kuàidì bāoguǒ.
en: Yesterday I got lots of delivery packages.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但是他还是收拾行李去旅游了。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dànshi tā háishi shōushi xíngli qù lǚyóu le.
en: Although the weather was bad, he still packed his bags and went on a trip.

zh: 这家店因为生意不好而决定收起几家分店。
pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn yīnwèi shēngyì búhǎo ér juédìng shōuqǐ jǐ jiā fēndiàn.
en: Because business was slow, the store decided to close down several of its branches.

zh: 他花了整个下午收拾房间，目的是给女朋友留下好印象。
pinyin: Tā huāle zhěngge xiàwǔ shōushi fángjiān, mùdì shi gěi nǚ péngyou liúxia hǎo yìnxiàng.
en: He spent the whole afternoon tidying up his room in order to make a good impression on his girlfriend.

zh: 我砸了玻璃。
pinyin: Wǒ zá le bōli.
en: I broke the glass.

zh: 他昨天不小心砸坏了手机。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān búxiǎoxin zá huài le shǒujī.
en: He accidentally smashed his phone yesterday.

zh: 因为生气，她砸了桌子上的花瓶。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shēngqì, tā zá le zhuōzi shang de huāpíng.
en: Because she was angry, she smashed the vase on the table.

zh: 虽然他只是不小心砸破了那扇窗户，但房东还是很生气。
pinyin: Suīrán tā zhǐshì búxiǎoxin zá pò le nà shàn chuānghu, dàn fángdōng háishi hěn shēngqì.
en: Although he only accidentally cracked that window, the landlord was still very upset.

zh: 他工作压力太大，回家后经常砸东西来发泄情绪。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò yālì tài dà, huíjiā hòu jīngcháng zá dōngxi lái fāxiè qíngxù.
en: His work stress is so high that he often smashes things when he gets home to vent his frustration.

zh: 我在街上买东西。
pinyin: Wǒ zài jiē shang mǎi dōngxi.
en: I'm shopping on the street.

zh: 昨天我和朋友去街上吃饭。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hé péngyou qù jiē shang chīfàn.
en: Yesterday I went out to eat on the street with a friend.

zh: 因为街上人很多，所以我们走得很慢。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jiē shang rén hěn duō, suǒyǐ wǒmen zǒu de hěn màn.
en: Because there were so many people on the street, we walked very slowly.

zh: 虽然这条街上有很多店铺，但是大部分都比较贵。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè tiáo jiē shang yǒu hěn duō diànpù, dànshì dàbùfen dōu bǐjiào guì.
en: Although there are plenty of shops on this street, most of them are quite expensive.

zh: 每当夜幕降临，这条商业街就热闹起来，各种美食摊位和商店里都挤满了人。
pinyin: Měi dāng yèmù jiànglin, zhè tiáo shāngyè jiē jiù rules qǐlai, gèzhǒng měishí tānwèi hé shāngdiàn lǐ dōu jǐmǎn le rén.
en: Every evening when darkness falls, this commercial street comes alive, with all sorts of food stalls and shops packed with customers.

zh: 这是我的电脑。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de diànnǎo.
en: This is my computer.

zh: 我每天用电脑工作两小时。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān yòng diànnǎo gōngzuò liǎng xiǎoshí.
en: I use my computer to work for two hours every day.

zh: 虽然电脑很贵，但是我需要它学习。
pinyin: Suīrán diànnǎo hěn guì, dànshì wǒ xūyào tā xuéxí.
en: Although computers are expensive, I need one to study.

zh: 因为公司的电脑坏了，所以我在家用自己的电脑开会。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngsī de diànnǎo huài le, suǒyǐ wǒ zàijiā yòng zìjǐ de diànnǎo kāihuì.
en: Because the office computer broke down, I had to use my own computer at home for the meeting.

zh: 随着人工智能的发展，现在的电脑性能越来越强大，几乎可以处理任何复杂的任务。
pinyin: Suízhe réngōng zhìnéng de fāzhǎn, xiànzài de diànnǎo xìngnéng yuèláiyuè qiángdà, jīhū kěyǐ chǔlǐ rènhé fùzá de rènwu.
en: With the development of artificial intelligence, modern computers have become increasingly powerful and can handle almost any complex task.

zh: 这是学生区。
pinyin: Zhè shì xuésheng qū.
en: This is the student area.

zh: 我家在城市的南区。
pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài chéngshì de nánqū.
en: My home is in the south district of the city.

zh: 因为那个区离学校近，所以很多学生住在那里。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nàge qū lí xuéxiào jìn, suǒyǐ hěnduō xuésheng zhù zài nàlǐ.
en: Because that district is close to the school, many students live there.

zh: 虽然新区的房子贵，但是环境比老区好得多。
pinyin: Suīrán xīnqū de fángzi guì, dànshì huánjìng bǐ lǎoqū hǎo de duō.
en: Although housing in the new district is expensive, the environment is much better than the old district.

zh: 为了吸引年轻人，政府在工业区推出了多项优惠政策。
pinyin: Wèile xīyǐn niánqīng rén, zhèngfǔ zài gōngyè qū tuīchūle duōxiàng yōuhuì zhèngcè.
en: To attract young people, the government has rolled out several favorable policies in the industrial zone.

zh: 我撞到了门。
pinyin: Wǒ zhuàngle le mén.
en: I bumped into the door.

zh: 昨天我在街上撞到了一个朋友。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài jiēshang zhuàngle le yī ge péngyou.
en: Yesterday I ran into a friend on the street.

zh: 因为没有看路，他骑自行车撞到了树。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu kàn lù, tā qī zìxíngchē zhuàngle le shù.
en: Because he wasn't watching the road, he rode his bike into a tree.

zh: 两辆车在十字路口撞在了一起，幸好没有人受伤。
pinyin: Liǎng liàng chē zài shízìlùkǒu zhuàng zài le yīqǐ, xìnghǎo méiyǒu rén shòushāng.
en: Two cars collided at the intersection, but fortunately no one was hurt.

zh: 他开车时低头看手机，结果撞到了前面的车，现在要赔很多钱。
pinyin: Tā kāichē shí dītou kàn shǒujī, jiéguǒ zhuàngle le qiánmiàn de chē, xiànzài yào péi hěn duō qián.
en: He was looking at his phone while driving and ended up crashing into the car ahead—now he has to pay a lot of money.

zh: 我借你一支笔。
pinyin: Wǒ jiè nǐ yī zhī bǐ.
en: I'll lend you a pen.

zh: 昨天我向朋友借了钱。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ xiàng péngyou jièle qián.
en: I borrowed money from a friend yesterday.

zh: 因为我没有雨伞，所以借了姐姐的。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ méiyǒu yǔsǎn, suǒyǐ jièle jiějie de.
en: Because I didn't have an umbrella, I borrowed my sister's.

zh: 他经常借口很忙来拒绝参加聚会。
pinyin: Tā jīngcháng jiè kǒu hěn máng lái jùjué cānjiā jùhuì.
en: He often uses being busy as an excuse to turn down invitations to gatherings.

zh: 与其等待机会，不如借助现有资源先行动起来。
pinyin: Yǔqī děngdài jīhuì, búrú jiè zhù xiànyǒu zīyuán xiānxíngdòng qǐlai.
en: Rather than wait for an opportunity, it's better to take action first by leveraging the resources you already have.

zh: 等一秒钟。
pinyin: Děng yī miǎo zhōng.
en: Wait a second.

zh: 他三秒钟就跑完了。
pinyin: Tā sān miǎo zhōng jiù pǎo wán le.
en: He finished running in just three seconds.

zh: 虽然只有五秒钟,但是我记得很清楚。
pinyin: Suīrán zhǐyǒu wǔ miǎo zhōng, dànshì wǒ jìde hěn qīngchǔ.
en: Even though it was only five seconds, I remember it very clearly.

zh: 这个视频需要快进,因为有些部分只有两秒钟。
pinyin: Zhège shìpín xūyào kuàijìn, yīnwèi yǒuxiē bùfen zhǐyǒu liǎng miǎo zhōng.
en: We need to speed up this video because some sections are only two seconds long.

zh: 网络延迟虽然只差一秒钟,却往往决定了游戏的胜负。
pinyin: Wǎngluò yánchíhòu suīrán zhǐ chā yī miǎo zhōng, què wǎngwǎng juéddìng le yóuxì de shèngnègē.
en: Network lag of just one second, though seemingly insignificant, often determines whether you win or lose the game.

zh: 他似乎很高兴。
pinyin: Tā sìhū hěn gāoxìng.
en: He seems really happy.

zh: 今天天气似乎要下雨了。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì sìhū yào xiàyǔ le.
en: It looks like it's going to rain today.

zh: 虽然他没说，但似乎他不太同意这个计划。
pinyin: Suīrán tā méi shuō, dàn sìhū tā búhěn tóngyì zhège jìhuà.
en: Although he didn't say anything, it seems like he doesn't really agree with the plan.

zh: 从他的表情来看，他似乎对这份工作感到很失望。
pinyin: Cóng tāde biǎoqíng lái kàn, tā sìhū duì zhèfèn gōngzuò gǎndào hěn shīwàng.
en: From the look on his face, he seems quite disappointed about this job.

zh: 经理的态度似乎在暗示，那些不努力的员工可能会被淘汰。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ de tàidù sìhū zài ànshì, nàxiē búnǔlì de yuángōng kěnéng huì bèi tàotài.
en: The manager's attitude seems to hint that employees who don't work hard might get eliminated.

zh: 放下手机吃饭。
pinyin: Fàngxià shǒujī chīfàn.
en: Put down your phone and eat.

zh: 妈妈放下购物袋坐下了。
pinyin: Māma fàngxià gòuwù dài zuòxiàle.
en: Mom put down her shopping bags and sat down.

zh: 因为太累了，他放下工作去休息。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tài lèile, tā fàngxià gōngzuò qù xiūxi.
en: Because he was exhausted, he set aside his work to rest.

zh: 虽然有很多事情要做，但他决定放下一切陪家人。
pinyin: Suīrán yǒu hěnduō shìqing yào zuò, dàn tā juéding fàngxià yīqiè péi jiārén.
en: Although he had a lot to do, he decided to drop everything and spend time with his family.

zh: 与其一直纠缠过去的错误，不如放下包袱重新开始。
pinyin: Yǔqī yīzhí jiūchán guòqù de cuòwù, búrú fàngxià bāofu chóngxīn kāishǐ.
en: Rather than dwelling on past mistakes, it's better to let go of that burden and make a fresh start.

zh: 我有很大的力量。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu hěn dà de lìliàng.
en: I have a lot of strength.

zh: 运动员的力量很强。
pinyin: Yùndòngyuán de lìliàng hěn qiáng.
en: Athletes have very strong physical power.

zh: 因为他经常练习，所以力量变得更强了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā jīngcháng liànxí, suǒyǐ lìliàng biàn de gèng qiáng le.
en: Because he trains regularly, his strength has become even greater.

zh: 虽然他个子不大，但他的力量足以完成这项工作。
pinyin: Suīrán tā gèzi búdà, dàn tā de lìliàng zúyǐ wánchéng zhè xiàng gōngzuò.
en: Although he's not tall, he has enough strength to complete this task.

zh: 团结就是力量，一个人的努力远不如团队合作来得有效。
pinyin: Tuánjié jiùshi lìliàng, yī ge rén de nǔlì yuǎn búrú tuánduì hézuò lái de yǒuxiào.
en: Unity is strength; one person's effort is far less effective than teamwork.

zh: 老师命令学生坐下。
pinyin: Lǎoshī mìnglìng xuésheng zuò xià.
en: The teacher ordered the students to sit down.

zh: 警察今天早上命令我们离开这里。
pinyin: Jǐngchá jīntiān zǎoshang mìnglìng wǒmen líkāi zhèlǐ.
en: The police officer ordered us to leave this place this morning.

zh: 因为天气不好，所以经理命令员工在家工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, suǒyǐ jīnglǐ mìnglìng yuángōng zài jiā gōngzuò.
en: Because the weather was bad, the manager ordered the staff to work from home.

zh: 虽然他只是新员工，但老板已经给了他很多重要的命令。
pinyin: Suīrán tā zhǐshì xīn yuángōng, dàn lǎobǎn yǐjīng gěile tā hěnduō zhòngyào de mìnglìng.
en: Although he's only a new employee, the boss has already given him many important orders.

zh: 这位将军的每一条命令都直接影响了战争的结果。
pinyin: Zhè wèi jiāngjūn de měi yī tiáo mìnglìng dōu zhíjiē yǐngxiǎngle zhànzhēng de jiéguǒ.
en: Every single order from this general directly affected the outcome of the war.

zh: 我吃饭，同时喝水。
pinyin: Wǒ chīfàn, tóngshí hēshuǐ.
en: I eat and drink water at the same time.

zh: 她在看书，同时听音乐。
pinyin: Tā zài kànshū, tóngshí tīng yīnyuè.
en: She reads a book while listening to music.

zh: 虽然很忙，但他同时还要照顾家人。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn máng, dàn tā tóngshí háiyào zhàogù jiārén.
en: Although very busy, he still has to take care of his family at the same time.

zh: 公司同时开发新产品和改进服务质量。
pinyin: Gōngsī tóngshí kāifā xīn chǎnpǐn hé gǎijìn fúwù zhìliàng.
en: The company develops new products and improves service quality simultaneously.

zh: 经济增长同时也带来了环境污染问题。
pinyin: Jīngjì zēngzhǎng tóngshí yě dàilái le huánjìng wūrǎn wèntí.
en: Economic growth has brought environmental pollution issues at the same time.

zh: 妈妈提供午餐。
pinyin: Māma tígōng wǔcān.
en: Mom provides lunch.

zh: 学校每天提供免费水。
pinyin: Xuéxiào měi tiān tígōng miǎnfèi shuǐ.
en: The school provides free water every day.

zh: 因为天气冷，宾馆提供了热毛巾。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì lěng, bīnguǎn tígōngle rè máojīn.
en: Because the weather was cold, the hotel provided hot towels.

zh: 这个平台为用户提供了安全的购物环境。
pinyin: Zhège píng tái wèi yònghù tígōngle ānquán de gòuwù huánjìng.
en: This platform provides users with a secure shopping environment.

zh: 公司不仅提供竞争力的薪酬，还为员工提供专业发展机会。
pinyin: Gōngsī búyǐn tígōng jìngjìnglì de xīnchóu, háishi wèi yuángōng tígōng zhuānyè fāzhǎn jīhuì.
en: The company not only offers competitive compensation but also provides professional development opportunities for employees.

zh: 狗威胁我。
pinyin: Gǒu wēixié wǒ.
en: The dog is threatening me.

zh: 坏人威胁了他很多次。
pinyin: Huàirén wēixié le tā hěnduō cì.
en: Bad guys have threatened him many times.

zh: 虽然他威胁我，但我不害怕。
pinyin: Suīrán tā wēixié wǒ, dànshì wǒ búhàipà.
en: Although he's threatening me, I'm not scared.

zh: 公司威胁要裁员，员工们都很担心。
pinyin: Gōngsī wēixié yào cáiyuán, yuángōngmen dōu hěn dānxīn.
en: The company threatened to lay people off, so all the employees are very worried.

zh: 这个问题对我们的安全构成严重威胁。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí duì wǒmen de ānquán gòuchéng yánzhòng wēixié.
en: This issue poses a serious threat to our security.

zh: 我输了。
pinyin: Wǒ shū le.
en: I lost.

zh: 昨天比赛我输给了他。
pinyin: Zuótiān bǐsài wǒ shū gěi le tā.
en: I lost the match to him yesterday.

zh: 因为我没有练习，所以输了这场游戏。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ méiyǒu liànxí, suǒyǐ shū le zhè chǎng yóuxì.
en: Because I didn't practice, I lost this game.

zh: 虽然他输了比赛，但他的表现还是值得表扬。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shū le bǐsài, dàn tā de biǎoxiàn háishi zhídé biǎoyáng.
en: Although he lost the competition, his performance was still praiseworthy.

zh: 在生意上输了不少钱以后，他决定改变策略。
pinyin: Zài shēngyì shang shū le búshǎo qián yǐhòu, tā juédìng gǎibiàn cèlüè.
en: After losing a lot of money in business, he decided to change his approach.

zh: 这是我的号码。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de hàomǎ.
en: This is my number.

zh: 你的电话号码是多少？
pinyin: Nǐ de diànhuà hàomǎ shì duōshao?
en: What is your phone number?

zh: 因为我忘记了号码，所以没能给他打电话。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ wàngjìle hàomǎ, suǒyǐ méiyǒunéng gěi tā dǎ diànhuà.
en: Because I forgot the number, I wasn't able to call him.

zh: 银行要求我提供账户号码来确认我的身份。
pinyin: Yínháng yāoqiú wǒ tígōng zhànghù hàomǎ lái quèrènmíng wǒ de shēnfèn.
en: The bank asked me to provide my account number to verify my identity.

zh: 自从换了新号码以后，很多朋友都没联系上我，我得重新告诉他们。
pinyin: Zìcóng huànle xīn hàomǎ yǐhòu, hěnduō péngyou dōu méi liánxìshàng wǒ, wǒ děi chóngxīn gàosu tāmen.
en: Ever since I changed my number, a lot of friends haven't been able to reach me, so I've had to tell them all over again.

zh: 我的日子很好。
pinyin: Wǒ de rìzi hěn hǎo.
en: My life is good.

zh: 最近的日子过得很快。
pinyin: Zuìjìn de rìzi guòde hěn kuài.
en: The days have been flying by lately.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但是我的日子还是很充实。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshi wǒ de rìzi háishi hěn chōngshí.
en: Although work is busy, my life is still very fulfilling.

zh: 自从有了孩子以后，我们的日子变得更有意义。
pinyin: Zìcóng yǒule háizi yǐhòu, wǒmen de rìzi biànde gèng yǒu yìyì.
en: Since we had our child, our daily life has become much more meaningful.

zh: 那段艰苦的日子虽然难熬，但教会了我很多东西。
pinyin: Nà duàn jiānkǔ de rìzi suīrán nán'áo, dàn jiāohuìle wǒ hěnduō dōngxi.
en: Those difficult times were hard to endure, but they taught me a lot.

zh: 这座山很高。
pinyin: Zhè zuò shān hěn gāo.
en: This mountain is very tall.

zh: 公园里有一座漂亮的桥。
pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ yǒu yī zuò piàoliàng de qiào.
en: There's a beautiful bridge in the park.

zh: 虽然这座楼很旧，但是住在里面很舒服。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè zuò lóu hěn jiù, dànshì zhù zài lǐmiàn hěn shūfu.
en: Although this building is old, it's actually very comfortable to live in.

zh: 因为地铁站离这座医院很近，所以病人来看病很方便。
pinyin: Yīnwèi dìtiězhàn lí zhè zuò yīyuàn hěn jìn, suǒyǐ bìngrén lái kànbìng hěn fāngbiàn.
en: Because the subway station is close to this hospital, patients find it very convenient to come for treatment.

zh: 这座城市虽然不如大都市繁华，却因为环境优美和消费便宜而吸引了越来越多的年轻人。
pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì suīrán búrú dà dūshì fánhuá, què yīnwèi huanjìng yōuměi hé xiāofèi piányi ér xīyǐnle yuèláiyuè duō de niánqīng rén.
en: Though this city isn't as bustling as a major metropolis, it's increasingly attracting young people because of its pleasant environment and affordable cost of living.

zh: 比如，苹果是红色的。
pinyin: Bǐrú, píngguǒ shì hóngsè de.
en: For example, an apple is red.

zh: 我喜欢吃水果，比如香蕉和橙子。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān chī shuǐguǒ, bǐrú xiāngjiāo hé chéngzi.
en: I like eating fruit, such as bananas and oranges.

zh: 有些动物很聪明，比如狗会学主人说话。
pinyin: Yǒuxiē dòngwù hěn cōngmíng, bǐrú gǒu huì xué zhǔrén shuōhuà.
en: Some animals are very smart; for instance, dogs can learn to imitate their owners' speech.

zh: 很多人因为工作忙而不锻炼身体，比如那些经常加班的白领。
pinyin: Hěnduō rén yīnwèi gōngzuò máng ér bù duànliàn shēntǐ, bǐrú nàxiē jīngcháng jiābān de báilǐng.
en: Many people don't exercise because they're busy with work—for example, office workers who often work overtime.

zh: 某些传统手艺正在逐渐消失，比如瓷器制作这类工作已经很难找到年轻人去学。
pinyin: Mǒuxiē chuántǒng shǒuyì zhèngzài zhújiàn xiāoshī, bǐrú cíqì zhìzuò zhè lèi gōngzuò yǐjīng hěnnan zhǎodào niánqīng rén qù xué.
en: Certain traditional crafts are gradually disappearing—for instance, it's become really hard to find young people willing to learn skills like porcelain-making.

zh: 你喜欢哪个苹果？
pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuān哪ge píngguǒ?
en: Which apple do you like?

zh: 早上你通常吃哪个面包？
pinyin: Zǎoshang nǐ tōngcháng chī哪ge miànbāo?
en: Which bread do you usually eat in the morning?

zh: 虽然两个都好，但你觉得哪个更便宜？
pinyin: Suīrán liǎnge dōu hǎo, dàn nǐ juéde哪ge gèng piányi?
en: Even though both are good, which one do you think is cheaper?

zh: 因为工作太忙，我忘记了哪个客户需要特别照顾。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng, wǒ wàngjìle哪ge kèhù xūyào tèbié zhàogu.
en: Because I've been so swamped with work, I forgot which client needs special attention.

zh: 在众多的机会中，他很难判断哪个决定才是真正对自己有利的。
pinyin: Zài zhòngduō de jīhuì zhōng, tā hěn nán pànduàn哪ge juéding cái shì zhēnzhèng duì zìjǐ yǒulì de.
en: Faced with so many opportunities, it's hard for him to tell which decision would actually benefit him most.

zh: 我吃了饭，剩下一些米。
pinyin: Wǒ chīle fàn, shèngxià yīxiē mǐ.
en: I ate, and there's some rice left over.

zh: 昨天买的苹果，现在剩下三个了。
pinyin: Zuótiān mǎi de píngguǒ, xiànzài shèngxià sān ge le.
en: The apples we bought yesterday—there are only three left now.

zh: 虽然他吃了很多，但是碗里还剩下一点饭。
pinyin: Suīrán tā chīle hěnduō, dànshì wǎn lǐ háishi shèngxià yīdiǎn fàn.
en: Although he ate a lot, there's still a little rice left in the bowl.

zh: 会议结束后，剩下的工作我们明天继续做。
pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, shèngxià de gōngzuò wǒmen míngtiān jìxù zuò.
en: After the meeting ends, we'll continue with the remaining work tomorrow.

zh: 预算的一半用于营销，剩下的部分才能分配到产品研发。
pinyin: Yùsuàn de yībàn yòngyú yíngxiāo, shèngxià de bùfen cái néng fēnpèi dào chǎnpǐn yánfā.
en: Half the budget goes to marketing, and only the remaining portion can be allocated to product development.

zh: 他生病很严重。
pinyin: Tā shēngbìng hěn yánzhòng.
en: He is very seriously ill.

zh: 昨天的车祸很严重，两个人受伤了。
pinyin: Zuótiān de chēhuò hěn yánzhòng, liǎng ge rén shòushāng le.
en: Yesterday's car accident was serious—two people got hurt.

zh: 因为污染很严重，所以政府决定关闭那家工厂。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wūrǎn hěn yánzhòng, suǒyǐ zhèngfǔ juédìng guānbì nà jiā gōngchǎng.
en: Because the pollution is serious, the government decided to shut down that factory.

zh: 虽然他只是迟到了，但经理认为这是严重的职业素质问题。
pinyin: Suīrán tā zhǐshì chídào le, dàn jīnglǐ rènwéi zhè shì yánzhòng de zhíyè sùzhì wèntí.
en: Although he was just late, the manager considered it a serious issue of professional standards.

zh: 如果不立即解决这个问题，后果会非常严重，甚至影响整个项目的进展。
pinyin: Rúguǒ búlìjí jiějué zhège wèntí, hòuguǒ huì fēicháng yánzhòng, shènzhì yǐngxiǎng zhěngge xiàngmù de jìnzhǎn.
en: If we don't solve this problem immediately, the consequences will be very serious and could even affect the entire project's progress.

zh: 我感到很开心。
pinyin: Wǒ gǎndào hěn kāixīn.
en: I feel very happy.

zh: 吃了妈妈做的饭，我感到很舒服。
pinyin: Chīle māma zuò de fàn, wǒ gǎndào hěn shūfu.
en: After eating the food Mom made, I felt really comfortable.

zh: 虽然今天很累，但是我感到特别满足。
pinyin: Suīrán jīntiān hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ gǎndào tèbié mǎnzú.
en: Although I was tired today, I felt especially satisfied.

zh: 他的话让我感到有些失望，不过我还是很感谢他的帮助。
pinyin: Tā de huà ràng wǒ gǎndào yǒuxiē shīwàng, búguò wǒ háishi hěn gǎnxiè tā de bāngzhù.
en: What he said made me feel a bit disappointed, but I'm still grateful for his help.

zh: 经过这几年的工作经验，我对这个行业的前景感到乐观。
pinyin: Jīngguò zhè jǐ nián de gōngzuò jīngyàn, wǒ duì zhège hángyè de qiánjǐng gǎndào lèguān.
en: After several years of work experience, I feel optimistic about this industry's prospects.

zh: 我享受吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngshòu chīfàn.
en: I enjoy eating.

zh: 周末我喜欢享受咖啡和阳光。
pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ xǐhuān xiǎngshòu kāfēi hé yángguāng.
en: On weekends I like to enjoy coffee and sunshine.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但我还是享受和朋友在一起的时候。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn wǒ háishi xiǎngshòu hé péngyou zàiyīqǐ de shíhou.
en: Even though work is busy, I still enjoy the time I spend with my friends.

zh: 许多人因为压力太大而无法享受生活，这其实很可惜。
pinyin: Xǔduō rén yīnwèi yālì tài dà ér wúfǎ xiǎngshòu shēnghuó, zhè qīshí hěn kěxī.
en: Many people are unable to enjoy life because of excessive stress, which is really a shame.

zh: 与其整天为了金钱奔波，不如好好享受当下和身边的人。
pinyin: Yǔqī zhěngtiān wèile jīnqián bēnbō, búrú hǎohāo xiǎngshòu dāngxià hé shēnbiān de rén.
en: Rather than rushing around all day for money, it's better to really savor the present moment and the people around you.

zh: 战争很危险。
pinyin: Zhànzhēng hěn wēixiǎn.
en: War is very dangerous.

zh: 历史上有很多战争。
pinyin: Lìshǐ shang yǒu hěnduō zhànzhēng.
en: There were many wars throughout history.

zh: 因为战争，很多人失去了家人。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhànzhēng, hěnduō rén shīqùle jiārén.
en: Because of the war, many people lost their families.

zh: 两个国家为了领土发生了战争。
pinyin: Liǎng ge guójiā wèile lǐngtǔ fāshēngle zhànzhēng.
en: The two countries went to war over territory.

zh: 这场战争持续了多年，最终给双方都造成了巨大损失。
pinyin: Zhè chǎng zhànzhēng chíxùle duō nián, zuìzhōng gěi shuāngfāng dōu zàochéngle jùdà sǔnshī.
en: This war lasted many years and ultimately caused tremendous losses for both sides.

zh: 恭喜你！
pinyin: gōngxǐ nǐ!
en: Congratulations!

zh: 恭喜你今天生日快乐！
pinyin: gōngxǐ nǐ jīntiān shēngrì kuàilè!
en: Happy birthday to you today!

zh: 你考上了大学，我们都很为你恭喜。
pinyin: Nǐ kǎoshàngle dàxué, wǒmen dōu hěn wèi nǐ gōngxǐ.
en: You got into university—we're all really happy for you.

zh: 听说你升职了，我来恭喜你这个好消息。
pinyin: Tīngsuō nǐ shēngzhí le, wǒ lái gōngxǐ nǐ zhège hǎo xiāoxi.
en: I heard you got promoted—let me congratulate you on this great news.

zh: 既然你们的公司成功融资了，我得好好恭喜一下。
pinyin: 既然 nǐmen de gōngsī chéngōng róngjī le, wǒ děi hǎohāo gōngxǐ yīxià.
en: Since your company successfully raised funding, I really should offer my congratulations.

zh: 猫杀死了老鼠。
pinyin: Māo shāsǐ le lǎoshǔ.
en: The cat killed the mouse.

zh: 昨天晚上，他杀死了一条蛇。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang, tā shāsǐ le yī tiáo shé.
en: Last night, he killed a snake.

zh: 因为这只狗很危险，所以农民杀死了它。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè zhī gǒu hěn wēixiǎn, suǒyǐ nóngmín shāsǐ le tā.
en: Because that dog was dangerous, the farmer killed it.

zh: 医生说这种药能杀死癌细胞，对患者很重要。
pinyin: Yīshēng shuō zhè zhǒng yào néng shāsǐ áixì báobào, duì huànzhě hěn zhòngyào.
en: The doctor said this medicine can kill cancer cells, which is very important for patients.

zh: 研究人员发现这种新型抗生素能够杀死多种耐药细菌。
pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán fāxiàn zhè zhǒng xīnxíng kàngsēngsù nénggoù shāsǐ duō zhǒng nàiyào xìjūn.
en: Researchers discovered that this new antibiotic can kill multiple drug-resistant bacteria.

zh: 这是我的书，其他的是他的。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de shū, qítā de shì tā de.
en: This is my book, and the others are his.

zh: 我喜欢这个苹果，其他的苹果不太好吃。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zhège píngguǒ, qítā de píngguǒ búkè tài hǎochī.
en: I like this apple, but the other apples don't taste as good.

zh: 虽然这个工作很难，但是其他的选择也不好，所以我继续做。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège gōngzuò hěn nán, dànshì qítā de xuǎnzé yě búhǎo, suǒyǐ wǒ jìxù zuò.
en: Although this job is difficult, the other options aren't great either, so I'll keep doing it.

zh: 与其每天担心失败，不如把精力放在提高自己的能力上。
pinyin: Yǔqī měi tiān dānxīn shībài, búrú bǎ jīnglì fàng zài tígāo zìjǐ de néngglì shang.
en: Rather than worrying about failure every day, it's better to focus your energy on improving your own abilities.

zh: 这个方案虽然成本较高，但其长期收益远超其他竞争对手的产品。
pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn suīrán chéngběn jiào gāo, dàn qī chángqī shōuyì yuǎn chāo qítā jìngjìng duìsh手 de chǎnpǐn.
en: Although this plan has higher costs, its long-term returns far exceed those of competitors' products.

zh: 天气影响我的心情。
pinyin: Tiānqì yǐngxiǎng wǒ de xīnqing.
en: The weather affects my mood.

zh: 睡眠不好会影响第二天的工作。
pinyin: Shuìmián búhǎo huì yǐngxiǎng dì-èr tiān de gōngzuò.
en: Poor sleep will affect your work the next day.

zh: 虽然他生病了，但是他的乐观精神影响了大家。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shēngbìng le, búshì tā de lèguān jīngshén yǐngxiǎng le dàjiā.
en: Although he's sick, his optimistic spirit has influenced everyone.

zh: 父母的教育方式会深深影响孩子的人格发展。
pinyin: Fùmǔ de jiàoyù fāngshì huì shēnshēn yǐngxiǎng háizi de réngé fāzhǎn.
en: Parents' education methods deeply influence how a child's personality develops.

zh: 社交媒体对年轻人的影响已经不容小觑，我们需要正确引导。
pinyin: Shèjiāo méitǐ duì niánqīng rén de yǐngxiǎng yǐjīng búróng xiǎo qù, wǒmen xūyào zhèngquè yǐndǎo.
en: The influence of social media on young people is now significant and shouldn't be underestimated; we need to guide them properly.

zh: 我利用周末去公园。
pinyin: Wǒ lìyòng zhōumò qù gōngyuán.
en: I use the weekend to go to the park.

zh: 他每天利用午饭时间看书。
pinyin: Tā měitiān lìyòng wǔfàn shíjiān kànshū.
en: He uses his lunch break every day to read.

zh: 因为天气好，我们利用假期去旅游。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hǎo, wǒmen lìyòng jiàqī qù lǚyóu.
en: Because the weather is nice, we're using the holiday to travel.

zh: 公司利用新的技术来提高生产效率。
pinyin: Gōngsī lìyòng xīn de jìshù lái tígāo shēngchǎn xiàoǜ.
en: The company is leveraging new technology to improve production efficiency.

zh: 学生应该合理利用互联网资源来学习，而不是浪费时间。
pinyin: Xuésheng yīnggāi hélǐ lìyòng hùliánwǎng zīyuán lái xuéxí, érbúshì làngfèi shíjiān.
en: Students should make good use of internet resources for learning rather than wasting time.

zh: 我恨吃青菜。
pinyin: Wǒ hèn chī qīngcài.
en: I hate eating vegetables.

zh: 他很恨那个坏男孩。
pinyin: Tā hěn hèn nàge huài nánháir.
en: He really hates that bad boy.

zh: 因为她迟到了，所以我很恨她。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā chídào le, suǒyǐ wǒ hěn hèn tā.
en: Because she was late, I was really annoyed with her.

zh: 虽然他道歉了，但我还是有点恨他的态度。
pinyin: Suīrán tā dàoqiànle, dànshì wǒ háishi yǒudiǎn hèn tā de tàidù.
en: Even though he apologized, I still resent his attitude a bit.

zh: 我最恨的就是有人做事不负责任，这样会害其他人。
pinyin: Wǒ zuì hèn de jiùshi yǒu rén zuòshì bu fùzérèn, zhèyàng huì hài qítā rén.
en: What I hate most is when people act irresponsibly—it ends up hurting everyone else.

zh: 他杀人了。
pinyin: Tā shārén le.
en: He committed murder.

zh: 昨天发生了一起杀人案件。
pinyin: Zuótiān fāshēng le yī qǐ shārén ànjiàn.
en: A murder case happened yesterday.

zh: 警察在调查这个杀人案，因为受害者很有名。
pinyin: Jǐngchá zài diàochá zhège shārén àn, yīnwèi shòuhàizhě hěn yǒumíng.
en: The police are investigating this murder case because the victim was well-known.

zh: 虽然警察怀疑他杀人，但是没有足够的证据来逮捕他。
pinyin: Suīrán jǐngchá huáiyí tā shārén, dànshì méiyǒu zúgòu de zhèngjù lái dàibǔ tā.
en: Although the police suspect him of murder, they don't have enough evidence to arrest him.

zh: 这部电影讲的是一个无辜的人被控杀人，最后才证明是冤案。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiǎng de shì yī ge wúgū de rén bèi kòng shārén, zuìhòu cái zhèngmíng shì yuānàn.
en: This movie is about an innocent person accused of murder who is eventually proven to be a victim of a wrongful conviction.

zh: 我脱掉鞋子。
pinyin: Wǒ tuōdiào xiézi.
en: I took off my shoes.

zh: 他进门就脱掉了外套。
pinyin: Tā jìnmén jiù tuōdiào le wàitào.
en: He took off his coat as soon as he came through the door.

zh: 虽然天气冷，但他还是脱掉了厚毛衣。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì lěng, dànshì tā háishi tuōdiào le hòu máoyī.
en: Although the weather was cold, he still took off his heavy sweater.

zh: 他因为工作压力太大而脱发，医生建议他放松。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi gōngzuò yālì tài dà ér tuōfā, yīshēng jiànyì tā fàngsōng.
en: He started losing his hair because of work stress, and his doctor advised him to relax.

zh: 这个项目进展缓慢，我们需要脱离既有思维方式才能解决问题。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù jìnzhǎn huǎnman, wǒmen xūyào tuōlí jìyǒu sīwéi fāngshì cáinéng jiějué wèntí.
en: This project is progressing slowly; we need to break free from our existing mindset to solve the problem.

zh: 我陪你吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ péi nǐ chīfàn.
en: I'll keep you company while we eat.

zh: 妈妈今天陪我去公园。
pinyin: Māma jīntiān péi wǒ qù gōngyuán.
en: Mom is coming with me to the park today.

zh: 因为你不开心，所以我想陪着你。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nǐ búkāixīn, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng péizhe nǐ.
en: Because you're upset, I want to stay by your side.

zh: 她经常陪父母散步，虽然工作很忙。
pinyin: Tā jīngcháng péi fùmǔ sǎnbù, suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng.
en: She regularly takes walks with her parents, even though her job keeps her busy.

zh: 这些年我一直陪伴他度过了许多困难时期。
pinyin: Zhèxiē nián wǒ yìzhí péibàn tā dùguò le xǔduō kùnnan shíqī.
en: Over these years I've stood by him through quite a few difficult periods.

zh: 小猫失踪了。
pinyin: Xiǎo māo shīzōng le.
en: The kitten has gone missing.

zh: 昨天我的狗失踪了，我很担心。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ de gǒu shīzōng le, wǒ hěn dānxīn.
en: My dog went missing yesterday, and I'm really worried.

zh: 虽然警察在找，但那个男人仍然失踪了。
pinyin: Suīrán jǐngchá zài zhǎo, dàn nàge nánren réngránshì shīzōng le.
en: Although the police are searching, that man has still not been found.

zh: 自从他失踪以后，他的家人接到了陌生的电话。
pinyin: Zìcóng tā shīzōng yǐhòu, tā de jiārén jiēdào le mòshēng de diànhuà.
en: Since he disappeared, his family has been receiving calls from strangers.

zh: 那位乘客失踪事件引发了社会广泛讨论，航空公司也为此承担了责任。
pinyin: Nàwèi chéngkè shīzōng shìjiàn yǐnfāle shèhuì guǎngfàn tǎolùn, hángkōng gōngsī yě wèi cǐ chéngdānle zérèn.
en: The disappearance of that passenger sparked widespread public discussion, and the airline took responsibility for it.

zh: 我很认真地做功课。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn rènzhēn de zuò gōngkè.
en: I do my homework very carefully.

zh: 老师说我们要认真听课。
pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō wǒmen yào rènzhēn tīng kè.
en: The teacher says we need to pay attention in class.

zh: 虽然这个工作很难，但她认真做了。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège gōngzuò hěn nán, dàn tā rènzhēn zuò le.
en: Although the job was difficult, she did it seriously.

zh: 因为他认真对待每一个细节，所以产品质量很好。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā rènzhēn duìdài měi yī ge xìjié, suǒyǐ chǎnpǐn zhìliàng hěn hǎo.
en: Because he takes every detail seriously, the product quality is excellent.

zh: 只要认真对待生活中的每件事，就不会轻易放弃。
pinyin: Zhǐyào rènzhēn duìdài shēnghuó zhōng de měi jiàn shì, jiù búhuì qīngyì fàngqì.
en: As long as you take each thing in life seriously, you won't easily give up.

zh: 真相是什么？
pinyin: Zhēnxiāng shì shénme?
en: What is the truth?

zh: 他昨天告诉我真相了。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān gàosu wǒ zhēnxiāng le.
en: He told me the truth yesterday.

zh: 虽然很难相信，但真相就是这样。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán xiāngxìn, dàn zhēnxiāng jiùshì zhèyàng.
en: It's hard to believe, but that's actually the truth.

zh: 警察通过调查发现了案件的真相。
pinyin: Jǐngchá tōngguò diàochá fāxiàn le ànjìan de zhēnxiāng.
en: The police uncovered the real facts of the case through their investigation.

zh: 媒体应该报道真相，而不是传播谣言。
pinyin: Méitǐ yīnggāi bàodào zhēnxiāng, érbuShì chuánbō yáoyán.
en: The media should report the facts, not spread rumors.

zh: 法律很重要。
pinyin: Fǎlǜ hěn zhòngyào.
en: Laws are very important.

zh: 我们要遵守法律。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào zūnshǒu fǎlǜ.
en: We need to follow the law.

zh: 因为有法律，所以社会才能安全。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu fǎlǜ, suǒyǐ shèhuì cái néng ānquán.
en: Because there are laws, society can be safe.

zh: 违反法律的人会受到处罚。
pinyin: Wéifǎn fǎlǜ de rén huì shòudào chǔfá.
en: People who break the law will face punishment.

zh: 了解基本法律常识对每个公民都很必要。
pinyin: Liǎojiě jīběn fǎlǜ chángshi duì měi ge gōngmín dōu hěn bìyào.
en: Understanding basic legal knowledge is necessary for every citizen.

zh: 我们每天训练。
pinyin: Wǒmen měitiān xùnliàn.
en: We train every day.

zh: 他在学校训练足球。
pinyin: Tā zài xuéxiào xùnliàn zúqiú.
en: He practices soccer at school.

zh: 因为要参加比赛，所以我们现在训练很认真。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yào cānjiā bǐsài, suǒyǐ wǒmen xiànzài xùnliàn hěn rènzhēn.
en: Because we have a competition coming up, we're training very seriously right now.

zh: 运动员虽然已经很强了，但还需要每周训练五次。
pinyin: Yùndòngyuán suīrán yǐjīng hěn qiáng le, dàn háixū měi zhōu xùnliàn wǔ cì.
en: Although the athlete is already very skilled, he still needs to train five times a week.

zh: 长期坚持训练不仅能提高技能，还能培养人的意志力。
pinyin: Cháng期 jiānchí xùnliàn bújǐn néng tígāo jìnéng, háinnéng péiyǎng rén de yìzhìlì.
en: Maintaining consistent training over time not only improves your skills but also builds mental toughness.

zh: 我喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: I like to eat rice.

zh: 每天早上妈妈给我煮米粥。
pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang māma gěi wǒ zhǔ mǐ zhōu.
en: Every morning my mom cooks rice porridge for me.

zh: 因为这种米很便宜，所以很多人都买它。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè zhǒng mǐ hěn piányi, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén dōu mǎi tā.
en: Because this type of rice is cheap, lots of people buy it.

zh: 虽然进口米的质量更好，但国内米的价格更合理。
pinyin: Suīrán jìnkǒu mǐ de zhìliàng gèng hǎo, dàn guónèi mǐ de jiàgé gèng héalǐ.
en: Although imported rice has better quality, domestic rice offers better value for money.

zh: 这家餐厅的米饭讲究火候和水量的搭配，难怪生意这么好。
