pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de mǐfàn jiǎngjiù huǒhòu hé shuǐliàng de dāpèi, nánguài shēngyì zhème hǎo.
en: This restaurant is meticulous about the cooking temperature and water ratio for their rice, which explains why business is so good.

zh: 这个苹果很好吃，值得买。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ hěn hǎochī, zhíde mǎi.
en: This apple tastes really good—it's worth buying.

zh: 那部电影很有趣，很值得看。
pinyin: Nà bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù, hěn zhíde kàn.
en: That movie is really interesting—definitely worth watching.

zh: 虽然票很贵，但是这个演唱会真的值得去。
pinyin: Suīrán piào hěn guì, dànshì zhège yǎnchànghui zhēnde zhíde qù.
en: Even though the tickets are expensive, this concert is really worth going to.

zh: 因为他很努力，所以他的成功完全值得尊重。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn nǔlì, suǒyǐ tāde chénggōng wánquán zhíde zūnjìng.
en: Because he worked so hard, his success is completely deserving of respect.

zh: 学习新技能花了不少时间，但长远来看还是值得投资。
pinyin: Xuéxí xīn jìnéng huāle búshǎo shíjiān, dàn chángyuǎn lái kàn háishi zhíde tóuzī.
en: Learning new skills took a fair amount of time, but in the long run it's still worth the investment.

zh: 阿姨在家。
pinyin: Āyí zài jiā.
en: Auntie is at home.

zh: 我的阿姨今天来我家吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ de āyí jīntiān lái wǒ jiā chīfàn.
en: My auntie is coming to my place for dinner today.

zh: 虽然阿姨很忙，但是她还是经常来看我们。
pinyin: Suīrán āyí hěn máng, dànshì tā háishi jīngcháng lái kàn wǒmen.
en: Although auntie is very busy, she still visits us quite often.

zh: 因为阿姨最近搬到了新城市工作，所以我们见面的次数变少了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi āyí zuìjìn bān到le xīn chéngshì gōngzuò, suǒyǐ wǒmen jiànmiàn de cìshù biàn shǎo le.
en: Since auntie recently moved to work in a new city, we've been seeing each other less often.

zh: 那位阿姨虽然年纪不小，但对新技术的接受能力比年轻人还强。
pinyin: Nà wèi āyí suīrán niánjì bù xiǎo, dàn duì xīn jìshù de jiēshòu néngglì bǐ niánqīng rén háishi qiáng.
en: That auntie, despite being quite elderly, actually has a better grasp of new technology than many young people.

zh: 我是主人。
pinyin: Wǒ shì zhǔrén.
en: I'm the owner.

zh: 今天主菜是鸡肉和米饭。
pinyin: Jīntiān zhǔcài shì jīròu hé mǐfàn.
en: Today the main dish is chicken and rice.

zh: 虽然有很多选择，但我的主意是去公园。
pinyin: Suīrán yǒu hěnduō xuǎnzé, dàn wǒ de zhǔyi shì qù gōngyuán.
en: Although there are many options, my main idea is to go to the park.

zh: 这个项目的主要目标是改进生产效率和降低成本。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de zhǔyào mùbiāo shì gǎijìn shēngchǎn xiàolǜ hé jiàngdī chéngběn.
en: The main objective of this project is to improve production efficiency and reduce costs.

zh: 在这次会议上，主要讨论了公司如何应对市场变化的策略。
pinyin: Zài zhè cì huìyì shang, zhǔyào tǎolùnle gōngsī rúhé yìngduì shìchǎng biànhuà de cèlüè.
en: At this meeting, the main discussion focused on how the company should respond to market changes.

zh: 这个游戏很有意思。
pinyin: Zhège yóuxì hěn yǒuyìsi.
en: This game is really fun.

zh: 昨天我看了一个有意思的电影。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ kànle yīge yǒuyìsi de diànyǐng.
en: Yesterday I watched a really interesting movie.

zh: 虽然这本书很长，但是很有意思，我喜欢读。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè běn shū hěn cháng, dànshì hěn yǒuyìsi, wǒ xǐhuān dú.
en: Although this book is long, it's actually really engaging and I enjoy reading it.

zh: 他讲的故事特别有意思，听的时候我一直在笑。
pinyin: Tā jiǎng de gùshi tèbié yǒuyìsi, tīng de shíhou wǒ yīzhí zài xiào.
en: The stories he told were particularly amusing; I was laughing the whole time I listened.

zh: 这个人物设定很有意思，既不是传统的好人也不是坏人。
pinyin: Zhège rénwù shèdìng hěn yǒuyìsi, jì búshì chuántǒng de hǎorén yě búshì huàirén.
en: This character is really compelling because they're neither a traditional hero nor a villain.

zh: 今天很热。
pinyin: Jīntiān hěn rè.
en: It's very hot today.

zh: 夏天的时候天气很热。
pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou tiānqì hěn rè.
en: The weather is very hot in summer.

zh: 虽然外面很热，但是我们还要去运动。
pinyin: Suīrán wàimiàn hěn rè, dànshi wǒmen háiyào qù yùndòng.
en: Although it's very hot outside, we still need to exercise.

zh: 这家餐厅因为食物好吃而且服务热情，所以很受欢迎。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng yīnwèi shíwù hǎochī érqiě fúwù règing, suǒyǐ hěn shòu huānyíng.
en: This restaurant is quite popular because the food is delicious and the service is warm and enthusiastic.

zh: 他对工作的热情感染了整个团队，大家都变得更积极主动了。
pinyin: Tā duì gōngzuò de règing gǎnrǎnle zhěngge tuánduì, dàjiā dōu biànde gèng jījí zhǔdòng le.
en: His enthusiasm for work was contagious, and the whole team became more proactive and engaged.

zh: 我使用筷子吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ shǐyòng kuàizi chīfàn.
en: I use chopsticks to eat.

zh: 你可以使用这个手机打电话。
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ shǐyòng zhège shǒujī dǎ diànhuà.
en: You can use this phone to make calls.

zh: 因为电脑坏了，所以我使用平板工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi diànnǎo huài le, suǒyǐ wǒ shǐyòng píngbǎn gōngzuò.
en: Because my computer broke, I'm using a tablet to work instead.

zh: 虽然这个软件很贵，但很多公司都在使用它。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège ruǎnjiàn hěn guì, dàn hěnduō gōngsī dōu zài shǐyòng tā.
en: Although this software is expensive, many companies still use it.

zh: 我们应该合理使用资源，不要浪费能源。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi héalǐ shǐyòng zīyuán, búyào làngfèi néngyuán.
en: We should use resources wisely and not waste energy.

zh: 我们差五分钟。
pinyin: Wǒmen chà wǔ fēnzhōng.
en: We're five minutes short / We need five more minutes.

zh: 你的苹果和我的苹果差不多。
pinyin: Nǐ de píngguǒ hé wǒ de píngguǒ chàbuduō.
en: Your apple and my apple are pretty much the same.

zh: 虽然这两个手机差一点钱，但是质量很不一样。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè liǎng ge shǒujī chà yìdiǎn qián, dànshì zhìliàng hěn búyīyàng.
en: Although these two phones differ in price, their quality is really different.

zh: 他的工作经验和学历虽然有差距，但能力很强。
pinyin: Tā de gōngzuò jīngyàn hé xuéli suīrán yǒu chājù, dàn néngliǎ hěn qiáng.
en: Although there's a gap between his work experience and education, his actual ability is very strong.

zh: 这个城市的发展速度和隔壁城市差了不少，主要原因是政策支持力度不同。
pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de fāzhǎn sùdù hé gébì chéngshì chà le búshǎo, zhǔyào yuányīn shì zhèngcè zhīchí lìdù búgòng.
en: This city's development pace lags behind the neighboring city quite a bit, mainly because the policy support differs.

zh: 我在学习方面很努力。
pinyin: Wǒ zài xuéxí fāngmiàn hěn nǔlì.
en: I work hard when it comes to studying.

zh: 这个工作在时间方面有点困难。
pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò zài shíjiān fāngmiàn yǒudiǎn kùnnan.
en: This job is a bit difficult in terms of time.

zh: 虽然他很聪明，但是在英语方面还需要练习。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn cōngming, dànshì zài yīngyǔ fāngmiàn háishi xūyào liànxí.
en: Although he's smart, he still needs to practice when it comes to English.

zh: 在健康方面，我们应该多运动，少吃油腻的食物。
pinyin: Zài jiànkāng fāngmiàn, wǒmen yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī yóunì de shíwù.
en: Regarding health, we should exercise more and eat less greasy food.

zh: 公司在产品质量方面做得相当不错，但营销策略还有改进的空间。
pinyin: Gōngsī zài chǎnpǐn zhìliàng fāngmiàn zuòde xiāngdāng búcuò, dàn yíngxiāo cèlüè háiyǒu gǎijìn de kōngjiān.
en: The company is doing quite well in terms of product quality, but there's still room for improvement in their marketing strategy.

zh: 我去银行。
pinyin: Wǒ qù yínháng.
en: I'm going to the bank.

zh: 明天我要去银行取钱。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào qù yínháng qǔ qián.
en: Tomorrow I need to go to the bank to withdraw money.

zh: 因为我要买房子，所以我去银行申请贷款。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ yào mǎi fángzi, suǒyǐ wǒ qù yínháng shēnqǐng dàikuǎn.
en: Because I want to buy a house, I went to the bank to apply for a loan.

zh: 虽然网上银行很方便，但是很多老人还是喜欢去银行办事。
pinyin: Suīrán wǎngshang yínháng hěn fāngbiàn, dànshi hěnduō lǎorén háishi xǐhuān qù yínháng bànshì.
en: Although online banking is convenient, many elderly people still prefer to handle things in person at the bank.

zh: 为了提高竞争力，许多小银行开始提供更灵活的利率和服务。
pinyin: Wèile tígāo jìngzhēnglì, xǔduō xiǎo yínháng kāishǐ tígōng gèng línghuó de lìlǜ hé fúwù.
en: To enhance their competitiveness, many smaller banks have started offering more flexible interest rates and services.

zh: 这个电影很恐怖。
pinyin: Zhège diànyǐng hěn kǒngbù.
en: This movie is really scary.

zh: 昨天晚上我看了一个恐怖的故事。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ kànle yīge kǒngbù de gùshì.
en: Last night I read a horror story.

zh: 因为天气很暗，他走在街上的时候感到恐怖。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn àn, tā zǒu zài jiēshang de shíhou gǎndào kǒngbù.
en: Because it was so dark out, he felt afraid walking down the street.

zh: 那场恐怖袭击让整个城市的人都感到不安全。
pinyin: Nà chǎng kǒngbù xíjī ràng zhěnggè chéngshì de rén dōu gǎndào búānquán.
en: That terrorist attack made everyone in the city feel unsafe.

zh: 媒体对恐怖主义的报道往往会引起公众的恐慌和焦虑。
pinyin: Méitǐ duì kǒngbù zhǔyì de bàodào wǎngwǎng huì yǐnqǐ gōngzhòng de kǒnghuàng hé jiāolǜ.
en: Media coverage of terrorism often causes public panic and anxiety.

zh: 我吃尽了所有饭。
pinyin: Wǒ chījìnle suǒyǒu fàn.
en: I ate all the rice.

zh: 昨天我尽力做完了作业。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ jìnlì zuòwánle zuòyè.
en: Yesterday I did my best to finish my homework.

zh: 虽然很难，但是他尽管努力去学中文。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dànshì tā jìnguǎn nǔlì qù xué Zhōngwén.
en: Although it's difficult, he still tries hard to study Chinese anyway.

zh: 这家公司尽快地改进了服务质量，所以顾客更满意了。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī jìnkuài de gǎijìnle fúwù zhìliàng, suǒyǐ gùkè gèng mǎnyìle.
en: The company improved its service quality as quickly as possible, so customers became more satisfied.

zh: 虽然资源有限，管理者仍然尽力为员工提供更好的工作环境。
pinyin: Suīrán zīyuán yǒuxiàn, guǎnlǐzhě réngrán jìnlì wèi yuángōng tígōng gèng hǎo de gōngzuò huánjìng.
en: Though resources are limited, managers still do their best to provide employees with a better work environment.

zh: 原来你在这里。
pinyin: Yuánlái nǐ zài zhèlǐ.
en: Oh, so you were here all along.

zh: 原来他昨天没有来上班。
pinyin: Yuánlái tā zuótiān méiyǒu lái shàngbān.
en: I see—he didn't come to work yesterday.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但原来他一直想帮我们。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn yuánlái tā yīzhí xiǎng bāng wǒmen.
en: Although he's been busy, it turns out he's always wanted to help us.

zh: 原来那个问题我们早就解决过，只是大家都忘记了。
pinyin: Yuánlái nàge wèntí wǒmen zǎo jiù jiějué guò, zhǐshì dàjiā dōu wàngjì le.
en: Turns out we solved that problem long ago—we just all forgot about it.

zh: 原来他之前的沉默并不是生气，而是在思考如何更好地表达自己的想法。
pinyin: Yuánlái tā zhīqián de chénmò búshì shēngqì, érshì zài sīkǎo rúhé gèng hǎo de biǎodá zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
en: It turns out his silence before wasn't him being angry—he was actually thinking about how to express his thoughts better.

zh: 警官很高。
pinyin: Jǐngguān hěn gāo.
en: The police officer is very tall.

zh: 那个警官今天在学校。
pinyin: Nàge jǐngguān jīntiān zài xuéxiào.
en: That police officer is at school today.

zh: 因为有坏人，所以警官来了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu huàirén, suǒyǐ jǐngguān lái le.
en: Because there was a bad person, the police officer came.

zh: 那位警官虽然很忙，但还是帮了我们。
pinyin: Nàwèi jǐngguān suīrán hěn máng, dàn háishi bāng le wǒmen.
en: Even though that police officer was very busy, he still helped us.

zh: 这个警官因为工作表现突出，所以被提升为队长了。
pinyin: Zhège jǐngguān yīnwèi gōngzuò biǎoxiàn túchū, suǒyǐ bèi tíshēng wéi duìzhǎng le.
en: This police officer was promoted to squad leader because he had outstanding job performance.

zh: 她穿的衣服很性感。
pinyin: Tā chuān de yīfu hěn xìnggǎn.
en: The clothes she's wearing are very sexy.

zh: 这个女演员很性感，所以很受欢迎。
pinyin: Zhège nǚ yǎnyuànyuán hěn xìnggǎn, suǒyǐ hěn shòu huānyíng.
en: This actress is really sexy, so she's very popular.

zh: 虽然她的打扮很性感，但是她的气质更吸引人。
pinyin: Suīrán tā de dǎban hěn xìnggǎn, dànshì tā de qìzhì gèng xīyǐnrén.
en: Although her style is quite sexy, her overall vibe is actually more attractive.

zh: 现在很多品牌都用性感的广告来吸引年轻消费者。
pinyin: Xiànzài hěnduō pǐnpái dōu yòng xìnggǎn de guǎnggào lái xīyǐnrán niánqīng xiāofèizhě.
en: Nowadays many brands use sexy advertising to attract younger consumers.

zh: 他认为性感的外表和真实的内涵同样重要，不能厚此薄彼。
pinyin: Tā rènwéi xìnggǎn de wàibiǎo hé zhēnshí de nèikuàn tóngyàng zhòngyào, búnéng hòucǐ báobǐ.
en: He believes that a sexy appearance and genuine character are equally important—you can't value one over the other.

zh: 他想自杀。
pinyin: Tā xiǎng zìshā.
en: He wants to kill himself.

zh: 那个人昨天想自杀，很危险。
pinyin: Nàge rén zuótiān xiǎng zìshā, hěn wēixiǎn.
en: That person tried to kill himself yesterday—it was very dangerous.

zh: 因为他很难受，所以他想自杀。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn nánshòu, suǒyǐ tā xiǎng zìshā.
en: Because he was suffering so much, he wanted to end his life.

zh: 很多抑郁症患者会有自杀的念头。
pinyin: Hěnduō yìyù zhèng huànzhě huì yǒu zìshā de niàntou.
en: Many people with depression have thoughts of suicide.

zh: 研究表明，缺乏社会支持的人更容易产生自杀倾向。
pinyin: Yánjiū biǎomíng, quēfá shèhuì zhīchí de rén gèng róngyì chǎnshēng zìshā qīngxiàng.
en: Research shows that people lacking social support are more prone to suicidal tendencies.

zh: 我喜欢去酒吧。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān qù jiǔbā.
en: I like going to bars.

zh: 昨天晚上我在酒吧喝了啤酒。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ zài jiǔbā hēle píjiǔ.
en: Last night I had a beer at the bar.

zh: 因为工作很累，所以我经常去酒吧放松。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò hěn lèi, suǒyǐ wǒ jīngcháng qù jiǔbā fàngsōng.
en: Because work is tiring, I often go to bars to relax.

zh: 这家酒吧的音乐很好听，我每周都会去。
pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔbā de yīnyuè hěn hǎotīng, wǒ měi zhōu dōu huì qù.
en: The music at this bar is really good, so I go every week.

zh: 虽然酒吧里人很多，但是这里的调酒师很专业，值得一来。
pinyin: Suīrán jiǔbā lǐ rén hěn duō, dànshì zhèlǐ de tiáojiǔshī hěn zhuānyè, zhíde yī lái.
en: Although the bar gets crowded, the bartenders here are really skilled—it's worth a visit.

zh: 我们讨论吃什么。
pinyin: Wǒmen tǎolùn chī shénme.
en: We're discussing what to eat.

zh: 昨天我和朋友讨论了这个问题。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hé péngyou tǎolùnle zhège wèntí.
en: Yesterday my friend and I talked about this issue.

zh: 因为时间不够，我们没有讨论所有的计划。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shíjiān búgòu, wǒmen méiyǒu tǎolùn suǒyǒu de jìhuà.
en: Because we didn't have enough time, we didn't discuss all the plans.

zh: 虽然意见不同，但是团队还是认真讨论了每个建议。
pinyin: Suīrán yìjiàn búgòng, dànshì tuánduì háishi rènzhēn tǎolùnle měi ge jiànyì.
en: Although they had different opinions, the team still seriously discussed each suggestion.

zh: 在会议上，大家热烈讨论了这个新产品的市场前景和可能遇到的挑战。
pinyin: Zài huìyì shang, dàjiā règuó tǎolùnle zhège xīn chǎnpǐn de shìchǎng qiánjǐng hé kěnéng yùdào de tiǎozhàn.
en: During the meeting, everyone had a lively discussion about the market prospects and potential challenges of this new product.

zh: 我喜欢苹果，他同样喜欢。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān píngguǒ, tā tónyàng xǐhuān.
en: I like apples, and he likes them too.

zh: 昨天很冷，今天同样很冷。
pinyin: Zuótiān hěn lěng, jīntiān tónyàng hěn lěng.
en: Yesterday was cold, and today is just as cold.

zh: 虽然这个工作很难，但同样很有意思。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège gōngzuò hěn nán, dàn tónyàng hěn yǒu yìsi.
en: Although this job is difficult, it's equally interesting.

zh: 大城市的生活成本高，小城市同样面临这个问题。
pinyin: Dà chéngshì de shēnghuó chéngběn gāo, xiǎo chéngshì tónyàng miànlín zhège wèntí.
en: The cost of living is high in big cities, and smaller cities face the same issue.

zh: 技术进步很重要，但同样重要的是如何负责任地使用它。
pinyin: Jìshù jìnbù hěn zhòngyào, dàn tónyàng zhòngyào de shì rúhé fùzérènwù de shǐyòng tā.
en: Technological advancement is important, but equally crucial is how we use it responsibly.

zh: 我的身份是学生。
pinyin: Wǒ de shēnfèn shì xuésheng.
en: My identity is a student.

zh: 他的身份很特殊，是公司的经理。
pinyin: Tā de shēnfèn hěn tèshū, shì gōngsī de jīnglǐ.
en: His position is quite special—he's the company manager.

zh: 因为身份不同，所以他们的工作也不一样。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shēnfèn búdòng, suǒyǐ tāmen de gōngzuò yě búyīyàng.
en: Because they have different roles, their jobs are also different.

zh: 虽然他改变了身份，但大家还是认出了他。
pinyin: Suīrán tā gǎibiàn le shēnfèn, dàn dàjiā háishi rènchū le tā.
en: Although he changed his identity, everyone still recognized him.

zh: 在这次活动中，她既是参与者，又以评委的身份参加。
pinyin: Zài zhè cì huódòng zhōng, tā jìshi cānyùzhě, yòu yǐ píngwěi de shēnfèn cānjiā.
en: At this event, she served as both a participant and a judge.

zh: 这个说明书很简单。
pinyin: Zhège shuōmíngshū hěn jiǎndān.
en: This instruction manual is very simple.

zh: 老师说明了这个语法规则。
pinyin: Lǎoshī shuōmíng le zhège yǔfǎ guīzé.
en: The teacher explained this grammar rule.

zh: 虽然他没来，但他的邮件说明了原因。
pinyin: Suīrán tā méi lái, dàn tāde yóujiàn shuōmíng le yuányīn.
en: Although he didn't come, his email explained the reason.

zh: 这份报告的数据充分说明了我们的进展。
pinyin: Zhèn fèn bàogào de shùjù chōngfèn shuōmíng le wǒmen de jìnzhǎn.
en: The data in this report clearly demonstrates our progress.

zh: 最近的销售额说明了消费者对新产品的热情。
pinyin: Zuìjìn de xiāoshòué shuōmíng le xiāofèizhě duì xīn chǎnpǐn de règíng.
en: Recent sales figures illustrate consumers' enthusiasm for the new product.

zh: 你的书包是什么样的？
pinyin: Nǐ de shūbāo shì什么样 de?
en: What does your backpack look like?

zh: 今天的天气什么样？很冷吗？
pinyin: Jīntiān de tiānqì什么样? Hěn lěng ma?
en: How's the weather today? Is it very cold?

zh: 虽然我没去过，但我想知道那个城市什么样。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ méi qùguo, dàn wǒ xiǎng zhīdào nàge chéngshì什么样.
en: I've never been there, but I'd like to know what that city is like.

zh: 如果你想找工作，首先要了解公司什么样的文化。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng zhǎo gōngzuò, shǒuxiān yào liǎojiě gōngsī什么样 de wénhuà.
en: If you want to find a job, you need to first understand what kind of culture the company has.

zh: 现在的年轻人什么样的生活方式才能算成功，标准差别很大。
pinyin: Xiànzài de niánqīngrén什么样 de shēnghuó fāngshì cái néng suàn chénggōng, biāozhǔn chābié hěn dà.
en: There's no single definition of what lifestyle makes a young person successful these days—the standards vary widely.

zh: 图书馆很安静。
pinyin: Túshūguǎn hěn ānJìng.
en: The library is very quiet.

zh: 晚上房间里很安静，我可以睡觉。
pinyin: Wǎnshang fángjiān lǐ hěn ānJìng, wǒ kěyǐ shuìjiào.
en: The room is quiet in the evening, so I can sleep.

zh: 虽然外面很吵，但是这个教室里很安静。
pinyin: Suīrán wàimiàn hěn chāo, dànshì zhège jiàoshì lǐ hěn ānJìng.
en: Even though it's noisy outside, this classroom is very quiet.

zh: 为了专注学习，学生们都保持安静，没有人说话。
pinyin: Wèile zhuānzhù xuéxí, xuéshengmen dōu bǎochí ānJìng, méiyǒu rén shuōhuà.
en: In order to focus on studying, the students all stayed quiet and nobody spoke.

zh: 自从搬到乡村以后，我就特别喜欢这里安静的环境，远离了城市的喧嚣。
pinyin: Zìcóng bānDào xiāngcūn yǐhòu, wǒ jiù tèbié xǐhuān zhèlǐ ānJìng de huánjìng, yuǎnlí le chéngshì de xuānxiāo.
en: Since moving to the countryside, I've really come to love the peaceful environment here, far away from the hustle and bustle of the city.

zh: 这是一个岛。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè dǎo.
en: This is an island.

zh: 我们昨天去了一个美丽的岛。
pinyin: Wǒmen zuótiān qùle yī gè měilì de dǎo.
en: We went to a beautiful island yesterday.

zh: 虽然这个岛很小,但是那里有很多有趣的地方。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège dǎo hěn xiǎo, dànshì nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō yǒuqù de dìfang.
en: Although the island is small, there are many interesting places there.

zh: 因为那个岛距离城市比较远,所以游客不太多。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nàge dǎo jùl离 chéngshì bǐjiào yuǎn, suǒyǐ yóukè búbú duō.
en: Because that island is quite far from the city, there aren't many tourists.

zh: 这个岛屿拥有丰富的海洋资源,吸引了许多研究人员前来调查。
pinyin: Zhège dǎoyǔ yōngyǒu fēngfù de hǎiyáng zīyuán, xīyǐnle xǔduō yánjiū rényuán qiánlái diàochá.
en: This island has abundant marine resources, which has attracted many researchers to come investigate.

zh: 她是一个模特。
pinyin: Tā shì yīgè móutè.
en: She is a model.

zh: 这个模特很漂亮，很受欢迎。
pinyin: Zhège móutè hěn piàoliang, hěn shòu huānyíng.
en: This model is very pretty and popular.

zh: 因为她很高，所以她能做模特的工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn gāo, suǒyǐ tā néng zuò móutè de gōngzuò.
en: Because she is tall, she can work as a model.

zh: 虽然做模特挣钱不少，但是工作压力也很大。
pinyin: Suīrán zuò móutè zhèngqián búshǎo, búguò gōngzuò yālì yě hěn dà.
en: Although modeling pays well, the job pressure is also quite high.

zh: 想成为专业模特需要持之以恒的训练和健康的生活方式。
pinyin: Xiǎng chéngwéi zhuānyè móutè xūyào chízhī yǐ héng de xùnliàn hé jiànkāng de shēnghuó fāngshì.
en: Becoming a professional model requires consistent training and a healthy lifestyle.

zh: 这个苹果多么红啊！
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ duōme hóng a!
en: This apple is so red!

zh: 昨天的天气多么冷，我穿了很厚的衣服。
pinyin: Zuótiān de tiānqì duōme lěng, wǒ chuānle hěn hòu de yīfu.
en: Yesterday was so cold that I wore really thick clothes.

zh: 虽然这道菜很便宜，但是味道多么好啊！
pinyin: Suīrán zhè dào cài hěn piányi, dànshì wèidào duōme hǎo a!
en: Even though this dish is cheap, the flavor is so delicious!

zh: 看到他成功的时候，我能感受到他多么开心。
pinyin: Kàndào tā chénggōng de shíhou, wǒ néng gǎnshòudào tā duōme kāixīn.
en: When I saw him succeed, I could really feel how happy he was.

zh: 经过这么多年的努力，他终于明白了坚持多么重要。
pinyin: Jīngguò zhème duō nián de nǔlì, tā zhōngyú míngbaile jiānchí duōme zhòngyào.
en: After so many years of effort, he finally understood just how important persistence is.

zh: 这些米足够吃。
pinyin: Zhèxiē mǐ zúgòu chī.
en: This rice is enough to eat.

zh: 我有足够的钱买书。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu zúgòu de qián mǎi shū.
en: I have enough money to buy books.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但是他足够了解这个问题。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì tā zúgòu liǎojiě zhège wèntí.
en: Although he's very busy, he understands this problem well enough.

zh: 因为准备时间足够，所以我们能做出更好的计划。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhǔnbèi shíjiān zúgòu, suǒyǐ wǒmen néng zuòchū gèng hǎo de jìhuà.
en: Because we had enough preparation time, we were able to make a better plan.

zh: 只要信息足够透明，消费者就能做出更理性的购物决定。
pinyin: Zhǐyào xìnxī zúgòu tòumíng, xiāofèizhě jiù néng zuòchū gèng lǐxìng de gòuwù juéding.
en: As long as information is transparent enough, consumers can make more rational purchasing decisions.

zh: 我很饿。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn饿。
en: I'm very hungry.

zh: 早上我没吃饭，现在很饿。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ méi chīfàn, xiànzài hěn饿。
en: I didn't eat breakfast this morning, so I'm really hungry now.

zh: 因为下午一直在工作，所以现在特别饿。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàwǔ yìzhí zài gōngzuò, suǒyǐ xiànzài tèbié饿。
en: Because I've been working all afternoon, I'm especially hungry right now.

zh: 他虽然刚吃过午饭，但一个小时后又饿了。
pinyin: Tā suīrán gāng chīguò wǔfàn, dàn yī gè xiǎoshí hòu yòu饿 le。
en: Even though he just had lunch, he got hungry again an hour later.

zh: 长时间没有进食会导致身体饿得难受，甚至影响工作效率。
pinyin: Cháng shíjiān méiyǒu jìnshí huì dǎozhì shēntǐ饿 de nánshòu, shènzhì yǐngxiǎng gōngzuò xiàolǜ。
en: Going without food for extended periods makes your body feel uncomfortably hungry and can even affect your work performance.

zh: 这是学生。
pinyin: Zhè shì xuésheng.
en: This is a student.

zh: 今天学生在学校。
pinyin: Jīntiān xuésheng zài xuéxiào.
en: The students are at school today.

zh: 因为明天有考试，所以学生都在复习。
pinyin: Yīnwèi míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì, suǒyǐ xuésheng dōu zài fùxí.
en: Because there's a test tomorrow, the students are all reviewing.

zh: 虽然这个学生很聪明，但是他经常不做功课。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège xuésheng hěn cōngming, dànshì tā jīngcháng búzuò gōngkè.
en: Although this student is very smart, he often doesn't do his homework.

zh: 许多学生毕业后才意识到，在学校的时光其实很珍贵。
pinyin: Xǔduō xuésheng bìyè hòu cái yìshí dào, zài xuéxiào de shíguāng qīshí hěn zhēnguì.
en: Many students only realize after graduation that their school years were actually precious.

zh: 这是红苹果。
pinyin: Zhè shì hóng píngguǒ.
en: This is a red apple.

zh: 她今天穿了一条红裙子。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān chuānle yī tiáo hóng qúnzi.
en: She wore a red skirt today.

zh: 因为喜欢红色，所以我买了这个红帽子。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xǐhuān hóng sè, suǒyǐ wǒ mǎile zhège hóng màozi.
en: Because I like the color red, I bought this red hat.

zh: 虽然这件红衣服很漂亮，但是我觉得有点贵。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiàn hóng yīfu hěn piàoliang, dànshi wǒ juéde yǒudiǎn guì.
en: Although this red garment is really pretty, I think it's a bit expensive.

zh: 他脸红了，因为在众人面前犯了一个很尴尬的错误。
pinyin: Tā liǎn hóngle, yīnwèi zài zhòngrén miànqián fànle yī ge hěn gāngà de cuòwù.
en: His face turned red because he made an awkward mistake in front of everyone.

zh: 我喜欢吃鸡。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān chī jī.
en: I like to eat chicken.

zh: 昨天我妈妈买了一只鸡。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ māma mǎi le yī zhī jī.
en: Yesterday my mom bought a chicken.

zh: 因为今天有客人，所以爸爸去买鸡做晚饭。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān yǒu kèrén, suǒyǐ bàba qù mǎi jī zuò wǎnfàn.
en: Because we have guests today, dad went to buy chicken for dinner.

zh: 虽然这家餐厅的鸡比较贵，但是味道确实很不错。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiā cāntīng de jī bǐjiào guì, dànshì wèidào quèshí hěn búcuò.
en: Although the chicken at this restaurant is rather expensive, the flavor is actually really good.

zh: 我们经常在家里自己腌制鸡，这样既能节省成本，又能吃得更放心。
pinyin: Wǒmen jīngcháng zài jiālǐ zìjǐ yānzhì jī, zhèyàng jì néng jiéshěng chéngběn, yòu néng chīde gèng fàngxin.
en: We often marinate chicken at home ourselves, which not only saves money but also lets us eat with more peace of mind.

zh: 我养一只猫。
pinyin: Wǒ yǎng yī zhī māo.
en: I have a cat.

zh: 他每天都养鱼和养花。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu yǎng yú hé yǎng huā.
en: He keeps fish and plants every day.

zh: 因为她喜欢狗，所以她养了一条大狗。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā xǐhuān gǒu, suǒyǐ tā yǎngle yī tiáo dà gǒu.
en: Because she loves dogs, she got a big one.

zh: 养宠物需要花很多时间和金钱，但是很多人还是决定养。
pinyin: Yǎng chǒngwù xūyào huā hěn duō shíjiān hé jīnqián, búguò hěn duō rén háishi juédìng yǎng.
en: Keeping pets takes lots of time and money, yet many people still decide to have them.

zh: 现在越来越多的年轻人选择养宠物，这反映了他们对生活质量的追求。
pinyin: Xiànzài yuèláiyuè duō de niánqīng rén xuǎnzé yǎng chǒngwù, zhè fǎnyìngle tāmen duì shēnghuó zhìliàng de zhuīqiú.
en: Nowadays more and more young people choose to keep pets, which reflects their pursuit of a better quality of life.

zh: 下午我吃饭。
pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǒ chīfàn.
en: I eat in the afternoon.

zh: 下午两点我去学校。
pinyin: Xiàwǔ liǎngdiǎn wǒ qù xuéxiào.
en: I go to school at two o'clock in the afternoon.

zh: 因为下午有课，所以我不能去公园。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàwǔ yǒu kè, suǒyǐ wǒ búnéng qù gōngyuán.
en: Because I have class in the afternoon, I can't go to the park.

zh: 下午的会议推迟了，我们改到明天进行。
pinyin: Xiàwǔ de huìyì tuīchíle, wǒmen gǎi dào míngtiān jìnxíng.
en: The afternoon meeting was postponed, so we rescheduled it for tomorrow.

zh: 下午接到客户电话后，我立即调整了工作计划。
pinyin: Xiàwǔ jiēdào kèhù diànhuà hòu, wǒ lìjí tiáozhěngle gōngzuò jìhuà.
en: After receiving a call from the client in the afternoon, I immediately adjusted my work schedule.

zh: 他仍然喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Tā réngrán xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: He still likes to eat rice.

zh: 下雨了，我仍然要去上班。
pinyin: Xiàyǔ le, wǒ réngrán yào qù shàngbān.
en: It's raining, but I still have to go to work.

zh: 虽然很累，但是他仍然坚持跑步。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì tā réngrán jiānchí pǎobù.
en: Even though he was tired, he still kept running.

zh: 经过了这么多年，他对这份工作仍然很有热情。
pinyin: Jīngguò le zhème duō nián, tā duì zhè fèn gōngzuò réngrán hěn yǒu règíng.
en: After all these years, he still has a lot of passion for this job.

zh: 尽管技术在不断进步，许多人仍然习惯用老办法。
pinyin: Jìnguǎn jìshù zài búduàn jìnbù, xǔduō rén réngrán xíguàn yòng lǎo bànfǎ.
en: Despite constant technological advancement, many people still prefer to use the old methods.

zh: 一旦下雨，我们就在家。
pinyin: Yīdàn xiàyǔ, wǒmen jiù zài jiā.
en: Once it rains, we stay at home.

zh: 一旦你吃了早饭，就可以去上学了。
pinyin: Yīdàn nǐ chīle zǎofàn, jiù kěyǐ qù shàngxué le.
en: As soon as you've had breakfast, you can go to school.

zh: 虽然天气很好，但是一旦开始下雪，我们就不能出门了。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn hǎo, dànshì yīdàn kāishǐ xiàxuě, wǒmen jiù búnéng chūmén le.
en: Although the weather is nice, once it starts snowing, we can't go outside.

zh: 一旦你决定了这个工作，就要认真去做，不能半途而废。
pinyin: Yīdàn nǐ juédìngle zhège gōngzuò, jiù yào rènzhēn qù zuò, búnéng bàntúérhéi.
en: Once you've committed to this job, you need to take it seriously and not give up halfway.

zh: 一旦失去了信任，要重新建立起来就难上加难，这是做人的基本道理。
pinyin: Yīdàn shīqùle xìnrèn, yào chóngxīn jiànlì qǐlái jiù nán shàng jiā nán, zhè shì zuòrén de jīběn dàolǐ.
en: Once trust is lost, rebuilding it becomes exponentially harder—that's just a basic truth about relationships.

zh: 我在追一只猫。
pinyin: Wǒ zài zhuī yī zhī māo.
en: I'm chasing a cat.

zh: 昨天我追了很久的公交车。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zhuīle hěnjiǔ de gōngjiāochē.
en: Yesterday I ran after the bus for a long time.

zh: 因为喜欢这个明星，所以很多粉丝都在追他的新电影。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xǐhuān zhège míngxīng, suǒyǐ hěnduō fěnsī dōu zài zhuī tā de xīn diànyǐng.
en: Because they like this celebrity, many fans keep following his new movies.

zh: 虽然追了三年的梦想，但他最后还是决定换个方向。
pinyin: Suīrán zhuīle sān nián de mèngxiǎng, dàn tā zuìhòu háishi juédìng huàn ge fāngxiàng.
en: Although he pursued that dream for three years, he ultimately decided to change direction.

zh: 不少年轻人为了追求高薪资，往往忽视了工作和生活的平衡。
pinyin: Búshǎo niánqīngrén wèile zhuīqiú gāo xīnzīliào, wǎngwǎng hūshìle gōngzuò hé shēnghuó de pínghéng.
en: Many young people chasing higher salaries often overlook the balance between work and life.

zh: 他的动作很快。
pinyin: Tā de dòngzuò hěn kuài.
en: His movements are very fast.

zh: 每天早上我做同样的动作。
pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang wǒ zuò tóngyàng de dòngzuò.
en: I do the same movements every morning.

zh: 虽然他的动作不标准，但是他很努力。
pinyin: Suīrán tā de dòngzuò bù biāozhǔn, dànshì tā hěn nǔlì.
en: Although his technique isn't perfect, he tries really hard.

zh: 教练指出了我在跳舞时动作不协调的问题。
pinyin: Jiàoliàn zhǐchūle wǒ zài tiàowǔ shí dòngzuò bù xiétiáo de wèntí.
en: The coach pointed out that my movements lacked coordination while dancing.

zh: 要想在运动中取得进步，关键是把每个动作都做到位。
pinyin: Yào xiǎng zài yùndòng zhōng qǔdé jìnbù, guānjiàn shì bǎ měi ge dòngzuò dōu zuòdào wèi.
en: If you want to improve at sports, the key is making sure every movement is executed properly.

zh: 谢谢你的帮助。
pinyin: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù.
en: Thank you for your help.

zh: 昨天你给了我一个礼物，我很感谢。
pinyin: Zuótiān nǐ gěile wǒ yī ge lǐwù, wǒ hěn gǎnxiè.
en: You gave me a gift yesterday, and I really appreciate it.

zh: 因为你们的支持，所以我想表示感谢。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nǐmen de zhīchí, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng biǎoshì gǎnxiè.
en: Because of your support, I want to express my gratitude.

zh: 虽然这个项目很困难，但大家都没有谢绝参与。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège xiàngmù hěn kùnnan, dàn dàjiā dōu méiyǒu xièjué cānyù.
en: Although the project was challenging, everyone agreed to participate without refusing.

zh: 他对批评不仅没有谢绝，反而虚心接纳了员工的建议。
pinyin: Tā duì píngpíng bújǐn méiyǒu xièjué, fǎn'ér xūxīn jiēnà le yuángōng de jiànyì.
en: Not only did he not reject the criticism, but he humbly accepted the employees' suggestions.

zh: 下雨意味着不能去公园。
pinyin: Xiàyǔ yìwèizháo búnéng qù gōngyuán.
en: Rain means we can't go to the park.

zh: 他明天要工作，意味着他今天不能出去玩。
pinyin: Tā míngtiān yào gōngzuò, yìwèizháo tā jīntiān búnéng chūqu wán.
en: He has to work tomorrow, which means he can't go out and have fun today.

zh: 虽然天气很冷，但这意味着我们可以去滑冰。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, dàn zhè yìwèizháo wǒmen kěyǐ qù huábīng.
en: Although the weather is very cold, this means we can go ice skating.

zh: 公司决定关闭这个工厂，意味着很多员工会失去工作。
pinyin: Gōngsī juéding guānbì zhège gōngchǎng, yìwèizháo hěnduō yuángōng huì shīqu gōngzuò.
en: The company's decision to close this factory means many employees will lose their jobs.

zh: 他辞去了稳定的工作，意味着他愿意承担更多风险来追求梦想。
pinyin: Tā cíqu le wěndìng de gōngzuò, yìwèizháo tā yuànyì chéngdān gèngduō fēngxiǎn lái zhuīqiú梦xiǎng.
en: His resignation from a stable job shows he's willing to take greater risks in pursuit of his dreams.

zh: 我受到了表扬。
pinyin: Wǒ shòudào le biǎoyáng.
en: I received praise.

zh: 昨天我受到了老师的帮助。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ shòudào le lǎoshī de bāngzhù.
en: Yesterday the teacher helped me.

zh: 因为下雨，比赛受到了影响。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, bǐsài shòudào le yǐngxiǎng.
en: Because of the rain, the match was affected.

zh: 这个项目受到了很多投资者的关注。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù shòudào le hěnduō tóuzīzhě de guānzhù.
en: This project has attracted a lot of investor attention.

zh: 尽管面临挑战，公司的新产品还是受到了市场的认可。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn miànlín tiǎozhàn, gōngsī de xīn chǎnpǐn háishi shòudào le shìchǎng de rènkě.
en: Despite facing challenges, the company's new product still gained market recognition.

zh: 一群鸭子在水里。
pinyin: Yī qún yāzi zài shuǐ lǐ.
en: A flock of ducks is in the water.

zh: 昨天我看到一群小孩在公园里玩。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ kàndào yī qún xiǎo háizi zài gōngyuán lǐ wán.
en: Yesterday I saw a group of children playing in the park.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以一群人去山上爬山。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ yī qún rén qù shānshang páshān.
en: Because the weather was so nice, a bunch of people went hiking up the mountain.

zh: 这群学生虽然来自不同的国家，但是他们相处得很融洽。
pinyin: Zhè qún xuésheng suīrán láizì búntóng de guójiā, dànshi tāmen xiāngchǔ de hěn rónghè.
en: Although these students come from different countries, they get along really well.

zh: 那群员工对新政策的反应不一，有人支持，有人则表示担忧。
pinyin: Nà qún yuángōng duì xīn zhèngcè de fǎnyìng búyī, yǒurén zhīchí, yǒurén zé biǎoshì dānyōu.
en: That group of employees had mixed reactions to the new policy—some were supportive while others expressed concern.

zh: 苹果是我最喜欢的水果之一。
pinyin: Píngguǒ shì wǒ zuì xǐhuān de shuǐguǒ zhī yī.
en: Apples are one of my favorite fruits.

zh: 中国是世界上人口最多的国家之一。
pinyin: Zhōngguó shì shìjiè shang rénkǒu zuì duō de guójiā zhī yī.
en: China is one of the most populous countries in the world.

zh: 虽然他很年轻，但他已经成为公司最重要的员工之一。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn niánqīng, dànshì tā yǐjīng chéngwéi gōngsī zuì zhòngyào de yuángōng zhī yī.
en: Although he's quite young, he's already become one of the company's most important employees.

zh: 这部电影因为故事精彩而获得了许多观众的喜爱，成为今年的热门电影之一。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng yīnwèi gùshì jīngcǎi ér huòdéle xǔduō guāny众 de xǐ'ài, chéngwéi jīnnián de règmén diànyǐng zhī yī.
en: This film has become one of this year's hit movies because its story is so compelling and audiences love it.

zh: 他在学术界的地位不断提升，现在已经是这个领域的权威专家之一。
pinyin: Tā zài xuéshù jiè de dìwèi búduàn tíshēng, xiànzài yǐjīng shì zhège lǐngyù de quánwēi zhuānjiā zhī yī.
en: His standing in academia keeps growing, and he's now become one of the leading experts in this field.

zh: 因为下雨，我们在家。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒmen zàijiā.
en: Because it's raining, we're staying at home.

zh: 他因为生病今天没有来上课。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi shēngbìng jīntiān méiyǒu lái shàngkè.
en: He didn't come to class today because he's sick.

zh: 虽然这很困难，但我因为喜欢所以还是要试试。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè hěn kùnnan, dàn wǒ yīnwèi xǐhuān suǒyǐ háishi yào shìshi.
en: Even though it's difficult, I want to try anyway because I like it.

zh: 这个项目因为缺少资金而被迫延期了两个月。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù yīnwèi quēshǎo zījīn érběi pòpoǐ yánqī le liǎng ge yuè.
en: The project was forced to be postponed for two months due to lack of funding.

zh: 他因祸得福，失业后反而找到了更好的工作机会。
pinyin: Tā yīnhuò défú, shīyè hòu fǎn'ér zhǎodào le gèng hǎo de gōngzuò jīhuì.
en: He turned a misfortune into a blessing—losing that job actually led him to a better opportunity.

zh: 我们约了明天见面。
pinyin: Wǒmen yuēle míngtiān jiànmiàn.
en: We made plans to meet tomorrow.

zh: 他约我这个周末去吃饭。
pinyin: Tā yuē wǒ zhège zhōumò qù chīfàn.
en: He asked me to go out for dinner this weekend.

zh: 因为下雨，我们约好改到明天下午。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒmen yuēhǎo gǎidào míngtiān xiàwǔ.
en: Because of the rain, we rescheduled our plans to tomorrow afternoon.

zh: 他经常迟到，所以我们约他的时候通常提前半小时。
pinyin: Tā jīngcháng chídào, suǒyǐ wǒmen yuē tā de shíhou tōngcháng tíqián bàn xiǎoshí.
en: Since he's always late, we usually tell him to come half an hour earlier when we make plans.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但我们还是约定每个月至少见一次面。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn wǒmen háishi yuēdìng měi ge yuè zhìshǎo jiàn yī cì miàn.
en: Despite our busy schedules, we've agreed to see each other at least once a month.

zh: 第三个苹果是红的。
pinyin: Dì sān ge píngguǒ shì hóng de.
en: The third apple is red.

zh: 今天第三节课是英语。
pinyin: Jīntiān dì sān jié kè shì yīngyǔ.
en: English is the third class today.

zh: 虽然第一和第二都不错，但第三个最便宜。
pinyin: Suīrán dì yī hé dì èr dōu búcuò, dàn dì sān ge zuì piányi.
en: Although the first and second aren't bad, the third one is the cheapest.

zh: 他在第三次申请的时候才被公司录用了。
pinyin: Tā zài dì sān cì shēnqǐng de shíhou cái bèi gōngsī lùyòngle.
en: He only got hired by the company on his third application attempt.

zh: 这是我们第三次合作，对方的工作态度比前两次好得多。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒmen dì sān cì hézuò, duìfang de gōngzuò tàidu bǐ qián liǎng cì hǎo de duō.
en: This is our third collaboration, and the other party's work attitude is much better than the previous two times.

zh: 我要赶上班。
pinyin: Wǒ yào gǎn shàng bān.
en: I need to hurry to work.

zh: 明天早上我要赶火车。
pinyin: Míngtiān zǎoshang wǒ yào gǎn huǒchē.
en: Tomorrow morning I have to catch a train.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以我赶紧回家。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ wǒ gǎnjǐn huí jiā.
en: Because it started raining, I hurried back home right away.

zh: 虽然很累，但他还是赶完了所有的工作。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì tā háishi gǎnwán le suǒyǒu de gōngzuò.
en: Although he was exhausted, he still managed to finish all his work.

zh: 我们得赶在截止时间前提交这份报告。
pinyin: Wǒmen děi gǎn zài jiēzhǐ shíjiān qián tíjiāo zhè fèn bàogào.
en: We need to get this report submitted before the deadline.

zh: 我面对妈妈。
pinyin: Wǒ miànduì māma.
en: I'm facing my mom.

zh: 明天我要面对一个大考试。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào miànduì yī gè dà kǎoshì.
en: Tomorrow I have to face a big exam.

zh: 虽然很害怕，但我决定面对这个问题。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn hàipà, dàn wǒ juéding miànduì zhège wèntí.
en: Even though I'm scared, I've decided to face this problem.

zh: 失业以后，他不得不面对生活的挑战。
pinyin: Shīyè yǐhòu, tā búděbù miànduì shēnghuó de tiǎozhàn.
en: After losing his job, he had no choice but to face life's challenges.

zh: 面对日益激烈的竞争，许多小公司选择转型。
pinyin: Miànduì rìyì jīliè de jìngjìng, xǔduō xiǎo gōngsī xuǎnzé zhuǎnxíng.
en: Facing increasingly fierce competition, many small companies have chosen to transform.

zh: 我怀疑他吃了我的苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ huáiyí tā chīle wǒ de píngguǒ.
en: I suspect he ate my apple.

zh: 昨天他没来上课，我怀疑他生病了。
pinyin: Zuótiān tā méi lái shàngkè, wǒ huáiyí tā shēngbìng le.
en: He didn't come to class yesterday, so I suspect he's sick.

zh: 虽然他说是意外，但我还是怀疑他故意的。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shuō shì yìwài, dàn wǒ háishi huáiyí tā gùyì de.
en: Although he says it was an accident, I still suspect he did it on purpose.

zh: 这个消息来源不太可靠，所以我对它的真实性产生了怀疑。
pinyin: Zhège xiāoxī láiyuán búduō kě靠, suǒyǐ wǒ duì tā de zhēnshíxìng chǎnshēngle huáiyí.
en: The source of this information isn't very reliable, so I've become doubtful about its authenticity.

zh: 虽然他的解释听起来合理，但我的直觉让我对他的动机产生了怀疑。
pinyin: Suīrán tā de jiěshì tīng qǐlái héhéli, dàn wǒ de zhíjiào ràng wǒ duì tā de dòngjī chǎnshēngle huáiyí.
en: Even though his explanation sounds reasonable, my gut feeling makes me suspicious of his motives.

zh: 请慢一点。
pinyin: Qǐng màn yīdiǎn.
en: Please slow down a bit.

zh: 他走得很慢，所以迟到了。
pinyin: Tā zǒu de hěn màn, suǒyǐ chídào le.
en: He walked so slowly that he ended up being late.

zh: 虽然这辆车很旧，但是开得还是很慢。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè liàng chē hěn jiù, dànshì kāi de háishi hěn màn.
en: Although the car is old, it still drives quite slowly.

zh: 因为网络连接慢，我的视频一直在缓冲。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǎngluò liánjiē màn, wǒ de shìpín yìzhí zài huǎnchōng.
en: Because my internet connection is slow, my video keeps buffering.

zh: 工作效率慢不仅影响了项目进度，也打击了团队的积极性。
pinyin: Gōngzuò xiàolǜ màn búyǐn yǐngxiǎng le xiàngmù jìndù, yě dǎjī le tuánduì de jījíxìng.
en: Slow work efficiency not only affected the project timeline but also dampened the team's motivation.

zh: 他居然不吃米饭。
pinyin: Tā jūrán bù chī mǐfàn.
en: He actually doesn't eat rice.

zh: 今天下雨，她居然还去公园了。
pinyin: Jīntiān xiàyǔ, tā jūrán háishi qù gōngyuán le.
en: It was raining today, but she went to the park anyway.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但居然还记得我的生日。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn jūrán háishi jìde wǒ de shēngrì.
en: Even though he was very busy, he somehow still remembered my birthday.

zh: 这么简单的问题，他居然都答错了。
pinyin: Zhème jiǎndān de wèntí, tā jūrán dōu dácuò le.
en: Such a simple question, and he got it wrong.

zh: 我们都以为他会拒绝，没想到他居然一口答应了。
pinyin: Wǒmen dōu yǐwéi tā huì jùjué, méi xiǎngdào tā jūrán yīkǒu dāying le.
en: We all expected him to refuse, but to our surprise he agreed right away.

zh: 我就要吃饭了。
pinyin: Wǒ jiùyào chīfàn le.
en: I'm about to eat.

zh: 明天就要放假了,我很高兴。
pinyin: Míngtiān jiùyào fàngjià le, wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
en: Tomorrow we're getting time off, and I'm really happy about it.

zh: 因为下雨了,所以比赛就要延期,球员们都很失望。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ bǐsài jiùyào yánqī, qiúyuán men dōu hěn shīwàng.
en: Since it's raining, the match is going to be postponed, and all the players are disappointed.

zh: 虽然项目还没完成,但合同就要失效了,我们必须加快进度。
pinyin: Suīrán xiàngmù háishi méi wánchéng, dàn héTóng jiùyào shīxiào le, wǒmen bìxū jiākuài jìndù.
en: Even though the project isn't finished yet, the contract is about to expire, so we have to speed things up.

zh: 他在公司待了十年,眼看就要升职了,结果却因为一个错误被开除了。
pinyin: Tā zài gōngsī dāi le shí nián, yǎnkàn jiùyào shēngzhí le, jiéguǒ què yīnwèi yīgè cuòwù bèi kāichú le.
en: He'd been at the company for ten years and was on the verge of a promotion, but then he got fired for making one mistake.

zh: 他拒绝了我的邀请。
pinyin: Tā jùjué le wǒ de yāoqǐng.
en: He turned down my invitation.

zh: 昨天她拒绝了那份工作。
pinyin: Zuótiān tā jùjué le nà fèn gōngzuò.
en: She rejected that job offer yesterday.

zh: 虽然薪水很高，但他还是拒绝了。
pinyin: Suīrán xīnshui hěn gāo, dànshì tā háishi jùjué le.
en: Even though the salary was high, he still refused it.

zh: 因为担心隐私问题，许多用户拒绝分享个人信息。
pinyin: Yīnwèi dānxin yǐnsī wèntí, xǔduō yònghù jùjué fēnxiǎng gèrén xìnxī.
en: Worried about privacy, many users refuse to share personal information.

zh: 尽管条件不错，他还是坚决拒绝了这个合作机会。
pinyin: Jìnguǎn tiáojiàn búcuò, tā háishi jiānquè jùjué le zhège hézuò jīhuì.
en: Despite the attractive terms, he firmly declined the partnership opportunity.

zh: 我的家人很好。
pinyin: Wǒ de jiārén hěn hǎo.
en: My family is very nice.

zh: 周末我和家人一起吃饭。
pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ hé jiārén yìqǐ chīfàn.
en: On weekends, I eat meals together with my family.

zh: 因为喜欢家人，所以我经常回家。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xǐhuān jiārén, suǒyǐ wǒ jīngcháng huíjiā.
en: Because I love my family, I go home often.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但我还是会抽时间陪家人。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn wǒ háishi huì chōu shíjiān péi jiārén.
en: Even though work keeps me busy, I still make time to spend with my family.

zh: 无论走到哪里，家人的支持都是我前进的动力。
pinyin: Wúlùn zǒudào nǎlǐ, jiārén de zhīchī dōu shì wǒ qiángjìn de dònglì.
en: No matter where I go, my family's support is what drives me forward.

zh: 昨天下雨打雷了。
pinyin: Zuótiān xiàyǔ dǎléi le.
en: It rained and thundered yesterday.

zh: 夏天经常会打雷和下大雨。
pinyin: Xiàtiān jīngcháng huì dǎléi hé xià dà yǔ.
en: In summer, it often thunders and rains heavily.

zh: 因为外面打雷，所以孩子害怕睡不着。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wàimiàn dǎléi, suǒyǐ háizi hàipà shuì bu zhào.
en: Because it's thundering outside, the child is scared and can't sleep.

zh: 虽然现在还没有雷声，但天气预报说晚上会打雷。
pinyin: Suīrán xiànzài háishi méiyǒu léishēng, dàn tiānqì yùbào shuō wǎnshang huì dǎléi.
en: Although there's no thunder yet, the weather forecast says it will thunder this evening.

zh: 那次暴雨中的雷声特别响，把我们都吓了一跳。
pinyin: Nà cì bàoyǔ zhōng de léishēng tèbié xiǎng, bǎ wǒmen dōu xiàle yī tiào.
en: The thunder during that downpour was unusually loud and startled all of us.

zh: 她是演员。
pinyin: Tā shì yǎnyuán.
en: She is an actress.

zh: 那个演员很有名。
pinyin: Nàge yǎnyuán hěn yǒumíng.
en: That actor is very famous.

zh: 因为她是演员，所以很忙。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā shì yǎnyuán, suǒyǐ hěn máng.
en: Because she's an actress, she's very busy.

zh: 这位演员虽然年纪不大，但演技很不错。
pinyin: Zhè wèi yǎnyuán suīrán niánjì búdà, dàn yǎnjì hěn búcuò.
en: Although this actor isn't very old, their acting skills are quite good.

zh: 许多年轻演员都梦想能在国际电影节上获得认可。
pinyin: Xǔduō niánqīng yǎnyuán dōu mèngxiǎng néng zài guójì diànyǐng jié shang huòdé rènkě.
en: Many young actors dream of getting recognition at international film festivals.

zh: 妈妈在烧饭。
pinyin: Māmā zài shāo fàn.
en: Mom is cooking dinner.

zh: 昨天我烧了一条鱼。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ shāole yī tiáo yú.
en: Yesterday I cooked a fish.

zh: 因为天气冷，他烧了暖气的时候感觉舒服。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì lěng, tā shāole nuǎnqì de shíhou gǎnjuéle shūfu.
en: Because the weather was cold, he felt comfortable when he turned on the heating.

zh: 虽然这道菜有点烧焦了，但是味道还是不错的。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè dào cài yǒudiǎn shāojiāole, búguò wèidào háishi búcuò de.
en: Although this dish is a bit burnt, the flavor is still pretty good.

zh: 经理为了赶上截止日期，把整个项目烧了个底朝天。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ wèile gǎnshang jiēzhǐ rìqī, bǎ zhěnggè xiàngmù shāole ge dǐ cháotiāntiān.
en: To meet the deadline, the manager put the entire project through a complete overhaul.

zh: 这是真实的故事。
pinyin: Zhè shì zhēnshí de gùshì.
en: This is a true story.

zh: 他说的话不是真实的。
pinyin: Tā shuō de huà búshì zhēnshí de.
en: What he said isn't true.

zh: 虽然电影很好看，但故事不太真实。
pinyin: Suīrán diànyǐng hěn hǎokàn, dàn gùshì búhuì zhēnshí.
en: Although the movie is entertaining, the story isn't very realistic.

zh: 我们需要根据真实的数据来做出决定。
pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào gēnjù zhēnshí de shùjù lái zuòchū juéding.
en: We need to make decisions based on real data.

zh: 与其相信那些夸大其词的广告，不如看真实的用户评价。
pinyin: Yǔqī xiāngxìn nàxiē kuādà qīcí de guǎnggào, búrú kàn zhēnshí de yònghù píngpià.
en: Rather than believe exaggerated ads, it's better to look at genuine user reviews.

zh: 我们交易了书。
pinyin: Wǒmen jiāoyì le shū.
en: We exchanged books.

zh: 昨天我和朋友交易了一个球。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hé péngyou jiāoyì le yī ge qiú.
en: Yesterday I traded a ball with my friend.

zh: 虽然这个交易很便宜，但是我没有钱。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège jiāoyì hěn piányì, dànshì wǒ méiyǒu qián.
en: Although this deal is cheap, I don't have the money for it.

zh: 他在网上完成了一笔重要的交易，花了很长时间。
pinyin: Tā zài wǎngshang wánchéngle yī bǐ zhòngyào de jiāoyì, huāle hěn cháng shíjiān.
en: He completed an important transaction online, which took a long time.

zh: 这家公司因为诚信问题，失去了许多大客户的交易机会。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yīnwèi chéngxìn wèntí, shīqùle xǔduō dà kèhù de jiāoyì jīhuì.
en: Because of integrity issues, this company lost many major trading opportunities with large clients.

zh: 杯子破了。
pinyin: Bēizi pòle.
en: The cup broke.

zh: 昨天我不小心把花瓶破了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ búxiǎoxin bǎ huāpíng pòle.
en: I accidentally broke the vase yesterday.

zh: 虽然手机屏幕破了，但是还能用。
pinyin: Suīrán shǒujī píngmù pòle, dànshi háinéng yòng.
en: Although the phone screen is cracked, it still works.

zh: 因为经常摔跤，他的自行车轮胎经常破。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīngcháng shuāijiāo, tā de zìxíngchē lúntāi jīngcháng pò.
en: Because he falls off so often, his bike tires keep getting punctured.

zh: 公司遇到困难以后，很多员工都破罐子破摔，工作不再认真。
pinyin: Gōngsī yùdào kùnnan yǐhòu, hěnduō yuángōng dōu pòguàn zi pò shuài, gōngzuò búzài rènzhēn.
en: After the company ran into trouble, many employees gave up trying and stopped working seriously.

zh: 下雨了，我们停止踢球。
pinyin: Xiàyǔ le, wǒmen tíngzhǐ tīqiú.
en: It's raining, so we stopped playing soccer.

zh: 老师说停止说话，学生们马上安静了。
pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō tíngzhǐ shuōhuà, xuéshengmen mǎshàng ānjìng le.
en: When the teacher told everyone to stop talking, the students went quiet right away.

zh: 因为天气不好，工人们停止了工作，所以今天没有进展。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, gōngrénmen tíngzhǐ le gōngzuò, suǒyǐ jīntiān méiyǒu jìnzhǎn.
en: Because the weather was bad, the workers stopped work, so there was no progress today.

zh: 警察要求司机停止违法行为，否则会被罚款。
pinyin: Jǐngchá yāoqiú sījī tíngzhǐ wéifǎ xíngwéi, fǒuze huì beǐ fákuǎn.
en: The police ordered the driver to stop illegal behavior, or he would be fined.

zh: 尽管公司经营困难，但管理层决定停止裁员计划，以稳定员工士气。
pinyin: Jìnguǎn gōngsī jīngyíng kùnnan, dàn guǎnlǐcéng juédinìng tíngzhǐ cáiyuán jìhuà, yǐ wěndìng yuángōng shìqì.
en: Although the company is struggling financially, management decided to stop the layoff plan to maintain employee morale.

zh: 人生很短。
pinyin: Rénshēng hěn duǎn.
en: Life is short.

zh: 我的人生开始了。
pinyin: Wǒ de rénshēng kāishǐ le.
en: My life has begun.

zh: 虽然人生有困难，但是我们要努力。
pinyin: Suīrán rénshēng yǒu kùnnan, dànshì wǒmen yào nǔlì.
en: Although life has difficulties, we must work hard.

zh: 他认为人生最重要的是和家人一起。
pinyin: Tā rènwéi rénshēng zuì zhòngyào de shì hé jiārén yìqǐ.
en: He believes that the most important thing in life is being with family.

zh: 人生如同一场马拉松,不是冲刺而是要坚持。
pinyin: Rénshēng rútóng yì chǎng mǎlāsōng, búshì chōngjì érshì yào jiānchí.
en: Life is like a marathon—it's not about sprinting but about persistence.

zh: 水很清。
pinyin: Shuǐ hěn qīng.
en: The water is clear.

zh: 早上我洗脸，水很清凉。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ xǐliǎn, shuǐ hěn qīngliáng.
en: In the morning when I wash my face, the water feels nice and cool.

zh: 虽然天气很冷，但是空气很清新，我喜欢。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, dànshì kōngqì hěn qīngxīn, wǒ xǐhuān.
en: Even though the weather is cold, the air is fresh and clean, and I really like it.

zh: 因为经常打扫，所以办公室里面的空气一直很清爽。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīngcháng dǎsao, suǒyǐ bàngōngshì lǐmiàn de kōngqì yīzhí hěn qīngshuǎng.
en: Because we clean regularly, the air in the office always stays fresh and pleasant.

zh: 他讲话很清楚，逻辑清晰，所以大家都能听明白他的意思。
pinyin: Tā jiǎnghuà hěn qīngchu, luójí qīngxī, suǒyǐ dàjiā dōu néng tīng míngbai tā de yìsi.
en: He speaks very clearly and logically, so everyone can easily understand what he means.

zh: 下雨了，因此我们不去公园。
pinyin: Xiàyǔ le, yīncǐ wǒmen búqù gōngyuán.
en: It's raining, so we're not going to the park.

zh: 他今天很忙，因此没有时间吃午饭。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān hěn máng, yīncǐ méiyǒu shíjiān chī wǔfàn.
en: He's very busy today, so he didn't have time to eat lunch.

zh: 虽然这个电影很长，但是很有趣，因此我很喜欢。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège diànyǐng hěn cháng, dànshi hěn yǒuqù, yīncǐ wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
en: Although the movie is long, it's very interesting, so I really enjoyed it.

zh: 这家公司最近发展得很快，因此他们招聘了很多新员工。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zuìjìn fāzhǎn de hěn kuài, yīncǐ tāmen zhāopìn le hěnduō xīn yuángōng.
en: This company has been growing rapidly lately, so they've hired a lot of new employees.

zh: 由于经济形势不好，消费者变得更加谨慎，因此零售业的销售额大幅下降。
pinyin: Yóuyú jīngjì xíngshì búhǎo, xiāofèizhě biàn de gèngjiā jǐnshèn, yīncǐ língshòuyè de xiāoshòuée dàfú xiàjiàng.
en: Due to poor economic conditions, consumers have become more cautious, and therefore retail sales have dropped significantly.

zh: 这个味道很恶心。
pinyin: Zhège wèidào hěn ěuxīn.
en: This smell is really disgusting.

zh: 他昨天吃坏了肚子，很恶心。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān chī huài le dùzi, hěn ěuxīn.
en: He ate something bad yesterday and felt nauseous.

zh: 虽然这个菜好吃，但是颜色很恶心。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège cài hǎochī, dànshi yánsè hěn ěuxīn.
en: Although this dish tastes good, its color is pretty gross.

zh: 他说的那些谎话让我觉得很恶心，不想再见他。
pinyin: Tā shuō de nàxiē huǎnghuà ràng wǒ juéde hěn ěuxīn, búxiǎng zài jiàn tā.
en: The lies he told really turned me off, and I don't want to see him again.

zh: 他那种虚伪的态度让人恶心，大家都看不惯他。
pinyin: Tā nàzhǒng xūwěi de tàidù ràng rén ěuxīn, dàjiā dōu kànbuguàn tā.
en: His fake attitude is repulsive; nobody can stomach how he acts.

zh: 他受伤了。
pinyin: Tā shòushāng le.
en: He got hurt.

zh: 昨天他踢足球的时候受伤了。
pinyin: Zuótiān tā tī zúqiú de shíhou shòushāng le.
en: He got injured while playing soccer yesterday.

zh: 虽然他受伤了，但是他还要去上班。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shòushāng le, dànshi tā háiyào qù shàngbān.
en: Although he was injured, he still had to go to work.

zh: 这个运动员因为受伤严重，所以这个赛季不能比赛。
pinyin: Zhège yùndòng yuán yīnwèi shòushāng yánzhòng, suǒyǐ zhège sàijì búnéng bǐsài.
en: Because the athlete's injury was severe, he couldn't compete this season.

zh: 他在车祸中受伤，幸好没有生命危险。
pinyin: Tā zài chēhuò zhōng shòushāng, xìnghǎo méiyǒu shēngmìng wēixiǎn.
en: He was injured in a car accident, but fortunately his life wasn't in danger.

zh: 我每天夜里睡觉。
pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān yè lǐ shuì jiào.
en: I sleep every night.

zh: 昨天夜晚我和朋友一起吃饭。
pinyin: Zuó tiān yè wǎn wǒ hé péng you yī qǐ chī fàn.
en: Last night I had dinner with a friend.

zh: 因为昨天夜里下雨，所以今天路很湿。
pinyin: Yīn wèi zuó tiān yè lǐ xià yǔ, suǒ yǐ jīn tiān lù hěn shī.
en: Because it rained last night, the road is wet today.

zh: 虽然夜里很冷，但是他还是坚持跑步。
pinyin: Suī rán yè lǐ hěn lěng, dàn shì tā háishi jiān chí pǎo bù.
en: Although it was cold at night, he still insisted on going for a run.

zh: 加班到深夜已经成为这份工作的常态。
pinyin: Jiā bān dào shēn yè yǐ jīng chéng wéi zhè fèn gōng zuò de cháng tài.
en: Working late into the night has become the norm for this job.

zh: 她是个坏婊子。
pinyin: Tā shì ge huài婊子。
en: She's a bad woman.

zh: 那个婊子昨天又骗人了。
pinyin: Nàge婊子 zuótiān yòu piàn rén le。
en: That woman lied to people again yesterday.

zh: 因为她是个婊子，所以没人相信她的话。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā shì ge婊子，suǒyǐ méi rén xiāngxìn tā de huà。
en: Because she's untrustworthy, nobody believes what she says.

zh: 他虽然很有钱，但那个婊子还是背着他去找别人。
pinyin: Tā suīrán hěn yǒu qián，dàn nàge婊子 háishi bèizhe tā qù zhǎo biérén。
en: Even though he's rich, that unfaithful woman still cheated on him.

zh: 别被那个婊子的甜言蜜语骗了，她就是想要你的钱。
pinyin: Bié bèi nàge婊子 de tiányán mìyǔ piàn le，tā jiùshi xiǎngyào nǐ de qián。
en: Don't fall for that woman's sweet talk—she's just after your money.

zh: 苹果属于水果。
pinyin: píngguǒ shǔyú shuǐguǒ。
en: Apples belong to the fruit category.

zh: 这个公园属于我们的城市。
pinyin: Zhège gōngyuán shǔyú wǒmen de chéngshì。
en: This park belongs to our city.

zh: 因为他工作很努力，所以这个奖项属于他。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā gōngzuò hěn nǔlì, suǒyǐ zhège jiǎngxiàng shǔyú tā。
en: Because he works so hard, this award rightfully goes to him.

zh: 这些问题属于技术范围，不属于管理问题。
pinyin: Zhèxiē wèntí shǔyú jìshù fànwéi, búshǔyú guǎnlǐ wèntí。
en: These issues fall into the technical category rather than being management problems.

zh: 在公司改革期间，许多部门属于被重组的对象。
pinyin: Zài gōngsī gǎigé qījiān, xǔduō bùmén shǔyú bèi chóngzǔ de duìxiàng。
en: During the company's restructuring, many departments were among those subject to reorganization.

zh: 我喜欢舞蹈。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān wǔdǎo.
en: I like dance.

zh: 她每天都在跳舞蹈。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu zài tiào wǔdǎo.
en: She dances every day.

zh: 因为喜欢舞蹈，所以她参加了舞蹈班。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xǐhuān wǔdǎo, suǒyǐ tā cānjiāle wǔdǎo bān.
en: Because she loves dance, she joined a dance class.

zh: 这个舞蹈表演虽然只有五分钟，但给观众留下了深刻印象。
pinyin: Zhège wǔdǎo biǎoyǎn suīrán zhǐyǒu wǔ fēnzhōng, dàn gěi guānzhòng liúxiàle shēnkè yìnxiàng.
en: Although this dance performance was only five minutes long, it left a strong impression on the audience.

zh: 随着音乐的节奏，舞蹈演员的动作越来越流畅，最后赢得了全场掌声。
pinyin: Suízhē yīnyuè de jiēzòu, wǔdǎo yǎnyuán de dòngzuò yuèláiyuè liúchàng, zuìhòu yíngdele quánchǎng zhǎngshēng.
en: Following the rhythm of the music, the dancer's movements became increasingly fluid, and in the end, she earned a standing ovation from the entire audience.

zh: 根据天气，我们去公园。
pinyin: Gēnjù tiānqì, wǒmen qù gōngyuán.
en: Based on the weather, we're going to the park.

zh: 根据老师的意见，我改了作业。
pinyin: Gēnjù lǎoshī de yìjiàn, wǒ gǎile zuòyè.
en: Following the teacher's feedback, I revised my homework.

zh: 根据医生的建议，虽然很累，但是我还是坚持运动。
pinyin: Gēnjù yīshēng de jiànyì, suīránhěn lèi, dànshì wǒ háishi jiānchí yùndòng.
en: Following the doctor's advice, even though I'm tired, I still keep exercising.

zh: 根据最近的调查数据，年轻人更喜欢在线购物。
pinyin: Gēnjù zuìjìn de tiáochá shùjù, niánqīng rén gèng xǐhuān zàixiàn gòuwù.
en: According to recent survey data, young people prefer shopping online.

zh: 根据公司的长期发展战略，我们需要培养更多的技术人才。
pinyin: Gēnjù gōngsī de chángqī fāzhǎn zhànlüè, wǒmen xūyào péiyǎng gèngduō de jìshù réncái.
en: In line with the company's long-term development strategy, we need to cultivate more technical talent.

zh: 我几乎每天吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ jīhū měi tiān chī mǐfàn.
en: I eat rice almost every day.

zh: 昨天下午我几乎睡了三个小时。
pinyin: Zuótiān xiàwǔ wǒ jīhū shuìle sān ge xiǎoshí.
en: Yesterday afternoon I slept for almost three hours.

zh: 因为太忙，他几乎没有时间和家人在一起。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tài máng, tā jīhū méiyǒu shíjiān hé jiārén zài yīqǐ.
en: Because he was so busy, he had almost no time to spend with his family.

zh: 虽然她努力学习，但考试成绩几乎没有进步。
pinyin: Suīrán tā nǔlì xuéxí, dàn kǎoshì chéngjì jīhū méiyǒu jìnbù.
en: Although she studied hard, her exam scores showed almost no improvement.

zh: 公司的新产品几乎占据了整个市场的一半份额。
pinyin: Gōngsī de xīn chǎnpǐn jīhū zhànnjù le zhěnge shìchǎng de yībàn fèn'é.
en: The company's new product has captured almost half of the entire market share.

zh: 这个苹果算是好吃。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ suànshì hǎochī.
en: This apple is pretty tasty.

zh: 她昨天来了，算是很准时。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān lái le, suànshì hěn zhǔnshí.
en: She came yesterday, and she was quite punctual about it.

zh: 虽然天气冷，但这次旅游算是成功的。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì lěng, dàn zhè cì lǚyóu suànshì chénggōng de.
en: Even though the weather was cold, the trip turned out to be a success overall.

zh: 他的中文不太好，但在工作中算是能用英文补救。
pinyin: Tā de zhōngwén búhuài tài hǎo, dàn zài gōngzuò zhōng suànshì néng yòng yīngwén bǔjiù.
en: His Chinese isn't great, but at work he manages to make up for it by using English.

zh: 这个城市发展虽然快，但环境问题还是没解决好，算是有所不足。
pinyin: Zhège chéngshì fāzhǎn suīrán kuài, dàn huanjìng wèntí háishi méi jiějué hǎo, suànshì yǒusuǒ búzú.
en: The city's development is rapid, but environmental issues haven't been properly addressed—you could say that's a real shortcoming.

zh: 他在电视上演戏。
pinyin: Tā zài diànshì shang yǎn xì.
en: He acts in a TV show.

zh: 昨天我看了一个演员演的电影。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ kànle yīge yǎnyuán yǎn de diànyǐng.
en: Yesterday I watched a movie with an actor in it.

zh: 因为她很聪明，所以她演得特别好。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn聪míng, suǒyǐ tā yǎn de tèbié hǎo.
en: Because she's very talented, she acts exceptionally well.

zh: 这个演员虽然年轻，但在舞台上的表现令人印象深刻。
pinyin: Zhège yǎnyuán suīrán niánqīng, dàn zài wǔtái shang de biǎoxiàn lìng rén yìnxiàng shēnkè.
en: Though young, this actor's stage performance left a deep impression.

zh: 他在这部剧里的演技突飞猛进，获得了许多观众的认可。
pinyin: Tā zài zhè bù jù lǐ de yǎnjì túfēi měngjìn, huòdéle xǔduō guānzhòng de rènkě.
en: His acting in this production has improved dramatically and earned considerable audience approval.

zh: 她是尼泊尔人。
pinyin: Tā shì Níbōěr rén.
en: She is from Nepal.

zh: 我的朋友住在尼日利亚。
pinyin: Wǒ de péngyou zhù zài Níròu lìyà.
en: My friend lives in Nigeria.

zh: 虽然尼泊尔很远，但是那里的风景很美。
pinyin: Suīrán Níbōěr hěn yuǎn, dànshì nàlǐ de fēngjǐng hěn měi.
en: Although Nepal is far away, the scenery there is really beautiful.

zh: 他上个月去尼日利亚出差，回来后告诉我很多有趣的事。
pinyin: Tā shàng ge yuè qù Níròu lìyà chūchāi, huílái hòu gàosu wǒ hěnduō yǒuqù de shì.
en: He went to Nigeria on a business trip last month and told me many interesting things when he got back.

zh: 据说尼泊尔的喜马拉雅地区因为地理位置特殊，所以吸引了世界各地的登山者前去挑战。
pinyin: Jùshuō Níbōěr de Xǐmǎlāyǎ dìqū yīnwèi dìlǐ wèizhì tèshū, suǒyǐ xīyǐnle shìjiè gèdì de dēngshānzhě qù tiǎozhàn.
en: It's said that the Himalayan region of Nepal attracts mountaineers from all over the world because of its unique geographical location.

zh: 这是答案。
pinyin: Zhè shì dáàn.
en: This is the answer.

zh: 我找到了正确的答案。
pinyin: Wǒ zhǎodào le zhèngquè de dáàn.
en: I found the correct answer.

zh: 因为他很聪明，所以他的答案总是对的。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn cōngmíng, suǒyǐ tā de dáàn zǒngshì duì de.
en: Because he's smart, his answers are always right.

zh: 虽然题目很难，但是大多数学生都写出了答案。
pinyin: Suīrán tímù hěn nán, dànshì dàduōshù xuésheng dōu xiěchūle dáàn.
en: Although the question was difficult, most students still came up with an answer.

zh: 这个问题没有绝对的答案，需要根据不同的情况来判断。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí méiyǒu juéduì de dáàn, xūyào gēnjù búróng de qíngkuàng lái pànduàn.
en: This question doesn't have an absolute answer—you have to judge based on the specific circumstances.

zh: 她今天很出色。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān hěn chūsè.
en: She did really well today.

zh: 这个学生的英语很出色。
pinyin: Zhège xuésheng de Yīngyǔ hěn chūsè.
en: This student's English is really excellent.

zh: 虽然他很年轻，但是工作表现出色。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn niánqīng, dànshì gōngzuò biǎoxiàn chūsè.
en: Although he's quite young, his work performance is outstanding.

zh: 因为准备充分，她在比赛中的表现特别出色。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhǔnbèi chōngfèn, tā zài bǐsài zhōng de biǎoxiàn tèbié chūsè.
en: Because she prepared thoroughly, her performance at the competition was exceptionally impressive.

zh: 这位设计师虽然资历不深，但创意能力出色，已经获得业界认可。
pinyin: Zhèwèi shèjìshī suīrán zīlì búshēn, dàn chuàngyì néngf力 chūsè, yǐjīng huòdé yèjiè rènkě.
en: Though this designer is relatively inexperienced, her creative abilities are outstanding and she's already gained industry recognition.

zh: 目前我在家。
pinyin: Mùqián wǒ zài jiā.
en: I'm at home right now.

zh: 目前天气很好，我们可以出去。
pinyin: Mùqián tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen kěyǐ chūqù.
en: The weather is nice at the moment, so we can go out.

zh: 因为目前还没有下雨，所以孩子们在外面玩。
pinyin: Yīnwèi mùqián háishi méiyǒu xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ háizi men zài wàimiàn wán.
en: Since it hasn't rained yet right now, the kids are playing outside.

zh: 目前这个项目进展顺利，但我们还需要更多时间。
pinyin: Mùqián zhège xiàngmù jìnzhǎn shùnlì, dàn wǒmen háishi xūyào gèngduō shíjiān.
en: The project is progressing well at present, but we still need more time.

zh: 目前国内的经济形势虽然面临挑战，但总体趋势依然向好。
pinyin: Mùqián guónèi de jīngjì xíngshì suīrán miànlín tiǎozhàn, dàn zǒngtǐ qūshì yīrán xiàng hǎo.
en: While the current domestic economic situation faces challenges, the overall trend remains positive.

zh: 我们周末有活动。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhōumò yǒu huódòng.
en: We have an activity this weekend.

zh: 学校今天下午有运动活动。
pinyin: Xuéxiào jīntiān xiàwǔ yǒu yùndòng huódòng.
en: The school has a sports activity this afternoon.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但我们的户外活动还是很有趣。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dàn wǒmen de hùwài huódòng háishi hěn yǒuqù.
en: Even though the weather wasn't great, our outdoor activity was still a lot of fun.

zh: 公司组织了一个月度团队活动，目的是增进同事之间的关系。
pinyin: Gōngsī zǔzhīle yīge yuèdù tuánduì huódòng, múdì shì zēngjìn tóngshì zhījiān de guānxi.
en: The company organized a monthly team activity aimed at strengthening relationships between colleagues.

zh: 为了吸引更多年轻人参加，社区决定将传统文化融入到每月的活动中。
pinyin: Wèile xīyǐn gèngduō niánqīng rén cānjiā, shèqū juédìng jiāng chuántǒng wénhuà róngrù dào měi yuè de huódòng zhōng.
en: In order to attract more young people, the community decided to incorporate traditional culture into its monthly activities.

zh: 门上有一把锁。
pinyin: Mén shàng yǒu yī bǎ suǒ.
en: There's a lock on the door.

zh: 我找不到钥匙,锁打不开。
pinyin: Wǒ zhǎo bu dào yàoshi, suǒ dǎ bu kāi.
en: I can't find the key, so the lock won't open.

zh: 虽然门很旧,但是锁还是很结实的。
pinyin: Suīrán mén hěn jiù, dànshì suǒ háishi hěn jiēshi de.
en: Although the door is old, the lock is still very sturdy.

zh: 因为他忘记锁车门,所以东西被偷了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā wàngjì suǒ chēmén, suǒyǐ dōngxi bèi tōu le.
en: Because he forgot to lock the car door, his belongings got stolen.

zh: 这个新系统能自动锁定陌生设备的访问权限。
pinyin: Zhège xīn xìtǒng néng zìdòng suǒdìng mòshēng shèbèi de fǎngwèn quány限.
en: This new system can automatically lock out access from unfamiliar devices.

zh: 我的梦想是医生。
pinyin: Wǒ de梦想 shì yīshēng.
en: My dream is to be a doctor.

zh: 她从小就有梦想做老师。
pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo jiù yǒu梦想 zuò lǎoshī.
en: She's wanted to be a teacher since she was little.

zh: 虽然很困难，但是他坚持自己的梦想。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn kùnnan, dànshì tā jiānchí zìjǐ de梦想.
en: Although it's hard, he sticks with his dream.

zh: 为了实现梦想，她每天都很认真地学习。
pinyin: Wèile shíxiàn梦想, tā měitiān dōu hěn rènzhēn de xuéxí.
en: To achieve her dream, she studies seriously every single day.

zh: 他相信只要坚持不懈，梦想最终一定会实现。
pinyin: Tā xiāngxìn zhǐyào jiānchí búxié,梦想 zuìzhōng yídìng huì shíxiàn.
en: He believes that as long as he persists, his dream will definitely come true in the end.

zh: 最终我们吃了米饭。
pinyin: Zuìzhōng wǒmen chīle mǐfàn.
en: In the end, we ate rice.

zh: 他找了很久，最终找到了钥匙。
pinyin: Tā zhǎole hěnjiǔ, zuìzhōng zhǎodàole yàoshi.
en: He searched for a long time and finally found the key.

zh: 虽然开始很难，但他最终学会了游泳。
pinyin: Suīrán kāishǐ hěn nán, dàn tā zuìzhōng xuéhuìle yóuyǒng.
en: Although it was hard at first, he eventually learned to swim.

zh: 经过多次尝试和改进，他们最终开发出了新产品。
pinyin: Jīngguò duō cì chángshì hé gǎijìn, tāmen zuìzhōng kāifāchūle xīn chǎnpǐn.
en: After multiple attempts and improvements, they finally developed a new product.

zh: 虽然面对许多挑战和质疑，这个项目最终还是圆满完成了。
pinyin: Suīrán miànduì xǔduō tiǎozhàn hé zhìyí, zhège xiàngmù zuìzhōng háishi yuánmǎn wánchéngle.
en: Despite facing numerous challenges and skepticism, the project was ultimately completed successfully.

zh: 大人在家里。
pinyin: Dàrén zài jiāli.
en: The adults are at home.

zh: 小孩跟着大人一起去公园。
pinyin: Xiǎohái gēnzhe dàrén yìqǐ qù gōngyuán.
en: The child follows the adults to the park together.

zh: 虽然天气很冷，但大人还是带孩子出去玩了。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, dàn dàrén háishi dài háizi chūqù wán le.
en: Although the weather was cold, the adults still took the children out to play.

zh: 在饭桌上，大人们讨论工作的事情，小孩就在旁边安静地吃饭。
pinyin: Zài fànzhuō shang, dàrénmen tǎolùn gōngzuò de shìqing, xiǎohái jiù zài pángbiān ānjìng de chīfàn.
en: At the dinner table, the adults discuss work matters while the children eat quietly on the side.

zh: 现在的大人们往往忙于工作，很难抽出时间陪孩子成长。
pinyin: Xiànzài de dàrénmen wǎngwǎng máng yú gōngzuò, hěnnan chōuchū shíjiān péi háizi chéngzhǎng.
en: Nowadays, adults are often so busy with work that they struggle to find time to spend with their growing children.

zh: 我再次吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ zàicì chī mǐfàn.
en: I'm eating rice again.

zh: 他明天再次来我家。
pinyin: Tā míngtiān zàicì lái wǒ jiā.
en: He's coming to my house again tomorrow.

zh: 因为很好吃，我再次买了这个蛋糕。
pinyin: Yīnwèi hěn hǎochī, wǒ zàicì mǎile zhège dàngāo.
en: Because it was so delicious, I bought this cake again.

zh: 虽然很累，但他还是再次参加了那个比赛。
pinyin: Suīránhěn lèi, dàn tā háishi zàicì cānjiāle nàge bǐsài.
en: Even though he was exhausted, he participated in that competition once more.

zh: 经过几次失败后，她再次鼓起勇气申请了那份工作。
pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ cì shībài hòu, tā zàicì gǔqǐ yǒngqì shēnqǐngle nàfèn gōngzuò.
en: After several failures, she found the courage to apply for that job again.

zh: 既然你喜欢吃米饭，我们就吃米饭。
pinyin: 既然 nǐ xǐhuān chī mǐfàn, wǒmen jiù chī mǐfàn.
en: Since you like eating rice, let's have rice then.

zh: 既然今天天气很好，我们一起去公园吧。
pinyin: 既然 jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen yìqǐ qù gōngyuán ba.
en: Since the weather is nice today, let's go to the park together.

zh: 既然你已经来了，就坐下喝杯茶吧。
pinyin: 既然 nǐ yǐjīng láile, jiù zuòxia hēbēi chá ba.
en: Since you're already here, sit down and have some tea with us.

zh: 既然你决定了要换工作，就不要再犹豫了。
pinyin: 既然 nǐ juéding le yào huàn gōngzuò, jiù búyào zài yóuyù le.
en: Now that you've made up your mind to change jobs, don't second-guess yourself.

zh: 既然我们的目标一致，何不携手合作把这个项目做好？
pinyin: 既然 wǒmen de mùbiāo yìzhì, hébúshì xiéshǒu hézuò bǎ zhège xiàngmù zuò hǎo?
en: Since our goals align, why don't we join forces and do this project well together?

zh: 公司人员很多。
pinyin: Gōngsī rényuán hěn duō.
en: The company has a lot of staff.

zh: 医院的医生人员今天很忙。
pinyin: Yīyuàn de yīshēng rényuán jīntiān hěn máng.
en: The hospital's doctors and medical staff are very busy today.

zh: 因为项目很重要，所以公司增加了人员。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàngmù hěn zhòngyào, suǒyǐ gōngsī zēngjiāle rényuán.
en: Because the project is important, the company hired more personnel.

zh: 新店铺开业时，需要招聘更多销售人员来应对客流。
pinyin: Xīn diànpù kāiyè shí, xūyào zhāopìn gèngduō xiāoshòu rényuán lái yìngduì kèliú.
en: When the new store opened, we had to hire more sales staff to handle the customer traffic.

zh: 虽然人员编制有限，但这支团队凭借专业素养完成了所有任务。
pinyin: Suīrán rényuán biānzhì yǒuxiàn, dàn zhè zhī tuánduì píngjiè zhuānyè sùyǎng wánchéngle suǒyǒu rènwu.
en: Despite the limited staff numbers, the team completed all tasks through their professional expertise.

zh: 他是英雄。
pinyin: Tā shì yīngxióng.
en: He is a hero.

zh: 这个英雄很勇敢，我很喜欢他。
pinyin: Zhège yīngxióng hěn yǒnggăn, wǒ hěn xǐhuān tā.
en: This hero is very brave, and I really like him.

zh: 因为他很聪明，所以他成了英雄，救了很多人。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn cōngmíng, suǒyǐ tā chéngle yīngxióng, jiùle hěnduō rén.
en: Because he was smart, he became a hero and saved many people.

zh: 虽然这个英雄没有超能力，但是他用聪慧和勇气帮助了很多需要的人。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège yīngxióng méiyǒu chāonéngglì, dànshì tā yòng cōnghuì hé yǒngqì bāngzhùle hěnduō xūyào de rén.
en: Although this hero doesn't have superpowers, he used intelligence and courage to help many people in need.

zh: 在那个困难的时代，许多普通人挺身而出，成了真正的英雄，他们的故事激励了好几代人。
pinyin: Zài nàge kùnnan de shídài, xǔduō pǔtōng rén tǐngshēn érchū, chéngle zhēnzhèng de yīngxióng, tāmen de gùshì jīlì le hǎo jǐ dài rén.
en: During that difficult era, many ordinary people stepped up and became true heroes; their stories inspired several generations.

zh: 请坐下。
pinyin: Qǐng zuò xia.
en: Please sit down.

zh: 我们一起坐下吃饭吧。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīqǐ zuò xia chīfàn ba.
en: Let's sit down and eat together.

zh: 因为很累，我坐下休息了一会儿。
pinyin: Yīnwèi hěn lèi, wǒ zuò xia xiūxi le yīhuǐr.
en: Because I was very tired, I sat down to rest for a while.

zh: 医生让我坐下，然后开始检查我的身体。
pinyin: Yīshēng ràng wǒ zuò xia, ránhòu kāishǐ jiǎnchá wǒ de shēntǐ.
en: The doctor asked me to sit down and then started examining my body.

zh: 他看起来心烦意乱，坐下后就一直盯着窗外发呆。
pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlai xīnfán yìluàn, zuò xia hòu jiù yīzhí dīngzhe chuāngwài fādāi.
en: He seemed upset, and after sitting down he just kept staring out the window in a daze.

zh: 我感受到冷。
pinyin: Wǒ gǎnshòu dào lěng.
en: I feel cold.

zh: 昨天吃了冰淇淋，我感受到很甜。
pinyin: Zuótiān chīle bīngqílín, wǒ gǎnshòu dào hěn tián.
en: I ate ice cream yesterday and it tasted really sweet.

zh: 虽然工作很累，但我感受到了家人的爱。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn lèi, dàn wǒ gǎnshòule jiārén de ài.
en: Even though work is tiring, I feel my family's love.

zh: 第一次来这个城市，我感受到了不同的文化和生活方式。
pinyin: Dì yī cì lái zhège chéngshì, wǒ gǎnshòule búyīyàng de wénhuà hé shēnghuó fāngshì.
en: Coming to this city for the first time, I experienced a completely different culture and way of life.

zh: 通过这个项目的合作，我深深感受到了团队精神的重要性。
pinyin: Tōngguò zhège xiàngmù de hézuò, wǒ shēnshēn gǎnshòule tuánduì jīngshén de zhòngyàoxìng.
en: Through this project collaboration, I deeply appreciated how important teamwork really is.

zh: 我有一副眼镜。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī fù yǎnjìng.
en: I have a pair of glasses.

zh: 老师给了我们一副新的地图。
pinyin: Lǎoshī gěi le wǒmen yī fù xīn de dìtú.
en: The teacher gave us a new map.

zh: 虽然他是副经理，但是工作很认真。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shì fù jīnglǐ, dànshì gōngzuò hěn rènzhēn.
en: Although he's an associate manager, he works very carefully.

zh: 这个公司的副总裁负责国际业务发展。
pinyin: Zhège gōngsī de fù zǒngcái fùzé guójì yèwù fāzhǎn.
en: The company's vice president is in charge of international business expansion.

zh: 作为副编辑，她不仅要审稿，还得处理日常的行政事务。
pinyin: Zuòwéi fù biānjí, tā bújǐn yào shěngǎo, háidé chǔlǐ rìcháng de xíngzhèng shìwù.
en: As associate editor, she not only reviews manuscripts but also handles routine administrative tasks.

zh: 今天发生了一个事件。
pinyin: Jīntiān fāshēng le yī gè shìjiàn.
en: Something happened today.

zh: 昨天学校发生了一个有趣的事件。
pinyin: Zuótiān xuéxiào fāshēng le yī gè yǒuqù de shìjiàn.
en: An interesting event happened at school yesterday.

zh: 虽然那个事件很突然，但是大家都很冷静。
pinyin: Suīrán nà ge shìjiàn hěn túrán, dànshì dàjiā dōu hěn lěngjìng.
en: Although that incident was sudden, everyone stayed calm.

zh: 警察正在调查这起交通事件的原因。
pinyin: Jǐngchá zhèngzài diàochá zhè qǐ jiāotōng shìjiàn de yuányīn.
en: The police are investigating the cause of this traffic incident.

zh: 那次公共安全事件引发了社会对城市管理的广泛讨论。
pinyin: Nà cì gōngòng ānquán shìjiàn yǐnfāle shèhuì duì chéngshì guǎnlǐ de guǎngfàn tǎolùn.
en: That public safety incident sparked widespread public discussion about urban management.

zh: 妈妈吻我。
pinyin: Māma wěn wǒ.
en: Mom kisses me.

zh: 他每天早上都吻女朋友。
pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshang dōu wěn nǚ péngyou.
en: He kisses his girlfriend every morning.

zh: 虽然他们才认识一周，但他们已经互相吻过了。
pinyin: Suīrán tāmen cái rènshi yī zhōu, dàn tāmen yǐjīng hùxiāng wěnguo le.
en: Although they've only known each other for a week, they've already kissed.

zh: 在电影里看到浪漫的吻戏，她忍不住想起了自己的初恋。
pinyin: Zài diànyǐng lǐ kàndào làngmàn de wěnxì, tā rěnbuzhù xiǎngqǐ le zìjǐ de chūliàn.
en: Watching a romantic kiss scene in the movie, she couldn't help but think of her first love.

zh: 他们的吻不仅是身体的接触，更代表了彼此的承诺和信任。
pinyin: Tāmen de wěn bújǐn shì shēntǐ de jiēchù, gèng dàibiǎo le bǐcǐ de chéngnuò hé xìnrèn.
en: Their kiss wasn't just physical contact—it represented mutual commitment and trust.

zh: 他犯了罪。
pinyin: Tā fànle zuì.
en: He committed a crime.

zh: 那个人因为犯罪被警察抓住了。
pinyin: Nàge rén yīnwèi fànzuì bèi jǐngchá zhuāzhù le.
en: That person was caught by the police because of committing a crime.

zh: 虽然他犯了罪，但是他现在很后悔。
pinyin: Suīrán tā fànle zuì, dànshì tā xiànzài hěn hòuhuǐ.
en: Although he committed a crime, he really regrets it now.

zh: 法官认为这个罪行非常严重，所以判了他五年监禁。
pinyin: Fǎguān rènwéi zhège zuìxíng fēicháng yánzhòng, suǒyǐ pàn le tā wǔ nián jiānjìn.
en: The judge thought the crime was extremely serious, so she sentenced him to five years in prison.

zh: 他为自己的罪行付出了代价，现在正努力重新开始新的生活。
pinyin: Tā wèi zìjǐ de zuìxíng fùchūle dàijià, xiànzài zhèng nǔlì chóngxīn kāishǐ xīn de shēnghuó.
en: He paid the price for his crime, and now he's working hard to make a fresh start with his life.

zh: 小鸟逃走了。
pinyin: Xiǎo niǎo táozǒu le.
en: The little bird flew away.

zh: 昨天那只猫从家里逃出去了。
pinyin: Zuótiān nà zhī māo cóng jiālǐ táochūqù le.
en: That cat escaped from the house yesterday.

zh: 因为天气很热，所以他逃到了树下乘凉。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn rè, suǒyǐ tā táodào le shù xià chéngliang.
en: Because it was so hot, he went to cool off under a tree.

zh: 那个学生逃避了很多课程，最后成绩很差。
pinyin: Nàge xuésheng táobì le hěnduō kèchéng, zuìhòu chéngjì hěn chà.
en: That student avoided a lot of classes, and as a result his grades were really poor.

zh: 他想逃避责任，但最终还是无法躲过公司的调查。
pinyin: Tā xiǎng táobì zérèn, dàn zuìzh终 háishi wúfǎ duǒguò gōngsī de diàochá.
en: He tried to dodge responsibility, but ultimately couldn't escape the company's investigation.

zh: 老师通知我们明天放假。
pinyin: Lǎoshī tōngzhī wǒmen míngtiān fàngjià.
en: The teacher told us that we have tomorrow off.

zh: 公司通知所有员工下午三点开会。
pinyin: Gōngsī tōngzhī suǒyǒu yuángōng xiàwǔ sān diǎn kāihuì.
en: The company notified all employees that there's a meeting at 3 PM.

zh: 虽然已经通知了，但是还有很多人没有看到。
pinyin: Suīrán yǐjīng tōngzhī le, dànshì háishi yǒu hěnduō rén méiyǒu kàndào.
en: Even though the notice was sent out, many people still didn't see it.

zh: 医院通知患者应该定期检查身体状况。
pinyin: Yīyuàn tōngzhī huànzhě yīnggāi dìngqī jiǎnchá shēntǐ zhuàngkuàng.
en: The hospital informed patients that they should have regular checkups.

zh: 系统会自动通知您有关订单和退款的所有重要信息。
pinyin: Xìtǒng huì zìdòng tōngzhī nín yǒuguān dìngdān hé tuìkuǎn de suǒyǒu zhòngyào xìnxī.
en: The system will automatically notify you about all important information regarding your orders and refunds.

zh: 下雨了，我不得不在家。
pinyin: Xiàyǔ le, wǒ búdébù zài jiā.
en: It's raining, so I have to stay home.

zh: 妈妈生病了，爸爸不得不请假去医院。
pinyin: Māma shēngbìng le, bàba búdébù qǐngjià qù yīyuàn.
en: Mom got sick, so Dad had to take time off to go to the hospital.

zh: 因为公交车坏了，我的时候不得不走路去上班。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngjiāochē huài le, wǒ de shíhou búdébù zǒulù qù shàngbān.
en: Because the bus broke down, I had no choice but to walk to work.

zh: 虽然很累，但是工作还没完成，他不得不继续加班。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshi gōngzuò háishi méi wánchéng, tā búdébù jìxù jiābān.
en: Although he was exhausted and the work still wasn't finished, he had to keep working overtime.

zh: 面对激烈的竞争和不断上升的成本，公司不得不调整发展战略。
pinyin: Miànduì jīliè de jìngjìng hé búduàn shàngshēng de chéngběn, gōngsī búdébù tiáozhěng fāzhǎn zhànlüè.
en: Facing fierce competition and rising costs, the company had to adjust its development strategy.

zh: 无论晴天还是雨天，我都喜欢跑步。
pinyin: Wúlùn qīngtiān háishi yǔtiān, wǒ dōu xǐhuān pǎobù.
en: Whether it's sunny or rainy, I like running.

zh: 无论你多忙，也要记得吃饭。
pinyin: Wúlùn nǐ duō máng, yě yào jìde chīfàn.
en: No matter how busy you are, you still need to remember to eat.

zh: 无论我们去哪里旅游，爸爸都喜欢拍很多照片。
pinyin: Wúlùn wǒmen qù nǎlǐ lǚyóu, bàba dōu xǐhuān pāi hěnduō zhàopiàn.
en: Wherever we travel, my dad always likes to take tons of photos.

zh: 无论你选择哪个工作机会，只要努力，都能成功。
pinyin: Wúlùn nǐ xuǎnzé nǎge gōngzuò jīhuì, zhǐyào nǔlì, dōu néng chénggōng.
en: Whichever job opportunity you choose, as long as you work hard, you can succeed.

zh: 无论经济形势如何，公司都坚持投资员工的发展和培训。
pinyin: Wúlùn jīngjì xíngshì rúhé, gōngsī dōu jiānchí tóuzī yuángōng de fāzhǎn hé péixùn.
en: Regardless of economic conditions, the company remains committed to investing in employee development and training.

zh: 妈妈放开我的手。
pinyin: Māma fàngkāi wǒ de shǒu.
en: Mom let go of my hand.

zh: 请放开这个门，我要进去。
pinyin: Qǐng fàngkāi zhège mén, wǒ yào jìnqu.
en: Please open this door—I need to go in.

zh: 虽然很害怕，但他还是放开了绳子。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn hàipà, dàn tā háishi fàngkāile绳zi.
en: Even though he was scared, he still let go of the rope.

zh: 政府决定放开这个行业的限制，吸引更多企业。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ juéding fàngkāi zhège hángyè de xiànzhì, xīyǐn gèngduō qǐyè.
en: The government decided to loosen restrictions on this industry to attract more businesses.

zh: 只有真正放开心态，才能在竞争中发挥最好的水平。
pinyin: Zhǐyǒu zhēnzhèng fàngkāi xīntài, cáinéng zài jìngjìng zhōng fāhuī zuìhǎo de shuǐpíng.
en: Only by truly letting go mentally can you perform at your best in competition.

zh: 这是一把刀。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī bǎ dāo.
en: This is a knife.

zh: 妈妈用刀切菜很快。
pinyin: Māma yòng dāo qiē cài hěn kuài.
en: Mom cuts vegetables with a knife really fast.

zh: 因为刀很锋利，所以我们要小心使用。
pinyin: Yīnwèi dāo hěn fēnglì, suǒyǐ wǒmen yào xiǎoxin shǐyòng.
en: Because the knife is so sharp, we need to be careful when we use it.

zh: 虽然这把刀看起来旧，但它切肉的时候还是很有效果。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè bǎ dāo kàn qǐlai jiù, dàn tā qiē ròu de shíhou háishi hěn yǒu xiàoguǒ.
en: Although this knife looks old, it's still very effective when cutting meat.

zh: 在厨房里工作多年后，他已经能够用刀完成各种复杂的料理任务。
pinyin: Zài chúfáng li gōngzuò duō nián hòu, tā yǐjīng nénggoù yòng dāo wánchéng gèzhǒng fùzá de liàolǐ rènwu.
en: After years of working in the kitchen, he can now handle all sorts of complicated cooking tasks with his knife.

zh: 我没有笔，后来妈妈给我了。
pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu bǐ, hòulái māma gěi wǒ le.
en: I didn't have a pen, but later my mom gave me one.

zh: 早上下雨了，后来天气变好了。
pinyin: Zǎoshang xiàyǔ le, hòulái tiānqì biàn hǎo le.
en: It rained this morning, but later the weather got better.

zh: 我们在公园玩的时候很开心，但后来天黑了，我们就回家了。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài gōngyuán wán de shíhou hěn kāixīn, dàn hòulái tiānhēi le, wǒmen jiù huíjiā le.
en: We were having fun playing in the park, but later it got dark, so we went home.

zh: 因为他最初不太感兴趣，后来通过朋友的介绍，他才开始喜欢这个运动。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā zuìchū búhuà gǎn xìngqùnéss, hòulái tōngguò péngyou de jièshào, tā cái kāishǐ xǐhuān zhège yùndòng.
en: Because he wasn't really interested at first, but later through a friend's introduction, he started to enjoy the sport.

zh: 这家公司刚开始业绩不理想，后来经过管理层的改革和员工的努力，逐渐成为了行业的佼佼者。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī gāng kāishǐ yèjī búlǐxiǎng, hòulái jīngguò guǎnlǐcéng de gǎigé hé yuángōng de nǔlì, zhújiàn chéngwéi le hángyè de jiǎojiǎozhě.
en: This company didn't have ideal performance at first, but later through management reforms and employees' hard work, it gradually became one of the industry's top performers.

zh: 我愿意吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ yuànyì chī mǐfàn.
en: I'm willing to eat rice.

zh: 她愿意明天和我们一起去公园。
pinyin: Tā yuànyì míngtiān hé wǒmen yìqǐ qù gōngyuán.
en: She's willing to go to the park with us tomorrow.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但他们仍然愿意来参加派对。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dàn tāmen réngrán yuànyì lái cānjiā pàiduì.
en: Although the weather is bad, they're still willing to come to the party.

zh: 许多年轻人不太愿意从事传统的工作，更喜欢自己创业。
pinyin: Xǔduō niánqīngrén búhuì yuànyì cóngshì chuántǒng de gōngzuò, gèng xǐhuān zìjǐ chuàngyè.
en: Many young people aren't really willing to do traditional jobs; they'd rather start their own businesses.

zh: 只要条件允许，我们都愿意投入更多的时间和资源来改善教育质量。
pinyin: Zhǐyào tiáojiàn yǔnxǔ, wǒmen dōu yuànyì tóurù gèngduō de shíjiān hé zīyuán lái gǎishàn jiàoyù zhìliàng.
en: As long as circumstances allow, we're all willing to invest more time and resources in improving educational quality.

zh: 这件衣服适合你。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu shìhéhé nǐ.
en: This shirt suits you.

zh: 夏天适合吃冰淇淋。
pinyin: Xiàtiān shìhéhé chī bīngqílín.
en: Ice cream is good to eat in summer.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但这份工作还是适合他。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì zhè fèn gōngzuò háishi shìhéhé tā.
en: Although he's busy, this job is still a good fit for him.

zh: 因为天气很冷，这种厚外套特别适合现在穿。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn lěng, zhè zhǒng hòu wàitào tèbié shìhéhé xiànzài chuān.
en: Since the weather is cold, this thick jacket is especially suitable to wear right now.

zh: 我们需要找一个既能控制成本，又适合大众消费的产品定位。
pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào zhǎo yīgè jì néng kòngzhì chéngběn, yòu shìhéhé dàzhòng xiāofèi de chǎnpǐn dìngwèi.
en: We need to find a product positioning that can control costs while also appealing to mainstream consumers.

zh: 妈妈允许我吃糖。
pinyin: Māma yǔnxǔ wǒ chī táng.
en: Mom allows me to eat candy.

zh: 老师允许学生带手机吗？
pinyin: Lǎoshī yǔnxǔ xuésheng dài shǒujī ma?
en: Does the teacher allow students to bring their phones?

zh: 因为天气不好，公司不允许员工外出工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, gōngsī búyǔnxǔ yuángōng wàichū gōngzuò.
en: Because the weather is bad, the company doesn't allow employees to work outside.

zh: 虽然规则不允许迟到，但是经理会理解特殊情况。
pinyin: Suīrán guīzé búyǔnxǔ chídào, dànshì jīnglǐ huì lǐjiě tèshū qíngkuàng.
en: Although the rules don't permit being late, the manager will understand special circumstances.

zh: 政府允许小企业申请贷款，以便刺激经济增长。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ yǔnxǔ xiǎo qǐyè shēnqǐng dàikuǎn, yǐbiàn cìjī jīngjì zēngzhǎng.
en: The government permits small businesses to apply for loans in order to stimulate economic growth.

zh: 我很失望。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn shīwàng.
en: I'm very disappointed.

zh: 他没来，我感到失望。
pinyin: Tā méi lái, wǒ gǎndào shīwàng.
en: He didn't come, and I felt disappointed.

zh: 虽然我很期待，但结果让我失望了。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ hěn qīdài, dàn jiéguǒ ràng wǒ shīwàngle.
en: Although I was really looking forward to it, the result disappointed me.

zh: 因为他的表现不符合预期，所以观众感到失望。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā de biǎoxiàn bù fúhé yùqī, suǒyǐ guānzhòng gǎndào shīwàng.
en: Since his performance didn't meet expectations, the audience was disappointed.

zh: 这部电影虽然投资很大，但质量不尽人意，让许多影迷感到失望。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng suīrán tóuzī hěn dà, dàn zhìliàng bújìnrényì, ràng xǔduō yǐngmí gǎndào shīwàng.
en: Despite its huge budget, this film's quality left much to be desired, disappointing many movie fans.

zh: 我的意见是吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ de yìjiàn shì chī mǐfàn.
en: My suggestion is to eat rice.

zh: 妈妈听了我的意见,很高兴。
pinyin: Māma tīngle wǒ de yìjiàn, hěn gāoxìng.
en: Mom heard my opinion and was very happy.

zh: 因为老师要听意见,所以学生都说了自己的想法。
pinyin: Yīnwèi lǎoshī yào tīng yìjiàn, suǒyǐ xuésheng dōu shuōle zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
en: Because the teacher wanted to hear opinions, all the students shared their thoughts.

zh: 虽然大家的意见不一样,但我们找到了一个好办法。
pinyin: Suīrán dàjiā de yìjiàn búyīyàng, dàn wǒmen zhǎodàole yī ge hǎo bànfǎ.
