en: Although everyone had different opinions, we found a good solution together.

zh: 我们在会议上听取了各部门的意见,为下一步的计划做准备。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài huìyì shang tīngqǔle gè bùmén de yìjiàn, wèi xiàyībù de jìhuà zuò zhǔnbèi.
en: We gathered feedback from each department at the meeting to prepare for our next plan.

zh: 我获得了一个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ huòdé le yī ge píngguǒ.
en: I got an apple.

zh: 她昨天获得了一份新工作。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān huòdé le yī fèn xīn gōngzuò.
en: She got a new job yesterday.

zh: 因为他努力学习，所以获得了很好的成绩。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā nǔlì xuéxí, suǒyǐ huòdé le hěn hǎo de chéngjì.
en: Because he studied hard, he got really good grades.

zh: 参加这个比赛的人都有机会获得奖金和奖杯。
pinyin: Cānjiā zhège bǐsài de rén dōu yǒu jīhuì huòdé jiǎngjīn hé jiǎngbēi.
en: Everyone who participates in this competition has a chance to win prize money and a trophy.

zh: 通过与国际团队合作，我们公司获得了更多的市场机遇。
pinyin: Tōngguò yǔ guójì tuánduì hézuò, wǒmen gōngsī huòdé le gèngduō de shìchǎng jīhuì.
en: By working with international teams, our company gained access to more market opportunities.

zh: 要是下雨，我们不去。
pinyin: Yàoshi xiàyǔ, wǒmen búqù.
en: If it rains, we won't go.

zh: 要是你明天有时间，可以来我家吃饭。
pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ míngtiān yǒu shíjiān, kěyǐ lái wǒ jiā chīfàn.
en: If you have time tomorrow, you can come to my house for dinner.

zh: 要是你不好好学习，考试的时候就会很难。
pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ búhǎohāo xuéxí, kǎoshì de shíhou jiù huì hěn nán.
en: If you don't study hard, the exam will be really difficult for you.

zh: 要是没有你的帮助，我根本完成不了这个项目。
pinyin: Yàoshi méiyǒu nǐ de bāngzhù, wǒ gēnběn wánchéng búliǎo zhège xiàngmù.
en: Without your help, I simply wouldn't have been able to finish this project.

zh: 要是早知道会这么麻烦，我就不应该答应他们的要求。
pinyin: Yàoshi zǎo zhīdào huì zhème máfan, wǒ jiù búyīnggāi dāying tāmen de yāoqiú.
en: If I'd known it would be such a hassle, I shouldn't have agreed to their demands in the first place.

zh: 我家很近。
pinyin: Wǒ jiā hěn jìn.
en: My home is very close.

zh: 学校离这里不太近。
pinyin: Xuéxiào lí zhèlǐ búTài jìn.
en: The school isn't very close to here.

zh: 因为他家很近，所以他经常来我家玩。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā jiā hěn jìn, suǒyǐ tā jīngcháng lái wǒ jiā wán.
en: Since his place is nearby, he comes to my house to hang out often.

zh: 虽然地铁站离我们公司不近，但是上班还是很方便。
pinyin: Suīrán dìtiě zhàn lí wǒmen gōngsī bújìn, búguò shàngbān háishi hěn fāngbiàn.
en: Although the subway station isn't close to our office, commuting is still quite convenient.

zh: 随着城市发展越来越快，远郊和市中心的距离在不断拉近。
pinyin: Suízhe chéngshì fāzhǎn yuèláiyuè kuài, yuǎnjiāo hé shì zhōngxīn de jùlí zài búduàn lājìn.
en: As the city develops faster and faster, the distance between the outer suburbs and downtown keeps shrinking.

zh: 我有数个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu shù ge píngguǒ.
en: I have several apples.

zh: 昨天我数了一百个学生。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ shǔle yībǎi ge xuésheng.
en: Yesterday I counted a hundred students.

zh: 虽然数字很大，但是我们可以理解这个问题。
pinyin: Suīrán shùzì hěn dà, dànshì wǒmen kěyǐ lǐjiě zhège wèntí.
en: Although the numbers are large, we can still understand the problem.

zh: 根据最新的数据显示，今年的销售额增长了很多。
pinyin: Gēnjù zuìxīn de shùjù xiǎnshì, jīnnián de xiāoshòu'é zēngzhǎngle hěnduō.
en: According to the latest data, sales revenue this year has grown significantly.

zh: 这家公司的数据分析能力强，能够准确预测市场趋势。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de shùjù fēnxī nénggli qiáng, nénggoù zhǔnquè yùcè shìchǎng qūshì.
en: This company has strong data analysis capabilities and can accurately predict market trends.

zh: 这是我的公寓。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de gōngyù.
en: This is my apartment.

zh: 我昨天买了一个新公寓。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān mǎile yī ge xīn gōngyù.
en: I bought a new apartment yesterday.

zh: 因为房子太贵，所以我租了一个小公寓。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fángzi tài guì, suǒyǐ wǒ zūle yī ge xiǎo gōngyù.
en: Because houses are too expensive, I rented a small apartment instead.

zh: 这个公寓虽然离地铁远，但是价格便宜很多。
pinyin: Zhège gōngyù suīrán lí dìtiě yuǎn, dànshi jiàgé piányì hěnduō.
en: Although this apartment is far from the subway, it's much cheaper.

zh: 他在市中心的公寓里工作和生活，每个月的租金占了工资的三分之一。
pinyin: Tā zài shì zhōngxīn de gōngyù lǐ gōngzuò hé shēnghuó, měi ge yuè de zūjīn zhānle gōngzī de sān fēnzhī yī.
en: He works and lives in an apartment downtown, where the monthly rent takes up a third of his salary.

zh: 这是我的文件。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de wénjiàn.
en: This is my file.

zh: 老师今天给我们新的文件。
pinyin: Lǎoshī jīntiān gěi wǒmen xīn de wénjiàn.
en: The teacher gave us new documents today.

zh: 因为文件很重要，所以我把它保存了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wénjiàn hěn zhòngyào, suǒyǐ wǒ bǎ tā bǎocúnle.
en: Because the file is important, I saved it.

zh: 虽然文件已经发送了，但是客户还没有收到。
pinyin: Suīrán wénjiàn yǐjīng fāsòngle, dànshì kèhù háishi méiyǒu shōudào.
en: Although the document was sent, the client still hasn't received it.

zh: 这份合同文件需要双方签字，否则就没有法律效力。
pinyin: Zhè fèn hétonɡ wénjiàn xūyào shuāngfāng qiānzì, fǒuzé jiù méiyǒu fǎlǜ xiàolì.
en: This contract document needs to be signed by both parties, otherwise it won't be legally valid.

zh: 我只能吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ zhǐnéng chī mǐfàn.
en: I can only eat rice.

zh: 今天下雨,我们只能在家里。
pinyin: Jīntiān xiàyǔ, wǒmen zhǐnéng zàijiālǐ.
en: It's raining today, so we can only stay at home.

zh: 因为没有钱,他只能坐公交车去上班。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu qián, tā zhǐnéng zuò gōngjiāo chē qù shàngbān.
en: Because he doesn't have money, he can only take the bus to work.

zh: 虽然很累,但是他们只能继续工作来完成这个项目。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì tāmen zhǐnéng jìxù gōngzuò lái wánchéng zhège xiàngmù.
en: Although they're exhausted, they can only keep working to finish this project.

zh: 在这种情况下,我们只能暂时搁置分歧,先把重要的事情解决了。
pinyin: Zài zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng xià, wǒmen zhǐnéng zànshíxing gēzhì fēnqī, xiān bǎ zhònyào de shìqing jiějuéle.
en: Given these circumstances, we can only set aside our differences for now and handle the urgent matters first.

zh: 这是白纸。
pinyin: Zhè shì bái zhǐ.
en: This is white paper.

zh: 我喜欢喝白牛奶。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān hē bái niúnǎi.
en: I like drinking white milk.

zh: 因为天气很冷，所以雪是白的。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn lěng, suǒyǐ xuě shì bái de.
en: Because the weather is very cold, the snow is white.

zh: 她穿着白色的裙子去参加了朋友的婚礼。
pinyin: Tā chuānzhe báisè de qúnzi qù cānjiāle péngyou de hūnlǐ.
en: She wore a white dress to attend her friend's wedding.

zh: 虽然他为这个项目付出了很多努力，但成果却不理想，几乎白费了功夫。
pinyin: Suīrán tā wèi zhège xiàngmù fùchūle hěnduō nǔlì, dàn chéngguǒ què bù lǐxiǎng, jīhū báifèile gōngfu.
en: Although he put a lot of effort into this project, the results fell short, and his work was almost wasted.

zh: 我在寻找我的钥匙。
pinyin: Wǒ zài xúnzhǎo wǒ de yàoshi.
en: I'm looking for my keys.

zh: 昨天我在公园里寻找我的狗。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài gōngyuán lǐ xúnzhǎo wǒ de gǒu.
en: Yesterday I was searching for my dog in the park.

zh: 因为找不到工作,所以他在网上寻找机会。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhǎo bu dào gōngzuò, suǒyǐ tā zài wǎngshang xúnzhǎo jīhuì.
en: Because he couldn't find a job, he's been searching for opportunities online.

zh: 虽然这很困难,但很多人还在寻找更好的生活。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè hěn kùnnan, dàn hěnduō rén háishi zài xúnzhǎo gèng hǎo de shēnghuó.
en: Although it's difficult, many people are still searching for a better life.

zh: 现在很多年轻人都在寻找一份既能赚钱又有意义的工作。
pinyin: Xiànzài hěnduō niánqīng rén dōu zài xúnzhǎo yī fèn既 néng zuànqián yòu yǒu yìyì de gōngzuò.
en: These days, many young people are looking for work that's both lucrative and meaningful.

zh: 狗攻击了我。
pinyin: Gǒu gōngjī le wǒ.
en: The dog attacked me.

zh: 昨天敌人攻击了我们的城市。
pinyin: Zuótiān díren gōngjī le wǒmen de chéngshì.
en: The enemy attacked our city yesterday.

zh: 虽然我们很强，但敌人还是攻击了我们。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen hěn qiáng, dàn díren háishi gōngjī le wǒmen.
en: Although we were strong, the enemy still attacked us.

zh: 在网络上，很多人喜欢攻击那些有名的明星。
pinyin: Zài wǎngluò shang, hěnduō rén xǐhuān gōngjī nàxiē yǒumíng de míngxīng.
en: On the internet, a lot of people like to attack famous celebrities.

zh: 政府决定用新的策略来攻击这个经济问题。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ juéding yòng xīn de cèlüè lái gōngjī zhège jīngjì wèntí.
en: The government decided to tackle this economic problem with a new strategy.

zh: 这个苹果烂了。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ làn le.
en: This apple is rotten.

zh: 昨天买的菜今天就烂了。
pinyin: Zuótiān mǎi de cài jīntiān jiù làn le.
en: The vegetables I bought yesterday are already bad today.

zh: 因为天气太热，所以食物很容易烂掉。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì tài rè, suǒyǐ shíwù hěn róngyì làn diào.
en: Because the weather is so hot, food spoils easily.

zh: 虽然这部电影的剧情有点烂，但演员表现得不错。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè bù diànyǐng de jùqíng yǒudiǎn làn, dàn yǎnyuán biǎoxiàn de búcuò.
en: Although the plot of this movie is pretty weak, the actors performed well.

zh: 他这几年工作烂透了，成天混日子，难怪领导对他没信心。
pinyin: Tā zhè jǐ nián gōngzuò làn tòu le, chéngtiān hùn rìzi, nánguài lǐngdǎo duì tā méi xìnxin.
en: His work has been terrible these past few years—he just coasts by every day—so it's no wonder his boss has lost confidence in him.

zh: 你要吃饭，不然会饿。
pinyin: Nǐ yào chīfàn, búrán huì è.
en: You need to eat, or else you'll get hungry.

zh: 现在就睡觉，不然明天会很累。
pinyin: Xiànzài jiù shuìjiào, búrán míngtiān huì hěn lèi.
en: Go to bed now, otherwise you'll be really tired tomorrow.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以我们要带伞，不然衣服会湿。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ wǒmen yào dàisǎn, búrán yīfu huì shī.
en: Since it's raining, we need to bring an umbrella, or our clothes will get wet.

zh: 你必须今天完成这个项目，不然老板会很生气。
pinyin: Nǐ bìxū jīntiān wánchéng zhège xiàngmù, búrán lǎobǎn huì hěn shēngqì.
en: You have to finish this project today, or the boss will be really upset.

zh: 我们得立刻采取行动，不然这个问题会越来越严重。
pinyin: Wǒmen děi lìkè cǎiqǔ xíngdòng, búrán zhège wèntí huì yuèláiyuè yánzhòng.
en: We need to take action immediately, otherwise this problem will only get worse and worse.

zh: 我邀请你吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ yāoqǐng nǐ chīfàn.
en: I'm inviting you to eat.

zh: 妈妈邀请朋友来家里玩。
pinyin: Māma yāoqǐng péngyou lái jiālǐ wán.
en: Mom is inviting friends over to our house.

zh: 因为周末有时间，我邀请了她一起去公园。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhōumò yǒu shíjiān, wǒ yāoqǐngle tā yìqǐ qù gōngyuán.
en: Since I have free time on the weekend, I invited her to go to the park with me.

zh: 虽然我们不常见面，但他仍然邀请我参加他的生日派对。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen búcháng jiànmiàn, dàn tā réngránhuà yāoqǐng wǒ cānjiā tāde shēngrì pàiduì.
en: Even though we don't see each other often, he still invited me to his birthday party.

zh: 公司邀请了几位业界专家来分享他们在数字营销方面的经验。
pinyin: Gōngsī yāoqǐngle jǐ wèi yèjiè zhuānjiā lái fēnxiǎng tāmende zài shùzì yíngxiāo fāngmiàn de jīngyàn.
en: The company invited several industry experts to share their experience in digital marketing.

zh: 尽管下雨，我还是去了。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn xiàyǔ, wǒ háishi qùle.
en: Even though it was raining, I still went.

zh: 尽管很累，他今天还要工作。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn hěn lèi, tā jīntiān háiyào gōngzuò.
en: Despite being very tired, he still has to work today.

zh: 尽管天气不好，但是公园里还有很多人。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tiānqì búhǎo, dànshi gōngyuán li háiyǒu hěnduō rén.
en: Although the weather is bad, there are still many people in the park.

zh: 尽管这个计划有风险，公司还是决定试一试。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhège jìhuà yǒu fēngxiǎn, gōngsī háishi juéding shì yī shi.
en: Despite the risks involved in this plan, the company decided to give it a try anyway.

zh: 尽管媒体有各种质疑，这部电影最终还是获得了广泛认可。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn méitǐ yǒu gèzhǒng zhìyí, zhè bù diànyǐng zuìzhōng háishi huòdéle guǎngfàn rènkě.
en: Despite widespread skepticism from the media, the film ultimately gained broad acceptance.

zh: 我姐姐很高。
pinyin: Wǒ jiějie hěn gāo.
en: My older sister is very tall.

zh: 姐姐每天都吃早饭。
pinyin: Jiějie měi tiān dōu chī zǎofàn.
en: My older sister eats breakfast every day.

zh: 因为姐姐很忙，所以我帮她做饭。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jiějie hěn máng, suǒyǐ wǒ bāng tā zuò fàn.
en: Because my older sister is busy, I help her cook.

zh: 虽然姐姐工作很累，但她还是坚持学英语。
pinyin: Suīrán jiějie gōngzuò hěn lèi, dàn tā háishi jiānchí xué yīngyǔ.
en: Although my older sister's job is tiring, she still insists on studying English.

zh: 姐姐最近升职了，她对新工作既兴奋又有点紧张。
pinyin: Jiějie zuìjìn shēngzhí le, tā duì xīn gōngzuò jì xīngfèn yòu yǒudiǎn jǐnzhāng.
en: My older sister got promoted recently, and she's both excited and a bit nervous about her new position.

zh: 不要浪费食物。
pinyin: Búyào làngfèi shíwù.
en: Don't waste food.

zh: 每天浪费很多水真的不好。
pinyin: Měitiān làngfèi hěnduō shuǐ zhēnde búhǎo.
en: Wasting so much water every day is really not good.

zh: 虽然很贵，但是浪费钱就太傻了。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn guì, búshì làngfèi qián jiù tài shǎ le.
en: Even though it's expensive, wasting money like that is just foolish.

zh: 为了不浪费资源，公司决定回收所有旧的材料。
pinyin: Wèile búlàngfèi zīyuán, gōngsī juéding huīshōu suǒyǒu jiù de cáiliào.
en: In order to avoid wasting resources, the company decided to recycle all the old materials.

zh: 现在很多年轻人意识到浪费粮食的危害，开始珍惜每一餐。
pinyin: Xiànzài hěnduō niánqīng rén yìshi dào làngfèi liángshi de wēihài, kāishǐ zhēnxī měi yī cān.
en: Nowadays many young people are becoming aware of the harm caused by wasting food and have started to value every meal.

zh: 谢谢你，多谢了。
pinyin: Xièxie nǐ, duōxiè le.
en: Thank you so much.

zh: 你帮我买饭，我多谢你。
pinyin: Nǐ bāng wǒ mǎi fàn, wǒ duōxiè nǐ.
en: You bought me lunch—I really appreciate it.

zh: 虽然很忙，但你还是帮了我，多谢。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn máng, dànshì nǐ háishi bāng le wǒ, duōxiè.
en: Even though you were busy, you still helped me out—thanks a lot.

zh: 上次面试多谢你的建议，我后来成功了。
pinyin: Shàng cì miànshì duōxiè nǐ de jiànyì, wǒ hòulái chénggōng le.
en: I really appreciated your advice before my last interview—I ended up getting the job.

zh: 这些年来无论什么困难你都在，多谢你的信任和陪伴。
pinyin: Zhè xiē nián lái wúlùn shénme kùnnan nǐ dōu zài, duōxiè nǐ de xìnrèn hé péibàn.
en: All these years, no matter what challenges came up, you were there—thank you so much for your trust and support.

zh: 我有一个女朋友。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī ge nǚ péngyou.
en: I have a girlfriend.

zh: 昨天我和女朋友去吃饭了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hé nǚ péngyou qù chīfàn le.
en: Yesterday I went out to eat with my girlfriend.

zh: 因为喜欢她，所以我给女朋友买了礼物。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xǐhuān tā, suǒyǐ wǒ gěi nǚ péngyou mǎi le lǐwù.
en: Because I like her, I bought my girlfriend a gift.

zh: 我女朋友虽然很忙，但是每天都会给我打电话。
pinyin: Wǒ nǚ péngyou suīrán hěn máng, búguò měi tiān dōu huì gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
en: Although my girlfriend is very busy, she still calls me every day.

zh: 我和女朋友相处三年了，现在考虑和她一起搬家。
pinyin: Wǒ hé nǚ péngyou xiāngchǔ sān nián le, xiànzài kǎolǜ hé tā yīqǐ bānjiā.
en: My girlfriend and I have been together for three years, and now we're thinking about moving in together.

zh: 我喜欢动物。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān dòngwù.
en: I like animals.

zh: 动物园里有很多动物。
pinyin: Dòngwùyuán lǐ yǒu hěnduō dòngwù.
en: There are lots of animals in the zoo.

zh: 因为天气很冷，所以很多动物都睡觉了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn lěng, suǒyǐ hěnduō dòngwù dōu shuìjiào le.
en: Because the weather is so cold, a lot of animals are hibernating.

zh: 虽然这些动物看起来很凶，但是它们其实很害怕人。
pinyin: Suīrán zhèxiē dòngwù kàn qǐlai hěn xiōng, dànshì tāmen qīshí hěn hàipà rén.
en: Although these animals look fierce, they're actually quite afraid of humans.

zh: 研究表明，许多野生动物的栖息地正在急速减少。
pinyin: Yánjiū biǎomíng, xǔduō yěshēng dòngwù de qīxī dì zhèngzài jísù jiǎnshǎo.
en: Research shows that the habitats of many wild animals are rapidly shrinking.

zh: 我吃了一半的苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ chīle yībàn de píngguǒ.
en: I ate half of the apple.

zh: 今天一半的时间下雨了。
pinyin: Jīntiān yībàn de shíjiān xiàyǔle.
en: It rained for half of the day today.

zh: 虽然我做完了一半的工作，但是还很累。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ zuòwánle yībàn de gōngzuò, dànshì háishi hěn lèi.
en: Although I've finished half the work, I'm still really tired.

zh: 因为只有一半的员工来参加会议，所以会议延迟了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhǐyǒu yībàn de yuángōng lái cānjiā huìyì, suǒyǐ huìyì yánchíle.
en: The meeting was postponed because only half the staff showed up.

zh: 这个项目的预算已经用掉一半了，剩下的时间可能不够完成。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de yùsuàn yǐjīng yòngdiào yībàn le, shèngxià de shíjiān kěnéng búgòu wánchéng.
en: Half the project budget has already been spent, and the remaining time might not be enough to finish it.

zh: 某个学生很聪明。
pinyin: Mǒuggè xuésheng hěn cōngming.
en: A certain student is very smart.

zh: 某个星期天，我去了公园。
pinyin: Mǒuggè xīngqītiān, wǒ qùle gōngyuán.
en: One Sunday, I went to the park.

zh: 虽然某个办法很简单，但是效果特别好。
pinyin: Suīrán mǒuggè bànfǎ hěn jiǎndān, dànshì xiàoguǒ tèbié hǎo.
en: Although a certain method is very simple, the results are particularly good.

zh: 他在某个会议上提出了新的建议和想法。
pinyin: Tā zài mǒuggè huìyì shang tíchūle xīnde jiànyì hé xiǎngfǎ.
en: He put forward new suggestions and ideas at a certain meeting.

zh: 某个公司虽然规模不大，但凭借专业技术在市场上站稳了脚跟。
pinyin: Mǒuggè gōngsī suīrán guīmó búdà, dàn píngjiè zhuānyè jìshù zài shìchǎng shang zhànwěnle jiǎogēn.
en: Although a certain company isn't large in scale, it has established itself firmly in the market through professional expertise.

zh: 猫躲在床下。
pinyin: māo躲zài chuángxià。
en: The cat is hiding under the bed.

zh: 下雨的时候，我躲在家里。
pinyin: xiàyǔ de shíhou, wǒ躲zài jiāli。
en: When it rains, I stay inside at home.

zh: 虽然很害怕，但他还是躲在角落里。
pinyin: suīrán hěn hàipà, dànshi tā háishi躲zài jiǎoluò li。
en: Although he was very scared, he still hid himself in the corner.

zh: 因为害怕被批评，她躲避了这次重要的会议。
pinyin: yīnwèi hàipà bèi pīpíng, tā躲bì le zhè cì zhòngyào de huìyì。
en: Because she was afraid of being criticized, she avoided this important meeting.

zh: 与其躲躲闪闪，不如坦诚面对问题。
pinyin: yǔqī躲躲shǎnshǎn, búrú tǎnchéng miànduì wèntí。
en: It's better to face the problem honestly than to keep dodging and evading it.

zh: 你为何不吃饭？
pinyin: Nǐ wèihé bù chīfàn?
en: Why aren't you eating?

zh: 他今天为何没有来上课？
pinyin: Tā jīntiān wèihé méiyǒu lái shàngkè?
en: Why didn't he come to class today?

zh: 虽然天气不好，但我还是想知道你为何要去。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dàn wǒ háishi xiǎng zhīdào nǐ wèihé yào qù.
en: Even though the weather is bad, I still want to know why you're going.

zh: 他对这个决定感到失望，为何公司没有征询员工的意见。
pinyin: Tā duì zhège juéding gǎndào shīwàng, wèihé gōngsī méiyǒu zhēngxún yuángōng de yìjiàn.
en: He's disappointed about the decision—why the company didn't consult employees' opinions.

zh: 我一直搞不明白为何他们宁可放弃机会也不愿改变主意。
pinyin: Wǒ yīzhí gǎobu míngbai wèihé tāmen níngkě fàngqì jīhuì yě búyuàn gǎibiàn zhǔyì.
en: I've never understood why they'd rather give up the opportunity than change their minds.

zh: 要么吃饭，要么睡觉。
pinyin: Yàome chīfàn, yàome shuìjiào.
en: Either eat or sleep.

zh: 今天要么下雨，要么天气很好。
pinyin: Jīntiān yàome xiàyǔ, yàome tiānqì hěn hǎo.
en: Today it'll either rain or be nice weather.

zh: 因为时间不够，要么现在出发，要么明天再去。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shíjiān búgòu, yàome xiànzài chūfā, yàome míngtiān zài qù.
en: Since we don't have enough time, we either leave now or go tomorrow.

zh: 他的性格很矛盾，要么特别热情，要么完全冷漠。
pinyin: Tā de xìnggé hěn máodùn, yàome tèbié règíng, yàome wánquán lěngmò.
en: His personality is contradictory—he's either extremely warm or completely indifferent.

zh: 与其纠结过去的错误，要么积极改变，要么学会释怀。
pinyin: Yǔqī jiūjié guòqù de cuòwù, yàome jījí gǎibiàn, yàome xuéhuì shìhuái.
en: Rather than dwell on past mistakes, you either take active steps to change or learn to let it go.

zh: 别逼我吃菜。
pinyin: Bié bī wǒ chī cài.
en: Don't force me to eat vegetables.

zh: 妈妈总是逼我做功课。
pinyin: Māma zǒngshì bī wǒ zuò gōngkè.
en: Mom is always pushing me to do my homework.

zh: 虽然他逼我去参加比赛，但是我现在很感谢他。
pinyin: Suīrán tā bī wǒ qù cānjiā bǐsài, dànshì wǒ xiànzài hěn gǎnxiè tā.
en: Although he pressured me into competing, I'm really grateful to him now.

zh: 工作压力很大，我感觉被逼到了墙角。
pinyin: Gōngzuò yālì hěn dà, wǒ gǎnjuéde bèi bī dàole qiángjiǎo.
en: The work pressure is intense, and I feel backed into a corner.

zh: 形势所迫，公司逼不得已裁员百分之二十。
pinyin: Xíngshì suǒ pò, gōngsī bībuděyǐ cáiyuán bǎifēnzhī èrshí.
en: Given the circumstances, the company had no choice but to lay off twenty percent of its staff.

zh: 我欠你五块钱。
pinyin: Wǒ qiàn nǐ wǔ kuài qián.
en: I owe you five yuan.

zh: 上次借你的书，我还欠你一本。
pinyin: Shàng cì jiè nǐ de shū, wǒ háishi qiàn nǐ yī běn.
en: I still owe you one book from when you lent me some last time.

zh: 因为工作太忙，我欠了很多朋友的饭，但是下个月会还。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng, wǒ qiànle hěnduō péngyou de fàn, dànshì xià ge yuè huì huán.
en: Because I've been so busy with work, I owe several friends meals, but I'll pay them back next month.

zh: 他欠了银行一大笔钱，现在每个月都要还利息。
pinyin: Tā qiànle yínháng yī dà bǐ qián, xiànzài měi ge yuè dōu yào huán lìxī.
en: He owes the bank a large sum of money and has to pay interest every month now.

zh: 虽然公司欠薪已经三个月，但员工们还是坚持在岗位上工作。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngsī qiàn xīn yǐjīng sān ge yuè, dàn yuángōngmen háishi jiānchí zài gǎngwèi shang gōngzuò.
en: Although the company has been behind on wages for three months already, the employees are still sticking to their posts.

zh: 这是一个轮子。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè lúnzi.
en: This is a wheel.

zh: 自行车的轮子很圆。
pinyin: Zìxíngchē de lúnzi hěn yuán.
en: The wheels on a bicycle are very round.

zh: 因为下雨，汽车的轮子很脏。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, qìchē de lúnzi hěn zāng.
en: Because it rained, the car's wheels got really dirty.

zh: 我们轮流做饭，这样每个人的负担都不太重。
pinyin: Wǒmen lúnliú zuòfàn, zhèyàng měi ge rén de fùdān dōu búhuì tài zhòng.
en: We take turns cooking, so no one person has too heavy a load.

zh: 在团队项目中，大家轮流担任不同的角色，这样能发挥每个人的优势。
pinyin: Zài tuánduì xiàngmù zhōng, dàjiā lúnliú dānrèn búntóng de juésè, zhèyàng néng fāhuī měi ge rén de yōushì.
en: In team projects, everyone takes turns in different roles, which allows each person to play to their strengths.

zh: 他试图吃饭。
pinyin: Tā shìtú chīfàn.
en: He's trying to eat.

zh: 昨天她试图找我的书。
pinyin: Zuótiān tā shìtú zhǎo wǒ de shū.
en: Yesterday she tried to find my book.

zh: 虽然他试图帮我，但是我不需要帮助。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shìtú bāng wǒ, dànshì wǒ búxūyào bāngzhù.
en: Although he tried to help me, I didn't need any help.

zh: 公司试图通过降低价格来吸引更多的客户。
pinyin: Gōngsī shìtú tōngguò jiàngdī jiàgé lái xīyǐn gèngduō de kèhù.
en: The company is trying to attract more customers by lowering prices.

zh: 尽管政府一再试图改革教育系统，但进展仍然缓慢。
pinyin: Jìnguǎn zhèngfǔ yīzài shìtú gǎigé jiàoyù xìtǒng, dàn jìnzhǎn réngrán huǎnman.
en: Despite the government's repeated attempts to reform the education system, progress remains slow.

zh: 我很快反应了。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn kuài fǎnyìng le.
en: I reacted very quickly.

zh: 他听到声音后立刻反应过来。
pinyin: Tā tīngdào shēngyīn hòu lìkè fǎnyìng guòlái.
en: He immediately reacted when he heard the sound.

zh: 虽然我很累，但我对他的话还是有反应。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ hěn lèi, dàn wǒ duì tā de huà háishi yǒu fǎnyìng.
en: Even though I was exhausted, I still responded to what he said.

zh: 医生观察了病人对药物的反应情况。
pinyin: Yīshēng guānchá le bìngrén duì yàowù de fǎnyìng qíngkuàng.
en: The doctor monitored how the patient reacted to the medication.

zh: 市场对这项政策的反应相当冷淡，投资者普遍持观望态度。
pinyin: Shìchǎng duì zhè xiàng zhèngcè de fǎnyìng xiāngdāng lěngdàn, tóuzīzhě pǔbiàn chí guānwàng tàidù.
en: The market's response to this policy has been rather lukewarm, with investors generally taking a wait-and-see approach.

zh: 我家在西边。
pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài xībīan.
en: My home is on the west side.

zh: 昨天我去了西边的商店。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ qùle xībīan de shāngdiàn.
en: Yesterday I went to the shop on the west side.

zh: 虽然西边的路很远，但是我经常去那里。
pinyin: Suīrán xībīan de lù hěn yuǎn, dànshì wǒ jīngcháng qù nàlǐ.
en: Although the road to the west is far, I often go there.

zh: 因为西部的经济发展得不够快，政府开始投入更多资源。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xībù de jīngjì fāzhǎn de búgòu kuài, zhèngfǔ kāishǐ tóurù gèngduō zīyuán.
en: Because economic development in the west region isn't progressing fast enough, the government has started investing more resources.

zh: 这家公司向西扩展业务时遇到了不少文化差异的挑战。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī xiàng xī kuòzhǎn yèwù shí yùdàole búshǎo wénhuà chāyì de tiǎozhàn.
en: When this company expanded its business westward, it encountered quite a few challenges related to cultural differences.

zh: 我一边吃饭一边看电视。
pinyin: Wǒ yībīan chīfàn yībīan kàn diànshì.
en: I eat while watching TV.

zh: 妈妈一边做饭一边唱歌很开心。
pinyin: Māma yībīan zuòfàn yībīan chànggē hěn kāixīn.
en: Mom is very happy cooking while singing.

zh: 因为时间不多，我一边走路一边吃早饭。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shíjiān búduō, wǒ yībīan zǒulù yībīan chī zǎofàn.
en: Because I don't have much time, I eat breakfast while walking.

zh: 他一边听音乐一边工作，效率反而提高了。
pinyin: Tā yībīan tīng yīnyuè yībīan gōngzuò, xiàolǜ fǎn'ér tígāo le.
en: He listens to music while working, and his productivity actually improved.

zh: 现在很多人一边刷手机一边吃饭，根本没尝出食物的味道。
pinyin: Xiànzài hěnduō rén yībīan shuā shǒujī yībīan chīfàn, gēnběn méi chángchū shíwù de wèidào.
en: These days lots of people scroll on their phones while eating and completely miss the flavor of their food.

zh: 我听见妈妈的声音。
pinyin: Wǒ tīngjìan māma de shēngyīn.
en: I hear my mom's voice.

zh: 早上我听见了鸟儿唱歌。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ tīngjìan le niǎor chànggē.
en: This morning I heard the birds singing.

zh: 虽然很远，但我还是听见了那个声音。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn yuǎn, dàn wǒ háishi tīngjìan le nàge shēngyīn.
en: Even though it was far away, I could still hear that sound.

zh: 在电话里听见朋友的笑声，我感到很开心。
pinyin: Zài diànhuà lǐ tīngjìan péngyou de xiàoshēng, wǒ gǎndào hěn kāixīn.
en: Hearing my friend's laughter over the phone made me feel really happy.

zh: 他从未听见过这么美妙的音乐，简直惊艳到了。
pinyin: Tā cóngwèi tīngjìan guò zhème měimiào de yīnyuè, jiǎnzhí jīngyàn dào le.
en: He'd never heard music so beautiful before—it absolutely amazed him.

zh: 这个床很舒服。
pinyin: Zhège chuáng hěn shūfu.
en: This bed is very comfortable.

zh: 穿上新衣服以后，我感到很舒服。
pinyin: Chuān shang xīn yīfu yǐhòu, wǒ gǎndào hěn shūfu.
en: After putting on new clothes, I felt really comfortable.

zh: 虽然天气很热，但是这个房间里很舒服，因为有空调。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn rè, dànshì zhège fángjiān lǐ hěn shūfu, yīnwèi yǒu kōngtiáo.
en: Although it's hot outside, this room is very comfortable because there's air conditioning.

zh: 长时间坐着会不舒服，所以我建议每小时站起来活动一下。
pinyin: Cháng shíjiān zuòzhe huì búshūfu, suǒyǐ wǒ jiànyì měi xiǎoshí zhàn qǐlai huódòng yīxià.
en: Sitting for long periods becomes uncomfortable, so I recommend standing up and moving around every hour.

zh: 这家咖啡馆的环境和服务都不错，让人坐下来就感到身心舒服。
pinyin: Zhè jiā kāfēiguǎn de huánjìng hé fúwù dōu búcuò, ràng rén zuòxiàlai jiù gǎndào shēnxīn shūfu.
en: This café has a nice atmosphere and good service that makes you feel at ease both physically and mentally.

zh: 他的考试失败了。
pinyin: Tā de kǎoshì shībài le.
en: He failed his exam.

zh: 昨天我做饭失败了,菜烧焦了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zuòfàn shībài le, cài shāojiāo le.
en: I messed up cooking yesterday and burned the food.

zh: 虽然第一次失败了,但是他继续努力,最后成功了。
pinyin: Suīrán dì-yī cì shībài le, dànshì tā jìxù nǔlì, zuìhòu chénggōng le.
en: Although he failed the first time, he kept trying and eventually succeeded.

zh: 这个项目失败的原因是团队沟通不够,导致进度延迟。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù shībài de yuányīn shì tuánduì gōutōng búguò, dǎozhì jìnduò yánchí.
en: The project failed because the team didn't communicate well enough, which caused delays.

zh: 许多创业者经历过失败,但他们把失败当作学习的机会,最终才能成功。
pinyin: Xǔduō chuàngyèzhě jīnglìguò shībài, dàn tāmen bǎ shībài dàngzuò xuéxí de jīhuì, zuìzhōng cáinéng chénggōng.
en: Many entrepreneurs have experienced failure, but by treating it as a learning opportunity, they eventually find success.

zh: 这条路通到学校。
pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù tōng dào xuéxiào.
en: This road leads to the school.

zh: 地铁通过我们的城市。
pinyin: Dìtiě tōngguò wǒmen de chéngshì.
en: The subway runs through our city.

zh: 因为这扇门坏了，所以不通了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè shàn mén huài le, suǒyǐ bù tōng le.
en: Since this door is broken, it won't open anymore.

zh: 我们用邮件通知了所有的客户这个新政策。
pinyin: Wǒmen yòng yóujiàn tōngzhī le suǒyǒu de kèhù zhège xīn zhèngcè.
en: We notified all our customers about the new policy by email.

zh: 只要你能打通这个关系，就容易和他们谈合作了。
pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ néng dǎ tōng zhège guānxi, jiù róngyì hé tāmen tán hézuò le.
en: Once you can establish that connection, it'll be easy to discuss a partnership with them.

zh: 我有时吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒushí chī mǐfàn.
en: I eat rice sometimes.

zh: 她有时在家看电视。
pinyin: Tā yǒushí zài jiā kàn diànshì.
en: She watches TV at home sometimes.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但有时还是会来看我。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn yǒushí háishi huì lái kàn wǒ.
en: Even though he's busy, he still comes to see me sometimes.

zh: 下雨的时候，我有时会选择在家工作而不是去办公室。
pinyin: Xiàyǔ de shíhou, wǒ yǒushí huì xuǎnzé zài jiā gōngzuò érbuShì qù bàngōngshì.
en: When it rains, I sometimes choose to work from home instead of going to the office.

zh: 有时候生活的压力太大，我们需要停下来反思一下自己的目标。
pinyin: Yǒushíhou shēnghuó de yālì tài dà, wǒmen xūyào tíngxialai fǎnsi yīxià zìjǐ de mùbiāo.
en: Sometimes when life's pressure builds up too much, we need to pause and reflect on what we're really after.

zh: 我一般吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ yībān chī mǐfàn.
en: I usually eat rice.

zh: 他一般每天早上跑步。
pinyin: Tā yībān měitiān zǎoshang pǎobù.
en: He generally runs every morning.

zh: 虽然今天很累，但我一般还是会去运动。
pinyin: Suīrán jīntiān hěn lèi, dàn wǒ yībān háishi huì qù yùndòng.
en: Even though I'm tired today, I still usually go exercise.

zh: 这家餐厅的菜一般都不太辣，很适合北方人吃。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài yībān dōu búhuò tài là, hěn shìhéhé běifāng rén chī.
en: The dishes at this restaurant are generally not very spicy, which suits people from the north.

zh: 一般来说，年轻人对新技术的接受度比较高，这反映了社会的进步。
pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, niánqīng rén duì xīn jìshù de jiēshòu dù bǐjiào gāo, zhè fǎnyìngle shèhuì de jìnbù.
en: Generally speaking, young people tend to accept new technology more readily, which reflects social progress.

zh: 我喜欢吃蛋。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān chī dàn.
en: I like to eat eggs.

zh: 早上我吃了两个蛋和面包。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ chīle liǎng ge dàn hé miànbāo.
en: This morning I had two eggs and some bread.

zh: 因为蛋很便宜，所以我经常买蛋吃。
pinyin: Yīnwèi dàn hěn piányì, suǒyǐ wǒ jīngcháng mǎi dàn chī.
en: Because eggs are cheap, I buy them to eat quite often.

zh: 虽然这个蛋看起来有点奇怪，但是味道还是不错的。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège dàn kàn qǐlái yǒudiǎn qíguài, dànshì wèidào háishi búcuò de.
en: Even though this egg looks a bit odd, it still tastes pretty good.

zh: 他不想碰那些蛋，因为害怕弄坏了会被责骂。
pinyin: Tā búxiǎng pèng nàxiē dàn, yīnwèi hàipà nònghuàile huì bèi zéomà.
en: He didn't want to touch those eggs because he was afraid of breaking them and getting scolded.

zh: 我介绍一下我的家人。
pinyin: Wǒ介shào yīxià wǒ de jiārén.
en: Let me introduce my family.

zh: 今天我给你介绍我的新朋友。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ gěi nǐ介shào wǒ de xīn péngyou.
en: Today I'll introduce you to my new friend.

zh: 因为他很有趣，所以我想介绍他给你认识。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn yǒuqù, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng介shào tā gěi nǐ rènshi.
en: Because he's really fun, I want to introduce him to you.

zh: 这家餐厅很受欢迎，我经常向朋友介绍它。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng hěn shòu huānyíng, wǒ jīngcháng xiàng péngyou介shào tā.
en: This restaurant is very popular, and I often recommend it to friends.

zh: 与其自己摸索，不如让专家介绍一下最新的技术发展趋势。
pinyin: Yǔqī zìjǐ mōsuǒ, búrú ràng zhuānjiā介shào yīxià zuìxīn de jìshù fāzhǎn qūshì.
en: Rather than fumbling around ourselves, we might as well have an expert walk us through the latest tech trends.

zh: 下雨很意外。
pinyin: Xiàyǔ hěn yìwài.
en: The rain was unexpected.

zh: 他今天没来，我很意外。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān méi lái, wǒ hěn yìwài.
en: He didn't come today—I was really surprised.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但是他意外地到了。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, búshì tā yìwài de dàole.
en: Although the weather was bad, he surprisingly managed to arrive.

zh: 这个计划失败了，结果意外地引发了更多的讨论。
pinyin: Zhège jìhuà shībàile, jiéguǒ yìwài de yǐnfāle gèngduō de tǎolùn.
en: The plan fell through, but unexpectedly it sparked even more discussion.

zh: 他一开始反对这个想法，意外的是，后来他成了最坚定的支持者。
pinyin: Tā yīkāishǐ fǎnduì zhège xiǎngfǎ, yìwài de shì, hòulái tā chéngle zuì jiānhuà de zhīchízhě.
en: He initially opposed the idea, but surprisingly, he later became its strongest advocate.

zh: 这个字很难。
pinyin: Zhège zì hěn nán.
en: This character is really difficult.

zh: 老师教我们写字的时候很耐心。
pinyin: Lǎoshī jiāo wǒmen xiězì de shíhou hěn nàixin.
en: The teacher is very patient when teaching us how to write characters.

zh: 虽然我认识这个字，但是我不知道它的意思。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ rènshi zhège zì, dànshi wǒ búzhīdào tā de yìsi.
en: Even though I recognize this character, I don't actually know what it means.

zh: 因为字写得不规范，老板让我重新填这份表格。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zì xiězhe búguīfàn, lǎobǎn ràng wǒ chóngxīn tiánzhè fèn biǎogé.
en: Because my handwriting wasn't neat, the boss made me fill out the form again.

zh: 这个词有多种写法，但是现代汉语里最常用的字形还是这一种。
pinyin: Zhège cí yǒu duōzhǒng xiězǐfǎ, dànshi xiàndài Hànyǔ lǐ zuì chángyòng de zìxíng háishi zhè yī zhǒng.
en: This word has several different written forms, but in modern Chinese the most common character form is still this one.

zh: 我进入教室。
pinyin: Wǒ jìnrù jiàoshì.
en: I enter the classroom.

zh: 每天早上我都进入办公室工作。
pinyin: Měi tiān zǎoshang wǒ dōu jìnrù bàngōngshì gōngzuò.
en: Every morning I go into the office to work.

zh: 因为天气很冷，我进入房间的时候立刻关上了门。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn lěng, wǒ jìnrù fángjiān de shíhou lìkè guānshàng le mén.
en: Because it was very cold, I shut the door right away when I entered the room.

zh: 虽然他没有邀请，但我还是进入了派对，和朋友们一起玩。
pinyin: Suīrán tā méiyǒu yāoqǐng, dàn wǒ háishi jìnrù le pàiduì, hé péngyoumen yìqǐ wán.
en: Even though he didn't invite me, I still went into the party and hung out with friends.

zh: 随着科技发展，越来越多的学生进入大学深造自己的专业知识。
pinyin: Suízhe kējì fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuè duō de xuésheng jìnrù dàxué shēnzào zìjǐ de zhuānyè zhīshi.
en: As technology advances, more and more students are entering universities to deepen their expertise in their fields of study.

zh: 这是我的责任。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de zérèn.
en: This is my responsibility.

zh: 每个学生都有责任做好功课。
pinyin: Měi ge xuésheng dōu yǒu zérèn zuò hǎo gōngkè.
en: Every student has a responsibility to do their homework well.

zh: 虽然这很难，但我们必须承担这个责任。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè hěn nán, dàn wǒmen bìxū chéngdān zhège zérèn.
en: Although it's difficult, we must take on this responsibility.

zh: 作为父母，我们有责任教育孩子独立思考。
pinyin: Zuòwéi fùmǔ, wǒmen yǒu zérèn jiàoyù háizi dúlì sīkǎo.
en: As parents, we have the responsibility to teach our children to think independently.

zh: 公司必须对消费者负起责任，而不是只追求利润。
pinyin: Gōngsī bìxū duì xiāofèizhě fùqǐ zérèn, érbuShì zhǐ zhuīqiú lìrùn.
en: Companies must be accountable to consumers rather than just chasing profits.

zh: 这是食物。
pinyin: Zhè shì shíwù.
en: This is food.

zh: 早上我吃了很多食物。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ chīle hěnduō shíwù.
en: I ate a lot of food this morning.

zh: 虽然这个食物很便宜，但是很好吃。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège shíwù hěn piányi, dànshì hěn hǎochī.
en: Although this food is cheap, it tastes really good.

zh: 在超市买食物的时候，我通常会看一下价格。
pinyin: Zài chāoshì mǎi shíwù de shíhou, wǒ tōngcháng huì kàn yīxià jiàgé.
en: When I buy food at the supermarket, I usually check the price first.

zh: 现在很多人关注食物的营养价值，因为健康饮食越来越重要。
pinyin: Xiànzài hěnduō rén guānzhù shíwù de yíngyǎng jiàzhí, yīnwèi jiànkāng yǐnshí yuèláiyuè zhòngyào.
en: Nowadays many people pay attention to the nutritional value of food, because a healthy diet is becoming increasingly important.

zh: 洛杉矶在美国。
pinyin: Luòshānjī zài Měiguó.
en: Los Angeles is in the United States.

zh: 我想去洛杉矶看电影。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù Luòshānjī kàn diànyǐng.
en: I want to go to Los Angeles to watch movies.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以很多人喜欢住在洛杉矶。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén xǐhuān zhù zài Luòshānjī.
en: Because the weather is nice, many people like to live in Los Angeles.

zh: 虽然洛杉矶很拥挤，但是那里有很多有名的公司。
pinyin: Suīrán Luòshānjī hěn yōngjǐ, dànshì nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō yǒumíng de gōngsī.
en: Although Los Angeles is crowded, there are many famous companies there.

zh: 许多演员和音乐家都梦想在洛杉矶成名，希望能够实现自己的梦想。
pinyin: Xǔduō yǎnyuán hé yīnyuèjiā dōu mèngxiǎng zài Luòshānjī chéngmíng, xīwàng nénggòu shíxiàn zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
en: Many actors and musicians dream of becoming famous in Los Angeles, hoping to make their dreams come true.

zh: 我很遗憾没有来。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn yíhàn méiyǒu lái.
en: I'm really sorry I couldn't come.

zh: 昨天的比赛我没看，很遗憾。
pinyin: Zuótiān de bǐsài wǒ méi kàn, hěn yíhàn.
en: I didn't watch yesterday's match, and I really regret it.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但我没有遗憾去爬山。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dàn wǒ méiyǒu yíhàn qù páshān.
en: Even though the weather was bad, I don't regret going hiking.

zh: 因为时间的限制，我们遗憾地没能完成这个项目。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shíjiān de xiànzhì, wǒmen yíhàn de méinéng wánchéng zhège xiàngmù.
en: Due to time constraints, we regrettably weren't able to complete this project.

zh: 他对年轻时没有好好学习这一点始终感到遗憾。
pinyin: Tā duì niánqīng shí méiyǒu hǎohāo xuéxí zhè yīdiǎn shǐzhōng gǎndào yíhàn.
en: He's always regretted not studying hard when he was young.

zh: 反正我喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Fǎnzhèng wǒ xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: Anyway, I like eating rice.

zh: 反正你明天也要来，现在就别走了。
pinyin: Fǎnzhèng nǐ míngtiān yě yào lái, xiànzài jiù bié zǒu le.
en: Since you're coming tomorrow anyway, you might as well stay now.

zh: 虽然这件衣服有点贵，但反正我经常穿，所以买了。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiàn yīfu yǒudiǎn guì, dàn fǎnzhèng wǒ jīngcháng chuān, suǒyǐ mǎi le.
en: Even though this shirt is a bit expensive, I wear it all the time anyway, so I bought it.

zh: 反正这个项目已经延期了，我们不如先把计划改一改。
pinyin: Fǎnzhèng zhège xiàngmù yǐjīng yánqī le, wǒmen búrú xiān bǎ jìhuà gǎi yī gǎi.
en: Since the project's already been postponed anyway, we might as well revise the plan now.

zh: 反正这笔钱迟早要花，与其省着，倒不如用在刀刃上。
pinyin: Fǎnzhèng zhè bǐ qián chízǎo yào huā, yǔqī shěngzhe, dàobúrú yòng zài dāorènshang.
en: That money's going to be spent sooner or later anyway, so rather than pinching pennies, we might as well spend it where it really matters.

zh: 他是一个杀手。
pinyin: Tā shì yī gè shāshǒu.
en: He is an assassin.

zh: 电影里的杀手很危险。
pinyin: Diànyǐng lǐ de shāshǒu hěn wēixiǎn.
en: The assassin in the movie is very dangerous.

zh: 虽然他是杀手，但是他现在不想杀人了。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shì shāshǒu, dànshì tā xiànzài búxiǎng shārén le.
en: Although he's an assassin, he doesn't want to kill people anymore now.

zh: 警察抓住了那个杀手，因为他留下了指纹证据。
pinyin: Jǐngchá zhuāzhù le nàge shāshǒu, yīnwèi tā liúxià le zhǐwén zhèngjù.
en: The police caught the assassin because he left behind fingerprint evidence.

zh: 这个杀手虽然身手高超，但最终还是被特工队员识破了真身。
pinyin: Zhège shāshǒu suīrán shēnshǒu gāo chāo, dàn zuìzhōng háishi bèi tègōng duìyuán shípò le zhēnshēn.
en: Although this assassin had exceptional skills, the special ops team eventually saw through his disguise.

zh: 我设计了一个新房子。
pinyin: Wǒ shèjì le yī gè xīn fángzi.
en: I designed a new house.

zh: 今天我们要设计一个新的游戏。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒmen yào shèjì yī gè xīn de yóuxì.
en: Today we need to design a new game.

zh: 因为这个产品很重要,所以设计的时候要很小心。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhège chǎnpǐn hěn zhòngyào, suǒyǐ shèjì de shíhou yào hěn xiǎoxin.
en: Because this product is important, we need to be very careful when designing it.

zh: 虽然设计这个网站花了很多时间,但最后的效果很满意。
pinyin: Suīrán shèjì zhège wǎngzhàn huā le hěnduō shíjiān, dàn zuìhòu de xiàoguǒ hěn mǎnyì.
en: Although designing this website took a lot of time, the final result turned out really well.

zh: 我们的设计团队决定采用更创新的方案来吸引年轻消费者。
pinyin: Wǒmen de shèjì tuánduì juéding cǎiyòng gèng chuàngxīn de fāng'àn lái xīyǐn niánqīng xiāofèizhě.
en: Our design team decided to adopt a more innovative approach in order to attract younger consumers.

zh: 这是一封信。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī fēng xìn.
en: This is a letter.

zh: 妈妈昨天收到一封快递。
pinyin: Māma zuótiān shōudào yī fēng kuàidì.
en: Mom received a package delivery yesterday.

zh: 因为下雨，我没有收到那封邮件。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒ méiyǒu shōudào nà fēng yóujiàn.
en: Because of the rain, I didn't receive that email.

zh: 他给公司写了一封投诉信，但至今没有回复。
pinyin: Tā gěi gōngsī xiěle yī fēng tóusu xìn, dàn zhìjīn méiyǒu huífù.
en: He wrote a complaint letter to the company, but they haven't responded yet.

zh: 我找了好久才在旧箱子里发现那几封爸爸年轻时候寄来的信。
pinyin: Wǒ zhǎole hǎojiǔ cái zài jiù xiāngzi lǐ fāxiàn nà jǐ fēng bàba niánqīng shíhou jìlái de xìn.
en: I searched for ages before finally finding those old letters Dad had sent us when he was young in an old box.

zh: 他赢得了比赛。
pinyin: Tā yíngdé le bǐsài.
en: He won the match.

zh: 昨天我们的队赢得了足球比赛。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒmen de duì yíngdé le zúqiú bǐsài.
en: Yesterday our team won the soccer game.

zh: 虽然比赛很难，但是我们最后还是赢得了胜利。
pinyin: Suīrán bǐsài hěn nán, dànshì wǒmen zuìhòu háishi yíngdé le shènglì.
en: Although the match was tough, we managed to win in the end.

zh: 通过努力训练和团队合作，我们赢得了全年的冠军。
pinyin: Tōngguò nǔlì xùnliàn hé tuánduì hézuò, wǒmen yíngdé le quánnián de guàngjūn.
en: Through hard training and teamwork, we won the year-long championship.

zh: 他凭借出色的表现和坚持不懈的精神，赢得了观众和评委的高度认可。
pinyin: Tā píngjiè chūsè de biǎoxiàn hé jiānchí búxié de jīngshén, yíngdé le guānzhòng hé píngwěi de gāodù rènkě.
en: With his excellent performance and unwavering determination, he earned high recognition from both the audience and the judges.

zh: 现在正是吃饭的时候。
pinyin: Xiànzài zhèngshì chīfàn de shíhou.
en: It's exactly mealtime right now.

zh: 今天天气很好，正是出去玩的好日子。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, zhèngshì chūqù wán de hǎo rìzi.
en: The weather is great today—it's the perfect day to go out and have fun.

zh: 虽然他很累，但现在正是他最需要休息的时候。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn lèi, dàn xiànzài zhèngshì tā zuì xūyào xiūxi de shíhou.
en: Although he's exhausted, this is exactly when he needs rest the most.

zh: 因为疫情的原因，现在正是居家办公最流行的工作方式。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yìqíng de yuányīn, xiànzài zhèngshì jūjiā bàngōng zuì liúxíng de gōngzuò fāngshi.
en: Due to the pandemic, working from home is exactly the most popular work method right now.

zh: 他工作多年终于升职了，正是春风得意的时候，却突然遇到了挫折。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò duō nián zh终于 shēngzhí le, zhèngshì chūnfēng déyì de shíhou, què túrán yùdào le cuòzhé.
en: After years of work he finally got promoted, and just when he was riding high with success, he suddenly faced a setback.

zh: 他是证人。
pinyin: Tā shì zhèng rén.
en: He is a witness.

zh: 昨天警察问了证人很多问题。
pinyin: Zuótiān jǐngchá wènle zhèng rén hěnduō wèntí.
en: Yesterday the police asked the witness many questions.

zh: 因为证人看到了事故，所以他要去法院作证。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhèng rén kàndàole shìgù, suǒyǐ tā yào qù fǎyuàn zuòzhèng.
en: Because the witness saw the accident, he has to go to court to testify.

zh: 法官让证人详细描述了当时发生的情况。
pinyin: Fǎguān ràng zhèng rén xiáng细 miáoshùle dāngshí fāshēng de qíngkuàng.
en: The judge had the witness describe in detail what happened at that time.

zh: 虽然证人很紧张，但他如实提供了有助于案件破解的关键信息。
pinyin: Suīrán zhèng rén hěn jǐnzhāng, dàn tā rúshí tígōngle yǒuzhùyú ànjiàn pòjiě de guānjiàn xìnxī.
en: Although the witness was nervous, he faithfully provided crucial information that helped solve the case.

zh: 这个女孩很美丽。
pinyin: Zhège nǚhái hěn měilì.
en: This girl is very beautiful.

zh: 春天的花园非常美丽。
pinyin: Chūntiān de huāyuán fēicháng měilì.
en: The garden is extremely beautiful in spring.

zh: 虽然天气冷,但是雪景很美丽。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì lěng, dànshì xuějǐng hěn měilì.
en: Although it's cold, the snowy scenery is really beautiful.

zh: 因为她的微笑很温暖,所以看起来更美丽了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā de wēixiào hěn wēnnuǎn, suǒyǐ kàn qǐlái gèng měilì le.
en: Because her smile is so warm, she looks even more beautiful.

zh: 她不仅外表美丽,内心也很善良,这才是真正的美丽。
pinyin: Tā bújǐn wàibiǎo měilì, nèixīn yě hěn shànliáng, zhè cái shì zhēnzhèng de měilì.
en: She's not just outwardly beautiful—she has a kind heart too, and that's what real beauty is.

zh: 我有很大压力。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu hěn dà yālì.
en: I'm under a lot of pressure.

zh: 工作压力让我很累。
pinyin: Gōngzuò yālì ràng wǒ hěn lèi.
en: Work pressure makes me exhausted.

zh: 因为考试压力大，所以我睡眠不好。
pinyin: Yīnwèi kǎoshì yālì dà, suǒyǐ wǒ shuìmián búhǎo.
en: Because the exam pressure is high, my sleep hasn't been good.

zh: 虽然工作压力很大，但她还是坚持健身。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò yālì hěn dà, dànshì tā háishi jiānchí jiànshēn.
en: Although work pressure is intense, she still manages to exercise regularly.

zh: 长期承受工作压力会影响身心健康，需要学会释放压力。
pinyin: Chángqī chéngshòu gōngzuò yālì huì yǐngxiǎng shēnxīn jiànkāng, xūyào xuéhuì shìfàng yālì.
en: Being under sustained work pressure affects both physical and mental health; you need to learn how to relieve stress.

zh: 这个苹果的味道很好。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ de wèidào hěn hǎo.
en: This apple tastes really good.

zh: 妈妈做的菜有很香的味道。
pinyin: Māma zuò de cài yǒu hěn xiāng de wèidào.
en: The dish Mom made has a really nice aroma.

zh: 虽然这个咖啡很苦，但是味道不错。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège kāfēi hěn kǔ, dànshì wèidào búcuò.
en: Although this coffee is bitter, it actually tastes pretty good.

zh: 我尝了一口，发现这家餐厅的味道比上次好多了。
pinyin: Wǒ chángle yī kǒu, fāxiàn zhè jiā cāntīng de wèidào bǐ shàng cì hǎo duō le.
en: I took a bite and found that this restaurant's food tastes much better than last time.

zh: 这道菜的味道让我想起了童年，有一种熟悉的温暖感。
pinyin: Zhè dào cài de wèidào ràng wǒ xiǎngqǐle tóngnián, yǒu yī zhǒng shúxī de wēnnuǎn gǎn.
en: The taste of this dish brings back childhood memories and gives me a sense of familiar warmth.

zh: 旧衣服被淘汰了。
pinyin: Jiù yīfu bèi táotài le.
en: The old clothes were thrown out.

zh: 这个手机太旧，已经被淘汰了。
pinyin: Zhège shǒujī tài jiù, yǐjīng bèi táotài le.
en: This phone is too old and has been phased out.

zh: 虽然这个产品不错，但因为技术进步，它最终被淘汰了。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège chǎnpǐn búcuò, dàn yīnwèi jìshù jìnbù, tā zuìzhōng bèi táotài le.
en: Although the product was good, it was eventually phased out because of technological advances.

zh: 很多小公司因为竞争力不足而被市场淘汰了。
pinyin: Hěnduō xiǎo gōngsī yīnwèi jìngjìnglì búzú érshì bèi shìchǎng táotài le.
en: Many small companies were eliminated from the market due to weak competitiveness.

zh: 互联网时代，不创新的企业很容易被淘汰出局。
pinyin: Hùliánwǎng shídài, búchuàngxīn de qǐyè hěn róngyì bèi táotài chūjú.
en: In the internet era, companies that don't innovate get knocked out of the game pretty easily.

zh: 我喜欢吃鱼。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān chī yú.
en: I like eating fish.

zh: 昨天我买了一条新鲜的鱼。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ mǎile yī tiáo xīnxiān de yú.
en: Yesterday I bought a fresh fish.

zh: 因为鱼很有营养，所以医生建议我们经常吃鱼。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yú hěn yǒu yíngyǎng, suǒyǐ yīshēng jiànyì wǒmen jīngcháng chī yú.
en: Because fish is very nutritious, the doctor recommends we eat it regularly.

zh: 在超市里我找不到便宜的鱼，只好去菜市场买了。
pinyin: Zài chāoshì lǐ wǒ zhǎobuzhào piányì de yú, zhǐhǎo qù càishìcháng mǎile.
en: I couldn't find affordable fish at the supermarket, so I ended up buying it at the wet market instead.

zh: 这家餐厅的红烧鱼做得特别地道，每次去都能吃到新鲜的食材。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de hóngshāo yú zuòde tèbié de dào, měi cì qù dōu néng chīdào xīnxiān de shíhuò.
en: This restaurant's braised fish is exceptionally authentic, and you can always taste the fresh ingredients whenever you go.

zh: 你哥哥很厉害。
pinyin: Nǐ gēge hěn lìhai.
en: Your older brother is really impressive.

zh: 这个学生的数学很厉害。
pinyin: Zhège xuésheng de shùxué hěn lìhai.
en: This student is really good at math.

zh: 虽然他很年轻，但是他的工作能力很厉害。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn niánqīng, dànshì tā de gōngzuò néngLì hěn lìhai.
en: Although he's quite young, he's actually very capable at work.

zh: 因为她以前做过这个项目，所以这次表现特别厉害。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā yǐqián zuòguo zhège xiàngmù, suǒyǐ zhè cì biǎoxiàn tèbié lìhai.
en: Because she's done this project before, her performance this time was especially impressive.

zh: 那个营销团队最近的成绩确实厉害，他们的创意策略打动了很多客户。
pinyin: Nàge yíngxiāo tuánduì zuìjìn de chéngjì quèshí lìhai, tāmen de chuàngyì cèlüè dǎdòngle hěnduō kèhù.
en: That marketing team's recent results have genuinely been impressive—their creative strategy really resonated with a lot of customers.

zh: 他射箭。
pinyin: Tā shè jiàn.
en: He shoots arrows.

zh: 小孩在公园里射气球。
pinyin: Xiǎo háizi zài gōngyuán lǐ shè qìqiú.
en: The child is shooting balloons in the park.

zh: 虽然他没有练习，但是他射得很准。
pinyin: Suīrán tā méiyǒu liànxí, dànshì tā shè de hěn zhǔn.
en: Although he hasn't practiced, he shoots quite accurately.

zh: 运动员在比赛中射了十支箭，其中八支命中靶心。
pinyin: Yùndòng yuán zài bǐsài zhōng shè le shí zhī jiàn, qīzhōng bā zhī mìngzhòng bǎ xīn.
en: The athlete shot ten arrows in the competition, and eight of them hit the bullseye.

zh: 激光射向镜子时会反射，这个原理被广泛用于医学和工业领域。
pinyin: Jīguāng shè xiàng jìngzi shí huì fǎnshè, zhège yuánlǐ bèi guǎngfàn yòngyú yīxué hé gōngyè lǐngyù.
en: When a laser beam is directed at a mirror, it reflects—a principle widely used in medicine and industry.

zh: 这是我的房室。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de fángshì.
en: This is my room.

zh: 我每天在办公室工作八小时。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zài bàngōngshì gōngzuò bā xiǎoshí.
en: I work in the office eight hours every day.

zh: 虽然教室很拥挤，但是学生们还是认真听课。
pinyin: Suīrán jiàoshì hěn yōngjǐ, dànshì xuéshēngmen háishi rènzhēn tīngkè.
en: Although the classroom is crowded, the students still listen carefully to the lesson.

zh: 为了改善工作环境，公司最近翻新了所有办公室。
pinyin: Wèile gǎish善 gōngzuò huánjìng, gōngsī zuìjìn fānxīnle suǒyǒu bàngōngshì.
en: To improve the work environment, the company recently renovated all the offices.

zh: 医生在诊疗室里为患者详细解释了治疗方案和可能的风险。
pinyin: Yīshēng zài zhěnliàoshì lǐ wèi huànzhě xiáng细 jiěshìle zhìliáo fāng'àn hé kěnéng de fēngxiǎn.
en: The doctor explained the treatment plan and potential risks to the patient in detail in the consultation room.

zh: 他醉了。
pinyin: Tā zuì le.
en: He's drunk.

zh: 昨天晚上我喝酒醉了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ hējiǔ zuì le.
en: I got drunk drinking alcohol last night.

zh: 因为喝了太多啤酒，他变得很醉，所以不能开车。
pinyin: Yīnwèi hēle tàiduō píjiǔ, tā biàn de hěn zuì, suǒyǐ búnéng kāichē.
en: Because he drank too much beer and got very drunk, he can't drive.

zh: 虽然派对很好玩，但他喝醉了以后就开始说傻话。
pinyin: Suīrán pàiduì hěn hǎowán, dàn tā hēzuì le yǐhòu jiù kāishǐ shuō shǎhuà.
en: Although the party was fun, after he got drunk he started talking nonsense.

zh: 他在酒吧和朋友聊天，不知不觉就醉得一塌糊涂了。
pinyin: Tā zài jiǔbā hé péngyou liáotiān, búzhī bújué jiù zuì de yītāhútu le.
en: He was chatting with friends at the bar and before he knew it, he was completely wasted.

zh: 他很蠢。
pinyin: Tā hěn chǔn.
en: He's really stupid.

zh: 你昨天的想法很蠢。
pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān de xiǎngfǎ hěn chǔn.
en: Your idea yesterday was pretty dumb.

zh: 虽然他很聪明，但他有时候做蠢事。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn cōngming, dàn tā yǒushíhou zuò chǔnshì.
en: Although he's smart, he sometimes does stupid things.

zh: 与其说他蠢，不如说他太懒得去想。
pinyin: Yǔqī shuō tā chǔn, búrú shuō tā tài lǎn de qù xiǎng.
en: Rather than calling him stupid, it's more that he's too lazy to think.

zh: 那种重复犯同样错误的人真是蠢到家了。
pinyin: Nà zhǒng chóngfù fàn tóngyàng cuòwù de rén zhēnshi chǔn dào jiā le.
en: Someone who keeps making the same mistake over and over is just hopelessly dumb.

zh: 我还未吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ háishi wèi chīfàn.
en: I haven't eaten yet.

zh: 昨天我未去学校，因为生病了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ wèi qù xuéxiào, yīnwèi shēngbìng le.
en: I didn't go to school yesterday because I was sick.

zh: 虽然他很努力，但是成绩未达到理想的水平。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn nǔlì, dànshi chéngjì wèi dádào lǐxiǎng de shuǐpíng.
en: Although he works hard, his grades haven't reached the level he hopes for.

zh: 由于天气原因，明天的比赛未必能按时进行。
pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì yuányīn, míngtiān de bǐsài wèibì néng ànshí jìnxíng.
en: Because of the weather, tomorrow's match may not happen on schedule.

zh: 这个问题我们讨论了很久，但仍未找到令人满意的解决方案。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí wǒmen tǎolùn le hěnjiǔ, dàn réngwèi zhǎodào lìngrén mǎnyì de jiějué fāng'àn.
en: We discussed this issue for a long time, but still haven't found a satisfactory solution.

zh: 他很有德。
pinyin: Tā hěn yǒu dé.
en: He is a very virtuous person.

zh: 我们的老师德行很好，学生都喜欢他。
pinyin: Wǒmen de lǎoshī déxíng hěn hǎo, xuésheng dōu xǐhuān tā.
en: Our teacher has great moral character, and all the students like him.

zh: 虽然他很有钱，但是他的德行不好，因为他经常骗人。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn yǒu qián, dànshì tā de déxíng búhǎo, yīnwèi tā jīngcháng piàn rén.
en: Although he is very rich, his moral character is poor because he often deceives people.

zh: 这位领导人因为德行出众而得到了全国人民的尊重。
pinyin: Zhè wèi lǐngdǎo rén yīnwèi déxíng chūzhòng ér dé到le quánguó rénmín de zūnjìng.
en: This leader gained the respect of the entire nation because of his outstanding moral character.

zh: 在现代社会里，德才兼备的人往往能走得更远。
pinyin: Zài xiàndài shèhuì lǐ, décái jiānbèi de rén wǎngwǎng néng zǒu de gèng yuǎn.
en: In modern society, people who possess both moral integrity and talent tend to go further in life.

zh: 这是我的私人物品。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de sīrén wùpǐn.
en: This is my personal belonging.

zh: 他有一个私人办公室在公司里。
pinyin: Tā yǒu yī ge sīrén bàngōngshì zài gōngsī lǐ.
en: He has a private office at the company.

zh: 虽然这是工作场所，但我们也需要私人的时间。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè shì gōngzuò chǎngsuǒ, dàn wǒmen yě xūyào sīrén de shíjiān.
en: Even though this is a workplace, we still need personal time.

zh: 医生和病人之间需要保持私人信息的保密关系。
pinyin: Yīshēng hé bìngrén zhījiān xūyào bǎochí sīrén xìnxī de bǎomì guānxi.
en: There needs to be confidentiality between doctors and patients regarding personal information.

zh: 现在很多人担心自己的私人数据会被互联网公司泄露。
pinyin: Xiànzài hěnduō rén dānxīn zìjǐ de sīrén shùjù huì bèi húliánwǎng gōngsī xièlòu.
en: These days many people worry that their personal data might be leaked by internet companies.

zh: 某个学生很聪明。
pinyin: Mǒu gè xuésheng hěn聪明。
en: A certain student is very smart.

zh: 昨天某个朋友给我打电话了。
pinyin: Zuótiān mǒu gè péngyou gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà le。
en: A friend called me yesterday.

zh: 因为某些原因，会议被推迟了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi mǒuxiē yuányīn, huìyì bèi tuīchíle。
en: Due to certain reasons, the meeting was postponed.

zh: 虽然某个计划看起来不错，但我们还需要再讨论一下。
pinyin: Suīrán mǒu gè jìhuà kàn qǐlai búcuò, dàn wǒmen háixū zài tǎolùn yīxià。
en: Although a certain plan looks promising, we still need to discuss it further.

zh: 他在某家公司工作，虽然薪水不高，但工作环境还是不错的。
pinyin: Tā zài mǒu jiā gōngsī gōngzuò, suīrán xīnshuǐ búgāo, dàn gōngzuò huánjìng háishi búcuò de。
en: He works at a certain company; the salary isn't great, but the working environment is decent.

zh: 我们明天出发。
pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān chūfā.
en: We're leaving tomorrow.

zh: 早上八点我们从家里出发。
pinyin: Zǎoshang bā diǎn wǒmen cóng jiāli chūfā.
en: We're heading out from home at 8 in the morning.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以我们决定今天出发去爬山。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen juéding jīntiān chūfā qù páshān.
en: Because the weather is nice, we've decided to set out hiking today.

zh: 虽然车子还没修好，但我们还是准时出发去见客户了。
pinyin: Suīrán chēzi háishi méi xiūhǎo, dàn wǒmen háishi zhǔnshí chūfā qù jiàn kèhù le.
en: Although the car wasn't fully fixed, we still left on time to meet the clients.

zh: 他们凌晨四点就出发了，为的是赶上这班难得的班机。
pinyin: Tāmen língchén sì diǎn jiù chūfā le, wèi de shì gǎnshang zhè bān nándé de bānjī.
en: They left before dawn to catch this rare flight.

zh: 爸爸很伟大。
pinyin: Bàba hěn wěidà.
en: Dad is really great.

zh: 我们的老师做了伟大的事情。
pinyin: Wǒmen de lǎoshī zuòle wěidà de shìqing.
en: Our teacher did something really great.

zh: 虽然他很年轻，但他已经做了伟大的工作。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn niánqīng, dàn tā yǐjīng zuòle wěidà de gōngzuò.
en: Even though he's young, he's already done impressive work.

zh: 因为她的伟大贡献，公司决定给她升职。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā de wěidà gòngxiàn, gōngsī juédìng gěi tā shēngzhí.
en: Because of her significant contributions, the company decided to promote her.

zh: 虽然这个项目很困难，但团队用伟大的毅力最终成功了。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège xiàngmù hěn kùnnan, dàn tuánduì yòng wěidà de yìlì zuìzhōng chénggōngle.
en: Although the project was difficult, the team ultimately succeeded through remarkable perseverance.

zh: 我很兴奋。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn xīngfèn.
en: I'm very excited.

zh: 他看到小狗时很兴奋。
pinyin: Tā kàndào xiǎo gǒu shí hěn xīngfèn.
en: He got really excited when he saw the puppy.

zh: 因为要去旅游，孩子们都很兴奋。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yào qù lǚyóu, háizimen dōu hěn xīngfèn.
en: Because they're going on a trip, the children are all excited.

zh: 虽然很兴奋，但她还是努力保持冷静。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn xīngfèn, dàn tā háishi nǔlì bǎochí lěngjìng.
en: Although she was excited, she still tried hard to stay calm.

zh: 这个新项目让整个团队都兴奋不已，大家干劲十足。
pinyin: Zhège xīn xiàngmù ràng zhěngge tuánduì dōu xīngfèn búyǐ, dàjiā gānqìn shíz足.
en: This new project has the whole team buzzing with excitement, and everyone is fired up.

zh: 观众很高兴。
pinyin: Guānzhòng hěn gāoxìng.
en: The audience is very happy.

zh: 今天的观众特别多。
pinyin: Jīntiān de guānzhòng tèbié duō.
en: There are especially many spectators today.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但观众还是来看表演了。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dàn guānzhòng háishi lái kàn biǎoyǎn le.
en: Although the weather was bad, the audience still came to watch the performance.

zh: 因为演员的精彩表现，观众们不停地鼓掌。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yǎnyuán de jīngcǎi biǎoxiàn, guānzhòngmen búting de gǔzhǎng.
en: Because of the actors' brilliant performance, the audience kept applauding.

zh: 这部电影吸引了大批观众，票房成绩非常理想。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng xīyǐnle dàpī guānzhòng, piàofáng chéngjì fēicháng lǐxiǎng.
en: This film attracted a large audience, and the box office results were very impressive.

zh: 这个鱼很臭。
pinyin: Zhège yú hěn chòu.
en: This fish smells really bad.

zh: 昨天的袜子臭了，我要洗。
pinyin: Zuótiān de wàzi chòu le, wǒ yào xǐ.
en: Yesterday's socks are stinky, so I need to wash them.

zh: 因为天气热，垃圾桶的味道很臭，所以我们要经常清理。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì rè, lèsè tǒng de wèidào hěn chòu, suǒyǐ wǒmen yào jīngcháng qīnglǐ.
en: Because it's hot, the trash can smells awful, so we need to clean it regularly.

zh: 他在健身房锻炼后全身臭汗淋漓，赶紧去洗了个澡。
pinyin: Tā zài jiànshēnfáng duànliàn hòu quánshēn chòu hàn línlī, gǎnjǐn qù xǐ le ge澡.
en: After working out at the gym, he was drenched in stinky sweat, so he immediately took a shower.

zh: 这家餐厅虽然装修不错，但是厨房臭气熏天，让我怀疑食材的新鲜度。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cānting suīrán zhuāngxiū búcuò, dànshi chúfáng chòuqì xūntiān, ràng wǒ huáiyí shícái de xīnxiān dù.
en: Although this restaurant has nice décor, the kitchen reeks so badly that it makes me doubt the freshness of the ingredients.

zh: 我们今天达到了目标。
pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān dádàole mùbiāo.
en: We reached our goal today.

zh: 这封信明天会达到你的手里。
pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn míngtiān huì dádào nǐ de shǒu lǐ.
en: This letter will reach your hands tomorrow.

zh: 因为他们努力工作，所以很快就达成了协议。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tāmen nǔlì gōngzuò, suǒyǐ hěnkuài jiù dáchéngle xiéyì.
en: Because they worked hard, they reached an agreement very quickly.

zh: 尽管路很远，但是他坚持不懈，最终还是达成了自己的梦想。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn lù hěn yuǎn, dànshì tā jiānchí búxié, zuìzhōng háishi dáchéngle zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
en: Although the road was long, he persevered and ultimately achieved his own dream.

zh: 随着互联网的发展，信息传递的速度已经达到了前所未有的程度。
pinyin: Suízhe hùliánwǎng de fāzhǎn, xìnxī chuándigé de sùdù yǐjīng dádàole qiánsuǒ wèiyǒu de chéngdù.
en: With the development of the internet, the speed at which information is transmitted has reached an unprecedented level.

zh: 自从去年，我每天吃米饭。
pinyin: Zìcóng qùnián, wǒ měitiān chī mǐfàn.
en: Since last year, I eat rice every day.

zh: 自从上个月，她在这家公司工作。
pinyin: Zìcóng shàng ge yuè, tā zài zhè jiā gōngsī gōngzuò.
en: Since last month, she's been working at this company.

zh: 自从有了孩子以后，虽然很累，但是我很开心。
pinyin: Zìcóng yǒu le háizi yǐhòu, suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ hěn kāixīn.
en: Since having kids, although I'm tired, I've been really happy.

zh: 自从搬到北方以来，我逐渐习惯了这里的天气。
pinyin: Zìcóng bānhuà dào běifāng yǐlái, wǒ zhújiàn xíguàn le zhèlǐ de tiānqì.
en: Since moving to the north, I've gradually gotten used to the weather here.

zh: 自从那次失败之后，他就更加努力工作，决心要扭转局面。
pinyin: Zìcóng nà cì shībài zhīhòu, tā jiù gèngjiā nǔlì gōngzuò, juéxīn yào niǔzhuǎn júmiàn.
en: Ever since that failure, he's been working even harder, determined to turn things around.

zh: 这个钟是红色的。
pinyin: Zhège zhōng shì hóng sè de.
en: This clock is red.

zh: 早上八点钟我去上班。
pinyin: Zǎoshang bā diǎn zhōng wǒ qù shàngbān.
en: I go to work at 8 o'clock in the morning.

zh: 虽然这个钟很便宜，但是走得很准。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège zhōng hěn piányi, dànshì zǒu de hěn zhǔn.
en: Although this clock is inexpensive, it keeps very accurate time.

zh: 他盯着墙上的钟，担心自己会迟到。
pinyin: Tā dīngzhe qiáng shang de zhōng, dānxīn zìjǐ huì chídào.
en: He stared at the clock on the wall, worried he'd be late.

zh: 每次开会的时候，他都会下意识地看钟，仿佛在数着分钟。
pinyin: Měi cì kāihuì de shíhou, tā dōu huì xiàyìshí de kàn zhōng, fǎngfú zài shǔzhe fēnzhōng.
en: Whenever there's a meeting, he unconsciously glances at the clock, as if counting down the minutes.

zh: 枪里有子弹。
pinyin: Qiāng lǐ yǒu zǐdàn.
en: There are bullets in the gun.

zh: 这个子弹很小，但是很危险。
pinyin: Zhège zǐdàn hěn xiǎo, dànshì hěn wēixiǎn.
en: This bullet is small, but it's very dangerous.

zh: 因为没有子弹了，所以他不能再射击。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu zǐdàn le, suǒyǐ tā búnéng zài shèjī.
en: Because there were no more bullets left, he couldn't shoot anymore.

zh: 这种新式子弹能穿透厚钢板，效果比以前好得多。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīnshì zǐdàn néng chuāntòu hòu gāngbǎn, xiàoguǒ bǐ yǐqián hǎo de duō.
en: This new type of bullet can penetrate thick steel plates, and performs much better than before.

zh: 虽然那支枪装满了子弹，但在实际战斗中往往需要谨慎使用。
pinyin: Suīrán nà zhī qiāng zhuāngmǎn le zǐdàn, dàn zài shíjì zhàndòu zhōng wǎngwǎng xūyào jǐnshèn shǐyòng.
en: Although that rifle was fully loaded with bullets, in actual combat you often need to use them carefully.

zh: 这是垃圾。
pinyin: Zhè shì lājī.
en: This is trash.

zh: 我每天都要扔垃圾。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān dōu yào rēng lājī.
en: I throw out the trash every day.

zh: 因为房间里有很多垃圾，所以我打扫了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fángjiān lǐ yǒu hěnduō lājī, suǒyǐ wǒ dǎsǎole.
en: Because there was a lot of trash in the room, I cleaned it up.

zh: 这个APP的设计有点垃圾，用户体验不太好。
pinyin: Zhège APP de shèjì yǒudiǎn lājī, yònghu tǐyàn búhuì hǎo.
en: This app's design is pretty bad; the user experience isn't great.

zh: 他说的那些理由都是垃圾，根本站不住脚。
pinyin: Tā shuōde nàxiē lǐyóu dōu shì lājī, gēnběn zhàn búzhù jiǎo.
en: Those reasons he gave are all garbage—they don't hold up at all.

zh: 这是我的叔叔。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de shūshu.
en: This is my uncle.

zh: 叔叔每天早上跑步。
pinyin: Shūshu měitiān zǎoshang pǎobù.
en: My uncle runs every morning.

zh: 因为叔叔喜欢做饭，所以我们经常去他家。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shūshu xǐhuān zuòfàn, suǒyǐ wǒmen jīngcháng qù tā jiā.
en: Because my uncle loves to cook, we often go to his place.

zh: 叔叔虽然工作很忙，但还是会抽时间陪我们。
pinyin: Shūshu suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn háishi huì chōu shíjiān péi wǒmen.
en: Although my uncle is very busy with work, he still makes time to spend with us.

zh: 叔叔前年从外地调回来以后，生意越来越好。
pinyin: Shūshu qiánnián cóng wàidì tiáohuí lái yǐhòu, shēngyì yuèláiyuè hǎo.
en: Since my uncle transferred back from out of town a couple of years ago, his business has been booming.

zh: 我的男朋友很高。
pinyin: Wǒ de男péng you hěn gāo.
en: My boyfriend is very tall.

zh: 昨天我和男朋友去吃饭了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hé nánpéng you qù chīfàn le.
en: Yesterday I went out to eat with my boyfriend.

zh: 因为男朋友很忙,所以我们周末才见面。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nánpéng you hěn máng, suǒyǐ wǒmen zhōumò cái jiànmiàn.
en: Because my boyfriend is busy, we only see each other on weekends.

zh: 虽然男朋友工作很累,但是他还是抽空陪我。
pinyin: Suīrán nánpéng you gōngzuò hěn lèi, dànshì tā háishi chōukōng péi wǒ.
en: Even though my boyfriend's job is exhausting, he still makes time to spend with me.

zh: 我男朋友虽然嘴上不说,但从他的行动能看出他很在乎我。
pinyin: Wǒ nánpéng you suīrán zuǐ shang búshuō, dàn cóng tā de xíngdòng néng kànchū tā hěn zàihu wǒ.
en: My boyfriend doesn't say much, but you can tell from his actions how much he cares about me.

zh: 我的头疼。
pinyin: Wǒ de tóu téng.
en: I have a headache.

zh: 昨天我牙疼了一整天。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ yá téng le yī zhěngtiān.
en: Yesterday I had a toothache all day long.

zh: 因为运动太多，他的腿疼，所以今天休息了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yùndòng tài duō, tā de tuǐ téng, suǒyǐ jīntiān xiūxi le.
en: Because he exercised too much, his legs hurt, so he rested today.

zh: 感冒的时候不仅发烧，喉咙也特别疼。
pinyin: Gǎnmào de shíhou búyǐn fāshāo, hóulóng yě tèbié téng.
en: When you have a cold, not only do you get a fever, but your throat also hurts a lot.

zh: 长期对着电脑工作，很多人都会感觉颈椎疼痛。
pinyin: Chángqī duìzhe diànnǎo gōngzuò, hěnduō rén dōu huì gǎnjuéde jǐngzhuī téngtòng.
en: Working at a computer for long periods, many people end up with neck pain.

zh: 毒品很危险。
pinyin: Dúpǐn hěn wēixiǎn.
en: Drugs are very dangerous.

zh: 警察在抓捕毒品犯罪。
pinyin: Jǐngchá zài zhuābǔ dúpǐn fànzuì.
en: The police are cracking down on drug crimes.

zh: 因为毒品危害很大，所以学生不能接触毒品。
pinyin: Yīnwèi dúpǐn wēihài hěn dà, suǒyǐ xuésheng búnéng jiēchù dúpǐn.
en: Because drugs cause serious harm, students must not use them.

zh: 很多年轻人因为好奇开始吸毒品，最后陷入了严重的成瘾问题。
pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng rén yīnwèi hàoqī kāishǐ xī dúpǐn, zuìhòu xiànrù le yánzhòng de chéngyǐn wèntí.
en: Many young people start using drugs out of curiosity, and later fall into serious addiction problems.

zh: 要解决毒品问题，不仅需要严厉的法律惩罚，还要提供有效的戒毒和心理咨询服务。
pinyin: Yào jiějué dúpǐn wèntí, bújǐn xūyào yánlì de fǎlǜ chěngfá, háiyào tígōng yǒuxiào de jièdú hé xīnlǐ zīxún fúwù.
en: To address the drug problem, we need not only strict legal penalties, but also effective rehabilitation and psychological counseling services.

zh: 我要签名。
pinyin: Wǒ yào qiānmíng.
en: I need to sign my name.

zh: 请在这里签字，然后给我。
pinyin: Qǐng zài zhèlǐ qiānzì, ránhòu gěi wǒ.
en: Please sign here and then give it to me.

zh: 因为这是重要的合同，所以我需要仔细签名。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè shì zhòngyào de hétonɡ, suǒyǐ wǒ xūyào zǐxì qiānmíng.
en: Because this is an important contract, I need to sign carefully.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但还是抽空签了这份文件。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn háishi chōukōng qiānle zhè fèn wénjiàn.
en: Although he was very busy, he still made time to sign this document.

zh: 在递交申请前，务必确保所有信息都已签署且准确无误。
pinyin: Zài dìjiāo shēnqǐng qián, wùbì quèbǎo suǒyǒu xìnxī dōu yǐ qiānshǔ qiě zhǔnquè wúwù.
en: Before submitting your application, you must make sure all information has been signed and is accurate.

zh: 你不必吃米饭。
pinyin: Nǐ búbì chī mǐfàn.
en: You don't have to eat rice.

zh: 明天下雨，你不必来上课。
pinyin: Míngtiān xiàyǔ, nǐ búbì lái shànghè.
en: It'll rain tomorrow, so you don't need to come to class.

zh: 因为我已经买了票，所以你不必再买。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ yǐjīng mǎile piào, suǒyǐ nǐ búbì zài mǎi.
en: Since I've already bought the tickets, you don't need to buy them again.

zh: 虽然这个工作不太难，但你也不必那么着急完成。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège gōngzuò búTài nán, dàn nǐ yě búbì nàme zháojí wánchéng.
en: Even though this job isn't very difficult, you don't have to rush to finish it.

zh: 对于这类小问题，我们不必劳师动众地开会讨论。
pinyin: Duìyú zhè lèi xiǎo wèntí, wǒmen búbì láoshī dònngzhòng de kāihuì tǎolùn.
en: For minor issues like this, we don't need to make a big fuss by calling a meeting to discuss it.

zh: 我反对吃糖。
pinyin: Wǒ fǎnduì chī táng.
en: I'm against eating candy.

zh: 他们都反对这个计划。
pinyin: Tāmen dōu fǎnduì zhège jìhuà.
en: They all oppose this plan.

zh: 虽然很多人反对，但是我们还是要做。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn duō rén fǎnduì, dànshì wǒmen háishi yào zuò.
en: Although many people are against it, we still have to do it.

zh: 他因为工作太忙反对去旅游，我觉得他的理由不太合理。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng fǎnduì qù lǚyóu, wǒ juéde tā de lǐyóu búshì tài héhéli.
en: He opposed going on a trip because he's too busy with work, but I don't think his reason is very reasonable.

zh: 尽管公司高层强烈反对这个创新方案，但年轻员工仍然坚持推进。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn gōngsī gāocéng qiángliè fǎnduì zhège chuàngxīn fāng'àn, dàn niánqīng yuángōng réngránjiǔ jiānchí tuījìn.
en: Despite strong opposition from senior management to this innovative proposal, the younger employees are still determined to move it forward.

zh: 我吃了一颗糖。
pinyin: Wǒ chīle yī kē táng.
en: I ate a candy.

zh: 妈妈买了两颗红苹果。
pinyin: Māma mǎile liǎng kē hóng píngguǒ.
en: Mom bought two red apples.

zh: 因为天气很冷，树上的叶子都掉了，只剩下一颗颗冰冷的果实。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn lěng, shù shang de yèzi dōu diàole, zhǐ shèngxia yī kē kē bīngléng de guǒshí.
en: Because the weather is so cold, all the leaves on the tree have fallen, leaving only a few icy fruits.

zh: 这个项目虽然有很多困难，但每颗螺丝钉都必须仔细检查。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù suīrán yǒu hěnduō kùnnan, dàn měi kē luó sī dìng dōu bìxū zǐxì jiǎnchá.
en: Although this project faces many challenges, every screw must be carefully inspected.

zh: 他对这份工作的态度很认真，处理每一颗细节都不放过，这种精益求精的精神值得我们学习。
pinyin: Tā duì zhè fèn gōngzuò de tàidù hěn rènzhēn, chǔlǐ měi yī kē xìjié dōu búfàngguò, zhè zhǒng jīngyì qiújīng de jīngshén zhídé wǒmen xuéxí.
en: He takes this job very seriously, not overlooking a single detail, and his pursuit of excellence is truly worth learning from.

zh: 车停下了。
pinyin: Chē tíngxià le.
en: The car stopped.

zh: 他听到声音，马上停下来。
pinyin: Tā tīngdào shēngyīn, mǎshàng tíngxià lai.
en: He heard a noise and stopped right away.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以我们停下来等一会儿。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ wǒmen tíngxià lai děng yīhuǐr.
en: Because it started raining, we stopped and waited a bit.

zh: 他工作太累了，决定停下来休息几天。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò tài lèi le, juédìng tíngxià lai xiūxi jǐ tiān.
en: He was exhausted from work, so he decided to take a break for a few days.

zh: 这个项目遇到了问题，我们需要停下来重新评估一下情况。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù遇到了 wèntí, wǒmen xūyào tíngxià lai chóngxīn pínggu yīxià qíngkuàng.
en: The project ran into problems, so we need to pause and reassess the situation.

zh: 我喜欢吃肉。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān chī ròu.
en: I like to eat meat.

zh: 今天晚饭有鸡肉和米饭。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnfàn yǒu jīròu hé mǐfàn.
en: Tonight's dinner has chicken and rice.

zh: 因为这个肉很新鲜，所以味道特别好。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhège ròu hěn xīnxiān, suǒyǐ wèidào tèbié hǎo.
en: Because this meat is very fresh, it tastes especially good.

zh: 超市里的肉价格最近涨得很厉害，我们改吃鱼了。
pinyin: Chāoshì lǐ de ròu jiàgé zuìjìn zhǎng de hěn lìhai, wǒmen gǎi chī yú le.
en: Meat prices at the supermarket have gone up a lot recently, so we switched to eating fish.

zh: 虽然现在很多人提倡素食，但是在中国文化里，肉类菜肴仍然占据重要地位。
pinyin: Suīrán xiànzài hěnduō rén tíchàng sùshí, dànshì zài Zhōngguó wénhuà lǐ, ròulèi càiyao仍然 zhànjù zhòngyào dìwèi.
en: Although many people advocate vegetarianism these days, meat dishes still hold an important place in Chinese cuisine.

zh: 我们测试新软件。
pinyin: Wǒmen cèshì xīn ruǎnjiàn.
en: We're testing new software.

zh: 老师今天给我们测试英语。
pinyin: Lǎoshī jīntiān gěi wǒmen cèshì yīngyǔ.
en: The teacher gave us an English test today.

zh: 因为产品还不完美，所以我们需要测试很多次。
pinyin: Yīnwèi chǎnpǐn háishi búwánměi, suǒyǐ wǒmen xūyào cèshì hěnduō cì.
en: Because the product isn't perfect yet, we need to test it many times.

zh: 在上市之前，公司必须对所有新产品进行严格的测试。
pinyin: Zài shàngshì zhīqián, gōngsī bìxū duì suǒyǒu xīn chǎnpǐn jìnxíng yánggé de cèshì.
en: Before launching, the company must conduct rigorous testing on all new products.

zh: 虽然我们已经测试了很多遍，但用户反馈仍然暴露出一些我们没想到的问题。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen yǐjīng cèshìle hěnduō biàn, dàn yònghù fǎnkuì réngránbàolù chūyīxiē wǒmen méi xiǎngdào de wèntí.
en: Although we've tested it many times, user feedback still revealed some problems we hadn't anticipated.

zh: 这个电影很精彩。
pinyin: Zhège diànyǐng hěn jīngcǎi.
en: This movie is really great.

zh: 昨天的足球比赛很精彩,我看得很开心。
pinyin: Zuótiān de zúqiú bǐsài hěn jīngcǎi, wǒ kàn de hěn kāixīn.
en: Yesterday's soccer match was exciting, and I really enjoyed watching it.

zh: 虽然演员很年轻,但是他的表演精彩得让人印象深刻。
pinyin: Suīrán yǎnyuán hěn niánqīng, búguò tā de biǎoyǎn jīngcǎi de ràng rén yìnxiàng shēnkè.
en: Although the actor is young, his performance was so brilliant that it left a deep impression on people.

zh: 因为舞蹈演员们的精彩表演,观众们都站起来鼓掌了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǔdǎo yǎnyuányuán men de jīngcǎi biǎoyǎn, guānzhòng men dōu zhàn qǐlái gǔzhǎng le.
en: Because of the dancers' spectacular performance, the audience stood up and applauded.

zh: 这次演讲内容充实,讲师的精彩阐述让专业人士也学到了不少东西。
pinyin: Zhè cì yǎnjiǎng nèiróng chōngshí, jiǎngshī de jīngcǎi chǎnshù ràng zhuānyè rénshì yě xuéd dào le búshǎo dōngxi.
en: This lecture was substantive, and the speaker's brilliant exposition taught even the professionals a lot of valuable things.

zh: 这个金戒指很漂亮。
pinyin: Zhège jīn jièzhǐ hěn piàoliàng.
en: This gold ring is very beautiful.

zh: 昨天我买了一条金项链。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ mǎile yī tiáo jīn xiàngliàn.
en: I bought a gold necklace yesterday.

zh: 因为金价很高，所以很多人喜欢存金币。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīnjià hěn gāo, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén xǐhuān cún jīn bì.
en: Because gold prices are high, many people like to save gold coins.

zh: 虽然这件首饰不是真金，但是看起来跟真的一样。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiàn shǒushì búshì zhēn jīn, dànshi kàn qǐlái gēn zhēn de yīyàng.
en: Although this piece of jewelry isn't real gold, it looks just like the genuine thing.

zh: 投资黄金需要了解市场，不能盲目跟风买金条。
pinyin: Tóuzī huángjīn xūyào liǎojiě shìchǎng, búnéng máng mù gēnfēng mǎi jīn tiáo.
en: To invest in gold successfully, you need to understand the market and not blindly follow trends when buying gold bars.

zh: 我和妈妈的感情很好。
pinyin: Wǒ hé māma de gǎnqíng hěn hǎo.
en: My mom and I have a really good relationship.

zh: 他们的感情最近变得不太好。
pinyin: Tāmen de gǎnqíng zuìjìn biàn de bútuài hǎo.
en: Their relationship has gotten a bit worse lately.

zh: 虽然他们吵架了，但是他们的感情还是很深。
pinyin: Suīrán tāmen chǎojià le, búshì tāmen de gǎnqíng háishi hěn shēn.
en: Even though they fought, their bond is still really strong.

zh: 长期在外工作让我们的感情有些淡了，得回家多陪陪父母。
pinyin: Chángqī zài wài gōngzuò ràng wǒmen de gǎnqíng yǒuxiē dàn le, děi huíjiā duō péipeì péi fùmǔ.
en: Working away for long periods has made our relationship a bit distant—I need to go home and spend more time with my parents.

zh: 两人虽然感情深厚，但在生活观念上存在不少分歧，需要更多沟通来化解。
pinyin: Liǎng rén suīrán gǎnqíng shēnhòu, búshì zài shēnghuó guānniàn shang cúnzài búshǎo fēnqī, xūyào gèngduō gōutōng lái huàjiě.
en: Although they have a deep bond, they have quite a few differences in their outlook on life and need more communication to work things out.

zh: 我有时候吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒushíhou chī mǐfàn.
en: Sometimes I eat rice.

zh: 她有时候在家看电视。
pinyin: Tā yǒushíhou zàijiā kàn diànshì.
en: She sometimes watches TV at home.

zh: 虽然天气很冷，但我有时候还是去公园。
pinyin: Suīránguò tiānqì hěn lěng, dànshì wǒ yǒushíhou háishi qù gōngyuán.
en: Even though it's cold outside, I still go to the park sometimes.

zh: 因为工作太忙，他有时候没时间和朋友一起吃饭。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng, tā yǒushíhou méi shíjiān hé péngyou yìqǐ chīfàn.
en: Because work is so busy, he sometimes doesn't have time to eat with friends.

zh: 虽然这个项目很困难，但我们有时候能想到一些创意的解决办法。
pinyin: Suīránguò zhège xiàngmù hěn kùnnan, dànshì wǒmen yǒushíhou néng xiǎngdào yīxiē chuàngyì de jiějué bànfǎ.
en: Although this project is quite challenging, we sometimes come up with creative solutions.

zh: 小狗袭击了我。
pinyin: Xiǎo gǒu xíjī le wǒ.
en: The puppy attacked me.

zh: 昨天晚上小偷袭击了我们的家。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang xiǎo tōu xíjī le wǒmen de jiā.
en: A burglar attacked our house last night.

zh: 虽然警察很勇敢，但是他们还是被袭击了。
pinyin: Suīrán jǐngchá hěn yǒngǎn, dànshì tāmen háishi bèi xíjī le.
en: Although the police were brave, they still got attacked.

zh: 因为这个地区很危险，所以经常有人被袭击。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhège dìqū hěn wēixiǎn, suǒyǐ jīngcháng yǒu rén bèi xíjī.
en: Because this area is dangerous, people often get attacked there.

zh: 那次恐怖分子的袭击事件对整个城市造成了深远的影响。
pinyin: Nà cì kǒngbù fēnzǐ de xíjī shìjiàn duì zhěnggè chéngshì zàochéngle shēnyuǎn de yǐngxiǎng.
en: That terrorist attack had a profound impact on the entire city.

zh: 今天我们演出了。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒmen yǎnchū le.
en: We performed today.

zh: 明天晚上有一个演出。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǎnshang yǒu yīgè yǎnchū.
en: There's a performance tomorrow evening.

zh: 虽然很紧张，但是演出很成功。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn jǐnzhāng, dànshì yǎnchū hěn chénggōng.
en: Although we were nervous, the performance went really well.

zh: 学生们为了这次演出练习了好几个月。
pinyin: Xuéshēngmen wèile zhè cì yǎnchū liànxí le hǎo jǐ ge yuè.
en: The students practiced for several months to prepare for this performance.

zh: 这个演出获得了观众的热烈掌声和好评。
pinyin: Zhège yǎnchū huòdé le guānzhòng de règuó zhǎngshēng hé hǎopíng.
en: The performance earned enthusiastic applause and rave reviews from the audience.

zh: 我一生喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ yīshēng xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: I love eating rice my whole life.

zh: 他一生都住在这个城市里。
pinyin: Tā yīshēng dōu zhù zài zhège chéngshì lǐ.
en: He has lived in this city his entire life.

zh: 虽然她一生很辛苦,但是她很开心。
pinyin: Suīrán tā yīshēng hěn xinku, dànshì tā hěn kāixīn.
en: Although she worked hard her whole life, she was still happy.

zh: 因为喜欢读书,他一生都在追求知识。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xǐhuān dúshū, tā yīshēng dōu zài zhuīqiú zhīshi.
en: Because he loved reading, he spent his whole life pursuing knowledge.

zh: 他一生致力于教育事业,影响了数千名学生。
pinyin: Tā yīshēng zhìlì yú jiàoyù shìyè, yǐngxiǎngle shù qiān míng xuésheng.
en: He dedicated his entire life to education, impacting thousands of students.

zh: 我不在乎。
pinyin: Wǒ búzàihū.
en: I don't care.

zh: 他不在乎别人的意见。
pinyin: Tā búzàihū biérén de yìjiàn.
en: He doesn't care what other people think.

zh: 虽然输了，但我不在乎，因为我很开心。
pinyin: Suīrán shūle, dàn wǒ búzàihū, yīnwèi wǒ hěn kāixīn.
en: Even though I lost, I don't mind because I had fun.

zh: 只要能和朋友在一起，他不在乎去哪个地方。
pinyin: Zhǐyào néng hé péngyou zàiyīqǐ, tā búzàihū qù nǎge dìfang.
en: As long as he can be with friends, he doesn't care where they go.

zh: 年轻人往往不在乎后果，只想做自己喜欢的事情。
pinyin: Niánqīngnián wǎngwǎng búzàihū hòuuǒ, zhǐ xiǎng zuò zìjǐ xǐhuān de shìqing.
en: Young people often don't care about the consequences; they just want to do what they like.

zh: 我朝窗户看。
pinyin: Wǒ cháo chuānghu kàn.
en: I look toward the window.

zh: 每天早上我朝东方看日出。
pinyin: Měi tiān zǎoshang wǒ cháo dōngfāng kàn rìchū.
en: Every morning I watch the sunrise in the eastern direction.

zh: 因为房间朝南，所以冬天很温暖。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fángjiān cháo nán, suǒyǐ dōngtiān hěn wēnnuǎn.
en: Because the room faces south, it's very warm in winter.

zh: 他朝我竖起大拇指，表示我的想法很不错。
pinyin: Tā cháo wǒ shùqǐ dà mǔzhǐ, biǎoshì wǒ de xiǎngfǎ hěn búcuò.
en: He gave me a thumbs up toward me, showing that my idea was pretty good.

zh: 与其朝三暮四地改变计划，不如坚持原来的目标。
pinyin: Yǔqī cháo sān mù sì de gǎibiàn jìhuà, búrú jiānchí yuánlái de mùbiāo.
en: Rather than keep flip-flopping on your plans, it's better to stick with your original goals.

zh: 我呼吸空气。
pinyin: Wǒ hūxī kōngqì.
en: I breathe air.

zh: 运动的时候呼吸很快。
pinyin: Yùndòng de shíhou hūxī hěn kuài.
en: When exercising, your breathing becomes very fast.

zh: 虽然他很累，但是呼吸还是很平稳。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn lèi, dànshì hūxī háishi hěn píngwěn.
en: Although he was exhausted, his breathing remained quite steady.

zh: 医生让病人深呼吸，以便检查他的肺功能。
pinyin: Yīshēng ràng bìngrén shēn hūxī, yǐbiàn jiǎnchá tā de fèi gōngnéng.
en: The doctor had the patient take deep breaths so she could check his lung function.

zh: 长期压力过大会影响呼吸节奏，甚至引发焦虑症。
pinyin: Chángqī yālì guòdà huì yǐngxiǎng hūxī jiézòu, shènzhì yǐnfā jiāolǜ zhèng.
en: Prolonged excessive stress can disrupt your breathing rhythm and even trigger anxiety disorders.

zh: 她是明星。
pinyin: Tā shì míngxīng.
en: She is a star.

zh: 我喜欢看明星唱歌。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān kàn míngxīng chànggē.
en: I like watching stars sing.

zh: 因为她很漂亮，所以她成了明星。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn piàoliang, suǒyǐ tā chéngle míngxīng.
en: Because she was very beautiful, she became a celebrity.

zh: 这个明星虽然有名，但他从不炫耀自己。
pinyin: Zhège míngxīng suīrán yǒumíng, dàn tā cóngbù xuànyào zìjǐ.
en: Although this star is famous, he never shows off.

zh: 那位明星一夜成名后，面临了不少来自粉丝的压力。
pinyin: Nàwèi míngxīng yīyè chéngmíng hòu, miànlínle búshǎo láizì fěnsī de yālì.
en: After that celebrity became famous overnight, he faced considerable pressure from his fans.

zh: 我的手机在桌子上。
pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī zài zhuōzi shang.
en: My phone is on the table.

zh: 昨天我买了一个新手机。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ mǎile yī ge xīn shǒujī.
en: I bought a new phone yesterday.

zh: 因为没有手机，所以我找不到朋友。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu shǒujī, suǒyǐ wǒ zhǎobúdào péngyou.
en: Because I don't have my phone, I can't find my friend.

zh: 虽然这台机器很旧，但是它工作得还不错。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè tái jīqì hěn jiù, dànshi tā gōngzuò de háishi búcuò.
en: Even though this machine is old, it still works pretty well.

zh: 公司最近购买了几台新的印刷机来提高生产效率。
pinyin: Gōngsī zuìjìn gòumǎile jǐ tái xīn de yìnshuā jī lái tígāo shēngchǎn xiàolǜ.
en: The company recently bought several new printing machines to boost production efficiency.

zh: 我住在城里。
pinyin: Wǒ zhù zài chéng lǐ.
en: I live in the city.

zh: 这个城很大，有很多人。
pinyin: Zhège chéng hěn dà, yǒu hěn duō rén.
en: This city is really big and has lots of people.

zh: 虽然城里很吵，但是工作机会很多。
pinyin: Suīrán chéng lǐ hěn chǎo, dànshì gōngzuò jīhuì hěn duō.
en: Although the city is noisy, there are plenty of job opportunities.

zh: 因为城市发展快，所以很多人都想搬到城里来工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi chéngshì fāzhǎn kuài, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén dōu xiǎng bān dào chéng lǐ lái gōngzuò.
en: Because cities develop so quickly, lots of people want to move there to find work.

zh: 随着经济增长，小城镇逐渐演变成了现代化的大城市。
pinyin: Suízhē jīngjì zēngzhǎng, xiǎo chéngzhèn zhújiàn yǎnbiàn chéngle xiàndàihuà de dà chéngshì.
en: As the economy has grown, small towns have gradually transformed into modern cities.

zh: 这个超级好吃。
pinyin: Zhège chāojí hǎochī.
en: This is super delicious.

zh: 昨天我买了一个超级大的西瓜。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ mǎile yīgè chāojí dà de xīguā.
en: Yesterday I bought a super huge watermelon.

zh: 虽然他很累，但是他超级想去看电影。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn lèi, dànshì tā chāojí xiǎng qù kàn diànyǐng.
en: Even though he's exhausted, he's super eager to go see a movie.

zh: 因为今年产量超级低，所以水果的价格变得特别贵。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīnnián chǎnyàng chāojí dī, suǒyǐ shuǐguǒ de jiàgé biàn de tèbié guì.
en: Because production this year has been super low, fruit prices have become unusually expensive.

zh: 他虽然工作超级忙，但还是抽空陪家人，这种平衡真的不容易。
pinyin: Tā suīrán gōngzuò chāojí máng, dànshì háishi chōukonɡ péi jiārén, zhè zhǒng pínghuàng zhēnde búrónɡyì.
en: Although his work is super demanding, he still makes time for his family—that kind of balance is genuinely hard to achieve.

zh: 音乐是我的灵魂。
pinyin: Yīnyuè shì wǒ de línghuó.
en: Music is my soul.

zh: 他每天都在想自己的灵魂。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu zài xiǎng zìjǐ de línghuó.
en: He thinks about his soul every day.

zh: 虽然身体很累，但是他的灵魂还很强大。
pinyin: Suīrán shēntǐ hěn lèi, dànshì tā de línghuó háishi hěn qiángdà.
en: Although his body was exhausted, his spirit remained strong.

zh: 这部电影触动了我的灵魂，让我重新思考人生的意义。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng chùdòngle wǒ de línghuó, ràng wǒ chóngxīn sīkǎo rénshēng de yìyì.
en: This film touched my soul and made me rethink the meaning of life.

zh: 经历了那么多挫折后，我才明白真正的灵魂自由不是逃避，而是接纳。
pinyin: Jīng历le nàme duō cuòzhé hòu, wǒ cái míngbai zhēnzhèng de línghuó zìyóu búshì táobì, érshì jiēnà.
en: After facing so many setbacks, I finally understood that true spiritual freedom isn't about escape—it's about acceptance.

zh: 孩子破坏了玩具。
pinyin: háizi pòhuàile wánjù.
en: The child broke the toy.

zh: 昨天的风暴破坏了我们的房子。
pinyin: zuótiān de fēngbào pòhuàile wǒmen de fángzi.
en: Yesterday's storm damaged our house.

zh: 虽然雨很大，但是没有破坏庄稼。
pinyin: Suīrán yǔ hěn dà, dànshi méiyǒu pòhuài zhuāngjia.
