en: Although the rain was heavy, it didn't damage the crops.

zh: 长期的污染破坏了这个地区的生态环境。
pinyin: Chángqī de wūrǎn pòhuàile zhège dìqū de shēngtài huánjìng.
en: Long-term pollution has destroyed the ecosystem in this area.

zh: 战争破坏了许多古代建筑，文化遗产损失惨重。
pinyin: Zhànzhēng pòhuàile xǔduō gǔdài jiànzhù, wénhuà yíchǎn sǔnshī cǎnzhòng.
en: The war destroyed many ancient buildings, resulting in severe losses to cultural heritage.

zh: 这只不过是一个苹果。
pinyin: Zhè zhǐ búguò shì yī ge píngguǒ.
en: This is just an apple.

zh: 他迟到了，只不过晚了五分钟。
pinyin: Tā chídào le, zhǐ búguò wǎn le wǔ fēnzhōng.
en: He was late, but only by five minutes.

zh: 虽然他很聪明，但他的成功只不过是因为努力。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn cōngming, dàn tā de chénggōng zhǐ búguò shì yīnwèi nǔlì.
en: Although he's smart, his success is really just the result of hard work.

zh: 你担心的那些问题只不过是想象出来的，根本不会发生。
pinyin: Nǐ dānxīn de nàxiē wèntí zhǐ búguò shì xiǎngxiàng chūlái de, gēnběn búhuì fāshēng.
en: Those problems you're worried about are just things you've imagined; they won't actually happen.

zh: 与其说他反对这个计划，倒不如说他只不过是担心投资的风险而已。
pinyin: Yǔ qī shuō tā fǎnduì zhège jìhuà, dào búrú shuō tā zhǐ búguò shì dānxīn tóuzī de fēngxiǎn éryǐ.
en: Rather than saying he opposes the plan, it's more accurate to say he's just concerned about investment risk.

zh: 这是我的房。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de fáng.
en: This is my room.

zh: 我每天在房里做功课。
pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zài fáng lǐ zuò gōngkè.
en: I do my homework in my room every day.

zh: 因为房间很小，所以我们买了新房子。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fángjiān hěn xiǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen mǎi le xīn fángzi.
en: Because the apartment was too small, we bought a new house.

zh: 他租的房子虽然离公司远，但是房租比较便宜。
pinyin: Tā zū de fángzi suīrán lí gōngsī yuǎn, dànshì fángzū bǐjiào piányí.
en: Although the apartment he rents is far from the office, the rent is quite affordable.

zh: 随着房价上涨，越来越多年轻人选择先租房而不是立刻买房。
pinyin: Suízhe fángjià shànngzhǎng, yuèláiyuè duō niánqīng rén xuǎnzé xiān zūfáng érbushì lìkè mǎifáng.
en: As housing prices rise, more and more young people choose to rent first rather than buy immediately.

zh: 我们一起玩，很愉快。
pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ wán, hěn愉快.
en: We played together and had a lot of fun.

zh: 昨天和朋友一起吃饭，感觉很愉快。
pinyin: Zuótiān hé péngyou yìqǐ chīfàn, gǎnjué hěn愉快.
en: Yesterday I had dinner with friends and it felt really pleasant.

zh: 虽然天气很冷，但是家人在一起的时候很愉快。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, dànshì jiārén zài yìqǐ de shíhou hěn愉快.
en: Even though the weather was cold, being together with family was really enjoyable.

zh: 因为同事们都很友善，所以工作环境显得特别愉快。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tóngshì men dōu hěn yǒushàn, suǒyǐ gōngzuò huánjìng xiǎnde tèbié愉快.
en: Since my coworkers are all friendly, the work environment feels especially pleasant.

zh: 虽然出差很疲劳，但和团队完成项目后那种愉快的成就感无法比拟。
pinyin: Suīrán chūchāi hěn píláo, dàn hé tuánduì wánchéng xiàngmù hòu nàzhǒng愉快de chéngjiùgǎn wúfǎ bǐnì.
en: Although the business trip was exhausting, the sense of satisfaction and joy we felt after completing the project with the team was incomparable.

zh: 气球爆炸了。
pinyin: Qìqiú bàozhà le.
en: The balloon popped.

zh: 昨天工厂里发生了爆炸。
pinyin: Zuótiān gōngchǎng lǐ fāshēng le bàozhà.
en: There was an explosion at the factory yesterday.

zh: 因为天气太热，汽车轮胎爆炸了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì tài rè, qìchē lúntāi bàozhà le.
en: Because it was so hot, the car tire burst.

zh: 虽然警察及时赶到，但还是没能阻止炸弹爆炸。
pinyin: Suīrán jǐngchá jíshí gǎndào, dàn háishi méi néng zǔzhǐ zhàdàn bàozhà.
en: Although the police arrived in time, they still couldn't prevent the bomb from exploding.

zh: 手机电池在充电时突然爆炸，幸好没有人员伤亡。
pinyin: Shǒujī diànchí zài chōngdiàn shí túrán bàozhà, xìnghǎo méiyǒu rényuán shāngyáng.
en: The phone battery suddenly exploded while charging, fortunately with no casualties.

zh: 我迟到了。
pinyin: Wǒ chídào le.
en: I'm late.

zh: 他今天迟到了十分钟。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān chídào le shí fēnzhōng.
en: He was ten minutes late today.

zh: 因为堵车，所以我迟到了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi dǔchē, suǒyǐ wǒ chídào le.
en: I was late because of traffic.

zh: 虽然他经常迟到，但老板还是没有开除他。
pinyin: Suīrán tā jīngcháng chídào, dàn lǎobǎn háishi méiyǒu kāichúle tā.
en: Although he's often late, his boss still hasn't fired him.

zh: 要是再迟到的话，可能会影响你的工作评价。
pinyin: Yàoshi zài chídào dehuà, kěnéng huì yǐngxiǎng nǐ de gōngzuò píngjiǎ.
en: If you keep being late, it might affect your work evaluation.

zh: 我带走了你的书。
pinyin: Wǒ dàizǒu le nǐ de shū.
en: I took your book with me.

zh: 他昨天带走了一些吃的东西。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān dàizǒu le yīxiē chīde dōngxi.
en: He took some food with him yesterday.

zh: 因为下雨了，我们把东西都带走了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, wǒmen bǎ dōngxi dōu dàizǒu le.
en: Because it was raining, we took everything with us.

zh: 虽然会议很长，但他还是提前离开把文件都带走了。
pinyin: Suīrán huìyì hěn cháng, dàn tā háishi tíqián líkāi bǎ wénjiàn dōu dàizǒu le.
en: Although the meeting was long, he still left early and took all the documents with him.

zh: 警察抓住了那个小偷，并把他偷的东西都带走作为证据。
pinyin: Jǐngchá zhuāzhù le nàge xiǎothief, bìng bǎ tā tōu de dōngxi dōu dàizǒu zuòwéi zhèngjù.
en: The police caught the thief and took all the stolen goods as evidence.

zh: 我们吃晚餐。
pinyin: Wǒmen chī wǎncān.
en: We eat dinner.

zh: 今天晚餐有鱼和米饭。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǎncān yǒu yú hé mǐfàn.
en: Today's dinner has fish and rice.

zh: 因为很忙，所以晚餐吃得很快。
pinyin: Yīnwèi hěn máng, suǒyǐ wǎncān chīde hěn kuài.
en: Because I was busy, I ate dinner very quickly.

zh: 虽然晚餐准备得不太复杂，但是家人都很喜欢。
pinyin: Suīrán wǎncān zhǔnbèi de búzhào fùzá, danshì jiārén dōu hěn xǐhuān.
en: Although dinner wasn't very complicated to prepare, my family really enjoyed it.

zh: 每周五和朋友一起吃晚餐已经成了我们的习惯。
pinyin: Měi zhōuwǔ hé péngyou yìqǐ chī wǎncān yǐjīng chéngle wǒmen de xíguàn.
en: Having dinner together with friends every Friday has become our habit.

zh: 他在开玩笑。
pinyin: Tā zài kāi wánxiào.
en: He's joking.

zh: 别开玩笑，我不喜欢这样。
pinyin: Bié kāi wánxiào, wǒ búxǐhuān zhèyàng.
en: Stop joking around—I don't like that.

zh: 虽然他经常开玩笑，但是大家都知道他很善良。
pinyin: Suīrán tā jīngcháng kāi wánxiào, búshì dàjiā dōu zhīdào tā hěn shànliáng.
en: Although he jokes around a lot, everyone knows he's really kind.

zh: 他喜欢开玩笑，结果被同学们误会了他的本意。
pinyin: Tā xǐhuān kāi wánxiào, jiéguǒ bèi túngxuémen wùhuì le tā de běnyì.
en: Because he likes to joke around, his classmates ended up misunderstanding his real intentions.

zh: 在正式场合开玩笑需要拿捏分寸，否则容易显得不尊重人。
pinyin: Zài zhèngshì chǎngh合 kāi wánxiào xūyào náinieē fēnsu, fǒuzé róngyì xiǎnde búzūnzhòng rén.
en: Joking at formal occasions requires careful judgment—otherwise you risk coming across as disrespectful.

zh: 我在电影里的角色是学生。
pinyin: Wǒ zài diànyǐng lǐ de jiǎosè shì xuésheng.
en: My role in the movie is a student.

zh: 她今年在话剧里演一个重要的角色。
pinyin: Tā jīnnián zài huàjù lǐ yǎn yīge zhònyào de jiǎosè.
en: She's playing an important role in a stage play this year.

zh: 虽然这个角色只有几句台词，但是很难演好。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège jiǎosè zhǐyǒu jǐ jù táicí, búguò hěn nán yǎn hǎo.
en: Even though this role only has a few lines, it's quite difficult to perform well.

zh: 演员需要充分理解自己的角色背景才能表演得更逼真。
pinyin: Yǎnyuán xūyào chōngfèn lǐjiě zìjǐ de jiǎosè bèijǐng cáinéng biǎoyǎn de gèng bīzhēn.
en: Actors need to fully understand their character's background in order to perform more convincingly.

zh: 在这部电视剧中，主角色的塑造相当成功，引起了观众的广泛共鸣。
pinyin: Zài zhè búfen diànshìjù zhōng, zhǔ jiǎosè de sùzào xiāngdāng chénggōng, yǐnqǐle guānzhòng de guǎngfàn gòngrìng.
en: The development of the main character in this TV series is quite successful and has resonated widely with the audience.

zh: 我的脑子很好。
pinyin: Wǒ de nǎozi hěn hǎo.
en: My brain works well.

zh: 他今天脑子不清楚。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān nǎozi bu qīngchu.
en: His head isn't clear today.

zh: 因为没有睡好，所以我的脑子很累。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu shuì hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒ de nǎozi hěn lèi.
en: Because I didn't sleep well, my brain feels tired.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他的脑子还是很活跃。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn tā de nǎozi háishi hěn huóyuè.
en: Although he's very busy with work, his mind is still quite sharp.

zh: 长期缺乏运动会影响脑子的反应速度和记忆力。
pinyin: Chángqī quēfá yùndòng huì yǐngxiǎng nǎozi de fǎnyìng sùdù hé jìyìlì.
en: Lack of exercise over time can affect your brain's reaction speed and memory.

zh: 我路上吃了苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ lùshang chīle píngguǒ.
en: I ate an apple on the way.

zh: 昨天路上我看到了一只小狗。
pinyin: Zuótiān lùshang wǒ kàndàole yī zhī xiǎo gǒu.
en: Yesterday on the road, I saw a little dog.

zh: 因为路上堵车，所以他迟到了半小时。
pinyin: Yīnwèi lùshang dǔchē, suǒyǐ tā chídàole bàn xiǎoshí.
en: Because there was traffic on the way, he was thirty minutes late.

zh: 虽然路上花了三个小时，但她还是按时到达了会议。
pinyin: Suīrán lùshang huāle sān ge xiǎoshí, dàn tā háishi ànshí dàodále huìyì.
en: Although it took three hours to get there, she still made it to the meeting on time.

zh: 路上我们经过了好几家新开的餐厅，其中有两家看起来生意挺不错的。
pinyin: Lùshang wǒmen jīngguòle hǎo jǐ jiā xīn kāi de cāntīng, qīzhōng yǒu liǎng jiā kàn qǐlai shēngyì tǐng búcuò de.
en: On the way, we passed several newly opened restaurants, and a couple of them seemed to be doing pretty well.

zh: 见鬼了！
pinyin: Jiàn guǐ le!
en: What the heck! (lit. I've seen a ghost!)

zh: 这件事真奇怪，见鬼了。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zhēn qíguài, jiàn guǐ le.
en: This thing is really weird—something's definitely off.

zh: 因为没有人来，所以我说见鬼了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu rén lái, suǒyǐ wǒ shuō jiàn guǐ le.
en: Since nobody showed up, I said something must be seriously wrong.

zh: 他说的话根本不合理，我听了以后就说见鬼了。
pinyin: Tā shuōde huà gēnběn búhéelǐ, wǒ tīngle yǐhòu jiù shuō jiàn guǐ le.
en: What he said made absolutely no sense, so I told him he was talking nonsense.

zh: 这个计划改了五次还是有问题，真是见鬼了！
pinyin: Zhège jìhuà gǎile wǔ cì háishi yǒu wèntí, zhēnshi jiàn guǐ le!
en: We've revised this plan five times and it's still broken—this is ridiculous!

zh: 我看杂志。
pinyin: Wǒ kàn zázhì.
en: I'm reading a magazine.

zh: 姐姐每天都看杂志。
pinyin: Jiějie měitiān dōu kàn zázhì.
en: My older sister reads magazines every day.

zh: 因为喜欢画画，所以我经常买美术杂志。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xǐhuān huàhuà, suǒyǐ wǒ jīngcháng mǎi měishù zázhì.
en: Because I love drawing, I often buy art magazines.

zh: 这本科技杂志虽然价格有点贵，但内容很专业。
pinyin: Zhè běn kējì zázhì suīrán jiàgé yǒudiǎn guì, dàn nèiróng hěn zhuānyè.
en: Although this tech magazine is a bit pricey, the content is really professional.

zh: 许多年轻上班族都靠阅读商业杂志来了解市场动态。
pinyin: Xǔduō niánqīng shàngbānzú dōu kào yuèdú shāngyè zázhì lái liǎojiě shìchǎng dònghuà.
en: Many young office workers rely on reading business magazines to stay updated on market trends.

zh: 她很秀气。
pinyin: Tā hěn xiùqì.
en: She looks delicate and pretty.

zh: 这个女孩穿着很秀气的裙子。
pinyin: Zhège nǚhái chuānzhe hěn xiùqì de qúnzi.
en: This girl is wearing a delicate and elegant dress.

zh: 虽然天气很热，但她还是秀出了漂亮的衣服。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn rè, dànshì tā háishi xiùchūle piàoliang de yīfu.
en: Although it was hot, she still showed off her beautiful clothes.

zh: 他在朋友面前喜欢秀自己的才能和成绩。
pinyin: Tā zài péngyou miànqian xǐhuān xiù zìjǐ de cáinéng hé chéngjì.
en: He likes to show off his abilities and achievements in front of his friends.

zh: 现在很多年轻人在社交媒体上秀生活，其实有点过了。
pinyin: Xiànzài hěnduō niánqīng rén zài shèjiāo méitǐ shang xiù shēnghuó, qīshí yǒudiǎn guòle.
en: Nowadays a lot of young people show off their lives on social media, which is honestly kind of excessive.

zh: 我们服务很好。
pinyin: Wǒmen fúwù hěn hǎo.
en: Our service is very good.

zh: 这家餐厅的服务很快。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de fúwù hěn kuài.
en: The service at this restaurant is really fast.

zh: 因为服务态度好，所以很多人喜欢去那里。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fúwù tàidù hǎo, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén xǐhuān qù nàlǐ.
en: Because their service attitude is good, many people like going there.

zh: 虽然价格贵，但是这个公司的服务质量值得信任。
pinyin: Suīrán jiàgé guì, dànshi zhège gōngsī de fúwù zhìliàng zhíde xìnrèn.
en: Although the prices are high, this company's service quality is trustworthy.

zh: 我们致力于为客户提供最优质的服务体验。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhìlì yú wèi kèhù tígōng zuì yōuzhìliàng de fúwù tǐyàn.
en: We're committed to providing our customers with the best possible service experience.

zh: 这件衣服很合适。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu hěn héshì.
en: This shirt fits really well.

zh: 周末去公园很合适,天气很好。
pinyin: Zhōumò qù gōngyuán hěn héshì, tiānqì hěn hǎo.
en: Going to the park this weekend is perfect—the weather is great.

zh: 虽然这个工作离家远,但是工资合适,我就接受了。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège gōngzuò líjiā yuǎn, dànshi gōngzī héshì, wǒ jiù jiēshòule.
en: Even though the job is far from home, the salary is reasonable, so I accepted it.

zh: 我们需要找一个合适的时间开会,最好是下午两点左右。
pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào zhǎo yīgè héshì de shíjiān kāihuì, zuìhǎo shi xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn zuǒyòu.
en: We need to find a suitable time for the meeting—ideally around 2 p.m.

zh: 这份工作的待遇和发展前景都很合适,我觉得值得尝试。
pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò de dàiyù hé fāzhǎn qiánjǐng dōu hěn héshì, wǒ juéde zhídé chángshi.
en: The compensation and career prospects for this job are both really appealing—I think it's worth a shot.

zh: 我每天学习。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān xuéxí.
en: I study every day.

zh: 他在学校学习英语。
pinyin: Tā zài xuéxiào xuéxí yīngyǔ.
en: He studies English at school.

zh: 因为明天有考试，所以我现在要学习。
pinyin: Yīnwèi míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì, suǒyǐ wǒ xiànzài yào xuéxí.
en: Because there's an exam tomorrow, I need to study now.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但我还是坚持每周学习新技能。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn wǒ háishi jiānchí měi zhōu xuéxí xīn jìnéng.
en: Even though work is busy, I still make time to learn new skills every week.

zh: 要想在这个领域成功，必须持之以恒地学习和实践。
pinyin: Yàoxiǎng zài zhège lǐngyù chénggōng, bìxū chízhī yǐ héng de xuéxí hé shíjiàn.
en: If you want to succeed in this field, you have to keep studying and practicing consistently.

zh: 我吃了一顿饭。
pinyin: Wǒ chīle yī顿 fàn.
en: I had a meal.

zh: 昨天晚上我们吃了一顿很好吃的饭。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒmen chīle yī顿 hěn hǎochī de fàn.
en: Last night we had a really delicious dinner.

zh: 因为今天很累，所以我想吃一顿舒服的饭。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān hěn lèi, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng chī yī顿 shūfu de fàn.
en: Because I'm tired today, I want to have a nice, comfortable meal.

zh: 他们虽然工作很忙，但还是一起吃了顿丰盛的午餐。
pinyin: Tāmen suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn háishi yīqǐ chīle顿 fēngshèng de wǔcān.
en: Although they were very busy with work, they still had a hearty lunch together.

zh: 最近加班太多，难得能跟家人坐下来好好吃一顿饭。
pinyin: Zuìjìn jiābān tàiduō, nándé néng gēn jiārén zuòxiàlai hǎohāo chī yī顿 fàn.
en: With so much overtime lately, it's rare to get the chance to sit down and have a proper meal with family.

zh: 有车很便宜。
pinyin: Yǒu chē hěn piányi.
en: Having a car is very cheap.

zh: 买东西的时候用手机很便利。
pinyin: Mǎi dōngxi de shíhou yòng shǒujī hěn biànyì.
en: Using your phone when shopping is very convenient.

zh: 虽然地方小，但是住在城市中心很便利。
pinyin: Suīrán dìfang xiǎo, búguò zhù zài chéngshì zhōngxīn hěn biànyì.
en: Although the place is small, living in the city center is very convenient.

zh: 自从有了这个应用，我买票就便宜多了。
pinyin: Zìcóng yǒule zhège yìngyòng, wǒ mǎi piào jiù piányi duōle.
en: Ever since I got this app, buying tickets has become much cheaper for me.

zh: 远程工作让很多人可以住在郊区，既节省开支，又便于照顾家人。
pinyin: Yuǎnchéng gōngzuò ràng hěnduō rén kěyǐ zhù zài jiāoōu, jì jiéshěng kāizhī, yòu biànyú zhàogu jiārén.
en: Remote work allows many people to live in the suburbs, which both saves money and makes it easier to care for family.

zh: 早饭包括面包和牛奶。
pinyin: Zǎofàn bāokuò miànbāo hé niúnǎi.
en: Breakfast includes bread and milk.

zh: 我的家人包括爸爸、妈妈和妹妹。
pinyin: Wǒ de jiārén bāokuò bàba, māma hé mèimei.
en: My family includes my dad, mom, and little sister.

zh: 这个公司的员工包括工程师、设计师和销售人员。
pinyin: Zhège gōngsī de yuángōng bāokuò gōngchéngshī, shèjìshī hé xiāoshòu rényuán.
en: The company's employees include engineers, designers, and salespeople.

zh: 今年的假期费用包括机票、酒店和食物，预算大约五千块。
pinyin: Jīnnián de jiàqī fèiyòng bāokuò jīpiào, jiǔdiàn hé shíwù, yùsuàn dàyuē wǔqiān kuài.
en: This year's vacation costs, which include flights, hotels, and meals, total about five thousand yuan.

zh: 这项改革的核心内容包括简化审批流程、降低企业税负和优化营商环境。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé de héxxīn nèiróng bāokuò jiǎnhuà shěnpī liúchéng, jiàngdī qǐyè shuìfù hé yōuhuà yíngshāng huánjìng.
en: The core aspects of this reform include streamlining approval procedures, reducing corporate tax burdens, and improving the business environment.

zh: 我很累。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn lèi.
en: I'm very tired.

zh: 今天工作很多,我感到很累。
pinyin: Jīntiān gōngzuò hěn duō, wǒ gǎndào hěn lèi.
en: There was a lot of work today, and I felt really exhausted.

zh: 因为昨天睡眠不够,所以我今天很累。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zuótiān shuìmián búguò, suǒyǐ wǒ jīntiān hěn lèi.
en: Because I didn't get enough sleep yesterday, I'm very tired today.

zh: 虽然周末休息了,但是工作压力还是让我感到很累。
pinyin: Suīrán zhōumò xiūxi le, dànshi gōngzuò yālì háishi ràng wǒ gǎndào hěn lèi.
en: Even though I rested over the weekend, the work stress still leaves me feeling worn out.

zh: 长期加班不仅累身体,更累心理,我需要找到平衡。
pinyin: Chángqī jiābān búnjǐn lèi shēntǐ, gèng lèi xīnlǐ, wǒ xūyào zhǎodào pínghéng.
en: Working overtime constantly exhausts not just my body but also my mind—I need to find better balance.

zh: 这是一辆汽车。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī liàng qìchē.
en: This is a car.

zh: 我爸爸的汽车是黑色的。
pinyin: Wǒ bàba de qìchē shì hēisè de.
en: My dad's car is black.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以我们坐汽车去公园。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ wǒmen zuò qìchē qù gōngyuán.
en: Because it's raining, we're taking the car to the park.

zh: 他买的那辆汽车虽然很贵，但是开起来很舒服。
pinyin: Tā mǎi de nà liàng qìchē suīrán hěn guì, dànshì kāi qǐlái hěn shūfu.
en: Although the car he bought is expensive, it drives really comfortably.

zh: 随着城市发展，汽车数量不断增加，停车问题也变得越来越严重。
pinyin: Suízhe chéngshì fāzhǎn, qìchē shùliàng búduàn zēngjiā, tíngchē wèntí yě biàn de yuèláiyuè yánzhòng.
en: As the city develops, the number of cars keeps growing, and parking has become an increasingly serious problem.

zh: 现在时刻是下午三点。
pinyin: Xiànzài shíkè shì xiàwǔ sān diǎn.
en: The time right now is 3 PM.

zh: 每一时刻我都在想你。
pinyin: Měi yī shíkè wǒ dōu zài xiǎng nǐ.
en: Every moment, I'm thinking of you.

zh: 虽然很累，但那时刻我还是很开心。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn nà shíkè wǒ háishi hěn kāixīn.
en: Even though I was tired, I was still really happy at that moment.

zh: 因为紧急情况，我们时刻准备应对突发事件。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jǐnjí qíngkuàng, wǒmen shíkè zhǔnbèi yìngduì túfā shìjiàn.
en: Because of the emergency, we're constantly prepared to handle unexpected incidents.

zh: 在这个信息爆炸的时代，我们需要时刻保持警惕。
pinyin: Zài zhège xìnxī bàozhà de shídài, wǒmen xūyào shíkè bǎochíng jǐngtì.
en: In this age of information overload, we need to stay alert at all times.

zh: 这是一张单人床。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī zhāng dānrén chuáng.
en: This is a single bed.

zh: 我昨天买了一件单色的衣服。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān mǎile yī jiàn dāngsè de yīfu.
en: I bought a solid-colored piece of clothing yesterday.

zh: 虽然这个菜单很长，但是我们只点了两个菜。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège càidān hěn cháng, dànshì wǒmen zhǐ diǎnle liǎng ge càI.
en: Although the menu is long, we only ordered two dishes.

zh: 因为工作太忙，他这个月单独在家吃了好几次饭。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng, tā zhège yuè dāndú zàijiā chīle hǎo jǐ cì fàn.
en: Because work has been so busy, he's eaten alone at home several times this month.

zh: 这份工作报告虽然内容详细，但是格式单调得有点让人厌烦。
pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò bàogào suīrán nèiróng xiángxì, dànshì gēshì dāndiào de yǒudiǎn ràng rén yànfán.
en: Although this work report is detailed in content, the format is so monotonous it's a bit tedious.

zh: 这是一个广告。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè guǎnggào.
en: This is an advertisement.

zh: 电视上有很多广告。
pinyin: Diànshì shang yǒu hěnduō guǎnggào.
en: There are lots of ads on TV.

zh: 因为那个广告很有趣，所以我喜欢看。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nàge guǎnggào hěn yǒuqù, suǒyǐ wǒ xǐhuān kàn.
en: Because that ad is funny, I like watching it.

zh: 公司花了很多钱做广告来吸引更多客人。
pinyin: Gōngsī huāle hěnduō qián zuò guǎnggào lái xīyǐn gèngduō kèrén.
en: The company spent a lot of money on advertising to attract more customers.

zh: 虽然那个广告制作得很精美，但消费者对它的反应并不热烈。
pinyin: Suīrán nàge guǎnggào zhìzuò de hěn jīngměi, dàn xiāofèizhě duì tā de fǎnyìng bìngbù règuó.
en: Though the advertisement was produced beautifully, consumers' response to it wasn't particularly enthusiastic.

zh: 哥们，你好！
pinyin: Gēmen, nǐ hǎo!
en: Hey buddy, how are you?

zh: 哥们，今天我们一起去吃饭吧。
pinyin: Gēmen, jīntiān wǒmen yìqǐ qù chīfàn ba.
en: Hey man, let's grab food together today.

zh: 虽然我们很久没见，但是哥们之间的感情没变。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen hěnjiǔ méi jiàn, dànshì gēmen zhījiān de gǎnqíng méi biàn.
en: Even though we haven't seen each other in ages, the bond between us buddies hasn't changed.

zh: 哥们，你遇到困难的时候，记得我们一直在你身边。
pinyin: Gēmen, nǐ yùdào kùnnan de shíhou, jìde wǒmen yìzhí zài nǐ shēnbiān.
en: Buddy, whenever you're facing tough times, remember we've always got your back.

zh: 哥们，咱们从小就一起长大，经历了那么多风风雨雨。
pinyin: Gēmen, zánmen cóngxiǎo jiù yìqǐ zhǎngdà, jīnglìle nàme duō fēngfēng yǔyǔ.
en: Man, we've grown up together since we were kids and been through thick and thin.

zh: 我来自英国。
pinyin: Wǒ lái zì Yīngguó.
en: I come from the United Kingdom.

zh: 英国的天气很冷，经常下雨。
pinyin: Yīngguó de tiānqì hěn lěng, jīngcháng xiàyǔ.
en: The weather in the UK is very cold and it rains a lot.

zh: 虽然英国很远，但是我很想去旅游。
pinyin: Suīrán Yīngguó hěn yuǎn, dànshì wǒ hěn xiǎng qù lǚyóu.
en: Although the UK is far away, I really want to go traveling there.

zh: 因为他在英国读了五年大学，所以他的英文特别流利。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā zài Yīngguó dúle wǔ nián dàxué, suǒyǐ tā de Yīngwén tèbié liúlì.
en: Because he studied at university in the UK for five years, his English is particularly fluent.

zh: 英国的教育制度对学生要求严格，这也是很多人选择去那里留学的原因。
pinyin: Yīngguó de jiàoyù zhìdù duì xuésheng yāoqiú yánggé, zhè yě shì hěnduō rén xuǎnzé qù nàlǐ liúxué de yuányīn.
en: The UK's education system has strict requirements for students, which is also why many people choose to study abroad there.

zh: 这个苹果什么样？
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ shénmeyàng?
en: What does this apple look like?

zh: 昨天我买的衣服样子很漂亮。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ mǎi de yīfu yàngzi hěn piàoliang.
en: The style of the clothes I bought yesterday is really pretty.

zh: 虽然这个房间样式很旧，但是很便宜。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège fángjiān yàngshi hěn jiù, dànshi hěn piányí.
en: Although the style of this room is quite old, it's very affordable.

zh: 他每次说话的样子都让人觉得他很自信。
pinyin: Tā měi cì shuōhuà de yàngzi dōu ràng rén juéde tā hěn zìxìn.
en: The way he speaks every time makes people feel he's very confident.

zh: 从她紧张的样子来看，这次面试对她很重要。
pinyin: Cóng tā jǐnzhāng de yàngzi lái kàn, zhè cì miànshì duì tā hěn zhòngyào.
en: Judging from how nervous she looks, this interview really matters to her.

zh: 你是笨蛋。
pinyin: Nǐ shì笨蛋。
en: You're an idiot.

zh: 他昨天又做了一件笨蛋的事。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān yòu zuòle yī jiàn笨蛋 de shì。
en: He did something stupid again yesterday.

zh: 因为他很笨蛋，所以没人想和他一起玩。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn笨蛋，suǒyǐ méi rén xiǎng hé tā yīqǐ wán。
en: Because he's such an idiot, nobody wants to play with him.

zh: 虽然他不是笨蛋，但他的决定真的很愚蠢。
pinyin: Suīrán tā búshì笨蛋，dàn tā de juéding zhēnde hěn yúchǔn。
en: He's not an idiot, but his decision was genuinely foolish.

zh: 别像个笨蛋似的老是重复同样的错误。
pinyin: Biéyàng ge笨蛋 shìde lǎoshi chóngfù tónyàng de cuòwù。
en: Stop being such an idiot and repeating the same mistake over and over.

zh: 这个水很冷。
pinyin: Zhège shuǐ hěn lěng.
en: This water is very cold.

zh: 冬天天气很冷，我穿了厚衣服。
pinyin: Dōngtiān tiānqì hěn lěng, wǒ chuānle厚衣服。
en: It's very cold in winter, so I wore thick clothes.

zh: 因为外面很冷，所以很多人不想出门。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wàimiàn hěn lěng, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén búxiǎng chūmén.
en: Because it's cold outside, many people don't want to go out.

zh: 虽然冰淇淋很冷，但是夏天吃起来特别舒服。
pinyin: Suīrán bīngqīlín hěn lěng, dànshi xiàtiān chīqǐlai tèbié shūfu.
en: Even though ice cream is cold, it feels especially refreshing to eat in summer.

zh: 这家公司的工作环境比较冷淡，员工们都感到有些孤独。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de gōngzuò huánjìng bǐjiào lěngdàn, yuángōngmen dōu gǎndào yǒuxiē gūdú.
en: The work atmosphere at this company is quite cold and distant, so the employees all feel a bit isolated.

zh: 这个苹果相当大。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ xiāngdāng dà.
en: This apple is quite big.

zh: 昨天的天气相当冷，我穿了很厚的衣服。
pinyin: Zuótiān de tiānqì xiāngdāng lěng, wǒ chuānle hěn hòu de yīfu.
en: Yesterday's weather was pretty cold, so I wore thick clothes.

zh: 虽然他很年轻，但是他的工作经验相当丰富。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn niánqīng, dànshì tā de gōngzuò jīngyàn xiāngdāng fēngfù.
en: Although he's young, his work experience is quite extensive.

zh: 这部电影的票房成绩相当不错，吸引了很多观众。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de piàofáng chéngjī xiāngdāng búcuò, xīyǐnle hěnduō guāny众.
en: This film's box office performance was pretty impressive and attracted a lot of audiences.

zh: 在这个项目中，每个团队成员的贡献都相当重要，缺一不可。
pinyin: Zài zhège xiàngmù zhōng, měi ge tuánduì chéngyuán de gòngxiàn dōu xiāngdāng zhòngyào, quēyībúkě.
en: In this project, every team member's contribution is equally important—we can't do without anyone.

zh: 我投篮。
pinyin: Wǒ tóu lán.
en: I'm shooting a basket.

zh: 他每天投一个硬币到盒子里。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān tóu yī gè yìngbì dào hézi lǐ.
en: He throws a coin into the box every day.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但是孩子们还是投球玩。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dànshi háizi men háishi tóu qiú wán.
en: Even though the weather was bad, the kids still played catch.

zh: 公司决定投资新项目，因为市场前景看起来很不错。
pinyin: Gōngsī juéding tóuzī xīn xiàngmù, yīnwèi shìchǎng qiánjǐng kàn qǐlai hěn búcuò.
en: The company decided to invest in a new project because the market outlook looks quite promising.

zh: 与其投机取巧，不如脚踏实地地做好本职工作。
pinyin: Yǔqī tóujī qǔ qiǎo, búrú jiǎo tà shíde de zuò hǎo běnzhí gōngzuò.
en: Rather than cutting corners and taking shortcuts, it's better to buckle down and do your job well.

zh: 我闻到香味。
pinyin: Wǒ wèn dào xiāng wèi.
en: I smell something fragrant.

zh: 早上我闻到了面包的香气。
pinyin: Zǎo shang wǒ wèn dào le miàn bāo de xiāng qì.
en: This morning I smelled the aroma of bread.

zh: 虽然我没看见花，但我闻到了花的香味。
pinyin: Suī rán wǒ méi kàn jiàn huā, dàn wǒ wèn dào le huā de xiāng wèi.
en: Although I didn't see the flowers, I could smell their fragrance.

zh: 他闻到了烧焦的味道，立刻跑进厨房检查。
pinyin: Tā wèn dào le shāo jiāo de wèi dào, lì kè pǎo jìn chú fáng jiǎn chá.
en: He smelled something burning and immediately ran into the kitchen to check.

zh: 这家餐厅以特色菜闻名，食客们都是闻香而至。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cān tīng yǐ tè sè cài wén míng, shí kè men dōu shì wèn xiāng ér zhì.
en: This restaurant is famous for its signature dishes, and customers come from far and wide drawn by the aroma.

zh: 老师很公平。
pinyin: Lǎoshī hěn gōngpíng.
en: The teacher is very fair.

zh: 分糖果的时候要公平。
pinyin: Fēn tángguǒ de shíhou yào gōngpíng.
en: When dividing candy, you need to be fair.

zh: 虽然他很聪明，但是考试要公平对待所有学生。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn cōngming, dànshì kǎoshì yào gōngpíng duìdài suǒyǒu xuésheng.
en: Although he's smart, the exam should treat all students fairly.

zh: 为了确保比赛公平，裁判需要严格执行规则。
pinyin: Wèile quèbǎo bǐsài gōngpíng, cáipàn xūyào yángé zhíxíng guīzé.
en: To ensure the competition is fair, the referee needs to strictly enforce the rules.

zh: 在这个项目中，只有透明的流程和公平的评估才能赢得团队信任。
pinyin: Zài zhège xiàngmù zhōng, zhǐyǒu tòumíng de liúchéng hé gōngpíng de pínggu cái néng yíngde tuánduì xìnrèn.
en: In this project, only transparent processes and fair evaluation can win the team's trust.

zh: 这个玩意很有趣。
pinyin: Zhège wányì hěn yǒuqù.
en: This thing is really fun.

zh: 小孩子喜欢玩这种玩意。
pinyin: Xiǎoháizi xǐhuān wán zhè zhǒng wányì.
en: Kids like playing with this kind of toy.

zh: 虽然这个玩意很便宜，但是质量不错。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège wányì hěn piányi, dànshi zhìliàng búcuò.
en: Although this gadget is cheap, the quality is actually pretty good.

zh: 他买了一堆电子玩意，花了不少钱。
pinyin: Tā mǎile yī duī diànzǐ wányì, huāle búshǎo qián.
en: He bought a bunch of electronic gadgets and spent quite a bit of money.

zh: 这些高科技玩意看起来复杂，其实用起来挺简单的。
pinyin: Zhèxiē gāokējì wányì kàn qǐlai fùzá, qíshí yònglai tǐng jiǎndān de.
en: These high-tech contraptions look complicated, but they're actually pretty straightforward to use.

zh: 我喜欢苹果及香蕉。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān píngguǒ jí xiāngjiāo.
en: I like apples and bananas.

zh: 妈妈和爸爸及我的哥哥都来了。
pinyin: Māma hé bàba jí wǒ de gēge dōu lái le.
en: Mom, Dad, and my older brother all came.

zh: 因为天气很冷，所以我穿上外套及围巾。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ chuān shang wàitào jí wéijīn.
en: Because the weather was cold, I put on a jacket and a scarf.

zh: 这个项目需要设计、开发及测试三个阶段。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào shèjì, kāifā jí cèshì sān ge jiēduàn.
en: This project requires three stages: design, development, and testing.

zh: 公司在提高产品质量及服务水平方面取得了显著进展。
pinyin: Gōngsī zài tígāo chǎnpǐn zhìliàng jí fúwù shuǐpíng fāngmiàn qǔdé le xiǎnzhù jìnzhǎn.
en: The company has made significant progress in improving both product quality and service standards.

zh: 我的鞋很好。
pinyin: Wǒ de xiéhěn hǎo.
en: My shoes are nice.

zh: 早上我穿上新鞋去学校。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ chuānshang xīn xiéqù xuéxiào.
en: This morning I put on my new shoes and went to school.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以我换了防水的鞋。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ wǒ huànle fánghuǐ de xiéo.
en: Because it was raining, I changed into waterproof shoes.

zh: 运动员的鞋子需要很好的支撑和舒适感。
pinyin: Yùndòngyuán de xiézi xūyào hěn hǎo de zhīchēng hé shūshì gǎn.
en: Athletes' shoes need good support and comfort.

zh: 虽然这双鞋价格不便宜，但质量和设计都值得这个价钱。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè shuāng xiéjiàgé bu biànyì, dàn zhìliàng hé shèjì dōu zhídé zhège jiàqián.
en: Although these shoes aren't cheap, the quality and design are worth the price.

zh: 狗放屁了。
pinyin: Gǒu fàng píqì le.
en: The dog farted.

zh: 他吃完豆子以后放了很多屁。
pinyin: Tā chīwán dòuzi yǐhòu fàngle hěnduō píqì.
en: After he finished eating beans, he farted a lot.

zh: 虽然他放屁很臭，但是大家都笑了。
pinyin: Suīrán tā fàng píqì hěn chòu, dànshì dàjiā dōu xiàole.
en: Even though his fart smelled really bad, everyone laughed.

zh: 他在会议上突然放屁，这让他感到很尴尬。
pinyin: Tā zài huìyì shàng túrán fàng píqì, zhè ràng tā gǎndào hěn gānggà.
en: He suddenly farted during the meeting, which made him feel very embarrassed.

zh: 与其在那儿放屁抱怨，不如起来做点有用的事。
pinyin: Yǔqī zài nàr fàng píqì bàoyuàn, búrú qǐlái zuò diǎn yǒuyòng de shì.
en: Rather than sitting around complaining, you might as well get up and do something useful.

zh: 我盯着球。
pinyin: Wǒ盯zháo qiú.
en: I'm staring at the ball.

zh: 他一直盯着手机看。
pinyin: Tā yìzhí盯zháo shǒujī kàn.
en: He keeps staring at his phone.

zh: 因为很紧张，她盯着老师的眼睛。
pinyin: Yīnwèi hěn jǐnzhāng, tā盯zháo lǎoshī de yǎnjing.
en: Because she was nervous, she stared directly into the teacher's eyes.

zh: 经理盯着销售数据，担心这个月的目标完不成。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ盯zháo xiāoshòu shùjù, dānxin zhège yuè de mùbiāo wán bu chéng.
en: The manager stared at the sales figures, worried they wouldn't hit this month's target.

zh: 投资者们盯着股票行情，生怕错过任何机会。
pinyin: Tóuzizhězhě men盯zháo gǔpiào xíngqing, shēngpà cuòguò rènhé jīhuì.
en: The investors kept their eyes glued to the stock market, terrified of missing any opportunity.

zh: 花自然很漂亮。
pinyin: Huā zìránhěn piàoliàng.
en: Flowers are naturally beautiful.

zh: 下雨的时候，我自然待在家里。
pinyin: Xiàyǔ de shíhou, wǒ zìrán dāizài jiālǐ.
en: When it rains, I naturally stay at home.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但他自然想帮助朋友。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn tā zìrán xiǎng bāngzhù péngyou.
en: Although he's busy, he naturally wants to help his friends.

zh: 在自然的环境里，孩子们学得更快。
pinyin: Zài zìrán de huanjìng lǐ, háizimen xué de gèng kuài.
en: In a natural environment, children learn much faster.

zh: 与其刻意表现，不如自然地展现自己的优点。
pinyin: Yǔqī kèyì biǎoxiàn, búrú zìránde zhǎnxiàn zìjǐ de yōudiǎn.
en: Rather than put on an act, it's better to naturally show off your strengths.

zh: 桌子上有一堆书。
pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu yī duī shū.
en: There's a pile of books on the table.

zh: 昨天我堆了很多雪。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ duīle hěnduō xuě.
en: Yesterday I piled up a lot of snow.

zh: 虽然地上有一堆垃圾，但是我们还是要打扫干净。
pinyin: Suīrán dì shàng yǒu yī duī lājī, dànshì wǒmen háishi yào dǎsǎo gānjìng.
en: Even though there's a heap of trash on the ground, we still need to clean it up.

zh: 他工作很忙，办公桌上堆满了各种文件和邮件。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò hěn máng, bàngōngzhuō shàng duīmǎnle gèzhǒng wénjiàn hé yóujiàn.
en: He's very busy at work, and his desk is piled high with all kinds of documents and emails.

zh: 这个项目还有一大堆问题需要解决，但团队决心要在期限前完成。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù háiyǒu yī dà duī wèntí xūyào jiějué, dàn tuánduì juéxīn yào zài qīxiàn qián wánchéng.
en: This project still has a heap of issues to resolve, but the team is determined to finish before the deadline.

zh: 我喜欢历史。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān lìshǐ.
en: I like history.

zh: 他在学校学习历史和地理。
pinyin: Tā zài xuéxiào xuéxí lìshǐ hé dìlǐ.
en: He studies history and geography at school.

zh: 虽然历史很复杂，但是了解历史很重要。
pinyin: Suīrán lìshǐ hěn fùzá, dànshì liǎojiě lìshǐ hěn zhòngyào.
en: Although history is complicated, understanding it is really important.

zh: 这个博物馆展示了很多关于中国历史的文物。
pinyin: Zhège bówùguǎn zhǎnshìle hěnduō guānyú Zhōngguó lìshǐ de wénwù.
en: This museum displays many cultural relics related to Chinese history.

zh: 要想理解现在，就必须学习历史，因为历史往往重演。
pinyin: Yào xiǎng lǐjiě xiànzài, jiù bìxū xuéxí lìshǐ, yīnwèi lìshǐ wǎngwǎng chóngyǎn.
en: To understand the present, you have to study history, because history tends to repeat itself.

zh: 这个井很深。
pinyin: Zhège jǐng hěn shēn.
en: This well is very deep.

zh: 晚上的时候，天色很深了。
pinyin: Wǎnshang de shíhou, tiānséè hěn shēn le.
en: By evening, it had gotten quite dark.

zh: 虽然他们才认识一个月，但是感情已经很深了。
pinyin: Suīrán tāmen cái rènshi yī ge yuè, dànshi gǎnqíng yǐjīng hěn shēn le.
en: Although they've only known each other for a month, their bond has already become quite deep.

zh: 他对传统文化的理解很深，经常在课堂上给我们讲解。
pinyin: Tā duì chuántǒng wénhuà de lǐjiě hěn shēn, jīngcháng zài kètáng shang gěi wǒmen jiǎngjiě.
en: His understanding of traditional culture runs deep, and he often explains it to us in class.

zh: 这个问题涉及很深的哲学思想，不是三言两语就能说清楚的。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí shèjí hěn shēn de zhéxué sīxiǎng, búshì sān yán liǎng yǔ jiù néng shuōqīngchu de.
en: This question touches on profound philosophical concepts—it can't be explained in just a few words.

zh: 我去取水。
pinyin: Wǒ qù qǔ shuǐ.
en: I'm going to get some water.

zh: 早上我从冰箱里取出牛奶。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ cóng bīngxiāng lǐ qǔchū niúnǎi.
en: In the morning I take the milk out of the fridge.

zh: 因为明天要用，所以我今天去银行取钱。
pinyin: Yīnwèi míngtiān yào yòng, suǒyǐ wǒ jīntiān qù yínháng qǔ qián.
en: Since I need it tomorrow, I'm going to the bank today to withdraw money.

zh: 他决定取消这个计划，虽然已经花了很多时间准备。
pinyin: Tā juédìng qǔxiāo zhège jìhuà, suīránǐ yǐjīng huāle hěnduō shíjiān zhǔnbèi.
en: He decided to cancel this plan, even though he'd already spent a lot of time preparing.

zh: 这个策略的成功取决于我们能否有效地沟通和协调。
pinyin: Zhège cèlüè de chénggōng qǔjuéyú wǒmen néngfǒu yǒuxiào de gōutōng hé xiétiáo.
en: The success of this strategy depends on whether we can communicate and coordinate effectively.

zh: 这是法庭。
pinyin: Zhè shì fǎtíng.
en: This is a courtroom.

zh: 明天我要去法庭。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào qù fǎtíng.
en: Tomorrow I have to go to the courtroom.

zh: 因为他犯了错误，所以他在法庭上被审判了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā fànle cuòwù, suǒyǐ tā zài fǎtíng shàng bèi shěnpàn le.
en: Because he made a mistake, he was tried in court.

zh: 律师在法庭上为被告人辩护，虽然证据不足。
pinyin: Lǜshī zài fǎtíng shàng wèi bèigàorén biànhù, suīrán zhèngjù búzú.
en: The lawyer defended the defendant in court, even though the evidence was insufficient.

zh: 这个案件经过法庭的仔细审理，最终判决结果令双方都不太满意。
pinyin: Zhège ànjiàn jīngguò fǎtíng de zǐxì shěnlǐ, zuìzhōng pàngjué jiéguǒ lìng shuāngfāng dōu búduō mǎnyì.
en: After careful examination by the court, the final verdict left both sides somewhat dissatisfied.

zh: 我在俱乐部打球。
pinyin: Wǒ zài jùlèbù dǎ qiú.
en: I play ball at the club.

zh: 他每周去俱乐部运动两次。
pinyin: Tā měi zhōu qù jùlèbù yùndòng liǎng cì.
en: He exercises at the club twice a week.

zh: 因为俱乐部的设施很好，所以很多人都去。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jùlèbù de shèshī hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén dōu qù.
en: Because the club has great facilities, lots of people go there.

zh: 虽然俱乐部的会费不便宜，但会员还是越来越多。
pinyin: Suīrán jùlèbù de huìfèi búbiànyí, dàn huìyuán háishi yuèláiyuè duō.
en: Although the club membership fees aren't cheap, the number of members keeps growing.

zh: 这家俱乐部通过组织各种活动来吸引不同年龄的会员。
pinyin: Zhè jiā jùlèbù tōngguò zǔzhī gèzhǒng huódòng lái xīyǐn búyī niánlìng de huìyuán.
en: This club attracts members of different ages by organizing various activities.

zh: 我通常吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ tōngcháng chī mǐfàn.
en: I usually eat rice.

zh: 她通常早上七点起床。
pinyin: Tā tōngcháng zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng.
en: She usually gets up at seven in the morning.

zh: 虽然天气冷，但是我们通常还是去公园。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì lěng, búshì wǒmen tōngcháng háishi qù gōngyuán.
en: Even though it's cold outside, we usually still go to the park.

zh: 因为工作很忙，他通常没有时间陪家人。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò hěn máng, tā tōngcháng méiyǒu shíjiān péi jiārén.
en: Because his work is demanding, he usually doesn't have time to spend with his family.

zh: 新产品上市的前几周通常会吸引大量消费者购买。
pinyin: Xīn chǎnpǐn shàngshì de qián jǐ zhōu tōngcháng huì xīyǐn dàliàng xiāofèizhě gòumǎi.
en: In the first few weeks after a new product launches, it typically attracts a large number of consumers to buy it.

zh: 医生拯救了他的生命。
pinyin: Yīshēng zhěngjiù le tā de shēngmìng.
en: The doctor saved his life.

zh: 消防员昨天拯救了那只小猫。
pinyin: Xiāofángduì yuán zuótiān zhěngjiù le nà zhī xiǎo māo.
en: The firefighter rescued that kitten yesterday.

zh: 虽然很危险，但警察还是拯救了被困的人。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn wēixiǎn, dàn jǐngchá háishi zhěngjiù le bèi kùn de rén.
en: Although it was very dangerous, the police officer still managed to rescue the trapped people.

zh: 这个新技术可以拯救许多患有心脏病的患者。
pinyin: Zhège xīn jìshù kěyǐ zhěngjiù xǔduō huànyǒu xīnzàngbìng de huànzhě.
en: This new technology can save many patients who suffer from heart disease.

zh: 经济学家认为只有改革才能拯救这个陷入困境的国家。
pinyin: Jīngjìxuéjiā rènwéi zhǐyǒu gǎigé cáinéng zhěngjiù zhège xiànrù kùnjìng de guójiā.
en: Economists believe that only reform can save this country that has fallen into crisis.

zh: 我差点摔倒。
pinyin: Wǒ chàdiǎn shuāidào.
en: I almost fell.

zh: 昨天我差点迟到了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ chàdiǎn chídào le.
en: I almost arrived late yesterday.

zh: 因为堵车，我差点赶不上飞机。
pinyin: Yīnwèi dǔchē, wǒ chàdiǎn gǎnbushàng fēijī.
en: Because of traffic, I almost missed my flight.

zh: 他在演讲时差点说漏嘴，幸好及时止住了。
pinyin: Tā zài yǎnjiǎng shí chàdiǎn shuōlòu zuǐ, xìnghǎo jíshí zhǐzhù le.
en: He almost let something slip during his speech, but fortunately caught himself in time.

zh: 这个项目差点因为资金问题而搁浅，多亏了投资者的支持。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù chàdiǎn yīnwèi zījīn wèntí ér gēqiàn, duōkuī le tóuzīzhě de zhīchí.
en: This project almost fell through due to funding issues, but fortunately the investors came through.

zh: 我喝啤酒。
pinyin: Wǒ hē píjiǔ.
en: I drink beer.

zh: 他每天晚上喝啤酒。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān wǎnshang hē píjiǔ.
en: He drinks beer every evening.

zh: 因为天气很热，所以我想喝冷的啤酒。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn rè, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng hē lěng de píjiǔ.
en: Because the weather is hot, I want to drink cold beer.

zh: 朋友们聚在一起的时候，总是喜欢喝啤酒。
pinyin: Péngyou men jù zài yīqǐ de shíhou, zǒngshì xǐhuān hē píjiǔ.
en: Whenever friends get together, they always like to have beer.

zh: 虽然啤酒很便宜，但是品质好的啤酒需要时间慢慢品尝。
pinyin: Suīrán píjiǔ hěn piányí, dànshì pǐnzhì hǎo de píjiǔ xūyào shíjiān màn man pǐnncháng.
en: Although beer is affordable, really good beer takes time to savor properly.

zh: 狗咬我的手。
pinyin: Gǒu yǎo wǒ de shǒu.
en: The dog bit my hand.

zh: 我昨天吃苹果的时候咬到了牙。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān chī píngguǒ de shíhou yǎodào le yá.
en: I accidentally bit my tooth while eating an apple yesterday.

zh: 因为他很生气，所以咬着牙说话。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn shēngqì, suǒyǐ yǎozhe yá shuōhuà.
en: Because he was very angry, he spoke through gritted teeth.

zh: 蚊子咬了我的腿，现在痒得要命。
pinyin: Wénzi yǎo le wǒ de tuǐ, xiànzài yǎng de yàomìng.
en: A mosquito bit my leg, and now it's unbearably itchy.

zh: 他紧咬着嘴唇，似乎在隐忍什么秘密。
pinyin: Tā jǐnyǎozhe zuǐchún, sìhū zài yǐnrěn shénme mìmì.
en: He clenched his lip tightly, seemingly holding back some secret.

zh: 这条裤子太短了。
pinyin: Zhè tiáo kùzi tài duǎn le.
en: These pants are too short.

zh: 他的头发很短，看起来很整洁。
pinyin: Tā de tóufa hěn duǎn, kàn qǐlái hěn zhěngjié.
en: His hair is short and looks very neat.

zh: 虽然这个电影只有一个小时，但是故事很有意思。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège diànyǐng zhǐyǒu yī ge xiǎoshí, dànshi gùshi hěn yǒu yìsi.
en: Although the film is only an hour long, the story is really interesting.

zh: 因为时间短，我们只能快速地看了一遍重要的部分。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shíjiān duǎn, wǒmen zhǐnéng kuàisù de kàn le yī biàn zhòngyào de bùfen.
en: Because time was limited, we could only quickly go through the important parts once.

zh: 这个项目的周期很短，但我们必须在短时间内完成高质量的工作。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de zhōuqī hěn duǎn, dàn wǒmen bìxū zài duǎn shíjiān nèi wánchéng gāo zhìliàng de gōngzuò.
en: This project has a tight timeline, but we have to deliver high-quality work in a short span.

zh: 地球很大。
pinyin: Dìqiú hěn dà.
en: The Earth is very big.

zh: 我们都住在地球上。
pinyin: Wǒmen dōu zhù zài dìqiú shang.
en: We all live on Earth.

zh: 因为地球变暖，所以冰川在融化。
pinyin: Yīnwèi dìqiú biàn nuǎn, suǒyǐ bīngchuān zài rónghuà.
en: Because the Earth is warming, glaciers are melting.

zh: 科学家研究地球气候变化已经很多年了。
pinyin: Kēxuéjiā yánjiū dìqiú qìhòu biànhuà yǐjīng hěn duō nián le.
en: Scientists have been studying Earth's climate change for many years.

zh: 保护地球环境是每个人的责任，不能掉以轻心。
pinyin: Bǎohù dìqiú huánjìng shì měi ge rén de zérèn, búnéng diàoyǐ qīngxīn.
en: Protecting Earth's environment is everyone's responsibility—we can't take it lightly.

zh: 我的裤子很紧。
pinyin: Wǒ de kùzi hěn jǐn.
en: My pants are too tight.

zh: 时间很紧，我们要快一点。
pinyin: Shíjiān hěn jǐn, wǒmen yào kuài yīdiǎn.
en: We're short on time, so we need to hurry.

zh: 虽然工作很紧张，但是他还是坚持运动。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn jǐnzhāng, dànshì tā háishi jiānchí yùndòng.
en: Although his work schedule is tight, he still makes time to exercise.

zh: 因为预算紧张，公司决定延后招聘新员工。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yùsuàn jǐnzhāng, gōngsī juéding yánhòu zhāopìn xīn yuángōng.
en: Because the budget is tight, the company decided to postpone hiring new staff.

zh: 随着竞争日益激烈，各个行业的利润都紧跟着下降。
pinyin: Suízhe jìngjìng rìyì jīliè, gège hángyè de lìrùn dōu jǐnsuí zhe xiàjiàng.
en: As competition intensifies, profit margins across industries are steadily declining.

zh: 玻璃很透。
pinyin: Bōli hěn tòu.
en: The glass is very clear.

zh: 早上的阳光透进房间。
pinyin: Zǎoshang de yángguāng tòujìn fángjiān.
en: The morning sunlight comes through into the room.

zh: 虽然窗帘很厚，但阳光还是透过来了。
pinyin: Suīrán chuāngliè hěn hòu, dànshi yángguāng háishi tòuguòlái le.
en: Even though the curtains are thick, the sunlight still seeps through.

zh: 他把想法透露给了我们，我们才明白他的真实意图。
pinyin: Tā bǎ xiǎngfǎ tòulù gěi le wǒmen, wǒmen cái míngbai tā de zhēnshí yìtú.
en: He revealed his thoughts to us, and only then did we understand his real intentions.

zh: 这份报告字里行间透露出管理层对未来的担忧。
pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào zìlǐ xíngjiān tòulù chūlái guǎnlǐcéng duì wèilái de dānxīn.
en: This report subtly conveys management's concerns about the future between the lines.

zh: 受害者很害怕。
pinyin: Shòu害zhě hěn hàipà.
en: The victim was very scared.

zh: 警察帮助了受害者。
pinyin: Jǐngchá bāngzhù le shòuhaìzhě.
en: The police helped the victim.

zh: 因为发生了事故，受害者在医院里。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fāshēng le shìgù, shòuhaìzhě zài yīyuàn lǐ.
en: Because an accident happened, the victim is in the hospital.

zh: 虽然时间过了很久，但受害者仍然记得那天。
pinyin: Suīrán shíjiān guò le hěn jiǔ, dàn shòuhaìzhě réngránjiì de nà tiān.
en: Even though a long time has passed, the victim still remembers that day.

zh: 法院判决要求被告向受害者赔偿所有的医疗费用。
pinyin: Fǎyuàn pànjué yāoqiú bèi gàoqì xiàng shòuhaìzhě peichángsuǒyǒu de yīliào fèiyòng.
en: The court ruled that the defendant must compensate the victim for all medical expenses.

zh: 我有力气。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu lìqi.
en: I'm strong.

zh: 他很用力地推门。
pinyin: Tā hěn yònglì de tuīmén.
en: He pushed the door with a lot of force.

zh: 因为她每天运动，所以力气很大。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā měitiān yùndòng, suǒyǐ lìqi hěn dà.
en: Because she exercises every day, she's become very strong.

zh: 虽然他年纪大了，但工作的时候还是很有力气。
pinyin: Suīrán tā niánjì dà le, dàn gōngzuò de shíhou háishi hěn yǒu lìqi.
en: Although he's older, he still has a lot of strength when he works.

zh: 这家公司的竞争力强，主要是因为团队合力开发了新产品。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de jìngzhēng lì qiáng, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi tuánduì héli kāifā le xīn chǎnpǐn.
en: This company has strong competitiveness, mainly because the team worked together to develop a new product.

zh: 这个主意很愚蠢。
pinyin: Zhège zhǔyì hěn yúchǔn.
en: That idea is really stupid.

zh: 他做了一个很愚蠢的决定。
pinyin: Tā zuòle yīge hěn yúchǔn de juéding.
en: He made a very foolish decision.

zh: 虽然他很聪明，但有时候做愚蠢的事。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn cōngmíng, dàn yǒushíhou zuò yúchǔn de shì.
en: Although he's smart, he sometimes does dumb things.

zh: 因为他的愚蠢行为，整个计划都失败了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tāde yúchǔn xíngwéi, zhěnggè jìhuà dōu shībàile.
en: Because of his foolish actions, the whole plan fell through.

zh: 与其说他愚蠢，不如说他太固执，听不进别人的建议。
pinyin: Yǔqī shuō tā yúchǔn, búrú shuō tā tài gùzhí, tīngbu進别rén de jiànyì.
en: Rather than calling him stupid, it's more accurate to say he's stubborn and won't listen to anyone's advice.

zh: 这是一个炸弹。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè zhàdàn.
en: This is a bomb.

zh: 警察找到了一个炸弹。
pinyin: Jǐngchá zhǎodàole yī gè zhàdàn.
en: The police found a bomb.

zh: 因为有炸弹，所以他们关闭了火车站。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu zhàdàn, suǒyǐ tāmen guānbìle huǒchēzhàn.
en: Because there was a bomb, they closed the train station.

zh: 新闻说昨天在城市中心发现了一个炸弹。
pinyin: Xīnwén shuō zuótiān zài chéngshì zhōngxīn fāxiànle yī gè zhàdàn.
en: The news reported that a bomb was discovered in the city center yesterday.

zh: 虽然排弹队成功拆除了炸弹，但整个社区还是陷入了恐慌。
pinyin: Suīrán pái dàn duì chéngōng chāichúle zhàdàn, dàn zhěngge shèqū háishi xiànrùle kǒnghuang.
en: Although the bomb disposal team successfully defused the bomb, the whole neighborhood still fell into panic.

zh: 他很帅。
pinyin: Tā hěn shuài.
en: He's very handsome.

zh: 那个男生又高又帅。
pinyin: Nàge nánshēng yòu gāo yòu shuài.
en: That guy is both tall and handsome.

zh: 虽然他很帅，但是他不太爱说话。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn shuài, dànshì tā búzhào ài shuōhuà.
en: Although he's good-looking, he doesn't really like to talk much.

zh: 她喜欢那个帅气的演员，因为他不仅外表帅还很有才华。
pinyin: Tā xǐhuān nàge shuàiqì de yǎnyuán, yīnwèi tā bújǐn wàibiǎo shuài háishi hěn yǒu cáihuà.
en: She likes that handsome actor because he's not only good-looking but also very talented.

zh: 别被他帅气的外表迷惑了，工作能力才是最重要的。
pinyin: Biébèi tā shuàiqì de wàibiǎo míhuò le, gōngzuò nénglik cái shi zuì zhòngyào de.
en: Don't be taken in by his good looks—what really matters is his work ability.

zh: 我踢球。
pinyin: Wǒ tī qiú.
en: I kick the ball.

zh: 昨天我和朋友踢足球了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hé péngyou tī zúqiú le.
en: Yesterday I played soccer with a friend.

zh: 因为今天下雨，所以我们不能踢球。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen búnéng tī qiú.
en: Because it's raining today, we can't play ball.

zh: 他虽然腿受伤了，但还是坚持踢完了这场比赛。
pinyin: Tā suīrán tuǐ shòushāng le, dàn háishi jiānchí tī wán le zhè chǎng bǐsài.
en: Even though his leg was injured, he still insisted on finishing the match.

zh: 那个运动员在国际赛场上踢出了精彩的表现，赢得了许多球迷的尊重。
pinyin: Nàge yùndòng yuán zài guójì saìchǎng shang tī chūle jīngcǎi de biǎoxiàn, yíng de le xǔduō qiú mí de zūnjìng.
en: That athlete put on a brilliant performance on the international stage and earned respect from many fans.

zh: 美国是联邦。
pinyin: Měiguó shì liánbāng.
en: The United States is a federation.

zh: 联邦有很多州。
pinyin: Liánbāng yǒu hěnduō zhōu.
en: A federation has many states.

zh: 因为每个州都独立，所以需要联邦来管理。
pinyin: Yīnwèi měi ge zhōu dōu dúlì, suǒyǐ xūyào liánbāng lái guǎnlǐ.
en: Because each state is independent, a federation is needed to manage them.

zh: 虽然联邦政府很强大，但各州仍然保有自己的权力。
pinyin: Suīrán liánbāng zhèngfǔ hěn qiángdà, dàn gè zhōu réngrán bǎoyǒu zìjǐ de quánlì.
en: Although the federal government is powerful, each state still retains its own authority.

zh: 联邦制度的核心在于中央与地方权力的平衡。
pinyin: Liánbāng zhìdù de héxīn zàiyú zhōngyāng yǔ dìfang quánlì de pínghuà.
en: The core of the federal system lies in balancing power between the central government and local authorities.

zh: 评委在看比赛。
pinyin: Píngwěi zài kàn bǐsài.
en: The judges are watching the competition.

zh: 今天有五个评委给我们打分。
pinyin: Jīntiān yǒu wǔ ge píngwěi gěi wǒmen dǎfēn.
en: There are five judges scoring us today.

zh: 虽然评委很严格，但是他们很公平。
pinyin: Suīrán píngwěi hěn yángé, dànshì tāmen hěn gōngpíng.
en: Although the judges are strict, they're fair.

zh: 因为评委来自不同的背景，所以评分的标准有时会不一样。
pinyin: Yīnwèi píngwěi láizì búntóng de bèijǐng, suǒyǐ píngfēn de biāozhǔn yǒushí huì búyīyàng.
en: Because the judges come from different backgrounds, their scoring standards sometimes vary.

zh: 这次比赛的评委阵容很强大，包括几位业界资深人士。
pinyin: Zhè cì bǐsài de píngwěi zhènróng hěn qiángdà, bāokuò jǐ wèi yèjiè zīshēn rénshì.
en: The judging panel for this competition is impressive, including several industry veterans.

zh: 不用客气，请吃饭。
pinyin: Búyòng kèqì, qǐng chīfàn.
en: Don't be polite—please have some food.

zh: 他很客气，总是说谢谢你。
pinyin: Tā hěn kèqì, zǒngshì shuō xièxiè nǐ.
en: He's very polite and always says thank you.

zh: 虽然我们第一次见面，但他一点也不客气。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen dì yī cì jiànmiàn, dàn tā yīdiǎn yě búkèqì.
en: Even though it was our first time meeting, he wasn't the least bit awkward with us.

zh: 在家人面前你不需要那么客气，放松一点。
pinyin: Zài jiārén miànqián nǐ búxūyào nàme kèqì, fàngsōng yīdiǎn.
en: You don't need to be so formal around family—just relax.

zh: 他虽然身份特殊，但为人很随和，从不跟人客气。
pinyin: Tā suīrán shēnfèn tèshū, dàn wéirén hěn suíhé, cóngbù gēn rén kèqì.
en: Despite his special status, he's easygoing by nature and never stands on ceremony with anyone.

zh: 雨造成了问题。
pinyin: Yǔ zàochéngle wèntí.
en: The rain caused a problem.

zh: 昨天的事故造成了很大麻烦。
pinyin: Zuótiān de shìgù zàochéngle hěn dà máfan.
en: Yesterday's accident created a lot of trouble.

zh: 因为他迟到了，所以造成了会议延迟。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā chídào le, suǒyǐ zàochéngle huìyì yánchí.
en: Because he arrived late, it caused the meeting to be postponed.

zh: 这个政策虽然初衷很好，但造成了一些负面影响。
pinyin: Zhège zhèngcè suīrán chūzhōng hěn hǎo, dàn zàochéngle yīxiē fùmiàn yǐngxiǎng.
en: Although this policy had good intentions, it ended up having some negative effects.

zh: 长期的压力和睡眠不足造成了他身体和心理的双重问题。
pinyin: Chángqī de yālì hé shuìmián búzú zàochéngle tā shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ de shuāngzhòng wèntí.
en: The long-term stress and lack of sleep caused him both physical and psychological problems.

zh: 我经过学校。
pinyin: Wǒ jīngguò xuéxiào.
en: I pass by the school.

zh: 她每天经过这家店。
pinyin: Tā měitiān jīngguò zhè jiā diàn.
en: She passes this shop every day.

zh: 虽然经过很多困难，但是他坚持了。
pinyin: Suīrán jīngguò hěnduō kùnnan, dànshì tā jiānchíle.
en: Although he went through many difficulties, he persisted.

zh: 经过医生的治疗，他的病情已经好多了。
pinyin: Jīngguò yīshēng de zhìliáo, tā de bìngqíng yǐjīng hǎo duōle.
en: After undergoing treatment from the doctor, his condition has improved significantly.

zh: 这个项目经过反复讨论和修改，才最终获得了批准。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù jīngguò fǎnfù tǎolùn hé xiūgǎi, cái zuìzhōng huòdéle pīzhǔn.
en: After repeated discussion and revision, the project finally received approval.

zh: 我周末喜欢睡觉。
pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò xǐhuān shuìjiào.
en: I like to sleep in on weekends.

zh: 周末我和家人一起吃饭。
pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ hé jiārén yīqǐ chīfàn.
en: On weekends, I eat together with my family.

zh: 因为周末没有课，所以我可以休息。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhōumò méiyǒu kè, suǒyǐ wǒ kěyǐ xiūxi.
en: Because there are no classes on weekends, I can relax.

zh: 虽然周末很忙，但我还是喜欢和朋友一起运动。
pinyin: Suīrán zhōumò hěn máng, dàn wǒ háishi xǐhuān hé péngyou yīqǐ yùndòng.
en: Even though weekends are busy, I still enjoy exercising with friends.

zh: 为了保持健康，我利用周末的时间坚持锻炼身体。
pinyin: Wèile bǎochí jiànkāng, wǒ lìyòng zhōumò de shíjiān jiānchí duànliàn shēntǐ.
en: To stay healthy, I make use of my weekend time to stick with exercising regularly.

zh: 天上有很多星。
pinyin: Tiānshang yǒu hěnduō xīng.
en: There are many stars in the sky.

zh: 晚上我看到了一颗很亮的星。
pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒ kàndàole yī kē hěn liàng de xīng.
en: Last night I saw a very bright star.

zh: 因为天气晴朗，所以我们看到了很多星星。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì qīngláng, suǒyǐ wǒmen kàndàole hěnduō xīngxing.
en: Because the weather was clear, we could see lots of stars.

zh: 虽然城市里光污染很严重，但我们还是能看到几颗星。
pinyin: Suīrán chéngshì lǐ guāng wūrǎn hěn yánzhòng, dàn wǒmen háishi néng kàndào jǐ kē xīng.
en: Although there's serious light pollution in the city, we can still see a few stars.

zh: 他从小就对天文学感兴趣，经常在夜里观察星座和行星的位置。
pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù duì tiānwénxué gǎn xìngqùnèi, jīngcháng zài yèlǐ guānchá xīngzuò hé xíngxīng de wèizhì.
en: He's been interested in astronomy since childhood and often observes the positions of constellations and planets at night.

zh: 红色信号灯亮了。
pinyin: Hóngsè xìnhào děng liàng le.
en: The red signal light is on.

zh: 司机看到绿色信号就开车了。
pinyin: Sījī kàndào lǜsè xìnhào jiù kāichē le.
en: The driver started driving as soon as he saw the green signal.

zh: 虽然信号不太好，但我们还是能通话。
pinyin: Suīrán xìnhào búTài hǎo, dànshì wǒmen háishi néng tōnghuà.
en: Although the signal isn't great, we can still have a conversation.

zh: 手机信号弱的时候，网络速度会变得特别慢。
pinyin: Shǒujī xìnhào ruò de shíhou, wǎngluò sùdù huì biàn de tèbié màn.
en: When your phone signal is weak, your internet speed becomes especially slow.

zh: 这个地方信号覆盖不足，导致很多游客无法及时联系家人。
pinyin: Zhège dìfang xìnhào fùgài búzú, dǎozhì hěnduō yóukè wúfǎ jíshí liánxì jiārén.
en: Signal coverage in this area is insufficient, which prevents many tourists from reaching their families in time.

zh: 警察跟踪小偷。
pinyin: Jǐngchá gēnzōng xiǎotōu.
en: The police officer is tracking the thief.

zh: 我昨天跟踪了那只猫。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān gēnzōngle nà zhī māo.
en: I followed that cat yesterday.

zh: 因为他偷了东西，所以警察决定跟踪他。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā tōule dōngxi, suǒyǐ jǐngchá juédìng gēnzōng tā.
en: Because he stole something, the police decided to track him.

zh: 公司雇佣调查员跟踪竞争对手的商业活动。
pinyin: Gōngsī gùyōng tiáochákeyuán gēnzōng jìngjìng duìshǒu de shāngyè huódòng.
en: The company hired an investigator to monitor its competitors' business activities.

zh: 警方通过GPS设备跟踪嫌疑人的行动，最终掌握了关键证据。
pinyin: Jǐngfāng tōngguò GPS shèbèi gēnzōng xiányírén de xíngdòng, zuìzh终 zhǎngwòle guānjiàn zhèngjù.
en: The police tracked the suspect's movements using GPS, ultimately gathering key evidence.

zh: 我推门进去。
pinyin: Wǒ tuī mén jìnqu.
en: I pushed the door open and went in.

zh: 他用手推了我一下。
pinyin: Tā yòng shǒu tuīle wǒ yīxià.
en: He gave me a push with his hand.

zh: 因为人太多，我被推到了后面。
pinyin: Yīnwèi rén tài duō, wǒ bèi tuīdàole hòumiàn.
en: Because there were so many people, I got pushed to the back.

zh: 他推荐了一家不错的餐厅给我们。
pinyin: Tā tuījiànyile yī jiā búcuò de cāntīng gěi wǒmen.
en: He recommended a really good restaurant to us.

zh: 公司推出新产品的时候，市场反应相当热烈。
pinyin: Gōngsī tuīchūle xīn chǎnpǐn de shíhou, shìchǎng fǎnyìng xiāngdāng règuàn.
en: When the company launched its new product, the market response was quite enthusiastic.

zh: 我喝酒。
pinyin: Wǒ hējiǔ.
en: I'm drinking alcohol.

zh: 昨天晚上我和朋友喝酒了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ hé péngyou hējiǔ le.
en: Last night I had drinks with my friends.

zh: 因为今天是生日，所以我们一起喝酒庆祝。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān shì shēngrì, suǒyǐ wǒmen yìqǐ hējiǔ qìngzhù.
en: Because it's my birthday today, we're drinking together to celebrate.

zh: 他虽然喝酒了很多，但是还是很清楚自己在做什么。
pinyin: Tā suīrán hējiǔ le hěnduō, dànshì háishi hěn qīngchu zìjǐ zài zuò shénme.
en: Even though he drank a lot, he's still very aware of what he's doing.

zh: 在中国文化里，喝酒经常和社交、谈生意有关联。
pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó wénhuà lǐ, hējiǔ jīngcháng hé shèjiāo, tán shēngyì yǒu guānlián.
en: In Chinese culture, drinking is often connected to socializing and doing business deals.

zh: 关键是要吃饭。
pinyin: Guānjiàn shì yào chīfàn.
en: The important thing is to eat.

zh: 学习的关键是每天都要练习。
pinyin: Xuéxí de guānjiàn shì měitiān dōu yào liànxí.
en: The key to learning is practicing every day.

zh: 虽然很难，但是关键是不要放弃你的梦想。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dànshì guānjiàn shì búyào fàngqì nǐ de梦想.
en: Although it's hard, the important thing is not to give up on your dreams.

zh: 这个项目成功的关键在于团队的沟通和合作。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù chénggōng de guānjiàn zàiyú tuánduì de gōutōng hé hézuò.
en: The key to this project's success lies in the team's communication and cooperation.

zh: 面试中关键不是你说了什么，而是你如何展现自己的能力。
pinyin: Miànshì zhōng guānjiàn búshì nǐ shuōle shénme, érshì nǐ rúhé zhǎnxiàn zìjǐ de nénglik.
en: In an interview, the key isn't what you say, but how you demonstrate your abilities.

zh: 下次我吃米饭。
pinyin: Xiàcì wǒ chī mǐfàn.
en: Next time I'll eat rice.

zh: 下次你来我家吃饭吧。
pinyin: Xiàcì nǐ lái wǒ jiā chīfàn ba.
en: Come to my place for dinner next time, okay?

zh: 因为今天没有时间，所以下次再去公园。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān méiyǒu shíjiān, suǒyǐ xiàcì zài qù gōngyuán.
en: Since we don't have time today, let's go to the park next time.

zh: 上次聚会的时候我们讨论了计划，下次见面就可以开始执行。
pinyin: Shàngcì jùhuì de shíhou wǒmen tǎolùnle jìhuà, xiàcì jiànmiàn jiù kěyǐ kāishǐ zhíxíng.
en: When we got together last time we discussed the plan, so next time we meet we can start putting it into action.

zh: 这次的经验教训对我们很有帮助，下次遇到类似的问题就能更好地处理了。
pinyin: Zhè cì de jīngyàn jiàoxùn duì wǒmen hěn yǒu bāngzhù, xiàcì yùdào lèisì de wèntí jiù néng gèng hǎo de chǔlǐ le.
en: The lessons we learned this time have been really helpful, so next time we face a similar problem we'll be able to handle it much better.

zh: 房间充满了玩具。
pinyin: Fángjiān chōngmǎnle le wánjù.
en: The room is full of toys.

zh: 早上的教室充满了学生的声音。
pinyin: Zǎoshang de jiàoshì chōngmǎn le xuésheng de shēngyīn.
en: The classroom in the morning is full of students' voices.

zh: 因为下雨了，公园里充满了水，所以我们没去。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, gōngyuán lǐ chōngmǎn le shuǐ, suǒyǐ wǒmen méi qù.
en: Because it rained, the park was flooded with water, so we didn't go.

zh: 这个新项目让团队充满了工作的热情和动力。
pinyin: Zhège xīn xiàngmù ràng tuánduì chōngmǎn le gōngzuò de règing hé dònglì.
en: This new project filled the team with enthusiasm and motivation for the work.

zh: 尽管面临困难，他对未来的计划依然充满了信心。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn miànlín kùnnan, tā duì wèilái de jìhuà yīrán chōngmǎn le xìnxin.
en: Despite facing difficulties, he remained full of confidence about his plans for the future.

zh: 绳子断了。
pinyin: Shéngzi duàn le.
en: The rope broke.

zh: 昨天我的手机屏幕断了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ de shǒujī píngmù duàn le.
en: My phone screen cracked yesterday.

zh: 因为下雨很大，所以电断了两个小时。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ hěn dà, suǒyǐ diàn duàn le liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
en: Because it rained heavily, the power went out for two hours.

zh: 虽然他们很久没联系，但友谊并没有断。
pinyin: Suīrán tāmen hěnjiǔ méi liánxì, dàn yǒuyì bìngméiyǒu duàn.
en: Although they haven't been in touch for a long time, their friendship hasn't been broken.

zh: 他决定和前公司彻底断绝联系，重新开始新生活。
pinyin: Tā juéding hé qián gōngsī chèdǐ duànjué liánxì, chóngxīn kāishǐ xīn shēnghuó.
en: He decided to completely cut ties with his former company and start a fresh life.

zh: 我喜欢苹果，其它水果也好吃。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān píngguǒ, qítā shuǐguǒ yě hǎochī.
en: I like apples, and other fruits are also tasty.

zh: 今天我买了书，其它的东西明天再买。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ mǎile shū, qítā de dōngxi míngtiān zài mǎi.
en: I bought books today, and I'll buy other things tomorrow.

zh: 虽然这个工作很好，但其它公司的工作也不错。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège gōngzuò hěn hǎo, dàn qítā gōngsī de gōngzuò yě búcuò.
en: Although this job is great, jobs at other companies are pretty good too.

zh: 除了英文课以外，其它课程我都比较喜欢上。
pinyin: Chúle Yīngwén kè yǐwài, qítā kèchéng wǒ dōu bǐjiào xǐhuān shang.
en: Apart from English class, I enjoy attending all the other courses.

zh: 与其纠结这件事，不如把精力放在其它更重要的事情上。
pinyin: Yǔqī jiūjié zhè jiàn shì, búrú bǎ jīnglì fàngzài qítā gèng zhòngyào de shìqing shang.
en: Rather than dwelling on this matter, it's better to focus your energy on other more important things.

zh: 我先吃饭，再说。
pinyin: Wǒ xiān chīfàn, zàishuō.
en: Let me eat first, and we'll talk later.

zh: 这件事明天再说吧，今天太累了。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì míngtiān zàishuō ba, jīntiān tài lèi le.
en: Let's discuss this tomorrow—I'm too tired today.

zh: 虽然很想去，但是没有钱，再说天气也不好。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn xiǎng qù, dànshì méiyǒu qián, zàishuō tiānqì yě búhǎo.
en: Although I'd love to go, I don't have money, and besides, the weather isn't nice either.

zh: 他现在还没准备好面试，再说公司的条件也不是特别好。
pinyin: Tā xiànzài háishi méi zhǔnbèi hǎo miànshì, zàishuō gōngsī de tiáojiàn yě búshì tèbié hǎo.
en: He's not ready for the interview yet, and besides, the company's terms aren't that great anyway.

zh: 这个项目风险太大，投资成本也很高，再说市场前景还不明朗，我们得再考虑考虑。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù fēngxiǎn tài dà, tóuzī chéngběn yě hěn gāo, zàishuō shìchǎng qiánjǐng háishi búmínglǎng, wǒmen děi zài kǎolǜ kǎolǜ.
en: This project is too risky, the investment costs are high, and moreover the market outlook is still unclear—we really need to think it through some more.

zh: 这个盒子是空的。
pinyin: Zhège héziǐ shì kōng de.
en: This box is empty.

zh: 早上天空很蓝，我很高兴。
pinyin: Zǎoshang tiānkōng hěn lán, wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
en: The sky was very blue this morning, and I felt happy.

zh: 因为房间很空，所以我们可以在里面跳舞。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fángjiān hěn kōng, suǒyǐ wǒmen kěyǐ zài lǐmiàn tiàowǔ.
en: Because the room is so empty, we can dance inside it.

zh: 虽然这个停车场现在是空的，但是晚上会很满。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège tíngchēchǎng xiànzài shì kōng de, búguò wǎnshang huì hěn mǎn.
en: Although the parking lot is empty right now, it'll be packed in the evening.

zh: 他整天忙于工作，却感到心里空荡荡的，好像缺少了什么。
pinyin: Tā zhěngtiān máng yú gōngzuò, què gǎndào xīnlǐ kōngdàngdàng de, háoxiàng quēshǎo le shénme.
en: He was busy with work all day, yet felt an emptiness inside, as if something were missing.

zh: 我抱着孩子。
pinyin: Wǒ báozhe háizi.
en: I'm holding the child.

zh: 妈妈早上抱起了小猫。
pinyin: Māma zǎoshang báoqǐle xiǎo māo.
en: Mom picked up the kitten this morning.

zh: 他抱着书的时候，脸上有微笑。
pinyin: Tā báozhe shū de shíhou, liǎnshang yǒu wēixiào.
en: When he held the book, there was a smile on his face.

zh: 因为太疲惫了，她只好抱怨公司的工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tài píhuì le, tā zhǐhǎo bàoyuàn gōngsī de gōngzuò.
en: Because she was so exhausted, she ended up complaining about the company's work.

zh: 别老是抱怨生活不公平，还不如主动想办法解决问题。
pinyin: Biéyáo lǎoshì bàoyuàn shēnghuó búgōngpíng, háinbùrú zhǔdòng xiǎng bànfǎ jiějué wèntí.
en: Instead of constantly complaining that life is unfair, you'd be better off actively finding ways to solve the problem.

zh: 你究竟喜欢吃什么？
pinyin: Nǐ jiūjìng xǐhuān chī什me?
en: What do you actually like to eat?

zh: 他今天究竟去了哪个地方？
pinyin: Tā jīntiān jiūjìng qù le nǎge dìfang?
en: Where did he actually go today?

zh: 虽然很难，但我究竟还是完成了这个工作。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dàn wǒ jiūjìng háishi wánchéng le zhège gōngzuò.
en: Although it was difficult, I actually managed to finish the job in the end.

zh: 经过长时间的调查，我们究竟发现了问题的真正原因。
pinyin: Jīngguò cháng shíjiān de diàochá, wǒmen jiūjìng fāxiàn le wèntí de zhēnzhèng yuányīn.
en: After a lengthy investigation, we finally discovered the real cause of the problem.

zh: 这个项目从开始到结束耗费了三年，究竟是值得的投资还是失败的决定，取决于最终的效果。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù cóng kāishǐ dào jiéshù háofèi le sān nián, jiūjìng shì zhídé de tóuzī háishi shībài de juéding, qǔjuéyú zuìzhōng de xiàoxiào.
en: This project took three years from start to finish, and whether it's ultimately a worthwhile investment or a failed decision really depends on the final results.

zh: 这是美好的一天。
pinyin: Zhè shì měihǎo de yī tiān.
en: This is a beautiful day.

zh: 我喜欢美好的周末和家人在一起。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān měihǎo de zhōumò hé jiārén zài yīqǐ.
en: I love spending beautiful weekends with my family.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但是我们仍然享受美好的时光。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì wǒmen仍然 xiǎngshòu měihǎo de shíguāng.
en: Even though work is busy, we still enjoy nice moments together.

zh: 为了拥有美好的未来，我们需要现在付出更多努力。
pinyin: Wèile yōngyǒu měihǎo de wèilái, wǒmen xūyào xiànzài付出 gèngduō nǔlì.
en: In order to have a better future, we need to work harder right now.

zh: 人们总是对美好生活充满憧憬，但往往忽略了眼前的幸福。
pinyin: Rénmen zǒngshì duì měihǎo shēnghuó chōngmǎn chōngjǐng, dàn wǎngwǎng húlüè le yǎnqián de xìngfú.
en: People are always yearning for a better life, but often overlook the happiness right in front of them.

zh: 我每天上班。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shàng bān.
en: I go to work every day.

zh: 今天我们班有二十个学生。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒmen bān yǒu èrshí ge xuésheng.
en: Our class has twenty students today.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以这班公交车晚到了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ zhè bān gōngjiāo chē wǎn dào le.
en: Because it was raining, this bus arrived late.

zh: 虽然他经常迟到，但班主任还是很耐心地教他。
pinyin: Suīrán tā jīngcháng chídào, dàn bānzhǔrèn háishi hěn nàixīn de jiāo tā.
en: Although he's often late, his homeroom teacher patiently continues to teach him.

zh: 他在这个班工作了五年，已经成为不可或缺的一员。
pinyin: Tā zài zhège bān gōngzuò le wǔ nián, yǐjīng chéngwéi búkěhuòquē de yī yuán.
en: He's been working in this team for five years and has become an indispensable member.

zh: 桌子上有一架相机。
pinyin: Zhuōzi shang yǒu yī jià xiāngjī.
en: There's a camera on the table.

zh: 我家里有一架钢琴，每天都弹。
pinyin: Wǒ jiālǐ yǒu yī jià gāngqín, měi tiān dōu tán.
en: We have a piano at home, and I play it every day.

zh: 虽然这架飞机很旧，但是飞得还是很快。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jià fēijī hěn jiù, dànshì fēi de háishi hěn kuài.
en: Although this airplane is old, it still flies pretty fast.

zh: 因为电脑坏了，我只能用这架旧笔记本工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi diànnǎo huài le, wǒ zhǐnéng yòng zhè jià jiù bǐjìběn gōngzuò.
en: Since my desktop broke, I've had to work on this old laptop instead.

zh: 他那架破自行车虽然旧，却骑了十多年从未出过问题。
pinyin: Tā nà jià pò zìxíngchē suīrán jiù, què qī le shí duō nián cóngwèi chūguò wèntí.
en: His beat-up bike is old, but he's ridden it for over ten years without any problems.

zh: 圣诞节很有名。
pinyin: Shèngdàn jié hěn yǒumíng.
en: Christmas is very famous.

zh: 我们学校有一个圣诞树。
pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào yǒu yī gè shèngdàn shù.
en: Our school has a Christmas tree.

zh: 虽然他很年轻，但是他的想法很圣洁。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn niánqīng, dànshì tā de xiǎngfǎ hěn shèngjié.
en: Although he's young, his thoughts are very pure and noble.

zh: 这位圣人因为长期做慈善工作，所以得到了很多人的尊敬。
pinyin: Zhè wèi shèngrén yīnwèi chángqī zuò císhàn gōngzuò, suǒyǐ dé到le hěnduō rén de zūnjìng.
en: Because this virtuous person has been doing charity work for a long time, he's earned the respect of many people.

zh: 他虽然出身平凡，却因为坚持道德原则而被尊为圣贤。
pinyin: Tā suīrán chūshēn píngfán, què yīnwèi jiānchí dàodé yuánnzé érběi zūnwéi shèngxián.
en: Despite his humble origins, he earned the status of a sage by steadfastly upholding moral principles.

zh: 恐怕明天会下雨。
pinyin: Kǒngpà míngtiān huì xiàyǔ.
en: I'm afraid it might rain tomorrow.

zh: 他恐怕不能来参加晚宴了。
pinyin: Tā kǒngpà búnéng lái cānjiā wǎnyàn le.
en: I'm afraid he won't be able to come to the dinner party.

zh: 因为堵车,我恐怕会迟到半小时。
pinyin: Yīnwèi dǔchē, wǒ kǒngpà huì chídào bàn xiǎoshí.
en: Because of traffic, I'm worried I'll be half an hour late.

zh: 虽然他说能完成,但我恐怕这个项目期限太紧。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shuō néng wánchéng, dàn wǒ kǒngpà zhège xiàngmù qīxiàn tài jǐn.
en: Although he says he can finish it, I'm worried the deadline for this project is too tight.

zh: 按照现在的发展速度,恐怕这笔投资很难在两年内收回成本。
pinyin: Ànzhào xiànzài de fāzhǎn sùdù, kǒngpà zhè bǐ tóuzī hěn nán zài liǎng nián nèi shōuhuí chéngběn.
en: At the current rate of development, I'm afraid this investment will struggle to break even within two years.

zh: 这个时间准吗？
pinyin: Zhège shíjiān zhǔn ma?
en: Is this time correct?

zh: 明天下午两点准时来我家。
pinyin: Míngtiān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn zhǔnshí lái wǒ jiā.
en: Come to my house tomorrow at 2 PM sharp.

zh: 虽然他说得很快，但我听得准他的意思。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shuō de hěn kuài, dàn wǒ tīng de zhǔn tā de yìsi.
en: Even though he speaks quickly, I can still understand what he means.

zh: 这份报告的数据准确吗？我们需要在提交前检查一遍。
pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào de shùjù zhǔnquè ma? Wǒmen xūyào zài tíjiāo qián jiǎnchá yī biàn.
en: Are the figures in this report accurate? We should check them once before submitting.

zh: 与其猜测，不如直接问他，这样才能准确掌握情况。
pinyin: Yǔqī cāicè, búrú zhíjiē wèn tā, zhèyàng cáinéng zhǔnquè zhǎngwò qíngkuàng.
en: Rather than guessing, it's better to ask him directly so we can get the facts straight.

zh: 孩子们抢玩具。
pinyin: háizi men qiǎng wánjù.
en: The kids are fighting over toys.

zh: 昨天超市打折，大家都抢着买东西。
pinyin: zuótiān chāoshì dǎzhé, dàjiā dōu qiǎngzhe mǎi dōngxi.
en: Yesterday the supermarket had a sale, and everyone was rushing to buy things.

zh: 因为饭菜很好吃，所以人们抢着吃，结果都没了。
pinyin: yīnwèi fàncài hěn hǎochī, suǒyǐ rénmen qiǎngzhe chī, jiéguǒ dōu méi le.
en: Because the food was so delicious, people rushed to eat it, and in the end there was nothing left.

zh: 虽然票价很贵，但是演唱会的门票还是被抢售一空。
pinyin: suīrán piàojià hěn guì, dànshì yǎnchànghui de ménpiào háishi bèi qiǎngshòu yīkōng.
en: Although ticket prices were expensive, the concert tickets were still sold out immediately.

zh: 新产品一上市就被消费者抢购，商家的库存在短短两周内就告罄了。
pinyin: xīn chǎnpǐn yī shàngshì jiù bèi xiāofèizhě qiǎnggòu, shāngjia de kùcún zài duǎnduǎn liǎng zhōu nèi jiù gàoqìng le.
en: As soon as the new product hit the market, consumers snapped it up, and the company's inventory was completely depleted within just two weeks.

zh: 我有一节课。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī jié kè.
en: I have one class.

zh: 今天下午有数学课吗？
pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ yǒu shùxué kè ma?
en: Do you have math class this afternoon?

zh: 虽然这节课很难，但是学生们都很认真。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jié kè hěn nán, dànshì xuéshēngmen dōu hěn rènzhēn.
en: Although this class is difficult, all the students are paying close attention.

zh: 因为老师病了，所以今天的课改到了明天下午。
pinyin: Yīnwèi lǎoshī bìng le, suǒyǐ jīntiān de kè gǎi dào le míngtiān xiàwǔ.
en: Because the teacher is sick, today's class has been moved to tomorrow afternoon.

zh: 他经常逃课，结果考试成绩一塌糊涂，这真是自作自受。
pinyin: Tā jīngcháng táo kè, jiéguǒ kǎoshì chéngjì yītāhútu, zhè zhēnshi zìzuòzìshòu.
en: He skips class all the time, so his exam results are a total mess—he's really brought it on himself.

zh: 我的习惯是每天吃早饭。
pinyin: Wǒ de xíguàn shì měitiān chī zǎofàn.
en: My habit is to eat breakfast every day.

zh: 她有一个好习惯，就是常常运动。
pinyin: Tā yǒu yī ge hǎo xíguàn, jiùshì chángcháng yùndòng.
en: She has a good habit, which is exercising regularly.

zh: 虽然改掉坏习惯很难，但是坚持就会成功。
pinyin: Suīrán gǎitiào huài xíguàn hěn nán, dànshì jiānchíjiù huì chénggōng.
en: Although breaking a bad habit is difficult, persisting will lead to success.

zh: 长期的好习惯能帮助我们保持身体健康和心理平衡。
pinyin: Chángqī de hǎo xíguàn néng bāngzhù wǒmen bǎochí shēntǐ jiànkāng hé xīnlǐ pínghéng.
en: Long-term good habits can help us maintain physical health and mental balance.

zh: 养成一个新习惯需要时间，但一旦形成就会深深影响我们的生活质量。
pinyin: Yǎngchéng yī ge xīn xíguàn xūyào shíjiān, dàn yīdàn xíngchéng jiù huì shēnshēn yǐngxiǎng wǒmen de shēnghuó zhìliàng.
en: Developing a new habit takes time, but once formed it will deeply affect the quality of our lives.

zh: 现实很难。
pinyin: Xiànshí hěn nán.
en: Reality is very hard.

zh: 他每天都要面对现实。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu yào miànduì xiànshí.
en: He has to face reality every day.

zh: 虽然梦想很美好，但是现实往往不同。
pinyin: Suīrán梦想hěn měihǎo, dànshì xiànshí wǎngwǎng búsame.
en: Although dreams are beautiful, reality is often different.

zh: 年轻人有时候会逃避现实，不想接受困难的挑战。
pinyin: Niánqīng rén yǒushíhou huì táobì xiànshí, búxiǎng jiēshòu kùnnan de tiǎozhàn.
en: Young people sometimes try to avoid reality because they don't want to face difficult challenges.

zh: 与其沉溺于幻想，不如勇敢地拥抱现实，为自己的未来奋斗。
pinyin: Yǔqī chénmì yú huànxiǎng, búrú yǒngǎn de yōngbào xiànshí, wèi zìjǐ de wèilái fèndòu.
en: Rather than getting lost in fantasy, it's better to courageously embrace reality and strive for your own future.

zh: 我做出了蛋糕。
pinyin: Wǒ zuòchū le dàngāo.
en: I made a cake.

zh: 昨天他做出了一个很好的决定。
pinyin: Zuótiān tā zuòchū le yīgè hěn hǎo de juéding.
en: Yesterday he made a really good decision.

zh: 虽然很困难，但他还是做出了努力去改变。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn kùnnan, dànshì tā háishi zuòchū le nǔlì qù gǎibiàn.
en: Even though it was hard, he still made the effort to change.

zh: 在压力很大的情况下，她做出了一个令人印象深刻的表现。
pinyin: Zài yālì hěn dà de qíngkuàng xià, tā zuòchū le yīgè lìngrén yìnxiàng shēnkè de biǎoxiàn.
en: Under huge pressure, she delivered an impressive performance.

zh: 面对这种复杂的局面，专家们做出了符合实际的分析和建议。
pinyin: Miànduì zhè zhǒng fùzá de júmiàn, zhuānjiā men zuòchū le fúhè shíjì de fēnxī hé jiànyì.
en: Faced with such a complex situation, the experts made practical and realistic analysis and recommendations.

zh: 我每天上班。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shàngbān.
en: I go to work every day.

zh: 他明天早上七点上班。
pinyin: Tā míngtiān zǎoshang qī diǎn shàngbān.
en: He goes to work at seven o'clock tomorrow morning.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以她今天不能上班。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ tā jīntiān búnéng shàngbān.
en: Because it's raining, she can't go to work today.

zh: 自从换了新工作以后，他上班的时间变得更早了。
pinyin: Zìcóng huàn le xīn gōngzuò yǐhòu, tā shàngbān de shíjiān biàn de gèng zǎo le.
en: Ever since he changed jobs, he's been going to work much earlier.

zh: 虽然上班很累，但是他坚持不懈，从不迟到过。
pinyin: Suīrán shàngbān hěn lèi, dànshì tā jiānchí búxié, cóngbù chídào guò.
en: Although work is exhausting, he perseveres and has never been late.

zh: 我躺在床上。
pinyin: Wǒ tǎng zài chuángshang.
en: I'm lying on the bed.

zh: 他累了，躺下休息一会儿。
pinyin: Tā lèile, tǎngxia xiūxi yīhuǐr.
en: He was tired, so he lay down to rest for a bit.

zh: 因为昨天工作很累，我今天躺了一整天。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zuótiān gōngzuò hěn lèi, wǒ jīntiān tǎngle yī zhěngtiān.
en: Because I worked hard yesterday, I spent the whole day lying in bed today.

zh: 医生建议他躺着不要动，这样能更快恢复。
pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā tǎngzhe búyào dòng, zhèyàng néng gèng kuài huīfù.
en: The doctor advised him to stay lying down without moving so he could recover faster.

zh: 与其坐着担心，他干脆躺在沙发上，决定顺其自然。
pinyin: Yǔqī zuòzhe dānxīn, tā gānzui tǎng zài shāfā shang, juéding shùnqì zìránü.
en: Rather than sit around worrying, he just lay back on the couch and decided to let things take their course.

zh: 天气越来越冷。
pinyin: Tiānqì yuèláiyuè lěng.
en: The weather is getting colder and colder.

zh: 他的中文越来越好了。
pinyin: Tā de zhōngwén yuèláiyuè hǎo le.
en: His Chinese is getting better and better.

zh: 因为每天练习，所以他的技术越来越强。
pinyin: Yīnwèi měitiān liànxí, suǒyǐ tā de jìshù yuèláiyuè qiáng.
en: Because he practices every day, his skills are becoming stronger and stronger.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但是他的生活质量越来越高。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì tā de shēnghuó zhìliàng yuèláiyuè gāo.
en: Although his work is busy, his quality of life is continuously improving.

zh: 随着科技发展，人们对隐私的关注越来越多。
pinyin: Suízhe kējì fāzhǎn, rénmen duì yǐnsi de guānzhù yuèláiyuè duō.
en: As technology advances, people are paying increasingly more attention to privacy issues.

zh: 这是一座山。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī zuò shān.
en: This is a mountain.

zh: 去年我和爸爸爬山了。
pinyin: Qùnián wǒ hé bàba páshān le.
en: Last year I went mountain climbing with my dad.

zh: 因为山很高，所以爬山的时候很累。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shān hěn gāo, suǒyǐ páshān de shíhou hěn lèi.
en: Because the mountain is so high, climbing it is really tiring.

zh: 虽然那座山海拔不算太高，但是很多游客喜欢去。
pinyin: Suīrán nà zuò shān hǎibá búsuàn tài gāo, dànshi hěnduō yóukè xǐhuān qù.
en: Although that mountain isn't particularly high in elevation, many tourists like visiting it.

zh: 住在山脚下的人们习惯了每天看着这座山。
pinyin: Zhù zài shānjiǎoxià de rénmen xíguàn le měitiān kànzhe zhè zuò shān.
en: The people living at the foot of the mountain have grown accustomed to seeing it every day.

zh: 这是名单。
pinyin: Zhè shì míngdān.
en: This is the list.

zh: 老师今天公布了名单。
pinyin: Lǎoshī jīntiān gōngbùle míngdān.
en: The teacher announced the list today.

zh: 虽然我看了名单，但是没有找到我的名字。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ kànle míngdān, dànshì méiyǒu zhǎodào wǒ de míngzi.
en: Although I looked at the list, I didn't find my name on it.

zh: 参加比赛的学生名单需要在周五之前提交。
pinyin: Cānjiā bǐsài de xuésheng míngdān xūyào zài zhōuwǔ zhīqián tíjiāo.
en: The list of students participating in the competition needs to be submitted by Friday.

zh: 这份名单包括了所有获得奖学金的候选人，名单将在下周公开。
pinyin: Zhè fèn míngdān bāokuòle suǒyǒu huòdé jiǎngxuéjīn de hòuxuǎnrén, míngdān jiāng zài xiàzhōu gōngkāi.
en: This list includes all the scholarship candidates, and it will be made public next week.

zh: 他不幸生病了。
pinyin: Tā búxìng shēngbìng le.
en: Unfortunately, he got sick.

zh: 昨天他不幸丢了钥匙。
pinyin: Zuótiān tā búxìng diūle yàoshi.
en: Yesterday he unfortunately lost his keys.

zh: 虽然他很努力，但不幸没有通过考试。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn nǔlì, dàn búxìng méiyǒu tōngguò kǎoshì.
en: Although he worked hard, sadly he didn't pass the exam.

zh: 他不幸在出差期间患上了流感，只好提前回家了。
pinyin: Tā búxìng zài chūchāi qījiān huànshàngle liúgǎn, zhǐhǎo tíqián huíjiā le.
en: He unfortunately caught the flu while on a business trip, so he had to go back home early.

zh: 这家公司不幸在经济危机中破产了，很多员工失业。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī búxìng zài jīngjì wēijī zhōng pòchǎn le, hěnduō yuángōng shīyè.
en: Unfortunately, this company went bankrupt during the economic crisis, and many employees lost their jobs.

zh: 他病好了，恢复了。
pinyin: Tā bìng hǎo le, huīfùle.
en: He got better and recovered.

zh: 休息几天以后，他恢复了精神。
pinyin: Xiūxi jǐ tiān yǐhòu, tā huīfùle jīngshén.
en: After resting for a few days, he got his energy back.

zh: 虽然受了伤，但是经过治疗他很快恢复了。
pinyin: Suīrán shòu le shāng, dànshì jīngguò zhìliáo tā hěn kuài huīfùle.
en: Although he was injured, he recovered quickly thanks to treatment.

zh: 公司遭受损失后，通过改革措施逐渐恢复了竞争力。
pinyin: Gōngsī zāoshòu sǔnshī hòu, tōngguò gǎigé cuòshī zhújiàn huīfùle jìngjìnglìlì.
en: After suffering losses, the company gradually recovered its competitive edge through reform measures.

zh: 经济危机过后，消费信心需要时间才能完全恢复。
pinyin: Jīngjì wēijī guòhòu, xiāofèi xìnxin xūyào shíjiān cáinéng wánquán huīfù.
en: After the economic crisis, it takes time for consumer confidence to fully recover.

zh: 我确认了。
pinyin: Wǒ quèrènle.
en: I confirmed it.

zh: 明天下午你能确认时间吗？
pinyin: Míngtiān xiàwǔ nǐ néng quèrèn shíjiān ma?
en: Can you confirm the time for tomorrow afternoon?

zh: 虽然他说了，但我还是想确认一下信息。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shuōle, dànshì wǒ háishi xiǎng quèrèn yīxià xìnxī.
en: Even though he told me, I still want to double-check the information.

zh: 在签合同之前，我们需要确认所有的细节都没问题。
pinyin: Zài qiān hétongtóng zhīqián, wǒmen xūyào quèrèn suǒyǒu de xìjié dōu méi wèntí.
en: Before signing the contract, we need to confirm that all the details are sorted out.

zh: 客户已经确认了订单，但由于供应链问题，交货日期可能会推迟。
pinyin: Kèhù yǐjīng quèrènle dìngdān, dànyóu yú gōngyìngliàn wèntí, jiāohuò rìqī kěnéng huì tuīchí.
en: The customer has confirmed the order, but due to supply chain issues, the delivery date may be delayed.

zh: 我们周末聚会。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhōumò jùhuì.
en: We're having a gathering this weekend.

zh: 昨天晚上我们在家聚会吃饭。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒmen zài jiā jùhuì chīfàn.
en: Last night we had a get-together at home and ate dinner.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以我们决定在公园聚会。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen juédìng zài gōngyuán jùhuì.
en: Because the weather was nice, we decided to have our gathering in the park.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但同学们还是经常聚会聊天。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn tóngxuémen háishi jīngcháng jùhuì liáotiān.
en: Although we're all busy with work, we still get together often to chat with our classmates.

zh: 每个月他们都会找个理由聚会，有时为了庆祝生日，有时就是想放松一下。
pinyin: Měi ge yuè tāmen dōu huì zhǎo ge lǐyóu jùhuì, yǒushí wèile qìngzhù shēngrì, yǒushí jiùshi xiǎng fàngsōng yīxià.
en: Every month they find some reason to get together—sometimes to celebrate a birthday, sometimes just to unwind.

zh: 她怀孕了。
pinyin: Tā huáiyùn le.
en: She is pregnant.

zh: 我妈妈现在怀孕三个月。
pinyin: Wǒ māma xiànzài huáiyùn sān ge yuè.
en: My mom is three months pregnant now.

zh: 因为她怀孕了，所以不能喝咖啡。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā huáiyùn le, suǒyǐ búnéng hē kāfēi.
en: Because she's pregnant, she can't drink coffee.

zh: 怀孕期间需要定期检查，这样可以保证母婴健康。
pinyin: Huáiyùn qījiān xūyào dìngqī jiǎnchá, zhèyàng kěyǐ bǎozhèng mǔyīng jiànkāng.
en: Regular check-ups during pregnancy are necessary to ensure the health of both mother and baby.

zh: 很多职业女性怀孕后面临工作和家庭的平衡问题。
pinyin: Hěnduō zhíyè nǚxìng huáiyùn hòu miànlín gōngzuò hé jiātíng de pínghuà wèntí.
en: Many working women face the challenge of balancing career and family after becoming pregnant.

zh: 我喜欢公园。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān gōngyuán.
en: I like the park.

zh: 周末我们去公园玩。
pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen qù gōngyuán wán.
en: We go to the park to play on weekends.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以很多人在公园里散步。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén zài gōngyuán lǐ sǎnbù.
en: Because the weather is nice, many people are taking walks in the park.

zh: 虽然公园离我家比较远，但我还是经常去那里运动。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngyuán lí wǒ jiā bǐjiào yuǎn, dàn wǒ háishi jīngcháng qù nàlǐ yùndòng.
en: Although the park is quite far from my house, I still go there regularly to exercise.

zh: 这个公园的绿化很不错，已经成为周边居民休闲放松的首选地点。
pinyin: Zhège gōngyuán de lǜhuà hěn búcuò, yǐjīng chéngwéi zhōubiān jūmín xiūxián fàngsōng de shǒuxuǎn dìdiǎn.
en: This park has excellent landscaping and has become the top choice for locals to relax and unwind.

zh: 坏人绑架了小孩。
pinyin: Huàirén bǎngjiā le xiǎoháizi.
en: Bad guys kidnapped the child.

zh: 昨天有人绑架了银行的经理。
pinyin: Zuótiān yǒurén bǎngjiā le yínháng de jīnglǐ.
en: Yesterday someone kidnapped the bank manager.

zh: 因为警察很快出现,所以绑架犯没有逃跑。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jǐngchá hěn kuài chūxiàn, suǒyǐ bǎngjiā fàn méiyǒu táopǎo.
en: Because the police showed up quickly, the kidnappers couldn't escape.

zh: 那个绑架案件发生在市中心,引起了很大的社会关注。
pinyin: Nàge bǎngjiā ànjiàn fāshēng zài shì zhōngxīn, yǐnqǐ le hěn dà de shèhuì guānzhù.
en: That kidnapping case happened downtown and drew considerable public attention.

zh: 虽然绑架犯要求支付赎金,但是受害者家人选择了报警而不是妥协。
pinyin: Suīrán bǎngjiā fàn yāoqiú zhīfù shújīn, dànshì shòuhàizhě jiārén xuǎnzé le bàojǐng érbúshì tuǒxié.
en: Although the kidnappers demanded a ransom, the victim's family chose to call the police rather than give in.

zh: 这个部落很小。
pinyin: Zhège bùluò hěn xiǎo.
en: This tribe is very small.

zh: 古代的部落住在山里。
pinyin: Gǔdài de bùluò zhù zài shān lǐ.
en: Ancient tribes lived in the mountains.

zh: 虽然部落人数少,但是他们很团结。
pinyin: Suīrán bùluò rénshù shǎo, búshì tāmen hěn tuánjié.
en: Although the tribe had few people, they were very united.

zh: 这个部落因为地理位置偏远,所以保留了传统文化。
pinyin: Zhège bùluò yīnwèi dìlǐ wèizhì piānyuǎn, suǒyǐ bǎoliúle chuántǒng wénhuà.
