en: Because this tribe's location is remote, it has preserved traditional culture.

zh: 研究人员发现该部落的语言和习俗与周边地区差异很大。
pinyin: Yánjiū rényuan fāxiàn gāi bùluò de yǔyán hé xísú yǔ zhōubiān dìqū chāyì hěn dà.
en: Researchers found that this tribe's language and customs differ greatly from surrounding regions.

zh: 他肯吃米饭。
pinyin: Tā kěn chī mǐfàn.
en: He is willing to eat rice.

zh: 妈妈肯给我买新书。
pinyin: Māma kěn gěi wǒ mǎi xīn shū.
en: Mom is willing to buy me a new book.

zh: 虽然很贵，但他还是肯买这件衣服。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn guì, dànshì tā háishi kěn mǎi zhè jiàn yīfu.
en: Even though it's expensive, he's still willing to buy this piece of clothing.

zh: 只要你认真学习，老师肯定会肯你的进步。
pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ rènzhēn xuéxí, lǎoshī kěndìng huì kěn nǐ de jìnbù.
en: As long as you study seriously, the teacher will definitely acknowledge your progress.

zh: 这个项目困难重重，但团队肯定能够坚持到底。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù kùnnan zhòngzhòng, dàn tuánduì kěndìng néng gòu jiānchí dào dǐ.
en: This project faces major challenges, but the team is sure to persevere to the end.

zh: 这是学习资料。
pinyin: Zhè shì xuéxí zīliào.
en: This is study material.

zh: 老师给我们很多资料。
pinyin: Lǎoshī gěi wǒmen hěnduō zīliào.
en: The teacher gave us a lot of materials.

zh: 因为要考试，所以我收集了很多资料。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yào kǎoshì, suǒyǐ wǒ shōují le hěnduō zīliào.
en: Because there's an exam coming, I gathered lots of reference materials.

zh: 虽然网上资料很多，但是找到可靠的信息并不容易。
pinyin: Suīrán wǎngshang zīliào hěnduō, dànshi zhǎodào kě靠 de xìnxī bìngbù róngyì.
en: Although there's plenty of material online, finding reliable information isn't easy.

zh: 这个项目需要从多个渠道整理资料，才能得出准确的结论。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào cóng duōge qúdào zhěnglǐ zīliào, cáinéng déchū zhǔnquè de jiēlùn.
en: This project requires gathering and organizing materials from multiple sources in order to reach accurate conclusions.

zh: 这个碗很干净。
pinyin: Zhège wǎn hěn gānnjìng.
en: This bowl is very clean.

zh: 早上我打扫房间,现在很干净。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ dǎsǎo fángjiān, xiànzài hěn gānnjìng.
en: I cleaned the room this morning, and it's very clean now.

zh: 虽然天气不好,但是她把家打扫得很干净。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, búguò tā bǎ jiā dǎsǎo de hěn gānnjìng.
en: Even though the weather was bad, she still cleaned the house thoroughly.

zh: 因为经常打扫,所以他的办公室总是干净整洁。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīngcháng dǎsǎo, suǒyǐ tā de bàngōngshì zǒngshì gānnjìng zhěngjiè.
en: Because he cleans regularly, his office is always neat and tidy.

zh: 做人要干干净净,不要被那些不好的习惯所影响。
pinyin: Zuòrén yào gānngānnjìngjìng, búyào bèi nàxiē búhǎo de xíguàn suǒ yǐngxiǎng.
en: You should keep yourself clean and upright as a person; don't let bad habits influence you.

zh: 他们的婚姻很好。
pinyin: Tāmen de húnyīn hěn hǎo.
en: Their marriage is good.

zh: 去年他们决定开始婚姻生活。
pinyin: Qùnián tāmen juédìng kāishǐ húnyīn shēnghuó.
en: Last year they decided to begin married life.

zh: 虽然他们的婚姻有困难,但是他们还是很相爱。
pinyin: Suīrán tāmen de húnyīn yǒu kunnan, dànshì tāmen háishi hěn xiāngài.
en: Although their marriage has had difficulties, they still love each other very much.

zh: 现在很多年轻人对婚姻的看法和他们父母不一样。
pinyin: Xiànzài hěnduō niánqīngrén duì húnyīn de kànfǎ hé tāmen fùmǔ búyīyàng.
en: Nowadays, many young people's views on marriage differ from those of their parents.

zh: 要维持一段幸福的婚姻,双方都需要付出努力和耐心。
pinyin: Yào wéichí yī duàn xìngfú de húnyīn, shuāngfāng dōu xūyào fùchū nǔlì hé nàixīn.
en: To maintain a happy marriage, both partners need to put in effort and patience.

zh: 我的头很痛。
pinyin: Wǒ de tóu hěn tòng.
en: I have a really bad headache.

zh: 昨天运动以后，我的腿很痛。
pinyin: Zuótiān yùndòng yǐhòu, wǒ de tuǐ hěn tòng.
en: After exercising yesterday, my legs were really sore.

zh: 虽然他的脚很痛，但是他还是去上班了。
pinyin: Suīrán tā de jiǎo hěn tòng, dànshì tā háishi qù shàngbān le.
en: Even though his foot hurt badly, he still went to work.

zh: 医生说我的肩膀痛是因为长时间对着电脑。
pinyin: Yīshēng shuō wǒ de jiānbǎng tòng shì yīnwèi cháng shíjiān duìzhe diànnǎo.
en: The doctor said my shoulder pain is from sitting at the computer for long periods.

zh: 经过几个月的治疗，他终于摆脱了那种令人痛苦的腰痛。
pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ ge yuè de zhìliáo, tā zhōngyú báituō le nà zhǒng lìngrén tòngkǔ de yāotòng.
en: After months of treatment, he finally got rid of that agonizing lower back pain.

zh: 我很亲爸爸。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn qīn bàba.
en: I'm very close to my dad.

zh: 昨天我亲了我的妈妈。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ qīnle wǒ de māma.
en: I kissed my mom yesterday.

zh: 虽然我们住得远，但我们的关系很亲密。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen zhùde yuǎn, dàn wǒmen de guānxi hěn qīnmì.
en: Although we live far apart, our relationship is very close.

zh: 因为他们亲眼看到了事情的经过，所以知道真相。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tāmen qīnyǎn kàndàole shìqing de jīngguò, suǒyǐ zhīdào zhēnxiāng.
en: Because they witnessed it with their own eyes, they know the truth.

zh: 他是个很亲民的领导，经常深入基层和普通员工亲切交流。
pinyin: Tā shì ge hěn qīnmín de lǐngdǎo, jīngcháng shēnyù jīcéng hé pǔtōng yuángōng qīnqiè jiāoliú.
en: He's an approachable leader who regularly goes to the grassroots level and has warm conversations with ordinary staff.

zh: 这是一个教堂。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè jiàotáng.
en: This is a church.

zh: 周日我和家人去教堂。
pinyin: Zhōurì wǒ hé jiārén qù jiàotáng.
en: On Sunday I go to church with my family.

zh: 因为今天下雨，所以我们没去教堂。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen méi qù jiàotáng.
en: Because it rained today, we didn't go to church.

zh: 那个古老的教堂每个星期天都有很多人来做礼拜。
pinyin: Nàge gǔlǎo de jiàotáng měi ge xīngqītiān dōu yǒu hěnduō rén lái zuò lǐbài.
en: That old church has a lot of people coming to worship every Sunday.

zh: 这座教堂建于十九世纪，虽然建筑老旧，但仍然保持着原来的风格。
pinyin: Zhè zuò jiàotáng jiànyú shíjiǔ shìjì, suīrán jiànzhú lǎojiù, dàn仍然 bǎochízhe yuánlái de fēnggé.
en: This church was built in the nineteenth century; although the structure is aging, it still maintains its original style.

zh: 这个苹果的皮很厚。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ de píhěn hòu.
en: This apple has a thick skin.

zh: 我每天都要洗脸，保护皮肤。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān dōu yào xǐliǎn, bǎohù pífu.
en: I wash my face every day to protect my skin.

zh: 因为天气干燥，所以我的皮肤很痒。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì gānzào, suǒyǐ wǒ de pífu hěn yǎng.
en: Because the weather is dry, my skin gets itchy.

zh: 虽然这个包的皮质量不错，但价格有点贵。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège bāo de pízhì liàngliàng búcuò, dàn jiàgé yǒudiǎn guì.
en: Although this bag's leather quality is decent, it's a bit pricey.

zh: 长期暴晒会损伤皮肤，所以防晒工作不能马虎。
pinyin: Chángqī bàoshài huì sǔnshāng pífu, suǒyǐ fángshài gōngzuò búnéng mǎhu.
en: Prolonged sun exposure damages skin, so you can't be careless about sun protection.

zh: 这是一只鸟。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī zhī niǎo.
en: This is a bird.

zh: 早上我看到一只黄色的鸟在树上。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ kàndào yī zhī huángsè de niǎo zài shù shang.
en: This morning I saw a yellow bird in the tree.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以很多鸟都在公园里唱歌。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ hěnduō niǎo dōu zài gōngyuán lǐ chànggē.
en: Because the weather is nice, lots of birds are singing in the park.

zh: 那种小鸟虽然个子很小，但是唱歌的声音特别好听。
pinyin: Nà zhǒng xiǎo niǎo suīrán gèzi hěn xiǎo, dànshì chànggē de shēngyīn tèbié hǎotīng.
en: Although that type of small bird is tiny, its singing voice is surprisingly beautiful.

zh: 我们公司的年轻员工就像一群活泼的鸟，总是充满热情和创意。
pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī de niánqīng yuángōng jiùshì yī qún huópo de niǎo, zǒngshì chōngmǎn règíng hé chuàngyì.
en: Our company's young employees are like a flock of lively birds—always full of passion and creativity.

zh: 这个冰淇淋很爽。
pinyin: Zhège bīngqílín hěn爽.
en: This ice cream is really refreshing.

zh: 夏天喝冷水感觉很爽快。
pinyin: Xiàtiān hē lěnghuǐ gǎnjuéhěn爽kuài.
en: Drinking cold water in summer feels really nice and refreshing.

zh: 虽然很累，但洗澡后感觉爽多了。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn xǐzǎo hòu gǎnjué爽 duō le.
en: Even though I was tired, I felt so much better after taking a shower.

zh: 他性格开朗爽快，大家都喜欢跟他做朋友。
pinyin: Tā xìnggé kāilǎng爽kuài, dàjiā dōu xǐhuān gēn tā zuò péngyou.
en: He has a cheerful and straightforward personality, so everyone likes being friends with him.

zh: 这份合同条款清楚明了，双方都爽快地同意了。
pinyin: Zhè fèn héyuē tiáokuǎn qīngchu míngliǎo, shuāngfāng dōu爽kuài de tóngyì le.
en: The contract terms were clear and straightforward, so both parties readily agreed to it.

zh: 我很健康。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn jiànkāng.
en: I'm very healthy.

zh: 每天运动对健康很重要。
pinyin: Měi tiān yùndòng duì jiànkāng hěn zhòngyào.
en: Exercising every day is very important for your health.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但是他坚持锻炼身体保持健康。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì tā jiānchí duànliàn shēntǐ bǎochíi jiànkāng.
en: Even though his work is busy, he still exercises regularly to maintain his health.

zh: 医生建议我们多吃蔬菜和水果，这样才能保证长期的身体健康。
pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì wǒmen duō chī shūcài hé shuǐguǒ, zhèyàng cái néng bǎozhèng chángqī de shēntǐ jiànkāng.
en: The doctor recommended that we eat more vegetables and fruit to ensure long-term physical health.

zh: 随着生活水平提高，越来越多的人开始重视心理健康和身体健康的平衡发展。
pinyin: Suízhe shēnghuó shuǐpíng tígāo, yuèláiyuè duō de rén kāishǐ zhòngshì xīnlǐ jiànkāng hé shēntǐ jiànkāng de pínghéng fāzhǎn.
en: As living standards improve, more and more people are beginning to emphasize the balanced development of mental and physical health.

zh: 我们的客户很多。
pinyin: Wǒmen de kèhù hěn duō.
en: We have a lot of customers.

zh: 今天有一个新客户来我们店。
pinyin: Jīntiān yǒu yī ge xīn kèhù lái wǒmen diàn.
en: A new customer came to our shop today.

zh: 因为服务很好，所以我们的客户都很满意。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fúwù hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen de kèhù dōu hěn mǎnyì.
en: Because our service is good, our customers are always satisfied.

zh: 销售人员需要了解每个客户的需求和偏好。
pinyin: Xiāoshòu rényuán xūyào liǎojiě měi ge kèhù de xūqiú hé piānhào.
en: Sales staff need to understand each customer's needs and preferences.

zh: 虽然我们的产品价格不是最便宜的，但客户仍然信任我们。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen de chǎnpǐn jiàgé búshì zuì piányí de, dàn kèhù réngránxìn rènxìn wǒmen.
en: Although our products aren't the cheapest, customers still trust us.

zh: 我画了一个圈。
pinyin: Wǒ huà le yī ge quān.
en: I drew a circle.

zh: 他每天都在公园里走一圈。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu zài gōngyuán lǐ zǒu yī quān.
en: He walks around the park once every day.

zh: 虽然这个圈子很小，但是里面的人都很友好。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège quānzi hěn xiǎo, dànshì lǐmiàn de rén dōu hěn yǒuhǎo.
en: Although this social circle is small, the people in it are all very friendly.

zh: 在互联网圈子里，很多人都认识他，因为他发表过很有影响力的文章。
pinyin: Zài hùliánwǎng quānzi lǐ, hěn duō rén dōu rènshi tā, yīnwèi tā fābiǎo guò hěn yǒu yǐngxiǎnglì de wénzhāng.
en: In the internet industry, many people know him because he's published articles with significant influence.

zh: 他在金融圈混了十多年，人脉广泛，但最近因为一个项目失利而被圈内人冷遇。
pinyin: Tā zài jīnróng quān huàn le shí duō nián, rénmài guǎngfàn, dàn zuìjìn yīnwèi yī ge xiàngmù shīlì érbèi quānnèi rén lěngyù.
en: He's been around the finance sector for over ten years with extensive connections, but lately people in the industry have given him the cold shoulder over a failed project.

zh: 我的脑袋疼。
pinyin: Wǒ de nǎodài ténɡ.
en: My head hurts.

zh: 他昨天碰到脑袋，现在还疼。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān pènɡdào nǎodài, xiànzài háishi ténɡ.
en: He bumped his head yesterday and it still hurts now.

zh: 因为工作太累，所以我的脑袋总是很疼。
pinyin: Yīnwèi ɡōnɡzuò tài lèi, suǒyǐ wǒ de nǎodài zǒngshi hěn ténɡ.
en: Because work is exhausting, my head is always hurting.

zh: 虽然脑袋不舒服，但是他还是坚持去上班。
pinyin: Suīránɡ nǎodài búshūfu, dànshi tā háishi jiānchí qù shànɡbān.
en: Although his head wasn't feeling well, he still insisted on going to work.

zh: 这个问题把我的脑袋搞得一团糟，我得好好想想。
pinyin: Zhèɡe wèntí bǎ wǒ de nǎodài ɡǎo de yī tuán zāo, wǒ děi hǎohāo xiǎnɡxiǎnɡ.
en: This problem has scrambled my brain, so I need to think it through carefully.

zh: 米不够了。
pinyin: Mǐ búgòu le.
en: We don't have enough rice.

zh: 今天的钱不够买两个苹果。
pinyin: Jīntiān de qián búgòu mǎi liǎng ge píngguǒ.
en: Today's money isn't enough to buy two apples.

zh: 虽然他很努力，但是经验还是不够。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn nǔlì, dànshì jīngyàn háishi búgòu.
en: Even though he works hard, his experience is still not enough.

zh: 这个计划的预算不够，我们需要重新考虑。
pinyin: Zhège jìhuà de yùsuàn búgòu, wǒmen xūyào chóngxīn kǎolǜ.
en: This plan's budget isn't sufficient, so we need to reconsider it.

zh: 仅凭热情是不够的，还要有实际的行动和坚持。
pinyin: Jǐnpíng règíng shì búgòu de, háiyào yǒu shíjì de xíngdòng hé jiānchí.
en: Passion alone is not enough; you also need concrete action and perseverance.

zh: 嘘，别说话。
pinyin: Xū, bié shuōhuà.
en: Shh, don't talk.

zh: 妈妈对我嘘了一声，让我安静。
pinyin: Māma duì wǒ xūle yī shēng, ràng wǒ ānjìng.
en: Mom made a shushing sound at me to keep quiet.

zh: 因为宝宝在睡觉，爸爸用手指嘘我们不要出声。
pinyin: Yīnwèi báobǎo zài shuìjiào, bàba yòng shǒuzhǐ xū wǒmen búyào chūshēng.
en: Because the baby was sleeping, Dad put his finger to his lips to tell us to be quiet.

zh: 他一边嘘我安静，一边自己却在房间里大声讲电话。
pinyin: Tā yībān xū wǒ ānjìng, yībān zìjǐ què zài fángjiān li dàshēng jiǎng diànhuà.
en: He was shushing me to stay quiet while talking loudly on the phone in the other room.

zh: 图书馆员对那些吵闹的学生不断嘘，但效果甚微。
pinyin: Túshūguǎn yuán duì nàxiē chǎonào de xuésheng búduàn xū, dàn xiàoguǒ shènwēi.
en: The librarian kept shushing the noisy students, but it hardly made any difference.

zh: 前面有一个公园。
pinyin: Qiánmiàn yǒu yīgè gōngyuán.
en: There's a park in front.

zh: 前面的那个男孩是我的朋友。
pinyin: Qiánmiàn de nàgè nánháizi shì wǒ de péngyou.
en: That boy in front is my friend.

zh: 虽然前面有很多人，但是我们还是进去了。
pinyin: Suīrán qiánmiàn yǒu hěnduō rén, dànshì wǒmen háishi jìnqù le.
en: Even though there were lots of people ahead, we went in anyway.

zh: 根据前面的讨论，我们需要修改一下这个计划。
pinyin: Gēnjù qiánmiàn de tǎolùn, wǒmen xūyào xiūgǎi yīxià zhège jìhuà.
en: Based on what we discussed earlier, we need to adjust this plan a bit.

zh: 前面的经历让我明白了什么叫真正的坚持和努力。
pinyin: Qiánmiàn de jīnglì ràng wǒ míngbai le shénme jiào zhēnzhèng de jiānchí hé nǔlì.
en: Those earlier experiences taught me what true persistence and hard work really mean.

zh: 他们分手了。
pinyin: Tāmen fēnshǒu le.
en: They broke up.

zh: 去年他和女朋友分手了。
pinyin: Qùnián tā hé nǚpéngyou fēnshǒu le.
en: Last year he broke up with his girlfriend.

zh: 因为工作太忙，他们决定分手。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng, tāmen juéding fēnshǒu.
en: Because they were both too busy with work, they decided to break up.

zh: 虽然他们相爱，但是还是选择了分手。
pinyin: Suīrán tāmen xiāngrài, dànshi háishi xuǎnzé le fēnshǒu.
en: Despite loving each other, they still chose to break up.

zh: 他们的分手不是因为不爱，而是觉得彼此已经变成了不同的人。
pinyin: Tāmen de fēnshǒu búshì yīnwèi búài, érshì juéde bǐcǐ yǐjīng biànchéng le búyītòng de rén.
en: Their breakup wasn't because they stopped loving each other, but because they felt they'd become completely different people.

zh: 我们往北方向走。
pinyin: Wǒmen wǎng běi fāngxiàng zǒu.
en: We're walking toward the north.

zh: 早上太阳在东方向升起。
pinyin: Zǎoshang tàiyáng zài dōng fāngxiàng shēngqǐ.
en: The sun rises in the eastern direction in the morning.

zh: 因为下雨了，我们改变了方向往家里走。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, wǒmen gǎibiàn le fāngxiàng wǎng jiāli zǒu.
en: Because it started raining, we changed direction and headed home.

zh: GPS显示的方向和我看到的路标方向不一样。
pinyin: GPS xiǎnshì de fāngxiàng hé wǒ kàndào de lùbiāo fāngxiàng búyīyàng.
en: The direction the GPS is showing isn't the same as the direction the road sign indicates.

zh: 这个项目虽然初期困难重重，但我们坚持了正确的方向，最后取得了成功。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù suīrán chūqī kùnnan zhòngzhòng, dàn wǒmen jiānchíle zhèngquè de fāngxiàng, zuìhòu qǔdéle chénggōng.
en: Although the project faced many difficulties at first, we stuck to the right direction and ultimately achieved success.

zh: 我的心理很好。
pinyin: Wǒ de xīnlǐ hěn hǎo.
en: My mental state is good.

zh: 考试前,他的心理有点紧张。
pinyin: Kǎoshì qián, tā de xīnlǐ yǒudiǎn jǐnzhāng.
en: Before the exam, he felt a bit anxious mentally.

zh: 虽然工作很累,但是她的心理状态还不错。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn lèi, dànshì tā de xīnlǐ zhuàngtài háishi búcuò.
en: Although the work is tiring, her psychological state is still pretty good.

zh: 心理医生帮助患者理解自己的情绪问题。
pinyin: Xīnlǐ yīshēng bāngzhù huànzhě lǐjiě zìjǐ de qíngxù wèntí.
en: The psychologist helps patients understand their emotional issues.

zh: 长期的工作压力会影响员工的心理健康,企业应该重视这个问题。
pinyin: Chángqī de gōngzuò yālì huì yǐngxiǎng yuángōng de xīnlǐ jiànkāng, qǐyè yīnggāi zhòngshì zhège wèntí.
en: Prolonged work stress affects employees' mental health, and companies should take this issue seriously.

zh: 家人在一起很幸福。
pinyin: Jiārén zài yīqǐ hěn xìngfú.
en: Being with family makes us happy.

zh: 每天吃好吃的东西，我感到幸福。
pinyin: Měitiān chī hǎochīde dōngxi, wǒ gǎndào xìngfú.
en: I feel happy every day when I eat delicious food.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但是和朋友聊天的时候我感到幸福。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì hé péngyou liáotiān de shíhou wǒ gǎndào xìngfú.
en: Although work is busy, I feel happy when chatting with friends.

zh: 她说幸福不是拥有很多钱，而是和爱的人在一起。
pinyin: Tā shuō xìngfú búshì yōngyǒu hěnduō qián, érshì hé ài de rén zài yīqǐ.
en: She says happiness isn't about having lots of money, but being with the people you love.

zh: 研究表明，真正的幸福来自于有意义的人际关系和个人成长。
pinyin: Yánjiū biǎomíng, zhēnzhèng de xìngfú láizìyú yǒu yìyì de rén际 guānxi hé gèrén chéngzhǎng.
en: Research shows that genuine happiness comes from meaningful relationships and personal development.

zh: 这是一棵树。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī k棵 shù.
en: This is a tree.

zh: 公园里有很多大树。
pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ yǒu hěnduō dà shù.
en: There are lots of big trees in the park.

zh: 因为下雨，我们在树下等了一会儿。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒmen zài shù xià děngle yīhuǐr.
en: Because it was raining, we waited under the tree for a while.

zh: 这棵老树虽然很高，但是树根还是很稳固。
pinyin: Zhè k棵 lǎo shù suīrán hěn gāo, dànshì shùgēn háishi hěn wěngù.
en: Although this old tree is very tall, its roots are still very firm.

zh: 为了保护这些百年老树，政府决定限制附近的建筑开发。
pinyin: Wèile bǎohù zhèxiē bǎi nián lǎo shù, zhèngfǔ juédìng xiànzhì fùjìn de jiànzhù kāifā.
en: To protect these century-old trees, the government decided to restrict construction development in the surrounding area.

zh: 救命啊！
pinyin: Jiùmìng a!
en: Help! / Save me!

zh: 他掉进水里，大声喊救命。
pinyin: Tā diào jìn shuǐ lǐ, dà shēng hǎn jiùmìng.
en: He fell into the water and shouted for help.

zh: 因为火很大，她躲在角落里喊救命。
pinyin: Yīnwèi huǒ hěn dà, tā duǒ zài jiǎoluò lǐ hǎn jiùmìng.
en: Because the fire was so big, she hid in the corner and cried out for help.

zh: 看到有人溺水，游泳选手立刻游过去救命。
pinyin: Kàn dào yǒu rén nìshuǐ, yóuyǒng xuǎnshǒu lìkè yóu guòqu jiùmìng.
en: Seeing someone drowning, the swimmer immediately swam over to save them.

zh: 关键时刻他挺身而出，真是救命的恩人啊。
pinyin: Guānjiàn shíkè tā tǐngshēn ér chū, zhēnshi jiùmìng de ēnrén a.
en: He stepped up at the critical moment—he really was a lifesaver.

zh: 我吃饭，接着睡觉。
pinyin: Wǒ chīfàn, jiēzháo shuìjiào.
en: I eat, and then I sleep.

zh: 他上午上课，接着下午去公园。
pinyin: Tā shàngwǔ shàngkè, jiēzháo xiàwǔ qù gōngyuán.
en: He has class in the morning, then goes to the park in the afternoon.

zh: 妈妈做好饭以后，接着我们就一起吃晚饭。
pinyin: Māma zuòhǎo fàn yǐhòu, jiēzháo wǒmen jiù yìqǐ chī wǎnfàn.
en: After mom finishes cooking, then we eat dinner together right away.

zh: 会议讨论了去年的成绩，接着进行了今年的计划安排。
pinyin: Huìyì tǎolùnle qùnián de chéngjì, jiēzháo jìnxíngle jīnnián de jìhuà ānpái.
en: The meeting reviewed last year's results, then proceeded to arrange this year's plans.

zh: 他虽然工作很忙，但接着还要照顾家里，压力可想而知。
pinyin: Tā suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn jiēzháo háiyào zhàogu jiālǐ, yālì kě xiǎng ér zhī.
en: Although his work is demanding, he still has to take care of family on top of it—the stress is obvious.

zh: 这个项目很有趣。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù hěn yǒuqù.
en: This project is really interesting.

zh: 学校有很多体育项目。
pinyin: Xuéxiào yǒu hěnduō tǐyù xiàngmù.
en: The school has lots of sports activities.

zh: 虽然这个项目很困难，但是我们坚持做完了。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège xiàngmù hěn kùnnan, dànshì wǒmen jiānchí zuò wán le.
en: Although the project was difficult, we stuck with it and finished.

zh: 公司的财务报表显示了多个项目的支出情况。
pinyin: Gōngsī de cáiwù bàobiǎo xiǎnshì le duōge xiàngmù de zhīchū qíngkuàng.
en: The company's financial statement shows the spending breakdown across multiple projects.

zh: 为了提高效率，管理层决定合并几个相似的项目。
pinyin: Wèile tígāo xiàoxiào, guǎnlǐcéng juéding hebìng jǐge xiāngsì de xiàngmù.
en: To improve efficiency, management decided to consolidate several similar projects into one.

zh: 他是疯子。
pinyin: Tā shì fēngzi.
en: He's crazy.

zh: 那个疯子每天都在街上跑。
pinyin: Nàgè fēngzi měitiān dōu zài jiēshang pǎo.
en: That crazy guy runs around the street every day.

zh: 虽然他有点疯子，但是他人很好。
pinyin: Suīrán tā yǒudiǎn fēngzi, dànshì tā rén hěn hǎo.
en: Even though he's a bit crazy, he's actually a good person.

zh: 因为他总是说奇怪的话，大家都叫他疯子。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā zǒngshì shuō qíguài de huà, dàjiā dōu jiào tā fēngzi.
en: Because he's always saying weird stuff, everyone calls him a crazy person.

zh: 他那些疯子一样的想法其实挺有创意的。
pinyin: Tā nàxiē fēngzi yīyàng de xiǎngfǎ qíshí tǐng yǒu chuàngyì de.
en: His crazy-type ideas are actually pretty creative when you think about it.

zh: 我喜欢看比赛。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān kàn bǐsài.
en: I like watching competitions.

zh: 昨天我们班赢了比赛。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒmen bān yíngले bǐsài.
en: Our class won the competition yesterday.

zh: 因为他训练很认真，所以他在比赛中表现得很好。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā xùnliàn hěn rènzhēn, suǒyǐ tā zài bǐsài zhōng biǎoxiàn de hěn hǎo.
en: Because he trained seriously, he performed really well in the competition.

zh: 虽然这次比赛很困难，但我们的队员都没有放弃。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè cì bǐsài hěn kùnnan, dàn wǒmen de duìyuán dōu méiyǒu fàngqì.
en: Although this competition was very challenging, none of our team members gave up.

zh: 参加这个国际比赛让我开阔了视野，也明白了自己的不足之处。
pinyin: Cānjiā zhège guójì bǐsài ràng wǒ kāikuò le shì野, yě míngbai le zìjǐ de búzú zhī chù.
en: Participating in this international competition broadened my horizons and showed me where I need to improve.

zh: 他是将军。
pinyin: Tā shì jiāngjūn.
en: He is a general.

zh: 这位将军很有名。
pinyin: Zhè wèi jiāngjūn hěn yǒumíng.
en: This general is very famous.

zh: 因为那个将军很聪明，所以他赢了战争。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nàge jiāngjūn hěn cōngming, suǒyǐ tā yíngle zhànzhēng.
en: Because that general was very smart, he won the war.

zh: 这位将军虽然年纪大了，但是他的经验对国家很重要。
pinyin: Zhè wèi jiāngjūn suīrán niánjì dàle, dànshì tāde jīngyàn duì guójiā hěn zhòngyào.
en: Although this general is getting older, his experience is very important to the country.

zh: 那位将军凭借丰富的战场经验，成功地化解了这次危机。
pinyin: Nà wèi jiāngjūn píngjiè fēngfù de zhànchǎng jīngyàn, chénggōng de huàjiě le zhè cì wēijī.
en: That general successfully resolved the crisis by drawing on his extensive battlefield experience.

zh: 他学习技术。
pinyin: Tā xuéxí jìshù.
en: He is studying technology.

zh: 我爸爸的工作是技术员。
pinyin: Wǒ bàba de gōngzuò shì jìshùyuán.
en: My dad's job is as a technician.

zh: 因为他有很好的技术，所以公司很信任他。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā yǒu hěn hǎo de jìshù, suǒyǐ gōngsī hěn xìnrèn tā.
en: Because he has excellent technical skills, the company really trusts him.

zh: 虽然这个技术很新，但是已经有很多公司在使用。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège jìshù hěn xīn, dànshì yǐjīng yǒu hěnduō gōngsī zài shǐyòng.
en: Although this technology is quite new, many companies are already using it.

zh: 要想在这个行业竞争，必须不断提高自己的技术水平。
pinyin: Yào xiǎng zài zhège hángyè jìngjìng, bìxū búduàn tígāo zìjǐ de jìshù shuǐpíng.
en: If you want to compete in this industry, you have to constantly improve your technical skill level.

zh: 我每天吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān chīfàn.
en: I eat every day.

zh: 我们一起在家吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīqǐ zài jiā chīfàn.
en: We eat together at home.

zh: 因为今天很忙，所以我没有时间吃饭。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān hěn máng, suǒyǐ wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān chīfàn.
en: Because I'm very busy today, I didn't have time to eat.

zh: 虽然工作很累，但是我们还是要按时吃饭。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn lèi, dànshì wǒmen háishi yào ànshí chīfàn.
en: Even though work is tiring, we still need to eat on schedule.

zh: 想要身体健康就得规律吃饭，不能经常吃外卖。
pinyin: Xiǎngyào shēntǐ jiànkāng jiù děi guīlǜ chīfàn, búnéng jīngcháng chī wàimài.
en: If you want to stay healthy, you have to eat regularly and can't always rely on takeout.

zh: 妈妈传给我一个苹果。
pinyin: Māma chuán gěi wǒ yī ge píngguǒ.
en: Mom passed me an apple.

zh: 老师昨天传了一个重要的消息。
pinyin: Lǎoshī zuótiān chuán le yī ge zhònyào de xiāoxī.
en: The teacher sent an important message yesterday.

zh: 因为网络不好，视频传不了，所以我们改了时间。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǎngluò búhǎo, shìpín chuán búliǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen gǎi le shíjiān.
en: Because the internet was bad and the video wouldn't upload, we rescheduled.

zh: 这个传统在我们家族已经传了好几代，现在还在继续。
pinyin: Zhège chuántǒng zài wǒmen jiāzú yǐjīng chuán le hǎo jǐ dài, xiànzài háishi zài jìxù.
en: This tradition has been passed down through several generations in our family and continues today.

zh: 他把自己的经验和技能传授给年轻员工，这样知识才不会失传。
pinyin: Tā bǎ zìjǐ de jīngyàn hé jìnéng chuánshòu gěi niánqīng yuángōng, zhèyàng zhīshi cái búhuì shīchuán.
en: He passes his experience and skills on to younger employees so that this knowledge won't be lost.

zh: 学习很困难。
pinyin: Xuéxí hěn kùnnan.
en: Learning is really difficult.

zh: 我昨天遇到了一个困难的问题。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān yùdàole yīge kùnnan de wèntí.
en: Yesterday I ran into a difficult problem.

zh: 虽然这份工作有困难，但是我还是很喜欢。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè fèn gōngzuò yǒu kùnnan, dànshì wǒ háishi hěn xǐhuān.
en: Even though this job has its challenges, I still really like it.

zh: 如果你在工作中遇到困难，可以告诉我们的经理。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ zài gōngzuò zhōng yùdào kùnnan, kěyǐ gàosu wǒmen de jīnglǐ.
en: If you encounter difficulties at work, you can tell our manager.

zh: 创业的路上必然会有困难，关键是怎样克服这些挑战。
pinyin: Chuàngyè de lùshang bìrán huì yǒu kùnnan, guānjiàn shì zěnyàng kèfu zhèxiē tiǎozhàn.
en: Starting a business inevitably involves difficulties; what matters is how you overcome these challenges.

zh: 妈妈不许我吃糖。
pinyin: Māma búxǔ wǒ chī táng.
en: Mom won't let me eat candy.

zh: 老师不许学生在课堂上说话。
pinyin: Lǎoshī búxǔ xuésheng zài kètáng shang shuōhuà.
en: The teacher doesn't allow students to talk during class.

zh: 虽然天气很冷，但是爸爸不许我穿太多衣服。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, búshì bàba búxǔ wǒ chuān tàiduō yīfu.
en: Even though it's very cold, Dad won't let me wear too many clothes.

zh: 公司的规定不许员工在工作时间玩手机。
pinyin: Gōngsī de guīdìng búxǔ yuángōng zài gōngzuò shíjiān wán shǒujī.
en: The company's policy forbids employees from using their phones during work hours.

zh: 虽然这是我的个人隐私，但公司还是不许我透露任何信息。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè shì wǒ de gèrén yǐnsi, búshì gōngsī háishi búxǔ wǒ tòulù rènhé xìnxī.
en: Even though it's my personal privacy, the company still won't let me disclose any information about it.

zh: 我喜欢某种水果。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān móuzhǒng shuǐguǒ.
en: I like a certain kind of fruit.

zh: 他每天喝某种茶，很健康。
pinyin: Tā měitiān hē móuzhǒng chá, hěn jiànkāng.
en: He drinks a certain type of tea every day, and it's very healthy.

zh: 虽然我不知道是什么，但这某种药很有效。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ búzhīdào shì shénme, dàn zhè móuzhǒng yào hěn yǒuxiàoò.
en: Although I don't know what it is, this particular medicine works really well.

zh: 她用某种特殊的方法解决了这个问题。
pinyin: Tā yòng móuzhǒng tèshū de fāngfǎ jiějuéle zhège wèntí.
en: She resolved this problem using a particular special method.

zh: 现代社会的压力让很多人产生了某种焦虑感。
pinyin: Xiàndài shèhuì de yālì ràng hěnduō rén chǎnshēngle móuzhǒng jiāolǜ gǎn.
en: The stress of modern society has caused many people to develop a certain sense of anxiety.

zh: 我的记忆很好。
pinyin: Wǒ de jìyì hěn hǎo.
en: My memory is very good.

zh: 小时候的记忆很模糊了。
pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou de jìyì hěn móhú le.
en: My memories from childhood have become quite fuzzy.

zh: 虽然时间很长,但我还记得那次旅行的记忆。
pinyin: Suīrán shíjiān hěn cháng, dàn wǒ háishi jìde nà cì lǚxíng de jìyì.
en: Even though it's been a long time, I still remember the memories from that trip.

zh: 经常复习笔记能帮助加强学生的长期记忆。
pinyin: Jīngcháng fùxí bǐjì néng bāngzhù jiāqiáng xuésheng de chángqī jìyì.
en: Regularly reviewing notes can help strengthen students' long-term memory.

zh: 不少人发现随着年纪增长,对细节的记忆力会逐渐衰退。
pinyin: Búshǎo rén fāxiàn suízhe niánjì zēngzhǎng, duì xì節de jìyìlì huì zhújiàn shuāituì.
en: Many people find that as they age, their ability to remember details gradually declines.

zh: 乐队很好听。
pinyin: Yuèduì hěn hǎotīng.
en: The band sounds really good.

zh: 昨天我看了一个乐队的演唱会。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ kànle yīge yuèduì de yǎnchànghuì.
en: Yesterday I went to see a band's concert.

zh: 因为乐队的音乐很好听，所以很多人都喜欢他们。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yuèduì de yīnyuè hěn hǎotīng, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén dōu xǐhuān tāmen.
en: Because the band's music is so good, lots of people like them.

zh: 这个乐队虽然成立时间不长，但是已经在国内获得了很多粉丝。
pinyin: Zhège yuèduì suīrán chéglì shíjiān búcháng, búguò yǐjīng zài guónèi huòdéle hěnduō fěnsī.
en: Although this band hasn't been around very long, they've already gained a lot of fans domestically.

zh: 随着音乐节目的热播，这支乐队一夜成名，成了年轻人追捧的对象。
pinyin: Suízhe yīnyuè jiémù de règuǎng, zhè zhī yuèduì yīyè chéngmíng, chéngle niánqīngrén zhuīpěng de duìxiàng.
en: As the music show went viral, this band became an overnight sensation and turned into something young people are crazy about.

zh: 这是紧急电话。
pinyin: Zhè shì jǐnjí diànhuà.
en: This is an emergency phone.

zh: 医院今天有紧急病人来了。
pinyin: Yīyuàn jīntiān yǒu jǐnjí bìngrén lái le.
en: The hospital had an emergency patient come in today.

zh: 因为发生了紧急情况，所以大家都很紧张。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fāshēng le jǐnjí qíngkuàng, suǒyǐ dàjiā dōu hěn jǐnzhāng.
en: Because an urgent situation came up, everyone became very tense.

zh: 当你遇到紧急问题时，不要慌，要冷静想办法。
pinyin: Dāng nǐ yùdào jǐnjí wèntí shí, búyào huāng, yào lěngjìng xiǎng bànfǎ.
en: When you face an urgent problem, don't panic—stay calm and think of a solution.

zh: 公司紧急召开会议讨论这个项目的延期问题。
pinyin: Gōngsī jǐnjí zhàokāi huìyì tǎolùn zhège xiàngmù de yánqī wèntí.
en: The company held an emergency meeting to discuss the project delay issue.

zh: 我在高中。
pinyin: Wǒ zài gāozhōng.
en: I'm in high school.

zh: 他明年进入高中学习。
pinyin: Tā míngnián jìnrù gāozhōng xuéxí.
en: He's going into high school next year.

zh: 因为要考大学，所以高中的功课很多。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yào kǎo dàxué, suǒyǐ gāozhōng de gōngkè hěnduō.
en: Because we have to prepare for university, high school has a lot of coursework.

zh: 虽然高中很辛苦，但很多学生还是坚持完成了。
pinyin: Suīrán gāozhōng hěn xīnkǔ, dàn hěnduō xuésheng háishi jiānchí wánchéngle.
en: Although high school is tough, most students still manage to push through and finish.

zh: 在高中期间，他既要处理学业压力，又要考虑将来的方向。
pinyin: Zài gāozhōng qījiān, tā jìyào chǔlǐ xuéyè yālì, yòuyào kǎolǜ jiānglái de fāngxiàng.
en: During high school, he had to juggle academic pressure while also thinking about his future path.

zh: 你听听我的歌。
pinyin: Nǐ tīngtīng wǒ de gē.
en: Listen to my song.

zh: 明天你来听听我们的音乐课。
pinyin: Míngtiān nǐ lái tīngtīng wǒmen de yīnyuè kè.
en: Come listen to our music class tomorrow.

zh: 因为他很有经验，所以我想听听他的意见。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn yǒu jīngyàn, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng tīngtīng tā de yìjiàn.
en: Since he has lots of experience, I'd like to hear his opinion.

zh: 虽然很忙，但我还是想听听你对这个项目的看法。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn máng, dàn wǒ háishi xiǎng tīngtīng nǐ duì zhège xiàngmù de kànfǎ.
en: Even though I'm busy, I'd still like to hear what you think about this project.

zh: 在做决定之前，我们应该听听不同部门的意见，这样才能更周全。
pinyin: Zài zuò juéding zhīqián, wǒmen yīnggāi tīngtīng búyī bùmén de yìjiàn, zhèyàng cái néng gèng zhōuquán.
en: Before we make a decision, we should hear from different departments so we can be more thorough.

zh: 我正好饿了。
pinyin: Wǒ zhènghǎo è le.
en: I'm actually hungry right now.

zh: 你来的时候正好下雨了。
pinyin: Nǐ lái de shíhou zhènghǎo xiàyǔ le.
en: When you arrived, it had just started raining.

zh: 虽然很贵，但这个手机的价格正好在我的预算里。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn guì, dàn zhège shǒujī de jiàgé zhènghǎo zài wǒ de yùsuàn lǐ.
en: Although it's expensive, this phone's price happens to fit right within my budget.

zh: 我们计划今年去旅游，他的假期正好和我的时间对上了。
pinyin: Wǒmen jìhuà jīnnián qù lǚyóu, tā de jiàqī zhènghǎo hé wǒ de shíjiān duì shang le.
en: We were planning to travel this year, and his vacation just happened to line up with my schedule.

zh: 虽然那个机会很难得，但我们的团队配合得正好，最终成功了。
pinyin: Suīrán nàge jīhuì hěn nándé, dàn wǒmen de tuánduì pèihé de zhènghǎo, zuìzhōng chénggōng le.
en: Although the opportunity was rare, our team's coordination happened to be perfect, and we pulled it off in the end.

zh: 美国有五十个州。
pinyin: Měiguó yǒu wǔshí ge zhōu.
en: The United States has fifty states.

zh: 我叔叔住在南方的一个州里。
pinyin: Wǒ shúshu zhù zài nánfāng de yī ge zhōu lǐ.
en: My uncle lives in a state in the south.

zh: 因为那个州的天气很热，所以很多人喜欢去旅游。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nàge zhōu de tiānqì hěn rè, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén xǐhuān qù lǚyóu.
en: Because that state has hot weather, many people like to travel there.

zh: 这个州虽然面积不大，但是人口密度很高。
pinyin: Zhège zhōu suīrán miànjī búdà, búguò rénkǒu mìdù hěn gāo.
en: Although this state isn't very large in area, its population density is quite high.

zh: 随着经济发展，越来越多的公司选择在沿海州设立总部。
pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuè duō de gōngsī xuǎnzé zài yánhǎi zhōu shèlì zǒngbù.
en: As the economy develops, more and more companies are choosing to establish headquarters in coastal states.

zh: 这个苹果毫无坏处。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ háowú huàichù.
en: This apple has nothing wrong with it.

zh: 昨天的比赛毫无悬念，他赢了。
pinyin: Zuótiān de bǐsài háowú xuánnián, tā yíng le.
en: Yesterday's match was completely one-sided—he won.

zh: 虽然他很努力，但这个计划毫无成功的可能。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn nǔlì, dàn zhège jìhuà háowú chénggōng de kěnéng.
en: Even though he worked hard, this plan has no chance of succeeding.

zh: 他对这份工作毫无热情，所以每天都很不开心。
pinyin: Tā duì zhè fèn gōngzuò háowú règíng, suǒyǐ měi tiān dōu hěn búkāixīn.
en: He has zero enthusiasm for this job, which is why he's unhappy every day.

zh: 这个提议毫无实际意义，与其浪费时间不如直接拒绝。
pinyin: Zhège tíyì háowú shíjì yìyì, yǔqī làngfèi shíjiān búrú zhíjiē jùjué.
en: This proposal is utterly pointless—it's better to refuse outright than waste time on it.

zh: 妈妈提醒我吃饭。
pinyin: Māma tíxǐng wǒ chīfàn.
en: Mom reminds me to eat.

zh: 老师提醒我们明天要考试。
pinyin: Lǎoshī tíxǐng wǒmen míngtiān yào kǎoshì.
en: The teacher reminds us that there's an exam tomorrow.

zh: 虽然天气很好,但朋友还是提醒我带伞。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn hǎo, dàn péngyou háishi tíxǐng wǒ dài sǎn.
en: Even though the weather is nice, my friend still reminds me to bring an umbrella.

zh: 每次出门前,爸爸都会提醒我检查钱包和钥匙。
pinyin: Měi cì chūmén qián, bàba dōu huì tíxǐng wǒ jiǎnchá qiánbāo hé yàoshi.
en: Every time before leaving, my dad reminds me to check my wallet and keys.

zh: 医生多次提醒患者要按时服药,不能掉以轻心。
pinyin: Yīshēng duō cì tíxǐng huànzhě yào ànshí fúyào, búnéng diàoyǐ qīngxīn.
en: The doctor has repeatedly reminded the patient to take medication on time and not to be careless.

zh: 我喜欢旅行。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān lǚxíng.
en: I like traveling.

zh: 今年暑假我们去旅行。
pinyin: Jīnnián shǔjiǎ wǒmen qù lǚxíng.
en: This summer we're going on a trip.

zh: 因为工作很忙，所以我很少去旅行。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò hěn máng, suǒyǐ wǒ hěn shǎo qù lǚxíng.
en: Because work is really busy, I rarely travel.

zh: 虽然旅行花钱很多，但是我认为很值得。
pinyin: Suīrán lǚxíng huāqián hěn duō, dànshì wǒ rènwéi hěn zhíde.
en: Although traveling costs a lot of money, I think it's really worth it.

zh: 与其整天宅在家里，不如抽空出去旅行，开阔一下眼界。
pinyin: Yǔqǐ zhěngtiān zhái zài jiālǐ, búrú chōukòng chūqù lǚxíng, kāikuò yīxià yǎnjiè.
en: Rather than staying cooped up at home all day, why not take some time to travel and broaden your horizons.

zh: 妈妈给我惊喜。
pinyin: Māma gěi wǒ jīngxǐ.
en: Mom gave me a surprise.

zh: 昨天他们给了我一个大惊喜。
pinyin: Zuótiān tāmen gěile wǒ yīgè dà jīngxǐ.
en: Yesterday they gave me a big surprise.

zh: 虽然很累，但收到礼物时我感到惊喜。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn shōudào lǐwù shí wǒ gǎndào jīngxǐ.
en: Even though I was tired, I felt surprised and delighted when I received the gift.

zh: 他精心准备了生日派对，想给女友一个惊喜。
pinyin: Tā jīngxīn zhǔnbèile shēngrì pàiduì, xiǎng gěi nǚyǒu yīgè jīngxǐ.
en: He carefully prepared a birthday party because he wanted to give his girlfriend a surprise.

zh: 看到故乡的老朋友突然出现，她既高兴又惊喜，一时不知道说什么好。
pinyin: Kàndào gùxiāng de lǎo péngyou túrán chūxiàn, tā jì gāoxìng yòu jīngxǐ, yīshí búzhīdào shuō shénme hǎo.
en: When her old hometown friend suddenly appeared, she was so thrilled and surprised that she didn't know what to say.

zh: 他拿走了我的书。
pinyin: Tā názǒu le wǒ de shū.
en: He took my book away.

zh: 妈妈早上拿走了桌子上的苹果。
pinyin: Māma zǎoshang názǒu le zhuōzi shang de píngguǒ.
en: Mom took the apples off the table this morning.

zh: 因为他很饿，所以拿走了厨房里所有的面包。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn饿，suǒyǐ názǒu le chúfáng lǐ suǒyǒu de miànbāo.
en: Because he was very hungry, he took away all the bread in the kitchen.

zh: 虽然我不想失去这件衣服，但他还是把它拿走了。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ búxiǎng shīqù zhè jiàn yīfu, dàn tā háishi bǎ tā názǒu le.
en: Even though I didn't want to lose this piece of clothing, he took it away anyway.

zh: 客户对我们的设计方案很满意，决定把全部文件拿走进行下一步的合作。
pinyin: Kèhù duì wǒmen de shèjì fāng'àn hěn mǎnyì, juéding bǎ quánbù wénjiàn názǒu jìnxíng xiàyībù de hézuò.
en: The client was very satisfied with our design proposal and decided to take all the documents to move forward with the next phase of collaboration.

zh: 我接近他。
pinyin: Wǒ jiēnjìn tā.
en: I'm getting close to him.

zh: 下午三点,我接近了学校。
pinyin: Xiàwǔ sān diǎn, wǒ jiēnjìn le xuéxiào.
en: At three in the afternoon, I approached the school.

zh: 因为天黑了,我们接近了城市,所以看到了灯。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānhēi le, wǒmen jiēnjìn le chéngshì, suǒyǐ kàndào le dēng.
en: Because it was getting dark and we were approaching the city, we could see the lights.

zh: 虽然我们接近了真相,但还有很多问题需要解决。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen jiēnjìn le zhēnxiàng, dàn háiyǒu hěnduō wèntí xūyào jiějué.
en: Although we're getting closer to the truth, there are still many problems we need to solve.

zh: 随着研究深入,科学家们逐渐接近了这个难题的答案。
pinyin: Suízhe yánjiū shēnyù, kēxuéjiā men zhújiàn jiēnjìn le zhège nántí de dáàn.
en: As the research deepened, scientists gradually came closer to finding the answer to this difficult problem.

zh: 警察逮捕了小偷。
pinyin: Jǐngchá dǎibǔ le xiǎotōu.
en: The police arrested the thief.

zh: 昨天警察逮捕了一个坏人。
pinyin: Zuótiān jǐngchá dǎibǔ le yī ge huàirén.
en: Yesterday the police arrested a bad guy.

zh: 因为他偷了东西，所以被警察逮捕了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā tōu le dōngxi, suǒyǐ bèi jǐngchá dǎibǔ le.
en: Because he stole something, he was arrested by the police.

zh: 那个犯罪嫌疑人在机场试图逃跑，但还是被逮捕了。
pinyin: Nàge fànzuì xiányí rén zài jīchǎng shìtú táopǎo, dàn háishi bèi dǎibǔ le.
en: The suspect tried to escape at the airport, but was still arrested.

zh: 警方经过半年调查，最终逮捕了这个诈骗团伙的主要负责人。
pinyin: Jǐngfāng jīngguò bànnián diàochá, zuìzh終dì dǎibǔ le zhège zhàpiàn tuánhuǒ de zhǔyào fùzérén.
en: After six months of investigation, police finally arrested the main leader of this fraud ring.

zh: 他们在吵架。
pinyin: Tāmen zài chǎo jià.
en: They're arguing.

zh: 孩子们早上吵得很厉害。
pinyin: Háizi men zǎo shang chǎo de hěn lìhai.
en: The kids were making a real racket this morning.

zh: 因为噪音太吵，我睡不好觉。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zào yīn tài chǎo, wǒ shuì bu hǎo jiào.
en: Because the noise is too loud, I can't sleep well.

zh: 虽然他们经常吵架，但他们的关系其实很好。
pinyin: Suīrán tāmen jīngcháng chǎo jià, dàn tāmen de guānxi qíshí hěn hǎo.
en: Although they argue a lot, their relationship is actually pretty solid.

zh: 街上的声音太吵了，我没法专心工作。
pinyin: Jiē shang de shēng yīn tài chǎo le, wǒ méi fǎ zhuānxīn gōngzuò.
en: The street noise is too disruptive—I can't concentrate on my work.

zh: 猫在床旁边。
pinyin: Māo zài chuáng páng biān.
en: The cat is next to the bed.

zh: 我妈妈坐在我旁边吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ māma zuò zài wǒ páng biān chīfàn.
en: My mom is sitting beside me eating dinner.

zh: 虽然房间很小，但是旁边有个公园很舒服。
pinyin: Suīrán fángjiān hěn xiǎo, dànshì páng biān yǒu ge gōngyuán hěn shūfu.
en: Although the room is small, it's nice because there's a park right next to it.

zh: 我在咖啡馆旁边的书店找到了这本书。
pinyin: Wǒ zài kāfēiguǎn páng biān de shūdiàn zhǎodào le zhè běn shū.
en: I found this book at the bookstore next to the café.

zh: 办公室旁边的会议室经常有人开会，所以我们工作的时候容易分心。
pinyin: Bàngōngshì páng biān de huìyìshì jīngcháng yǒurén kāihuì, suǒyǐ wǒmen gōngzuò de shíhou róngyì fēnxīn.
en: The conference room next to the office is always busy with meetings, so we get easily distracted while working.

zh: 我很激动。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn jīdòng.
en: I'm very excited.

zh: 他看到礼物时很激动。
pinyin: Tā kàndào lǐwù shí hěn jīdòng.
en: He got really excited when he saw the gift.

zh: 虽然很累，但她还是激动地说起了这个计划。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì tā háishi jīdòngde shuōqǐle zhège jìhuà.
en: Although she was tired, she still talked excitedly about the plan.

zh: 因为赢得了比赛，整个队都激动得说不出话来。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yíngdéle bǐsài, zhěnggè duì dōu jīdòng de shuōbuchu huàlái.
en: Because they won the match, the whole team was so excited they couldn't even speak.

zh: 听到这个消息后，他激动地给家人打了电话。
pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi hòu, tā jīdòngde gěi jiārén dǎle diànhuà.
en: After hearing the news, he eagerly called his family to tell them.

zh: 我很骄傲。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn jiāo'ào.
en: I'm very proud.

zh: 他因为考试成功而骄傲。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi kǎoshì chénggōng ér jiāo'ào.
en: He's proud because he did well on the exam.

zh: 虽然她很骄傲，但是她对朋友很友好。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn jiāo'ào, dànshì tā duì péngyou hěn yǒuhǎo.
en: Although she's proud, she's very friendly to her friends.

zh: 他不应该为一点小成就就骄傲起来。
pinyin: Tā búyīnggāi wèi yīdiǎn xiǎo chéngjiù jiù jiāo'ào qǐlai.
en: He shouldn't become arrogant over such a minor achievement.

zh: 过度的骄傲往往会导致失败，这是很多人的教训。
pinyin: Guòdù de jiāo'ào wǎngwǎng huì dǎozhì shībài, zhè shì hěnduō rén de jiàoxun.
en: Excessive pride often leads to failure—that's a lesson many people have learned.

zh: 这不是苹果，而是橙子。
pinyin: Zhè búshì píngguǒ, érshì chéngzi.
en: This isn't an apple—it's an orange.

zh: 她不喜欢喝茶，而是喜欢喝咖啡。
pinyin: Tā búxǐhuān hēchá, érshì xǐhuān hēkāfēi.
en: She doesn't like drinking tea; she likes drinking coffee instead.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但我们去的不是公园，而是电影院。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dàn wǒmen qù de búshì gōngyuán, érshì diànyǐngyuàn.
en: Although the weather was bad, we didn't go to the park—we went to the cinema instead.

zh: 他辞职的原因不是因为工资低，而是想追求自己真正感兴趣的事业。
pinyin: Tā císhí de yuányīn búshì yīnwèi gōngzī dī, érshì xiǎng zhuīqiú zìjǐ zhēnzhèng gǎn xìngqù de shìyè.
en: The reason he quit wasn't the low salary—it was because he wanted to pursue a career he was truly passionate about.

zh: 这个项目失败的关键不是缺少资金或技术，而是团队之间沟通不足导致的执行力下降。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù shībài de guānjiàn búshì quēshǎo zījīn huò jìshù, érshì tuánduì zhījiān gōutōng búzú dǎozhì de zhíxíng lì xiàjiàng.
en: The real reason this project failed wasn't a lack of funding or expertise—it was poor communication within the team that resulted in decreased execution.

zh: 这把刀很利。
pinyin: Zhè bǎ dāo hěn lì.
en: This knife is very sharp.

zh: 早起对身体有利。
pinyin: Zǎo qǐ duì shēntǐ yǒu lì.
en: Waking up early is good for your health.

zh: 虽然价格高，但这个产品很有利用价值。
pinyin: Suīrán jiàgé gāo, dàn zhège chǎnpǐn hěn yǒu lìyòng jiàzhí.
en: Although the price is high, this product is very useful.

zh: 这个政策对年轻人找工作有利，因为它增加了就业机会。
pinyin: Zhège zhèngcè duì niánqīng rén zhǎo gōngzuò yǒu lì, yīnwèi tā zēngjiāle jiùyè jīhuì.
en: This policy benefits young people looking for jobs because it creates more employment opportunities.

zh: 互联网虽然带来了便利，但我们也要防范它带来的安全风险。
pinyin: Hùliánwǎng suīrán dàiláile biànlì, dàn wǒmen yě yào fángfàn tā dàiláide ānquán fēngxiǎn.
en: The internet certainly brings convenience, but we also need to guard against the security risks it poses.

zh: 这是我的牌。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de pái.
en: This is my card.

zh: 我昨天买了一个新牌子的手机。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān mǎi le yī ge xīn páizi de shǒujī.
en: I bought a new brand of phone yesterday.

zh: 因为他很会打牌，所以朋友们都喜欢和他玩。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn huì dǎ pái, suǒyǐ péngyoumen dōu xǐhuān hé tā wán.
en: Because he's really good at playing cards, his friends all like to play with him.

zh: 虽然这个牌子的衣服比较贵，但是质量特别好。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège páizi de yīfu bǐjiào guì, dànshì zhìliàng tèbié hǎo.
en: Although this brand of clothing is rather expensive, the quality is exceptionally good.

zh: 他在公司里名气很大，已经成了公司的金字招牌。
pinyin: Tā zài gōngsī lǐ míngqi hěn dà, yǐjīng chéng le gōngsī de jīnzì zhāopái.
en: He's built quite a reputation at the company and has become the company's flagship asset.

zh: 我八岁了。
pinyin: Wǒ bā suì le.
en: I'm eight years old.

zh: 今天是八月十五号。
pinyin: Jīntiān shì bāyuè shíwǔ hào.
en: Today is August 15th.

zh: 虽然只有八个苹果，但够全家吃。
pinyin: Suīrán zhǐyǒu bā ge píngguǒ, dàn gòu quánjiā chī.
en: Even though there are only eight apples, they're enough for the whole family to eat.

zh: 公司八点开会，我必须提前十分钟到达。
pinyin: Gōngsī bā diǎn kāihuì, wǒ bìxū tíqián shí fēnzhōng dàodá.
en: The company meeting is at eight o'clock, so I need to arrive ten minutes early.

zh: 这家餐厅每周八点才关门，生意好得不行。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng měi zhōu bā diǎn cái guānmén, shēngyì hǎo de búxíng.
en: This restaurant doesn't close until eight every night—the business is incredibly good.

zh: 我们队有五个成员。
pinyin: Wǒmen duì yǒu wǔ gè chéngyuán.
en: Our team has five members.

zh: 这个小组的成员都很聪明。
pinyin: Zhège xiǎozǔ de chéngyuán dōu hěn cōngming.
en: All the members of this group are very smart.

zh: 因为每个成员都努力工作，所以我们成功了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi měi gè chéngyuán dōu nǔlì gōngzuò, suǒyǐ wǒmen chénggōng le.
en: Because every member worked hard, we succeeded.

zh: 虽然新成员刚来，但他已经适应了团队的工作方式。
pinyin: Suīrán xīn chéngyuán gāng lái, dàn tā yǐjīng shìyìng le tuánduì de gōngzuò fāngshì.
en: Although the new member just arrived, he's already adjusted to the team's working style.

zh: 要想提高团队效率，管理者需要充分了解每位成员的优势和不足。
pinyin: Yào xiǎng tígāo tuánduì xiàolǜ, guǎnlǐzhě xūyào chōngfèn liǎojiě měi wèi chéngyuán de yōush势 hé búzú.
en: To improve team efficiency, managers need to fully understand each member's strengths and weaknesses.

zh: 警察监视那个人。
pinyin: Jǐngchá jiānshì nàge rén.
en: The police are watching that person.

zh: 老师在教室里监视学生。
pinyin: Lǎoshī zài jiàoshì lǐ jiānshì xuésheng.
en: The teacher monitors the students in the classroom.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但他还是监视着公司的工作。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì tā háishi jiānshìzhe gōngsī de gōngzuò.
en: Although he's very busy, he still keeps an eye on the company's work.

zh: 这个新的摄像头可以监视停车场，防止有人偷车。
pinyin: Zhège xīnde shèxiàngtou kěyǐ jiānshì tíngchēchǎng, fángzhǐ yǒurén tōu chē.
en: This new camera can monitor the parking lot to prevent car theft.

zh: 公司安装了先进的系统来监视员工的工作效率和上网情况。
pinyin: Gōngsī ānzhuāngle xiāngjìnde xìtǒng lái jiānshì yuángōng de gōngzuò xiàolǜ hé shàngyǔ qíngkuàng.
en: The company installed an advanced system to monitor employees' work efficiency and internet usage.

zh: 她是女性。
pinyin: Tā shì nǚxìng.
en: She is a woman.

zh: 很多女性喜欢穿裙子。
pinyin: Hěnduō nǚxìng xǐhuān chuān qúnzi.
en: Many women like to wear skirts.

zh: 因为她是女性，所以公司给她特殊待遇。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā shì nǚxìng, suǒyǐ gōngsī gěi tā tèshū dàiyù.
en: Because she's a woman, the company gives her special treatment.

zh: 这个行业虽然有很多女性工作者，但领导大多是男性。
pinyin: Zhège hángyè suīrán yǒu hěnduō nǚxìng gōngzuò zhě, dàn lǐngdǎo dàduōshù shì nánxìng.
en: Although this industry has many female workers, most of the leaders are men.

zh: 越来越多的女性在职场上取得成功，这改变了传统的社会观念。
pinyin: Yuèláiyuè duō de nǚxìng zài zhíchǎng shang qǔdé chénggōng, zhè gǎibiàn le chuántǒng de shèhuì guānniàn.
en: More and more women are achieving success in the workplace, which has shifted traditional social attitudes.

zh: 学生有权利说话。
pinyin: Xuésheng yǒu quánlì shuōhuà.
en: Students have the right to speak.

zh: 每个人都有权利选择自己的工作。
pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu quánlì xuǎnzé zìjǐ de gōngzuò.
en: Everyone has the right to choose their own job.

zh: 虽然她很年轻，但是她有权利做出自己的决定。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn niánqīng, dànshì tā yǒu quánlì zuòchū zìjǐ de juédìng.
en: Even though she's young, she has the right to make her own decisions.

zh: 公司剥夺了员工的休息权利，这是违法的行为。
pinyin: Gōngsī báoduó le yuángōng de xiūxi quánlì, zhè shì wéifǎ de xíngwéi.
en: The company stripped employees of their right to rest, which is illegal.

zh: 在民主社会中，公民不仅享有权利，也必须承担相应的责任。
pinyin: Zài mínzhǔ shèhuì zhōng, gōngmín bújǐn xiǎngyǒu quánlì, yě bìxū chéngdān xiāngyìng de zérèn.
en: In a democratic society, citizens not only enjoy rights but also must shoulder corresponding responsibilities.

zh: 他说谎了。
pinyin: Tā shuōhuǎng le.
en: He lied.

zh: 小孩子不应该说谎。
pinyin: Xiǎoháizi búyīnggāi shuōhuǎng.
en: Children shouldn't lie.

zh: 虽然他说谎了，但是我们还是相信他。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shuōhuǎng le, dànshì wǒmen háishi xiāngxìn tā.
en: Even though he lied, we still believed him.

zh: 因为他经常说谎，所以没人再相信他的话。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā jīngcháng shuōhuǎng, suǒyǐ méi rén zài xiāngxìn tā de huà.
en: Because he lies so often, nobody believes what he says anymore.

zh: 与其说谎骗自己，不如诚实地面对现实。
pinyin: Yǔqī shuōhuǎng piàn zìjǐ, búrú chéngshí de miànduì xiànshí.
en: Rather than lying to yourself, it's better to face reality honestly.

zh: 圣诞节是十二月。
pinyin: Shèngdàn jié shì shíèr yuè.
en: Christmas is in December.

zh: 我们每年都庆祝圣诞节。
pinyin: Wǒmen měi nián dōu qìngzhù shèngdàn jié.
en: We celebrate Christmas every year.

zh: 因为圣诞节快到了，所以很多商店都打折。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shèngdàn jié kuài dào le, suǒyǐ hěnduō shāngdiàn dōu dǎzhé.
en: Because Christmas is coming soon, many stores are having sales.

zh: 虽然圣诞节主要在西方国家庆祝，但现在中国也越来越受欢迎。
pinyin: Suīrán shèngdàn jié zhǔyào zài xīfāng guójiā qìngzhù, dàn xiànzài Zhōngguó yě yuèláiyuè shòu huānyíng.
en: Although Christmas is mainly celebrated in Western countries, it's becoming increasingly popular in China now.

zh: 年轻人对圣诞节的热情丝毫不亚于对春节的期待，这反映了文化交融的现象。
pinyin: Niánqīng rén duì shèngdàn jié de règing sīháo búyà yú duì Chūnjié de qīdài, zhè fǎnyìngle wénhuà jiāoróng de xiànxiàng.
en: Young people are just as enthusiastic about Christmas as they are anticipating Spring Festival, which reflects the phenomenon of cultural fusion.

zh: 他是黑人。
pinyin: Tā shì hēirén.
en: He is Black.

zh: 我的朋友是黑人,很友好。
pinyin: Wǒ de péngyou shì hēirén, hěn yǒuhǎo.
en: My friend is Black, and he's very friendly.

zh: 虽然他是黑人,但是我们是好朋友。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shì hēirén, dànshì wǒmen shì hǎo péngyou.
en: Even though he's Black, we're good friends.

zh: 美国有很多黑人,他们对音乐和体育很有天赋。
pinyin: Měiguó yǒu hěnduō hēirén, tāmen duì yīnyuè hé tǐyù hěn yǒu tiānfù.
en: There are many Black people in America, and they have great talent in music and sports.

zh: 随着全球化发展,越来越多的黑人参与到各个领域的工作中。
pinyin: Suízhe quánqiúhuà fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuèduō de hēirén cānyù dào gè gè lǐngyù de gōngzuò zhōng.
en: With globalization, more and more Black people are participating in work across various fields.

zh: 警方来了。
pinyin: Jǐngfāng lái le.
en: The police arrived.

zh: 昨天警方找到了那个人。
pinyin: Zuótiān jǐngfāng zhǎodào le nàge rén.
en: Yesterday the police found that person.

zh: 因为有人报警，所以警方很快就来了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒurén bàojǐng, suǒyǐ jǐngfāng hěnkuài jiù lái le.
en: Because someone called the police, they came very quickly.

zh: 警方表示这起事件还在调查阶段。
pinyin: Jǐngfāng biǎoshì zhè qǐ shìjiàn háizài diàochá jiēduàn.
en: The police stated that this incident is still under investigation.

zh: 根据警方的说法，嫌疑人已经承认了自己的犯罪行为。
pinyin: Gēnjù jǐngfāng de shuōfǎ, xiányírén yǐjīng chéngrèn le zìjǐ de fànzuì xíngwéi.
en: According to police, the suspect has already admitted to the crime.

zh: 我想去法国。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù Fǎguó.
en: I want to go to France.

zh: 法国的葡萄酒很好喝。
pinyin: Fǎguó de púptàojiǔ hěn hǎohē.
en: French wine tastes really good.

zh: 因为我喜欢美食，所以想去法国旅游。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ xǐhuān měishí, suǒyǐ xiǎng qù Fǎguó lǚyóu.
en: Because I love good food, I want to travel to France.

zh: 他在法国工作了五年，现在已经说得很流利了。
pinyin: Tā zài Fǎguó gōngzuòle wǔ nián, xiànzài yǐjīng shuōde hěn liúlì le.
en: He worked in France for five years and now speaks quite fluently.

zh: 虽然法国的生活成本很高，但很多人还是梦想在那里定居。
pinyin: Suīrán Fǎguó de shēnghuó chéngběn hěn gāo, dàn hěnduō rén háishi mèngxiǎng zài nàli dìngjū.
en: Although the cost of living in France is quite high, many people still dream of settling there.

zh: 这只猫有黑毛。
pinyin: Zhè zhī māo yǒu hēi máo.
en: This cat has black fur.

zh: 冬天我穿毛衣很暖和。
pinyin: Dōngtiān wǒ chuān máoyī hěn nuǎnhuo.
en: I wear a wool sweater in winter and it's really warm.

zh: 虽然这件毛衣很便宜，但是质量很好。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiàn máoyī hěn piányi, dànshì zhìliàng hěn hǎo.
en: Although this sweater is cheap, the quality is actually quite good.

zh: 他因为没有剃毛，所以看起来有点邋遢。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi méiyǒu tì máo, suǒyǐ kàn qǐlai yǒudiǎn lāta.
en: Because he hasn't shaved, he looks a bit scruffy.

zh: 这家店的毛巾质量参差不齐，我建议别在这儿买。
pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de máojīn zhìliàng cānchā búqī, wǒ jiànyì bié zài zhèr mǎi.
en: The towels at this shop are inconsistent in quality—I'd suggest shopping elsewhere.

zh: 我错过了早饭。
pinyin: Wǒ cuòguòle zǎofàn.
en: I missed breakfast.

zh: 昨天我错过了公共汽车。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ cuòguòle gōnggòng qìchē.
en: I missed the bus yesterday.

zh: 因为睡过头，我错过了重要的会议。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shuì guòtóu, wǒ cuòguòle zhòngyào de huìyì.
en: Because I overslept, I missed an important meeting.

zh: 如果你不现在报名，可能会错过这个机会。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ búxiànzài bàomíng, kěnéng huì cuòguò zhège jīhuì.
en: If you don't sign up now, you might miss this opportunity.

zh: 很多人因为害怕失败就选择逃避，最后反而错过了成功的机会。
pinyin: Hěnduō rén yīnwèi hàipà shībài jiù xuǎnzé táobì, zuìhòu fǎn'ér cuòguòle chénggōng de jīhuì.
en: Many people avoid challenges because they're afraid of failure, but in the end they miss their chance to succeed.

zh: 老师警告我们。
pinyin: Lǎoshī jǐnggào wǒmen.
en: The teacher warned us.

zh: 妈妈每天都警告我不要迟到。
pinyin: Māma měitiān dōu jǐnggào wǒ búyào chídào.
en: Mom warns me every day not to be late.

zh: 因为他经常犯错，所以警察给了他一个严肃的警告。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā jīngcháng fànzuò, suǒyǐ jǐngchá gěile tā yīge yánsusu de jǐnggào.
en: Because he kept making mistakes, the police gave him a serious warning.

zh: 尽管公司多次警告员工，但仍有人违反安全规则。
pinyin: Jìnguǎn gōngsī duōcì jǐnggào yuángōng, dàn réng yǒurén wēifǎn ānquán guīzé.
en: Although the company warned employees multiple times, some still broke the safety rules.

zh: 医生的警告让我意识到，继续这样生活习惯会带来严重后果。
pinyin: Yīshēng de jǐnggào ràng wǒ yìshí dào, jìxù zhèyàng shēnghuó xíguàn huì dàilaí yánzhòng hòuguǒ.
en: The doctor's warning made me realize that continuing these lifestyle habits would have serious consequences.

zh: 老天下雨了。
pinyin: Lǎotiān xiàyǔ le.
en: It's raining.

zh: 昨天老天很冷，我穿了厚衣服。
pinyin: Zuótiān lǎotiān hěn lěng, wǒ chuānle hòu yīfu.
en: Yesterday the weather was very cold, so I wore thick clothes.

zh: 虽然老天下雨，但是我们还是去公园玩了。
pinyin: Suīrán lǎotiān xiàyǔ, dànshi wǒmen háishi qù gōngyuán wánle.
en: Even though the weather was rainy, we still went to the park to play.

zh: 最近老天一直不好，我希望周末能晴天。
pinyin: Zuìjìn lǎotiān yìzhí búhǎo, wǒ xīwàng zhōumò néng qíngtiān.
en: The weather has been bad lately, and I'm hoping it'll be sunny this weekend.

zh: 老天不作美，我们的户外婚礼只好改期了。
pinyin: Lǎotiān búzuòměi, wǒmen de húwài hūnlǐ zhǐhǎo gǎiqī le.
en: The weather didn't cooperate, so we had to reschedule our outdoor wedding.

zh: 这个地方很吉利。
pinyin: Zhège dìfang hěn jīlì.
en: This place is very auspicious.

zh: 明天是吉日，我们去旅游吧。
pinyin: Míngtiān shì jīrì, wǒmen qù lǚyóu ba.
en: Tomorrow is a lucky day, so let's go on a trip.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但是大家都说今天吉祥，所以很高兴。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dànshì dàjiā dōu shuō jīntiān jīxiáng, suǒyǐ hěn gāoxìng.
en: Although the weather is bad, everyone says today is fortunate, so we're all happy.

zh: 他买了吉他，因为他想学音乐，所以每天都在练习。
pinyin: Tā mǎile jítā, yīnwèi tā xiǎng xué yīnyuè, suǒyǐ měitiān dōu zài liànxí.
en: He bought a guitar because he wants to learn music, so he practices every day.

zh: 这个项目能否成功取决于团队配合和时机吉凶，我们必须做好充分准备。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù néngfǒu chénggōng qǔjué yú tuánduì pèihé hé shíjī jīxiōng, wǒmen bìxū zuòhǎo chōngfèn zhǔnbèi.
en: Whether this project succeeds depends on teamwork and favorable timing, so we need to prepare thoroughly.

zh: 别惹我的狗。
pinyin: Bié rě wǒ de gǒu.
en: Don't bother my dog.

zh: 他经常惹妈妈生气。
pinyin: Tā jīngcháng rě māma shēngqì.
en: He often annoys his mom and makes her angry.

zh: 因为他惹了麻烦，所以被罚做家务。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā rěle máfan, suǒyǐ bèi fá zuò jiāwù.
en: Because he caused trouble, he was punished by having to do chores.

zh: 小孩子不小心惹翻了咖啡杯，弄脏了桌子。
pinyin: Xiǎoháizi búxiǎoxīn rěfānle kāfēi bēi, nòngzāngle zhuōzi.
en: The little child accidentally knocked over the coffee cup and stained the table.

zh: 他那些不负责任的言论惹恼了很多人，引发了网络讨论。
pinyin: Tā nàxiē búfùzérènren de yánlùn rěnàole hěnduō rén, yǐnfāle wǎngluò tǎolùn.
en: His irresponsible remarks irritated a lot of people and sparked discussions online.

zh: 这是一个酒店。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè jiǔdiàn.
en: This is a hotel.

zh: 我们明天要去酒店住一晚。
pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān yào qù jiǔdiàn zhù yī wǎn.
en: We're going to stay at a hotel for one night tomorrow.

zh: 因为飞机晚到了，所以我们住进了酒店。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fēijī wǎn dàole, suǒyǐ wǒmen zhù jìnle jiǔdiàn.
en: Because the plane arrived late, we ended up checking into a hotel.

zh: 这家酒店虽然价格便宜，但是房间很舒服。
pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔdiàn suīrán jiàgé piányi, dànshì fángjiān hěn shūfu.
en: Although this hotel's prices are affordable, the rooms are quite comfortable.

zh: 出差时我通常会选择靠近公司的酒店，这样可以节省时间。
pinyin: Chūchāi shí wǒ tōngcháng huì xuǎnzé kàojìn gōngsī de jiǔdiàn, zhèyàng kěyǐ jiéshěng shíjiān.
en: When I'm on a business trip, I usually book a hotel near the office to save time.

zh: 我抽烟。
pinyin: Wǒ chōu yān.
en: I smoke.

zh: 他经常抽出时间运动。
pinyin: Tā jīngcháng chōu chū shíjiān yùndòng.
en: He regularly makes time to exercise.

zh: 虽然很忙，但他还是抽空看了电影。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn máng, dànshì tā háishi chōu kòng kàn le diànyǐng.
en: Even though he was busy, he still found time to watch a movie.

zh: 抽签的时候，他非常紧张，最后抽到了特等奖。
pinyin: Chōuqiān de shíhou, tā fēicháng jǐnzhāng, zuìhòu chōu dào le tèděng jiǎng.
en: When drawing lots, he was very nervous, and in the end he drew the grand prize.

zh: 这个项目虽然资金紧张，但团队还是想办法抽调了最优秀的人员。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù suīrán zījīn jǐnzhāng, dànshì tuánduì háishi xiǎng bànfǎ chōudiào le zuì yōuxiù de rényuán.
en: Despite tight funding for this project, the team managed to reassign the most talented personnel.

zh: 我喜欢吃苹果、香蕉之类的。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān chī píngguǒ, xiāngjiāo zhīlèi de.
en: I like eating things like apples and bananas.

zh: 他每天都看书、玩游戏之类的事情。
pinyin: Tā měitiān dōu kànshū, wán yóuxì zhīlèi de shìqing.
en: Every day he does things like reading books and playing games.

zh: 因为天气不好，我们取消了运动、郊游之类的活动。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, wǒmen qǔxiāole yùndòng, jiāoyóu zhīlèi de huódòng.
en: Because the weather was bad, we cancelled activities like sports and outings.

zh: 公司要求员工穿正装、守时之类的，但对工作方式很灵活。
pinyin: Gōngsī yāoqiú yuángōng chuān zhèngzhuāng, shǒushí zhīlèi de, dàn duì gōngzuò fāngshì hěn línghuó.
en: The company requires things like formal dress and punctuality, but it's quite flexible about how you actually work.

zh: 关于薪资、假期之类的福利问题，员工们一直有意见，公司也开始重视。
pinyin: Guānyú薪zī, jiàqī zhīlèi de fúlì wèntí, yuángōngmen yīzhí yǒu yìjiàn, gōngsī yě kāishǐ zhòngshì.
en: When it comes to benefits like salary and time off, employees have always had complaints, and the company is finally starting to take it seriously.

zh: 他是王。
pinyin: Tā shì Wáng.
en: His surname is Wang.

zh: 王老师今天教我们英语。
pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī jīntiān jiāo wǒmen yīngyǔ.
en: Teacher Wang taught us English today.

zh: 虽然王很忙，但是他还是帮我做了功课。
pinyin: Suīrán Wáng hěn máng, dànshì tā háishi bāng助 wǒ zuòle gōngkè.
en: Although Wang was busy, he still helped me with my homework.

zh: 王因为工作压力大，最近看起来特别疲劳。
pinyin: Wáng yīnwèi gōngzuò yālì dà, zuìjìn kàn qǐlai tèbié píláo.
en: Wang looks particularly tired lately because of heavy work pressure.

zh: 王虽然出身普通，但凭借努力成为了公司的核心管理人员。
pinyin: Wáng suīrán chūshēn pǔtōng, dàn píngjiè nǔlì chéngwéile gōngsī de héxin guǎnlǐ rényuán.
en: Despite humble beginnings, Wang became a key manager at the company through sheer hard work.

zh: 他是冠军。
pinyin: Tā shì guànjūn.
en: He is the champion.

zh: 去年她赢得了冠军。
pinyin: Qùnián tā yíngdéle le guànjūn.
en: Last year she won the championship.

zh: 因为他训练很努力，所以他成为了冠军。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā xùnliàn hěn nǔlì, suǒyǐ tā chéngwéile le guànjūn.
en: Because he trained so hard, he became the champion.

zh: 虽然比赛很困难，但这位运动员最后赢得了冠军。
pinyin: Suīrán bǐsài hěn kùnnan, dàn zhè wèi yùndòngyuán zuìhòu yíngdéle guànjūn.
en: Although the competition was tough, the athlete ultimately won the championship.

zh: 经过多年的坚持和付出，他终于实现了成为冠军的梦想。
pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de jiānchí hé fùchū, tā zhōngyú shíxiànle le chéngwéi guànjūn de mèngxiǎng.
en: After years of persistence and hard work, he finally achieved his dream of becoming a champion.

zh: 我想尝试吃寿司。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chángshì chī shòusī.
en: I want to try eating sushi.

zh: 昨天我尝试了做新菜。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ chángshìle zuò xīn cài.
en: Yesterday I tried making a new dish.

zh: 虽然很难，但是我想尝试学习这个新技能。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dànshì wǒ xiǎng chángshì xuéxí zhège xīn jìnéng.
en: Even though it's difficult, I still want to try learning this new skill.

zh: 公司决定尝试使用新的营销方式来吸引更多客户。
pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng chángshì shǐyòng xīnde yíngxiāo fāngshi lái xīyǐn gèngduō kèhù.
en: The company decided to try using a new marketing approach to attract more customers.

zh: 与其等待完美的时机，不如现在就尝试去实现你的想法。
pinyin: Yǔqī děngdài wánměi de shíjī, búrú xiànzài jiù chángshì qù shíxiàn nǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
en: Rather than wait for the perfect moment, you might as well try putting your ideas into action now.

zh: 我的教练很好。
pinyin: Wǒ de jiàoliàn hěn hǎo.
en: My coach is very nice.

zh: 今天教练教我们打篮球。
pinyin: Jīntiān jiàoliàn jiāo wǒmen dǎ lánqiú.
en: Today the coach taught us how to play basketball.

zh: 虽然教练很严格，但是我们都很尊重他。
pinyin: Suīrán jiàoliàn hěn yángé, dànshì wǒmen dōu hěn zūnzhòng tā.
en: Although the coach is strict, we all respect him a lot.

zh: 因为我最近进步了，教练决定让我参加比赛。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ zuìjìn jìnbù le, jiàoliàn juédìng ràng wǒ cānjiā bǐsài.
en: Because I've improved recently, the coach decided to let me compete in the match.

zh: 那位教练虽然要求严苛，却能把学生的潜力激发出来。
pinyin: Nà wèi jiàoliàn suīrán yāoqiú yánkē, què néng bǎ xuésheng de qiánlì jīfā chūlái.
en: That coach, despite being demanding, has a real gift for unlocking students' potential.

zh: 我常吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ cháng chī mǐfàn.
en: I eat rice all the time.

zh: 她常常在早上喝咖啡。
pinyin: Tā chángcháng zài zǎoshang hē kāfēi.
en: She usually drinks coffee in the morning.

zh: 因为天气常常下雨，所以我们不能去公园。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì chángcháng xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen búnéng qù gōngyuán.
en: Because it rains frequently, we can't go to the park.

zh: 在北京工作的人常会感到压力很大。
pinyin: Zài Běijīng gōngzuò de rén cháng huì gǎndào yālì hěn dà.
en: People who work in Beijing often feel a lot of pressure.

zh: 他虽然工作很忙，但常抽时间陪孩子，这点值得学习。
pinyin: Tā suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn cháng chōu shíjiān péi háizi, zhè diǎn zhídé xuéxí.
en: Although he's busy with work, he regularly makes time for his kids—that's something to admire.

zh: 我喜欢对方。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān duìfāng.
en: I like the other person.

zh: 昨天我和对方一起吃饭。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hé duìfāng yīqǐ chīfàn.
en: Yesterday I had a meal together with the other person.

zh: 虽然对方很忙,但是他还是来帮我了。
pinyin: Suīrán duìfāng hěn máng, dànshì tā háishi lái bāng wǒ le.
en: Even though the other person was busy, they still came to help me.

zh: 这个问题我需要先了解对方的想法才能决定。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí wǒ xūyào xiān liǎojiě duìfāng de xiǎngfǎ cái néng juéding.
en: For this issue, I need to understand the other person's thoughts first before I can decide.

zh: 谈判时要换位思考,多考虑对方的立场和利益。
pinyin: Tǎnpàn shí yào huànyuè sīkǎo, duō kǎolǜ duìfāng de lìchǎng hé lìyì.
en: During negotiations, you need to put yourself in the other side's shoes and consider their position and interests more carefully.

zh: 我随时可以帮你。
pinyin: Wǒ suíshí kěyǐ bāng nǐ.
en: I can help you anytime.

zh: 你随时可以给我打电话。
pinyin: Nǐ suíshí kěyǐ gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
en: You can call me whenever you want.

zh: 因为天气可能变化，我们随时准备好雨伞。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì kěnéng biànhuà, wǒmen suíshí zhǔnbèi hǎo yǔsǎn.
en: Since the weather might change, we're always ready with an umbrella.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但随时都在想怎样帮助我们。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn suíshí dōu zài xiǎng zěnyàng bāngzhù wǒmen.
en: Even though he's busy, he's always thinking about how to help us.

zh: 在这个信息时代，人们需要随时保持警惕，以免被骗。
pinyin: Zài zhège xìnxī shídài, rénmen xūyào suíshí bǎochí jǐngtì, yǐmiǎn bèi piàn.
en: In this information age, people need to stay alert at all times to avoid being scammed.

zh: 我弹吉他。
pinyin: Wǒ tán jítā.
en: I play the guitar.

zh: 她每天都弹钢琴，很开心。
pinyin: Tā měitiān dōu tán gāngqín, hěn kāixīn.
en: She plays piano every day and really enjoys it.

zh: 因为他弹得很好，所以大家都喜欢听他的音乐。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā tán de hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ dàjiā dōu xǐhuān tīng tā de yīnyuè.
en: Because he plays so well, everyone loves listening to his music.

zh: 虽然弹钢琴很难，但是经过练习她现在弹得相当不错。
pinyin: Suīrán tán gāngqín hěn nán, dànshì jīngguò liànxí tā xiànzài tán de xiāngdāng búcuò.
en: Although playing piano is difficult, through practice she now plays quite well.

zh: 他不仅弹得一手好琴，还能把复杂的曲子改编成通俗版本。
pinyin: Tā bújǐn tán de yī shǒu hǎo qín, háinéng bǎ fùzá de qūzi gǎibiān chéng tōngsú bǎnběn.
en: Not only is he an accomplished pianist, but he can also arrange complex pieces into popular versions.

zh: 他是我的敌人。
pinyin: Tā shì wǒ de díren.
en: He is my enemy.

zh: 昨天我在学校看到了敌人。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài xuéxiào kàndàole díren.
en: I saw my enemy at school yesterday.

zh: 虽然他是敌人，但是我们可以一起工作。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shì díren, dànshì wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ gōngzuò.
en: Even though he's an enemy, we can still work together.

zh: 我们需要了解敌人的想法才能打败他们。
pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào liǎojiě díren de xiǎngfǎ cáinéng dǎbài tāmen.
en: We need to understand our enemies' thinking in order to defeat them.

zh: 知己知彼，百战不殆；不知敌人就很容易吃亏。
pinyin: Zhī jǐ zhī bǐ, bǎi zhàn bù dài; búzhī díren jiù hěn róngyì chīkuī.
en: Know yourself and know your enemy, and you'll never lose a battle; not understanding your enemy makes it easy to suffer losses.

zh: 他是我的搭档。
pinyin: Tā shì wǒ de dàdàng.
en: He is my partner.

zh: 我和搭档一起工作。
pinyin: Wǒ hé dàdàng yìqǐ gōngzuò.
en: My partner and I work together.

zh: 虽然搭档很忙，但是他还是帮助我。
pinyin: Suīrán dàdàng hěn máng, búguò tā háishi bāngzhù wǒ.
en: Although my partner is very busy, he still helps me.

zh: 因为有了好搭档，这个项目才能按时完成。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu le hǎo dàdàng, zhège xiàngmù cái néng ànshí wánchéng.
en: Because we have a good partner, we were able to finish the project on time.

zh: 在这个团队里，找到志同道合的搭档并不容易。
pinyin: Zài zhège tuánduì lǐ, zhǎodào zhìtóngdàohé de dàdàng bìng búróngyì.
en: In this team, it's not easy to find a partner who shares the same values and goals.

zh: 我从未吃过米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ cóngwèi chīguò mǐfàn.
en: I've never eaten rice.

zh: 她从未去过中国，但想去。
pinyin: Tā cóngwèi qùguò Zhōngguó, dàn xiǎng qù.
en: She's never been to China, but she wants to go.

zh: 虽然他从未学过英语，但他能听懂一些。
pinyin: Suīrán tā cóngwèi xuéguò Yīngyǔ, dàn tā néng tīngdǒng yīxiē.
en: Although he's never studied English, he can understand some of it.

zh: 这种情况在我们公司从未发生过，所以大家都很担心。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng zài wǒmen gōngsī cóngwèi fāshēngguò, suǒyǐ dàjiā dōu hěn dānxīn.
en: This kind of situation has never happened at our company before, so everyone is very worried.

zh: 他从未对自己的决定后悔过，这种自信在职场上帮了他很大忙。
pinyin: Tā cóngwèi duì zìjǐ de juéding hòuhuǐguò, zhè zhǒng zìxìn zài zhíchǎng shang bāngle tā hěn dà máng.
en: He's never regretted any of his decisions, and that kind of confidence has been a huge asset to him in his career.

zh: 这是我的帐。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de zhàng.
en: This is my account.

zh: 昨天我查了银行帐户。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ chá le yínháng zhànghu.
en: Yesterday I checked my bank account.

zh: 因为公司的帐目不清楚，所以经理很生气。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngsī de zhàngmù búqīngchu, suǒyǐ jīnglǐ hěn shēngqì.
en: Because the company's accounts were unclear, the manager was very angry.

zh: 虽然他记帐很仔细，但有时还是会出现小错误。
pinyin: Suīrán tā jìzhàng hěn zǐxì, dàn yǒushíhou háishi huì chūxiàn xiǎo cuòwù.
en: Although he keeps accounts very carefully, small mistakes sometimes still slip through.

zh: 这家公司因为长期做假帐，最后被税务部门查处了。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yīnwèi chángqī zuò jiǎzhàng, zuìhou bèi shuìwù bùmén chāchǔ le.
en: This company ultimately got caught by the tax bureau for cooking the books over a long period.

zh: 我和妈妈谈话。
pinyin: Wǒ hé māma tánhuà.
en: I'm talking with my mom.

zh: 昨天我和朋友谈话很久。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hé péngyou tánhuà hěn jiǔ.
en: Yesterday I had a long conversation with my friend.

zh: 因为有问题，所以我们谈话了半小时。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu wèntí, suǒyǐ wǒmen tánhuà le bàn xiǎoshí.
en: Because there was an issue, we talked for half an hour.

zh: 经理和员工每周都要谈话，讨论工作进展。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ hé yuángōng měi zhōu dōu yào tánhuà, tǎolùn gōngzuò jìnzhǎn.
en: The manager and employees have a conversation every week to discuss work progress.

zh: 心理医生通过谈话了解患者的想法，这对治疗非常重要。
pinyin: Xīnlǐ yīshēng tōngguò tánhuà liǎojiě huànzhě de xiǎngfǎ, zhè duì zhìliáo fēicháng zhòngyào.
en: The therapist gains insight into the patient's thoughts through conversation, which is crucial for treatment.

zh: 今天温度很高。
pinyin: Jīntiān wēndù hěn gāo.
en: The temperature is very high today.

zh: 冬天的温度比夏天低很多。
pinyin: Dōngtiān de wēndù bǐ xiàtiān dī hěn duō.
en: Winter temperatures are much lower than summer temperatures.

zh: 因为温度太低，所以我们不能去游泳。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wēndù tài dī, suǒyǐ wǒmen búnéng qù yóuyǒng.
en: Because the temperature is too cold, we can't go swimming.

zh: 虽然他的工作很忙，但是他对待顾客的态度总是很好。
pinyin: Suīrán tā de gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì tā duìdài gùkè de tàidù zǒngshì hěn hǎo.
en: Even though his job keeps him busy, his attitude toward customers is always excellent.

zh: 我们需要以开放的心态和态度去接受不同的文化观点。
pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào yǐ kāifàng de xīntài hé tàidù qù jiēshòu búntóng de wénhuà guāndiǎn.
en: We need to approach and accept different cultural perspectives with an open mindset and attitude.

zh: 我背着书包。
pinyin: Wǒ bēizhe shūbāo.
en: I'm carrying my backpack.

zh: 昨天我背了十个英文单词。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ bèile shí ge yīngwén dānncí.
en: Yesterday I memorized ten English words.

zh: 因为他背疼，所以不能去运动。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā bèi téng, suǒyǐ búnéng qù yùndòng.
en: Because his back hurts, he can't go exercise.

zh: 虽然背了很多课文，但他在考试时还是忘了一些。
pinyin: Suīrán bèile hěnduō kèwén, dànshì tā zài kǎoshì shí háishi wàngle yīxiē.
en: Even though he memorized lots of texts, he still forgot some parts during the exam.

zh: 他背地里说了你坏话，这事背后肯定有原因。
pinyin: Tā bèidì li shuōle nǐ huàihuà, zhè shì bèihòu kěndìng yǒu yuányīn.
en: He was talking trash about you behind your back—there's definitely a reason for it.

zh: 今天是春节。
pinyin: Jīntiān shì chūnjié.
en: Today is Spring Festival.

zh: 我们每年都过春节。
pinyin: Wǒmen měi nián dōu guò chūnjié.
en: We celebrate Spring Festival every year.

zh: 因为要过节，所以商店今天关门了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yào guò jié, suǒyǐ shāngdiàn jīntiān guānmén le.
en: Because it's a holiday, the shops are closed today.

zh: 虽然节目很长，但是观众都看得很认真。
pinyin: Suīrán jiémù hěn cháng, dànshì guānzhòng dōu kàn de hěn rènzhēn.
en: Although the program was long, the audience watched it very attentively.

zh: 他在节食减肥的过程中坚持运动，效果特别明显。
pinyin: Tā zài jiéshí jiǎnféi de guòchéng zhōng jiānchí yùndòng, xiàoguǒ tèbié míngxiǎn.
en: While dieting and exercising consistently through his weight-loss journey, he saw particularly impressive results.

zh: 我们排队买票。
pinyin: Wǒmen pái duì mǎi piào.
en: We're lining up to buy tickets.

zh: 早上很多人排队等公交车。
pinyin: Zǎoshang hěn duō rén pái duì děng gōngjiāo chē.
en: In the morning, lots of people queue up waiting for the bus.

zh: 虽然排队的人很多，但是我们还是等了下来。
pinyin: Suīrán pái duì de rén hěn duō, dànshì wǒmen háishi děngle xiàlái.
en: Although there were many people in the queue, we waited anyway.

zh: 餐厅每个周末都要排很长的队，因为菜特别好吃。
pinyin: Cāntīng měi ge zhōumò dōu yào pái hěn cháng de duì, yīnwèi cài tèbié hǎochī.
en: The restaurant has to deal with long queues every weekend because the food is really tasty.

zh: 公司排查了所有的安全隐患，确保员工的工作环境。
pinyin: Gōngsī pái chá le suǒyǒu de ānquán yǐnhuàn, quèbǎo yuángōng de gōngzuò huánjìng.
en: The company identified and checked all safety hazards to ensure a secure working environment for employees.

zh: 约翰是我的朋友。
pinyin: Yuēhàn shì wǒ de pényou.
en: John is my friend.

zh: 约翰今天穿了一件蓝色的衣服。
pinyin: Yuēhàn jīntiān chuānle yī jiàn lánsè de yīfu.
en: John wore a blue shirt today.

zh: 虽然约翰很忙，但是他还是来帮助我们。
pinyin: Suīrán Yuēhàn hěn máng, dànshì tā háishi lái bāngzhù wǒmen.
en: Although John was busy, he still came to help us.

zh: 因为约翰在公司工作多年，所以他对这个项目很有经验。
pinyin: Yīnwèi Yuēhàn zài gōngsī gōngzuò duō nián, suǒyǐ tā duì zhège xiàngmù hěn yǒu jīngyàn.
en: Because John has worked at the company for many years, he has a lot of experience with this project.

zh: 约翰提出的建议虽然看似简单，但实际上解决了我们长期遇到的难题。
pinyin: Yuēhàn tíchūle de jiànyì suīrán kànsì jiǎndān, dàn shíjìshang jiějuéle wǒmen chángqī yùdào de nántí.
en: The suggestion John put forward seemed simple on the surface, but it actually solved a persistent problem we'd been facing.

zh: 我有许多书。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu xǔduō shū.
en: I have a lot of books.

zh: 今天许多人来我家吃饭。
pinyin: Jīntiān xǔduō rén lái wǒ jiā chīfàn.
en: A lot of people came to my house to eat today.

zh: 虽然许多学生很累，但是他们还在继续学习。
pinyin: Suīrán xǔduō xuésheng hěn lèi, dànshì tāmen háizài jìxù xuéxí.
en: Although many students are tired, they keep studying anyway.

zh: 这家餐厅因为食物好吃吸引了许多顾客，生意很不错。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng yīnwèi shíwù hǎochī xīyǐnle xǔduō gùkè, shēngyì hěn búcuò.
en: This restaurant has attracted many customers because the food is delicious, and business is doing really well.

zh: 许多人说学外语很难，但只要坚持练习，就能事半功倍。
pinyin: Xǔduō rén shuō xué wàiyǔ hěn nán, dàn zhǐyào jiānchí liànxí, jiù néng shìbàn gōngbèi.
en: Many people say learning a foreign language is difficult, but if you stick with practice, you can achieve great results with less effort.

zh: 这个人物很有趣。
pinyin: Zhège rénwù hěn yǒuqù.
en: This character is very interesting.

zh: 电影里的主要人物叫什么名字？
pinyin: Diànyǐng lǐ de zhǔyào rénwù jiào shénme míngzi?
en: What's the name of the main character in the movie?

zh: 虽然这个人物很坏，但是观众还是喜欢他。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège rénwù hěn huài, dànshi guānzhòng háishi xǐhuān tā.
en: Even though this character is bad, the audience still likes him.

zh: 作者通过这个人物的经历表达了自己的想法。
pinyin: Zuòzhě tōngguò zhège rénwù de jīnglì biǎodá le zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
en: The author expressed his own thoughts through this character's experiences.

zh: 小说中的人物设定得很复杂，既不是绝对的好人也不是坏人。
pinyin: Xiǎoshuō zhōng de rénwù shèdìng de hěn fùzá, jì búshì juéduì de hǎorén yě búshì huàirén.
en: The characters in the novel are set up in a complex way—they're neither absolutely good nor bad.
